cmp:13acfwj0ms8ydz.why: Each running for a term: 'for' in 13:2 and 35:13, 'to' in 31:29. Memorizer set contained in the four-ayah card on the same words.

cmp:1nxz8w70m4j8q3.why: Two neighbouring ayat on the earth's signs, ending for people who reflect and for people who reason. Memorizer pair; the endings fit each sign.
cmp:1nxz8w70m4j8q3.relation: The broad layout of the earth calls for reflection; differing fruits from one water call for reason.

cmp:0xv55pp1uyp9ul.why: The disbelievers ask why no sign was sent down, twice in al-Ra'd, answered differently (you are only a warner; God leads astray whom He wills). Memorizer pair.
cmp:0xv55pp1uyp9ul.relation: The same demand answered once by the Prophet's role, once by God's will in guidance.

cmp:1pav83h1goq45j.why: To God prostrates whoever (13:15, 22:18) or whatever (16:49) is in the heavens and the earth, with different lists. Memorizer set and a theme worth pondering.
cmp:1pav83h1goq45j.relation: All creation bows to God, willingly or unwillingly, even shadows.

cmp:0vx02201hmza3q.why: To God prostrates whoever or whatever is in the heavens and the earth: 'who' with willing and unwilling, 'what' with creatures and angels. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1vgengz18nn82n.why: Idols own no benefit or harm for themselves (13:16) or no harm or benefit (25:3). The order is a classic memorizer trap.

cmp:0sw2jhz10s1cqp.why: A single ayah (13:17). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:1utpyp80kgefrc.why: Those who join what God commanded to be joined (13:21) and those who cut it (13:25). A direct contrast in the same words; memorizer pair worth pondering.
cmp:1utpyp80kgefrc.relation: Contrast: the people of reason keep ties God ordered; the cursed cut them.

cmp:057jb5o0o2v16s.why: God extends provision to whom He wills and restricts it: with or without 'of His servants' and 'for him', and different endings. Core memorizer set.

cmp:07ht2ut1g9qmkn.why: Four of the five places of God extending and restricting provision. Contained in the larger card but a valid memorizer set.

cmp:0nlcy7w1ccvycu.why: I gave respite to the disbelievers then seized them: how was My punishment, or how was My reproach. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1d6mquv1e7m2e7.why: Thus We sent it down as an Arabic judgement (13:37) or an Arabic Quran (20:113). Memorizer pair.

cmp:16vds290ztysi7.why: We sent messengers before you, then 'no messenger may bring a sign except by God's leave', with different middles and endings. Memorizer pair.

cmp:06xpobg15uooi4.why: We sent messengers before you (13:38) or before you messengers (30:47). The word order is the memorizer trap.

cmp:1pw0wax0pkp8en.why: God suffices as witness between me and you: 'witness' before or after 'between me and you', and different endings. Classic memorizer set.

cmp:1iu1w8n1vi75q1.why: To the path of the Mighty, the Praised (14:1, 34:6) or of the Praised alone (22:24). Memorizer set.

cmp:01qhoop1uh4nc1.why: Let the believers rely on God, then let those who rely rely on God: two neighbouring ayat with the same words of the messengers. Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:01qhoop1uh4nc1.relation: Reliance is first a mark of faith, then a quality of those who have learned it.

cmp:09x3dnn0w8sxuz.why: He created the heavens and earth and sent down water from the sky: with 'for you' added and different results. Memorizer pair.

cmp:14ov5po05mdijq.why: If you count God's favours you cannot number them: man is unjust and ungrateful (14:34), God is forgiving and merciful (16:18). Memorizer pair and a striking contrast.
cmp:14ov5po05mdijq.relation: The same countless favours, met by man's ingratitude and by God's forgiveness.

cmp:015xb7y0fv4id2.why: So that people of understanding take heed, in two forms of the verb (14:52, 38:29). Memorizer pair.

cmp:0wgjvu814jpy0e.why: Verses of the Book and a clear Quran (15:1) against verses of the Quran and a clear Book (27:1). A neat inversion for memorizers.

cmp:1c5wy1x1do7epz.why: A single ayah (15:7). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:0cov1m71xd0z8v.why: We sent before you among the sects of old, or how many prophets We sent among the ancients; then 'no messenger or prophet came to them but they mocked him'. The run-ons hold the matching sentence.
cmp:0cov1m71xd0z8v.relation: Every messenger was mocked; the Prophet is consoled by their example.

cmp:0yuvrck0g67j8e.why: Thus We insert it in the hearts of the criminals: present tense in 15:12, past in 26:200. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1c5tb240w4lp0e.why: O Iblis, what is with you (15:32) or what prevented you (38:75). Same story; memorizer pair.

cmp:0z0ay4s1ys7sh2.why: Abraham given glad tidings of a boy: knowing (15:53, 51:28) or forbearing (37:101). The books link the knowing boy to Isaac and the forbearing one to Ishmael; good for memorizers and pondering.
cmp:0z0ay4s1ys7sh2.relation: Two sons promised with two different qualities.

cmp:1s21vvz0j7qywb.why: In that are signs for those who discern (15:75) and a sign for the believers (15:77, 29:44): plural or singular with different audiences. Memorizer set.

cmp:0hn3rfl12jlgod.why: Two ayat apart in al-Hijr: signs for the discerning, then a sign for the believers. Memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp:0e8a5230lzvejv.why: Lower your wing to the believers (15:88) or to those of the believers who follow you (26:215). Memorizer pair and the same gentle command.

cmp:1pe9w0x1w9qvbf.why: Seven endings in al-Nahl: a sign or signs for people who reflect, reason, remember, hear, believe. Core memorizer set; each ending fits its sign.
cmp:1pe9w0x1w9qvbf.relation: Each blessing calls on a different faculty of the listener.

cmp:0p4558q0nwlnqc.why: Three consecutive ayat of al-Nahl ending reflect, reason, remember, with sign or signs. The books explain each ending; tight memorizer set.

cmp:1k6l7q207dlbk6.why: Fresh meat and ornaments from the sea and ships cleaving through it: word order of 'in it' and 'cleaving' and the conjunction before 'to seek' change. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:05r605d0lxdh8x.why: What has your Lord sent down: the disbelievers answer 'tales of the ancients', the God-fearing answer 'good'. Same question, opposite answers; memorizer pair worth pondering.
cmp:05r605d0lxdh8x.relation: Contrast: one question, answered with scorn and with gratitude.

cmp:0ib65bi0hioxr0.why: Enter the gates of Hell to abide in it: with 'so', 'it is said', or bare, and the emphatic letter only in 16:29. Classic memorizer set.

cmp:1ocbqxr10zgm9p.why: Neighbouring ayat: evil is the abode of the arrogant (16:29) and excellent is the home of the God-fearing (16:30). A direct contrast worth pondering.
cmp:1ocbqxr10zgm9p.relation: Contrast: the lodging of the arrogant and the home of the pious, side by side.

cmp:034r69l07xyair.why: The evils of what they did or earned struck them or appeared to them, then what they mocked surrounded them. Four places; core memorizer set.

cmp:129k9f40jx9e2s.why: The evils of what they did (16:34) or earned (39:51) struck them, with different continuations. Memorizer pair contained in the four-ayah card.

cmp:0qw6b3c13t4e5i.why: Have they not seen: with 'and' or 'so', followed by shadows, plants, provision, sky and earth, birds. Memorizer set on the opening particle; each sign worth pondering.

cmp:0tl11w91oe5fxv.why: Calling on God in distress and associating once relieved, then 'to deny what We gave them; so enjoy, you will know' in three surahs. Same theme; the run-ons carry the matching endings.
cmp:0tl11w91oe5fxv.relation: Ingratitude after rescue, met by the same warning.

cmp:1sz2snl1l42sv1.why: To deny what We gave them; so enjoy, you will know (16:55, 30:34) against 'and let them enjoy, they will know' (29:66). A precise memorizer set.

cmp:19h3z9c1yha5b6.why: His is the highest description, and He is the Mighty, the Wise: with 'in the heavens and the earth' added in 30:27. Memorizer pair.

cmp:05kbnpo149ucg0.why: If God took people to account: for their wrongdoing or for what they earned, on it or on its back, and two endings. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:0nrhol20fodkrw.why: Three ayat of al-Nahl on rain, fruits and honey ending: a sign for people who hear, reason, reflect. Memorizer set the books explain.

cmp:0keipsy1cuj3zu.why: After its death or after knowledge, with or without 'from' before 'after'. The book explains the extra particle; a precise memorizer set.

cmp:0onscfo113x4nc.why: In cattle is a lesson; We give you drink from their bellies: masculine pronoun in 16:66, feminine in 23:21, with different continuations. A famous memorizer pair.

cmp:0wgj3ik1070j9k.why: Some of you are returned to the most decrepit age so that they know nothing after knowing: with 'from' and the merged particle in 22:5. Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:0wgj3ik1070j9k.relation: Old age that strips knowledge, used as a sign of God's power over life stages.

cmp:0nt10o80vl8hmo.why: Do they believe in falsehood and deny God's favour: with the pronoun 'they' only in 16:72. Memorizer pair.

cmp:15jhfo71rx31sz.why: He gave you hearing, sight and hearts: so you may give thanks (16:78) or little do you thank (23:78, 67:23), with made or produced. Memorizer set and worth pondering.
cmp:15jhfo71rx31sz.relation: The same gifts, meant for gratitude yet rarely thanked.

cmp:1r5aotq093areq.why: Have they not seen the birds: subjected in the sky (16:79) or spreading and folding their wings (67:19), held only by God or the Most Merciful. Memorizer pair on the same sign.

cmp:1e5zlml1aw2nc1.why: On the Day We raise a witness from every nation (16:84) or in every nation (16:89). Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:1tou1650lekjx5.why: Guidance and glad tidings for the Muslims, closing two ayat of al-Nahl on the Book sent down, with 'mercy' added in 16:89. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1ou0vkj03zkm65.why: You will be asked about what you did (16:93), against: you will not be asked about our crimes nor we about your deeds (34:25). The book compares the wording; a theme of individual accountability.
cmp:1ou0vkj03zkm65.relation: Each answers for his own deeds.

cmp:0meabeo1hqfiio.why: We will reward them their due by the best of what they did: 'what' in al-Nahl, 'that which' in al-Zumar, with different verbs. Memorizer set.

cmp:1kbocjc0yc1fm4.why: Reward by the best of what (16:96) or of that which (39:35) they did. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1mdzv690xqfjev.why: Then your Lord, to those who emigrated after persecution, and to those who did wrong in ignorance then repented: after that He is forgiving and merciful. Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:1mdzv690xqfjev.relation: Forgiveness opened to two groups: the persecuted who strove and the sinners who repented.

cmp:0ge0x0w10ctfoi.why: Do not grieve over them nor be in distress at their plotting: the verb shortened in 16:127, full in 27:70, with 'be patient' only in the first. Memorizer pair.

cmp:19bho2x0wwvswt.why: The command to be patient in seven places, with 'and', 'so' or nothing before it, and different objects (with God's help, with the believers, at what they say, for your Lord's judgement). Memorizer set and a theme worth pondering.
cmp:19bho2x0wwvswt.relation: Patience prescribed to the Prophet in every situation, each time with a different support.

cmp:1taj0c90jdjhvj.why: The glorification openings: noun, past, present and imperative forms, with 'what is in the heavens and what is in the earth' or without the second 'what'. Essential for memorizers.

cmp:166lcr309oa2i3.why: Gives glad tidings to the believers who do good that theirs is a great reward (17:9) or a good reward (18:2). Memorizer pair.

cmp:06s2l5y16clr5i.why: Do not set up another god with God: you will sit blamed and forsaken (17:22) or be thrown into Hell blamed and banished (17:39); between them the miser 'sits blamed and regretful'. Memorizer set in one passage.
cmp:06s2l5y16clr5i.relation: The commandments of al-Isra open and close with the same prohibition of shirk.

cmp:1cclknc08q8tim.why: We have varied in this Quran, with 'for people' and 'every example' in different orders, and different reactions. Memorizer set the books explain.

cmp:10ok48m07ac8xm.why: When we are bones and dust, shall we be raised as a new creation: the same words twice in al-Isra, the second giving it as the cause of their punishment. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1hbzb4s0jhgibw.why: Call those you claim besides Him or besides God: they own no power to remove harm, or not an atom's weight. Memorizer pair on the same challenge.

cmp:0jctv691gfteiv.why: Then you will find no guardian, no avenger, no helper: four places in al-Isra with singular or plural address and different words. Memorizer set.

cmp:0gwzw7u1cehw3y.why: You will find no change in God's way: alteration or transformation, with 'and not' or 'never', in three surahs. Memorizer set and a theme worth pondering.
cmp:0gwzw7u1cehw3y.relation: God's way with nations does not change.

cmp:1vld6i31x7bkmn.why: Nothing prevented people from believing when guidance came except: that they said 'has God sent a human messenger', or that the way of the ancients should come upon them. Memorizer pair.

cmp:0azbtms0frzt4a.why: That is their recompense: because they disbelieved and denied resurrection (17:98), or Hell for disbelief and mockery (18:106). Memorizer pair.

cmp:1qu62zx1nt2pcf.why: He who created the heavens and the earth is able to create their like or revive the dead: three forms of the argument. Memorizer set and a central proof of resurrection.
cmp:1qu62zx1nt2pcf.relation: Creating the heavens is greater than recreating man.

cmp:11jg7y906z16ox.why: Pharaoh: I think you, Moses, bewitched; Moses: I think you, Pharaoh, doomed. Back-to-back ayat with the same words turned around. Memorizer pair and a striking reply.
cmp:11jg7y906z16ox.relation: Contrast: Moses answers Pharaoh's charge in his own words.

cmp:06f1vuy1tuc96y.why: A single ayah (18:22). The book's note is on the conjunction before 'the eighth' inside it; nothing to compare in the card.

cmp:1wiekot1eihtk1.why: I do not think the Hour will come, and if I am returned or brought back to my Lord: the garden owner and the ungrateful man. Memorizer pair and the same delusion.
cmp:1wiekot1eihtk1.relation: Two self-assured men expect good from God without faith in the Hour.

cmp:08cautm0gsrjj8.why: Who does greater wrong than one reminded of his Lord's signs who turns away: 'so' in 18:57, 'then' in 32:22, with different endings. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:1t17mlz06ac6y7.why: The fish took its way into the sea: tunnelling (18:61) and wondrously (18:63). Same story; memorizer pair.

cmp:1ijd9f30v8tu6h.why: So they set out until: boarding the ship (a grave thing) and meeting a boy (a terrible thing). Same story; memorizer pair worth pondering for the escalation.
cmp:1ijd9f30v8tu6h.relation: Moses's objection grows from 'grave' to 'terrible' as the deeds grow worse.

cmp:0epbd1t1pl4355.why: Did I not say you could not be patient with me: 'to you' added the second time. Memorizer pair and a pointed escalation.
cmp:0epbd1t1pl4355.relation: The reproach sharpens with the added 'to you'.

cmp:0ng3kzn0m94zxr.why: The interpretation of what you could not bear patiently: the full verb in 18:78, the shortened form in 18:82. A famous memorizer point and worth pondering.
cmp:0ng3kzn0m94zxr.relation: The verb itself lightens once the burden of the mystery is lifted.

cmp:1cz46ye0j3fsxq.why: Al-Khidr's three explanations: I wanted, we wanted, your Lord wanted. A famous point for pondering how he attributes the defect to himself and the good to God.
cmp:1cz46ye0j3fsxq.relation: Fault is claimed by the servant; pure mercy is attributed to God.

cmp:1110tkk05mjdx8.why: A single ayah (18:97). The well-known contrast of the two verb forms is inside this one ayah; there is no second place in the card.

cmp:0rt4kgm08dh4us.why: It is revealed to me that your god is one God: with 'I am only a human like you' in 18:110, without it in 21:108, and different endings. Memorizer pair.

cmp:18vtps70abvorv.why: Dutiful to his parents, not a tyrant: John (disobedient) and Jesus (wretched, to his mother). Memorizer pair and a parallel between two prophets in one surah.
cmp:18vtps70abvorv.relation: John and Jesus described in matching words, each fitted to his family.

cmp:038kvy30afaa7f.why: Peace on the day he was born, dies and is raised: spoken of John by God, and by Jesus of himself with the article. Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:038kvy30afaa7f.relation: Peace given to John by God, and claimed by Jesus as God's gift to him.

cmp:1b41cwj0prq6lj.why: The factions differed among themselves; woe to those who disbelieved, from the scene of a great day, or to those who did wrong, from the punishment of a painful day. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:0hfjphn1wmapev.why: And warn them of the Day: of regret (19:39) and of the approaching (40:18). Memorizer pair; two names of the Day worth pondering.
cmp:0hfjphn1wmapev.relation: Two names of the Day: regret when the matter is decided, and dread as it draws near.

cmp:1e3nu171uil9lz.why: Besides God or besides Him, in three places about idols. The book explains when the name or the pronoun is used; memorizer set.

cmp:08v1kqo13nh8ku.why: His brother Aaron as a prophet (19:53) or as a helper (25:35). Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:08v1kqo13nh8ku.relation: Aaron given to Moses as a mercy and as a minister.

cmp:1u7xtwh0oixwx1.why: Except whoever repents, believes and does good: 'good' or 'a good deed', then enter Paradise or have their evil deeds turned to good. Classic memorizer pair.
cmp:1u7xtwh0oixwx1.relation: Repentance leads to Paradise, and even transforms past sins.

cmp:09wjm8x0hxx70f.why: They took gods besides God or besides Him: for might, though they create nothing, or for help. Memorizer set.

cmp:02p4m5m1n7l42g.why: Moses sees a fire and tells his family: stay, perhaps I will bring a brand or find guidance; I will bring news or a burning brand; perhaps news or an ember. Same story; a classic memorizer set.

cmp:1kx574y1xevygq.why: The fire and the call at the valley in three surahs, from his words to his family to God's address. Same story; the run-on completes the al-Qasas row.

cmp:148z6ni0dulyss.why: When he came to it he was called: 'came' in two verbs and three different calls. Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:0py1vu21swdzds.why: The Hour is coming (20:15) or is surely coming (40:59), with different continuations. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1y8gzap1o0iy13.why: Moses's commission and his requests in Ta-Ha, al-Shu'ara and al-Qasas: chest, tongue, Aaron, fear of being denied or killed. Same story; a full memorizer comparison.

cmp:1a1ft9a1hbk1vm.why: The commission to go to Pharaoh, Moses's fear, and God's answer (your request is granted; We will strengthen you with your brother) in three surahs. Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:1pwr6r912zazr3.why: Go to Pharaoh, he has transgressed; go to the wrongdoing people; to Pharaoh and his chiefs, a defiant people. Three ways the mission is framed; memorizer set.

cmp:15mkm760j40er6.why: Moses asks for ease (20:26) where elsewhere he fears being killed for the man he struck (26:14, 28:33). The book lines up his requests across the three tellings; memorizer value.

cmp:1a7waz60redkna.why: Moses's tongue: untie the knot (20:27), my tongue is not free so send Aaron (26:13), Aaron is more eloquent (28:34). Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:0lazb370xzdbux.why: Moses asks for a helper from his family (20:29), or for Aaron to be sent (26:13, 28:34). Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:0qod45c1rqsn5s.why: We returned you to your mother so she might be comforted and not grieve: then the killing and trials (20:40), or so she might know God's promise is true (28:13). Same story; memorizer pair.
cmp:0qod45c1rqsn5s.relation: The same reunion, told to Moses as a favour and to the reader as a fulfilled promise.

cmp:0z864cd0ky3ffd.why: Say: we are the two messengers of your Lord (dual) or the messenger of the Lord of the worlds (singular). A famous memorizer point the book explains.

cmp:18axxqb0787v1f.why: The same two openings with the request to send the Children of Israel, which in al-Shu'ara is in the next ayah. Same story; the run-on gives the matching words.

cmp:0acrxef0t669hp.why: He made the earth a cradle for you: 'threaded paths' or 'made paths', and different continuations (rain and plants; so you may be guided). Memorizer pair.

cmp:0ht0xpm1ckhw2c.why: The magicians' faith: Lord of Aaron and Moses (Ta-Ha) against Lord of the worlds, Lord of Moses and Aaron (al-Shu'ara). Same story; the run-on carries the names.

cmp:1oq4uvl0m5zexd.why: Whoever does good deeds while a believer: 'and' or 'so', then he fears no wrong, or his effort will not be denied. Memorizer pair.
cmp:1oq4uvl0m5zexd.relation: Two assurances that a believer's good deeds are never lost.

cmp:0gmm6mo064160g.why: Has it not guided them how many generations We destroyed, in whose dwellings they walk: 'so' or 'and', 'before' or 'from before', and two endings. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:0msai341kh7dps.why: Be patient over what they say and glorify your Lord before sunrise and before its setting (20:130) or the setting (50:39). Memorizer pair on the same command.

cmp:1g5h95r1a1v903.why: Glorify with your Lord's praise, with three time frames: before sunrise and sunset, and when you rise and at night (the run-on in al-Tur). Memorizer set and the same instruction.
cmp:1g5h95r1a1v903.relation: Glorification as the companion of patience, at fixed times of the day.

cmp:1uvk2af0iemtv3.why: No new reminder comes to them from their Lord (or from the Most Merciful) but they listen while playing, or turn away. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1k0c2i10udp4id.why: We sent before you only men, or no messenger but We revealed to him, or none of the messengers but they ate food. Memorizer set on 'from before' and the continuations.

cmp:19hqotl13x3q6t.why: Every soul will taste death: 'and We test you' added in 21:35, then 'and to Us' or 'then to Us' you will be returned. Memorizer pair.

cmp:11birtk1ykejf6.why: When they see you they take you only in mockery: is this the one who mentions your gods, or whom God sent as messenger. Memorizer pair on the same scene.
cmp:11birtk1ykejf6.relation: Mockery of the Prophet for attacking their gods and for claiming to be sent.

cmp:0lz156a0joglk8.why: The deaf do not hear the call when warned (21:45), or you cannot make the deaf hear when they turn away (27:80, 30:52, with 'so'). Classic memorizer set.

cmp:0yqvhez0dm91c9.why: Abraham asks his father and people what they worship, and they answer that they found their fathers so: in al-Anbiya and al-Shu'ara. Same story; the run-on pairs question and answer.

cmp:1f1w73i1xkk0pa.why: We found our fathers worshipping them (21:53) or rather we found our fathers doing so (26:74). Same story; memorizer pair.

cmp:1ltfcfg1ehf166.why: They intended a plot against him and We made them the greatest losers (21:70) or the lowest (37:98). Same story; classic memorizer pair.

cmp:0ulzk3y08gla7u.why: Job's call and its answer in al-Anbiya and Sad: harm touched me, or Satan touched me with toil; then his family and as many again, as a reminder for worshippers or for people of understanding. Same story; memorizer set.

cmp:0iecote0karp8q.why: His family and as many with them, as mercy from Us (two forms) and a reminder for worshippers or for those of understanding. Same story; memorizer pair.

cmp:1q5zhst0x6syzl.why: She who guarded her chastity and We breathed into her (21:91) or into it (66:12). A famous memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp:1pwgr9k0ka71hc.why: This is your community, one community, and I am your Lord: so worship Me, or so fear Me; then they split their affair (the run-ons). Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:006sm1q13t4z6o.why: The same pair laid out ayah by ayah: worship Me or fear Me, then 'and they split' or 'but they split' into sects. Memorizer set.

cmp:0q3mya903u5ufl.why: A single ayah (22:2). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:0x600xq09t4o64.why: The stages of human life in al-Hajj and Ghafir: as a child, then to reach full strength, then some die and some are returned to old age. Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:0x600xq09t4o64.relation: The same life stages used once to prove resurrection and once to call to reason.

cmp:11heqby1ed4j8g.why: Among people is one who disputes about God without knowledge, guidance or an illuminating book: word for word in two surahs. Memorizer pair.

cmp:18frd8r0m4snv1.why: God admits those who believe and do good to gardens: ending 'God does what He wills' or with bracelets and silk. Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:1085mfq1o7w32m.why: Whenever they want to leave it they are returned to it: 'from anguish' and 'taste the burning' in 22:22, 'it is said to them, taste the Fire you denied' in 32:20. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1mtjaxf02odzdz.why: Eat of them and feed: the miserable poor (22:28) or the one who asks and the one who does not (22:36). Memorizer pair in one passage on sacrifices.

cmp:0vxgh5r1ve3m1v.why: The roll of nations who denied before, in al-Hajj, Sad and Qaf, each list in a different order with different members. Memorizer set and the same consolation.
cmp:0vxgh5r1ve3m1v.relation: The Prophet is reminded that every earlier messenger was denied.

cmp:16l4xyh1l86fpj.why: How many a town, unjust: 'so' and destroyed, or 'and' and given respite then seized. Two ayat apart in al-Hajj; memorizer pair.
cmp:16l4xyh1l86fpj.relation: Two fates of unjust towns: sudden ruin, or delay then seizure.

cmp:15wrvks1x16ydg.why: A day with your Lord like a thousand years, a day measured as a thousand, and as fifty thousand years. Memorizer set and worth pondering.
cmp:15wrvks1x16ydg.relation: Divine days measured on different scales in different contexts.

cmp:0bvzrte1g7bqcy.why: Those who believe and do good: forgiveness and generous provision (22:50), or gardens of bliss (22:56). Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:1n8xg8x03sgf63.why: God is the Truth and what they call besides Him is falsehood: with the pronoun 'it is' in 22:62 only. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:03odmoh0e1fi25.why: The two parallel pairs of al-Hajj and Luqman: God is the Truth, and God is the Rich, the Praised, with the emphatic letters differing. Memorizer set.

cmp:0q5fae9092m3e1.why: His or God's is what is in the heavens and the earth; He is the Rich, the Praised: with and without the extra 'what is in' and the emphasis. Memorizer pair.

cmp:00al90z1g6d4hh.why: The opening and close of the two parallel lists of believers' qualities (al-Mu'minun and al-Ma'arij): successful believers inheriting Paradise, and anxious man except the praying who are honoured in gardens. Useful for seeing where each list begins and ends.
cmp:00al90z1g6d4hh.relation: Two portraits of the believer, one opened with success, one with human weakness.

cmp:0iypyyv1lq3i9b.why: The shared qualities of al-Mu'minun and al-Ma'arij, nearly word for word, with al-Ma'arij adding testimony and prayer in the singular or plural. Core memorizer set.

cmp:0v2328s0kitufc.why: Guarding trusts, prayers (plural or singular), constant in prayer, upright in testimony: the two lists side by side. Core memorizer set.

cmp:020zrbn0907grv.why: Blessed is God or blessed is He who: openings and closings with this word across four surahs. Memorizer set on a recurring praise.
cmp:020zrbn0907grv.relation: The same blessing over creation of man, revelation, the heavens and sovereignty.

cmp:0zq0s7b1rwrfch.why: Many fruits for you, of which you eat: earthly gardens (with 'and') and Paradise (without). Memorizer pair and a contrast worth pondering.
cmp:0zq0s7b1rwrfch.relation: The fruits of this world prefigure the fruits of Paradise.

cmp:1p5sy1i1daifm2.why: The chiefs say: this is only a human like you, to Noah and to the next messenger, with the order of 'of his people' and 'who disbelieved' changing. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:0bv2fi5002qqlp.why: Had God, or our Lord, willed, He would have sent angels: Noah's people and 'Ad and Thamud. Memorizer pair on the same objection.
cmp:0bv2fi5002qqlp.relation: Every people demands an angel rather than a human messenger.

cmp:01l15w41wubntm.why: We made them scum, away with the wrongdoing people; We made them tales, away with a people who do not believe. Memorizer pair in one passage.

cmp:01ttqzy0s0xu1a.why: And do good; I see what you do: knowing (to the messengers) or seeing (to David's family). Memorizer pair.

cmp:18q36y20n9w1fe.why: My verses were recited to you, and you turned on your heels, or were they not recited and you denied them. Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:02s6k980nab1ri.why: We and our fathers were promised this before: 'this' after 'our fathers' or right after 'promised'. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:1ao5klg1k3m0vo.why: They will say 'to God'; say: will you not remember, not fear, how are you deluded. Three consecutive answers; a famous memorizer set.
cmp:1ao5klg1k3m0vo.relation: The argument rises from remembering to fearing to exposing their delusion.

cmp:1saekjm0uw4ffw.why: Were it not for God's favour on you and His mercy, and that God is relenting and wise (24:10) or kind and merciful (24:20). Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:1gluful163sc4d.why: A single ayah (24:10). The comparison is already in the pair card on the same words.

cmp:0fijx47187hngz.why: God makes the signs (or His signs) clear to you: endings 'knowing and wise' three times and 'so you may reason' once, in al-Nur. Memorizer set.

cmp:1io4vxs0cvxkwy.why: A single ayah (24:30). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:1wvjbd80quqrbc.why: We have sent down clear verses: 'to you' with an example and admonition (24:34), or without it with 'God guides whom He wills' (24:46). Memorizer pair.

cmp:1aj7qe015hy3xq.why: A single ayah (24:55). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:0soxq031pi4bl7.why: Thus God makes clear to you the signs (24:58) or His signs (24:59), in two neighbouring rulings on asking permission. Memorizer pair.

cmp:15krbtu1q6qwi2.why: They took gods besides Him (25:3) or besides God (36:74), with different continuations. Memorizer pair.

cmp:02r94hj1tdtvkn.why: A single ayah (25:3). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:0vkvmwp0eea9sx.why: A single ayah (25:55). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:030i8np1o7ugzb.why: He created the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, then rose over the Throne: 'God' added in 32:4 and two different continuations. Memorizer pair.

cmp:14nz1vl1l9655b.why: To our Lord we shall return: said by the magicians (with 'no harm') and by the rider's prayer (with the emphatic letter). Memorizer pair and worth pondering.

cmp:1j2twef06m0hin.why: Abraham describes his Lord in four ayat, with the emphatic pronoun in guiding, feeding and healing but not in causing death. A famous point for memorizers and pondering.

cmp:09h1zsk18v7fng.why: The last three ayat of Abraham's description with and without the emphatic pronoun. Contained in the four-ayah card but a valid memorizer set.

cmp:19k8vth0qoxyct.why: When their brother said to them: will you not fear God, for Noah, Hud, Salih and Lot, but without 'their brother' for Shu'ayb; then 'so fear God and obey me'. Core memorizer set.

cmp:0sog10f0dvbh4p.why: You are only a human like us: without 'and' to Salih, with 'and' to Shu'ayb, and different continuations. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:0vpm4iy0fez5i8.why: Throw your staff; he saw it writhing like a snake and fled: then 'do not fear, messengers do not fear before Me' (27:10) or 'come forward and do not fear, you are safe' (28:31). Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:1pxxm621w1en9w.why: The same staff scene, with al-Naml running on to 'except one who did wrong then replaced evil with good'. Memorizer pair; the run-on shows how each passage continues.

cmp:1ekgzi616kp4zu.why: The staff scene with both continuations read on: the exception in al-Naml and the hand sign in al-Qasas. Memorizer pair on the same story.

cmp:1iv6t9k0qljnj6.why: Put your hand in your bosom, it comes out white without harm: insert or slip, among nine signs or as two proofs, to Pharaoh and his people or his chiefs. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:163bl841vtdxz4.why: We saved those who believed and were God-fearing: two forms of 'saved'. Same story of Thamud; memorizer pair.

cmp:19ss5nb1b2xpwv.why: Is there a god with God? Five times in a row in al-Naml, each after a different sign and with a different ending. Core memorizer set and a powerful argument.

cmp:0lxgwi11d1hj1h.why: A single ayah (27:60). The full refrain set is in the five-ayah card.

cmp:1idjvma03gjpa2.why: None knows the unseen but God (27:65), and He discloses His unseen to none except a chosen messenger (72:26). Worth pondering together, though shared wording is slight.

cmp:0dc10ns0siqzwg.why: Until when they came: with or without 'ma', 'to it' or 'to Us', and different scenes of reckoning. Memorizer set.

cmp:0ldv7jp0ioqv1d.why: The Trumpet is blown and whoever is in the heavens and earth is terrified (27:87) or swoons (39:68), except whom God wills. Classic memorizer pair and worth pondering.

cmp:0nlajja0runi54.why: You will find me, God willing, among the righteous (Moses's father-in-law) or the patient (Ishmael). Memorizer pair and worth pondering.

cmp:0p4ymhh0cb1dcb.why: Pharaoh's tower to look at the god of Moses: 'among the liars' (28:38) or 'a liar' (40:37), with different surroundings. Same story; memorizer pair.

cmp:0vzd4rx1nxr3hd.why: Whatever you are given is the enjoyment of worldly life: 'and' or 'so', 'and its adornment' only in 28:60, and two endings. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp:0j3lq3i02oe71o.why: If God made the night, or the day, endless until the Day of Resurrection, who but God would bring light, or night: will you not hear, will you not see. Memorizer pair and a fine parallel.
cmp:0j3lq3i02oe71o.relation: Endless night is answered with 'hear', endless day with 'see'.

cmp:0l3la5p1kwyq2v.why: A single ayah (28:82). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:0bzzotk1fjdcc8.why: If your parents strive to make you associate with Me, do not obey them: 'to' or 'on that', and al-Luqman adding companionship in kindness. Classic memorizer pair.
cmp:0bzzotk1fjdcc8.relation: Kindness to parents, but no obedience in shirk.

cmp:0cxd8qw19n8wsk.why: We enjoined on man kindness to his parents in three surahs, with 'goodness' or 'kindness' or the mother's burden, and the run-on bringing the al-Ankabut wording into Luqman. Memorizer set.

cmp:0fwalt506v9045.why: We enjoined on man his parents: with goodness, with the mother's weakness and weaning in two years, with kindness and thirty months. Core memorizer set and worth pondering.
cmp:0fwalt506v9045.relation: The mother's burden named twice, with weaning and full term differently counted.

cmp:0m1n51l0tlntbn.why: A single ayah (29:21). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:1p0joz91hsm0eb.why: You cannot escape on earth (and in the sky only in 29:22), and you have no protector or helper besides God. Memorizer pair.

cmp:0ggf5ny0wwehl6.why: Signs for people who believe (29:24) against a sign for the believers (29:44): plural and singular in one surah. Memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp:0sm2v8e0zejz7u.why: A single ayah (29:36). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:184hrra0pzgoks.why: None rejects Our signs but the disbelievers (29:47) or the wrongdoers (29:49). Memorizer pair two ayat apart.

cmp:0s29vub17bdlbl.why: If you asked them who created the heavens and the earth, or who sends rain: they would say God, then different endings. Core memorizer set on the same argument.

cmp:0yfas3u1450k0e.why: They would say God; say praise be to God; but most of them do not reason (29:63) or do not know (31:25). Memorizer pair.

cmp:0zvmfpa1yl94bg.why: Have they not travelled and seen the end of those before them, who were stronger: four places with 'and' or 'so', 'were' added, and different endings. Core memorizer set.

cmp:1ynaour13kb01l.why: Three of the 'have they not travelled' places with the conjunction, and their differences. Contained in the four-ayah card; valid memorizer set.

cmp:1yp9g2j16lrh59.why: Among His signs, four times in al-Rum, ending for people who reflect, for the worlds (or the learned), who hear, who reason. Core memorizer set; each ending fits its sign.
cmp:1yp9g2j16lrh59.relation: Love calls for reflection, languages for knowledge, sleep for listening, lightning and rain for reason.

cmp:1kcmt5n0cuta4h.why: A single ayah (30:21). The comparison is in the four-ayah card.

cmp:0wdk6fi1slk8ci.why: A single ayah (30:22). The comparison is in the four-ayah card.

cmp:17hn1nu04jnrri.why: Two neighbouring signs ending for people who hear and for people who reason. Memorizer pair contained in the four-ayah card.

cmp:0qplk5j0je9cat.why: A single ayah (30:24). The comparison is in the four-ayah card.

cmp:1oafpaz1wzgkj5.why: When harm touches people they call their Lord turning to Him, then when He gives them mercy some associate (30:33) or he forgets (39:8). Same theme; memorizer pair with the run-on to the warning.

cmp:04rrcdt0rttyg5.why: Have they not seen (30:37) or known (39:52) that God extends provision: otherwise identical. A sharp memorizer pair.

cmp:06937fk0xs6wry.why: Before a Day comes that none can turn back from God: preceded by 'set your face to the religion' or 'respond to your Lord', and followed by different scenes. A rare clause shared; memorizer pair worth pondering.
cmp:06937fk0xs6wry.relation: Two calls to act now, before the irreversible Day.

cmp:0mzpc5t18xjwqr.why: Ships sail by His command so you may seek His bounty and give thanks: after the winds (30:46) or the subjected sea (45:12), with 'in it' only in 45:12. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1bw3jvt0wrb1i9.why: He turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them: with 'as if there were deafness in his ears' only in 31:7. Memorizer pair on the same type of person.

cmp:0wgh5td0qeyjxp.why: The same pair with 45:7 read on into 45:8, showing the arrogant listener in al-Jathiya is the sinful liar. Memorizer value as in the pair card.

cmp:0k6ykzs002k4j8.why: That is of resolve in affairs (31:17) or surely of resolve (42:43). Memorizer pair, part of the three-ayah set on patience.

cmp:0g460681am4a1m.why: Night into day and day into night, and the sun and moon each running for a term: merge or wrap, 'to' or 'for'. Memorizer set.

cmp:0v4jlyr1dzgmsv.why: A single ayah (32:26). The comparison with 20:128 is in the pair card.

cmp:172neui0elftam.why: God will ask the truthful about their truth (33:8) and reward the truthful for their truth (33:24). Worth pondering together in one surah.

cmp:1t7zvp40uhy6qq.relation: God's way with nations is constant.

cmp:1x0fpos0poa0oe.why: What will make you know, perhaps the Hour is near: with 'will be near' in 33:63 and 'near' in 42:17. Memorizer pair.

cmp:0nbnaa10blaot9.why: A sign for every penitent servant (34:9) and signs for every patient, grateful one (34:19). Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:0hbyzs71y1b27f.why: We sent no warner to a town but its affluent said: we disbelieve in your message, or we found our fathers on a way. Memorizer pair on the same pattern.
cmp:0hbyzs71y1b27f.relation: The wealthy always lead the rejection, out of disbelief or blind imitation.

cmp:1nr4czv1r0zagp.why: Say my Lord extends provision to whom He wills: with 'of His servants' and 'for him' only in 34:39, and different endings. Memorizer pair three ayat apart.

cmp:1dyzhzi1rgfz7q.why: Of differing colours, three times in two ayat (fruits, mountains, people and animals), with the pronoun changing. Memorizer value and a sign worth pondering.
cmp:1dyzhzi1rgfz7q.relation: Diversity in nature leads to the knowledge that brings fear of God.

cmp:0ly8ya310iwmh5.why: God is aware and seeing of His servants: with God named and the emphatic letter (35:31) or with a pronoun (42:27). Memorizer pair.

cmp:0zwmze00vnh6dy.why: A single ayah (34:9). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:0jix25f1rhiq57.why: It was only one shout, and then they were extinguished (36:29) or all brought before Us (36:53). Memorizer pair and a telling contrast.
cmp:0jix25f1rhiq57.relation: One shout ends a town; one shout raises all mankind.

cmp:07spk7l18e35x7.why: The messengers told the truth (36:52) and he confirmed the messengers (37:37): the same words with different grammar. Memorizer pair across neighbouring surahs.

cmp:1u6l47a1ijo34e.why: When we have died and become dust and bones, shall we be raised (37:16) or be judged (37:53). Memorizer pair in one surah.
cmp:1u6l47a1ijo34e.relation: The deniers doubt resurrection; the doomed companion doubted judgement.

cmp:01p03dd1772dkr.why: They turned to one another asking (37:27, 37:50, with 'and' or 'so') or blaming (68:30). Memorizer set and a contrast worth pondering.
cmp:01p03dd1772dkr.relation: The same gesture of turning to each other: in Hell to quarrel, in Paradise to converse, in the garden story to blame.

cmp:1bxdnua0y5w8le.why: Thus We deal with the criminals: with 'indeed We' in 37:34, without in 77:18. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1x2zato0epn95u.why: There is no god but God: when told it they were arrogant (37:35); know it and seek forgiveness (47:19). A contrast worth pondering.
cmp:1x2zato0epn95u.relation: Contrast: the same testimony rejected in arrogance and embraced with humility.

cmp:085fqut1qtankb.why: With them are maidens of restrained glance, wide-eyed (37:48) or of equal age (38:52). Memorizer pair.

cmp:01x6heo0blouga.why: The book groups two pairs: the maidens of Paradise (37:48, 38:52) and the denying nations (38:12, 50:12). Both are real memorizer pairs, though unrelated to each other.

cmp:0d7lijf0sqcbov.why: Only our first death, and we will not be punished (37:59) or raised (44:35). Memorizer pair, said by the saved and by the deniers.
cmp:0d7lijf0sqcbov.relation: The same words of relief in Paradise and of denial on earth.

cmp:05y0y3v0miviqj.why: Peace upon Noah, Abraham, Moses and Aaron, Elias, then 'and Lot / Jonah was among the messengers' and peace on the messengers. Memorizers must know which prophets get the greeting and which the other refrain.

cmp:19ejv8n0tqzyr5.why: Thus We reward the good-doers: with 'indeed We' everywhere except 37:110 for Abraham. A famous memorizer point the books explain.

cmp:09t58r40vp8vvy.why: The refrain of al-Saffat: thus We reward the good-doers, he was of Our believing servants, with Abraham's and the dual places marked. Core memorizer set.

cmp:04u1w2v0sjjy19.why: The book groups two pairs: 'will you not eat' to the idols and to the guests (37:91, 51:27), and 'watch them' and 'watch' (37:175, 37:179). Both are memorizer pairs.
cmp:04u1w2v0sjjy19.relation: Abraham's same words mock idols and honour guests.

cmp:0qe9rux065t22n.why: Glad tidings of a forbearing boy (37:101) or a knowing boy (51:28). Memorizer pair; commonly linked to Ishmael and Isaac.

cmp:0z9jerx0hahonj.why: So turn away from them for a while: 'so' then 'and', followed by 'watch them' and 'watch'. Memorizer pair; the run-ons give the second differing word.

cmp:1qr2b510sbk11f.why: Watch them, they will see (37:175) against watch, they will see (37:179). Tight memorizer pair the book explains.

cmp:12v3hu003pxi1y.why: They wondered that a warner came from among them: 'and' or 'rather', and the disbelievers said: a lying sorcerer, or a strange thing. Memorizer pair.

cmp:0lijrhz18vc6jr.why: Has the reminder been sent down, or cast, on him from among us: word order and verb differ, and the replies. Memorizer pair.
cmp:0lijrhz18vc6jr.relation: Quraysh and Thamud ask the same jealous question.

cmp:1y0dbyd0zvqngj.why: The denying nations in Sad and Qaf, ayah by ayah, with different members and order and the endings 'My punishment' and 'My threat'. Memorizer set.

cmp:1pxfns40mwczqo.why: We sent down the Book to you with the truth: 'to you' then 'worship God sincerely' (39:2), 'upon you for people' (39:41). Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:14tz6t70rnhgjp.why: I was commanded to worship God sincerely in religion (39:11), and it is God I worship, sincere in my religion (39:14). Memorizer pair and worth pondering the shift.
cmp:14tz6t70rnhgjp.relation: From the command received to the personal declaration.

cmp:0gxsxd2159q63k.why: I was commanded to worship (39:11) and commanded to be the first of the Muslims (39:12), with 'that' and 'to that'. The books explain the extra particle; memorizer pair.

cmp:05r5l9o1idhyge.why: Then it withers and you see it yellow, then He makes it chaff (39:21) or it becomes chaff (57:20). Memorizer pair and the same parable.
cmp:05r5l9o1idhyge.relation: The fading crop as a picture of worldly life.

cmp:1hkakmg1w4sgug.why: The evils of what they earned (39:48) or did (45:33) appeared to them, and what they mocked surrounded them. Memorizer pair.

cmp:0dupolj05cak6j.why: Driven in groups to Hell and to Paradise: 'its gates were opened' without 'and' for Hell, with 'and' for Paradise, then the keepers speak. A famous memorizer pair and a contrast worth pondering.
cmp:0dupolj05cak6j.relation: Contrast: Hell's gates open at their arrival; Paradise's gates already stand open for its people.

cmp:007odzq1su5540.why: Until when they came to it: the two gates scenes, the skins testifying (with 'ma'), and the companion's regret (came to Us). Memorizer set on the same opening.

cmp:1m7f1by0ogxiv6.why: Angels glorify their Lord's praise and seek forgiveness: for the believers (40:7) or for those on earth (42:5). Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:1m7f1by0ogxiv6.relation: The angels' prayer, first for the believers, then for all on earth.

cmp:1d3ccca0eyoxiy.why: That is because their messengers came to them with clear proofs and they disbelieved: 'they' or 'it' as subject pronoun, and different continuations. Memorizer pair.

cmp:192y4wc1v001hk.why: A single ayah (40:25). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:0hf6dtt1qu0oy7.why: But most people do not know, believe, give thanks: three endings within five ayat of Ghafir. Memorizer set the books explain.

cmp:1hvzwhm0faqf7m.why: Three consecutive ayat each closing with 'the Lord of the worlds' in different phrases (blessed is God, praise be to God, submit to). Memorizer value in the order.

cmp:1a4zype16vmjbe.why: And there the falsifiers lost (40:78) or the disbelievers lost (40:85). Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:15d1apu0632zue.why: The earth created in two days, and its provisions measured in four days, in neighbouring ayat. The book discusses how the days add up; worth pondering.

cmp:1yq8gh009f8mys.why: When evil touches man he is despairing (41:49) or full of long prayers (41:51). Memorizer pair and a sharp portrait.
cmp:1yq8gh009f8mys.relation: Two reactions of the same man to hardship: despair and loud supplication.

cmp:04ecwrv1erbdhp.why: A single ayah (42:11). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:09lfdxk1cemsnc.why: Whom God leaves astray has no protector after Him (42:44) or no way (42:46). Memorizer pair two ayat apart.

cmp:0xdi95q1qs5fri.why: Neighbouring ayat ending 'He is knowing, able' and 'He is high, wise'. The books explain each ending; memorizer pair.

cmp:1f0on9d135cl7l.why: A single ayah (42:51). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:1d8yd7v0n4xzxb.why: They have no knowledge of that; they only guess (43:20) or only suppose (45:24). Memorizer pair.

cmp:1pogpgb0i55e65.why: We found our fathers on a way and we are guided by their footsteps (43:22) or following them (43:23). A famous memorizer pair.
cmp:1pogpgb0i55e65.relation: The present deniers claim guidance; their predecessors merely followed.

cmp:0c028s61sc7wpo.why: The Children of Israel chosen or preferred above the worlds, in neighbouring surahs. Memorizer pair.

cmp:1azleyj05gio71.why: Signs for the believers, for people with certainty, for people who reason: three opening ayat of al-Jathiya. Memorizer set; each ending fits.
cmp:1azleyj05gio71.relation: Faith, certainty and reason climb through the signs.

cmp:0mn7a6s1d37o5g.why: A single ayah (45:12). Its pair with 30:46 is in another card.

cmp:14fxrjd01nfv8t.why: That He may recompense a people for what they earned (45:14) and every soul for what it earned (45:22). Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:15n1kus0m287qa.why: A single ayah (45:17). The comparison with 10:93 is in another card.

cmp:17r8kzr0f96dnr.why: A single ayah (45:24). Its pairs are in other cards.

cmp:0dyvkg71x32xr7.why: A single ayah (45:30). Its pair with 6:16 is in another card.

cmp:0tdusar0pl59pb.why: He will forgive you some of your sins (46:31, 71:4) or your sins (61:12). A memorizer point the book explains.

cmp:0u6ygmz0rpstmx.why: A single ayah (46:32). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:034i56s0obq6cu.why: They hated what God sent down (47:9), and they said to those who hated what God sent down (47:26): the two verb forms of 'sent down' in one surah. Memorizer pair.

cmp:0my81yr105ypd3.why: A single ayah (47:20). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:0yht8sp1hy6joh.why: After guidance had become clear to them: those who turned back (Satan enticed them) and those who disbelieved and obstructed (they will not harm God). Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:1r1ovc80ce8wzw.why: To God belong the armies of the heavens and earth, and God is knowing and wise (48:4) or mighty and wise (48:7). Memorizer pair three ayat apart.
cmp:1r1ovc80ce8wzw.relation: The armies bring tranquillity to believers (knowing) and punishment to enemies (mighty).

cmp:1ljg45x00wsu9v.why: And God is knowing and wise, or mighty and wise, three times in al-Fath. Memorizer set the book explains.

cmp:0z7afhp08e5exx.why: God is aware (48:11) or seeing (48:24) of what you do, with 'rather' in the first. Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:0ps1j3n0qp2ytp.why: Those who stayed behind will say: 'to you' and 'of the Bedouins' in 48:11, bare in 48:15. Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:0g3dgqj11a8ky1.why: A single ayah (48:15). Its pair with 48:11 is in another card.

cmp:0r6jn6l0rqhrlf.why: The five calls 'O you who believe' in al-Hujurat, then 'O mankind'. The book asks why the call is repeated; useful for memorizing the order of the surah's commands.
cmp:0r6jn6l0rqhrlf.relation: Each new call introduces a new manner, first towards the Prophet, then among believers, then all people.

cmp:0asfwfu1m78fks.why: His companion said: 'this is what I have ready' (the angel, with 'and') and 'our Lord, I did not make him transgress' (the devil). Memorizer pair and a contrast.
cmp:0asfwfu1m78fks.relation: Two companions speak at judgement: the angel recorder and the devil disowning him.

cmp:0c7mdk81w0cbws.why: What you are promised is true (51:5) or will befall (77:7), and your Lord's punishment will befall (52:7). Memorizer set with run-ons to the next ayah.

cmp:1cz2l1u1kak9hq.why: The God-fearing are in gardens and springs (51:15) or gardens and bliss (52:17). Memorizer pair in neighbouring surahs.

cmp:0f38p6a0cdewzm.why: The same pair read on into the next ayah: taking what their Lord gave them (because they did good) or enjoying what He gave and protected from Hell. Memorizer pair.

cmp:06mrx9v0z18tgf.why: In their wealth is a right for the beggar and the deprived (51:19), or a known right (70:24, with the run-on). Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:06mrx9v0z18tgf.relation: Voluntary giving in al-Dhariyat, a known fixed right in al-Ma'arij.

cmp:0b2y9u20nvuj7a.why: I am a clear warner to you from Him, closing two consecutive ayat (flee to God; do not set up another god). Memorizer pair.

cmp:18pfizw0xreeic.why: There circulate among them boys (52:24) or immortal youths (56:17, 76:19), with and without 'and' and with different pearl similes. Memorizer set.

cmp:0qyzvq0170bq0a.why: The chain of questions opening with 'or' in al-Tur, about fifteen of them. Memorizers need the order; the series is a powerful argument worth pondering.
cmp:0qyzvq0170bq0a.relation: Every possible excuse of the deniers is raised and dismissed in turn.

cmp:1od1wjj0bqun4r.why: Two identical ayat in al-Tur and al-Qalam (do you ask them a reward; is the unseen with them), followed by different ayat. Memorizer set.

cmp:08xx3vn0od4mph.why: Be patient for your Lord's judgement: 'and' or 'so', then 'you are in Our eyes', 'do not be like the man of the fish', 'do not obey sinner or ingrate'. Memorizer set.

cmp:104bvaw0w7p2ys.why: They follow only conjecture: and what their souls desire (53:23), and conjecture avails nothing against truth (53:28). Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:1b4erjn1rp8ktt.why: And that He: with the emphatic pronoun where people might claim the act (laughing, death, wealth, the star) and without it where none would (creating pairs, destroying 'Ad). A famous memorizer and pondering point.

cmp:1xw2gxr1x9xfkz.why: So how was My punishment and My warnings: the refrain of al-Qamar, twice in the story of 'Ad. Memorizers need its places.

cmp:13vrek21ybh4mk.why: We have made the Quran easy to remember; is there anyone who will remember? Four identical places in al-Qamar. Memorizers need to know after which stories it falls.

cmp:1skm2pz1vfy4fb.why: The refrain comes twice in 'Ad's story, before and after the punishment. The books ask why; a small memorizer point already inside the larger refrain card.

cmp:0x1yhjb18lxjfn.why: The balance three times in three ayat of al-Rahman. The book asks why the word is repeated rather than replaced by a pronoun; worth pondering.
cmp:0x1yhjb18lxjfn.relation: The balance set in the heavens, not to be transgressed, and not to be cut short.

cmp:1xpqgl214ub6gi.why: The three groups of al-Waqi'a introduced in three ayat: companions of the right, of the left, and the foremost. The book discusses the repeated names; worth pondering and good for memorizers.
cmp:1xpqgl214ub6gi.relation: Mankind sorted into three ranks, each named twice for emphasis.

cmp:1qbw5v9165395b.why: Have you considered: what you emit, what you sow, the water you drink, the fire you kindle. Four questions in al-Waqi'a; memorizers need the order, and the argument is worth pondering.
cmp:1qbw5v9165395b.relation: Every daily need is traced back to God as its real maker.

cmp:0usimiy1sr1r4a.why: The same four questions with their answers: is it you who create, sow, send it down, produce its tree, or We. The run-ons hold the matching answers.

cmp:0lnu9bs12hgqmk.why: Why then do you not remember (56:62), why then do you not give thanks (56:70). Memorizer pair; the endings fit the signs.
cmp:0lnu9bs12hgqmk.relation: The first creation calls for remembering; sweet water calls for thanks.

cmp:18l6q570ktfc75.why: The glorification openings with past or present verb, with or without the second 'what is in', and different closing names. Core memorizer set.

cmp:1v45l330zkmznl.why: The same openings with the end of al-Hashr (59:24) added. Memorizer set; al-Hashr opens and closes with glorification.
cmp:1v45l330zkmznl.relation: Al-Hashr is framed by glorification at both ends.

cmp:1h1yap80x087e8.why: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth: He gives life and death (57:2), to God all matters return (57:5). Memorizer pair in one passage.

cmp:0zcsxvx1cveak7.why: Their light running before them and on their right, with gardens beneath which rivers flow: word order of 'light' and 'running' changes, and al-Tahrim adds their prayer. Memorizer pair.
cmp:0zcsxvx1cveak7.relation: The believers' light on the Day, and their prayer that it be completed.

cmp:1o30iqg0fedppe.why: A single ayah (57:12). Its pair with 66:8 is in another card.

cmp:19l7ba71yezei3.why: No calamity strikes but it is in a Book (57:22) or by God's leave (64:11). Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:19l7ba71yezei3.relation: Every calamity is written beforehand and happens only by God's permission.

cmp:0gm66ej0wfsu3n.why: We sent Our messengers with clear proofs (57:25) and We sent Noah and Abraham (57:26): 'indeed' then 'and indeed'. Memorizer pair in one passage.

cmp:05get8m0vek2i4.why: Those who declare their wives like their mothers: 'among you' in 58:2, 'and those' in 58:3, then different rulings. Memorizer pair.

cmp:0ly6dq50c5wubn.why: For the disbelievers is a painful punishment (58:4) or a humiliating one (58:5). Memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp:0watyud0x87ual.why: A single ayah (58:8). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:17te6j30sf3olp.why: What God gave His messenger as spoil: 'and what' from them (59:6) and 'what' from the people of the towns (59:7). Memorizer pair.

cmp:14wct0i1haeukq.why: That is because they are a people who do not understand (59:13) or do not reason (59:14). Memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp:0hek8ek0jnk0qg.why: A single ayah (60:1). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:0ry1opu0yb4doi.why: A good example in Abraham and those with him: 'there has been' feminine (60:4) and masculine with 'indeed' (60:6). Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:0ry1opu0yb4doi.relation: The example is first described, then offered to whoever hopes in God.

cmp:1f6wzrw08eob7o.why: But the hypocrites do not understand (63:7) or do not know (63:8). A famous memorizer pair.
cmp:1f6wzrw08eob7o.relation: Not seeing God's treasury needs understanding; not seeing where might lies is ignorance.

cmp:14ne4bt1bvo2ax.why: What is in the heavens and the earth: with the second 'what is in' (64:1) and without it (64:4). Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp:0d9j6wh1q9krhl.why: Whoever believes in God and does good, He will admit him to gardens forever: with expiation of sins and 'the great success' (64:9) or 'God has made good provision' (65:11). Memorizer pair.

cmp:0rtvst903xs5qt.why: Whoever fears God, three promises in al-Talaq: a way out (with provision, in the run-on), ease in his affair, sins expiated. Memorizer set and worth pondering.
cmp:0rtvst903xs5qt.relation: Fear of God answered with a way out, ease and forgiveness.

cmp:0t9hc250wlyiyn.why: Whoever fears God: a way out, ease, expiation. Three promises in one surah; memorizer set.

cmp:15ifczu0p4bbv4.why: A single ayah (66:5). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:1k0duh01sq3khs.why: Turn your sight again (67:3), then turn your sight again twice (67:4). Memorizer pair and a vivid progression.
cmp:1k0duh01sq3khs.relation: Looking again and again only confirms there is no flaw.

cmp:0nbkoqb1dzsea5.why: Do you feel secure from Him who is in heaven: that He cause the earth to swallow you, or send a storm of stones. Two consecutive ayat; memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:0nbkoqb1dzsea5.relation: Danger from below and from above, both in God's hand.

cmp:173lx420unjgrc.why: As for him given his record in his right hand, and in his left: the joyful 'read my record' against 'would that I had not been given it'. A direct contrast in the same words.
cmp:173lx420unjgrc.relation: Contrast: the same moment of receiving the record, in delight and in despair.

cmp:1hdxsjb0qjixfx.why: Not the word of a poet, little do you believe; nor of a soothsayer, little do you remember. A famous memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp:049t5qd0lsdyob.why: Noah said, my Lord: they disobeyed me (71:21), and leave none of the disbelievers on earth (71:26), with 'and' in the second. Memorizer pair in one surah.
cmp:049t5qd0lsdyob.relation: Noah's complaint turns into his final prayer.

cmp:1mm2ydt1qy1zsv.why: Increase the wrongdoers only in error (71:24) or in ruin (71:28). Memorizer pair in Noah's prayer.

cmp:1nxbtl805kuske.why: Surahs and ayat opening with 'say', including the refuge surahs and the repeated 'from the evil of'. The book discusses the command word; some memorizer value in which openings carry it.

cmp:05v7nyz0gkvn57.why: The jinn's statements in al-Jinn, opening with two forms (and that He, and that we). Memorizers need the order and the forms; a known reading point too.

cmp:0ut5w7t0t9s149.why: O you wrapped, rise at night; O you cloaked, rise and warn. Two neighbouring surah openings; the run-ons show the different commands.
cmp:0ut5w7t0t9s149.relation: The same address leads to night prayer in one surah and to public warning in the next.

cmp:02rcqn01q1qze2.why: A single ayah (73:20). The book's note is on repetitions inside it; nothing to compare.

cmp:0q963r31a0dl1z.why: He thought and calculated; may he be destroyed, how he calculated; then may he be destroyed, how he calculated. The books explain the repetition; worth pondering.

cmp:0wwqfe213wt4gs.why: It is a reminder, so whoever wills will remember it, and they will not unless God wills: al-Muddaththir and al-Insan, with different wording. Memorizer set; the run-on gives the al-Insan match.
cmp:0wwqfe213wt4gs.relation: Human will acts within God's will.

cmp:0ty92dw1n5ilu4.why: I swear by the Day of Resurrection, and I swear by the self-reproaching soul. Two oaths with and without 'and'; worth pondering their link.
cmp:0ty92dw1n5ilu4.relation: The great Day and the conscience that anticipates it.

cmp:0r9tcz30zp4ka7.why: The moon is eclipsed, and sun and moon are joined: the moon named again rather than by pronoun. The books explain the repeat; worth pondering.

cmp:0flsf150ihrne1.why: Woe to you, woe; then woe to you, woe. The repeat with 'then' is a memorizer point and an emphasis worth pondering.

cmp:1b7cmfi1ai6z42.why: A cup mixed with camphor (76:5) and a cup mixed with ginger (76:17), from a spring called Salsabil. Memorizer set and worth pondering.
cmp:1b7cmfi1ai6z42.relation: Two drinks of the righteous, cool and warm.

cmp:1lzn7a60xkz5du.why: Vessels are passed around them (passive, 76:15) and immortal youths go round them (active, 76:19). Memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp:1p16kxc17fby4y.why: Woe that Day to the deniers: ten times in al-Mursalat and once in al-Mutaffifin. Memorizers need its places; the refrain drives the surah.

cmp:05dfjjn07m9mun.why: No, they will come to know; then no, they will come to know. Repetition with 'then'; memorizer point and an emphasis worth pondering.

cmp:0h6nzs50v63pm1.why: A fitting recompense (for the transgressors) and a recompense from your Lord, a gift by account (for the God-fearing). A contrast in the same word.
cmp:0h6nzs50v63pm1.relation: Contrast: punishment matched to deeds, reward as a gift beyond them.

cmp:1w8eudp19gers9.why: When the great Overwhelming comes (79:34) and when the Deafening Blast comes (80:33). Memorizer pair; two names of the Day.
cmp:1w8eudp19gers9.relation: Two names of the Hour, each fitting its surah.

cmp:0nq9opv09l99vt.why: When the seas are set ablaze (81:6) and burst forth (82:3). A famous memorizer pair.

cmp:1n17s3n1iph03h.why: Every soul will know what it has brought (81:14) or what it sent ahead and left behind (82:5). Memorizer pair.

cmp:1mo0u0h0psjimb.why: What will make you know what the Day of Judgement is; then what will make you know. Repetition with 'then'; memorizer and emphasis.

cmp:1ku71ph1r9zu1l.why: The record of the wicked in Sijjin and of the righteous in 'Illiyyun, each with 'what will make you know' and 'a written record'. A direct contrast in parallel words.
cmp:1ku71ph1r9zu1l.relation: Contrast: two registers, of the wicked and of the righteous, described in the same pattern.

cmp:03dv3dv04ck32v.why: A written record, twice, followed by woe to the deniers or witnessed by those brought near. The run-ons give the contrast.
cmp:03dv3dv04ck32v.relation: The same record, cursed for one group and witnessed by angels for the other.

cmp:18r34i81idsngo.why: And it listens to its Lord, as it must: said of the sky (84:2) and of the earth (84:5). Same refrain; memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:18r34i81idsngo.relation: Heaven and earth both obey their Lord on the Day.

cmp:0ngti0317dbajr.why: Rather those who disbelieve deny (84:22) or are in denial (85:19). Memorizer pair in neighbouring surahs.

cmp:065mrlv0andcdn.why: A single ayah (85:11). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:0pap1ut1hxcjlr.why: A single ayah (86:17). The book's note is on the repeated verb inside it; nothing to compare.

cmp:0wte04z1921kcp.why: Glorify the name of your Lord, who created (87:1-2), and read in the name of your Lord who created (96:1-2). Memorizer set and worth pondering.
cmp:0wte04z1921kcp.relation: Both surahs tie the Lord's name to His act of creating.

cmp:01pqt971vy84cl.why: Faces that Day humbled (88:2) and faces that Day joyful (88:8). A direct contrast in the same words.
cmp:01pqt971vy84cl.relation: Contrast: the two kinds of faces on the Day.

cmp:11185t918k1tn3.why: Parallel lists in al-Ghashiya: cups set out and cushions lined up, and the sky how it was raised and the mountains how they were set. The book discusses the paired descriptions; modest memorizer value.

cmp:0uoxcck0qwq5fg.why: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with 'Ad, and with the people of the elephant. Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:0uoxcck0qwq5fg.relation: God's dealing with a mighty nation and with an invading army.

cmp:13f8683127dogd.why: When his Lord tests him with honour he says 'my Lord honoured me'; with restricted provision, 'my Lord humiliated me'. A direct contrast in the same words.
cmp:13f8683127dogd.relation: Contrast: man misreads both ease and hardship as the measure of his worth.

cmp:1ahr5ds0knzmj0.why: I swear by this town, and you are free (or residing) in this town. The phrase repeated in two ayat; the book explains the repeat; worth pondering.
cmp:1ahr5ds0knzmj0.relation: The town is sworn by because the Prophet is in it.

cmp:007nop118p2b1l.why: We created man in toil (90:4) and in the best form (95:4). Memorizer pair and a contrast worth pondering.
cmp:007nop118p2b1l.relation: Man's two sides: created for struggle and created in excellence.

cmp:0uwoct51k9fomz.why: A single ayah (91:12). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:0mjhmsh06qri1l.why: We will ease him towards ease (92:7) and towards hardship (92:10). A direct contrast in the same words.
cmp:0mjhmsh06qri1l.relation: Contrast: the giver is eased to good, the miser to hardship.

cmp:1t0wgtz05lk5z9.why: As for the orphan, as for the one who asks, as for your Lord's favour: the closing commands of al-Duha. Memorizer set and worth pondering.
cmp:1t0wgtz05lk5z9.relation: The commands answer the favours listed before them: orphaned, lost, poor.

cmp:1efus711ctaw19.why: Who created; created man from a clot: the verb repeated across the first two ayat of al-'Alaq. The books explain the repeat; worth pondering.
cmp:1efus711ctaw19.relation: Creation in general, then man in particular.

cmp:1cv8rmh0p1efjd.why: Read, twice, in the first five ayat of al-'Alaq, with creation and teaching. Memorizer set and worth pondering.
cmp:1cv8rmh0p1efjd.relation: The first command to read is tied to creating, the second to teaching by the pen.

cmp:0c16wqr1ehr7u3.why: The Night of Decree named three times in three ayat instead of a pronoun. The book explains the repeat as exaltation; worth pondering.

cmp:0jg6lbi1eun8mu.why: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Book and the polytheists, at the start and at the end of al-Bayyina, and the believers as best of creatures. Worth pondering the contrast.
cmp:0jg6lbi1eun8mu.relation: Contrast: the worst of creatures and the best of creatures, in the same pattern.

cmp:172mfug1a56eww.why: Whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, and of evil will see it. A direct contrast in the same words.
cmp:172mfug1a56eww.relation: Contrast: nothing, good or evil, is too small to be seen.

cmp:1wfmxh41qs8pc0.why: The horses' oaths and the three statements about man (ungrateful, a witness to it, fierce in love of wealth). The book notes the parallel pattern; worth pondering.
cmp:1wfmxh41qs8pc0.relation: The loyal horse sworn by to expose the disloyal man.

cmp:1pbngl30a8m9j5.why: As for him whose scales are heavy, and him whose scales are light. A direct contrast in the same words.
cmp:1pbngl30a8m9j5.relation: Contrast: two fates decided by the weight of deeds.

cmp:0kywld50gbybv3.why: No, you will come to know; then no, you will come to know. Repetition with 'then'; memorizer point and emphasis.

cmp:0cdmex41ydhmb4.why: The three 'no' ayat of al-Takathur: you will know, then you will know, if only you knew with certainty. Memorizer set and a mounting warning.

cmp:17on4d20e1ceg8.why: You will surely see Hell, then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty. Repetition with escalation; worth pondering.

cmp:1rhledt0ngtrln.why: A single ayah (103:3). The book's note is on the repeated verb inside it; nothing to compare.

cmp:193qq8s1kjkhwu.why: A single row (104:1 reading on to 104:2). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:1qytwrz13bk6af.why: A single ayah (106:1). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:1f9bhl70uvdr5h.why: Those who are heedless of their prayer, those who show off, and withhold small kindness: the relative repeated in al-Ma'un. The book discusses the repeat; modest value for pondering.
cmp:1f9bhl70uvdr5h.relation: Neglect of prayer and of people go together.

cmp:0a9y6ou1xi0oi2.why: We have given you abundance, and your hater is the one cut off. Opening and close of al-Kawthar in parallel form; worth pondering.
cmp:0a9y6ou1xi0oi2.relation: Contrast: abundance for the Prophet, being cut off for his enemy.

cmp:19azv8q1dkci8e.why: The repeated negations of al-Kafirun with changing verb forms (worship, worshippers, worshipped). A famous memorizer and pondering point the books explain.
cmp:19azv8q1dkci8e.relation: Present and past, act and nature: no common worship on any level.

cmp:1g9hliz054qg9j.why: A single ayah (110:1). Nothing in the card to compare.

cmp:1ibbxys0pxwwwm.why: A single ayah (111:1). The book's note is on the repeated verb inside it; nothing to compare.

cmp:143zno401thlyi.why: God is One; God, the Eternal: the name repeated instead of a pronoun in al-Ikhlas. The book explains the repeat; worth pondering.

cmp:07bnvjn0rocp3r.why: And from the evil of: darkness, the blowers on knots, the envier. The book asks why the opening is repeated; memorizer and pondering value.

cmp:0dqmtv60s30cqe.why: Mankind named five times in al-Nas instead of a pronoun. The books explain the repeat; worth pondering.
cmp:0dqmtv60s30cqe.relation: God as Lord, King and God of mankind, against the whisperer among jinn and mankind.

cmp:1h6o3d5122kdwz.why: Lord of mankind, King of mankind, God of mankind: the three attributes with the word repeated. Contained in the larger card; valid for pondering.

cmp:15azvn31xcj1c5.why: The six surahs that open with the same three letters, each read on into its next ayah, so a memorizer sees how each one continues. That continuation is the real point of the card.

cmp:0qthv8n0sfgnbh.why: Believing in what was sent down to you and before you: the God-fearing (2:4), the hypocrites who only claim it (4:60), and the firm in knowledge (4:162). A meaningful contrast and a memorizer set.
cmp:0qthv8n0sfgnbh.relation: Contrast: true faith in all revelation, against a claim of it while seeking false judges.

cmp:0bfovu51fm8qur.why: The same two believing places are already in the three-ayah card on this phrase, which adds the hypocrites' contrast. This pair gives nothing more.

cmp:0qu23mb1wckbrh.why: Among people are those who say 'we believe in God': the hypocrites (2:8) and the one who breaks under persecution (29:10). Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp:0qu23mb1wckbrh.relation: Two kinds of hollow faith: one never real, one that fails under trial.

cmp:0ek4b6x09dx2ud.why: When it is said to them 'believe': the hypocrites answer 'shall we believe like the fools', and the Jews 'we believe in what was sent to us'. Same opening, two refusals; memorizer pair.
cmp:0ek4b6x09dx2ud.relation: Two refusals of the same call, one from contempt, one from exclusivity.

cmp:1pedyqz0q2o7kj.why: When they meet the believers they say 'we believe', and when alone: with their devils (the hypocrites) or with one another (some of the Jews). Classic memorizer pair on the same double face.
cmp:1pedyqz0q2o7kj.relation: The same two-faced speech, among hypocrites and among some of the People of the Book.

cmp:0x3o86p1l06aw9.why: Those who bought error for guidance, or worldly life for the Hereafter, with different consequences. Memorizer set on one image.
cmp:0x3o86p1l06aw9.relation: The losing trade of exchanging the lasting for the passing.

cmp:1iey6y915rc0or.why: God is able to do all things is a stock closing found in dozens of ayat; these eleven share only that and their subjects differ. Each row also reads on into an unrelated next ayah, which adds nothing to the match.

cmp:1soz0hv0imryl7.why: He who made the earth a bed (2:22) or a cradle (20:53, 43:10) for you, with the continuations differing. A real memorizer set. 36:80 shares only the opening words and is about fire from the green tree.
cmp:1soz0hv0imryl7.changes: Removed 36:80: it shares only the three opening words and speaks of fire from a tree, not the earth spread for people.

cmp:1he1j3n1gonz01.why: If you do not do it: the challenge to produce a surah (2:24) and the order to give up usury (2:279). Only this short phrase is shared and the subjects differ; the continuations are too different to confuse.

cmp:0ylc04w0ntfihi.why: Theirs are gardens beneath which rivers flow: a generic reward formula shared by five different groups. The memorizer traps it hides (forever, the great or the great success) are already covered by the book cards on this promise.

cmp:0z9ruvy1jd41b0.why: Those who believe and do good, with gardens: a generic reward formula with different speakers and endings. The real near-identical pairs (4:57 with 4:122; 22:14 with 47:12) are not together here; 4:57 with 4:122 already has its own card.

cmp:1o634bl1aoj461.why: Most rows share only the generic reward formula. Inside it is one real pair: 47:12 and 22:14 open with the same full sentence, God admits those who believe and do good to gardens, then end differently. That pair has no card of its own.
cmp:1o634bl1aoj461.changes: Kept only 47:12 and added 22:14, its near-identical twin; removed 2:25, 4:122, 29:58 and 85:11, which share only the generic formula.
cmp:1o634bl1aoj461.relation: The same promise, closed once by God doing what He wills and once by the disbelievers eating like cattle.

cmp:18z7q0j1m0rs1b.why: Another selection of the same generic reward formula with different subjects. It adds nothing to the other cards on this promise; 4:57 with 4:122 has its own card.

cmp:1hv8ev61q0vxze.why: The generic promise to those who believe and do good, with gardens beneath which rivers flow. Each ayah has its own subject and setting, and the same set is already covered by other cards. Nothing particular to learn.

cmp:1cx3yfh076iqop.why: Only the generic reward formula is shared. 2:25 goes on to the fruit of paradise and 22:23 to its jewellery and silk, so the subjects after the formula differ.

cmp:0qod6te1fdoxr0.why: Only the generic reward formula is shared. 4:122 closes with a statement about the truth of God's promise, which has nothing in common with 2:25.

cmp:04uvkn701jo9rj.why: Beyond the generic formula, both ayat also promise pure spouses in the gardens, which few ayat do. A memorizer can mix the two endings. Worth a small card.
cmp:04uvkn701jo9rj.relation: The same description of paradise, with its gardens and pure spouses, given in two surahs.

cmp:1nc74jj1x6gd19.why: Only the generic reward formula is shared. 29:58 speaks of lofty chambers and the reward of those who work, a different picture from 2:25.

cmp:16f16pb0epaq1j.why: As a whole the card shares only a three-word opening followed by unrelated verbs. Inside it, 4:40 and 10:44 make a real pair: both say that God does not wrong anyone, in two wordings a memorizer can confuse.
cmp:16f16pb0epaq1j.changes: Removed 2:26, 3:5 and 4:48. Their verbs after the opening are different words, so only 4:40 and 10:44 remain.
cmp:16f16pb0epaq1j.relation: God's justice stated twice: He wrongs no one by even an atom's weight, and people wrong only themselves.

cmp:0vhkl5808thi3u.why: A clear contrast built on the same clause. 13:21 praises those who join what God ordered joined, while 2:27 and 13:25 condemn those who cut it, in almost identical words. Their endings differ, which matters to a memorizer.
cmp:0vhkl5808thi3u.relation: Contrast: those who keep God's ties and those who break them, described with the same words.

cmp:02kj7xn1juya4t.why: Both ayat speak of God creating and then rising over the heaven or the throne. One is about the earth made for people, the other about the six days. The shared sequence invites reflection, and the different objects are a trap for a memorizer.
cmp:02kj7xn1juya4t.relation: The same pattern of creation followed by God's rising, told about the earth and heavens in two places.

cmp:0nrjf8z1mq82t5.why: The same rare rebuke opens both endings. God says it to the angels about His knowledge of the unseen, and Yaqub says it to his sons about the knowledge God gave him. A good pair for pondering and for memorizing.
cmp:0nrjf8z1mq82t5.relation: God's complete knowledge, and the knowledge He grants a prophet, both announced with the same words.

cmp:1214yha1qpncla.why: The story of the angels bowing to Adam and Iblis refusing, told in five surahs. Each telling ends differently: refusal, pride, an argument, being of the jinn. This is the classic mutashabih set.
cmp:1214yha1qpncla.relation: One story told five times, each telling showing another side of Iblis's refusal.

cmp:1r5ts1c0gwb61q.why: The same story and rows as cmp:1214yha1qpncla, without 7:11. It is fully contained in that card and adds nothing on its own.

cmp:0iu4xmr1oy0peb.why: A well-known memorizer refrain: no fear upon them, nor will they grieve. It is introduced in different ways and with different particles before it. Each row also shows who is promised safety, which suits pondering.
cmp:0iu4xmr1oy0peb.relation: The same promise of safety given to those who follow guidance, believe, give in charity or stand firm.

cmp:1km5x5c1kz3558.why: The companions of the fire, abiding in it eternally: a refrain whose lead-in differs in each place, and some places add a particle. Each row also names a different cause of the fate, which is useful for both purposes.
cmp:1km5x5c1kz3558.relation: The various deeds that lead to the same eternal end in the fire.

cmp:0ess9lv04uq6xz.why: Those who disbelieve and deny the signs: the same clause ends in the fire in some places and in hellfire in others. A real trap for a memorizer.

cmp:1rz5oqe1wptdnw.why: The same clause about those who disbelieve and deny, ending three ways: the fire, hellfire or a humiliating punishment. It overlaps the card cmp:0ess9lv04uq6xz but adds 22:57.

cmp:0ai4vf50fmng85.why: The call to the Children of Israel to remember God's favour, repeated three times. The first continues with keeping the covenant, the other two with being favoured over the worlds. A classic memorizer set.
cmp:0ai4vf50fmng85.relation: Repeated reminders of God's favour to the Children of Israel, at the opening and close of their story in al-Baqara.

cmp:0cjh6ln0zav859.why: The two ayat are word for word the same. The real difference is in the next ayah, where intercession and compensation swap places. A memorizer needs the pair together with the ayah after it.
cmp:0cjh6ln0zav859.relation: The same reminder bookends the story of the Children of Israel in al-Baqara.

cmp:04rhcuv13a0u03.why: The same rebuke for taking the calf after Musa left, once in the story itself and once as an argument against the Jews of Madina. They open differently and continue differently.
cmp:04rhcuv13a0u03.relation: The calf recalled twice: first as history, then as evidence against later claims of faith.

cmp:17w5mj01u382ty.why: Musa addressing his people: the call to his people appears in some places and not in others, and two places continue alike with remembering God's favour. These are known mutashabih. The subjects vary, but all are moments of Musa with his people.
cmp:17w5mj01u382ty.relation: Musa's dealings with his people: repentance, the cow, the favours, and their harming him.
