cmp:17qw3v705bmku1.why: Surely in that are signs for a people who reflect: closing four signs (the spread earth, spouses and love, sleep as a small death, all things subjected). The memorizer must match each sign to the faculty named; reflection is asked of these.
cmp:17qw3v705bmku1.relation: Similarity: the signs that call for reflection.

cmp:04j92sw033fnzs.why: Surely in that are signs for a people who reason: closing three signs (gardens watered by one water but different, night, day and stars subjected, lightning and rain). The memorizer must tie each sign to its closing.
cmp:04j92sw033fnzs.relation: Similarity: the signs that call for reasoning.

cmp:12iz1wk1gtdszg.why: Those who disbelieve say, three times in one surah: why has no sign been sent down (twice), and you are not a messenger. A memorizer set with the answers to each.
cmp:12iz1wk1gtdszg.relation: Same subject: the deniers' objections in ar-Rad, and God's replies.

cmp:03q0s5206580dk.why: Only the short opening, God knows what, is shared. One is about what every womb carries, the other about what you hide and show; a common phrase with different subjects.

cmp:1nhm37t196mdu7.why: Knower of the unseen and the seen, then: the Great, the Exalted; exalted above what they associate; the Mighty, the Wise. Three ayat that open alike and close with different names.
cmp:1nhm37t196mdu7.relation: Same attribute of God, joined each time to another of His names.

cmp:1xppzdq0id6f2s.why: It is He who shows you: lightning in fear and hope, and His signs with provision from the sky. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1xppzdq0id6f2s.relation: Same theme: signs from the sky that bring both fear and provision.

cmp:0cb5kvf1pl3qfd.why: The prayer of the disbelievers is only in error: after the parable of one stretching his hands to water, and in the reply of Hell's keepers. The only two places of this sentence.
cmp:0cb5kvf1pl3qfd.relation: Same theme: prayer to other than God, and prayer too late, are both lost.

cmp:1lf01nc123yqik.why: Say, who is Lord of the heavens...: and the earth, then God; and of the seven heavens and the great Throne. Two forms of the same question.
cmp:1lf01nc123yqik.relation: Same argument: the Lord of the heavens deserves sole worship.

cmp:0gpx2521neqpji.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the ransom of all that is on earth (with 5:36).

cmp:079yfoq182231c.why: Established prayer and spent of what We provided them, secretly and openly: in the description of the people of understanding and of those who recite God's Book. A memorizer pair.
cmp:079yfoq182231c.relation: Same description of the righteous: prayer and spending.

cmp:1iapco41ynxxmw.why: Gardens of Eden with the righteous among their fathers, spouses and offspring: as a description, and in the angels' prayer for the believers. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1iapco41ynxxmw.relation: Same promise: families reunited in the Garden, promised and prayed for.

cmp:129v4510w36iht.why: Gardens of Eden which they will enter: with the righteous of their families, with rivers and all they wish, adorned with gold, pearls and silk. Three openings alike with different descriptions.
cmp:129v4510w36iht.relation: Same promise: three pictures of the gardens of Eden.

cmp:1hpiez70x9h62h.why: God extends provision to whom He wills and restricts it: once with their delight in this world, twice with signs for those who believe, with two different questions (do they not see, do they not know). A memorizer set.
cmp:1hpiez70x9h62h.relation: Same theme: provision is measured by God, a sign for believers.

cmp:1chdxjh05mz5ph.why: God sends astray whom He wills and guides: whoever turns to Him, or whom He wills. A memorizer pair whose last words differ.
cmp:1chdxjh05mz5ph.relation: Same theme: guidance is God's, and turning to Him is the way to it.

cmp:14zn7p715qiqqj.why: Whom God sends astray has no...: guide (four times), protector after Him, or way. A classic memorizer tree with one subject.
cmp:14zn7p715qiqqj.relation: Same theme: no one can rescue whom God leaves to stray.

cmp:0rld9g80r6old2.why: A repeat: these four ayat are in the six-row card of the same phrase, which also shows the other two tails.

cmp:1ufp1sw0ftuwzo.why: The likeness of the Garden promised to the God-fearing: once briefly with rivers, lasting fruit and shade, once with four kinds of rivers. Each ends by setting it against the Fire.
cmp:1ufp1sw0ftuwzo.relation: Contrast: the Garden of the God-fearing set beside the Fire of the deniers.

cmp:1y6nair0kuuuub.why: Have they not seen that We...: reduce the land from its edges, made a safe sanctuary, drive water to dry land, created cattle for them. Four signs with the same opening.
cmp:1y6nair0kuuuub.relation: Same theme: visible signs of God's power and favour.

cmp:0x06rw90eykk1z.why: We come to the land, reducing it from its edges: with have they not seen and the judgment of God, or do they not see and are they the victors. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0x06rw90eykk1z.relation: Same sign: the shrinking of the deniers' land.

cmp:02jj58g0m2phr6.why: Those before them plotted: then all plotting belongs to God, or God came at their building from its foundations. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:02jj58g0m2phr6.relation: Same theme: the plots of the past failed against God.

cmp:0t4a7x0052jr1s.why: Say, God suffices as witness between me and you: answering you are not a messenger, then he who has knowledge of the Book; or He is aware and seeing of His servants. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0t4a7x0052jr1s.relation: Same answer: God as witness for His messenger.

cmp:1vjb5zk1dj6nkq.why: To whom belongs what is in the heavens and the earth: after God, after praise be to God, after the path of God, with different continuations. A memorizer set.
cmp:1vjb5zk1dj6nkq.relation: Same attribute: God's ownership as ground of praise, warning and the return of all matters.

cmp:0ejkjoh19q8g69.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same clause (with 34:1).

cmp:0rb4sup1gut3l5.why: God sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills: after the messenger speaking his people's tongue, and after the number of Hell's keepers as a test. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0rb4sup1gut3l5.relation: Same theme: clear messages and tests both lead some to guidance and some to error.

cmp:01horwm06kan1o.why: Surely in that are signs for every patient, grateful one: closing four signs (God's days with Moses' people, ships at sea, Saba torn apart, the still wind). A rare closing whose places the memorizer must know.
cmp:01horwm06kan1o.relation: Similarity: patience in hardship and gratitude in ease are what these signs teach.

cmp:029n14b004213r.why: The people of Noah, Ad and Thamud and those after them: in the messengers' address and in the believer of Pharaoh's people. Two tails, a memorizer pair.
cmp:029n14b004213r.relation: Same theme: the succession of destroyed peoples as a warning.

cmp:1uu07321styhky.why: Has not the news reached you of those before you: then the named peoples, or those who disbelieved and tasted the result of their deeds. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1uu07321styhky.relation: Same theme: the news of earlier peoples as a lesson.

cmp:0p3ws911t2p707.why: To forgive you of your sins and defer you to a set term: in the messengers' reply to their peoples, and in Noah's call. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0p3ws911t2p707.relation: Same promise: forgiveness and respite for those who answer the call.

cmp:0zm35ue1g8u8b8.why: To bar us, or you, from what our, or your, fathers worshipped: the deniers' charge against the messengers and against the Prophet. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0zm35ue1g8u8b8.relation: Same accusation against all prophets: they turn people from their fathers' ways.

cmp:0itccew0quuiwa.why: Except by God's permission, and upon God let the believers rely: the messengers' reply that they bring no proof except by God's leave, and the secret talk that cannot harm except by His leave. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0itccew0quuiwa.relation: Same theme: nothing happens without God's permission, so trust Him.

cmp:09r7uee0uu1amw.why: If He wills He will remove you and bring a new creation, and that is not hard for God: two ayat repeated together in two surahs, after the creation of the heavens and earth in truth and after man's need of God.
cmp:09r7uee0uu1amw.relation: Same theme: mankind replaceable at God's will.

cmp:0aetti41imhefc.why: A repeat: this short identical ayah is already inside the rows of the 14:19 and 35:16 pair, which shows it with what comes before it.

cmp:0ozsr1k1meyhos.why: The weak say to the arrogant, we were your followers, can you avail us: in the open gathering before God and in the arguing inside the Fire. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0ozsr1k1meyhos.relation: Same scene: followers blaming their leaders when it is too late.

cmp:11ln1if1vniwz3.why: God admits those who believe and do good into gardens with rivers flowing beneath: three times in the form indeed God admits, once as were admitted, each with a different tail (God does what He wills, bracelets of gold, the deniers eat like cattle). A branch that the large gardens card mostly lacks.
cmp:11ln1if1vniwz3.relation: Same promise, set once against the deniers' animal-like enjoyment.

cmp:11zlvw11i3k91j.why: Only the common gardens phrase is shared, already shown in the gardens cards. The pair adds no new branch.

cmp:039jbxl1kswrcn.why: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with...: Ad, the people of the elephant. Two short openings that a memorizer must keep apart. 14:24, have you not seen how God set forth a parable, has a different verb and subject.
cmp:039jbxl1kswrcn.changes: Removed 14:24, which is about a parable, not about how your Lord dealt with a people.
cmp:039jbxl1kswrcn.relation: Same theme: what God did to the arrogant of the past.

cmp:10ginbd1lwapk9.why: Hell, they will burn in it, and wretched is: the settlement, or the resting place. Two short ayat that differ in one word, a memorizer pair.
cmp:10ginbd1lwapk9.relation: Same end of the arrogant leaders and of the transgressors.

cmp:1l07gl81ya3o5u.why: They set up rivals to God to lead others from His way; say, enjoy yourselves: in plural to the deniers, and in singular to the ungrateful man who forgets his prayer in hardship. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1l07gl81ya3o5u.relation: Same rebuke: brief enjoyment, then the Fire, for those who set up rivals to God.

cmp:1apsun10z5yeud.why: Prayer and spending from what We provided, secretly and openly: a command to God's servants before a day with no trade, and the praise of those who recite the Book. A memorizer pair (13:22 has the same clause).
cmp:1apsun10z5yeud.relation: Same deeds: prayer and spending, commanded and praised.

cmp:179j4fi02483x0.why: God is the One who created: the heavens and earth and sends rain, the heavens and earth in six days, seven heavens and as many earths. Three openings alike, each going on to a different lesson.
cmp:179j4fi02483x0.relation: Same theme: creation as the ground of provision, rule and knowledge.

cmp:06ukg8y00azd0o.why: Never think God...: unaware of what the wrongdoers do, or failing His promise to His messengers. Two warnings in one passage with different conjunctions.
cmp:06ukg8y00azd0o.relation: Same theme: the delay of punishment is not neglect or a broken promise.

cmp:08uq9se03xf2ry.why: We destroyed no town but that it had: a known term, or warners. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:08uq9se03xf2ry.relation: Same theme: no town is destroyed without a term and a warning.

cmp:1im8d8m07ax95k.why: No nation can advance its term, nor delay it: the same ayah word for word in two surahs. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1im8d8m07ax95k.relation: Same theme: the appointed term of nations.

cmp:1kvovc31r4ks5v.why: It is We who sent down: the Reminder, and We are its guardians; the Quran to you in stages. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1kvovc31r4ks5v.relation: Same theme: God sent down the Quran and protects it.

cmp:0utovm41g077ec.why: We sent before you: among the sects of the ancients, and messengers to their peoples who brought clear proofs. A memorizer pair that consoles the Prophet.
cmp:0utovm41g077ec.relation: Same theme: earlier messengers, denied then vindicated.

cmp:1gucjp91vjww5x.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the seven-row card of no messenger or sign comes to them but they mock or turn away.

cmp:078ux8w1ryeuou.why: They will not believe in it: and the way of the ancients has passed, or until they see the painful punishment. Both follow the same sentence, thus We insert it into the hearts of the criminals. A strong short memorizer pair.
cmp:078ux8w1ryeuou.relation: Same theme: the criminals' hearts reject the Quran.

cmp:1no572v1jamqcx.why: We spread the earth, cast mountains in it and made grow in it of every...: well-measured thing, or delightful pair. A memorizer pair whose last words differ.
cmp:1no572v1jamqcx.relation: Same sign: the spread earth and what grows on it.

cmp:13h36gt1x2f3nz.why: We created man: from dry clay, from an extract of clay, knowing what his soul whispers, in toil, in the best form. Five places, three with the conjunction and two without. A memorizer set.
cmp:13h36gt1x2f3nz.relation: Same theme: the creation of man and his condition.

cmp:1908cpw1tyrioc.why: You are of those given respite until the day of the known time: identical in two tellings of Iblis's story, then his oath differs (because You misled me, by Your might). A memorizer pair.
cmp:1908cpw1tyrioc.relation: Same story: Iblis granted respite and his oath to mislead.

cmp:0qdupgf1q5bz91.why: He said, my Lord, because You...: misled me, I will make things fair to them (Iblis); blessed me, I will never support the criminals (Moses). The same words open a vow of evil and a vow of good.
cmp:0qdupgf1q5bz91.relation: Contrast: Iblis blames God and vows to mislead; Moses thanks God and vows to stay clear of wrong.

cmp:10t96cl0rexmfl.why: Over My servants you have no authority: except those who follow you, or your Lord suffices as guardian. A memorizer pair.
cmp:10t96cl0rexmfl.relation: Same promise: Satan has no power over God's true servants.

cmp:1v3lokk0r5pxm2.why: The God-fearing will be among gardens and springs: the same ayah word for word, then different next ayat. A memorizer pair.

cmp:1p3a0vb1tdl3e7.why: When they entered upon him and said peace, he said: we are afraid of you, or peace, strangers. Two tellings of Abraham's guests, a memorizer pair.

cmp:0vdas930fey7ov.why: What is your business, O messengers? They said, we have been sent to a criminal people: identical in two surahs, then the third ayah differs (except Lot's family, to send stones). A memorizer pair.
cmp:0vdas930fey7ov.relation: Same story: the angels' mission to Lot's people.

cmp:0fdyxbb1in07mr.why: A repeat: these two ayat are already inside the rows of the 15:57 and 51:31 pair, which shows them with the question before and the different ayah after.

cmp:1ce6lht0nlj86h.why: Two short ayat that share only the stock opening, surely in that are signs; one closes the ruin of Lot's people, the other the flood, with different endings. Nothing beyond the common formula.

cmp:17e2ung0bmuwti.why: What they used to earn did not avail them: closing the end of the people of al-Hijr, of those before who made the same claim, and of the stronger earlier peoples. A memorizer set with one lesson.
cmp:17e2ung0bmuwti.relation: Same theme: wealth and power do not protect from God's punishment.

cmp:0w95f8e0kxziwm.why: Did not avail them what they used to...: earn, or enjoy. Two short ayat, with and without the conjunction, that differ in the last word. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0w95f8e0kxziwm.relation: Same theme: earnings and pleasures are useless when punishment comes.

cmp:0nrfchm0pdybra.why: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them...: except in truth (twice) or in play. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer set.
cmp:0nrfchm0pdybra.relation: Same theme: creation has a purpose, not play.

cmp:1r1c5wd02imko5.why: Created the heavens and the earth and what is between them only in truth: twice in the first person and once in the third (God created), with and for a set term. A memorizer set.
cmp:1r1c5wd02imko5.relation: Same theme: creation in truth and for a term, so the Hour will come.

cmp:1kohibl0comb3r.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the two three-row cards of the same sentence.

cmp:0zysckb0sdbpg7.why: Do not extend your eyes to what We have given some of them to enjoy: then do not grieve over them and lower your wing to the believers, or the flower of worldly life. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:0zysckb0sdbpg7.relation: Same command: do not envy the deniers' worldly enjoyment.

cmp:1uiz9jl1hhs1dn.why: He sends the Spirit of His command on whom He wills of His servants: to warn that there is no god but Him, or to warn of the Day of Meeting. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1uiz9jl1hhs1dn.relation: Same theme: revelation chosen by God, for warning.

cmp:0yktg1m0gndagm.why: He created the heavens and the earth in truth: then exalted above what they associate, He wraps night over day, He shaped you well. Three openings alike, a memorizer set.
cmp:0yktg1m0gndagm.relation: Same theme: creation in truth, then oneness, cosmic order and the shaping of man.

cmp:0av2j2q1yudjeq.why: He created man from: a sperm-drop, haste, clay like pottery, a clinging clot. Four short openings, a memorizer set and a lesson on man's origin and nature.
cmp:0av2j2q1yudjeq.relation: Same theme: man's humble origin and his hasty, quarrelsome nature.

cmp:1u5241a1vkiz9i.why: From a sperm-drop, and then he is an open adversary: once as a statement, once inside the question does man not see. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1u5241a1vkiz9i.relation: Same irony: made from a drop, he argues against his Maker.

cmp:0j3ic7b08m2qbt.why: Surely in that is a sign for a people who reflect, with sign in the singular: closing the crops from rain and the bee's honey, in one surah. The memorizer must separate singular from plural closings.
cmp:0j3ic7b08m2qbt.relation: Similarity: rain and the bee, two signs that call for reflection.

cmp:06be37j0p69y5t.why: So that you may seek of His bounty and that you may be grateful: after the subjected sea and after the night and day made a mercy. A memorizer pair.
cmp:06be37j0p69y5t.relation: Same theme: God's signs are means of livelihood and reasons for thanks.

cmp:1m7a3wy1ytzoxq.why: He cast firm mountains on the earth lest it shift with you: then rivers and paths, or animals and rain. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1m7a3wy1ytzoxq.relation: Same sign: the mountains that steady the earth.

cmp:0cds5hb00skv2r.why: The punishment came to them from where they did not perceive: after the plotters whose building fell on them, and after the deniers before them. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0cds5hb00skv2r.relation: Same theme: sudden punishment of earlier deniers.

cmp:00la6xb0b6spbj.why: Those whom the angels take in death: wronging themselves, or good. Two ayat of one passage with opposite ends.
cmp:00la6xb0b6spbj.relation: Contrast: the death of the wrongdoers and the death of the good, in the same words.

cmp:1pu1s7416pcnpk.why: For those who do good in this world there is good: in the God-fearing's answer about revelation, and in the call to the believers to fear God. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1pu1s7416pcnpk.relation: Same promise: good for the doers of good, here and in the Hereafter.

cmp:15b640014k63ls.why: Those who emigrated for God, or in God's way: a good abode in this world and a greater reward, or a good provision if killed or dead. A memorizer pair.
cmp:15b640014k63ls.relation: Same subject: the reward of the emigrants.

cmp:1pm9w9n1dyop1l.why: Those who were patient and rely on their Lord: the same short ayah word for word in two surahs, then different next ayat. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1pm9w9n1dyop1l.relation: Same description of the emigrants and the believers.

cmp:1rboc9n0wy3uor.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of We sent before you only men (with 12:109).

cmp:11eqk741c25ca8.why: Have they not looked at: what God created whose shadows bow, the earth and what grows in it, the birds above them. Three signs, a memorizer set.
cmp:11eqk741c25ca8.relation: Same theme: signs within sight that point to God.

cmp:1n4vxsi19tefe4.why: So that they deny what We gave them; enjoy then, you will come to know: the same ayah word for word in two surahs, each after people who call on God in distress and then associate. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1n4vxsi19tefe4.relation: Same theme: ingratitude after rescue, met with a threat.

cmp:0wtgc370unkejn.why: So that they deny what We gave them, then enjoy, you will come to know: a command in the second person in 16:55, a third-person form in 29:66. A fine memorizer distinction.
cmp:0wtgc370unkejn.relation: Same theme: the ungrateful are left to enjoy for a while.

cmp:13zcl4m0yba6a2.why: We did not send down to you the Book, or the Quran: except to make clear what they differed about, or to make you miserable. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair on the purpose of revelation.
cmp:13zcl4m0yba6a2.relation: Same theme: why the Quran was revealed, to clarify and not to burden.

cmp:11bmw0j0pvzl3n.why: Water from the sky by which He revives the earth after its death, then signs for people who hear, or who reason: one past tense with a singular sign, one present with plural signs. A memorizer pair.
cmp:11bmw0j0pvzl3n.relation: Same sign: rain reviving dead land.

cmp:09sq9vq1cmhfwa.why: Sent down water from the sky and revived the earth after its death: a statement in an-Nahl and a question to the deniers in al-Ankabut, who answer God. A memorizer pair.
cmp:09sq9vq1cmhfwa.relation: Same sign used as a statement and as an argument against the idolaters.

cmp:195flm60eaav2s.why: God made for you: spouses from yourselves, homes and tents, shade and garments, the earth as a carpet. Four lists of favours with the same opening, three in one passage.
cmp:195flm60eaav2s.relation: Same theme: God's favours in family, shelter and the earth.

cmp:0k12agv1uf8der.why: Praise be to God, but most of them do not know: closing two parables (the slave and the free, the man with quarrelling partners) and the deniers' admission that God created all. A memorizer set.
cmp:0k12agv1uf8der.relation: Same theme: the plain truth that most people ignore.

cmp:17lu6os14yuch2.why: Surely in that are signs for a people who believe: closing five signs (the birds held in the sky, night and day, Abraham saved from the fire, provision extended and restricted twice). The memorizer must match each sign to its closing.
cmp:17lu6os14yuch2.relation: Similarity: the signs that speak to those who believe.

cmp:17lknqe18q2wv8.why: When those who wronged see the punishment, and when those who associated see their partners: consecutive ayat with the same opening and two scenes of the Day.
cmp:17lknqe18q2wv8.relation: Same scene: the wrongdoers face the punishment and their false gods.

cmp:0w43tts1fx6njo.why: He sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills: after had God willed He would have made you one community, and after the one whose evil deeds seem good to him. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0w43tts1fx6njo.relation: Same theme: guidance belongs to God, so do not grieve for those who stray.

cmp:0ufkljj0xt8hun.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of whoever does good, male or female, while a believer (with 4:124).

cmp:0mv4ib10iafwpt.why: Whoever does good: male or female while a believer (16:97), or it is for himself, whoever does evil it is against himself (41:46 and 45:15, alike up to the tail). A memorizer set.
cmp:0mv4ib10iafwpt.relation: Same theme: every deed returns to its doer.

cmp:1j0n6v31p2wa7p.why: When you recite the Quran: seek refuge in God from Satan, or We place a hidden barrier between you and the deniers. Different conjunctions, a memorizer pair.
cmp:1j0n6v31p2wa7p.relation: Same occasion, recitation: protection from Satan and a veil from the deniers.

cmp:0850eni1wfyx3o.why: Those are the ones whose hearts God has sealed: then their hearing and sight, they are heedless; or they followed their desires. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0850eni1wfyx3o.relation: Same theme: the sealed heart and its causes.

cmp:0ogr4ci1rdugbk.why: Those who repent after that and reform, God is Forgiving and Merciful: after evil done in ignorance, and after slander of chaste women. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0ogr4ci1rdugbk.relation: Same theme: repentance with reform opens forgiveness.

cmp:11wflz71jz967x.why: A partial copy of the family of your Lord knows best who strays from His path; its ayat belong in the four-row card proposed under the 6:117 card.

cmp:0pa83wt111bhrr.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the card of your Lord knows best who strays from His path.

cmp:1wchf6e1vbkb68.why: This Quran: guides to what is most upright, and relates to the Children of Israel most of what they differ about. A memorizer pair on what the Quran does.
cmp:1wchf6e1vbkb68.relation: Same subject: the Quran as guide and as judge of disputes.

cmp:1eeql651ntv4rd.why: How many We destroyed: of the generations after Noah, of towns proud of their living, of generations before them. A memorizer set.
cmp:1eeql651ntv4rd.relation: Same theme: the ruins of destroyed peoples as warning.

cmp:1wvscb810x6kk6.why: Do not set up another god with God: at the start and the end of the same list of commandments, with different results (blamed and forsaken, cast into Hell blamed and rejected). A memorizer pair.
cmp:1wvscb810x6kk6.relation: Same command framing the commandments of al-Isra.

cmp:1auh3sj03ty91h.why: Give the relative his right, and the needy and the traveller: then do not squander, or that is better for those who seek God's face. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1auh3sj03ty91h.relation: Same command: rights of kin and the needy.

cmp:0bh9s6u1mk9or4.why: He extends provision to whom He wills and restricts it; He is...: aware and seeing of His servants, or knowing of all things. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0bh9s6u1mk9or4.relation: Same theme: provision measured by knowledge.

cmp:0g1d0bi14gwiu8.why: We have varied in this Quran: so they may remember, yet it only increases their aversion; or every kind of example, yet man is most argumentative. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0g1d0bi14gwiu8.relation: Same theme: the variety of the Quran's examples and people's resistance.

cmp:08wrhju1c62th2.why: Only the short opening, say if there were, is shared. The three ayat argue different things (other gods with Him, angels on earth, the sea as ink); a common phrase with different subjects.

cmp:0w6u92v1caf6gp.why: The wrongdoers say, you follow only a bewitched man: in two surahs, and in both the next ayah is the same, see how they strike examples for you. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0w6u92v1caf6gp.relation: Same accusation and the same reply.

cmp:0nva1om06olc7w.why: We know best what they...: listen to, say (twice). Three places with the same opening and different continuations.
cmp:0nva1om06olc7w.relation: Same theme: God knows the deniers' talk, so the Prophet need not be troubled.

cmp:1xtx7e511vmdvv.why: The truth has come: and falsehood has vanished, or falsehood neither begins nor repeats. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:1xtx7e511vmdvv.relation: Same declaration: falsehood has no power before the truth.

cmp:083zy2m1xgdtmq.why: When We bless man he turns away and distances himself, and when evil touches him: he despairs, or he is full of long prayer. A long identical run with a different tail.
cmp:083zy2m1xgdtmq.relation: Same theme: man's ingratitude in ease and his state in hardship.

cmp:0hp1he209wmi7y.why: We have set forth, or varied, for people in this Quran every kind of example: three places with different verbs and tails (most refuse, the deniers call you liars, so they may remember). A memorizer set.
cmp:0hp1he209wmi7y.relation: Same theme: the Quran's many examples and people's responses.

cmp:0p0f5lw1q8bphc.why: We have varied for people in this Quran every example: the word order of for people and in this Quran is reversed between the two. A classic memorizer pair.
cmp:0p0f5lw1q8bphc.relation: Same theme: the many examples and man's refusal or argument.

cmp:19a115403klm76.why: Say, God suffices between me and you as witness: the word witness comes before between me and you in one and after it in the other. A memorizer pair (13:43 has a third form).
cmp:19a115403klm76.relation: Same answer to the deniers: God is witness.

cmp:0yg38b01ct9jp4.why: Whom God guides is rightly guided, and whom He sends astray, you will find for them no protectors, or for him no guiding ally. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0yg38b01ct9jp4.relation: Same theme: guidance and error in God's hand.

cmp:1ppb5jm1co8he6.why: Do they not see that God who created the heavens and the earth is able: to create their like, or to give life to the dead. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1ppb5jm1co8he6.relation: Same argument: the Creator of the heavens can raise the dead.

cmp:0ez0lgt11wfdb9.why: The strong part of this card is the 17:99 and 46:33 pair, which has its own card; 30:37 shares only the opening do they not see that God, with a different subject (provision).

cmp:0wy24ap0x7cyrv.why: He has not taken a son and has no partner in dominion: in the praise that closes al-Isra and in the description that opens al-Furqan, with different surroundings. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0wy24ap0x7cyrv.relation: Same declaration of God's oneness and sovereignty.

cmp:0gn39vb1ksd7kv.why: They have no knowledge of it: nor did their fathers, or they follow only conjecture. Said of those who claim God has a son and of those who name the angels female. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0gn39vb1ksd7kv.relation: Same theme: false claims about God made without knowledge.

cmp:1beuo071gz8pv5.why: Perhaps you will destroy yourself with grief: over their traces if they do not believe, or that they will not be believers. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:1beuo071gz8pv5.relation: Same consolation to the Prophet over his people's rejection.

cmp:1gejk890dxha87.why: They said, we stayed a day or part of a day: the youths of the cave after three centuries, and the deniers on the Day about their life on earth. A memorizer pair with a strong lesson.
cmp:1gejk890dxha87.relation: Similarity: long time felt as a day, in the cave and in the grave.

cmp:0chmn6w1tky166.why: Recite what is revealed to you of the Book: then none can change His words, or establish prayer. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:0chmn6w1tky166.relation: Same command: recite the revelation, joined to its steadfastness and to prayer.

cmp:0101h9a0txw70i.why: Adorned there with bracelets of gold: then green garments of silk, or pearls and silk clothing (22:23 and 35:33 alike). A memorizer set.
cmp:0101h9a0txw70i.relation: Same description of the dwellers of the Garden.

cmp:0u77teq0oir2ss.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the bracelets of gold (with 35:33).

cmp:093umjf1iry37h.why: Set forth for them a parable: the two men with gardens, and the people of the town to whom the messengers came. Two parables with the same opening.
cmp:093umjf1iry37h.relation: Same command: parables for the deniers, of pride in wealth and rejection of messengers.

cmp:1tjsw8n1mb0rqn.why: From dust, then from a sperm-drop, then...: four places, each continuing differently (He shaped you a man, a clot, made you pairs, brings you out as a child). A memorizer set.
cmp:1tjsw8n1mb0rqn.relation: Same theme: the stages of man's creation as proof of resurrection.

cmp:11yq82d0rva7b7.why: He had no party to help him besides God, nor could he help himself: the owner of the two gardens and Qarun. Two rich men undone in the same words.
cmp:11yq82d0rva7b7.relation: Similarity: wealth proud of itself, left with no helper.

cmp:1plvixu0lqeafe.why: So they set out until, when...: they boarded the ship, met a boy, came to a town. The three journeys of Moses with al-Khidr. A memorizer set.
cmp:1plvixu0lqeafe.relation: Same story: the three trials of Moses' patience.

cmp:1y8t94h1n8wts7.why: Until, when he reached: the setting of the sun, its rising, between the two barriers. The three stages of Dhul-Qarnayn. A memorizer set.

cmp:0oqv9ef0zt1idh.why: Then he followed a way: the same short ayah twice, each followed by a different destination. A memorizer pair in one story.
cmp:0oqv9ef0zt1idh.relation: Same story: the transitions in Dhul-Qarnayn's journeys.

cmp:1dfa62d094a46d.why: Say, I am only a man like you, revealed to me that your god is one God: then whoever hopes to meet his Lord, or go straight to Him. A long identical run with different tails.
cmp:1dfa62d094a46d.relation: Same declaration of the Prophet's humanity and of oneness.

cmp:0xz1s0r02yxseh.why: It is revealed to me that your god is one God: twice after I am only a man like you, once in a shorter form (21:108) with the question will you submit. A memorizer set.
cmp:0xz1s0r02yxseh.relation: Same message: the core of revelation is oneness.

cmp:12ovri40nm4ojk.why: Say, I am only...: a man like you (twice), or a warner (38:65); each then declares one God. A memorizer set on how the Prophet describes himself.
cmp:12ovri40nm4ojk.relation: Same theme: the Prophet is human and a warner, and God is one.

cmp:1htvttu0tnqnv8.why: He said, so it will be, your Lord says it is easy for Me: to Zakariya about John and to Mary about Jesus, in one surah, with different tails. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1htvttu0tnqnv8.relation: Same answer to two wondrous births.

cmp:1v642wj1n9rvcx.why: He came out to his people: Zakariya from the prayer niche, signing to them to glorify God, and Qarun in his finery, making people envy him. Same words, opposite figures.
cmp:1v642wj1n9rvcx.relation: Contrast: the prophet who comes out with worship and the rich man who comes out with display.

cmp:14ly49n1nt9s4v.why: Mention in the Book: Mary, Abraham, Moses, Ishmael, Idris, each with his quality (truthful prophet, sincere, true to his promise). The structure of Maryam; a memorizer set.
cmp:14ly49n1nt9s4v.relation: Same theme: the gallery of the prophets in surah Maryam.

cmp:0vvq56r0ttq2fd.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the five-row card of mention in the Book, which shows that Abraham and Idris share the same description.

cmp:12adi3l1kym77v.why: When he said to his father (and his people): four tellings of Abraham's question about what they worship. A memorizer set.
cmp:12adi3l1kym77v.relation: Same story: Abraham challenges his father's and people's idols.

cmp:1rc5qxs0sxs1r6.why: They will hear there no idle talk: but peace, nor sin, nor lying. Three tails, a memorizer set on the Garden.
cmp:1rc5qxs0sxs1r6.relation: Same description of the Garden's speech.

cmp:0b0wzpc1uz510u.why: That is the Garden which...: We give as inheritance to the God-fearing, or you have been given as inheritance for what you did. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:0b0wzpc1uz510u.relation: Same theme: the Garden inherited by piety and deeds.

cmp:043mll80e8vwok.why: Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them: five places that open alike and continue differently (so worship Him, Lord of the easts, the Mighty the Forgiving, if you are certain, the Merciful). A memorizer set.
cmp:043mll80e8vwok.relation: Same title of God, joined each time to another truth.

cmp:05bcdh00lnagie.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the six-row card of when Our clear signs are recited to them.

cmp:1lo62t51btopy1.why: How many generations We destroyed before them: better in goods, of whom you hear not a whisper, mightier in power. Three tails, a memorizer set.
cmp:1lo62t51btopy1.relation: Same warning: wealth and strength did not save earlier generations.

cmp:12ws04k0yy7sxw.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same phrase (with 19:98).

cmp:01iy6od164yc5j.why: They took gods besides God: to be a source of strength for them, or hoping to be helped. A memorizer pair.
cmp:01iy6od164yc5j.relation: Same theme: false gods taken for power and help, which fail.

cmp:0qrtmo0183j37w.why: They say the Merciful has taken a son: then you have brought a monstrous thing, or glory be to Him, they are honoured servants. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0qrtmo0183j37w.relation: Same claim, answered with horror and with correction.

cmp:0euw8xy15nwq5o.why: The heavens almost break apart: from this claim of a son, or from above them while the angels glorify. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0euw8xy15nwq5o.relation: Same image of the heavens nearly splitting, at blasphemy and at God's majesty.

cmp:11kd7dk1hjuer4.why: We have made it easy in your tongue: to give good news and warn, or so they may remember. Closing Maryam and ad-Dukhan, a memorizer pair.
cmp:11kd7dk1hjuer4.relation: Same theme: the Quran made easy for its purpose.

cmp:0m37zmw0f1fjaw.why: God, there is no god but He, His are...: the most beautiful names, or the praise in the first and the last. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0m37zmw0f1fjaw.relation: Same declaration of oneness with God's names and praise.

cmp:1mq378212ltnto.why: Has the story of ... reached you: Moses (twice), Abraham's guests, the armies, the Overwhelming. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer set.
cmp:1mq378212ltnto.relation: Same opening that draws attention to a story or warning.

cmp:13gvdop1f8pu7v.why: Moses sees a fire and tells his family to stay, I have perceived a fire, perhaps I will bring you...: in three tellings (20:10, 27:7, 28:29), now spread over two pairs. One card shows the three.
cmp:13gvdop1f8pu7v.changes: Added 27:7, the third telling of the same scene, now in a separate pair with 20:10.
cmp:13gvdop1f8pu7v.relation: Same scene: Moses and the fire, told three ways.

cmp:0e5gx3d0487w2h.why: A partial card of Moses seeing the fire; both ayat belong in the three-row card proposed under the 20:10 and 28:29 pair.

cmp:0xp3k7a06f5li0.why: When he came to it he was called: O Moses, briefly, or from the side of the valley in the blessed spot. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0xp3k7a06f5li0.relation: Same scene: the call to Moses at the fire.

cmp:0fg38pz057fw9v.why: Go to Pharaoh, he has transgressed: the same short ayah in two surahs, then Moses asks for an open breast, or the message to Pharaoh follows. A memorizer pair.

cmp:1ss9kp913aw7ix.why: Surely in that are signs for people of intellect: twice in Ta-Ha, after pastures and after the ruins of destroyed peoples. A rare closing in one surah.
cmp:1ss9kp913aw7ix.relation: Similarity: nature and history both read as signs by people of sense.

cmp:0k6y4v00irao2i.why: Moses said to them: woe to you, do not invent a lie against God; or throw what you will throw. Two words of Moses to the sorcerers, in two tellings.
cmp:0k6y4v00irao2i.relation: Same story: Moses' warning and challenge to the sorcerers.

cmp:179w2rn01qmzm1.why: You believed in him before I gave you leave, he is your chief who taught you magic: Pharaoh's threat in two tellings, with different details of the punishment. A strong memorizer pair.
cmp:179w2rn01qmzm1.relation: Same story: Pharaoh's threat to the believing sorcerers.

cmp:154pflk1ksee0e.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the large gardens card, which shows the gardens of Eden branch.

cmp:16m5cjm14v4nbi.why: We revealed to Moses: travel by night with My servants, then strike a dry path in the sea, or you will be pursued. A memorizer pair.
cmp:16m5cjm14v4nbi.relation: Same story: the exodus by night.

cmp:193xz4p10j2zcr.why: God, there is no god but He: then He encompasses all things in knowledge, the Knower of the unseen and the seen, the King, the Holy. Three places with lists of names.
cmp:193xz4p10j2zcr.relation: Same declaration of oneness, each with other names of God.

cmp:0a4kjk204f7xbc.why: Exalted is God, the King, the Truth: then do not hasten with the Quran, or there is no god but He, Lord of the noble Throne. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0a4kjk204f7xbc.relation: Same praise of God, the true King.

cmp:0z8d8ly0d6kjwu.why: Be patient over what they say: then glorify your Lord before sunrise and sunset (twice), remember Our servant David, leave them gracefully. Different conjunctions, a memorizer set.
cmp:0z8d8ly0d6kjwu.relation: Same command: patience with the deniers' words, with worship as its support.

cmp:1epdehx191o101.why: Our Lord, why did You not send us a messenger so that we would follow Your signs: the excuse the deniers would have given, in two surahs with different tails.
cmp:1epdehx191o101.relation: Same theme: messengers sent to cut off every excuse.

cmp:1wtfbyh1e4dx7d.why: We sent before you, without the preposition before before you: only in 21:7 and 25:20, men who were revealed to, and messengers who ate food and walked in markets. A known memorizer pair.
cmp:1wtfbyh1e4dx7d.relation: Same theme: the messengers were ordinary humans.

cmp:0xueft21ovkw1i.why: We have sent down to you: a Book in which is your mention, or clear signs and examples. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:0xueft21ovkw1i.relation: Same theme: what the Quran brings to its hearers.

cmp:11ekfi704mmrid.why: They said, woe to us, we were: wrongdoers, transgressors. Two short ayat that differ in one word, the destroyed town and the owners of the garden.
cmp:11ekfi704mmrid.relation: Same late confession of those struck by punishment.

cmp:19ebeij1v280fp.why: We did not create the heaven and the earth and what is between them: in play, or in vain. A memorizer pair whose last word differs.

cmp:0zmha1w0m88sn4.why: We did not create ... in play: heaven singular in 21:16 and heavens plural in 44:38, each followed by a different ayah. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0zmha1w0m88sn4.relation: Same theme: creation is not a game.

cmp:1xnyxww1azn9hy.why: Or have they taken besides Him...: gods, intercessors, protectors. Three challenges with different answers.
cmp:1xnyxww1azn9hy.relation: Same argument against taking any helper besides God.

cmp:1n27els0xnqqj0.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the six-row card of We sent no messenger before you except.

cmp:01dog2102ti1lx.why: Job when he called his Lord, harm has touched me: or Satan has touched me with weariness. Two tellings, a memorizer pair.
cmp:01dog2102ti1lx.relation: Same story: Job's prayer in affliction.

cmp:1xl8y5i0a3vngu.why: They split their affair among themselves: then all will return to Us, or into sects, each rejoicing in what it has. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1xl8y5i0a3vngu.relation: Same theme: the breaking of one community into sects.

cmp:18xpb3y1pghn58.why: You and what you worship: fuel of Hell, or cannot tempt anyone away from God. With and without the conjunction, two addresses to the idolaters.
cmp:18xpb3y1pghn58.relation: Same address to idolaters and their idols.

cmp:0fpb0481dskyd8.why: We have sent you only as: a mercy to the worlds, a bearer of good news and a warner, to all people. Three statements of the Prophet's mission.
cmp:0fpb0481dskyd8.relation: Same theme: the scope and purpose of the Prophet's mission.

cmp:1ytf1kl08ssteh.why: Among people is he who disputes about God without knowledge: then follows every devil, or without guidance or an enlightening Book (twice). A memorizer set.
cmp:1ytf1kl08ssteh.relation: Same type: arguing about God without knowledge.

cmp:03nui350zy26tj.why: When We send down water on it, it stirs and swells: then grows every lovely kind, or He who revived it will revive the dead. A memorizer pair.
cmp:03nui350zy26tj.relation: Same sign: the reviving earth as proof of resurrection.

cmp:0gq1xbd1iauyur.why: That is because God is the Truth: then He gives life to the dead, or what they call on besides Him is falsehood (twice, with and without a pronoun). A memorizer set.
cmp:0gq1xbd1iauyur.relation: Same theme: God is the Truth and idols are falsehood.

cmp:0y1hl5o0451cqs.why: He gives life to the dead and He is able over all things: once with that and once with He, after God is the Truth and after God is the Protector. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0y1hl5o0451cqs.relation: Same theme: the giver of life is the only real protector.

cmp:1hhduzv0rqqni9.why: A repeat: these three ayat are in the four-row card of God admits those who believe into gardens (with 14:23).

cmp:1b3ve4w0benx96.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the bracelets of gold (with 18:31).

cmp:0nyesx81bo8h5u.why: Only the common gardens phrase is shared, already shown in the gardens cards. The pair adds no new branch.

cmp:03bbakn0ta933f.why: Only the common phrase about those who believe and do good is shared, already shown in the gardens cards. The pair adds no new branch.

cmp:0g60td91j4ojlv.why: To mention God's name over the livestock He provided them: in the rites of pilgrimage and in the rite given to every nation. A memorizer pair in one passage.
cmp:0g60td91j4ojlv.relation: Same theme: sacrifice as remembrance of God, common to all nations.

cmp:035002m0dwc0he.why: That, and whoever honours...: the sacred things of God, it is better for him; the symbols of God, it is from the piety of hearts. Two ayat of one passage, a memorizer pair.
cmp:035002m0dwc0he.relation: Same theme: reverence for what God made sacred.

cmp:0x8k0zj0re29u5.why: For every nation We appointed a rite: to mention God's name over livestock, or which they perform, so let them not dispute with you. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp:0x8k0zj0re29u5.relation: Same theme: rites differ, the One worshipped does not.

cmp:09fmkwr1ay3wi5.why: If they deny you, those before them also denied: the people of Noah, Ad and Thamud; messengers before you; those before them with clear proofs. A memorizer set with one consolation.
cmp:09fmkwr1ay3wi5.relation: Same consolation: the Prophet is not the first to be denied.

cmp:1c9t4fp0halfdp.why: How many a town: We destroyed while it did wrong, I gave respite then seized, stronger than your town, rebelled against its Lord. Different conjunctions and tails, a memorizer set.
cmp:1c9t4fp0halfdp.relation: Same theme: the end of wrongdoing towns.

cmp:0xuiz7z1n2069h.why: He merges night into day and day into night: four places with different lead-ins and tails (hearing and seeing, subjected sun and moon twice, knowing what is in the breasts). A memorizer set.
cmp:0xuiz7z1n2069h.relation: Same sign: the alternation of night and day.

cmp:14rwzi91w6hhvn.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the four-row card of the merging of night and day.

cmp:13gzllc1dkz0ru.why: Have you not seen that God sent down water from the sky: then the earth becomes green, We brought out fruits of varied colours, He made it springs then crops. A memorizer set.
cmp:13gzllc1dkz0ru.relation: Same sign: rain and the variety it brings, a reminder for people of understanding.

cmp:0iuf0b90ux0jxd.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same question (with 35:27).

cmp:1l86c170i0cl4f.why: That God has subjected to you what is: on the earth, or in the heavens and on the earth. Have you not seen, singular and plural. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1l86c170i0cl4f.relation: Same theme: all creation put at mankind's service.

cmp:08ndupr15v4upx.why: In a Book; that is easy for God: after God's knowledge of heaven and earth, and after the term of every life. A memorizer pair.
cmp:08ndupr15v4upx.relation: Same theme: everything recorded, and its recording easy for God.

cmp:0eqddql05sg7t7.why: Both ayat already stand in fuller cards of God knowing what is in the heavens and the earth (22:70 with 5:97, 58:7 with 3:29 and others). The pair adds only the difference between have you not known and have you not seen.

cmp:1yaj5c91q7825h.why: Those who are in...: their prayer, humble; heedlessness, unaware; idle talk, playing. Short ayat that open alike and describe opposite people.
cmp:1yaj5c91q7825h.relation: Contrast: the believers absorbed in prayer and the deniers absorbed in heedlessness and play.

cmp:0fcu4nw0j06an2.why: Those who, from...: idle talk turn away, or their prayer are heedless. Two short ayat with one word different in structure and opposite meaning.
cmp:0fcu4nw0j06an2.relation: Contrast: the believers turn from idle talk, the hypocrites are heedless of prayer.

cmp:13h515v18nyklz.why: The same run of ayat in al-Muminun and al-Maarij (guarding chastity, except spouses, beyond that is transgression, keeping trusts), then the last one differs: guarding prayers, or standing by their testimony. A key memorizer pair.
cmp:13h515v18nyklz.relation: Same description of the believers in two surahs.

cmp:0dmrrue1ljjtr0.why: A repeat: these ayat are already inside the rows of the 23:5 and 70:29 pair, which shows the whole run.

cmp:19kwpfm096gyvw.why: A repeat: these ayat are already inside the rows of the 23:5 and 70:29 pair, which shows the whole run.

cmp:1nlisew0vcm3u8.why: A repeat: these ayat are already inside the rows of the 23:5 and 70:29 pair, which shows the whole run.

cmp:0kgk9ba1l0j06g.why: Those who are over their prayer: guarding it (twice, plural and singular), or constant in it. A memorizer set.

cmp:0djlyhr1dxm92b.why: Then on the Day of Resurrection you will: be raised, or dispute before your Lord. Two short ayat that open alike.
cmp:0djlyhr1dxm92b.relation: Same Day: resurrection and the settling of disputes.

cmp:1b5ehg31gqdopz.why: We never heard of this among our forefathers: said by Noah's people and by Pharaoh's people. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1b5ehg31gqdopz.relation: Same excuse: rejecting the truth because it is new.

cmp:00gtefh0r5avoh.why: A repeat: the two identical ayat are in the three-row card of my Lord, help me (with 29:30).

cmp:01qnn1t0mocfjn.why: My Lord, help me: because they denied me (Noah and the next messenger, word for word), or against the corrupting people (Lot). A memorizer set.
cmp:01qnn1t0mocfjn.relation: Same prayer of prophets rejected by their peoples.

cmp:1waqcz50qk75xn.why: Then We produced after them another generation, or other generations: singular and plural in one surah. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1waqcz50qk75xn.relation: Same theme: generations succeed one another.

cmp:1cb67rf0tm5jjj.why: There is only our worldly life, we die and we live: then we will not be raised, or nothing destroys us but time. A memorizer pair.
cmp:1cb67rf0tm5jjj.relation: Same creed of the deniers of resurrection.

cmp:0gd2fhz0hywp77.why: He gave you hearing, sight and hearts; little do you give thanks: three places, two followed by the same ayah about being spread on earth and gathered. A memorizer set.
cmp:0gd2fhz0hywp77.relation: Same theme: the senses as gifts met with little gratitude.

cmp:1q4poos15fe1e0.why: A repeat: these ayat are already inside the rows of the card of hearing, sight and hearts, which shows them after the ayah before.

cmp:17f9mu70m1yhl5.why: When we have died and become dust and bones, will we be raised, or be judged: four places, with and without they said, and with or without our forefathers after. A classic memorizer set.
cmp:17f9mu70m1yhl5.relation: Same denial of resurrection, in this world and recalled in the next.

cmp:180kmbj1t4ysfl.why: A repeat: these three ayat are in the four-row card of the same question (with 56:47).

cmp:0mj3ksj0kq5x6l.why: A repeat: these three ayat are in the four-row card of the same question (with 37:53).

cmp:0n2m7860lanpgk.why: When the trumpet is blown: then no ties of kinship, or with a single blast. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0n2m7860lanpgk.relation: Same event: the blowing of the trumpet.

cmp:03g03gg0w8rckq.why: There is no god but He, Lord of the Throne: noble, or great. A one-word memorizer difference.
cmp:03g03gg0w8rckq.relation: Same declaration of oneness with the Throne.

cmp:0olnw2n0u5iwjl.why: And the fifth, that God's curse be on him if he is of the liars; that God's wrath be on her if he is of the truthful: the oaths of mutual cursing. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0olnw2n0u5iwjl.relation: Same ruling: the oaths of husband and wife, mirror images.

cmp:1e9p8d70ctmf2l.why: Why, when you heard it, did you not...: think well of each other, say we may not speak of this. With and without the conjunction, in the slander passage.
cmp:1e9p8d70ctmf2l.relation: Same rebuke: how believers should have met the slander.

cmp:0mqxq7l0rg7ikn.why: God makes clear to you the signs, and God is Knowing, Wise: with and, and with thus. Two places in an-Nur. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0mqxq7l0rg7ikn.relation: Same closing of rulings on slander and on asking permission.

cmp:137j6ds12vv2do.why: O you who believe, do not enter: houses other than yours until you seek leave, the Prophet's houses unless invited. A memorizer pair.
cmp:137j6ds12vv2do.relation: Same theme: the etiquette of entering homes.

cmp:0ype52b0cwo5rx.why: He creates, or adds to creation, what He wills; God is able over all things: after creatures walking on two or four legs, and after angels with two, three or four wings.
cmp:0ype52b0cwo5rx.relation: Similarity: the variety of creatures on earth and of angels, both by God's will.

cmp:05i87481qej8qc.why: When they are called to God and His Messenger to judge between them: a party turns away, or the believers say we hear and obey. Three ayat apart.
cmp:05i87481qej8qc.relation: Contrast: the hypocrites and the believers answer the same call.

cmp:0zx4ube0a9r7mg.why: The Messenger's duty is only clear delivery: after obey God and the Messenger, and after the warning that earlier nations denied. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0zx4ube0a9r7mg.relation: Same theme: the Messenger delivers; the response is on the hearers.

cmp:0trfq7a1duhuhs.why: No blame on the blind, the lame, or the sick: then eating in relatives' houses, or the exemption from fighting. A long shared opening with different rulings.
cmp:0trfq7a1duhuhs.relation: Same principle: the excused are not blamed.

cmp:09fo5hg1k9rohw.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the believers are only those who (with 8:2).

cmp:0tpeiev1k854mf.why: Only the phrase whose is the dominion of the heavens and the earth is shared. One is about having no son or partner, the other about God witnessing the persecutors; the pair adds little.

cmp:12n4kaj17v6ggn.why: Do not obey the deniers: and strive against them with it, or and the hypocrites, ignore their harm. Different conjunctions, a memorizer pair.
cmp:12n4kaj17v6ggn.relation: Same command: firmness against the deniers, by the Quran and by trust in God.

cmp:0lt8o55005abbf.why: Say, I ask you no reward for it: except whoever wills to take a way to his Lord, or I am not of the pretenders. A memorizer pair.
cmp:0lt8o55005abbf.relation: Same stance: the Prophet asks nothing.

cmp:0eksp3x137b0ep.why: The heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days: then He rose over the Throne (twice), or no weariness touched Us (50:38). A memorizer set with the and what is between them form.
cmp:0eksp3x137b0ep.relation: Same theme: creation in six days without weariness.

cmp:1nn08j91a4z0q1.why: Three surah openings that differ only in the last word (the clear Book in 26:2 and 28:2, the wise Book in 31:2). A classic mix-up for memorizers, and the next ayah tells each surah apart.

cmp:0mnccyi12s8pf0.why: Same clause about every noble kind of plant made to grow, with a different lead-in in each surah (a question in 26:7, a list of creation in 31:10). Useful for memorizers, and both use plants as a sign of the Creator.
cmp:0mnccyi12s8pf0.relation: Both point to plant life as proof of God's creating power against those who deny or associate partners.

cmp:0dag8uy1yp2loe.why: The refrain of ash-Shuara that closes each prophet's story. Seeing all eight places with the ayah that follows shows the order of the stories, which is exactly what a memorizer needs.
cmp:0dag8uy1yp2loe.relation: The same verdict on God's might and mercy seals every story of a people who denied their messenger.

cmp:05v9gvt1bh6oe3.why: Same full description of the Lord of the heavens and the earth with the challenge about certainty: Moses to Pharaoh in 26:24, a direct statement in 44:7. Easy to confuse, and the run-on shows how each continues.

cmp:0rfsb3j0359ntr.why: Two descriptions of the Day when nothing helps: wealth and sons in 26:88, excuses of the wrongdoers in 40:52. Same opening, different thing that fails to help, worth pondering together.
cmp:0rfsb3j0359ntr.relation: On that Day neither what one owned nor what one says will benefit.

cmp:14iqucp00fjbgj.why: Same scene of Paradise brought near to the righteous, ending differently (Hell shown to the strayers in 26:91, not far in 50:31). A real mix-up point for memorizers.

cmp:0v451wv163bd8p.why: The three rows only open with the common phrase "besides God" continued from the previous ayah. The scenes are related (idols failing their worshippers on the Day), but the shared words are a stock phrase that sits mid-sentence, so the card teaches little.

cmp:17f2ham17q18i6.why: A repeat: these four rows are all inside cmp:0f19loh0izbna9, which also has Shuayb (26:177) and shows the one difference (no word for brother there).

cmp:0f19loh0izbna9.why: The five prophets of ash-Shuara call their people in the same words. Shuayb in 26:177 alone lacks the word for brother, since he was not of the people of the Wood. A key mix-up point and a pondering point.
cmp:0f19loh0izbna9.relation: Each messenger opens with the same call to fear God; the one difference reflects Shuayb's relation to his audience.

cmp:0q4drvd0m77ck1.why: The same disclaimer of payment by five prophets. The run-on shows what each says next, which is the real memorization difficulty in ash-Shuara.
cmp:0q4drvd0m77ck1.relation: Every messenger asks no wage; the message is the same whatever the people's sin.

cmp:0avs5mh1nuwecp.why: Same threat from two peoples, differing in the prophet named and the punishment (stoning for Noah, expulsion for Lot). A precise mix-up for memorizers.
cmp:0avs5mh1nuwecp.relation: Different peoples answer their prophets with the same threat.

cmp:17y3teq0bh0604.why: Thamud and the people of the Wood answer in identical words; the next ayah differs (a demand for a sign versus calling him a liar). A clear trap for memorizers.
cmp:17y3teq0bh0604.relation: Two peoples dismiss their prophets in the same words.

cmp:17v5h2109p2jh9.why: Two short story openings about Lot's people that differ in the last word (the messengers in 26:160, the warnings in 54:33). A frequent confusion between the two refrain-surahs.

cmp:07eknys108khsm.why: The punishment of Lot's people in identical words in two surahs, followed by different ayat. A memorizer must know which continuation belongs where.

cmp:1hyrihe192fa5c.why: The same prohibition of calling another god beside God, with a different connective and a different ending (being among the punished, or there is no god but He). Good for memorizers and for pondering tawhid.
cmp:1hyrihe192fa5c.relation: The command to worship God alone, once with a warning, once with the reason: all perishes but His face.

cmp:1vpbvhz0sy89q5.why: The exception of the believers who do good deeds closing four surahs, each with a different addition (remembering God and defending themselves, a reward unending with or without a connective, counseling truth and patience). Useful for memorizers and for pondering what the exception requires.
cmp:1vpbvhz0sy89q5.relation: Who is excepted from loss, and what each surah adds to the description.

cmp:1o7i7071i4huy7.why: A repeat: both ayat sit inside cmp:01im3jr0g3y2ab, which already shows this description of the believers in full.

cmp:0l8a71b14gck8f.why: Two gifts given to David with the same opening: knowledge with Solomon in 27:15, favor with the mountains and birds and iron in 34:10. Good for memorizers and for pondering the gifts.
cmp:0l8a71b14gck8f.relation: What God gave David: knowledge shared with his son, and power over nature.

cmp:1rwkpcz0jaapo9.why: The same prayer to be grateful for blessings on oneself and one's parents, said by Solomon in 27:19 and by the mature man of forty in 46:15, with different endings. A strong mix-up point and a beautiful link.
cmp:1rwkpcz0jaapo9.relation: A prophet-king and an ordinary believer pray the same prayer of gratitude.

cmp:0ddcncb00kiwel.why: Same clause about Satan beautifying deeds and turning people from the path, said of Sheba and of Aad and Thamud, with opposite endings (they are not guided, though they had insight).
cmp:0ddcncb00kiwel.relation: Satan's work on different peoples; even those who could see were led astray.

cmp:1lezz520ukwnpa.why: The Queen of Sheba addresses her council twice in the same words, three ayat apart, first to report the letter and then to ask their advice. Worth knowing which comes first.
cmp:1lezz520ukwnpa.relation: The queen's careful consultation before deciding.

cmp:0qzmbdn1qf5ycf.why: Same rule that whoever is grateful is grateful for his own good, said by Solomon and in the wisdom given to Luqman, each closing with a different pair of names of God.
cmp:0qzmbdn1qf5ycf.relation: Gratitude benefits only the grateful; God is free of need either way.

cmp:059y9z208ir5vm.why: Only the stock phrase "see how was the end of" is shared; one is about Thamud's plot, the other about those who were warned in general. The fuller cards on this phrase serve better.

cmp:0y3o0cp033vmyz.why: Lot rebukes his people in the same opening words in two surahs, continued differently. A clear mix-up for memorizers and the same story.
cmp:0y3o0cp033vmyz.relation: Two tellings of Lot's rebuke, each naming different sins.

cmp:11c7e6p0wjoto3.why: The same command to travel in the land and see, followed by three different things to see: the end of the criminals, how creation began, the end of those before. Useful for memorizers and for pondering what travel should teach.
cmp:11c7e6p0wjoto3.relation: Travel as a lesson both in God's punishment and in His creating power.

cmp:1fr7x5q0ty96e8.why: A repeat: both ayat are inside cmp:11c7e6p0wjoto3, which also shows 29:20.

cmp-card:1:6|4:68.why: The prayer for the straight path, and the promise that those who obey would be guided to it: the request and its answer.
cmp-card:1:6|4:68.relation: Request and answer: the worshipper asks for the straight path, and 4:68 says obedience is how it is given.

cmp-card:1:2|6:45.why: Only the praise formula is shared; one is the opening praise, the other closes the account of the wrongdoers being cut off. Different subjects, and the phrase is too common to teach a memorizer anything.

cmp-card:1:6|6:87.why: The prayer for the straight path beside the prophets and their families whom Allah chose and guided to it: the reader asks for the path the prophets walked.
cmp-card:1:6|6:87.relation: The worshipper asks for the path; 6:87 shows who was already guided to it.

cmp-card:1:2|10:10.why: The phrase that opens the Quran is the last call of the people of Paradise. A known point for pondering: praise is the first and the last word.
cmp-card:1:2|10:10.relation: The opening praise of the Book is also the final call of the dwellers of Paradise.

cmp-card:1:6|10:25.why: Only the stock phrase about guiding whom He wills to a straight path; a personal prayer against a general statement about the call to the abode of peace. Too common to add anything.

cmp-card:1:2|14:39.why: Only the opening words of praise are shared; 14:39 is Ibrahim thanking Allah for his sons in old age. Different subjects, nothing to learn from the pairing.

cmp-card:1:6|16:121.why: The prayer for the straight path beside Ibrahim, who was chosen and guided to it because he was grateful: a model of the answered prayer.
cmp-card:1:6|16:121.relation: The path asked for in 1:6 is the path Ibrahim was guided to, and gratitude is named as the way.

cmp-card:1:6|24:46.why: Only the stock phrase about guiding whom He wills to a straight path; 24:46 is about the clear signs sent down. Different subjects.

cmp-card:1:2|35:34.why: Only the opening words of praise; 35:34 is the people of Paradise thanking Allah for removing grief. The shared words are too common to make a card.

cmp-card:1:2|37:182.why: Only the praise formula, here as the closing line of a surah. A memorizer will not confuse the opening of the Fatiha with this, and the subjects differ.

cmp-card:1:2|40:65.why: Only the praise formula closing a call to sincere worship. Stock phrase, different subjects.

cmp-card:1:6|67:22.why: Only the words straight path; 67:22 is a parable comparing the one walking prone with the one walking upright. The link to the prayer is thin.

cmp-card:2:23|2:94.why: Only the challenge formula is shared; one challenges the doubters to bring a surah, the other challenges the claim to the hereafter by wishing for death. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:37|2:160.why: Adam's repentance accepted and the promise to accept those who hid the truth then repented: both end with the same divine name of accepting repentance.
cmp-card:2:37|2:160.relation: The first repentance in human history and the door left open for later sinners, closed with the same name.

cmp-card:2:39|2:81.why: Two descriptions of the people of the Fire, one by disbelief and denial, one by sin that surrounds a person, ending in the same verdict. Useful for memorizers and for pondering who earns it.
cmp-card:2:39|2:81.relation: Two routes, disbelief and being engulfed by one's sins, end in the same eternal Fire.

cmp-card:2:40|2:47.why: The same call to the Children of Israel to remember the favour, continuing two ways. A classic place for a memorizer to slip.

cmp-card:2:40|2:122.why: 2:122 repeats 2:47 word for word, and 2:40 with 2:47 is already a card. This pairing adds nothing that card does not show.

cmp-card:2:62|2:112,2:62|2:262,2:62|2:27.why: Four groups in one surah promised the same reward and freedom from fear and grief: the believers of all communities, the one who submits, the one who spends without reproach, the one who prays and gives zakat. Strong for memorizers and for pondering who earns it.
cmp-card:2:62|2:112,2:62|2:262,2:62|2:27.relation: Different deeds, one promised reward: no fear and no grief.

cmp-card:2:68|2:69.why: Consecutive questions about the cow, each asking again for a detail: same opening, different question. The story shows the people making it harder for themselves.
cmp-card:2:68|2:69.relation: Same story: repeated questions that only add restrictions.

cmp-card:2:94|2:111.why: Two claims of the People of the Book to own the hereafter or Paradise, each met with a challenge to prove it if they are truthful.
cmp-card:2:94|2:111.relation: Same theme: the claim to exclusive Paradise, answered by a demand for proof.

cmp-card:2:97|2:170.why: Only scattered common words; Jibril bringing the revelation versus following the fathers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:103|2:239.why: Only common words like believing and knowing; a reward the Jews missed versus prayer in fear. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:103|2:278.why: Only the common words believe and fear Allah; different subjects (the reward missed by the sorcerers' followers, and leaving usury).

cmp-card:2:103|2:280.why: Only the ending about what is better if you knew; different subjects (the missed reward, and giving debtors time).

cmp-card:2:106|2:148.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power over all things; abrogation versus each having a direction. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:110|2:277,2:112|2:277.why: Prayer and zakat with the promise that good is found with Allah, then the same promise phrased as reward with their Lord and no fear or grief. Shows how one surah repeats the same reward for the same deeds.
cmp-card:2:110|2:277,2:112|2:277.relation: The deeds of 2:110 and the reward of 2:112 meet in 2:277.

cmp-card:2:111|2:135.why: Two claims of the Jews and Christians in the same passage, each opened with the same words and each answered by the Prophet: one asks for their proof, the other points to the way of Ibrahim.
cmp-card:2:111|2:135.relation: Same theme: exclusive claims to salvation and guidance, answered two ways.

cmp-card:2:112|2:262,2:112|2:274.why: Submitting to Allah and spending in His way, by day and night, earn the same reward with the same closing words. Good for a memorizer to see where each ending sits.
cmp-card:2:112|2:262,2:112|2:274.relation: Different deeds, one reward: no fear and no grief.

cmp-card:2:129|2:151.why: Ibrahim's prayer for a messenger and its fulfilment, in nearly the same words; in the answer, purification comes before teaching. A well-known point for pondering and a place memorizers mix up.
cmp-card:2:129|2:151.relation: Prayer and answer: Ibrahim asked for a messenger, and 2:151 says he was sent.

cmp-card:2:144|2:149,2:144|2:150.why: The command to face the Sacred Mosque repeated three times with different continuations. A classic spot for memorizers.
cmp-card:2:144|2:149,2:144|2:150.relation: Same command, repeated for emphasis with a new reason each time.

cmp-card:2:154|2:190.why: Only the phrase in the way of Allah is shared; the martyrs being alive versus the command to fight without transgressing. The phrase is stock.

cmp-card:2:154|2:244.why: Only the phrase in the way of Allah is shared; the martyrs being alive versus the command to fight. The phrase is stock.

cmp-card:2:168|2:208.why: The same warning not to follow Satan's footsteps, said first to all people about food and then to the believers about entering Islam fully. Same ending, different openings: useful for memorizers.
cmp-card:2:168|2:208.relation: Satan's steps are a danger in what we eat and in how fully we submit.

cmp-card:2:190|2:195,2:190|2:244.why: Fight in the way of Allah but do not transgress, for He does not love transgressors; spend in His way and do good, for He loves those who do good. A clear contrast, plus the repeated command to fight.
cmp-card:2:190|2:195,2:190|2:244.relation: Contrast in one passage: what Allah does not love and what He loves.

cmp-card:2:262|2:274.why: Two descriptions of those who spend, one by the absence of reproach, one by spending day and night, secretly and openly, with the same reward. Memorizers need to know which wording goes where.
cmp-card:2:262|2:274.relation: Two qualities of spending, one promised reward.

cmp-card:2:262|2:277,2:274|2:277.why: The spenders and the believers who pray and give zakat share the same reward line. Useful for memorizers and for seeing that spending stands beside prayer.
cmp-card:2:262|2:277,2:274|2:277.relation: Different deeds, one reward: no fear and no grief.

cmp-card:2:51|23:41.why: Only the word wrongdoers is shared; the calf worship versus the blast that destroyed a people. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:53|23:49.why: The same statement that Musa was given the Book so people would be guided; one adds the criterion and addresses the Israelites, the other speaks of them. A memorizer's trap.
cmp-card:2:53|23:49.relation: Same purpose of the Book given to Musa: guidance.

cmp-card:2:92|23:41.why: Only the word wrongdoers is shared; the calf worship versus the blast that destroyed a people. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:11|26:152.why: Corrupters in the land who do not set things right: the hypocrites claim they are reformers, and Salih's people are described as those who corrupt and do not reform.
cmp-card:2:11|26:152.relation: Corruption that calls itself reform, and the plain verdict on corrupters.

cmp-card:2:117|26:24.why: Only the words heavens and earth; creation by the word Be versus Musa answering Pharaoh about the Lord. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:204|35:5.why: Only the words the life of this world are shared; the man whose speech impresses versus the warning not to be deceived. The link is thin.

cmp-card:2:284|35:1.why: Only heavens and earth and the stock closing about Allah's power; reckoning of hidden thoughts versus the angels as messengers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:66|36:9.why: Only the words before and behind; a punishment made an example versus a barrier set before the deniers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:66|36:45.why: Only the words before and behind; a punishment made an example versus a call to fear what is ahead. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:77|36:76.why: The same statement that Allah knows what they hide and what they show, once as a rebuke to the Jews, once as comfort to the Prophet. Same words, two uses.
cmp-card:2:77|36:76.relation: Allah's knowledge of the hidden as a warning to some and a comfort to the Messenger.

cmp-card:2:131|36:58.why: Only the word Lord and a shared root; Ibrahim's submission versus the greeting of peace in Paradise. Different scenes.

cmp-card:2:154|37:36.why: Only the verb of saying; martyrs alive versus the idolaters calling the Prophet a mad poet. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:66|41:42.why: Only the words before and behind; a punishment made an example versus falsehood not reaching the Quran. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:82|41:8.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good, followed by different rewards. A stock phrase; nothing specific to ponder.

cmp-card:2:86|41:31.why: Only the pair this world and the Hereafter; those who sold the Hereafter versus the angels' promise to the steadfast. The shared wording is stock.

cmp-card:2:70|43:49.why: Two peoples ask Musa to call his Lord for them and promise they will then be guided: the Israelites about the cow, Pharaoh's people under punishment. Both are evasion dressed as a request.
cmp-card:2:70|43:49.relation: Same request to Musa from two peoples, with the same empty promise of being guided.

cmp-card:2:92|43:38.why: Only scattered words; the calf after Musa versus the regret of the one with an evil companion. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:117|43:9.why: Only the words heavens and earth; creation by command versus the idolaters admitting who created them. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:131|43:89.why: Only a shared root of peace and submission; Ibrahim's submission versus the Prophet told to turn away. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:97|46:30.why: The Quran described as confirming what came before it and guiding, once about Jibril bringing it, once by the jinn who heard it. A rare shared description.
cmp-card:2:97|46:30.relation: The revelation confirms earlier scripture and guides, said by Allah and repeated by the jinn.

cmp-card:2:98|46:6.why: Only the roots of enmity and disbelief; enmity to Allah's angels versus idols disowning their worshippers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:107|46:32.why: Only the common idea of no protector besides Allah, in a stock wording; the dominion of Allah versus the jinn warning those who ignore the caller. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:176|46:2.why: Only the Book sent down from Allah; disputes about the Book versus a surah opening formula. Too common.

cmp-card:2:209|46:2.why: Only the names Mighty and Wise, a stock pair. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:284|46:33.why: Only heavens and earth and the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:106|48:21.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power over all things; abrogation versus spoils not yet won. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:107|48:14.why: Only the dominion of the heavens and earth, a stock phrase; no protector versus forgiving whom He wills. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:117|48:7.why: Only the words heavens and earth; creation by command versus Allah's hosts. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:119|48:8.why: The Prophet's mission in the same words, a bringer of good news and a warner; 48:8 adds witness. A memorizer must know which version has what.

cmp-card:2:148|48:21.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power over all things; racing to good deeds versus spoils not yet won. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:209|48:7.why: Only the names Mighty and Wise, a stock closing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:209|48:19.why: Only the names Mighty and Wise, a stock closing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:284|48:14.why: The same declaration: to Allah belongs what is in the heavens and earth, He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. One closes on His power, the other on His forgiveness, which a memorizer must keep apart.
cmp-card:2:284|48:14.relation: Allah's ownership of all things grounds His right to forgive and to punish.

cmp-card:2:95|49:1.why: Only the words for what hands put forward and the name Knowing; the Jews not wishing for death versus manners before the Prophet. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:103|49:1.why: Only the common words believe and fear Allah. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:107|49:16.why: Only heavens and earth and a verb of knowing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:116|49:16.why: Only the stock phrase of what is in the heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:137|49:1.why: Only the names Hearing and Knowing, a stock closing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:160|49:10.why: Only the roots of setting right and mercy; repentance versus brotherhood among believers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:182|49:10.why: Both command making peace between people: between heirs after an unjust bequest, and between believers who fight. Same act of reconciliation, closed with mercy.
cmp-card:2:182|49:10.relation: Reconciling people is praised in family disputes and in disputes among believers.

cmp-card:2:192|49:5.why: Only the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:224|49:1.why: Only fearing Allah and the names Hearing and Knowing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:224|49:13.why: Only the root of fearing Allah and the name Knowing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:284|49:16.why: Only the stock phrase of what is in the heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:32|51:30.why: Angels speaking, both closing on the names Knowing and Wise, in reverse order. A clear memorizer point.
cmp-card:2:32|51:30.relation: The angels confess Allah's knowledge and wisdom, once about Adam, once about Ibrahim's son.

cmp-card:2:55|51:44.why: The same punishment, the thunderbolt that took them while they watched: the Israelites who demanded to see Allah, and Thamud who defied His command. Address versus report: you versus them.
cmp-card:2:55|51:44.relation: Same punishment for two peoples who rebelled against what was asked of them.

cmp-card:2:86|59:3,2:201|59:3.why: This world and the Hereafter set side by side three ways: those who sold the Hereafter, the believers asking for good in both and protection from the Fire, and a people spared punishment in this world but left with the Fire.
cmp-card:2:86|59:3,2:201|59:3.relation: Contrast: the believers ask good in both worlds and safety from the Fire; the deniers face punishment in both.

cmp-card:2:116|59:24.why: Only the stock phrase of what is in the heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:148|59:6.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power over all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:190|60:8.why: Two rules for dealing with others: fight those who fight you and do not transgress; be kind and just to those who did not fight you. One says whom Allah does not love, the other whom He loves.
cmp-card:2:190|60:8.relation: Contrast in the rules of war and peace.

cmp-card:2:218|60:7.why: Only the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:101|63:1.why: Only the words a messenger of Allah came; the People of the Book casting the Book aside versus the hypocrites' false testimony. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:29|65:12.why: Both speak of the creation of seven heavens and of Allah's knowledge of all things. A real shared subject.
cmp-card:2:29|65:12.relation: The seven heavens as a sign of Allah's knowledge and power.

cmp-card:2:148|65:3.why: Only the words all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:261|65:12.why: Only the number seven. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:284|65:3.why: Only the words all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:284|65:12.why: Only heavens and earth and the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.
