cmp-card:2:173|66:1.why: Only the root of forbidding and the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful; the food laws versus the Prophet forbidding himself something. A possible point that only Allah sets what is lawful, but the wording is too thin.

cmp-card:2:199|66:1.why: Only the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:207|66:1.why: A rare phrase, seeking the pleasure of, used once for Allah and once for wives. The contrast itself is the lesson.
cmp-card:2:207|66:1.relation: Contrast: one sells himself seeking Allah's pleasure; the Prophet is gently asked why he sought his wives' pleasure.

cmp-card:2:218|66:1.why: Only the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:104|67:28.why: Only painful punishment for the disbelievers, a stock phrase. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:88|69:41.why: The rare rebuke little do they believe, said of the Jews who claimed sealed hearts and of the Makkans who called the Quran poetry. Both refuse the revelation.
cmp-card:2:88|69:41.relation: Two excuses for rejecting revelation, met by the same rebuke.

cmp-card:2:66|72:27.why: Only the words before and behind. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:48|82:19,2:123|82:19.why: The Day when no soul can help another: twice in al-Baqara with intercession and ransom swapped, and once in 82:19 with all command belonging to Allah. A strong memorizer pair plus a theme.
cmp-card:2:48|82:19,2:123|82:19.relation: Same Day, described as one where no soul avails another.

cmp-card:2:82|84:25.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good; different rewards follow. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:2:25|85:11,2:82|85:11.why: Only the generic reward formula for those who believe and do good, with gardens beneath which rivers flow. It recurs across the Quran; this grouping gives nothing particular.

cmp-card:2:107|85:9.why: Only the dominion of the heavens and earth, a stock phrase. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:116|85:9.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:39|90:19.why: The same verdict on those who reject Our signs: they are the people of the Fire, called in 90:19 the people of the left. Same subject, two wordings.
cmp-card:2:39|90:19.relation: Rejecting the signs and its end, named two ways.

cmp-card:2:82|95:6.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase; nothing particular to learn.

cmp-card:2:82|98:7.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase; nothing particular to learn.

cmp-card:2:209|98:4.why: Only the common phrase after the clear proofs came; slipping versus the People of the Book dividing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:2:82|103:3.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase; nothing particular to learn.

cmp-card:3:4|3:11.why: Those who deny Allah's signs and their severe punishment, stated generally in 3:4 and shown in Pharaoh's people in 3:11.
cmp-card:3:4|3:11.relation: A rule and its example: denial of the signs brings severe punishment.

cmp-card:3:6|3:62.why: Within Al Imran, both close on the declaration that there is no god but Him, then the names Mighty and Wise, as 3:18 does. A memorizer must place each closing.
cmp-card:3:6|3:62.relation: The surah keeps returning to the oneness of Allah closed with His might and wisdom.

cmp-card:3:15|3:198,3:136|3:198.why: Three places in one surah describing gardens with rivers flowing beneath, abiding, each with a different addition (spouses and good pleasure, forgiveness, hospitality from Allah). Useful for a memorizer to keep the endings apart.
cmp-card:3:15|3:198,3:136|3:198.relation: The same Garden, offered to the God-fearing and the repentant, described with different gifts.

cmp-card:3:18|3:62.why: Two declarations of oneness in the same surah, both closing on the names Mighty and Wise. A memorizer's point and a repeated theme.
cmp-card:3:18|3:62.relation: Allah's own witness to His oneness, and the true story that proves it.

cmp-card:3:19|3:199.why: Two kinds of People of the Book: those who differed out of envy, and those who believe humbly. Both close on Allah being swift in reckoning.
cmp-card:3:19|3:199.relation: Contrast within the People of the Book, both told reckoning is swift.

cmp-card:3:21|3:181.why: The crime of killing prophets without right, named twice, each followed by a promised punishment.
cmp-card:3:21|3:181.relation: Same crime of the People of the Book, recorded and answered.

cmp-card:3:25|3:161.why: The same line, every soul paid in full for what it earned and none wronged, about the gathering Day and about whoever cheats. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:3:25|3:161.relation: Full repayment on the Day, applied to a general and a specific sin.

cmp-card:3:29|3:165.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power over all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:31|3:129.why: Only the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:33|3:42.why: Allah chose Al Imran over the worlds, and then Maryam from that family over the women of the worlds. The same verb of choosing ties them.
cmp-card:3:33|3:42.relation: The choice of the family, then of Maryam within it.

cmp-card:3:40|3:165.why: Only the question word how; Zakariya's wonder at a son versus the believers asking why defeat came. One word is too little.

cmp-card:3:52|3:160.why: Only the root of helping; Isa's disciples versus Allah's help in battle. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:57|3:76.why: Only the closing about whom Allah loves or does not love, a stock pattern, and a shared root of paying in full. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:62|3:126.why: Only the names Mighty and Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:67|3:95,3:70|3:98.why: Two different pairs: Ibrahim described as upright and not of the polytheists (3:67, 3:95), and the rebuke to the People of the Book for disbelieving in the signs (3:70, 3:98). Each pair is good, but they are two things.
cmp-card:3:67|3:95,3:70|3:98.changes: Split into the Ibrahim pair and the rebuke pair, since the card joins two unrelated matches.
cmp-card:3:67|3:95,3:70|3:98.relation: Ibrahim's true way, and the People of the Book rebuked for denying what they witness.

cmp-card:3:83|3:109.why: All in the heavens and earth belong to Allah and return to Him: in 3:83 they submit willingly or not, in 3:109 all matters go back to Him.
cmp-card:3:83|3:109.relation: Everything in creation submits to Allah and returns to Him.

cmp-card:3:86|3:101.why: Two questions of how: how would Allah guide those who disbelieved after belief, and how can you disbelieve while the signs are recited and the Messenger is among you.
cmp-card:3:86|3:101.relation: Disbelief after the proof has come, warned against in the same passage.

cmp-card:3:104|3:114.why: Enjoining good and forbidding evil: commanded of this nation in 3:104, praised in the upright among the People of the Book in 3:114. A memorizer pair with different endings.
cmp-card:3:104|3:114.relation: The same duty, as a command and as praise.

cmp-card:3:122|3:160.why: Both close with the call for the believers to rely on Allah: when two groups almost lost heart, and when victory is His alone.
cmp-card:3:122|3:160.relation: Reliance on Allah as the lesson of the battle.

cmp-card:3:130|3:200.why: Two commands to the believers, leaving usury and holding firm in patience, both closing with fear Allah so that you may succeed.
cmp-card:3:130|3:200.relation: Success tied to fearing Allah in wealth and in steadfastness.

cmp-card:3:157|3:169.why: Those killed in the way of Allah: forgiveness better than what people gather, and they are alive with their Lord.
cmp-card:3:157|3:169.relation: Same subject: what awaits those killed in Allah's way.

cmp-card:3:176|3:177.why: Consecutive ayat: those who hasten into disbelief, and those who buy disbelief for faith, will not harm Allah at all. Different closings of punishment.

cmp-card:3:189|15:19.why: Only the words all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:177|17:10.why: Only painful punishment, a stock phrase. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:35|21:4.why: Only the names Hearing and Knowing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:94|23:38.why: Only the common phrase inventing a lie against Allah; a general verdict versus a people accusing their messenger. Different uses.

cmp-card:3:169|23:117.why: Only the words with their Lord. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:189|23:18.why: Only common words of heaven, earth and power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:57|26:227.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:57|32:19.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good, with different rewards. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:3:194|32:25.why: Only the words Day of Resurrection. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:29|33:27.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:31|33:73.why: Only the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:32|33:48.why: Only the words obey and disbelievers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:32|33:66.why: The command to obey Allah and the Messenger, and the cry of the people of the Fire wishing they had obeyed Allah and the Messenger. The regret echoes the command.
cmp-card:3:32|33:66.relation: Contrast: the command in this life and the regret for ignoring it in the Fire.

cmp-card:3:52|33:22.why: Only a verb of saying and the word belief; Isa's disciples versus the believers seeing the confederates. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:59|33:69.why: Only the words with Allah. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:68|33:56.why: Only the words the Prophet and those who believe. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:97|33:1.why: Only scattered common words. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:101|33:34.why: Only the recitation of Allah's verses; a warning against disbelief versus the Prophet's wives told to remember what is recited in their homes. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:102|33:56.why: Only the call O you who believe. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:129|33:24.why: Only punishing and the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:148|33:29.why: Only the Hereafter and the root of doing good. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:148|33:57.why: Only the pair this world and the Hereafter, a stock phrase. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:171|33:47.why: Only bounty from Allah and believers, common words. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:172|33:29.why: The same promise in the same structure: for those among them who do good, a great reward. Said of the Companions after Uhud and of the Prophet's wives. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:3:172|33:29.relation: Doing good earns a great reward, promised to the fighters and to the Prophet's wives alike.

cmp-card:3:176|33:29.why: Only a verb of willing and the Hereafter. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:189|33:27.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:57|34:4.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good, with different rewards. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:3:62|34:27.why: Only the names Mighty and Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:94|34:8.why: Only the common phrase inventing a lie against Allah; a general verdict versus the deniers accusing the Prophet. Different uses.

cmp-card:3:51|36:61.why: Worship Him, this is a straight path: said by Isa to his people, and by Allah to the children of Adam. Nearly the same words.
cmp-card:3:51|36:61.relation: The straight path defined the same way by a prophet and by Allah: worship.

cmp-card:3:142|36:26.why: Only the words enter Paradise. Different scenes.

cmp-card:3:189|36:83.why: Only dominion in two different words and all things. The phrase in 3:189 is stock.

cmp-card:3:137|37:73.why: The same command to look at how was the end, of the deniers and of those warned. A memorizer pair and a repeated lesson.
cmp-card:3:137|37:73.relation: History as a lesson: see the end of those who rejected warning.

cmp-card:3:16|38:61.why: Only our Lord and the punishment of the Fire; the believers' prayer versus the followers cursing their leaders. The shared wording is stock.

cmp-card:3:189|38:10.why: Only the dominion of the heavens and earth, a stock phrase. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:29|49:16,3:29|49:18.why: Allah knows what is in the heavens and earth: you cannot hide what is in your chests (3:29), you cannot teach Allah your religion (49:16), He knows the unseen (49:18). 3:29 and 49:16 are nearly identical lines.
cmp-card:3:29|49:16,3:29|49:18.relation: Allah's complete knowledge, used against hiding and against claiming faith.

cmp-card:3:89|49:5.why: Only the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:89|49:10.why: Only the root of setting right. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:121|49:1.why: Only the names Hearing and Knowing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:163|49:18.why: Only the closing that Allah sees what you do. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:189|49:16.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:16|52:18.why: The believers pray to be protected from the punishment of the Fire, and in 52:18 the people of Paradise are those whom their Lord protected from it.
cmp-card:3:16|52:18.relation: Prayer and answer: protect us from the Fire, and their Lord protected them.

cmp-card:3:189|54:49.why: Only the words all things and a shared root of power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:189|55:29.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:10|58:17,3:116|58:17.why: Three nearly identical statements that wealth and children will not avail against Allah, each with a different ending. A classic memorizer group.
cmp-card:3:10|58:17,3:116|58:17.relation: Wealth and children cannot save anyone from Allah.

cmp-card:3:176|58:10.why: Both comfort the believers that the enemies' actions cannot harm; but the wording is common and the subjects differ (disbelievers rushing to disbelief, secret talk).

cmp-card:3:31|60:7.why: Only the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:136|61:12.why: Only the generic reward of forgiveness and gardens beneath which rivers flow. Stock formula.

cmp-card:3:10|63:9.why: Wealth and children: they will not avail the disbelievers against Allah, and the believers are warned not to let them distract from His remembrance. Both end with a verdict on those concerned.
cmp-card:3:10|63:9.relation: Contrast: wealth and children cannot save the disbeliever, and can ruin the believer who is distracted by them.

cmp-card:3:18|63:1.why: Only the root of bearing witness; Allah's witness to His oneness versus the hypocrites' false testimony. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:149|63:3.why: Only the word disbelieved. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:10|64:15.why: Wealth and children: they avail nothing against Allah, and they are a trial while the great reward is with Him.
cmp-card:3:10|64:15.relation: Same subject: wealth and children are no refuge, only a test.

cmp-card:3:29|64:1.why: Only the stock phrase of what is in the heavens and earth and the closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:32|64:12,3:132|64:12.why: The command to obey Allah and the Messenger in three forms, with different endings: if they turn away Allah does not love the disbelievers, that you may receive mercy, and the Messenger's duty is only to convey. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:3:32|64:12,3:132|64:12.relation: Obedience commanded, and what follows from obeying or turning away.

cmp-card:3:122|64:13,3:160|64:13.why: Three places closing with the call for the believers to rely on Allah: two in the battle passages of Al Imran, one after the declaration of oneness in 64:13.
cmp-card:3:122|64:13,3:160|64:13.relation: Reliance on Allah follows from His oneness and from His help in battle.

cmp-card:3:129|64:1.why: Only the stock phrase of what is in the heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:129|64:14.why: Only forgiveness and the stock closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:163|64:2.why: Only the closing that Allah sees what is done. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:165|64:11.why: A calamity that strikes: in 3:165 it is from yourselves, in 64:11 none strikes except by Allah's permission. Read together they show cause and decree.
cmp-card:3:165|64:11.relation: Two sides of misfortune: our own doing and Allah's permission.

cmp-card:3:189|64:1.why: Only dominion and the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:29|65:12.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:189|65:12.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:189|67:1.why: Only dominion and the stock closing about Allah's power, which recur across the Quran.

cmp-card:3:192|71:25.why: Only entering the Fire and no helpers, a common pairing; the believers' prayer versus Nuh's people drowned. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:57|84:25.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:3:29|85:9.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:136|85:11.why: Only the generic reward of gardens beneath which rivers flow. Stock formula.

cmp-card:3:57|95:6.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:3:15|98:8,3:136|98:8,3:198|98:8.why: The gardens with rivers, abiding, in three places of Al Imran and in 98:8, each closing differently. 3:15 and 98:8 both place the reward with their Lord and speak of Allah's good pleasure. Useful for memorizers.
cmp-card:3:15|98:8,3:136|98:8,3:198|98:8.relation: The reward of the God-fearing, crowned with Allah's good pleasure.

cmp-card:3:57|98:7.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:3:100|98:4.why: Only those given the Book. Different subjects.

cmp-card:3:105|98:4.why: Division after the clear proof came: the believers warned not to be like those who divided, and the People of the Book who divided only after the proof came.
cmp-card:3:105|98:4.relation: Same lesson: division came after knowledge, not from lack of it.

cmp-card:3:57|103:3.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:4:11|4:12,4:11|4:176.why: The inheritance shares, with the repeated condition after a bequest or debt and the rule of two shares to the male. A memorizer must keep the numbers and cases apart.
cmp-card:4:11|4:12,4:11|4:176.relation: One law of inheritance, laid out over three ayat.

cmp-card:4:13|4:57,4:13|4:122.why: Three places in an-Nisa promising gardens with rivers, abiding; 4:57 and 4:122 open identically and diverge after forever. A clear memorizer group.
cmp-card:4:13|4:57,4:13|4:122.relation: Obedience and faith with good deeds, rewarded with the same Garden.

cmp-card:4:17|4:26.why: Allah turns to people in repentance, and both close on His knowledge and wisdom. Same passage of laws.
cmp-card:4:17|4:26.relation: Repentance accepted, grounded in His knowledge and wisdom.

cmp-card:4:17|4:104.why: Only the closing Knowing, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:17|4:148.why: Only the word evil and a closing name. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:29|4:152.why: Only the closing Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:30|4:169.why: Both end with the Fire and that being easy for Allah: for the one who kills or devours unjustly, and for the disbelievers who did wrong.
cmp-card:4:30|4:169.relation: Punishment of the unjust is easy for Allah.

cmp-card:4:38|4:39.why: Consecutive ayat: those who spend for show without believing, then what harm if they had believed and spent. The second answers the first.
cmp-card:4:38|4:39.relation: Contrast: spending without faith, and what spending with faith would have brought.

cmp-card:4:40|4:67.why: A great reward from His own presence, in nearly the same words. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:40|4:67.relation: Allah's own reward for the good done and for obedience.

cmp-card:4:44|4:51.why: The same opening about those given a portion of the Book, followed by two of their faults. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:44|4:51.relation: Same people, two faults: buying error, and preferring the idolaters.

cmp-card:4:45|4:166.why: Only the phrase Allah is sufficient, which an-Nisa repeats with many names. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:59|4:136,4:60|4:136.why: One theme in an-Nisa: the believers told to obey and to believe in Allah, His Messenger and the Books before, and those who claim to believe in what was sent down yet seek judgment from false gods. 4:60 and 4:136 share the phrase of what was sent to you and before, and the ending of straying far.
cmp-card:4:59|4:136,4:60|4:136.relation: True faith in the revelation against a claimed faith that turns to false judges.

cmp-card:4:64|4:110,4:106|4:110.why: Three places in an-Nisa where seeking Allah's forgiveness meets His forgiveness: those who wronged themselves coming to the Messenger, the Messenger told to seek forgiveness, and whoever does wrong then asks forgiveness. A memorizer group with one lesson.
cmp-card:4:64|4:110,4:106|4:110.relation: Whoever seeks forgiveness finds Allah forgiving.

cmp-card:4:74|4:76.why: Fighting in the way of Allah, close together: who should fight and what awaits them, then the believers fighting for Allah against those fighting for false gods.
cmp-card:4:74|4:76.relation: Two sides of fighting: in Allah's way and in the way of false gods.

cmp-card:4:79|4:165.why: Only messenger and a closing with Allah's name. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:86|4:126.why: Only a closing about Allah and all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:96|4:106.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:96|4:110.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:99|4:149.why: Both close on Allah being Pardoning, once with Forgiving and once with Powerful; 4:149 urges people to pardon too. A memorizer pair with a lesson.
cmp-card:4:99|4:149.relation: Allah pardons, and asks His servants to pardon.

cmp-card:4:106|4:152.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:108|4:126.why: Both close on Allah encompassing: what the plotters do, and all things. A memorizer pair, and the second widens the first.
cmp-card:4:108|4:126.relation: Nothing escapes Allah, neither secret plots nor anything in creation.

cmp-card:4:116|4:167.why: Associating partners and blocking Allah's way both end in straying far astray. A refrain of an-Nisa that memorizers must place.
cmp-card:4:116|4:167.relation: Shirk and turning people away from Allah lead to the same far error.

cmp-card:4:123|4:173.why: Both end with finding no protector or helper besides Allah: the evildoer whatever his wishes, and the arrogant, set against the believers repaid in full.
cmp-card:4:123|4:173.relation: Contrast: reward in full for believers, no protector for the evildoer and the arrogant.

cmp-card:4:136|4:162.why: Belief in what was sent to you and what was sent before: commanded to the believers and praised in those firm in knowledge.
cmp-card:4:136|4:162.relation: Same faith in all revelation, as a command and as praise.

cmp-card:4:139|4:144.why: Taking the disbelievers as allies instead of the believers: described in the hypocrites, then forbidden to the believers. Same words, two questions.
cmp-card:4:139|4:144.relation: Same warning, as a description and as a command.

cmp-card:4:158|4:165.why: Only the closing Mighty, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:13|5:119,4:57|5:119,4:122|5:1.why: Gardens with rivers, abiding: 4:57 and 4:122 add forever, as 5:119 does, and 4:13 and 5:119 close with the great success. A memorizer must know which ending goes where.
cmp-card:4:13|5:119,4:57|5:119,4:122|5:1.relation: The same reward for obedience, faith and truthfulness.

cmp-card:4:16|5:39.why: If they repent and set right, Allah turns to them: in a punishment for indecency and for the thief.
cmp-card:4:16|5:39.relation: Repentance with reform lifts the penalty in different laws.

cmp-card:4:80|5:92.why: Obeying the Messenger and turning away: the Messenger is not a guardian over them, his duty is only to convey.
cmp-card:4:80|5:92.relation: Obedience to the Messenger is obedience to Allah; turning away does not burden him.

cmp-card:4:96|5:34.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:96|5:74.why: Only forgiveness and the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:96|5:98.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:106|5:34.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:106|5:39.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:106|5:74.why: Only seeking forgiveness and the closing Forgiving, Merciful, a common pairing; the Prophet told to seek forgiveness versus the Christians invited to repent.

cmp-card:4:110|5:39,4:110|5:74.why: Doing wrong then turning to Allah: seeking forgiveness, repenting after wrongdoing, and the invitation to repent. Each finds Allah forgiving.
cmp-card:4:110|5:39,4:110|5:74.relation: Whoever turns back after wrong finds Allah forgiving.

cmp-card:4:110|5:98.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:126|5:40.why: Only the heavens-and-earth formula and all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:126|5:120.why: Only the heavens-and-earth formula and all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:131|5:57.why: Only those given the Book before you and fear Allah. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:158|5:38.why: Only the closing Mighty, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:159|5:59.why: Only the People of the Book and belief. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:160|5:87.why: Good things made lawful then forbidden: forbidden to the Jews as a punishment, and the believers told not to forbid them on themselves.
cmp-card:4:160|5:87.relation: Contrast: what Allah forbade as punishment, and what believers must not forbid themselves.

cmp-card:4:50|6:11.why: Only the words see how. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:50|6:21,4:50|6:24.why: See how they lie: inventing lies against Allah, the worst wrong, and on the Day lying against themselves while their inventions vanish.
cmp-card:4:50|6:21,4:50|6:24.relation: Lies against Allah, and how they turn against the liars.

cmp-card:4:68|6:87.why: Guided to a straight path: promised to the obedient in 4:68 and given to the prophets and their families in 6:87.
cmp-card:4:68|6:87.relation: The same guidance promised to the obedient and given to the chosen.

cmp-card:4:126|6:75.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:126|6:101.why: Only heavens and earth and all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:96|7:23.why: Only words of forgiveness and mercy. Different scenes.

cmp-card:4:106|5:98.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:110|7:23,4:110|7:153.why: Wronging oneself then turning to Allah: the rule in 4:110, Adam and Hawwa's prayer in 7:23, and those who did evil then repented in 7:153. The rule, its first example, and its promise.
cmp-card:4:110|7:23,4:110|7:153.relation: Adam's prayer is the model of the forgiveness promised to all who turn back.

cmp-card:4:167|7:45.why: Only the common phrase of turning people from Allah's way, joined to disbelief. Same kind of people but no particular lesson from the pairing.

cmp-card:4:26|8:71.why: Only before and the closing Knowing, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:32|8:75.why: Only some over others and the closing about Allah's knowledge. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:48|8:29.why: Only forgiveness and the word great. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:59|8:1.why: Both settle disputes by Allah and the Messenger: refer any dispute back to them, and the spoils belong to them so set things right between you. Both close on obedience if you are believers.
cmp-card:4:59|8:1.relation: Disputes among believers are settled by returning the matter to Allah and His Messenger.

cmp-card:4:69|8:46.why: Only the common command to obey Allah and the Messenger. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:80|8:20.why: Only obeying and turning away, a common pairing. Different emphasis.

cmp-card:4:106|8:69.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:107|8:27.why: Only the root of betrayal; defending traitors versus a command not to betray. Thin link.

cmp-card:4:107|8:58.why: Treachery and Allah's verdict on it: do not defend those who betray themselves, and if you fear betrayal from a people, break the treaty openly. Both close on Allah not loving the treacherous.
cmp-card:4:107|8:58.relation: Allah does not love treachery, from within or from an enemy.

cmp-card:4:108|8:47.why: The same closing, Allah encompasses what they do, after people who hide from others or show off to them. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:108|8:47.relation: Those who act for people's eyes are still encompassed by Allah.

cmp-card:4:110|8:69.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:134|8:67.why: Wanting the goods of this world: with Allah is the reward of both worlds, and you want the world while Allah wants the Hereafter.
cmp-card:4:134|8:67.relation: The world people chase against the Hereafter Allah offers.

cmp-card:4:148|8:53.why: Only the closing Hearing, Knowing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:150|8:1.why: Only Allah and His messengers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:152|8:24.why: Only believing and the Messenger. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:158|8:10.why: Only the closing Mighty, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:158|8:49.why: Only the closing Mighty, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:165|8:10.why: Only good news and the closing Mighty, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:165|8:67.why: Only the closing Mighty, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:13|9:72,4:13|9:89,4:13|9:100.why: Gardens with rivers, abiding, closing with that is the great success, in four places; 9:72 adds good pleasure, 9:100 adds forever and drops one word before rivers. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:4:13|9:72,4:13|9:89,4:13|9:100.relation: Obedience, faith, striving and following the forerunners earn the same great success.

cmp-card:4:14|9:63.why: Whoever disobeys or opposes Allah and His Messenger has the Fire, abiding in it, with a different closing of disgrace.
cmp-card:4:14|9:63.relation: Opposition to Allah and His Messenger, and its end.

cmp-card:4:16|9:104.why: Only repentance and the closing Relenting, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:17|9:15,4:17|9:106.why: Allah turns in repentance to whom He wills, each closing on Knowing, Wise. A memorizer group about the same divine act.
cmp-card:4:17|9:15,4:17|9:106.relation: Repentance accepted by the All-Knowing, All-Wise.

cmp-card:4:26|9:15,4:26|9:106.why: Allah turns to you or to them in repentance, closing on Knowing, Wise. A memorizer group like 4:17 with the same ayat.
cmp-card:4:26|9:15,4:26|9:106.relation: Repentance accepted by the All-Knowing, All-Wise.

cmp-card:4:26|9:104.why: Only repentance as a word. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:39|9:18.why: Only the common formula of believing in Allah and the Last Day. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:39|9:44.why: Only the common formula of believing in Allah and the Last Day. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:39|9:45.why: Only the common formula of believing in Allah and the Last Day. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:39|9:99.why: Belief in Allah and the Last Day joined to spending: what harm if they had done it, and the bedouins who do it and seek nearness to Allah.
cmp-card:4:39|9:99.relation: Faith with spending: missed by some, done by others.

cmp-card:4:45|9:116.why: Only the idea of protector and helper in stock wording. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:57|9:72,4:122|9:72.why: Gardens with rivers, abiding, in an-Nisa twice and at-Tawba once with different continuations. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:4:57|9:72,4:122|9:72.relation: The same promised Garden, to the believers who do good.

cmp-card:4:59|9:99.why: Only the formula of believing in Allah and the Last Day and the Messenger. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:93|9:89.why: Only abiding in it and prepared; Hell for a murderer versus gardens. Stock wording.

cmp-card:4:96|9:27.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:104|9:106.why: Only the closing Knowing, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:106|9:27.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:110|9:27.why: Only then and the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:110|9:102.why: Only evil deeds and the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:152|9:91.why: Only Allah and His Messenger and the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:169|9:22.why: Only abiding in it forever, said of Hell and of the Garden. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:4:49|10:44.why: Only the root of wronging; those who praise themselves versus people wronging themselves. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:50|10:17,4:50|10:69.why: Those who invent lies against Allah: see how they do it, none is more unjust, and they will not succeed. 10:17 and 10:69 both end on their failure.
cmp-card:4:50|10:17,4:50|10:69.relation: Lying against Allah is the worst wrong and never succeeds.

cmp-card:4:57|10:9,4:122|10:9.why: 10:9 shares only the generic formula of those who believe and do good and rivers flowing; its structure differs. The an-Nisa pair is already shown elsewhere.

cmp-card:4:68|10:25,4:175|10:25.why: Guidance to a straight path: promised to the obedient (4:68), to those who hold fast to Allah (4:175), and by the One who calls to the abode of peace (10:25). 4:68 and 4:175 are close in wording.
cmp-card:4:68|10:25,4:175|10:25.relation: Who is guided to the straight path, and by whom.

cmp-card:4:133|10:44.why: Only the word people. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:148|10:65.why: Only speech and the names Hearing, Knowing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:30|11:113.why: Only wrongdoing and Fire. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:134|11:20.why: Only roots of hearing and seeing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:167|11:19.why: Only the common phrase of turning people from Allah's way, joined to disbelief. Same kind of people but no particular lesson.

cmp-card:4:96|12:92.why: Only words of forgiveness and mercy. Different scenes.

cmp-card:4:106|12:92.why: Only words of forgiveness and mercy. Different scenes.

cmp-card:4:107|12:52.why: Allah and the treacherous: He does not love them, and He does not guide their plot. Yusuf's words echo the ruling.
cmp-card:4:107|12:52.relation: Treachery is hated by Allah and its plots fail.

cmp-card:4:105|13:1.why: Only the Book sent down to you with the truth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:13|14:23,4:57|14:23,4:122|14:.why: Admission into gardens with rivers, abiding, for the obedient and for those who believe and do good: an-Nisa three times and Ibrahim once, each closing differently. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:4:13|14:23,4:57|14:23,4:122|14:.relation: The same Garden promised, with different closing gifts.

cmp-card:4:126|14:19.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:133|14:19.why: If He wills He would remove you and bring others, or a new creation. Nearly the same words, a memorizer pair and a warning.
cmp-card:4:133|14:19.relation: Allah can replace any people; no one is indispensable.

cmp-card:4:165|14:4.why: Why messengers were sent: so people have no excuse, and in their people's language so they understand. Both close on Mighty, Wise.

cmp-card:4:167|14:3.why: Turning people from Allah's way ends in far error, in both. 14:3 adds the cause: loving this world over the Hereafter.
cmp-card:4:167|14:3.relation: Blocking Allah's way leads far astray, and love of the world is behind it.

cmp-card:4:41|16:84.why: The same scene: on the Day a witness is brought from every nation. 4:41 adds the Prophet as witness over his people.
cmp-card:4:41|16:84.relation: Every nation will face its witness.

cmp-card:4:50|16:105.why: Inventing lies: see how they invent lies against Allah, and only those who disbelieve invent lies. 16:105 turns the charge back on the accusers.
cmp-card:4:50|16:105.relation: The real liars are those who reject Allah's signs.

cmp-card:4:68|16:121.why: Guided to a straight path: promised to the obedient, and given to Ibrahim for his gratitude.
cmp-card:4:68|16:121.relation: The guidance promised to the obedient was given to Ibrahim.

cmp-card:4:96|16:18.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:106|16:18.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:109|16:107.why: Only the life of this world. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:110|16:18.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:110|16:119.why: Whoever does evil and then turns back finds Allah forgiving, merciful. Same promise in two surahs.
cmp-card:4:110|16:119.relation: Repentance after wrong always meets forgiveness.

cmp-card:4:124|16:97.why: Whoever does good, male or female, while a believer: in 4:124 enters Paradise, in 16:97 receives a good life and full reward. A memorizer pair and a key principle.
cmp-card:4:124|16:97.relation: Men and women equal in the reward of faith and good deeds.

cmp-card:4:126|16:73.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:126|16:77.why: Only heavens and earth and all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:167|16:88.why: The same opening, those who disbelieve and turn others from Allah's way, ending in far error or in punishment upon punishment. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:167|16:88.relation: Those who misguide others carry a double burden.

cmp-card:4:159|17:58.why: Only a shared construction and the words Day of Resurrection; belief in Isa before death versus towns destroyed. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:126|18:84.why: Only earth and all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:144|18:15.why: Only taking others besides and clear authority. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:13|20:76.why: Gardens with rivers, abiding, and that is: the great success in 4:13, the reward of the one who purifies himself in 20:76. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:13|20:76.relation: The same reward, named success and named the reward of purification.

cmp-card:4:50|20:61.why: Inventing lies against Allah: the Quran says see how they do it, and Musa warns Pharaoh's magicians not to do it.
cmp-card:4:50|20:61.relation: Musa's warning applies to every liar against Allah.

cmp-card:4:124|20:112.why: Whoever does good deeds while a believer will not be wronged: not a speck in 4:124, no fear of injustice or loss in 20:112. Same opening, a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:124|20:112.relation: Faith with good deeds is safe from any injustice.

cmp-card:4:118|21:26.why: Only the verb take and servants. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:126|21:30.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:13|22:14,4:57|22:14,4:122|22:.why: 22:14 shares only the generic promise of gardens with rivers to those who believe and do good; the an-Nisa ayat are already grouped elsewhere. Nothing more to learn from adding al-Hajj.

cmp-card:4:13|22:23,4:57|22:23,4:122|22:.why: 22:23 shares only the generic promise of gardens with rivers to those who believe and do good; the an-Nisa ayat are already grouped elsewhere. Nothing more to learn from adding al-Hajj.

cmp-card:4:99|22:60.why: Only the closing Pardoning, Forgiving. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:107|22:38.why: Allah does not love the treacherous: do not defend them, and Allah defends the believers against every treacherous ingrate.
cmp-card:4:107|22:38.relation: Contrast: the Prophet must not defend the treacherous; Allah defends the believers against them.

cmp-card:4:109|22:69.why: Only Day of Resurrection. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:116|22:12,4:167|22:12.why: Far error: associating partners, turning people from Allah's way, and calling on what neither harms nor benefits. 22:12 names it the far error.
cmp-card:4:116|22:12,4:167|22:12.relation: Shirk in its forms is the far error.

cmp-card:4:50|23:38.why: Only the phrase inventing a lie against Allah; here it is the deniers accusing their messenger. Different use.

cmp-card:4:13|24:52,4:69|24:52,4:80|24:5.why: Whoever obeys Allah and the Messenger, four times with four outcomes: the Garden, the company of the prophets, obeying Allah himself, and being the successful. A memorizer group with a theme.
cmp-card:4:13|24:52,4:69|24:52,4:80|24:5.relation: Obedience to Allah and His Messenger, and its rewards.

cmp-card:4:16|24:5.why: Repentance with reform after a legal penalty: for indecency and for slander. Both lift the penalty with Allah's mercy.
cmp-card:4:16|24:5.relation: Repentance with reform opens the way back in different laws.

cmp-card:4:26|24:59.why: Allah makes things clear to you, like those before you, closing on Knowing, Wise. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:26|24:59.relation: Allah explains His rulings, following the ways of earlier believers.

cmp-card:4:13|29:58,4:57|29:58,4:122|29:.relation: The same promise to those who believe and do good, rooms in 29:58 and gardens in an-Nisa.

cmp-card:4:125|31:22.relation: Submission with excellence, described as the best faith and the firmest hold.

cmp-card:4:131|31:12,4:131|31:26.why: If you disbelieve, Allah is free of need and praiseworthy: in an-Nisa after the command to fear Him, in Luqman after the call to gratitude, and plainly in 31:26. A memorizer group with one lesson.
cmp-card:4:131|31:12,4:131|31:26.relation: Disbelief and ingratitude harm only the one who commits them; Allah needs no one.

cmp-card:4:158|31:9.why: Only the closing Mighty, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:13|33:71,4:17|33:73.why: Two different pairs: whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger wins the great success (4:13, 33:71), and Allah turns in repentance to people (4:17, 33:73). Each pair is good, but they are two things.
cmp-card:4:13|33:71,4:17|33:73.changes: Split into the obedience pair and the repentance pair, since the card joins two unrelated matches.
cmp-card:4:13|33:71,4:17|33:73.relation: Obedience earns the great success; Allah accepts the believers' repentance.

cmp-card:4:14|33:57,4:93|33:57.why: Those who disobey Allah and His Messenger, kill a believer, or harm Allah and His Messenger: cursed, with a humiliating or great punishment prepared. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:4:14|33:57,4:93|33:57.relation: Grave offences against Allah, His Messenger and the believers, and the punishment prepared.

cmp-card:4:17|33:1.why: Only the closing Knowing, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:21|33:7.why: The rare phrase a solemn covenant, used for the marriage bond and for the covenant taken from the prophets. Placing marriage beside the prophets' covenant shows its weight.
cmp-card:4:21|33:7.relation: The marriage contract named with the same words as the prophets' covenant.

cmp-card:4:39|33:1.why: Only the closing about Allah's knowledge. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:39|33:21.why: Only Allah and the Last Day. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:40|33:29.why: Only a great reward. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:81|33:48.why: Turn away from them, rely on Allah, and Allah suffices as guardian: said about the hypocrites in both. A memorizer pair with the same counsel.
cmp-card:4:81|33:48.relation: The answer to the hypocrites' harm: ignore it and rely on Allah.

cmp-card:4:86|33:27.why: Only a closing about Allah and all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:111|33:1.why: Only the closing Knowing, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:112|33:58.why: Bearing a slander and a clear sin: blaming an innocent person, and harming believing men and women for what they did not do. Same rare phrase, same sin.
cmp-card:4:112|33:58.relation: Accusing the innocent is named slander and clear sin in both.

cmp-card:4:123|33:17.why: They will find no protector or helper besides Allah: for the evildoer, and for those who think they can escape what Allah wills for them.
cmp-card:4:123|33:17.relation: No one can shield a person from Allah's decree.

cmp-card:4:126|33:27.why: Only a closing about all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:126|33:54.why: Only a closing about all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:132|33:3,4:132|33:48.why: Allah suffices as guardian, with rely on Allah in 33:3 and 33:48. A memorizer group about reliance.
cmp-card:4:132|33:3,4:132|33:48.relation: Reliance on Allah, the owner of all, who is guardian enough.

cmp-card:4:134|33:29.why: Only wanting and the Hereafter. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:136|33:36.why: Whoever disbelieves in or disobeys Allah and His Messenger has strayed, far in 4:136 and clearly in 33:36. A memorizer pair.

cmp-card:4:105|35:31.why: Only the common statement that the Book sent to the Prophet is the truth; judging between people versus confirming earlier scripture. Common wording, different points.

cmp-card:4:165|35:2.why: Only people and the closing Mighty, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:39|36:47.why: Spending from what Allah provided: what harm if they had done it, and the disbelievers mocking the call to spend. The same phrase in a reproach and in a refusal.
cmp-card:4:39|36:47.relation: The call to spend from Allah's provision, ignored and mocked.

cmp-card:4:68|37:118.why: Guided to the straight path: promised to the obedient, and granted to Musa and Harun. Close wording.
cmp-card:4:68|37:118.relation: The guidance promised to the obedient was given to Musa and Harun.

cmp-card:4:39|39:26.why: Only the Last Day and the Hereafter. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:109|39:26.why: Only the life of this world. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:110|39:53.why: Whoever wrongs himself and asks forgiveness finds Allah forgiving, and the call to those who have wronged themselves not to despair, for Allah forgives all sins.
cmp-card:4:110|39:53.relation: Forgiveness for those who wronged themselves: a promise and an open call.

cmp-card:4:122|39:20.why: A home with rivers flowing beneath, sealed as Allah's promise: a true promise in 4:122, a promise Allah does not break in 39:20.
cmp-card:4:122|39:20.relation: The reward of the believers is Allah's promise, which is never broken.

cmp-card:4:147|39:26.why: Only words of punishment. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:148|39:24.why: Only the word evil. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:159|40:51.why: Only the root of witness. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:30|41:28.why: Only Fire and the root of enmity. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:126|41:54.why: The rare closing that Allah encompasses all things: after His ownership of creation, and after the deniers' doubt about meeting Him. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:126|41:54.relation: Nothing is outside Allah's reach, neither creation nor the doubters.

cmp-card:4:105|42:17.why: Only the common statement that Allah sent down the Book with the truth. Different points.

cmp-card:4:126|42:12.why: Only heavens and earth and all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:139|42:6,4:139|42:9.why: Different structures: 4:139 is about taking disbelievers as allies instead of believers; 42:6 and 42:9 are about taking protectors besides Allah, meaning false gods. The shared words mean different things.

cmp-card:4:143|42:46.why: Whomever Allah leaves astray has no way: the hypocrites wavering between two sides, and the wrongdoers with no protector. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:143|42:46.relation: There is no way out for the one Allah leaves astray.

cmp-card:4:144|42:6,4:144|42:9.why: Different structures: 4:144 forbids taking disbelievers as allies instead of believers; 42:6 and 42:9 are about taking protectors besides Allah. The shared words mean different things.

cmp-card:4:126|45:22.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:158|45:2.why: Only the names Mighty, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:80|47:33.why: Only the common command to obey Allah and the Messenger; different points.

cmp-card:4:167|47:1.why: The same opening, those who disbelieve and turn others from Allah's way: they have strayed far, and He made their deeds go astray. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:167|47:1.relation: Blocking Allah's way ruins both the person and his deeds.

cmp-card:4:167|47:32,4:167|47:34,4:168|4.why: Those who disbelieve and turn others from Allah's way, four times with four endings: far error, no forgiveness or guidance, ruined deeds, and no forgiveness after dying as disbelievers. A strong memorizer group.
cmp-card:4:167|47:32,4:167|47:34,4:168|4.relation: The fate of those who disbelieve and block others.

cmp-card:4:13|48:5,4:57|48:5,4:122|48:5.why: Gardens with rivers, abiding, and the great success: that is the great success in 4:13, that is with Allah a great success in 48:5. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:4:13|48:5,4:57|48:5,4:122|48:5.relation: The great success of the obedient and the believers.

cmp-card:4:79|48:28.why: Allah sent His Messenger, and Allah suffices as witness: to all people in 4:79, with guidance and the true religion in 48:28.

cmp-card:4:13|57:12.relation: The great success, promised to the obedient and announced to the believers on the Day.

cmp-card:4:40|57:11,4:40|57:18.why: Allah multiplies the good deed: in 4:40 with a great reward, in 57:11 and 57:18 the goodly loan multiplied with a generous reward. 57:11 and 57:18 are a strong memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:40|57:11,4:40|57:18.relation: Good deeds and spending are multiplied by Allah.

cmp-card:4:104|60:6.why: Only hoping for Allah. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:152|60:7.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:13|61:12.why: He will admit you to gardens with rivers, and that is the great success, in both. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:13|61:12.relation: Obedience and striving rewarded with the same great success.

cmp-card:4:29|61:11.why: Only wealth and selves. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:158|61:1.why: Only the names Mighty, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:158|62:1.why: Only the names Mighty, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:61|63:5.why: When told to come, to the revelation or to the Messenger's prayer for forgiveness, the hypocrites turn away. Same scene and words.
cmp-card:4:61|63:5.relation: The hypocrites' habit: turning away when called to the Messenger.

cmp-card:4:13|64:9,4:57|64:9,4:122|64:9.why: 64:9 joins both an-Nisa wordings: admitted to gardens with rivers, abiding forever, and that is the great success. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:4:13|64:9,4:57|64:9,4:122|64:9.relation: Faith and good deeds lead to the great success.

cmp-card:4:80|64:12.why: Obeying the Messenger, and if they turn away the Messenger is not their keeper; his duty is only to convey.
cmp-card:4:80|64:12.relation: The Messenger's duty ends with conveying; turning away is on those who turn.

cmp-card:4:96|64:14.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:106|64:14.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:126|64:1.why: Only the stock phrase of what is in the heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:131|64:6.why: Disbelief leaves Allah untouched: if you disbelieve, Allah is free of need and praiseworthy, and when they disbelieved, Allah had no need of them.
cmp-card:4:131|64:6.relation: Allah needs no one; disbelief harms only the disbeliever.

cmp-card:4:57|65:11.why: 65:11 shares the long clause: those who believe and do good, admitted to gardens with rivers, abiding forever, then a different closing. A memorizer trap more than a generic match.
cmp-card:4:57|65:11.relation: The same eternal Garden, closing on spouses and shade or on good provision.

cmp-card:4:122|65:11.why: 65:11 shares the long clause: those who believe and do good, admitted to gardens with rivers, abiding forever, then a different closing. A memorizer trap.
cmp-card:4:122|65:11.relation: The same eternal Garden, sealed as Allah's true promise or as His good provision.

cmp-card:4:106|66:1.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:110|66:1.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:68|67:22.why: Only straight path; 67:22 is a parable of walking prone or upright. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:145|71:25.why: Only Fire and helpers, a common pairing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:14|72:23.why: Whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has the Fire, abiding in it. Same clause, different endings: a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:14|72:23.relation: Disobeying Allah and His Messenger, and its lasting end.

cmp-card:4:17|76:30.why: Only the closing Knowing, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:104|76:30.why: Only the closing Knowing, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:111|76:30.why: Only the closing Knowing, Wise. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:138|84:24.why: Only the stock phrase give them tidings of a painful punishment. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:13|85:11,4:57|85:11,4:122|85:.why: 85:11 ends on that is the great triumph with a different adjective from 4:13's great success; a real trap for memorizers. Otherwise the shared wording is the generic Garden formula.
cmp-card:4:13|85:11,4:57|85:11,4:122|85:.relation: Two names for the same triumph of the believers.

cmp-card:4:126|85:9.why: Only heavens and earth and all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:4:13|98:8,4:57|98:8,4:122|98:8.why: Gardens with rivers, abiding forever: 98:8 shares forever with 4:57 and 4:122, and adds Allah's good pleasure. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:4:13|98:8,4:57|98:8,4:122|98:8.relation: The eternal Garden, crowned in 98:8 with mutual good pleasure.

cmp-card:5:7|5:11.why: Remember Allah's favour upon you, twice in al-Maida: the covenant you accepted, and the enemy's hands held back. Both add fear Allah. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:5:7|5:11.relation: Remembering Allah's favours, the covenant and the protection.

cmp-card:5:10|5:86.why: The same refrain word for word: those who disbelieve and deny Our signs are the people of Hellfire. A memorizer must place both.
cmp-card:5:10|5:86.relation: Same verdict repeated in the surah.

cmp-card:5:17|5:18,5:17|5:72.why: Answers to the claims about Isa and about being Allah's sons: 5:17 and 5:72 open identically, 5:17 and 5:18 share the dominion of the heavens and earth and what is between. A strong memorizer group.
cmp-card:5:17|5:18,5:17|5:72.relation: Every claim to a special status before Allah is answered by His sole dominion.

cmp-card:5:17|5:40,5:18|5:40.why: Allah's dominion and His will to forgive or punish: 5:18 and 5:40 have the forgive and punish clause in swapped order. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:5:17|5:40,5:18|5:40.relation: Allah's dominion grounds His freedom to forgive and to punish.

cmp-card:5:34|5:39,5:34|5:74.why: Repentance and forgiveness three times in al-Maida: brigands who repent before capture, the thief who repents, and the Christians invited to repent.
cmp-card:5:34|5:39,5:34|5:74.relation: The door of repentance kept open in the laws and in the call to the People of the Book.

cmp-card:5:34|5:98.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:39|5:74.why: Repentance followed by Allah's forgiveness: the thief who repents and the Christians invited to repent.
cmp-card:5:39|5:74.relation: Repentance is offered to the sinner and to the one in false belief.

cmp-card:5:39|5:98.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:40|5:97.why: Only heavens and earth and all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:40|5:120.why: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and earth, and He has power over all things: the same frame, 5:40 adding forgiving and punishing. A memorizer pair in one surah.
cmp-card:5:40|5:120.relation: Allah's dominion and power, repeated as the surah's frame.

cmp-card:5:47|5:59.why: The People of the Book and what Allah sent down, both closing on their being defiantly disobedient.
cmp-card:5:47|5:59.relation: Not judging by or resenting what Allah revealed marks defiance.

cmp-card:5:59|5:81.why: Belief in what was sent down, and most of them defiantly disobedient: 5:59 and 5:81 end on the same charge.
cmp-card:5:59|5:81.relation: Failing to believe in what was sent is the root of their defiance.

cmp-card:5:85|5:119.why: Gardens with rivers, abiding, for those who spoke truly: the Christians who wept at the Quran, and the truthful on the Day. Same surah, different closings.
cmp-card:5:85|5:119.relation: Truthful words rewarded with the same Garden.

cmp-card:5:76|6:56.why: Worshipping what is called on besides Allah: what has no power to harm or benefit, and the Prophet forbidden to worship them.
cmp-card:5:76|6:56.relation: The futility of worshipping others besides Allah.

cmp-card:5:88|6:118.why: Eat of what Allah provided, lawful and good, and eat of what Allah's name was said over, each tied to being believers.
cmp-card:5:88|6:118.relation: Eating is tied to faith: lawful provision and Allah's name.

cmp-card:5:105|6:88.why: Only guidance and what they used to do. Different subjects.
