cmp-card:5:85|48:5,5:119|48:5.why: Gardens with rivers, abiding, and success or reward: the reward of those who do good, the great success, and with Allah a great success. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:5:85|48:5,5:119|48:5.relation: The same Garden named reward and success.

cmp-card:5:120|48:14.why: Only the stock phrase of the dominion of the heavens and earth. Different continuations.

cmp-card:5:120|48:21.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:34|49:5.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:35|49:15.why: Only striving in Allah's way, common wording. Different points.

cmp-card:5:40|49:16.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:74|49:5.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:97|49:16.why: Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is in the earth, and He knows all things: the same clause, after the sacred rites and after the bedouins' claim of faith. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:5:97|49:16.relation: Allah's complete knowledge, behind His laws and behind every claim.

cmp-card:5:98|49:5.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:120|49:16.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:120|54:49.why: Only all things and a root of power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:120|55:29.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:10|57:19,5:86|57:19.why: The refrain those who disbelieve and deny Our signs are the people of Hellfire, twice in al-Maida and closing 57:19 after the truthful and the martyrs. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:5:10|57:19,5:86|57:19.relation: The same verdict, and in 57:19 set against the reward of the truthful.

cmp-card:5:40|57:2.why: Only the stock phrase of the dominion of the heavens and earth with Allah's power. It recurs too widely to make a card.

cmp-card:5:119|57:12.why: Gardens with rivers, abiding, and that is the great success, on the Day: the truthful in 5:119, the believers with their light in 57:12. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:5:119|57:12.relation: The Day's announcement of the great success.

cmp-card:5:120|57:2,5:120|57:5.why: Only the stock phrase of the dominion of the heavens and earth. It recurs too widely to make a card; 57:2 and 57:5 are better seen together on their own.

cmp-card:5:40|59:6.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:98|59:4.why: Only the stock phrase that Allah is severe in punishment. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:35|61:11.why: Only striving in Allah's way, common wording. Different points.

cmp-card:5:105|61:11.why: Only the frame of address to believers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:119|61:12.why: Gardens with rivers, and that is the great success. A memorizer pair across two surahs.
cmp-card:5:119|61:12.relation: The truthful and the strivers share the same great success.

cmp-card:5:9|64:15.why: Only a great reward. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:10|64:10,5:86|64:10.why: Those who disbelieve and deny Our signs: the people of Hellfire twice in al-Maida, the people of the Fire abiding in it in 64:10. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:5:10|64:10,5:86|64:10.relation: Denying the signs and its end.

cmp-card:5:36|64:5.why: Only disbelieved and painful punishment. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:40|64:1.why: Only heavens and earth and the stock closing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:74|64:14.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:92|64:12,5:99|64:12.why: Obey Allah and obey the Messenger, and if you turn away the Messenger's duty is only to convey: 5:92 and 64:12 nearly identical, 5:99 states the duty alone. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:5:92|64:12,5:99|64:12.relation: The Messenger only conveys; the hearers answer for their response.

cmp-card:5:119|64:9.why: Gardens with rivers, abiding forever, and that is the great success: the same long clause on two Days of gathering. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:5:119|64:9.relation: The truthful and the believers on the Day of mutual loss and gain.

cmp-card:5:120|64:1.why: Only heavens and earth and the stock closing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:40|65:12.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:39|66:1.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:74|66:1.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:98|66:1.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:5:120|67:1.why: Only dominion and the stock closing about Allah's power.

cmp-card:5:9|84:25.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:5:40|85:9,5:120|85:9.why: Only the stock phrase of the dominion of the heavens and earth. It recurs too widely to make a card.

cmp-card:5:85|85:11.why: Only gardens with rivers flowing; generic reward wording.

cmp-card:5:10|90:19,5:86|90:19.why: Those who disbelieve in Our signs: the people of Hellfire in al-Maida, the people of the left in 90:19. Same verdict.
cmp-card:5:10|90:19,5:86|90:19.relation: Rejecting the signs and its end, named two ways.

cmp-card:5:9|95:6.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:5:9|98:7.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:5:55|98:5.why: Only the common phrase of prayer and zakat. Different points.

cmp-card:5:85|98:8,5:119|98:8.why: Gardens with rivers, abiding forever, Allah pleased with them and they with Him: 5:119 and 98:8 share most of it, 5:85 the start. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:5:85|98:8,5:119|98:8.relation: Mutual good pleasure crowns the reward.

cmp-card:5:9|103:3.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:6:11|6:24.why: Only the words see how. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:23|6:161.why: Only the word idolaters. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:30|6:77.why: Only similar demonstratives with Lord. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:53|6:58.why: Allah knows best: the grateful in 6:53, the wrongdoers in 6:58. Close wording in the same passage; a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:53|6:58.relation: Allah knows who is grateful and who does wrong.

cmp-card:6:76|6:77,6:76|6:78.why: Ibrahim with the star, the moon and the sun: the same steps three times, each ending differently. A classic memorizer group and a story.
cmp-card:6:76|6:77,6:76|6:78.relation: Ibrahim's argument step by step, from what sets to the One who does not.

cmp-card:6:77|6:78.why: The moon and the sun in Ibrahim's argument: same structure, different endings. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:77|6:78.relation: Ibrahim's argument from what sets to the One who does not.

cmp-card:6:78|6:161.why: Ibrahim freeing himself from what they associate, and the way of Ibrahim who was not of the idolaters. Same surah, same theme.

cmp-card:6:101|6:102.why: Consecutive ayat: He created all things and knows all things; He is the creator of all things and guardian over all things.
cmp-card:6:101|6:102.relation: Creation, knowledge and care of all things belong to Allah.

cmp-card:6:118|6:121.why: Eat of what Allah's name was said over, and do not eat of what it was not said over. The same ruling stated both ways.
cmp-card:6:118|6:121.relation: Contrast: the permitted and the forbidden, by the mention of Allah's name.

cmp-card:6:5|7:106.why: Only came and bring. Different points.

cmp-card:6:11|7:84,6:11|7:103.why: See how was the end of: the deniers, the criminals, the corrupters. A memorizer group and a repeated lesson.
cmp-card:6:11|7:84,6:11|7:103.relation: The end of those who rejected, named by their crimes.

cmp-card:6:15|7:59.why: I fear the punishment of a tremendous Day: the Prophet for himself if he disobeyed, Nuh for his people. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:15|7:59.relation: Fear of the great Day, for oneself and for others.

cmp-card:6:21|7:177.why: Only denying the signs and wrongdoing. Different points.

cmp-card:6:24|7:84.why: Only the words see how. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:24|7:177.why: Only denied and themselves. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:27|7:72.why: Only denying the signs and believers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:27|7:149.why: Both are words of regret, but the wording differs. Too little shared.

cmp-card:6:37|7:131.why: Only the closing but most of them do not know. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:40|7:70.why: Only if you are truthful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:49|7:72.why: Only those who denied Our signs. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:49|7:136.why: Only denied Our signs. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:49|7:177.why: Only those who denied Our signs. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:54|7:153.why: Whoever does evil and then repents after it finds Allah forgiving, merciful. Same promise in two surahs.

cmp-card:6:58|7:131.why: Only with Allah and knowing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:74|7:60.why: I see you in clear error: Ibrahim says it truly to his idol-worshipping father, and Nuh's chiefs say it falsely to their prophet.
cmp-card:6:74|7:60.relation: Contrast: the same charge from a prophet and against a prophet.

cmp-card:6:101|7:185.why: Only heavens and earth and thing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:162|7:25.why: Only living and dying. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:118|8:2.why: Only mention, His signs and believers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:3|9:78.why: Allah knows their secret and what they disclose or whisper: said of all people in 6:3, of the hypocrites in 9:78.

cmp-card:6:97|9:11,6:126|9:11.why: We have detailed the signs for a people who know, or who remember: twice in al-Anam and once in at-Tawba. A memorizer group with different endings.
cmp-card:6:97|9:11,6:126|9:11.relation: The signs are detailed for those who know and reflect.

cmp-card:6:135|9:105.why: Only the command to work; a threat to the deniers versus an encouragement to the believers. The real pair for 6:135 is 11:93.

cmp-card:6:3|10:55.why: Only heavens and earth. Different points.

cmp-card:6:11|10:14.why: Only in the land and how. Different points.

cmp-card:6:13|10:67.why: Only night, day and hearing, with a shared root of rest. Different statements.

cmp-card:6:21|10:17,6:21|10:69.why: Who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allah or denies His signs: 6:21 and 10:17 differ only in the last word, wrongdoers or criminals; 10:69 says the liars will not succeed. A classic memorizer group.

cmp-card:6:21|10:95.why: Only denying Allah's signs. Different points.

cmp-card:6:22|10:28,6:24|10:30.why: Two parallel passages: the Day We gather them all and ask about their partners, and what they used to invent abandons them. A memorizer group and one scene.
cmp-card:6:22|10:28,6:24|10:30.relation: Same scene of the gathering: partners disowned, inventions gone.

cmp-card:6:33|10:65.why: Consolation to the Prophet: We know their words grieve you, and let their words not grieve you.
cmp-card:6:33|10:65.relation: Allah comforts His Messenger against the deniers' words.

cmp-card:6:33|10:95.why: Only denying Allah's signs. Different points.

cmp-card:6:45|10:10.why: Only the praise formula. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:47|10:50.why: Have you considered, if His punishment came to you suddenly or by night: the same question with different times and endings. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:47|10:50.relation: The punishment can come at any hour; why hasten it?

cmp-card:6:47|10:85.why: Only the wrongdoing people. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:49|10:95.why: Only those who deny the signs. Different points.

cmp-card:6:56|10:66.why: Only those you call on besides Allah. Different points.

cmp-card:6:79|10:105,6:161|10:105.why: Turning one's face to Allah, upright, and not being of the idolaters: Ibrahim in 6:79 and 6:161, the Prophet commanded in 10:105.
cmp-card:6:79|10:105,6:161|10:105.relation: The Prophet commanded to stand where Ibrahim stood.

cmp-card:6:87|10:25.why: Only the stock phrase to a straight path. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:95|10:31.why: He brings the living out of the dead and the dead out of the living: the same sign in two surahs, once stated, once asked.
cmp-card:6:95|10:31.relation: Life from death as a proof of Allah.

cmp-card:6:106|10:109.why: Follow what is revealed to you: with turn away from the idolaters, and with be patient until Allah judges. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:106|10:109.relation: The Prophet told to hold to revelation whatever others do.

cmp-card:6:129|10:52.why: Only for what they used to earn. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:162|10:10.why: Only to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:15|11:26.why: I fear the punishment of a Day, tremendous or painful: the Prophet for himself, Nuh for his people.
cmp-card:6:15|11:26.relation: Fear of the Day, for oneself and for others.

cmp-card:6:17|11:4.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:21|11:18,6:24|11:21.why: Who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allah, and what they invented abandons them. The two passages run in parallel.
cmp-card:6:21|11:18,6:24|11:21.relation: Lies against Allah and how they vanish on the Day.

cmp-card:6:40|11:13.why: Only calling besides Allah and if you are truthful. Different points.

cmp-card:6:78|11:54.why: I am free of what you associate: Ibrahim to his people, and Hud to his. Same declaration.
cmp-card:6:78|11:54.relation: Prophets disown their people's idols in the same words.

cmp-card:6:131|11:102,6:131|11:117.why: Your Lord and the destruction of towns: not unjustly while their people are heedless or righteous, and His seizing when they do wrong. 6:131 and 11:117 are close.
cmp-card:6:131|11:102,6:131|11:117.relation: Allah destroys towns only for their own wrong.

cmp-card:6:132|11:111.why: Each will receive the reward of their deeds, and your Lord is aware of what they do.
cmp-card:6:132|11:111.relation: Every deed is repaid, by a Lord who knows them all.

cmp-card:6:135|11:93.why: My people, work according to your position, I am working, you will come to know: nearly identical, then different endings. A classic memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:135|11:93.relation: The prophet's final challenge: let time show who is right.

cmp-card:6:40|12:107,6:47|12:107.why: Allah's punishment or the Hour coming upon them, suddenly. Same warning in close wording.
cmp-card:6:40|12:107,6:47|12:107.relation: The punishment or the Hour may come without warning.

cmp-card:6:53|12:90.why: Only Allah has favoured; the deniers mocking the poor believers versus Yusuf thanking Allah. A neat contrast, but one short phrase.

cmp-card:6:56|12:108.why: The Prophet declares his way against idolatry, each ending with and I am not of those who are guided or who associate. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:56|12:108.relation: The Prophet's stance: his own way, free of shirk.

cmp-card:6:74|12:8.why: Only the common phrase in clear error, about a father; a true charge by Ibrahim versus a false one by Yusuf's brothers. The phrase is too common.

cmp-card:6:74|12:78.why: Only father and we see you. Different scenes.

cmp-card:6:10|13:32.why: Messengers before you were mocked: the same opening, then two endings, what they mocked surrounded them, or Allah gave them time then seized them.
cmp-card:6:10|13:32.relation: Mockery of messengers always ends in its own punishment.

cmp-card:6:32|13:34.why: Only this world and the Hereafter. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:37|13:7,6:37|13:27.why: They ask why a sign was not sent down to him from his Lord, three times with three answers. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:6:37|13:7,6:37|13:27.relation: The demand for a miracle, answered three ways.

cmp-card:6:56|13:27.why: Only a verb of saying and guidance. Different points.

cmp-card:6:62|13:41.why: His is the judgment and He is swift in reckoning: in close wording in both.
cmp-card:6:62|13:41.relation: Allah's judgment cannot be overturned and comes quickly.

cmp-card:6:149|13:27.why: Only guidance by Allah's will, in different wording. Thin link.

cmp-card:6:1|14:2.why: Only heavens and earth and disbelievers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:1|14:19.why: Only the stock phrase that Allah created the heavens and earth. Different points.

cmp-card:6:45|14:39.why: Only the praise to Allah. Different scenes.

cmp-card:6:62|14:51.why: Only Allah's swiftness in reckoning, a common closing. Different points.

cmp-card:6:4|15:81.why: Signs came to them and they turned away from them: the same ending, said of the Makkans and of the people of al-Hijr.
cmp-card:6:4|15:81.relation: Turning away from signs is the habit of every denying people.

cmp-card:6:5|15:11.why: What they used to mock: the truth in 6:5, every messenger in 15:11. The same closing on mockery.
cmp-card:6:5|15:11.relation: Mockery of the truth and of messengers.

cmp-card:6:8|15:8.why: Sending down angels: if they were sent the matter would be settled and they would get no respite. Same reply to the same demand.
cmp-card:6:8|15:8.relation: Demanding angels means demanding final judgment.

cmp-card:6:3|16:19,6:3|16:23.why: Allah knows what you hide and what you show, three times; 16:19 and 16:23 differ only in you and they. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:6:3|16:19,6:3|16:23.relation: Allah's knowledge of the hidden and the open.

cmp-card:6:10|16:34,6:11|16:36.why: Two consecutive steps in both surahs: what they mocked surrounded them, then travel in the land and see the end of the deniers. Parallel passages.
cmp-card:6:10|16:34,6:11|16:36.relation: Mockery brings its own punishment; the ruins teach the lesson.

cmp-card:6:21|16:105.why: Inventing lies and denying Allah's signs: none is more unjust, and only those who disbelieve invent lies.
cmp-card:6:21|16:105.relation: Lying about Allah goes with rejecting His signs.

cmp-card:6:24|16:87.why: What they used to invent abandons them, the same closing on the Day. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:24|16:87.relation: False gods vanish when they are needed.

cmp-card:6:37|16:101.why: Only signs and the closing most of them do not know. Different points.

cmp-card:6:54|16:119.why: Whoever does evil in ignorance, then repents after it and reforms: Allah is forgiving, merciful. Same sequence in both.
cmp-card:6:54|16:119.relation: Repentance after sin committed in ignorance is accepted.

cmp-card:6:79|16:3.why: Only heavens and earth and associating. Different points.

cmp-card:6:87|16:121.why: Chosen and guided to a straight path: the prophets and their families in 6:87, Ibrahim in 16:121. Same two verbs.
cmp-card:6:87|16:121.relation: Allah chooses and then guides His prophets.

cmp-card:6:88|16:93.why: Only He guides whom He wills, a stock phrase. Different points.

cmp-card:6:109|16:38.why: They swore by Allah their strongest oaths: that they would believe if a sign came, and that Allah would not raise the dead. Both oaths were false.
cmp-card:6:109|16:38.relation: The deniers' solemn oaths, both answered.

cmp-card:6:117|16:125.why: Your Lord knows best who strays from His way and who is guided: nearly the same sentence, closing a ruling and the call to wise preaching. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:117|16:125.relation: Guidance is Allah's to judge; the caller only calls.

cmp-card:6:118|16:79.why: Only Allah, signs and believing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:161|16:123.why: The way of Ibrahim, upright, and he was not of the idolaters: the same clause in both. A memorizer pair.

cmp-card:6:1|17:99.why: Only the stock phrase of the One who created the heavens and earth, and the disbelievers' denial. Different points.

cmp-card:6:20|17:2.why: Only giving the Book. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:24|17:48.why: See how they...: lied against themselves, struck examples for you, and in both their error follows.
cmp-card:6:24|17:48.relation: The deniers' words lead them astray.

cmp-card:6:25|17:46.why: We placed coverings on their hearts lest they understand it, and deafness in their ears: the same clause, then different scenes. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:25|17:46.relation: The sealed hearts of those who reject the Quran.

cmp-card:6:48|17:105.why: Sent only as a bringer of good news and a warner: all messengers in 6:48, the Prophet in 17:105.
cmp-card:6:48|17:105.relation: The mission of every messenger, and of the Prophet.

cmp-card:6:63|17:67.why: In danger at sea people call on Allah alone, then when saved they turn ungrateful. Same scene.
cmp-card:6:63|17:67.relation: Sincere in danger, ungrateful in safety.

cmp-card:6:117|17:84.why: Your Lord knows best who is guided. Same idea in close words.
cmp-card:6:117|17:84.relation: Allah alone knows who is truly guided.

cmp-card:6:132|17:84.why: Only deeds and your Lord. Different points.

cmp-card:6:21|18:15.why: Who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allah: closing the youths of the cave's argument against their people.
cmp-card:6:21|18:15.relation: The cave youths use the Quran's own verdict on idolatry.

cmp-card:6:22|18:52.why: Where are the partners you claimed: the same summons on the Day, and in 18:52 they call them and get no answer.
cmp-card:6:22|18:52.relation: The false partners fail their worshippers on the Day.

cmp-card:6:149|18:60.why: Only a root of reaching. Different scenes.

cmp-card:6:11|19:29.why: Only the word how. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:127|19:47.why: Only the root of peace. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:4|20:133.why: Signs from their Lord: every sign that came they turned from, yet they demand a sign. Read together, the demand is exposed.
cmp-card:6:4|20:133.relation: Contrast: turning from every sign while asking for one.

cmp-card:6:21|20:61.why: Inventing a lie against Allah: the Quran's verdict, and Musa's warning to the magicians that whoever invents fails.

cmp-card:6:149|20:50.why: Only a root of guidance. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:3|21:4,6:3|21:110.why: Allah knows the secret and the open, the speech in heaven and earth, and what is spoken and hidden.
cmp-card:6:3|21:4,6:3|21:110.relation: Nothing said or hidden escapes Allah.

cmp-card:6:49|21:46.why: Only punishment touching them. Different scenes.

cmp-card:6:56|21:66.why: Worshipping besides Allah: the Prophet forbidden to do it, and Ibrahim asking his people how they worship what neither benefits nor harms.
cmp-card:6:56|21:66.relation: The prophets reject worship of anything besides Allah.

cmp-card:6:74|21:54.why: Ibrahim tells his father and people they are in clear error. Same story.
cmp-card:6:74|21:54.relation: Ibrahim's charge against his people's idols.

cmp-card:6:101|21:30.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:17|22:6.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:49|22:57.why: Only those who deny Our signs and punishment, stock wording.

cmp-card:6:15|23:86.why: Only the word great. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:21|23:38.why: Only the phrase inventing a lie against Allah; in 23:38 it is the deniers' accusation of their messenger. Different use.

cmp-card:6:45|23:28,6:64|23:28.why: Praise to Allah for removing or saving from the wrongdoing people: 6:45 after their destruction, 23:28 Nuh told to say it on the Ark. 6:64 adds Allah who saves from every distress.
cmp-card:6:45|23:28,6:64|23:28.relation: Deliverance from oppressors calls for praise.

cmp-card:6:45|23:94.why: Only the wrongdoing people. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:47|23:28.why: Only the wrongdoing people. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:77|23:106.why: Among the people who are astray: Ibrahim fears it unless his Lord guides him, and the people of the Fire confess it.
cmp-card:6:77|23:106.relation: Contrast: one who asks for guidance against those who admit too late.

cmp-card:6:3|24:41.why: Only heavens and earth and knowledge. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:39|24:46,6:87|24:46.why: Only the stock phrase of guidance to a straight path by Allah's will. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:75|24:42.why: Only dominion in two different words with heavens and earth. Different points.

cmp-card:6:101|24:64.why: Only the stock closing Allah knows all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:109|24:53.why: They swore by Allah their strongest oaths, if...: to believe if a sign came, to go out if commanded. Both oaths were empty. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:109|24:53.relation: Heavy oaths that hide no real intent.

cmp-card:6:24|25:9.why: See how they...: lied against themselves, struck examples for you, and in both they go astray.
cmp-card:6:24|25:9.relation: The deniers' words lead them astray.

cmp-card:6:33|25:36.why: Only denying the signs, common wording. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:48|25:56.why: Sent only as a bringer of good news and a warner: all messengers in 6:48, the Prophet in 25:56.
cmp-card:6:48|25:56.relation: The mission of every messenger, and of the Prophet.

cmp-card:6:56|25:17.why: Only what is worshipped besides Allah and straying. Different scenes.

cmp-card:6:4|26:5,6:5|26:6.why: Two consecutive ayat in both surahs: whatever sign or reminder comes to them they turn from, so they have denied and the news of what they mocked will come. Nearly word for word. A strong memorizer group.
cmp-card:6:4|26:5,6:5|26:6.relation: Turning away, denial, and the coming news of what was mocked.

cmp-card:6:15|26:135,6:15|26:156.why: The punishment of a tremendous Day: feared by the Prophet for himself, by Hud for his people, and threatened by Salih. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:6:15|26:135,6:15|26:156.relation: The great Day held before every people.

cmp-card:6:27|26:139.why: Only deny and believers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:75|26:24.why: The heavens and earth and certainty: Ibrahim shown their dominion to be among the certain, Musa telling Pharaoh their Lord is Allah if you would be certain.
cmp-card:6:75|26:24.relation: Creation as the road to certainty, for Ibrahim and for Pharaoh.

cmp-card:6:3|27:25.why: Allah in the heavens and earth knows what you hide and what you show; the hoopoe says the same of the One who brings out the hidden.
cmp-card:6:3|27:25.relation: Allah's knowledge of the hidden, praised even by the hoopoe.

cmp-card:6:11|27:14,6:11|27:51,6:11|27:6.why: See how was the end of: the deniers, the corrupters, their plot, the criminals. 6:11 and 27:69 open the same way. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:6:11|27:14,6:11|27:51,6:11|27:6.relation: The end of those who rejected, named by their crimes.

cmp-card:6:11|27:27.why: Only a verb of looking and liars. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:11|27:41.why: Only a verb of looking. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:24|27:14.why: Only the words see how. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:24|27:51.why: Only the words see how. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:24|27:69.why: Only the words see how. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:27|27:84.why: Only denying My signs. Different scenes.

cmp-card:6:33|27:84.why: Only deny and signs. Different scenes.

cmp-card:6:40|27:64.why: Only if you are truthful. Different points.

cmp-card:6:49|27:84.why: Only denying Our signs. Different scenes.

cmp-card:6:105|27:52.why: Only signs for a people who know. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:21|29:68.why: Who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allah or denies: His signs in 6:21, the truth when it came in 29:68. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:21|29:68.relation: Lying against Allah and denying the truth, the worst wrong.

cmp-card:6:32|29:64.why: The life of this world is only play and amusement, and the Hereafter is better or is the true life. The two words swap order. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:32|29:64.relation: The worldly life set against the real life of the Hereafter.

cmp-card:6:37|29:50,6:109|29:50.why: The demand for signs and the answer that signs are only with Allah: 6:37 and 29:50 share the demand, 6:109 and 29:50 share the answer.
cmp-card:6:37|29:50,6:109|29:50.relation: Signs belong to Allah, not to the demands of deniers.

cmp-card:6:40|29:29.why: Only Allah's punishment and if you are truthful. Different points.

cmp-card:6:105|29:35.why: Only signs and clear. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:105|29:49.why: Only signs and clear. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:49|30:16.why: Only denying Our signs and punishment, stock wording.

cmp-card:6:72|30:31.why: Establish prayer and fear Him, in swapped order. A memorizer pair.

cmp-card:6:95|30:19.why: He brings the living out of the dead and the dead out of the living, then a proof of resurrection or of Allah. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:95|30:19.relation: Life from death as a sign of the resurrection.

cmp-card:6:1|31:25.why: Praise to Allah who created the heavens and earth, and the deniers' inconsistency: they set equals to Him, or admit He created yet do not know.
cmp-card:6:1|31:25.relation: Creation calls for praise; the deniers admit it yet still associate.

cmp-card:6:3|31:25.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:37|31:25.why: Only the closing most of them do not know. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:74|31:11.why: Only the common phrase in clear error. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:126|32:25.why: Only your Lord and a root of detailing. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:162|32:11.why: Only say and Lord. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:17|33:27.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:48|33:45.why: Sent as a bringer of good news and a warner: all messengers in 6:48, the Prophet as witness too in 33:45.
cmp-card:6:48|33:45.relation: The mission of every messenger, and of the Prophet.

cmp-card:6:81|33:73.why: Only the root of shirk. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:101|33:40.why: Only the closing Allah knows all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:106|33:2.why: Follow what is revealed to you from your Lord, then different endings. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:106|33:2.relation: The Prophet's rule: follow the revelation.

cmp-card:6:117|33:67.why: Only way and straying. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:1|34:1.why: Two surah openings: praise to Allah who created the heavens and earth, praise to Allah to whom belongs all in them. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:1|34:1.relation: Praise for creation and for ownership of all.

cmp-card:6:22|34:40.why: The Day He gathers them all, then says: to the idolaters, where are your partners; to the angels, did these worship you. Same opening, a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:22|34:40.relation: On the Day the worshipped are questioned about their worshippers.

cmp-card:6:30|34:31.why: If you could see when they are made to stand before their Lord: the same scene opening, with two different exchanges.
cmp-card:6:30|34:31.relation: The deniers standing before their Lord.

cmp-card:6:37|34:36.why: Only the closing most do not know. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:48|34:28.why: Sent as a bringer of good news and a warner: all messengers, and the Prophet to all mankind.
cmp-card:6:48|34:28.relation: The mission of every messenger, made universal in the Prophet.

cmp-card:6:74|34:24.why: Only the common phrase in clear error. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:90|34:47.why: I ask you no reward for it: the Prophet's disclaimer in two forms, the reward is only from Allah.

cmp-card:6:3|35:38.why: Allah knows what is hidden in the heavens and earth and in the chests.

cmp-card:6:45|35:34.why: Only the praise to Allah. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:109|35:42.why: They swore by Allah their strongest oaths that if a sign, or a warner, came they would believe or be better guided; when it came it only increased their aversion.
cmp-card:6:109|35:42.relation: Oaths of the deniers broken when tested.

cmp-card:6:33|36:76.why: Let their words not grieve you; We know. Consolation to the Prophet in close words.
cmp-card:6:33|36:76.relation: Allah comforts His Messenger: He knows what they say.

cmp-card:6:96|36:38.why: That is the decree of the Mighty, the Knowing: after the sun and moon in both. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:96|36:38.relation: The ordered course of sun and moon as Allah's decree.

cmp-card:6:162|36:79.why: Only say and a root of life. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:11|37:73.why: See how was the end: of the deniers, of those warned. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:11|37:73.relation: The end of those who rejected warning.

cmp-card:6:45|37:182.why: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds, closing an account of the struggle between messengers and deniers: after the wrongdoers are cut off, and after peace on the messengers.
cmp-card:6:45|37:182.relation: Praise as the last word after the outcome of the struggle.

cmp-card:6:87|37:118.why: We guided them to the straight path: the prophets in 6:87, Musa and Harun in 37:118.

cmp-card:6:1|38:27.why: Only creation of heavens and earth and disbelievers. Different points.

cmp-card:6:75|38:10.why: Only dominion of heavens and earth, in two different words.

cmp-card:6:155|38:29.why: A blessed Book We sent down: to follow and fear in 6:155, to ponder and remember in 38:29. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:155|38:29.relation: The blessed Book, to be followed and pondered.

cmp-card:6:10|39:48.why: What they used to mock surrounded them: the same closing. A memorizer pair.

cmp-card:6:14|39:46.why: Say, addressed to the Originator of the heavens and earth: refusing any other protector, and calling on Him to judge.
cmp-card:6:14|39:46.relation: The Originator of creation is the only protector and judge.

cmp-card:6:56|39:36.why: Only besides and straying. Different points.

cmp-card:6:75|39:44.why: Only dominion of heavens and earth, in two different words.

cmp-card:6:101|39:62,6:102|39:62.why: Creator of all things and guardian over all things: 6:102 and 39:62 share the whole clause. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:6:101|39:62,6:102|39:62.relation: Allah creates all and takes charge of all.

cmp-card:6:10|40:83.why: What they used to mock surrounded them, after messengers were mocked or their clear proofs dismissed. A memorizer pair.

cmp-card:6:11|40:82.why: Travel in the land and see how was the end of those before. Same command.

cmp-card:6:15|40:30.why: I fear a Day: the Prophet fears the punishment of a great Day if he disobeys, and the believer of Pharaoh's family fears for his people a day like the confederates'.
cmp-card:6:15|40:30.relation: Fear of the Day, for oneself and for one's people.

cmp-card:6:23|40:84.why: The idolaters disown their shirk when they face the truth: we were not idolaters, and we disbelieve in what we associated. Too late in both.
cmp-card:6:23|40:84.relation: Denial of shirk only when it no longer helps.

cmp-card:6:56|40:74.why: Only besides Allah and straying. Different points.

cmp-card:6:162|40:65.why: Only to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Different points.

cmp-card:6:1|41:9.why: The One who created the heavens and earth, yet the disbelievers set equals to their Lord. Same charge in both.
cmp-card:6:1|41:9.relation: Creation should end idolatry, yet the deniers set up rivals.

cmp-card:6:97|41:3,6:126|41:3.why: Signs detailed for a people who know or remember: the same verb of detailing and similar endings. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:6:97|41:3,6:126|41:3.relation: The signs are set out clearly for those who know.

cmp-card:6:105|41:3.why: Only for a people who know, with different verbs. Different statements.

cmp-card:6:17|42:9.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:101|42:12.why: Only the closing Allah knows all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:3|43:9.why: Only heavens and earth and a divine name. Different points.

cmp-card:6:3|43:84.why: He is God in the heavens and on the earth: the same rare idea in both.

cmp-card:6:5|43:7.why: What they used to mock: the truth in 6:5, every prophet in 43:7. Same closing.

cmp-card:6:11|43:25.why: See how was the end of the deniers, the same ending. A memorizer pair.

cmp-card:6:32|43:35.why: The worldly life is play or mere enjoyment, and the Hereafter is better for the God-fearing.
cmp-card:6:32|43:35.relation: This world's goods against the Hereafter of the God-fearing.

cmp-card:6:75|44:7.why: The heavens and earth and certainty: Ibrahim shown their dominion to be certain, and their Lord named if you would be certain.
cmp-card:6:75|44:7.relation: Creation as the road to certainty.

cmp-card:6:75|44:29.why: Only heavens and earth. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:162|44:8.why: Only Lord and life and death wording. Different statements.

cmp-card:6:1|45:22.why: Only creation of heavens and earth. Different points.

cmp-card:6:1|45:36.why: Only praise with heavens and earth. Different points.

cmp-card:6:3|45:22.why: Only heavens and earth and earning. Different points.

cmp-card:6:3|45:36.why: Only heavens and earth. Different points.

cmp-card:6:10|45:33.why: What they used to mock surrounded them: the same closing. A memorizer pair.

cmp-card:6:12|45:26,6:16|45:30.why: Parallel passages: He will gather you to the Day of Resurrection with no doubt in it, and then His mercy as the clear triumph. 6:16 and 45:30 share the rare ending the clear triumph.
cmp-card:6:12|45:26,6:16|45:30.relation: The certain gathering, and mercy on that Day as the clear triumph.

cmp-card:6:12|45:27.why: Only heavens and earth and the Day. Different points.

cmp-card:6:37|45:26.why: Only the closing most do not know. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:45|45:36.why: Only praise and Lord of the worlds. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:89|45:16.why: We gave them the Book, judgment and prophethood: the prophets in 6:89, the Children of Israel in 45:16. Rare shared triad.
cmp-card:6:89|45:16.relation: The gifts of revelation, given to prophets and to a nation.

cmp-card:6:118|45:3.why: Only signs and believers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:162|45:24.why: Only living and dying; a striking contrast between life for Allah and life for this world alone, but the shared words are common.

cmp-card:6:1|46:3.why: Only creation of the heavens and earth and the disbelievers. Different points.

cmp-card:6:7|46:7.why: The disbelievers say this is nothing but clear magic: of a Book on parchment they could touch, and of the recited signs.
cmp-card:6:7|46:7.relation: Whatever proof came, the deniers called it magic.

cmp-card:6:40|46:4,6:40|46:22.why: Have you considered what you call on besides Allah, if you are truthful: 6:40 and 46:4 share the challenge; 46:22 adds the people of Hud daring the punishment.
cmp-card:6:40|46:4,6:40|46:22.relation: The challenge to the idolaters to prove their gods.

cmp-card:6:101|46:33.why: Only creation of heavens and earth and a closing name. Different points.

cmp-card:6:11|47:10.why: Travel in the land and see how was the end of those before. Same command.

cmp-card:6:32|47:36.why: The life of this world is only play and amusement, then the Hereafter or reward for the God-fearing. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:32|47:36.relation: The worldly life set against taqwa and its reward.

cmp-card:6:17|48:21.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:48|48:8.why: Sent as bringer of good news and warner: all messengers, and the Prophet as witness too.
cmp-card:6:48|48:8.relation: The mission of every messenger, and of the Prophet.

cmp-card:6:75|48:7.why: Only heavens and earth. Different statements.

cmp-card:6:101|49:16.why: Only the closing Allah knows all things. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:75|52:36.why: The heavens and earth and certainty: Ibrahim shown them to be among the certain, and the deniers who have no certainty though they did not create them.
cmp-card:6:75|52:36.relation: Contrast: certainty given to Ibrahim, lacking in the deniers.

cmp-card:6:117|53:30.why: Your Lord knows best who strays from His way and who is guided: nearly the same sentence. A memorizer pair.

cmp-card:6:66|54:9.why: Only people and denied. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:13|57:6.why: Only night, day and a closing name. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:75|57:2.why: Only dominion of heavens and earth in two different words.

cmp-card:6:75|57:5.why: Only dominion of heavens and earth in two different words.

cmp-card:6:1|59:24.why: Only creation and heavens and earth. Different points.

cmp-card:6:21|61:7.why: Who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allah: in 61:7, while being invited to Islam. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:21|61:7.relation: Lying against Allah, the worst wrong.

cmp-card:6:1|64:1.why: Only praise and heavens and earth. Different statements.

cmp-card:6:3|64:4.why: Allah knows what is in the heavens and earth, what you hide and what you show.

cmp-card:6:17|64:1.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:101|65:12.why: Only creation, all things and knowledge. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:3|67:13.why: Your secret and your open speech are known to Him.
cmp-card:6:3|67:13.relation: Allah knows the hidden and the spoken.

cmp-card:6:47|67:28.why: Only the opening have you considered and punishment. Different points.

cmp-card:6:23|72:20.why: Only our Lord and shirk. Different subjects.

cmp-card:6:15|76:10.why: Fear of a terrible Day from the Lord: the Prophet's fear if he disobeys, and the righteous who fear a grim Day.
cmp-card:6:15|76:10.relation: Fear of the Day drives obedience.

cmp-card:6:75|85:9.why: Only dominion of heavens and earth in two different words.

cmp-card:6:3|87:7.why: Allah knows the open and the hidden.
cmp-card:6:3|87:7.relation: Allah's knowledge of what is shown and what is hidden.

cmp-card:6:8|97:4.why: Only angels sent down. Different subjects.

cmp-card:7:9|7:177,7:72|7:177,7:136|7:17.why: Those who denied Our signs, four times in al-Araf, and twice with wronging themselves. A memorizer group in one surah.
cmp-card:7:9|7:177,7:72|7:177,7:136|7:17.relation: Denying the signs is a wrong against oneself.

cmp-card:7:23|7:149,7:23|7:151.why: Pleas for forgiveness and mercy: Adam and Hawwa, the calf worshippers, and Musa for himself and his brother. 7:23 and 7:149 end the same.
cmp-card:7:23|7:149,7:23|7:151.relation: Every sinner's plea: forgive and have mercy, or we are lost.

cmp-card:7:44|7:50.why: The people of Paradise and of the Fire call to each other, in each direction. Same scene.
cmp-card:7:44|7:50.relation: Two calls across the divide of the Hereafter.

cmp-card:7:46|7:48.why: The people of the Heights who know each by their marks, calling to both sides. Same scene.
cmp-card:7:46|7:48.relation: The Heights between Paradise and Fire.

cmp-card:7:59|7:65,7:60|7:66,7:61|7:67,7.why: Nuh and Hud told step by step in the same words: the call, the chiefs' charge, the denial of the charge, the message, and the end. A classic memorizer group.
cmp-card:7:59|7:65,7:60|7:66,7:61|7:67,7.relation: Every prophet's story follows the same pattern.

cmp-card:7:60|7:90,7:61|7:93,7:62|7:93.why: The chiefs, the prophet's reply, and conveying my Lord's messages and advising: Nuh and Shuayb in parallel. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:7:60|7:90,7:61|7:93,7:62|7:93.relation: Same pattern of call and rejection.

cmp-card:7:60|7:109,7:66|7:109,7:90|7:10.why: The chiefs of his people said: to Nuh, Hud, Shuayb and Musa. A memorizer group.

cmp-card:7:61|7:79,7:62|7:79.why: Conveying my Lord's message and advising: Nuh and Salih. A memorizer group.

cmp-card:7:61|7:104.why: I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds: Nuh to his people, Musa to Pharaoh.

cmp-card:7:66|7:67.why: Consecutive: the chiefs charge Hud with foolishness, and he denies it in their own word. Charge and reply.
cmp-card:7:66|7:67.relation: The prophet answers the charge with the same word.

cmp-card:7:66|7:90,7:67|7:93.why: The disbelieving chiefs of his people, and the prophet's reply to his people: Hud and Shuayb in parallel. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:7:66|7:90,7:67|7:93.relation: Same pattern of call and rejection.

cmp-card:7:67|7:79,7:68|7:79.why: Conveying my Lord's message and advising: Hud and Salih in parallel. A memorizer group.

cmp-card:7:67|7:104,7:70|7:106.why: Parallel moments in the stories of Hud and Musa: I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds, and the reply bring it if you are truthful.
cmp-card:7:67|7:104,7:70|7:106.relation: The same claim met with the same demand.

cmp-card:7:72|7:136.why: Destroyed because they denied Our signs: Hud's people and Pharaoh's people, with different closings. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:7:72|7:136.relation: Denial of the signs and its end.

cmp-card:7:73|7:85,7:75|7:88.why: Salih and Shuayb: the same call, a clear proof has come from your Lord, and the arrogant chiefs of his people. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:7:73|7:85,7:75|7:88.relation: Same pattern of call and arrogant rejection.

cmp-card:7:78|7:91.why: The same refrain word for word: the earthquake seized them and they lay fallen in their homes. Thamud and Madyan.

cmp-card:7:84|7:103.why: See how was the end of the criminals, of the corrupters. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:7:84|7:103.relation: The end of those who rejected.

cmp-card:7:118|7:139.why: What they used to do became void: the magicians' work, and the idol worship the Israelites wanted.

cmp-card:7:178|7:186.why: Whom Allah guides and whom He leaves astray, in the same surah.
cmp-card:7:178|7:186.relation: Contrast: guidance and its loss are in Allah's hand.

cmp-card:7:153|9:27,7:153|9:102.why: After sins, Allah turns to those who repent, closing on Forgiving, Merciful.

cmp-card:7:190|9:75.why: A promise to be righteous if Allah gives, broken once He gives: the couple given a child, and the hypocrite given wealth.
cmp-card:7:190|9:75.relation: Promises made in need and broken in plenty.

cmp-card:7:34|10:49,7:188|10:49.why: 10:49 joins two al-Araf sentences: I have no power to benefit or harm myself except as Allah wills, and every nation has a term it cannot delay or advance. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:7:34|10:49,7:188|10:49.relation: Neither the Prophet nor any nation controls benefit, harm or its term.

cmp-card:7:47|10:85.why: Our Lord, do not make us...the wrongdoing people: with them, or a trial for them. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:7:47|10:85.relation: The believers' prayer against being joined to the wrongdoers.

cmp-card:7:49|10:62.why: Only the common phrase no fear upon them nor shall they grieve. Too common to make a card.

cmp-card:7:52|10:57.why: The revelation as guidance and mercy for believers. Same description.
cmp-card:7:52|10:57.relation: The Book is guidance and mercy.

cmp-card:7:71|10:20.why: So wait, I am waiting with you: Hud to his people, and the Prophet to the deniers. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:7:71|10:20.relation: The prophets leave the outcome to Allah.

cmp-card:7:72|10:95.why: Only those who denied the signs. Different points.

cmp-card:7:92|10:95.why: Only those who denied and the losers. Different points.

cmp-card:7:101|10:13,7:101|10:74.why: Their messengers came with clear proofs but they would not believe; thus Allah seals or repays. 7:101 and 10:74 share most words. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:7:101|10:13,7:101|10:74.relation: Clear proofs do not move those who denied before.

cmp-card:7:103|10:73,7:103|10:75.why: Then after them We sent Musa to Pharaoh and his chiefs with Our signs, and see how was the end. 7:103 and 10:75 share the opening.
cmp-card:7:103|10:73,7:103|10:75.relation: The Musa story in parallel tellings.

cmp-card:7:105|10:108.why: Only has come to you from your Lord. Different subjects.

cmp-card:7:109|10:79,7:132|10:79.why: Pharaoh's court and the magicians: a learned magician, and every sign called magic. Same story.
cmp-card:7:109|10:79,7:132|10:79.relation: Pharaoh's people answer every sign with magic.

cmp-card:7:112|10:79,7:113|10:80,7:116|1.why: The contest with the magicians step by step in two tellings: bring every learned magician, the magicians came, throw, they threw. A strong memorizer group.

cmp-card:7:136|10:95.why: Only denied Our signs. Different points.

cmp-card:7:177|10:95.why: Only those who denied the signs. Different points.

cmp-card:7:194|10:38.why: Call on those besides Allah, if you are truthful: to answer you, and to help you produce a surah. Both challenge false gods.
cmp-card:7:194|10:38.relation: The challenge to the idols' worshippers.

cmp-card:7:23|12:92.why: Only forgiveness and mercy. Different scenes.

cmp-card:7:60|12:8.why: A prophet charged with clear error by those around him: Nuh by his chiefs, Yaqub by his own sons.
cmp-card:7:60|12:8.relation: Prophets are accused of error by those who cannot see.

cmp-card:7:151|12:64.why: Only the closing Most Merciful of the merciful. Different scenes.

cmp-card:7:151|12:92.why: Forgiveness for a brother and the Most Merciful of the merciful: Musa asks it for himself and his brother, Yusuf grants it to his brothers.
cmp-card:7:151|12:92.relation: Two prophets and their brothers, both turning to Allah's mercy.

cmp-card:7:151|12:98.why: Only forgiveness and mercy. Different scenes.

cmp-card:7:153|12:53.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:7:2|13:1.why: Only the Book sent down to you. Different points.

cmp-card:7:3|13:19.why: Only what was sent down from your Lord. Different points.

cmp-card:7:45|14:3.why: Those who turn others from Allah's way and seek to make it crooked: the same clause, then the Hereafter or far error. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:7:45|14:3.relation: Blocking Allah's way and twisting it.

cmp-card:7:141|14:6.why: Saved from Pharaoh's people who inflicted the worst torment, killing or slaughtering sons and sparing women. One word differs. A classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:7:151|14:36.why: Only forgiveness and mercy. Different prayers.

cmp-card:7:185|14:19.why: Only creation of heavens and earth. Different statements.

cmp-card:7:11|15:32,7:14|15:36.why: Iblis and the prostration, and his request for respite until the Day they are raised. Same story in two surahs.

cmp-card:7:16|15:41.why: The straight path in the Iblis story: he vows to sit on it, and Allah says this is a path to Me.
cmp-card:7:16|15:41.relation: Iblis threatens the path; Allah guards it.

cmp-card:7:34|15:5.why: Every nation has a term it cannot advance or delay.

cmp-card:7:106|15:7.why: Demanding a sign: bring it if you are truthful. Pharaoh to Musa, the Makkans to the Prophet.

cmp-card:7:109|15:15.why: Only the root of magic in different words. Thin link.

cmp-card:7:52|16:64.why: The Book as guidance and mercy for a people who believe. A memorizer pair.

cmp-card:7:131|16:101.why: Only most do not know. Different subjects.

cmp-card:7:153|16:110,7:153|16:119.why: Your Lord after that is forgiving, merciful, after repentance or after striving and patience: the same ending three times. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:7:153|16:110,7:153|16:119.relation: Allah's forgiveness after repentance and after trials.

cmp-card:7:167|16:119.why: Only the closing your Lord is forgiving, merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:7:177|16:118.why: They wronged only themselves: the deniers of the signs and the Jews denied good things. The same words in swapped order. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:7:177|16:118.relation: Allah wrongs no one; people wrong themselves.

cmp-card:7:178|16:37.why: Whom Allah leaves astray: the guided and the lost in 7:178, and Allah does not guide whom He leaves astray in 16:37.

cmp-card:7:185|16:73.why: Only heavens and earth. Different statements.

cmp-card:7:190|16:1.why: Only the stock closing exalted above what they associate. Different subjects.

cmp-card:7:200|16:98.why: Seek refuge in Allah from Satan: when he provokes you, and before reciting the Quran.
cmp-card:7:200|16:98.relation: Refuge from Satan in anger and in worship.

cmp-card:7:11|17:61,7:12|17:61.why: The angels prostrate to Adam except Iblis, and Iblis's refusal because of clay. Same story in two surahs.
cmp-card:7:11|17:61,7:12|17:61.relation: Iblis's pride against the one made of clay.

cmp-card:7:118|17:81.why: Truth prevailed and falsehood came to nothing: at the magicians' contest, and as a general law.

cmp-card:7:149|17:100.why: Only mercy of the Lord. Different scenes.

cmp-card:7:185|17:99.why: Do they not look at the heavens and earth, and at their own term: the creation of the heavens and earth and a term set for the deniers in both.
cmp-card:7:185|17:99.relation: Creation and the appointed term as a warning.

cmp-card:7:42|18:107.why: Only the generic formula of those who believe and do good. Stock phrase.

cmp-card:7:147|18:105.why: Those who denied the signs and the meeting of the Hereafter: their deeds are void. Same verdict.
cmp-card:7:147|18:105.relation: Denial of the meeting with Allah voids all deeds.

cmp-card:7:196|18:1.why: Only the One who sent down the Book, common wording. Different points.

cmp-card:7:25|19:66.why: Therein you die and from it you are brought out, and man asks whether he will be brought out alive after death.
cmp-card:7:25|19:66.relation: Allah's word on resurrection against man's doubt.

cmp-card:7:42|19:60.why: Only faith with good deeds and entering Paradise. Generic.

cmp-card:7:52|19:43.why: Only knowledge and guidance. Different scenes.

cmp-card:7:194|19:48.why: Only what you call on besides Allah, a common phrase. Different points.

cmp-card:7:11|20:116.why: The angels prostrated to Adam except Iblis: same scene.

cmp-card:7:20|20:120,7:22|20:121,7:24|20.why: Adam and the tree told in parallel: Satan whispered, their nakedness showed and they covered themselves with leaves, and go down as enemies to one another. A strong memorizer group.
cmp-card:7:20|20:120,7:22|20:121,7:24|20.relation: The same story of the first sin in two tellings.

cmp-card:7:60|20:92.why: Only words of error. Different scenes.

cmp-card:7:61|20:52.why: Only error and Lord. Different scenes.

cmp-card:7:120|20:70.why: The magicians were thrown down in prostration: same moment.

cmp-card:7:190|20:75.why: Only the word righteous. Different subjects.

cmp-card:7:203|20:47.why: Only sign and Lord. Different scenes.

cmp-card:7:60|21:54.why: In clear error: Nuh's chiefs say it falsely of him, Ibrahim says it truly of his people and fathers.
cmp-card:7:60|21:54.relation: Contrast: the same charge from a prophet and against a prophet.

cmp-card:7:64|21:77,7:136|21:77.why: Those who denied Our signs were drowned: Nuh's people twice and Pharaoh's people. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:7:64|21:77,7:136|21:77.relation: Drowning as the end of deniers.

cmp-card:7:177|21:77.why: Only the people who denied Our signs. Different scenes.

cmp-card:7:192|21:43,7:197|21:43.why: False gods cannot help their worshippers nor even themselves. A memorizer group.

cmp-card:7:8|23:102,7:9|23:103.why: Whose scales are heavy are the successful, whose scales are light have lost themselves: nearly identical pairs with different endings. A classic memorizer group.

cmp-card:7:14|23:100.why: Until the Day they are raised: Iblis's respite and the barrier after death both run to it.
cmp-card:7:14|23:100.relation: Everything waits for the Day of raising.

cmp-card:7:23|23:109,7:23|23:118.why: Pleas for forgiveness and mercy: Adam and Hawwa, the believers, and the Prophet told to say it.
cmp-card:7:23|23:109,7:23|23:118.relation: The prayer for forgiveness and mercy from the first humans onward.

cmp-card:7:34|23:43.why: No nation can advance or delay its term.

cmp-card:7:47|23:94.why: Lord, do not place us, or me, among the wrongdoing people. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:7:47|23:94.relation: Prayer to be kept apart from the wrongdoers.

cmp-card:7:59|23:23,7:59|23:32.why: We sent Nuh to his people: worship Allah, you have no god but Him, then different endings. A classic memorizer group.
cmp-card:7:59|23:23,7:59|23:32.relation: The same call of every messenger.

cmp-card:7:60|23:106.why: Only people and error. Different scenes.

cmp-card:7:61|23:106.why: Only people and error. Different scenes.

cmp-card:7:65|23:23,7:65|23:32.why: Worship Allah, you have no god but Him; will you not fear Him: Hud and two messengers in al-Muminun. A memorizer group.
cmp-card:7:65|23:23,7:65|23:32.relation: The same call of every messenger.

cmp-card:7:106|23:68.why: Only came and bring. Different subjects.

cmp-card:7:151|23:109,7:151|23:118.why: Forgive and have mercy, and You are the best, or most merciful, of the merciful. A memorizer group.

cmp-card:7:153|24:5.why: Only repentance after and the closing Forgiving, Merciful. Different subjects.

cmp-card:7:2|25:1.why: The Book sent down to the Prophet to warn: to warn with it, and to be a warner to the worlds.

cmp-card:7:57|25:48.why: He sends the winds as good news before His mercy, then the rain. Same sign.
cmp-card:7:57|25:48.relation: Winds and rain as signs of mercy.

cmp-card:7:177|25:36.why: Only the people who denied Our signs. Different scenes.

cmp-card:7:185|25:2.why: Only heavens and earth and creation. Different points.

cmp-card:7:106|26:31,7:107|26:32,7:108|2.why: Musa before Pharaoh and the magicians, told almost line by line in al-Araf and ash-Shuara, with small changes in words. One of the richest memorizer parallels in the Quran.
cmp-card:7:106|26:31,7:107|26:32,7:108|2.relation: The same story in two tellings, differing in small words.

cmp-card:7:119|26:44.why: The magicians boast by Pharaoh's might that they will win, and they were defeated. The boast and its answer.
cmp-card:7:119|26:44.relation: Contrast: we are the victors, and they were overcome.

cmp-card:7:23|27:11.why: Only wronging and forgiveness. Different scenes.

cmp-card:7:45|27:43.why: Only turned away and disbelievers. Different subjects.

cmp-card:7:52|27:77.why: Both describe the revelation as guidance and mercy for those who believe; the short form in 27:77 echoes the fuller 7:52.
cmp-card:7:52|27:77.relation: Same description of the Book, once at length and once in brief.

cmp-card:7:72|27:84.why: Only the stock phrase about denying the signs is shared. One tells of Hud's people cut off, the other is a question put on the Day of Judgement.

cmp-card:7:80|27:54,7:81|27:55,7:82|27:5.why: The same scene of Lot's story told in four matching ayat with small changes in each. That is a strong trap for memorizers, and the differing endings are worth pondering.
cmp-card:7:80|27:54,7:81|27:55,7:82|27:5.relation: Same story of Lot and his people, told twice with telling differences in wording.

cmp-card:7:84|27:14,7:84|27:51,7:84|27:6.why: The same call to look at the end of the destroyed, closed each time with a different word for the wrongdoers. Memorizers must keep the closing words apart.
cmp-card:7:84|27:14,7:84|27:51,7:84|27:6.relation: Each people destroyed is named by its own crime in the same warning sentence.

cmp-card:7:103|27:14,7:103|27:51,7:103|2.why: 7:103 and 27:14 are both about Pharaoh and end the same way; the other two use the same warning with other closings. This is a useful memorizer set.
cmp-card:7:103|27:14,7:103|27:51,7:103|2.relation: Pharaoh's people seen through the same warning in two surahs.

cmp-card:7:131|27:46.why: Only the words for good and evil are shared. The subjects differ: Pharaoh's people take an evil omen from Moses, while Salih asks his people why they hasten evil.

cmp-card:7:131|27:47.why: Two peoples blame their messenger for their bad fortune and receive the same answer: their omen is with Allah.
cmp-card:7:131|27:47.relation: Pharaoh's people and Thamud make the same accusation and are given the same answer.

cmp-card:7:136|27:84.why: Only the stock phrase about denying the signs is shared. One is the drowning of Pharaoh's people, the other a question on the Day of Judgement.

cmp-card:7:147|27:84.why: Only the stock phrases about denying the signs and about what they used to do. The subjects differ.

cmp-card:7:177|27:84.why: Only the stock phrase about denying the signs. One is a parable, the other a question on the Day of Judgement.

cmp-card:7:182|27:84.why: Only the stock phrase about denying the signs. One is about leading deniers on by degrees, the other a question on the Day of Judgement.

cmp-card:7:23|28:16,7:151|28:16.why: Adam's confession and Moses's confession use the same words about wronging oneself and ask for forgiveness, and 7:151 is Moses praying again. All three are repentant prayers worth reading together.
cmp-card:7:23|28:16,7:151|28:16.relation: Prophets who slipped confess and ask forgiveness in the same words.

cmp-card:7:47|28:21.why: Two prayers to be kept apart from the wrongdoing people: the people of the heights before the Fire, and Moses fleeing Egypt. Their wording differs, which is worth fixing for memorizers.
cmp-card:7:47|28:21.relation: The same plea to be kept from the wrongdoers, in this world and in the next.

cmp-card:7:84|28:40,7:103|28:40.why: 7:103 and 28:40 are both about Pharaoh and use the same warning with different closings; 7:84 adds Lot's people. These are useful closing-word traps.
cmp-card:7:84|28:40,7:103|28:40.relation: Pharaoh's end, told in two surahs with the same call to look at it.

cmp-card:7:106|28:49.why: The same challenge to bring something if you are truthful. In 7:106 Pharaoh challenges Moses for a sign; in 28:49 the Prophet challenges the deniers for a better book.
cmp-card:7:106|28:49.relation: Contrast: a denier challenges a messenger, and a messenger turns the same challenge on deniers.

cmp-card:7:194|28:64.why: Both show the partners that people call on besides Allah: they cannot answer their callers. One is a challenge in this world, the other the scene on the Day.
cmp-card:7:194|28:64.relation: The challenge to call on the false gods comes true on the Day, when they do not answer.

cmp-card:7:2|29:51,7:52|29:51.why: The Book sent down as mercy and a reminder for believers, worded close enough to be a memorizer trap.
cmp-card:7:2|29:51,7:52|29:51.relation: The same description of the Book's purpose in two surahs.

cmp-card:7:5|29:31.why: Destroyed towns described as wrongdoers: in 7:5 the people confess it, and in 29:31 the angels state it before Lot's town is destroyed. The link is thin.
cmp-card:7:5|29:31.relation: The verdict of wrongdoing, confessed by the destroyed and pronounced by the angels.

cmp-card:7:59|29:36.why: Two prophets open their call with the same words, Noah to his people and Shu'ayb to Madyan. Each continues differently, which is useful for memorizers.
cmp-card:7:59|29:36.relation: Every messenger's call begins the same way.

cmp-card:7:65|29:16,7:65|29:36.why: Hud, Abraham and Shu'ayb call their people to worship Allah in near-identical words, with different continuations.
cmp-card:7:65|29:16,7:65|29:36.relation: One message carried by different prophets.

cmp-card:7:70|29:29.why: Two peoples answer their prophet with the same mocking challenge to bring the punishment if he is truthful.
cmp-card:7:70|29:29.relation: Hud's people and Lot's people defy their messengers in the same words.

cmp-card:7:78|29:37,7:91|29:37.why: The same sentence for the destruction of Thamud and of Madyan, repeated in al-Ankabut. This is a classic memorizer trap.
cmp-card:7:78|29:37,7:91|29:37.relation: The same punishment falls on two peoples in the same words.

cmp-card:7:80|29:28,7:83|29:32,7:83|29:3.why: Lot's story: the same sentence about the immorality none did before, and the same exception of his wife. The small differences matter for memorizers.
cmp-card:7:80|29:28,7:83|29:32,7:83|29:3.relation: Same story of Lot in two surahs.

cmp-card:7:147|29:7.why: Only the stock closing about what they used to do is shared. The deniers' deeds coming to nothing and the believers' reward are each told in their own words, so there is no real contrast in shared wording.

cmp-card:7:185|29:44.why: Only the stock phrase about the creation of the heavens and the earth is shared, and the points differ.

cmp-card:7:84|30:42,7:103|30:42.why: The same warning to look at the end of earlier peoples, each with its own closing. These are memorizer traps on the last word.
cmp-card:7:84|30:42,7:103|30:42.relation: The fate of earlier peoples as a lesson, in the same words.

cmp-card:7:190|30:40.why: Only the stock closing glorifying Allah above what they associate. The subjects differ.

cmp-card:7:42|31:8.why: Only the generic formula about those who believe and do good. The rest differs.

cmp-card:7:42|32:19.why: Only the generic formula about those who believe and do good. The rest differs.

cmp-card:7:61|32:10.why: The words for error are used in different senses: Noah denies being in error, while deniers speak of being lost in the earth. Nothing links them.

cmp-card:7:34|34:30.why: The appointed term can be neither delayed nor brought forward by an hour, said of each nation and of the Day. The wording is near-identical, so it is a memorizer trap.
cmp-card:7:34|34:30.relation: The fixed term of nations and the fixed Day, described in the same words.

cmp-card:7:75|34:31.why: The arrogant and the weak: in 7:75 the arrogant chiefs question the weak believers, and in 34:31 the weak blame the arrogant in the Hereafter.
cmp-card:7:75|34:31.relation: Contrast: the arrogant and the weak in this world and on the Day.

cmp-card:7:164|34:46.why: Only the word for admonishing and the severe punishment are shared, and the scenes differ.

cmp-card:7:23|36:54.why: Only the words for wronging a soul. Adam's confession and the justice of the Day are different subjects.

cmp-card:7:84|37:73,7:103|37:73.why: The same warning to look at the end of those destroyed, with a different closing word each time. These are useful closing traps.
cmp-card:7:84|37:73,7:103|37:73.relation: Each destroyed people is named by its own crime in the same sentence.

cmp-card:7:106|37:157.why: The same challenge to bring something if you are truthful. Pharaoh demands a sign of Moses, and the deniers are asked for their book.
cmp-card:7:106|37:157.relation: Contrast: the same challenge in a denier's mouth and turned against deniers.

cmp-card:7:2|38:29.why: A Book sent down to you, in two openings that go on to state its purpose: to warn and remind, and to be pondered.
cmp-card:7:2|38:29.relation: Purpose of the revelation, stated in two ways.

cmp-card:7:12|38:75,7:12|38:76,7:14|38:7.why: Iblis's refusal, his claim to be better, and his request for respite are told in both surahs with small differences in wording. This is a strong memorizer set.
cmp-card:7:12|38:75,7:12|38:76,7:14|38:7.relation: Same story of Iblis told twice.

cmp-card:7:18|38:85.why: Allah's oath to fill Hell with Iblis and those who follow him, near-identical in both surahs.
cmp-card:7:18|38:85.relation: Same verdict on Iblis and his followers in the same story.

cmp-card:7:66|38:4.why: The deniers call their messenger a liar: Hud's chiefs and the Quraysh. The words for liar differ in form.
cmp-card:7:66|38:4.relation: Every messenger is called a liar by those who reject him.

cmp-card:7:39|39:24.why: The same command to taste the punishment for what they used to earn, said to the people of the Fire. A near-identical clause.
cmp-card:7:39|39:24.relation: Same sentence passed on the wrongdoers in the Hereafter.

cmp-card:7:59|39:13.why: Noah fears for his people the punishment of a tremendous day, and the Prophet is told to say he fears the same if he disobeys.
cmp-card:7:59|39:13.relation: A messenger fears for his people, and fears for himself, the same day.

cmp-card:7:106|39:59.why: Only loose words about coming with signs. Pharaoh's challenge and the answer to a regretful soul are different subjects.

cmp-card:7:147|39:35.why: Only the stock closing about recompense for what they did. The subjects differ.

cmp-card:7:178|39:37.why: Whom Allah guides, with two different continuations: he is the guided one, and none can mislead him. A memorizer trap.
cmp-card:7:178|39:37.relation: Guidance belongs to Allah alone, stated twice.

cmp-card:7:180|39:35.why: Only the stock closing about recompense. The beautiful names and the reward of the pious are different subjects.

cmp-card:7:196|39:1,7:196|39:2.why: Only the stock idea that Allah sent down the Book. 7:196 is about Allah as protector of the righteous, and the 39 openings are about the revelation itself.

cmp-card:7:90|40:38.why: Only words about following and calling the people. The chiefs' threat against Shu'ayb's followers and the believer's call are not linked by shared wording.

cmp-card:7:151|40:60.why: Only words about the Lord and entering are shared, and the subjects differ.

cmp-card:7:196|40:2.why: Only the stock idea that Allah sent down the Book. 7:196 is about Allah as protector of the righteous, 40:2 is a surah opening.

cmp-card:7:17|41:42.why: Only the phrase about coming from in front and from behind is shared. Satan's ambush and the Book that falsehood cannot reach are different subjects.

cmp-card:7:52|41:3.why: A Book made detailed for a people, closed once with believing and once with knowing. The two are easy to confuse.
cmp-card:7:52|41:3.relation: The detailed Book and the people it is for.

cmp-card:7:101|41:14.why: Messengers came to the destroyed nations and they refused to believe. This is the same pattern in the history of earlier peoples.
cmp-card:7:101|41:14.relation: Every destroyed people had messengers and rejected them.

cmp-card:7:105|41:14.why: Only words about coming with messages are shared. Moses's demand to Pharaoh and the refusal of Ad and Thamud are different scenes.

cmp-card:7:196|42:17.why: Only the stock idea that Allah sent down the Book, with different continuations.

cmp-card:7:61|43:46,7:67|43:46,7:104|43:.why: Noah, Hud and Moses each declare that they are a messenger from the Lord of the worlds, with slight differences in form. A memorizer set.
cmp-card:7:61|43:46,7:67|43:46,7:104|43:.relation: Every messenger gives the same declaration.

cmp-card:7:84|43:25,7:103|43:25.why: The same warning to look at the end of the destroyed, with a different closing word each time. These are useful closing traps.
cmp-card:7:84|43:25,7:103|43:25.relation: Each destroyed people is named by its own crime.

cmp-card:7:105|43:63.why: Moses and Jesus each tell their people that they have come to them with something from Allah, a clear proof and wisdom.
cmp-card:7:105|43:63.relation: Two messengers to the Children of Israel open their mission in the same words.

cmp-card:7:106|44:36.why: Deniers demand proof and close with the same condition, if you are truthful: Pharaoh asks for a sign, and the Makkans ask for their dead fathers back. This matches the kept 7:106 and 15:7 pair.
cmp-card:7:106|44:36.relation: Deniers in every age make the same demand.

cmp-card:7:52|45:20.why: Guidance and mercy for a people, closed once with believing and once with certainty. A closing-word trap.
cmp-card:7:52|45:20.relation: The same description of the revelation in two surahs.

cmp-card:7:70|45:25,7:106|45:25.why: Deniers demand that the messenger bring something if he is truthful: Hud's people, Pharaoh and the Makkans.
cmp-card:7:70|45:25,7:106|45:25.relation: Deniers in every age challenge their messenger in the same words.

cmp-card:7:118|45:29.why: Only the words for truth and for what they used to do. The magicians' defeat and the record of deeds are unrelated.

cmp-card:7:131|45:26.why: Only the stock closing that most of them do not know. The subjects differ.

cmp-card:7:133|45:31.why: The same verdict is passed on Pharaoh's people and on the deniers on the Day: they were arrogant and a criminal people. The clause is near-identical.
cmp-card:7:133|45:31.relation: Pharaoh's people in this world and the deniers in the next are judged in the same words.

cmp-card:7:153|45:30.why: Only general words about deeds and the Lord's mercy. The penitent forgiven and the believers admitted to mercy share no real wording.

cmp-card:7:196|45:2.why: Only the stock idea that Allah sent down the Book. 45:2 is a surah opening, and 7:196 is about Allah as protector of the righteous.

cmp-card:7:49|46:13.why: Only the common phrase that there is no fear and no grief, and the subjects differ. This matches the drop of 7:49 with 10:62.

cmp-card:7:59|46:21.why: Noah and Hud warn their peoples in the same words: worship none but Allah, I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous day.

cmp-card:7:70|46:22,7:77|46:22,7:106|46:.why: Ad repeats its challenge to Hud in near-identical words in two surahs, and Thamud and Pharaoh make the same demand. A strong memorizer set.
cmp-card:7:70|46:22,7:77|46:22,7:106|46:.relation: Deniers challenge their messengers to bring what they promise.

cmp-card:7:93|46:23.why: Shu'ayb and Hud each say they have conveyed what they were sent with, worded differently. A parallel in the stories of the prophets.
cmp-card:7:93|46:23.relation: Messengers who conveyed the message and left the outcome to Allah.

cmp-card:7:105|46:7.why: Only the words for truth and clear proofs. Moses's claim and the deniers calling the Quran magic share no real wording.

cmp-card:7:185|46:33.why: Only the opening question and the heavens and earth. The points differ: the approaching term, and the power to raise the dead.

cmp-card:7:194|46:5.why: Those called on besides Allah cannot answer their callers. The same theme in two forms.

cmp-card:7:196|46:2.why: Only the stock idea that Allah sent down the Book. 46:2 is a surah opening, and 7:196 is about Allah as protector of the righteous.

cmp-card:7:28|47:26.why: Only common words; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:7:45|47:1.why: Only the stock phrase about turning from Allah's way, with different predicates.

cmp-card:7:45|47:34.why: Only the stock phrase about turning from Allah's way, with different predicates.

cmp-card:7:84|47:10,7:103|47:10.why: The same call to look at the end of those destroyed, with a different closing in each. These are closing traps.
cmp-card:7:84|47:10,7:103|47:10.relation: The fate of earlier peoples as a lesson.

cmp-card:7:128|49:16.why: Only common words about Allah and the earth; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:7:25|50:11.why: Both point to life, death and coming out again, but through different words of the same roots, and the contexts differ: Adam sent down to the earth, and rain reviving dead land.

cmp-card:7:132|51:52.why: The link rests on different words of one root: bewitching in one, a sorcerer in the other. Otherwise the subjects differ.

cmp-card:7:106|52:34.why: The same condition, if you are truthful, closes a challenge: Pharaoh demands a sign, and the deniers are asked to bring a discourse like the Quran. This matches the kept 7:106 and 28:49 pair.
cmp-card:7:106|52:34.relation: Contrast: a denier's challenge, and the challenge turned back on deniers.

cmp-card:7:177|53:52.why: Only words about a people and wrongdoing; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:7:180|53:31.why: Only the opening possessive and the word for recompense. The beautiful names and reward for deeds are different subjects.
