cmp-card:9:116|45:27.why: Only the stock phrase about the dominion of the heavens and the earth.

cmp-card:9:109|46:10.why: Only the stock closing that Allah does not guide the wrongdoers.

cmp-card:9:116|46:32.why: Only the recurring idea of no protector besides Allah; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:9:116|46:33.why: Only the heavens and earth and giving life; the points differ.

cmp-card:9:9|47:1.why: Only the stock phrase about turning from Allah's way; the owner removed the same pairing before.

cmp-card:9:72|47:12.why: Only the generic phrase about rivers flowing in the gardens.

cmp-card:9:115|47:32.why: Only the idea of guidance made clear, in different words and with different points.

cmp-card:9:27|48:14.why: Only the phrase about whom He wills and the stock Forgiving and Merciful closing.

cmp-card:9:33|48:28.why: The same ayah, word for word, about the Messenger sent with the religion of truth to prevail over all religion. Only the closing differs.
cmp-card:9:33|48:28.relation: The promise that the religion of truth will prevail.

cmp-card:9:72|48:5,9:89|48:5,9:100|48:5.why: The gardens with rivers and abiding there, closed with the great triumph, in four forms. 48:5 adds the expiation of sins. A memorizer trap.
cmp-card:9:72|48:5,9:89|48:5,9:100|48:5.relation: The great triumph promised to the believers.

cmp-card:9:115|48:21.why: Only the stock closing about all things.

cmp-card:9:116|48:14.why: Only the stock phrase about the dominion of the heavens and the earth.

cmp-card:9:20|49:15,9:41|49:15,9:44|49:1.why: Striving with wealth and lives in Allah's way, the mark of true believers. The order of the phrases varies, which makes memorizer traps.
cmp-card:9:20|49:15,9:41|49:15,9:44|49:1.relation: True faith proven by striving with wealth and lives.

cmp-card:9:27|49:5.why: Only the stock Forgiving and Merciful closing.

cmp-card:9:99|49:14.why: Two kinds of Bedouins: those who truly believe and draw near to Allah by spending, and those who claim belief before it has entered their hearts.
cmp-card:9:99|49:14.relation: Contrast: true belief and claimed belief among the Bedouins.

cmp-card:9:115|49:16.why: Only the stock closing about Allah knowing all things.

cmp-card:9:53|51:46.why: Only the stock phrase about a disobedient people.

cmp-card:9:62|57:8.why: Only the phrase about being believers; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:9:72|57:12,9:73|57:15.why: The reward of believing men and women and the refuge of the disbelievers, in matching words in both surahs.
cmp-card:9:72|57:12,9:73|57:15.relation: Contrast: the believers' gardens and the disbelievers' Fire.

cmp-card:9:89|57:12,9:100|57:12.why: The same gardens, abiding there, the great triumph, with small variations. A memorizer trap.
cmp-card:9:89|57:12,9:100|57:12.relation: The great triumph promised to the believers.

cmp-card:9:99|57:28.why: Only mercy and the stock Forgiving and Merciful closing.

cmp-card:9:116|57:2,9:116|57:5.why: Allah's dominion of the heavens and the earth, and that He gives life and causes death. 9:116 and 57:2 share the longer clause and close differently. 57:5 repeats the opening in al-Hadid.
cmp-card:9:116|57:2,9:116|57:5.relation: The sovereign who gives life and death.

cmp-card:9:116|57:17.why: Only the word for giving life; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:9:9|58:15.why: The rare closing that evil is what they used to do. Both are about the hypocrites and those who turn from Allah's way.
cmp-card:9:9|58:15.relation: The verdict on those who turn people from Allah's way.

cmp-card:9:63|58:20.why: Those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, and the disgrace that awaits them. The verb is rare.
cmp-card:9:63|58:20.relation: Opposing Allah and His Messenger ends in disgrace.

cmp-card:9:71|58:13.why: The same list of duties: prayer, zakah, obeying Allah and His Messenger.
cmp-card:9:71|58:13.relation: The core duties of the believers.

cmp-card:9:16|59:18.why: Only the stock closing that Allah is aware of what they do.

cmp-card:9:39|59:6.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's power over all things.

cmp-card:9:78|59:22.why: Only a divine name from the same root in different forms; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:9:102|60:7.why: Only the word for perhaps and the stock Forgiving and Merciful closing.

cmp-card:9:123|60:13.why: Only the address to the believers and the disbelievers; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:9:20|61:11,9:41|61:11,9:44|61:1.why: Striving with wealth and lives in Allah's way. 9:41 and 61:11 close with the same words, that it is better for you if you knew. A memorizer trap.
cmp-card:9:20|61:11,9:41|61:11,9:44|61:1.relation: Striving with wealth and lives as the believer's trade.

cmp-card:9:32|61:8,9:33|61:9.why: Two consecutive ayat repeated with small changes: they want to put out Allah's light, and He sent His Messenger with the religion of truth. A classic memorizer trap.
cmp-card:9:32|61:8,9:33|61:9.relation: Allah completes His light against those who would put it out.

cmp-card:9:80|61:5.why: Only the stock closing that Allah does not guide the disobedient.

cmp-card:9:88|61:11,9:89|61:12.why: Striving with wealth and lives followed by the gardens and the great triumph, in the same order in both surahs.

cmp-card:9:94|62:8,9:105|62:8.why: The same closing sentence about being returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, who will tell you what you did. A memorizer trap.
cmp-card:9:94|62:8,9:105|62:8.relation: Every deed is brought back before Allah.

cmp-card:9:9|63:2.why: They turned people from Allah's way, and evil is what they used to do. Near-identical clauses about the hypocrites.
cmp-card:9:9|63:2.relation: The verdict on those who turn people from Allah's way.

cmp-card:9:105|63:8.why: Only the phrase about Allah, His Messenger and the believers; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:9:16|64:8.why: Only Allah and His Messenger and the stock closing that He is aware of what they do.

cmp-card:9:22|64:15.why: Only the closing that with Allah is a great reward. The subjects differ: the reward of the emigrants who strove, and wealth and children as a trial.

cmp-card:9:44|64:11.why: Only belief in Allah and a Knowing closing; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:9:51|64:13.why: The same closing command that the believers should rely on Allah.
cmp-card:9:51|64:13.relation: Trust in Allah as the believers' stance.

cmp-card:9:59|64:6.why: Only words about Allah's giving and sufficiency; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:9:63|64:8.why: Only the phrase about Allah and His Messenger.

cmp-card:9:72|64:9,9:73|64:10.why: The believers' gardens and the disbelievers' Fire, in near-identical words in both surahs.
cmp-card:9:72|64:9,9:73|64:10.relation: Contrast: the two ends, gardens and Fire.

cmp-card:9:78|64:4.why: Allah knows their secrets and what is in their breasts.

cmp-card:9:89|64:9,9:100|64:9.why: The same gardens, abiding there, the great triumph. 64:9 and 9:100 both add forever. A memorizer trap.
cmp-card:9:89|64:9,9:100|64:9.relation: The great triumph promised to the believers.

cmp-card:9:115|64:11.why: Only guidance words and the stock closing about Allah knowing all things.

cmp-card:9:72|65:11.why: The gardens with rivers, abiding there, with different continuations. 65:11 adds forever and a fine provision. A memorizer trap.
cmp-card:9:72|65:11.relation: The reward of the believers, worded with variations.

cmp-card:9:27|66:1.why: Only the stock Forgiving and Merciful closing.

cmp-card:9:73|67:6.why: Only the stock closing about Hell and a wretched destination.

cmp-card:9:21|68:34.why: Only the generic mention of gardens of bliss with their Lord.

cmp-card:9:27|74:56.why: Only Allah's will and forgiveness; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:9:15|76:30.why: Only Allah's will and the stock Knowing and Wise closing.

cmp-card:9:72|85:11,9:89|85:11.why: The gardens with rivers, closed with the great triumph in at-Tawba and with a different word for great in al-Buruj. That is a real memorizer trap, but beyond it the wording is the generic reward formula.
cmp-card:9:72|85:11,9:89|85:11.relation: The triumph of the believers, named in two ways.

cmp-card:9:116|85:9.why: Only the stock phrase about the dominion of the heavens and the earth.

cmp-card:9:11|98:5.why: Only the common phrase about prayer and zakah.

cmp-card:9:72|98:8,9:89|98:8,9:100|98:8.why: Gardens with rivers, abiding there forever, and Allah pleased with them and they with Him. 9:100 and 98:8 share that rare clause. A strong memorizer set.
cmp-card:9:72|98:8,9:89|98:8,9:100|98:8.relation: The reward and mutual pleasure between Allah and His servants.

cmp-card:10:6|10:67.why: The night and the day as signs for a people, closed with different words. A closing-word trap in one surah.
cmp-card:10:6|10:67.relation: The alternation of night and day as a sign.

cmp-card:10:6|10:101.why: Only the heavens and the earth; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:10:17|10:69,10:17|10:95.why: In one surah: the liars against Allah will not succeed, and those who deny His signs lose. 10:17 joins the two sins that the other ayat name one at a time.
cmp-card:10:17|10:69,10:17|10:95.relation: Inventing lies against Allah and denying His signs, and their end.

cmp-card:10:18|10:68,10:55|10:68.why: 10:18 and 10:68 both answer those who associate others with Allah: He is exalted, and they speak about Allah without knowledge. 10:55 shares only the stock phrase about what is in the heavens and earth, so it is removed.
cmp-card:10:18|10:68,10:55|10:68.changes: Removed 10:55: it shares only the stock phrase about what belongs to Allah in the heavens and earth, and does not answer a false claim.
cmp-card:10:18|10:68,10:55|10:68.relation: Two false claims about Allah, answered in the same way.

cmp-card:10:33|10:96.why: The word of your Lord has come true against them, that they will not believe. Two forms of the clause in one surah.
cmp-card:10:33|10:96.relation: The decree against those who persist in denial.

cmp-card:10:39|10:73.why: The same warning to look at the end of those who denied, closed with different words.
cmp-card:10:39|10:73.relation: The fate of deniers as a lesson.

cmp-card:10:52|10:70.why: The punishment as recompense for what they earned and for their disbelief, in one surah.
cmp-card:10:52|10:70.relation: Punishment as the fruit of their own deeds.

cmp-card:10:77|10:80.why: The same story of Moses and the magicians.
cmp-card:10:77|10:80.relation: Moses facing Pharaoh's charge of magic and then the magicians.

cmp-card:10:9|11:23.why: Only the generic formula about those who believe and do good; the rest differs.

cmp-card:10:17|11:18.why: The same question about who does greater wrong than one who invents a lie against Allah, with different continuations.
cmp-card:10:17|11:18.relation: The gravest wrong: lying about Allah.

cmp-card:10:19|11:110,10:19|11:118.why: The clause that, but for a prior word from your Lord, judgement would have been passed between them, and mankind as one community that differs.
cmp-card:10:19|11:110,10:19|11:118.relation: Allah's prior word delays judgement on people's differences.

cmp-card:10:30|11:21.why: The rare clause that what they used to invent has left them, said of the Hereafter.
cmp-card:10:30|11:21.relation: False gods abandon their worshippers on the Day.

cmp-card:10:48|11:32.why: Deniers challenge the messenger to bring the promised punishment if he is truthful.
cmp-card:10:48|11:32.relation: Deniers in every age demand the punishment.

cmp-card:10:72|11:51.why: Noah and Hud say they ask no reward, their reward is only from Allah.

cmp-card:10:60|12:38.why: Allah's bounty on people, but most of them do not give thanks. The same closing.

cmp-card:10:63|12:57.why: Those who believed and were mindful of Allah, the same short description.
cmp-card:10:63|12:57.relation: The definition of the righteous and their reward.

cmp-card:10:104|12:40.why: Rejecting the worship of what is besides Allah and holding to the worship of Him alone.
cmp-card:10:104|12:40.relation: Worship of Allah alone as the true religion.

cmp-card:10:20|13:7,10:20|13:27.why: The same demand, why has no sign been sent down to him, with three different answers.
cmp-card:10:20|13:7,10:20|13:27.relation: The demand for a sign and the answers to it.

cmp-card:10:29|13:43.why: Allah suffices as a witness between us and you.

cmp-card:10:46|13:40.why: Whether We show you some of what We promise them or take you in death, with different continuations. A memorizer trap.
cmp-card:10:46|13:40.relation: The Prophet's duty is to convey; the outcome is Allah's.

cmp-card:10:64|13:34.why: Glad tidings in this life and the Hereafter for the friends of Allah, and punishment in both for the deniers.
cmp-card:10:64|13:34.relation: Contrast: good news and punishment in both worlds.

cmp-card:10:101|13:7.why: Only words for signs and warning; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:10:6|14:19.why: Only the heavens and the earth; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:10:9|14:23.why: Only the generic formula about believers and gardens with rivers; 10:9 lacks the shared clause about abiding.

cmp-card:10:55|14:19.why: Only the heavens and the earth; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:10:64|14:3.why: Only this life and the Hereafter; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:10:85|14:40.why: Only the address to our Lord; the prayers differ.

cmp-card:10:6|16:12,10:67|16:12.why: The night and the day as signs, closed with different words for those who reflect. A closing-word trap.

cmp-card:10:6|16:52.why: Only the stock phrase about what is in the heavens and the earth.

cmp-card:21:24|28:75.why:
The same challenge to the idolaters, once in this world and once on the Day of Judgment, and the truth they now ignore they then come to know:
هاتوا برهانكم
cmp-card:21:24|28:75.relation: Contrast: here most of them do not know the truth and turn away; on that Day they know the truth belongs to Allah.

cmp-card:21:69|28:53.why: Nothing shared but common words; the fire made cool for Ibrahim and the People of the Book believing in the Quran are unrelated.

cmp-card:21:10|29:51.why: Both say the Book sent down is itself the reminder they need, answering those who demand other signs.
cmp-card:21:10|29:51.relation: The revealed Book is a reminder and enough as a sign.

cmp-card:21:16|29:44.why: Two sides of one point about creation: the heavens and earth were not made in play, they were made in truth.
cmp-card:21:16|29:44.relation: Creation has a purpose: not play (21:16), but truth (29:44).

cmp-card:21:108|29:46.why: The same creed in the same words, told to the idolaters and to the People of the Book: your God is one, and we submit to Him.
cmp-card:21:108|29:46.relation: One message of oneness and submission, addressed to two audiences.

cmp-card:21:45|30:52.why: Near-identical clause with a different ending, a real trap for memorizers; both say the deniers cannot hear the warning, like the deaf.
cmp-card:21:45|30:52.relation: The deaf do not hear the call: when warned (21:45), when they turn their backs (30:52).

cmp-card:21:94|30:45.why: Only the stock phrase of good deeds is shared; the subjects (no effort is lost, and the reward from His grace) are generic.

cmp-card:21:29|31:11.why: Only the stock words for false gods and wrongdoers are shared; a claim to godhood punished and a challenge to show what idols created are different points.

cmp-card:21:81|33:27.why: Only a closing attribute about all things is shared; the wind for Sulayman and the land given after the Quraiza have nothing to compare.

cmp-card:21:81|33:54.why: Only the stock closing about knowing all things; the subjects are unrelated.

cmp-card:21:38|34:29.why: The same ayah word for word in two surahs; a memorizer must know where it recurs and what follows each time.
cmp-card:21:38|34:29.relation: The deniers' recurring taunt about the promised Hour.

cmp-card:21:55|34:49.why: Only the word truth is shared; Ibrahim's people asking if he is serious and the truth having come are different scenes.

cmp-card:21:4|35:38.why: Only the stock attribute of knowing the heavens and earth; nothing specific to compare.

cmp-card:21:28|36:9.why: Before them and behind them means different things: Allah's knowledge of the angels, and a barrier set on the deniers. Nothing to learn by comparing.

cmp-card:21:28|36:45.why: Only the phrase before and behind is shared; Allah's knowledge of the angels and a call to the deniers to fear are different subjects.

cmp-card:21:38|36:48,21:38|36:52.why: The taunt is repeated word for word in both surahs, and Ya-Sin then shows its answer at the resurrection, when the deniers admit the promise was true.
cmp-card:21:38|36:48,21:38|36:52.relation: Contrast: they mock when this promise comes; when raised they confess this is what the Merciful promised.

cmp-card:21:43|36:74.why: Both say the gods they take besides Allah cannot help. The next ayah 36:75 completes the match: they cannot help themselves (21:43), they cannot help their worshippers (36:75).
cmp-card:21:43|36:74.changes: Added 36:75 to the Ya-Sin row, since the matching statement that the gods are unable to help is there.
cmp-card:21:43|36:74.relation: False gods cannot give victory, neither to themselves nor to those who worship them.

cmp-card:21:4|37:5.why: Only the stock words Lord, heaven and earth; Allah hearing all speech and His lordship of the easts are different points.

cmp-card:21:16|37:5.why: Only the stock phrase the heavens, earth and what is between them; creation not in play and a divine title share no point.

cmp-card:21:52|37:85,21:53|37:85.why: The same scene in nearly the same words: Ibrahim asks his father and his people about what they worship. A memorizer must tell the two questions apart.
cmp-card:21:52|37:85,21:53|37:85.relation: One story told twice: Ibrahim confronting his father and people over their idols.

cmp-card:21:56|37:5.why: Only the common divine title Lord of the heavens and the earth is shared; Ibrahim's answer and the oath at the opening of as-Saffat are different contexts.

cmp-card:21:76|37:76,21:76|37:115.why: The same rescue from the great distress, said of Nuh in both surahs and of Musa and Harun; a memorizer must keep the wording apart. In as-Saffat the call of Nuh is in 37:75, which matches his call in 21:76.
cmp-card:21:76|37:76,21:76|37:115.changes: Added 37:75 to the Nuh row in as-Saffat: it has Nuh calling and being answered, matching 21:76, and names who was saved.
cmp-card:21:76|37:76,21:76|37:115.relation: Allah answers the call and saves His messengers from the great distress.

cmp-card:21:112|37:180.why: Only the stock ending about what they describe; a plea for judgment and a glorification are different.

cmp-card:21:4|38:66.why: Only the stock words Lord, heaven and earth; nothing specific shared.

cmp-card:21:16|38:10.why: Only the stock phrase the heavens, earth and what is between them; creation with purpose and a challenge to the deniers over dominion are different points.

cmp-card:21:16|38:66.why: Only the stock phrase the heavens, earth and what is between them; creation with purpose and a divine title share no point.

cmp-card:21:56|38:66.why: Only the common divine title Lord of the heavens and the earth is shared; Ibrahim's answer to his people and the Prophet's declaration in Sad are different contexts.

cmp-card:21:83|38:41,21:84|38:43.why: The story of Ayyub told twice in close wording: his call that harm touched him, and his family given back with as many again, as a mercy and a reminder. The endings differ (for the worshippers / for people of understanding), a point for memorizers.
cmp-card:21:83|38:41,21:84|38:43.relation: One story: Ayyub's patience in affliction, his call, and Allah's answer.

cmp-card:21:108|38:65.why: Both are commands to the Prophet to declare that there is only one God, in parallel openings; useful to compare how each is framed.
cmp-card:21:108|38:65.relation: The core message of oneness, declared by the Prophet in two ways.

cmp-card:21:4|39:44.why: Only the heavens and the earth are shared; Allah hearing all speech and intercession belonging to Him are different points.

cmp-card:21:41|39:48.why: The same closing clause: what they mocked closed in on them. Once of earlier nations, once on the Day of Judgment.
cmp-card:21:41|39:48.relation: Mockery of the warning returns on the mockers, in this world and the next.

cmp-card:21:56|39:44.why: Only the heavens and the earth are shared; the Lord who created them and intercession belonging to Allah are different points.

cmp-card:21:41|40:83.why: The same end for those who mocked their messengers: what they mocked closed in on them.
cmp-card:21:41|40:83.relation: Mockery of the messengers returns on the mockers.

cmp-card:21:52|40:30.why: Only a speaker addressing his people is shared; Ibrahim on the idols and the believer of Pharaoh's family warning of the fate of the confederates are different subjects.

cmp-card:21:20|41:38.why: The same picture of the angels glorifying night and day without tiring, in two wordings a memorizer must keep apart.
cmp-card:21:20|41:38.relation: Those near Allah never tire of glorifying Him, while the proud refuse to bow.

cmp-card:21:108|41:6.why: The same revealed sentence, your God is one God, with different openings and endings; a clear trap for memorizers.
cmp-card:21:108|41:6.relation: The one message revealed to the Prophet, and the response asked for: submit, or go straight to Him and seek forgiveness.

cmp-card:21:81|42:12.why: Only the stock closing about all things; the subjects are unrelated.

cmp-card:21:4|43:9.why: Only the heavens, the earth and the Knowing are shared; nothing specific to compare.

cmp-card:21:4|43:82.why: Only the stock words Lord, heaven and earth; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:4|43:84.why: Only the heaven, the earth and the Knowing are shared; Allah hearing all speech and being God in heaven and earth are different points.

cmp-card:21:16|43:9.why: Only the common phrase about creating the heavens and the earth; creation not in play and the deniers' admission of the Creator are different points.

cmp-card:21:25|43:45.why: Both appeal to all the messengers sent before: every one was told to worship Allah alone, so ask them whether any other god was given.
cmp-card:21:25|43:45.relation: Every messenger before brought the same message of oneness.

cmp-card:21:26|43:20.why: Only the deniers' words about the Merciful are shared; the claim that He took a son and the excuse that He willed their worship are different points.

cmp-card:21:26|43:81.why: The same false claim, that the Merciful has a son, answered in two ways.
cmp-card:21:26|43:81.relation: Answers to the claim of a son: they are honoured servants (21:26); were it so, I would be the first to worship (43:81).

cmp-card:21:31|43:10.why: The same sign in close wording: ways made in the earth so that people may be guided. Useful for memorizers and for reflecting on the twofold guidance, on roads and to Allah.
cmp-card:21:31|43:10.relation: Paths in the earth as a sign that guides.

cmp-card:21:33|43:12.why: Only the words who created and all are shared; the orbits of sun and moon and the creation of pairs and mounts are different signs.

cmp-card:21:52|43:26.why: The same opening of Ibrahim's speech to his father and his people, in two surahs: once questioning the idols, once declaring himself free of them.
cmp-card:21:52|43:26.relation: One story: Ibrahim confronting his father and people, questioning and then disowning.

cmp-card:21:53|43:22,21:53|43:24.why: The same excuse of following the fathers, given to Ibrahim and to every messenger, and the messenger's answer.
cmp-card:21:53|43:22,21:53|43:24.relation: Blind following of forefathers as the deniers' excuse, and the call to something better guided.

cmp-card:21:53|43:26.why: Same story, but the rows do not match: one is the people's reply, the other Ibrahim's disowning. The pairs 21:52 with 43:26 and 21:53 with 43:22 already show the parallel.

cmp-card:21:54|43:40.why: Only the stock phrase clear error is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:55|43:30.why: Only the word truth and a reply are shared; the two answers to the messenger differ in meaning and wording.

cmp-card:21:56|43:82.why: Only the common title Lord of the heavens and the earth is shared; different contexts.

cmp-card:21:103|43:83.why: The same phrase, the Day they are promised, closes both: the believers are met by angels on it, the deniers are left to play until they meet it.
cmp-card:21:103|43:83.relation: Contrast: one promised Day, met in peace by the believers and in dread by the deniers.

cmp-card:21:112|43:82.why: Only the stock ending about what they describe; a plea for judgment and a glorification are different.

cmp-card:21:4|44:6.why: Only the stock closing the Hearing, the Knowing; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:4|44:7.why: Only the stock words Lord, heaven and earth; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:16|44:7.why: Only the stock phrase the heavens, earth and what is between them; different points.

cmp-card:21:56|44:7.why: Only the common title Lord of the heavens and the earth is shared; different contexts.

cmp-card:21:4|45:36.why: Only the stock words Lord, heaven and earth; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:41|45:33.why: The same closing clause: what they mocked closed in on them. The deeds wording here (what they did) differs from 39:48 (what they earned), a point for memorizers.
cmp-card:21:41|45:33.relation: Mockery of the warning returns on the mockers.

cmp-card:21:56|45:36.why: Only the common title Lord of the heavens and the earth is shared; different contexts.

cmp-card:21:16|46:3.why: The same statement about creation in near-identical wording: not in play (21:16), but in truth and for a fixed term (46:3).
cmp-card:21:16|46:3.relation: Creation has a purpose and an end.

cmp-card:21:30|46:33.why: Both open with the same rebuke to the deniers and point to the creation of the heavens and earth as proof of His power over life.
cmp-card:21:30|46:33.relation: Have they not seen: creation as the proof of giving life and raising the dead.

cmp-card:21:38|46:22.why: The same defiant demand by deniers in two ages: bring what you promise us, if you are truthful.
cmp-card:21:38|46:22.relation: Deniers of every age challenge the messenger to bring the threatened punishment.

cmp-card:21:78|48:19.why: Only words from the same root as judgment and wisdom; Dawud and Sulayman's ruling and the spoils of war are unrelated.

cmp-card:21:4|49:16.why: Only the stock statement that Allah knows what is in the heavens and earth; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:4|49:18.why: Only the stock statement of Allah's knowledge of the heavens and earth; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:16|50:38.why: The same creation of the heavens, earth and what is between them, with two denials: not in play, and with no fatigue.
cmp-card:21:16|50:38.relation: Creation done with purpose and without weariness.

cmp-card:21:4|51:23.why: Only the words Lord, heaven and earth; Allah hearing speech and an oath on the truth of provision are different.

cmp-card:21:56|51:23.why: Only the common title Lord of the heaven and earth; different contexts.

cmp-card:21:16|52:36.why: Only the creation of the heavens and earth is shared; creation not in play and the question whether they created them are different points.

cmp-card:21:4|64:4.why: Both say Allah knows all speech, secret and open, in heaven and earth; 21:4 answers the deniers' secret talk in 21:3.
cmp-card:21:4|64:4.relation: Nothing said in secret is hidden from Allah.

cmp-card:21:16|64:3.why: Two sides of one point about creation: the heavens and earth were not made in play, they were made in truth.
cmp-card:21:16|64:3.relation: Creation has a purpose: not play, but truth.

cmp-card:21:36|67:28.why: Only the word disbelievers and seeing are shared; the deniers mocking the Prophet and the question who will protect them are different points.

cmp-card:21:38|67:25.why: The same ayah word for word in two surahs; a memorizer must know where it recurs and what follows each time.
cmp-card:21:38|67:25.relation: The deniers' recurring taunt about the promised Hour.

cmp-card:21:49|67:12.why: The same description of the believers, those who fear their Lord unseen, with two endings: their dread of the Hour, and their forgiveness and reward.
cmp-card:21:49|67:12.relation: Fearing Allah unseen: its sign and its reward.

cmp-card:21:54|67:29.why: Only the stock phrase clear error is shared; Ibrahim's charge to his people and the Prophet's declaration of trust are different points.

cmp-card:21:61|67:30.why: Only the verb bring is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:60|68:51.why: Only hearing and mention are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:103|70:42,21:103|70:44.why: The promised Day closes all three: the believers are met by angels on it; the deniers are left to play until they meet it, then come humbled.
cmp-card:21:103|70:42,21:103|70:44.relation: Contrast: one promised Day, met in peace by the believers and in humiliation by the deniers.

cmp-card:21:42|71:5.why: Only night and day are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:4|78:37.why: Only the words Lord, heaven and earth; different subjects.

cmp-card:21:16|78:37.why: Only the stock phrase the heavens, earth and what is between them; different points.

cmp-card:21:56|78:37.why: Only the common title Lord of the heavens and the earth is shared; different contexts.

cmp-card:21:56|85:9.why: Only the heavens, earth and the word witness are shared; different points.

cmp-card:21:73|98:5.why: The prophets of Ibrahim's line were inspired to pray, give zakat and worship Allah, and the People of the Book were commanded nothing other than this; the upright religion is the same.
cmp-card:21:73|98:5.relation: The religion of the prophets is the one the People of the Book were commanded.

cmp-card:22:3|22:8.why: The same opening in one surah, a few ayat apart, with different continuations; a clear trap for memorizers.
cmp-card:22:3|22:8.relation: Two kinds of disputers about Allah without knowledge: the follower of every devil, and the proud leader without guidance or book.

cmp-card:22:6|22:74.why: Only words from the same roots are shared; different points.

cmp-card:22:8|22:68.why: In one surah: there are those who dispute about Allah without knowledge, and the Prophet is told how to answer them.
cmp-card:22:8|22:68.relation: Disputing about Allah, and the answer: Allah knows best what you do.

cmp-card:22:12|22:62.why: What they call on besides Allah is described twice in one surah: it neither harms nor benefits, it is falsehood.
cmp-card:22:12|22:62.relation: The emptiness of what is worshipped besides Allah, against Allah who is the Truth.

cmp-card:22:14|22:23,22:14|22:56.why: 22:14 and 22:23 open identically and differ in their endings, a real trap for memorizers; 22:56 gives the same promise on the Day Allah judges.
cmp-card:22:14|22:23,22:14|22:56.relation: The believers' reward, promised in one surah three times.

cmp-card:22:61|22:75.why: Only the stock closing the Hearing, the Seeing is shared; the alternation of night and day and the choosing of messengers are different subjects.

cmp-card:22:63|23:18.why: The same sign of water sent down from the sky to the earth, shown from two sides: it makes the earth green, and He could take it away.
cmp-card:22:63|23:18.relation: Rain as a sign of His kindness and His power.

cmp-card:22:66|23:37.why: Life, death and life again stated by Allah, and denied by the disbelievers in the same words.
cmp-card:22:66|23:37.relation: Contrast: He gives life, causes death and gives life again; they say we die and live and will not be raised.

cmp-card:22:16|24:1,22:16|24:34,22:16|24.why: The same statement, We sent down clear signs, with different endings; 22:16 and 24:46 both close with Allah guiding whom He wills.
cmp-card:22:16|24:1,22:16|24:34,22:16|24.relation: Clear signs are sent down, and guidance is from Allah.

cmp-card:22:61|24:44.why: The same sign of Allah alternating night and day, with a call to reflect on it.
cmp-card:22:61|24:44.relation: The turning of night and day as a sign of His power.

cmp-card:22:63|24:41.why: Only the opening do you not see that Allah is shared; rain and the glorification of all creatures are different signs.

cmp-card:22:69|24:48.why: Only judging between them is shared; Allah's judgment on the Day and the hypocrites refusing the Messenger's judgment are different.

cmp-card:22:70|24:64.why: Both close a passage with Allah's knowledge of all in the heavens and earth, and of what people do.
cmp-card:22:70|24:64.relation: Allah knows all, and all is recorded and will be told.

cmp-card:22:14|25:70.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; gardens and sins turned to good deeds are different points.

cmp-card:22:66|25:49.why: Only life and death words are shared; human life and death and rain reviving land are different subjects.

cmp-card:22:67|25:31.why: Only the words every and We made, and Lord with guidance; rites for each nation and enemies for each prophet are different points.

cmp-card:22:70|27:25,22:70|27:65,22:70|2.why: Allah's knowledge of what is hidden in the heavens and the earth; 22:70 and 27:75 both add that it is recorded in a book.
cmp-card:22:70|27:25,22:70|27:65,22:70|2.relation: Nothing hidden in heaven or earth escapes His knowledge or His record.

cmp-card:22:50|28:67.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:12|29:42.why: Only what they call on besides Allah is shared; the point of each ayah differs (no harm or benefit; Allah knows them).

cmp-card:22:14|29:58,22:23|29:58,22:56|2.why: Across the surahs only the general reward formula is shared: those who believe and do good, gardens with rivers. Nothing specific links al-Ankabut to al-Hajj here; the strong match of 22:14 with 22:23 is already its own card.

cmp-card:22:50|29:9.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

cmp-card:22:57|29:23.why: Only the general statement that deniers of the signs have punishment; nothing specific to compare.

cmp-card:22:62|29:42.why: The same clause about what they call on besides Him, and the same verdict: it is falsehood (22:62), it is nothing (29:42).
cmp-card:22:62|29:42.relation: What is worshipped besides Allah is nothing at all.

cmp-card:22:70|29:52.why: Only the stock statement that Allah knows what is in the heavens and the earth; the surrounding points differ.

cmp-card:22:6|30:50.why: Nearly the same closing: He gives life to the dead and is able over all things. In 30:50 it follows rain reviving the land, the proof of resurrection.
cmp-card:22:6|30:50.relation: Reviving the dead earth as proof of reviving the dead.

cmp-card:22:8|30:29.why: Only the phrase without knowledge is shared; disputing about Allah and following desires are different points.

cmp-card:22:38|30:45.why: Only the stock statement that Allah does not love the disbelievers; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:50|30:15.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

cmp-card:22:50|30:45.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:57|30:16.why: The same wording for the deniers' end, and in both surahs it follows straight after the believers' reward; a memorizer must keep the endings apart.
cmp-card:22:57|30:16.relation: Contrast: the believers in gardens, the deniers of the signs in punishment.

cmp-card:22:12|31:11.why: Only besides Allah and error are shared; different points.

cmp-card:22:12|31:30.why: What they call on besides Allah: it neither harms nor benefits (22:12), it is falsehood (31:30).
cmp-card:22:12|31:30.relation: The emptiness of what is worshipped besides Allah.

cmp-card:22:41|31:17.why: The same duties: establish prayer, enjoin good and forbid evil. Once as the mark of those given power, once in Luqman's advice to his son.
cmp-card:22:41|31:17.relation: The same duties, for the ruler and for the young believer, each closed with a word about affairs.

cmp-card:22:50|31:8.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

cmp-card:22:56|31:8.why: The same promise in close wording: those who believe and do good are in the Gardens of Bliss. Close enough to confuse a memorizer.
cmp-card:22:56|31:8.relation: The believers' reward, the Gardens of Bliss.

cmp-card:22:61|31:29,22:62|31:30.why: Two consecutive ayat repeated almost word for word in two surahs, with different endings; a key passage for memorizers.
cmp-card:22:61|31:29,22:62|31:30.relation: The alternation of night and day, and Allah as the Truth against the falsehood of other gods.

cmp-card:22:64|31:25.why: Only the heavens, earth and praise are shared; different points.

cmp-card:22:74|31:9.why: Only the words Allah, truth and Mighty; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:75|31:28.why: Only the stock closing the Hearing, the Seeing is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:50|32:19.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

cmp-card:22:56|32:19.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds with gardens; the names of the gardens and the contexts differ.

cmp-card:22:69|32:25.why: The same statement in close wording: on the Day of Resurrection Allah judges between them in what they differed. A memorizer must tell the openings apart.
cmp-card:22:69|32:25.relation: All disputes are settled by Allah on the Day of Resurrection.

cmp-card:22:6|33:27.why: Only the stock closing able over all things; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:50|33:31.why: Only noble provision and good deeds are shared; the reward of believers and of the Prophet's wives are different contexts.

cmp-card:22:63|33:34.why: Only the stock closing Subtle, Aware; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:44|34:45.why: Both close with the same question after earlier nations denied: then how was My rejection.
cmp-card:22:44|34:45.relation: The end of those who denied the messengers before.

cmp-card:22:50|34:4,22:51|34:5,22:54|34:.why: Three matching ayat in the same order: the believers' forgiveness and noble provision, those who strive against the signs, and those given knowledge seeing it is the truth. A strong parallel for memorizers and for pondering.
cmp-card:22:50|34:4,22:51|34:5,22:54|34:.relation: One sequence in two surahs: the believers' reward, the opponents' end, and the knowers' recognition of the truth.

cmp-card:22:51|34:38.why: The same description of those who strive to defeat Our signs, with two endings a memorizer must keep apart.
cmp-card:22:51|34:38.relation: The end of those who strive against the signs.

cmp-card:22:63|34:1.why: Only heaven, earth and Aware; different points.

cmp-card:22:64|34:1.why: The same statement that all in the heavens and the earth is His, joined to praise.
cmp-card:22:64|34:1.relation: Owner of all, and so the Praised.

cmp-card:22:44|35:26.why: The same words: then I seized them, and how was My rejection.
cmp-card:22:44|35:26.relation: The end of those who denied the messengers.

cmp-card:22:50|35:7.why: Close wording a memorizer can confuse: forgiveness and noble provision (22:50), forgiveness and a great reward (35:7). Both set the believers against the deniers.
cmp-card:22:50|35:7.relation: The believers' forgiveness and reward, beside the deniers' punishment.

cmp-card:22:61|35:13.why: The same words for the alternation of night and day; 35:13 also matches 31:29 with the sun and moon.
cmp-card:22:61|35:13.relation: The turning of night and day as a sign of His power.

cmp-card:22:64|35:15.why: Only the stock closing the Rich, the Praised is shared; His ownership and people's need of Him are different points.

cmp-card:22:70|35:38.why: Only the stock statement of Allah's knowledge of the heavens and earth; nothing specific shared.

cmp-card:22:76|35:4.why: Only the stock closing that matters return to Allah is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:6|36:12.why: Both declare that Allah gives life to the dead, and close with His power or His record of all things.
cmp-card:22:6|36:12.relation: Giving life to the dead, and all things counted.

cmp-card:22:76|36:9.why: Before them and behind them means different things: Allah's knowledge and a barrier set on the deniers.

cmp-card:22:76|36:45.why: Only the phrase before and behind is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:14|39:20.why: Only the general phrase about rivers flowing beneath is shared; nothing specific to compare.

cmp-card:22:69|39:46.why: Both say Allah judges between people in what they differed; once as a statement, once in the Prophet's prayer.
cmp-card:22:69|39:46.relation: Every dispute is left to Allah's judgment.

cmp-card:22:7|40:59.why: The same declaration that the Hour is coming, no doubt in it, with two different continuations; a point for memorizers.
cmp-card:22:7|40:59.relation: The certainty of the Hour, and those who still do not believe.

cmp-card:22:61|40:20.why: Only the stock closing the Hearing, the Seeing is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:62|40:12,22:62|40:20.why: Allah is the Truth and what they call on besides Him is nothing; 22:62 and 40:12 both close with the Most High, the Great, and 40:20 says their gods judge nothing.
cmp-card:22:62|40:12,22:62|40:20.relation: Allah alone is the Truth and the Judge; the gods they call on have no power.

cmp-card:22:69|40:48.why: The promise that Allah will judge between people, and the proud in Hell admitting He has judged.

cmp-card:22:75|40:20.why: Only the stock closing the Hearing, the Seeing is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:6|41:39.why: Nearly the same closing: He gives life to the dead and is able over all things. In 41:39 it follows rain reviving the land.
cmp-card:22:6|41:39.relation: Reviving the dead earth as proof of reviving the dead.

cmp-card:22:50|41:8.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

cmp-card:22:60|41:6.why: Only incidental words are shared; retaliation and the message of one God are unrelated.

cmp-card:22:76|41:42.why: Before and behind means different things: Allah's knowledge, and the Book guarded from falsehood.

cmp-card:22:35|42:38.why: Two portraits of the believers ending the same way: they establish prayer and spend from what We provided.
cmp-card:22:35|42:38.relation: The marks of true believers: prayer and spending.

cmp-card:22:74|42:19.why: Only the stock closing the Strong, the Mighty is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:69|43:63.why: Only the word differ is shared; Allah's judgment on the Day and Isa explaining their differences are different points.

cmp-card:22:6|44:8.why: Only giving life is shared; the resurrection argument and the declaration of oneness are different points.

cmp-card:22:19|44:48.why: The same punishment in close words: scalding water poured over the head of the denier.
cmp-card:22:19|44:48.relation: The punishment of those who disputed about their Lord.

cmp-card:22:50|45:30.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

cmp-card:22:57|45:9,22:57|45:11.why: Those who deny or mock Our signs, and their punishment: humiliating in 22:57 and 45:9, painful in 45:11. A memorizer must keep the endings apart.
cmp-card:22:57|45:9,22:57|45:11.relation: Denying or mocking the signs brings a humiliating punishment.

cmp-card:22:6|46:33.why: Nearly the same closing: able to give life to the dead, and able over all things.
cmp-card:22:6|46:33.relation: His power over creation proves His power to raise the dead.

cmp-card:22:12|46:32.why: Only besides Him and error are shared; different points.

cmp-card:22:67|46:25.why: Only incidental words are shared; rites for each nation and the wind that destroyed Ad are unrelated.

cmp-card:22:14|47:12,22:23|47:12,22:56|4.why: 47:12 opens with exactly the same words as 22:14 and 22:23, then each goes its own way; a real trap for memorizers. 47:12 adds the contrast with the deniers who eat like cattle.
cmp-card:22:14|47:12,22:23|47:12,22:56|4.relation: Contrast in 47:12: gardens for the believers, the Fire for those who only enjoy and eat.

cmp-card:22:68|47:30.why: Only Allah's knowledge of deeds is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:6|48:21.why: Only the stock closing able over all things; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:14|48:5,22:23|48:5.why: 48:5 shares only the general reward of gardens with rivers; the specific opening that links 22:14 and 22:23 is not there.

cmp-card:22:70|49:16,22:70|49:18.why: Only the stock statement that Allah knows what is in the heavens and earth; the points differ (it is written in a book; you cannot teach Allah your religion).

cmp-card:22:75|49:1.why: Only messengers and a closing name are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:42|50:12.why: The same list of earlier nations who denied, with differences in the names; useful for memorizers and as consolation.
cmp-card:22:42|50:12.relation: The Prophet consoled: nations before denied their messengers too.

cmp-card:22:70|50:4.why: Both join Allah's knowledge to a book that records it.
cmp-card:22:70|50:4.relation: Allah's knowledge is complete and recorded.

cmp-card:22:6|54:49.why: Only all things and a word of the same root as power are shared; different statements.

cmp-card:22:22|54:37.why: Only taste the punishment is shared; different scenes.

cmp-card:22:42|54:9.why: The same opening about earlier nations who denied before them.
cmp-card:22:42|54:9.relation: Nations before denied their messengers too.

cmp-card:22:44|54:18.why: The same question after the destruction of a denying people, worded differently: how was My rejection, how was My punishment and warnings.
cmp-card:22:44|54:18.relation: The end of those who denied the messengers.

cmp-card:22:6|57:2.why: Both join giving life to His power over all things.
cmp-card:22:6|57:2.relation: He gives life and death, and nothing is beyond Him.

cmp-card:22:16|57:9.why: Both speak of clear signs sent down, and what they lead to: guidance (22:16), out of darkness into light (57:9).
cmp-card:22:16|57:9.relation: Clear signs sent down for guidance.

cmp-card:22:61|57:6.why: The same words for the alternation of night and day, with different closings.
cmp-card:22:61|57:6.relation: The turning of night and day as a sign of His power and knowledge.

cmp-card:22:64|57:24.why: Only the stock closing the Rich, the Praised is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:70|57:22.why: Both say all is in a book and close with the same words: that is easy for Allah.
cmp-card:22:70|57:22.relation: All things, even every misfortune, are recorded beforehand, and this is easy for Allah.

cmp-card:22:76|57:5.why: Only the stock closing that matters return to Allah is shared; different points.

cmp-card:22:74|58:21.why: Only the stock closing Strong, Mighty is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:69|60:3.why: Both say that on the Day of Resurrection Allah will judge between you; in 60:3 even kin and children will not help then.
cmp-card:22:69|60:3.relation: On the Day of Resurrection only Allah's judgment counts.

cmp-card:22:14|61:12.why: Only the general phrase about gardens with rivers is shared; nothing specific to compare.

cmp-card:22:10|62:7.why: Only the common phrase about what their hands sent ahead is shared; the disputer's punishment and the Jews not wishing for death are different points.

cmp-card:22:6|64:1.why: Only the stock closing able over all things; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:57|64:10.why: The same opening about those who disbelieve and deny Our signs, with different endings; a trap for memorizers.
cmp-card:22:57|64:10.relation: The end of those who deny the signs.

cmp-card:22:63|64:8.why: Only sent down and the closing Aware are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:70|64:4.why: Only the stock statement of Allah's knowledge of the heavens and earth; the points differ.

cmp-card:22:14|65:11.why: Only the general reward formula is shared; nothing specific to compare.

cmp-card:22:6|67:1.why: Only the stock closing able over all things; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:44|67:18.why: Both close the same way after earlier nations denied: how was My rejection.
cmp-card:22:44|67:18.relation: The end of those who denied before.

cmp-card:22:49|67:26.why: The same command to the Prophet to declare he is only a clear warner, in different settings.
cmp-card:22:49|67:26.relation: The Prophet's role: only a warner, the knowledge of the Hour is with Allah.

cmp-card:22:49|71:2.why: The same words of warning from Muhammad to mankind and from Nuh to his people.
cmp-card:22:49|71:2.relation: Every messenger is a clear warner to his people.

cmp-card:22:76|72:27.why: Only before and behind is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:22:50|84:25.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

cmp-card:22:14|85:11,22:23|85:11,22:56|8.why: Across the surahs only the general reward formula is shared; the specific opening that links 22:14 and 22:23 is not in 85:11.

cmp-card:22:50|95:6.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; the rewards named differ.

cmp-card:22:14|98:8.why: Only the general phrase about gardens with rivers is shared; nothing specific to compare.

cmp-card:22:41|98:5.why: Only the common pair of prayer and zakat is shared; the empowered believers and what the People of the Book were commanded are different points.

cmp-card:22:50|98:7.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; nothing more.

cmp-card:22:50|103:3.why: Only the stock formula of faith and good deeds; different points.

cmp-card:23:23|23:32,23:24|23:33.why: Two messengers in one surah call with the same words, and the chiefs answer with the same words: only a man like you. A clear trap for memorizers.
cmp-card:23:23|23:32,23:24|23:33.relation: Different prophets, one call, one rejection.

cmp-card:23:29|23:118,23:109|23:118.why: Three prayers in one surah closing with You are the best of; 23:109 and 23:118 ask forgiveness and mercy in near-identical words.
cmp-card:23:29|23:118,23:109|23:118.relation: The believer's prayer, praising Allah as the best of those who give.

cmp-card:23:35|23:82.why: The same denial of resurrection in one surah: once from a past people, once from the Quraysh, with different last words.
cmp-card:23:35|23:82.relation: The denial of resurrection repeats across generations.

cmp-card:23:41|23:94.why: Only the stock phrase the wrongdoing people is shared; a destroyed nation and a prayer not to be among them are different points.

cmp-card:23:112|23:113.why: These are a question and its answer in one passage, not two places to compare.

cmp-card:23:32|24:52.why: Only Allah and fearing Him are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:23:82|24:16.why: Only a speech verb and incidental words are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:23:47|26:70.why: Only people and worship are shared; different stories.

cmp-card:23:68|26:26.why: Only their forefathers of old is shared; different points.

cmp-card:23:94|26:10.why: Only the stock phrase the wrongdoing people; different points.

cmp-card:23:112|26:18.why: Only lingering for years is shared; different scenes.

cmp-card:23:117|26:213.why: The same warning against calling on another god with Allah, as a statement and as a command.
cmp-card:23:117|26:213.relation: Calling another god with Allah ends in failure and punishment.

cmp-card:23:32|27:45.why: The same call of a messenger sent to his people: worship Allah.
cmp-card:23:32|27:45.relation: Every messenger brought the same call.

cmp-card:23:35|27:67.why: The same denial of resurrection: when we are dust, shall we be brought out.
cmp-card:23:35|27:67.relation: The denial of resurrection repeats across generations.

cmp-card:23:82|27:67,23:83|27:68.why: Two consecutive ayat repeated in two surahs with small changes in order and wording; a key passage for memorizers.
cmp-card:23:82|27:67,23:83|27:68.relation: The deniers' argument against resurrection, in the same words.

cmp-card:23:86|27:26,23:116|27:26.why: The title Lord of the Throne with two adjectives, great and noble; 23:116 and 27:26 both say there is no god but He before it.
cmp-card:23:86|27:26,23:116|27:26.relation: Allah, the only God, Lord of the Throne.

cmp-card:23:28|28:21,23:94|28:21.why: Prophets ask to be saved from the wrongdoing people and praise Allah when saved: Nuh, Musa, and the Prophet's own prayer.
cmp-card:23:28|28:21,23:94|28:21.relation: Prophets seek refuge from the wrongdoing people.

cmp-card:23:29|28:24.why: The link rests on words of one root (sending down and good), used differently: Nuh asks a blessed landing, Musa declares his need.

cmp-card:23:109|28:16,23:118|28:16.why: Prayers for forgiveness: the believers, the Prophet, and Musa after his mistake, who is forgiven at once.
cmp-card:23:109|28:16,23:118|28:16.relation: Asking forgiveness, and Allah answering it.

cmp-card:23:118|28:24.why: Only my Lord and good are shared; different prayers.

cmp-card:23:23|29:16,23:23|29:36.why: Three prophets open their call with the same words: worship Allah, then each adds his own point.
cmp-card:23:23|29:16,23:23|29:36.relation: Different prophets calling their people with one message.

cmp-card:23:26|29:30,23:39|29:30.why: The same prayer word for word from two prophets in al-Muminun, and Lut's version with a different ending.
cmp-card:23:26|29:30,23:39|29:30.relation: Prophets asking Allah for help against their deniers.

cmp-card:23:47|29:16.why: Only people and worship are shared; different stories.

cmp-card:23:49|32:23.why: The same statement that Musa was given the Book, for guidance.
cmp-card:23:49|32:23.relation: The Book given to Musa as guidance.

cmp-card:23:50|32:24.why: Only We made and signs are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:23:78|32:9.why: The same words: He made for you hearing, sight and hearts; little do you give thanks. In 32:9 it follows the creation of man and the breathing of the spirit.
cmp-card:23:78|32:9.relation: The gifts of perception, and how little thanks they get.

cmp-card:23:92|32:6.why: The same title, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, with different endings; a memorizer must keep the endings apart.
cmp-card:23:92|32:6.relation: Allah's knowledge of the hidden and the seen.

cmp-card:23:99|32:11.why: Only death, Lord and return are shared; the dying man begging to go back and the angel of death taking souls are different points.

cmp-card:23:106|33:67.why: Two confessions of the people of the Fire, both opening our Lord and admitting going astray: one blames their own wretchedness, one blames their leaders.
cmp-card:23:106|33:67.relation: The excuses of the damned in the Fire.

cmp-card:23:38|34:8.why: The same accusation against a messenger: he has invented a lie about Allah.
cmp-card:23:38|34:8.relation: Deniers in every age accuse the messenger of lying about Allah.

cmp-card:23:70|34:49.why: Both answer the claim that the Prophet is possessed (23:70 and 34:46) with the same reply: the truth has come.
cmp-card:23:70|34:49.relation: The charge of madness answered by the coming of the truth.

cmp-card:23:28|35:34.why: The same praise, opening the same way, for being saved: Nuh from the wrongdoers, the people of Paradise from all grief.
cmp-card:23:28|35:34.relation: Praise to Allah for deliverance, in this world and the next.

cmp-card:23:47|36:15.why: The same refusal of messengers: you are only human like us.
cmp-card:23:47|36:15.relation: Deniers in every age reject a human messenger.

cmp-card:23:35|37:16,23:35|37:53.why: The same denial of resurrection: when we die and are dust and bones. The last word changes (brought out, raised, judged), a trap for memorizers.
cmp-card:23:35|37:16,23:35|37:53.relation: The denial of resurrection repeated across peoples.

cmp-card:23:47|37:85.why: Only people and worship are shared; different stories.

cmp-card:23:82|37:16,23:82|37:53.why: Nearly identical words in two surahs, with only the last word changed in 37:53; a clear trap for memorizers.
cmp-card:23:82|37:16,23:82|37:53.relation: The denial of resurrection repeated across peoples.

cmp-card:23:46|38:75.why: Pride and haughtiness named together of Pharaoh's chiefs and of Iblis.
cmp-card:23:46|38:75.relation: The same sin, arrogance, in Iblis and in Pharaoh's chiefs.

cmp-card:23:100|38:79.why: Only the stock phrase until the Day they are raised is shared; the barrier for the dead and Iblis's respite are different subjects.

cmp-card:23:86|39:13.why: Only Lord and great are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:23:45|40:23.why: The same sentence: We sent Musa with Our signs and a clear authority, once with Harun named.
cmp-card:23:45|40:23.relation: Musa sent with signs and clear proof.

cmp-card:23:47|41:6.why: The deniers reject a human messenger, and the Prophet himself says he is only human like them, but revelation comes to him.
cmp-card:23:47|41:6.relation: Contrast: shall we believe men like us; I am only a man like you, but I receive revelation.

cmp-card:23:47|43:26.why: Only people and worship are shared; different stories.

cmp-card:23:68|43:24.why: Only the fathers are shared; the points differ.

cmp-card:23:86|43:82.why: Both join the two titles, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the Throne.
cmp-card:23:86|43:82.relation: Lord of the heavens and of the Throne, above what they ascribe.

cmp-card:23:89|43:87.why: The same pattern: asked who is Lord or Creator, they will say Allah; then how are you deluded.
cmp-card:23:89|43:87.relation: They admit Allah is Creator yet turn away from Him.

cmp-card:23:46|45:31,23:105|45:31.why: 45:31 joins two phrases found in al-Muminun: were My signs not recited to you, and you were arrogant, a criminal people.
cmp-card:23:46|45:31,23:105|45:31.relation: Arrogance before the signs and its reckoning in the Hereafter.

cmp-card:23:62|45:29,23:66|45:31.why: The same pair in both surahs: a record that speaks the truth, and My signs were recited to you.
cmp-card:23:62|45:29,23:66|45:31.relation: The record of deeds and the signs that were rejected.

cmp-card:23:68|46:22.why: Only the verb come is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:23:109|46:11.why: Only incidental words are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:23:18|50:9.why: The same sign: water sent down from the sky, in measure or blessed.
cmp-card:23:18|50:9.relation: Rain as a sign of His power and blessing.

cmp-card:23:35|50:3,23:82|50:3.why: The same denial of resurrection; 50:3 is the short form without bones.
cmp-card:23:35|50:3,23:82|50:3.relation: The denial of resurrection across peoples.

cmp-card:23:106|50:27.why: Only our Lord and going astray are shared; the different scenes are not compared by these words.

cmp-card:23:35|56:47,23:82|56:47.why: 56:47 is almost the same as 23:82; a clear trap for memorizers.
cmp-card:23:35|56:47,23:82|56:47.relation: The denial of resurrection repeated across peoples.

cmp-card:23:86|56:74.why: Only Lord and Great are shared; different statements.

cmp-card:23:86|56:96.why: Only Lord and Great are shared; different statements.

cmp-card:23:18|57:2.why: Only heaven, earth and power are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:23:92|59:22.why: The same title, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, with different surroundings; a memorizer must keep them apart.
cmp-card:23:92|59:22.relation: Allah's knowledge of the hidden and the seen.

cmp-card:23:92|64:18.why: The same title, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, with different endings; a memorizer must keep them apart.
cmp-card:23:92|64:18.relation: Allah's knowledge of the hidden and the seen.

cmp-card:23:78|67:23,23:79|67:24.why: Two consecutive ayat repeated in two surahs with small changes; a key passage for memorizers.
cmp-card:23:78|67:23,23:79|67:24.relation: The gifts of perception, and the gathering to Him.

cmp-card:23:88|67:1.why: Both say dominion over all things is in His hand.
cmp-card:23:88|67:1.relation: All dominion is in Allah's hand.

cmp-card:23:86|69:52.why: Only Lord and Great are shared; different statements.

cmp-card:23:5|70:29,23:6|70:30,23:7|70:3.why: A run of five ayat describing the believers repeated almost word for word in two surahs; a key passage for memorizers, with small differences such as the prayer word in 23:9 and 70:34.
cmp-card:23:5|70:29,23:6|70:30,23:7|70:3.relation: The same portrait of the believers in two surahs.

cmp-card:23:32|71:3.why: The same call to worship Allah and fear Him, from a messenger and from Nuh.
cmp-card:23:32|71:3.relation: Every messenger brought the same call.

cmp-card:23:55|71:12.why: Wealth and sons given as provision: the deniers think it is a reward, Nuh promises it to those who seek forgiveness.
cmp-card:23:55|71:12.relation: Contrast: wealth and sons as a test that deceives, and as a blessing for repentance.

cmp-card:24:1|24:34,24:1|24:46.why: Three statements in one surah that clear signs were sent down, each with a different ending.
cmp-card:24:1|24:34,24:1|24:46.relation: Clear signs sent down for reminder, admonition and guidance.

cmp-card:24:6|24:8,24:7|24:9.why: The oaths of the husband and the wife mirror each other word for word, with truthful and liar swapped and curse and wrath.
cmp-card:24:6|24:8,24:7|24:9.relation: The mutual oaths of li'an, each answering the other.

cmp-card:24:8|24:13.why: Four testimonies in one surah: the wife's four oaths, and the four witnesses the slanderers failed to bring, so Allah calls them liars.
cmp-card:24:8|24:13.relation: Four testimonies as the measure of truth and lies.

cmp-card:24:10|24:20,24:14|24:19,24:14|2.why: The card holds two different repeated phrases linked only through 24:14: were it not for Allah's favour and mercy (24:10, 24:14, 24:20), and punishment in this world and the Hereafter (24:14, 24:19, 24:23). Each set is good on its own.
cmp-card:24:10|24:20,24:14|24:19,24:14|2.changes: Split into two cards: the favour and mercy phrase, and the punishment in this world and the Hereafter.
cmp-card:24:10|24:20,24:14|24:19,24:14|2.relation: Allah's favour that spared the believers, and the punishment of those who spread slander.

cmp-card:24:18|24:59.why: The same closing in one surah: thus Allah makes clear to you the signs, Knowing, Wise.
cmp-card:24:18|24:59.relation: The rulings of the surah are signs made clear.

cmp-card:24:19|24:23.why: Two warnings in one surah against slandering believers, both with punishment in this world and the Hereafter.
cmp-card:24:19|24:23.relation: The grave punishment of spreading indecency and slandering chaste women.

cmp-card:24:41|24:64.why: Only the stock closing about Allah's knowledge is shared; the glorification of all creatures and His ownership of all are different points.

cmp-card:24:47|24:51,24:48|24:51.why: In one passage the hypocrites say we obey, then turn away when called to the judgment of Allah and His Messenger; the believers, called in the same words, say we hear and obey.
cmp-card:24:47|24:51,24:48|24:51.relation: Contrast: the hypocrites' answer and the believers' answer to the same call.

cmp-card:24:5|25:70,24:5|25:71.why: The same exception for those who repent and reform, closing with Allah's forgiveness; 25:70 adds that their bad deeds are changed to good.
cmp-card:24:5|25:70,24:5|25:71.relation: Repentance opens the door even after grave sins.

cmp-card:24:5|27:11.why: The same pattern: except one who does wrong then changes to good, for Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
cmp-card:24:5|27:11.relation: Repentance after wrong meets Allah's forgiveness.

cmp-card:24:56|27:3.why: Only the common pair of prayer and zakat is shared; a command and a description of believers are different points.

cmp-card:24:64|27:87.why: Only the heavens, earth and the Day are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:24|29:55.why: Only the Day and what they did are shared; different scenes.

cmp-card:24:46|29:35.why: Only clear sign is shared; revealed ayat and the ruins of Lut's town are different subjects.

cmp-card:24:64|29:52.why: Only the stock statement of Allah's knowledge of the heavens and earth; the points differ.

cmp-card:24:28|31:23.why: Only a closing about Allah's knowledge is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:41|31:20.why: Only do you not see that Allah and the heavens and earth are shared; different signs.

cmp-card:24:56|31:4.why: Only the common pair of prayer and zakat is shared; different points.

cmp-card:24:64|31:25.why: Only the heavens and earth are shared; different points.

cmp-card:24:14|33:57.why: Only this world and the Hereafter and punishment are shared; the favour that spared the believers and the curse on those who harm Allah are different points.

cmp-card:24:15|33:63.why: Only knowledge and with Allah are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:23|33:57.why: The same sentence for two grave sins: slandering chaste believing women, and harming Allah and His Messenger. Both are cursed in this world and the Hereafter.
cmp-card:24:23|33:57.relation: Harming the innocent and the Prophet brings the same curse.

cmp-card:24:50|33:12.why: Those with disease in their hearts distrust Allah and His Messenger: fearing injustice, and calling the promise a delusion.
cmp-card:24:50|33:12.relation: The doubts of those with diseased hearts.

cmp-card:24:52|33:71.why: The same promise: whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has triumphed.
cmp-card:24:52|33:71.relation: Obedience to Allah and His Messenger is success.

cmp-card:24:54|33:66.why: The command to obey Allah and obey the Messenger, and the damned in the Fire wishing they had obeyed, in the same words.
cmp-card:24:54|33:66.relation: Contrast: the command now, and the regret then.

cmp-card:24:64|33:40.why: Only the stock closing Allah knows all things; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:24|36:54.why: Only the Day and what they did are shared; 36:54 is not the ayah about limbs testifying.

cmp-card:24:46|37:23.why: Only guiding to a path is shared, and the paths are opposite: the straight path and the path of Hell.

cmp-card:24:46|37:118.why: Only the straight path is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:1|38:29.why: Both say the revelation was sent down so that people take heed.
cmp-card:24:1|38:29.relation: The purpose of revelation: reflection and remembrance.

cmp-card:24:42|38:10.why: Only the dominion of the heavens and earth is shared; different points.

cmp-card:24:19|39:26.why: Only this world and the Hereafter are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:42|39:44.why: Only dominion and return to Him are shared; different points.

cmp-card:24:38|40:40.why: The same phrase, provision without measure, for those who do good.
cmp-card:24:38|40:40.relation: The reward of the righteous is beyond reckoning.

cmp-card:24:48|40:48.why: Only judging between is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:24|41:20.why: The same scene: their own bodies testify against them about what they used to do; the organs named differ.
cmp-card:24:24|41:20.relation: On that Day one's own limbs bear witness.

cmp-card:24:42|42:53.why: Only the stock statement that all returns to Allah is shared; nothing specific to compare.

cmp-card:24:64|42:12.why: Only the stock closing Allah knows all things; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:46|43:64.why: Only the straight path is shared; different points.

cmp-card:24:42|45:27.why: Only the stock opening about the dominion of the heavens and earth is shared; what follows differs.

cmp-card:24:15|46:23.why: Only knowledge and with Allah are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:19|46:31.why: Only painful punishment is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:41|46:33.why: Only the rebuke and the heavens and earth are shared; different signs.

cmp-card:24:64|46:33.why: Only the heavens and earth and all things are shared; different points.

cmp-card:24:50|47:29.why: Those with disease in their hearts: their doubt about Allah's justice, and their belief that their hidden hatred will not be exposed.
cmp-card:24:50|47:29.relation: The hidden doubts of the hypocrites.

cmp-card:24:52|47:33.why: Only the command to obey Allah and the Messenger is shared; nothing more specific.

cmp-card:24:42|48:14.why: Only the stock opening about the dominion of the heavens and earth is shared; what follows differs.

cmp-card:24:46|48:2.why: Only guidance to a straight path is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:5|49:5.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:5|49:10.why: Only reconciling and mercy are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:10|49:8.why: Only the bounty of Allah and Wise are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:41|49:16.why: Only the heavens and earth and a closing about knowledge; different points.

cmp-card:24:64|49:16,24:64|49:18.why: Only the stock statement of Allah's knowledge of the heavens and earth; the points of the ayat differ.

cmp-card:24:16|56:47.why: Only incidental words are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:42|57:2.why: Only the stock statement of His dominion over the heavens and earth; what follows differs.

cmp-card:24:42|57:5,24:46|57:9.why: 24:42 and 57:5 match in both halves, dominion and return to Allah, with small differences that trap a memorizer; 24:46 and 57:9 both speak of clear signs sent down to guide.
cmp-card:24:42|57:5,24:46|57:9.relation: All dominion and all return belong to Allah, who sends clear signs to guide.

cmp-card:24:57|57:15.why: Only the stock closing about the Fire as refuge and a wretched destination is shared; different points.

cmp-card:24:64|58:6,24:64|58:7.why: The same pair: Allah knows what is in the heavens and earth and will inform them of what they did; 24:64 and 58:7 also share the closing. A trap for memorizers.
cmp-card:24:64|58:6,24:64|58:7.relation: Allah knows all, and on the Day He tells each what they did.

cmp-card:24:14|59:3.why: The same pattern: were it not for what Allah granted or decreed, punishment would have struck them in this world, beside the Hereafter.
cmp-card:24:14|59:3.relation: Allah's grace or decree holds back a punishment that was deserved.

cmp-card:24:19|59:3.why: Only punishment in this world and the Hereafter is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:45|59:6.why: Only the stock closing able over all things; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:38|62:4.why: Only His bounty to whom He wills is shared; nothing specific.

cmp-card:24:41|64:4.why: Only the heavens and earth and a closing about knowledge; different points.

cmp-card:24:42|64:3.why: Only the heavens and earth and the return to Him; different points.

cmp-card:24:52|64:12.why: Only obeying Allah and the Messenger is shared; the reward of obedience and the Messenger's duty to convey are different points.

cmp-card:24:57|64:10.why: Only the stock closing about the Fire and a wretched destination is shared; different points.

cmp-card:24:64|64:1.why: Only what is in the heavens and earth is shared; different points.

cmp-card:24:64|64:4.why: Only the stock statement of Allah's knowledge of the heavens and earth; nothing specific.

cmp-card:24:45|65:12.why: Only creation and able over all things; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:64|65:12.why: Only the stock statement of knowing all things; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:24|66:7.why: Only the Day and what they did are shared; different scenes.

cmp-card:24:57|66:9.why: Only the stock closing about the Fire and a wretched destination is shared.

cmp-card:24:15|67:26.why: Only knowledge and with Allah are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:24:57|67:6.why: Only the stock closing a wretched destination is shared.

cmp-card:24:42|85:9.why: Only the stock statement of His dominion is shared.

cmp-card:24:64|85:9.why: Only the heavens and earth and all things are shared.

cmp-card:25:27|25:57.why: In one surah: the wrongdoer on the Day wishes he had taken a way with the Messenger, and the Messenger asks no reward but that people take a way to their Lord.
cmp-card:25:27|25:57.relation: Contrast: the open way to the Lord now, and the regret of not taking it then.

cmp-card:25:41|25:43.why: Only the verb take is shared, in different senses: taking the Prophet as a joke, and taking desire as a god.

cmp-card:25:47|25:62.why: The same opening in one surah: He is the One who made the night and the day, for rest and work, and following one another for reflection and thanks.
cmp-card:25:47|25:62.relation: Night and day as mercy and as a reminder.

cmp-card:25:6|26:24.why: Only the heavens and earth are shared; different points.

cmp-card:25:36|26:15.why: The same command to Musa and Harun: go, both of you, with Our signs.
cmp-card:25:36|26:15.relation: One story: Musa and Harun sent to Pharaoh.

cmp-card:25:36|26:117.why: Only people and denial are shared; different stories.

cmp-card:25:57|26:109,25:57|26:127,25:57.why: Every messenger in ash-Shuara says the same words, and the Prophet in al-Furqan says them with his own ending.
cmp-card:25:57|26:109,25:57|26:127,25:57.relation: No messenger asks a reward; their reward is with the Lord of the worlds.

cmp-card:25:6|27:65.why: Only the heavens, earth and knowledge are shared; different points.

cmp-card:25:36|27:84.why: Only denying the signs is shared; different scenes.

cmp-card:25:48|27:63.why: The same words: He sends the winds as glad tidings before His mercy.
cmp-card:25:48|27:63.relation: The winds before the rain as a sign of mercy.

cmp-card:25:55|27:43.why: Only worship besides Allah is shared; different points.

cmp-card:25:47|28:73,25:62|28:73.why: Night and day made for you: for rest and rising (25:47), for remembrance and thanks (25:62), for rest and seeking bounty and thanks (28:73).
cmp-card:25:47|28:73,25:62|28:73.relation: Night and day as a mercy calling for thanks.

cmp-card:25:68|28:88.why: The same prohibition: do not call on another god with Allah.

cmp-card:25:70|28:67,25:71|28:67.why: The same words of repentance, faith and good deeds, each with its own promise.
cmp-card:25:70|28:67,25:71|28:67.relation: Repentance with faith and good deeds leads to success.

cmp-card:25:1|29:16.why: Only incidental words are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:25:70|29:7.why: Both promise that bad deeds are wiped out: changed into good deeds, or expiated.
cmp-card:25:70|29:7.relation: Faith and good deeds erase past sins.

cmp-card:25:35|32:23.why: The same opening: We gave Musa the Book, with different continuations.

cmp-card:25:73|32:22.why: The same situation, being reminded of the signs of one's Lord, with opposite responses.
cmp-card:25:73|32:22.relation: Contrast: the believers do not fall deaf and blind; the wrongdoer turns away.

cmp-card:25:2|33:27.why: Only all things and earth are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:25:56|33:45.why: The same statement: We sent you as a bringer of good news and a warner, with witness added in 33:45.

cmp-card:25:57|33:67.why: Only the word way is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:25:70|33:24.why: Only repentance and the closing Forgiving, Merciful are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:25:70|33:73.why: Only repentance and the closing Forgiving, Merciful are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:25:17|34:40.why: The same scene: on the Day He gathers them and asks the ones they worshipped about their worshippers.
cmp-card:25:17|34:40.relation: The worshipped are questioned before their worshippers.

cmp-card:25:43|34:51.why: Only incidental words are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:25:56|34:28.why: The same statement: We sent you only as a bearer of good news and a warner, with to all people added in 34:28.
cmp-card:25:56|34:28.relation: The Prophet's mission, to all mankind.

cmp-card:25:57|34:47.why: The Prophet tells them twice that he asks no reward for the message.
cmp-card:25:57|34:47.relation: The messenger asks no reward; his reward is with Allah.

cmp-card:25:59|38:27.why: Only the common phrase about creating the heavens, earth and what is between them is shared; the six days and the denial that creation is in vain are different points.

cmp-card:25:3|39:43.why: The same argument against the gods they take besides Allah: they own nothing.
cmp-card:25:3|39:43.relation: Gods that own nothing cannot be worshipped or intercede.

cmp-card:25:17|40:74.why: Both show, in the Hereafter, the false gods failing their worshippers and the worshippers lost.
cmp-card:25:17|40:74.relation: On the Day the worshipped and their worshippers part ways.

cmp-card:25:55|40:74.why: Only besides Allah is shared; different points.

cmp-card:25:77|40:60.why: Both make calling on Allah the measure of a person, with a threat for those who refuse.
cmp-card:25:77|40:60.relation: Supplication is what gives a person worth before Allah.

cmp-card:25:71|41:33.why: Only good deeds and to Allah are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:25:2|42:49.why: Only the stock statement of His dominion and creation is shared; what follows differs.

cmp-card:25:17|42:46.why: Only besides Allah and way are shared; different points.

cmp-card:25:34|42:46.why: Only going astray and way are shared; different points.

cmp-card:25:42|42:44.why: Only seeing the punishment and way are shared; the points differ.

cmp-card:25:43|42:6.why: Both tell the Prophet he is not a guardian over those who take other gods.
cmp-card:25:43|42:6.relation: The Prophet is not responsible for those who choose other gods.

cmp-card:25:1|44:3.why: Both speak of the revelation sent down, as blessed, in order to warn.
cmp-card:25:1|44:3.relation: The Quran sent down as a warning.

cmp-card:25:59|44:38.why: Only the common phrase about creating the heavens, earth and what is between them; different points.

cmp-card:25:59|46:3.why: Only the common phrase about creating the heavens, earth and what is between them; different points.

cmp-card:25:6|48:14.why: Only the closing Forgiving, Merciful is shared.

cmp-card:26:156|26:189.why: The punishment of a great day: threatened to Thamud, and fallen on the people of Shuayb.
cmp-card:26:156|26:189.relation: The warned punishment of a great day comes true.

cmp-card:26:2|27:1.relation: The surahs open by naming the clear Book.
