cmp-card:26:10|28:21.why: The same people named twice in Musa's story: he fled them praying to be saved from the wrongdoing people, and later was sent back to them.
cmp-card:26:10|28:21.relation: Musa saved from the wrongdoing people, then sent back to call them.

cmp-card:26:12|28:33.why: Musa's fear at his commission, in the same opening words: that they will deny me, that they will kill me.
cmp-card:26:12|28:33.relation: One story: Musa's fears when sent to Pharaoh.

cmp-card:26:31|28:49.why: Only the general challenge bring it if you are truthful is shared, and the roles are reversed: Pharaoh challenging Musa, the Prophet challenging the deniers.

cmp-card:26:70|29:16.why: Ibrahim addressing his people about worship in both surahs.
cmp-card:26:70|29:16.relation: One story: Ibrahim calling his people from idols to Allah.

cmp-card:26:93|29:22.why: Only besides Allah and help are shared; different points.

cmp-card:26:97|31:11.why: Only the stock phrase clear error is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:26:192|32:2.why: Both say the Book is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
cmp-card:26:192|32:2.relation: The Quran sent down by the Lord of the worlds.

cmp-card:26:213|33:57.why: Only Allah and punishment are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:26:24|34:24.why: Only the heavens and earth are shared; different points.

cmp-card:26:109|34:47,26:127|34:47,26:14.why: The prophets' refrain of ash-Shuara and the Prophet's own words in Saba: no reward asked, my reward is with Allah.
cmp-card:26:109|34:47,26:127|34:47,26:14.relation: Every messenger, including the last, asks no reward.

cmp-card:26:5|36:46.why: The same pattern: no reminder or sign comes to them but they turn away from it.
cmp-card:26:5|36:46.relation: The deniers turn away from every reminder.

cmp-card:26:93|36:74.why: The gods taken besides Allah for help that cannot help.

cmp-card:26:186|36:15.why: The same refusal of messengers: you are only human like us, and liars.
cmp-card:26:186|36:15.relation: Deniers in every age reject a human messenger.

cmp-card:26:24|38:10.why: Only the stock phrase the heavens, earth and what is between them; different points.

cmp-card:26:24|38:66.why: Only the common title Lord of the heavens, earth and what is between them; Musa's answer to Pharaoh and the declaration in Sad differ in point.

cmp-card:26:24|39:44.why: Only the heavens and earth are shared; different points.

cmp-card:26:135|39:13,26:156|39:13.why: The same warning, the punishment of a great day; 26:135 and 39:13 both open with I fear.
cmp-card:26:135|39:13,26:156|39:13.relation: Fear of the punishment of a great day, from Hud and from the Prophet.

cmp-card:26:111|40:38.why: Only believe and follow are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:26:93|42:31.why: Only besides Allah and help are shared; the false gods questioned in Hell and the general statement of no protector are different points.

cmp-card:26:24|43:82.why: Only the common title Lord of the heavens and earth is shared; different contexts.

cmp-card:26:70|43:26.why: Ibrahim speaking to his father and his people about what they worship, in the same words.
cmp-card:26:70|43:26.relation: One story: Ibrahim questioning and disowning his people's worship.

cmp-card:26:74|43:22,26:74|43:24.why: The same excuse of following the fathers, given to Ibrahim and to every messenger, and the messenger's answer.
cmp-card:26:74|43:22,26:74|43:24.relation: Blind following of forefathers as the deniers' excuse.

cmp-card:26:97|43:40.why: Only the stock phrase clear error is shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:26:202|43:66.why: The same words: it comes upon them suddenly while they do not perceive. Once of the punishment, once of the Hour.
cmp-card:26:202|43:66.relation: The punishment and the Hour come suddenly.

cmp-card:26:24|44:7,26:26|44:8.why: Two consecutive answers of Musa match two consecutive ayat of ad-Dukhan word for word: the Lord of the heavens and earth if you are certain, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.
cmp-card:26:24|44:7,26:26|44:8.relation: The same description of the Lord, by Musa before Pharaoh and in the Quran's own voice.

cmp-card:26:24|44:29.why: Only the heaven and earth are shared; different points.

cmp-card:26:24|44:38.why: Only the stock phrase the heavens, earth and what is between them; different points.

cmp-card:26:31|44:36,26:154|44:36.why: Deniers demanding a proof from their messenger in the same challenge: bring it, if you are truthful.
cmp-card:26:31|44:36,26:154|44:36.relation: Deniers in every age demand a sign from the messenger.

cmp-card:26:134|44:52,26:147|44:52.why: Gardens and springs: the worldly blessings of Ad and Thamud that they lost, and the gardens and springs of the righteous in Paradise.
cmp-card:26:134|44:52,26:147|44:52.relation: Contrast: gardens and springs lost by the deniers, gained forever by the righteous.

cmp-card:26:24|45:36.why: Only the common title Lord of the heavens and earth is shared; different contexts.

cmp-card:26:31|45:25.why: Deniers demanding a proof from their messenger in the same challenge: bring it, if you are truthful.
cmp-card:26:31|45:25.relation: Deniers in every age demand a sign from the messenger.

cmp-card:26:12|46:13.why: Only fear and Lord are shared; different subjects.

cmp-card:26:31|46:22,26:154|46:22.why: Three deniers in three stories challenge their messenger with the same words: bring it, if you are truthful.
cmp-card:26:31|46:22,26:154|46:22.relation: Deniers in every age demand a sign from the messenger.

cmp-card:26:24|48:7.why: Only the heavens and earth are shared.

cmp-card:26:24|50:38.why: Only the stock phrase the heavens, earth and what is between them; different points.

cmp-card:26:176|50:14.relation: The people of the Thicket and their denial.

cmp-card:26:213|50:26.why: Setting up another god with Allah leads to punishment: a warning, and the sentence carried out.
cmp-card:26:213|50:26.relation: Warning and fulfilment: another god with Allah ends in punishment.

cmp-card:26:24|51:23.why: Only Lord, heaven and earth are shared; different points.

cmp-card:26:5|52:34.why: Only come and new speech are shared; different points.

cmp-card:26:24|52:36.relation: Creation of the heavens and earth should bring certainty about their Lord.

cmp-card:26:31|52:34,26:154|52:34.why: The roles are reversed: in 26:31 and 26:154 deniers challenge a messenger, in 52:34 Allah challenges the deniers to produce speech like the Quran. Only the stock form of the challenge is shared.

cmp-card:39:25|71:1.why: Only the words before and punishment coming; past deniers seized and Nuh sent to warn make no real pair.

cmp-card:39:26|71:4.why: Only the stock phrase if they knew; worldly disgrace and Nuh's promise of respite differ.

cmp-card:39:31|83:6.why: Only the Day and the Lord are shared; disputing before the Lord and people standing for Him is too generic a link.

cmp-card:39:44|85:9.why: Only the stock phrase about the dominion of the heavens and the earth.

cmp-card:39:20|98:8.why: Only the generic reward formula of rivers flowing beneath; different wording otherwise.

cmp-card:40:39|41:31.why: Only the stock pair this world and the Hereafter; worldly life as enjoyment and the angels as allies differ.

cmp-card:40:62|41:54.why: Only Lord and all things are shared; creator of all things and doubt about meeting the Lord differ.

cmp-card:40:84|41:6.why: Only the words one and polytheists; a belated faith on seeing the punishment and the Prophet's call are different subjects.

cmp-card:40:2|42:17.why: Only the Book sent down, in different word forms and sentence shapes; no real match.

cmp-card:40:49|43:49.why: Only the call on your Lord; the people of the Fire and Pharaoh's people speaking to Musa are different scenes.

cmp-card:40:57|43:9.why: Only the creation of the heavens and the earth, a stock phrase used for different points.

cmp-card:40:17|45:14.why: Only the recompense for what they earned; the Day of Judgment and forgiving those who do not hope are different subjects. The close match for 40:17 is 45:22.

cmp-card:40:64|45:36.why: Only the title Lord of the worlds; His favours on creation and a closing praise differ.

cmp-card:40:65|45:36.why: Only the praise formula and the title Lord of the worlds are shared; a stock closing, as in other praise pairs.

cmp-card:40:74|47:10.why: Only before and disbelievers; idols failing their worshippers and destroyed nations differ.

cmp-card:40:2|58:21.why: Only scattered words (Book, Allah, Mighty); different subjects.

cmp-card:40:56|58:1.why: Only disputing and the closing Hearing, Seeing; arrogant disputers of the signs and the woman pleading about her husband are different subjects.

cmp-card:40:43|59:3.why: Only this world, the Hereafter and the Fire, stock wording; a believer's speech and the exile of a tribe differ.

cmp-card:40:49|72:20.why: Only calling on a Lord; the people of the Fire and the Prophet's declaration of worship differ.

cmp-card:39:43|46:28.why: Both ask about the gods taken besides Allah and show they are of no use: unable to intercede, absent when help was needed.
cmp-card:39:43|46:28.relation: Same theme: the intercessors and gods they took besides Allah fail them.

cmp-card:39:44|57:5.why: The full statement matches: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Him everything returns. Useful for memorizers.
cmp-card:39:44|57:5.relation: Dominion and return to Allah, in two wordings.

cmp-card:39:46|62:8.why: The rare title Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, each time with Allah judging or informing them of what they did.
cmp-card:39:46|62:8.relation: Allah who knows the unseen will judge their disputes and their deeds.

cmp-card:39:54|71:1.why: The same warning in nearly the same words: before the punishment comes to you. Here to this nation, there Nuh to his people.
cmp-card:39:54|71:1.relation: The same warning given by Nuh and by this message.

cmp-card:39:13|76:10.why: Fear of a terrible day from the Lord, said by the Prophet and by the righteous. Useful to ponder side by side.
cmp-card:39:13|76:10.relation: The Prophet and the righteous share one fear of the Day.

cmp-card:39:11|98:5.why: The same command, worship Allah sincere to Him in religion, given to the Prophet and to the people of the Book.
cmp-card:39:11|98:5.relation: One command for the Prophet and for earlier communities.

cmp-card:40:4|40:69.why: Two places in one surah on those who dispute about the signs of Allah: a memorizer can mix them, and they frame the surah's theme.
cmp-card:40:4|40:69.relation: Those who dispute about the signs, and how they are turned away.

cmp-card:40:20|40:74,40:50|40:74.why: Three places on calling on others besides Allah: they decide nothing, the disbelievers' call is lost, and in the Fire they admit they called on nothing.
cmp-card:40:20|40:74,40:50|40:74.relation: What they call on besides Allah fails them, here and in the Fire.

cmp-card:40:22|40:50.why: Messengers came with clear proofs: in the account of past nations and in the dialogue of the keepers of Hell. Same wording, same point.
cmp-card:40:22|40:50.relation: The proofs came; denial left them without excuse.

cmp-card:40:55|40:77.why: The same command in one surah: be patient, the promise of Allah is true. A memorizer needs to tell the two continuations apart.
cmp-card:40:55|40:77.relation: Patience grounded in the truth of Allah's promise.

cmp-card:40:63|41:28.why: The rare closing about rejecting the signs of Allah, in neighbouring surahs: turned away in this world, the Fire as their recompense.
cmp-card:40:63|41:28.relation: Rejecting the signs leads to delusion and then the Fire.

cmp-card:40:74|41:48.why: The same scene: what they used to call on before is lost to them. Near-identical wording in neighbouring surahs.
cmp-card:40:74|41:48.relation: Their idols vanish from them on the Day.

cmp-card:40:74|42:46.why: Both close on the same point: no one besides Allah helps them, and whom Allah leaves astray has no way.
cmp-card:40:74|42:46.relation: Those besides Allah fail; misguidance is from Allah.

cmp-card:40:39|43:35.why: The life of this world is only enjoyment and the Hereafter is better: the same lesson, from the believer of Pharaoh's people and in a general statement.
cmp-card:40:39|43:35.relation: Worldly enjoyment against the lasting Hereafter.

cmp-card:40:62|43:87.why: The same argument closes both: Allah is the creator, so how are you turned away?
cmp-card:40:62|43:87.relation: They admit Allah created them, yet turn away.

cmp-card:40:79|43:12.why: The same favour: He made livestock for you to ride. Worth pondering together.
cmp-card:40:79|43:12.relation: Livestock and ships made for riding as a sign of His favour.

cmp-card:40:2|45:2.why: Near-identical openings that differ only in the last divine name. Classic material for memorizers.

cmp-card:40:17|45:22.why: Every soul is repaid for what it earned and none is wronged: the same rare statement in two settings.
cmp-card:40:17|45:22.relation: Creation in truth so that every soul is repaid with justice.

cmp-card:40:2|46:2.why: Near-identical openings that differ only in the last divine name. Classic material for memorizers.

cmp-card:40:21|47:10,40:82|47:10.why: The refrain about travelling the earth and seeing the end of those before, with three different continuations to keep apart.
cmp-card:40:21|47:10,40:82|47:10.relation: The ruin of past nations as a lesson for the deniers.

cmp-card:40:55|50:39.why: The same command: be patient and glorify with the praise of your Lord, with different times named.
cmp-card:40:55|50:39.relation: Patience paired with glorification, in two places.

cmp-card:40:55|52:48.why: The same command: be patient and glorify with the praise of your Lord, with different times named.
cmp-card:40:55|52:48.relation: Patience paired with glorification, in two places.

cmp-card:40:22|59:4.why: Both explain a punishment by the same opening and close on Allah being severe in penalty: denying the messengers and opposing Allah and His messenger.
cmp-card:40:22|59:4.relation: Opposing the messengers brings the severe penalty.

cmp-card:40:6|64:10.why: The disbelievers are the companions of the Fire: the same verdict, as Allah's word fulfilled and as the end of those who denied.

cmp-card:40:22|64:6,40:50|64:6.why: Messengers came with clear proofs and they disbelieved: 40:22 and 64:6 share almost the whole opening, and 40:50 is the same point in Hell.
cmp-card:40:22|64:6,40:50|64:6.relation: The same reason for ruin: clear proofs met with denial.

cmp-card:40:48|40:60.why: The arrogant in the Fire and the warning that those too arrogant to worship will enter Hell: the threat and its fulfilment in one surah.
cmp-card:40:48|40:60.relation: The warning against arrogance and the arrogant in the Fire.

cmp-card:40:69|40:81.why: Disputing the signs of Allah and denying the signs He shows: close wording in one surah, but a thin link.

cmp-card:40:22|98:1.why: Only the clear proofs coming to them; past nations destroyed for denial and the people of the Book waiting for a proof are different points.

cmp-card:42:12|42:29.why: Only the heavens and the earth, His will and a stock closing; provision and the spread of creatures are different signs.

cmp-card:44:7|44:29.why: Only the heavens and the earth; the divine title and the sky not weeping over Pharaoh's people are unrelated.

cmp-card:44:7|44:38.why: Only the stock title of the heavens, the earth and what is between them; a title and a statement on creation not in play make no real pair.

cmp-card:45:15|45:30.why: Only deeds and the Lord; a general rule of personal responsibility and the believers' entry into mercy are too loosely linked.

cmp-card:45:22|64:1.why: Only the heavens and the earth; creation for just recompense and universal glorification differ.

cmp-card:45:36|64:1.why: Only praise and the heavens and the earth, in different statements.

cmp-card:45:11|67:6.why: Only the stock link of disbelieving in their Lord and punishment; different contexts.

cmp-card:45:36|78:37.why: Only the stock title Lord of the heavens and the earth; a closing praise and the silence of the Day differ.

cmp-card:45:26|83:6.why: Only the Day and people; too generic a link.

cmp-card:45:30|84:25.why: Only the believe-and-do-good formula is shared; the rewards are worded differently, so nothing specific to learn.

cmp-card:46:2|48:19.why: Only the closing names Mighty and Wise are shared; the revelation of the Book and this ayah are different subjects.

cmp-card:46:22|49:17.why: Only the stock ending if you are truthful; Hud's people demanding the punishment and a rebuke of the Bedouins differ.

cmp-card:46:33|49:16.why: Only the heavens and the earth and a stock closing; His power to revive and His knowledge of their religion differ.

cmp-card:46:22|51:5.why: Only words of promise and truth in different forms; a demand of deniers and the answer of an oath are unrelated.

cmp-card:46:22|52:34.why: The shared challenge runs in opposite directions: Hud's people challenge their prophet, while 52:34 challenges the deniers. Only a stock phrase links them.

cmp-card:46:22|68:41.why: The shared challenge runs in opposite directions: deniers challenge their prophet in 46:22, Allah challenges the deniers in 68:41.

cmp-card:46:14|81:22.why: A chance likeness of words with different meanings (companions of the Garden, your companion); nothing to learn.

cmp-card:46:33|64:1.why: Only the stock closing about power over all things.

cmp-card:46:33|85:9.why: Only the heavens and the earth and a stock closing.

cmp-card:47:32|47:34.why: This pair is already on the card that joins 47:1, 47:32 and 47:34; a separate card repeats it.

cmp-card:47:33|64:8.why: Only believing in Allah and His messenger, stock wording; the close match for 47:33 is 64:12.

cmp-card:41:14|41:30.why: In one surah: deniers say that if their Lord willed He would send angels, and angels do descend on those who say our Lord is Allah and stand firm.
cmp-card:41:14|41:30.relation: Contrast: the angels the deniers demanded descend on the steadfast believers.

cmp-card:41:20|41:22.why: Hearing, sight and skins testify against them, and they did not hide from that testimony: one scene in two ayat close together.
cmp-card:41:20|41:22.relation: The body's own witness against the sinner.

cmp-card:42:6|42:9.why: Two ayat in one passage about taking protectors besides Him, with different answers: Allah watches them, and Allah alone is the Protector.
cmp-card:42:6|42:9.relation: False protectors against the true Protector.

cmp-card:43:24|43:30.why: The deniers' reply that they disbelieve in what was sent: to the earlier messengers and to the truth that came to Quraysh. Close wording in one surah.
cmp-card:43:24|43:30.relation: The same rejection repeated by every generation.

cmp-card:45:3|45:13.why: Signs in the heavens and the earth, for believers and for people who reflect: close wording in one surah, useful for memorizers.

cmp-card:45:10|45:19.why: What they took besides Allah avails them nothing, and the wrongdoers are allies of one another while Allah is the ally of the righteous. One theme in one surah.
cmp-card:45:10|45:19.relation: False allies against the true Ally.

cmp-card:45:24|45:26.why: A claim and its answer: they say only time gives life and death, and the reply says Allah gives life, then death, then gathers you.
cmp-card:45:24|45:26.relation: Answer to the deniers: life and death are from Allah, not from time.

cmp-card:45:22|64:3.why: The same statement: He created the heavens and the earth in truth, followed by the purpose (recompense, and return to Him).
cmp-card:45:22|64:3.relation: Creation in truth points to the return and the reckoning.

cmp-card:45:8|84:24.why: The same rare sentence on those who turn from the recited signs: give them tidings of a painful punishment. In 84:21 they do not prostrate when the Quran is recited.
cmp-card:45:8|84:24.relation: Turning from the recited Quran earns the same tidings.

cmp-card:46:3|50:38.why: The same opening on creating the heavens, the earth and what is between them, with two continuations (in truth, in six days without fatigue). Worth keeping apart.
cmp-card:46:3|50:38.relation: Creation has a purpose and costs Him no effort.

cmp-card:46:14|52:16.why: The same closing, repaid for what they used to do, for the people of the Garden and for the people of the Fire.
cmp-card:46:14|52:16.relation: Contrast: the same justice gives the Garden and the Fire.

cmp-card:46:14|56:24.why: The same closing about the reward of the Garden for what they used to do.

cmp-card:46:14|66:7.why: The same closing, repaid for what they used to do, for the people of the Garden and for the disbelievers in the Fire.
cmp-card:46:14|66:7.relation: Contrast: the same justice gives the Garden and the Fire.

cmp-card:46:33|57:2.why: He gives life to the dead and has power over all things: the same point about resurrection.
cmp-card:46:33|57:2.relation: His power over life and death answers doubt about the resurrection.

cmp-card:46:33|65:12.why: Both argue from the creation of the heavens and the earth to His power over all things.
cmp-card:46:33|65:12.relation: Creation as the proof of His power, including over resurrection.

cmp-card:46:3|64:3.why: The heavens and the earth were created in truth, with the return or appointed term following.
cmp-card:46:3|64:3.relation: Creation in truth points to a return.

cmp-card:47:1|47:32,47:1|47:34.why: The same opening on those who disbelieve and turn others from the way of Allah, three times in one surah with three different endings. Strong memorizer material.
cmp-card:47:1|47:32,47:1|47:34.relation: Their deeds are lost, they cannot harm Allah, and they are not forgiven.

cmp-card:47:1|63:2.why: Turning people from the way of Allah, by the disbelievers and by the hypocrites, with their deeds judged as lost or evil.
cmp-card:47:1|63:2.relation: Disbelievers and hypocrites share one crime.

cmp-card:47:33|64:12.why: The same command: obey Allah and obey the Messenger, with two consequences.

cmp-card:43:9|43:84,43:9|43:87.why: 43:9 and 43:87 ask the same question: if you asked them who created, they would say Allah. A clear pair for memorizers and for the argument.
cmp-card:43:9|43:84,43:9|43:87.changes: Removed 43:84: it shares only the closing divine name All-Knowing, not the question.
cmp-card:43:9|43:84,43:9|43:87.relation: They admit Allah is the Creator yet worship others.

cmp-card:45:22|85:9.why: Only the heavens and the earth; creation for just recompense and His witness over all things differ.

cmp-card:47:19|71:4.why: Only forgiveness of sins; the Prophet told to seek forgiveness and Nuh's promise to his people are different subjects.

cmp-card:47:6|89:30.why: Only entering the Garden, in different words; a general promise and the address to the soul at peace.

cmp-card:47:2|103:3.why: Only the believe-and-do-good formula; the rest differs.

cmp-card:48:21|54:49.why: Only every thing and a shared root in different senses; spoils promised and creation by measure differ.

cmp-card:48:8|74:36.why: Only the word warner; the Prophet's mission and the Fire as a warning to mankind differ.

cmp-card:49:1|49:10.why: Only the stock command to fear Allah; not putting oneself before Allah and His messenger and reconciling brothers are different subjects.

cmp-card:49:18|53:31.why: Only the heavens and the earth and deeds; His knowledge of the unseen and recompense differ.

cmp-card:49:1|61:11.why: Only Allah and His messenger, a stock pairing.

cmp-card:49:1|62:7.why: Only words of putting forward and hands in a different sense; different subjects.

cmp-card:49:17|62:6.why: Only the stock ending if you are truthful; a rebuke of the Bedouins and a challenge to the Jews differ.

cmp-card:49:16|63:7.why: Only the heavens and the earth; His knowledge and His treasuries are different points.

cmp-card:49:16|64:1.why: Only the stock phrase what is in the heavens and the earth and a stock closing.

cmp-card:49:16|64:11.why: Only the stock closing that Allah knows all things.

cmp-card:49:18|64:2.why: Only the stock closing that Allah sees what you do.

cmp-card:49:16|65:12.why: Only a stock closing about all things.

cmp-card:49:16|85:9.why: Only the heavens and the earth and a stock closing.

cmp-card:50:38|52:36.why: Only creation of the heavens and the earth; His creation in six days and the question whether they created them make different points.

cmp-card:50:26|58:15.why: Only a severe punishment, a stock phrase.

cmp-card:50:38|64:3.why: Only creation of the heavens and the earth, continued in different ways; the close match for 50:38 is creation in six days elsewhere.

cmp-card:50:40|74:33.why: Only night and a shared root in different senses; a command to glorify and an oath by the night differ.

cmp-card:48:7|48:14,48:7|48:19.why: Three places in one surah that open on Allah's armies or dominion over the heavens and the earth, or close with the same pair of divine names. A memorizer can mix the closings.

cmp-card:48:5|57:12.why: Believing men and women, gardens with rivers, abiding, and the great success: the reward in nearly the same full wording.
cmp-card:48:5|57:12.relation: The promise in 48:5 is seen fulfilled on the Day in 57:12.

cmp-card:48:5|61:12.why: Sins removed or forgiven, gardens with rivers, and the great success: the same full promise in two places.

cmp-card:48:21|59:6.why: Both speak of gains the believers did not win by their own strength, and close on His power over all things.
cmp-card:48:21|59:6.relation: Spoils as a gift of Allah's power, not of their effort.

cmp-card:48:28|61:9.why: Identical first part with two endings. Classic material for memorizers.
cmp-card:48:28|61:9.relation: Victory of the religion of truth, witnessed by Allah despite the polytheists.

cmp-card:48:2|63:6.why: A sharp contrast: forgiveness and guidance granted to the Prophet, and forgiveness and guidance denied to the defiant hypocrites.
cmp-card:48:2|63:6.relation: Contrast: forgiveness and guidance given and withheld.

cmp-card:48:8|73:15.why: We sent you as a witness: the Prophet sent as witness, compared with the messenger sent to Pharaoh.
cmp-card:48:8|73:15.relation: The Prophet as witness, like Musa sent to Pharaoh.

cmp-card:49:16|49:18.why: Two closings in one passage on His knowledge of the heavens and the earth. Close wording a memorizer must separate.

cmp-card:49:16|58:7.why: The same full statement: Allah knows what is in the heavens and the earth, and knows all things.
cmp-card:49:16|58:7.relation: His knowledge reaches every private talk.

cmp-card:49:18|59:22.why: Allah knows the unseen: of the heavens and the earth, and the unseen and the witnessed.

cmp-card:49:15|61:11.why: The same description of true believers: belief in Allah and His messenger and striving with wealth and lives in His way.
cmp-card:49:15|61:11.relation: The true believers, and the trade that saves from punishment.

cmp-card:49:16|64:4,49:18|64:4.why: He knows what is in the heavens and the earth, and what you do or conceal: three closely worded places.

cmp-card:50:26|51:51.why: Setting up another god with Allah: a command not to, and the punishment of the one who did.

cmp-card:50:39|52:48,50:40|52:49.why: Two parallel two-ayah passages: be patient, glorify the praise of your Lord, and glorify Him in the night. The endings differ. Strong memorizer material.

cmp-card:50:43|53:44.why: He alone gives life and death, in emphatic wording in neighbouring surahs.

cmp-card:50:12|54:9.why: Before them the people of Nuh denied: the same opening, a list in one place and Nuh's story in the other.
cmp-card:50:12|54:9.relation: Consolation: denial is an old pattern.

cmp-card:50:3|56:47.why: The same denial of resurrection: when we have died and become dust.

cmp-card:50:2|67:9.why: A warner came to them and they rejected him: wondering at him in this world, confessing it in Hell.
cmp-card:50:2|67:9.relation: Their wonder in this world and their confession in the Fire.

cmp-card:50:20|69:13.why: The blowing of the Horn opens the scene of the Day in both.

cmp-card:48:2|71:4.why: Forgiveness of sins is shared, but the delaying words are of one root in different senses (past and future sins, and respite of life). The subjects differ: the Prophet and Nuh's people.

cmp-card:49:1|58:12.why: The putting-forward words are used in opposite senses: do not go ahead of Allah and His messenger, and give charity before private talk. Different subjects.

cmp-card:50:11|77:26.why: Only words of life and death in different forms; reviving the land and the earth holding the living and the dead differ.

cmp-card:50:43|77:26.why: Only words of life and death; His power over life and death and the earth as a container differ.

cmp-card:50:38|78:37.why: Only the stock phrase the heavens, the earth and what is between them; creation in six days and a divine title differ.

cmp-card:50:40|79:3.why: Only one root in two senses: glorifying and swimming. Nothing to learn.

cmp-card:50:40|79:5.why: Only one root in two senses: after prostration and the arrangers of affairs. Nothing to learn.

cmp-card:50:1|85:15.why: Only the single word glorious, describing the Quran and the Throne; too little.

cmp-card:50:17|85:6.why: Only one root in two senses: the recording angel seated and the people seated by the ditch.

cmp-card:50:43|87:13.why: Only words of life and death; His power and the state of the wretched in the Fire differ.

cmp-card:51:56|55:3.why: Only the creation of man and jinn; the purpose of creation and the listing of favours make different points.

cmp-card:51:23|64:3.why: Only the heavens, the earth and truth, in different senses: an oath that the promise is true, and creation in truth.

cmp-card:51:19|69:51.why: The same word in two senses: a due right in wealth, and the certain truth.

cmp-card:51:20|69:51.why: Only the root of certainty; signs for the certain and the Quran as certain truth differ.

cmp-card:51:5|70:26.why: Only the root of truth, in different senses.

cmp-card:51:6|70:26.why: Only the name Day of Judgement is shared, a common name; the sentences say different things.

cmp-card:51:12|70:26.why: Only the name Day of Judgement is shared, a common name; the sentences say different things.

cmp-card:51:12|74:46.why: Only the name Day of Judgement is shared, a common name; the sentences say different things.

cmp-card:51:12|82:17.why: Only the name Day of Judgement is shared, a common name; the sentences say different things.

cmp-card:51:12|83:11.why: Only the name Day of Judgement is shared, a common name; the sentences say different things.

cmp-card:51:12|70:25.why: Only the root of asking: deniers asking about the Day and the beggar. Different senses.

cmp-card:51:2|71:13.why: Only one root in two senses: a heavy load and reverence.

cmp-card:51:21|75:14.why: Same roots in different senses: signs within yourselves, and man as witness over himself.

cmp-card:52:36|64:3.why: Only creation of the heavens and the earth; a rebuke and a statement of creation in truth differ.

cmp-card:52:49|74:33.why: Only night and one root in two senses: glorifying as the stars set, and an oath by the night as it departs.

cmp-card:52:34|79:15.why: Only the words come and speech in different senses; a challenge to bring a speech like it and the story of Musa differ.

cmp-card:52:28|82:13.why: Only one root in two senses: the divine name The Most Kind and the righteous.

cmp-card:52:29|82:13.why: Only the root of favour; the Lord's favour on the Prophet and the bliss of the righteous differ.

cmp-card:52:28|83:22.why: Only one root in two senses: the divine name The Most Kind and the righteous.

cmp-card:52:29|83:22.why: Only the root of favour; different subjects.

cmp-card:52:42|86:17.why: Only chance words; the matching idea of plotting is in 86:16, which has its own card.

cmp-card:51:15|68:34.why: A generic reward formula for the righteous; the wording differs in structure, unlike the close twins of 51:15 elsewhere.

cmp-card:50:40|76:26.why: The same command to glorify Him in the night, with prostration mentioned in both.

cmp-card:50:6|77:9.why: The sky has no rifts now, and on the Day it will be split open: the same rare root marks the change.
cmp-card:50:6|77:9.relation: Contrast: the flawless sky of this world and its splitting on the Day.

cmp-card:50:20|78:18.why: The Horn is blown: the opening of the Day in both.

cmp-card:50:9|80:27.why: He sends down water and makes grain grow: the same favour in close words.
cmp-card:50:9|80:27.relation: Rain and grain as signs of provision and of resurrection.

cmp-card:50:44|80:26.why: The earth is split for the dead to come out and split for plants to grow.
cmp-card:50:44|80:26.relation: The earth split for plants points to it split for the resurrection.

cmp-card:50:31|81:13.why: The Garden brought near: the same rare verb for the same scene.

cmp-card:50:1|85:21.why: The Quran described as glorious, in the oath and in the reply to the deniers.

cmp-card:50:20|85:2.why: The Day named by its threat and by its promise: the same root in two forms.

cmp-card:51:20|52:36.why: Signs in the earth for those who are certain, and deniers who have no certainty: the same word of certainty in neighbouring surahs.
cmp-card:51:20|52:36.relation: Contrast: certainty from signs and doubt in the deniers.

cmp-card:51:49|53:45.why: He created everything in pairs, male and female.

cmp-card:51:50|71:2,51:51|71:2.why: The warner's words, I am a clear warner to you: twice in a row in 51 and from Nuh to his people.
cmp-card:51:50|71:2,51:51|71:2.relation: The Prophet speaks with Nuh's words.

cmp-card:51:24|79:15.why: The same device, has the story of ... reached you, opening the story of Ibrahim's guests and of Musa.

cmp-card:51:24|85:17.why: The same device, has the story of ... reached you, opening the story of Ibrahim's guests and of the armies.

cmp-card:51:24|88:1.why: The same device, has the story of ... reached you, opening a story and the overwhelming Day.

cmp-card:51:55|80:4.why: The reminder benefits: the same rare phrase on who profits from the reminder.

cmp-card:51:55|87:9.why: Remind, for the reminder benefits: the same command in two forms.

cmp-card:51:60|85:2.why: The Day they are promised and the promised Day: the same name for the Day.

cmp-card:51:47|91:5.why: The sky and its building by Allah: the same image, once as statement, once as oath.

cmp-card:51:11|107:5.why: The rare word for heedless in the same construction: heedless in confusion, and heedless of their prayer.
cmp-card:51:11|107:5.relation: Heedlessness of the Hereafter and heedlessness in prayer.

cmp-card:52:41|53:35.why: The same rebuke: do they hold the unseen and see it?

cmp-card:52:17|54:54.why: The same frame, the righteous are in gardens and ..., with two different endings. Memorizer material.

cmp-card:52:9|67:16.why: The rare verb of heaving: the sky heaving on the Day, and the earth heaving if He causes it to swallow them.

cmp-card:52:19|69:24.why: Eat and drink with pleasure for what you did: the same welcome with two endings.

cmp-card:52:29|69:42.why: The Prophet is not a soothsayer: the same defence in two surahs.

cmp-card:52:12|74:45.why: The deniers plunging in vain talk, described and then confessed in the Fire.
cmp-card:52:12|74:45.relation: Their play in this world, their confession in Hell.

cmp-card:52:6|81:6.why: The seas set aflame: the same scene.

cmp-card:52:10|81:3.why: The mountains set in motion: the same scene.

cmp-card:52:14|83:17.why: The same rebuke on the Day: this is what you used to deny.

cmp-card:52:42|86:16.why: They plot, and Allah plots against them: the same answer to the deniers' plotting.

cmp-card:51:19|70:24,51:19|70:25.why: The same clause, a right in their wealth for the beggar and the deprived, said once of the righteous and once of those who pray.
cmp-card:51:19|70:24,51:19|70:25.changes: Merged 70:24 and 70:25 into one row, since together they read as the one sentence that matches 51:19.
cmp-card:51:19|70:24,51:19|70:25.relation: The due of the poor as a mark of the people of the Garden.

cmp-card:55:2|56:76.why: Only one root in two senses: teaching the Quran and if you knew.

cmp-card:55:2|56:77.why: Only the word Quran, in different statements; nothing specific shared.

cmp-card:55:29|57:2.why: Only the heavens and the earth; all asking Him and His dominion over life and death differ.

cmp-card:55:12|77:2.why: Chance words of one root in two senses: husked grain and violent winds.

cmp-card:55:29|85:9.why: Only the heavens and the earth; different statements.

cmp-card:55:3|86:5.why: Only the creation of man; a statement of His favour and a command to consider one's origin make different points.

cmp-card:55:7|88:13.why: Only one root in two senses: the sky raised and couches raised.

cmp-card:55:7|88:14.why: Only one root in two senses: the balance set and cups set out.

cmp-card:55:5|91:1.why: Only the sun, in an unrelated oath.

cmp-card:55:5|91:2.why: Only the moon, in an unrelated oath.

cmp-card:55:2|96:1.why: Only a root of reading and teaching in different words; too thin.

cmp-card:55:3|96:1.why: Only the verb created; the matching clause for 55:3 is in 96:2, which has its own card.

cmp-card:56:74|56:96.why: This identical pair is already on the card that joins 56:74, 56:96 and 87:1.

cmp-card:56:10|79:4.why: Only one root in two senses: the foremost believers and the angels racing ahead.

cmp-card:56:56|82:17.why: Only the name Day of Judgement, in different statements.

cmp-card:56:56|82:18.why: Only the name Day of Judgement, in different statements.

cmp-card:56:77|82:11.why: Only the word noble, describing the Quran and the scribes; too thin.

cmp-card:56:78|82:11.why: Only one root in two senses: a hidden book and recording scribes.

cmp-card:56:94|82:14.why: Only the word Hell; different statements.

cmp-card:56:19|86:12.why: Chance words of one root in two senses: headache and the cracking earth.

cmp-card:56:49|93:4.why: Related words in different senses: earlier and later peoples, and the two lives.

cmp-card:56:77|96:3.why: Only roots of reading and nobility in unrelated statements.

cmp-card:56:94|102:6.why: Only the word Hell; different statements.

cmp-card:57:11|57:18.why: This pair is already on the card that joins 57:11, 57:18 and 73:20; a separate card repeats it.

cmp-card:57:12|58:22.why: Only the generic reward clause of gardens with rivers beneath; the subjects and the rest of the wording differ.

cmp-card:57:12|65:11.why: Only the generic reward clause of gardens with rivers beneath; the subjects and the rest of the wording differ.

cmp-card:57:12|98:8.why: Only the generic reward clause of gardens with rivers beneath; the subjects and the rest of the wording differ.

cmp-card:58:22|61:12.why: Only the generic reward clause of gardens with rivers beneath; the subjects and the rest of the wording differ.

cmp-card:57:12|61:12.why: Only gardens with rivers and the great success, a reward formula; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:57:8|61:11.why: Only believing in Allah and His messenger; a rebuke for not believing and the trade that saves differ.

cmp-card:57:15|66:9.why: Only the stock closing about their refuge and a wretched destination.

cmp-card:57:2|77:26.why: Only words of life and death; His power and the earth holding the living and the dead differ.

cmp-card:57:5|86:11.why: Only one root in two senses: matters returning to Allah and the sky that returns rain.

cmp-card:55:3|70:19.why: He created man, and man was created anxious: the same creation, then his nature named.
cmp-card:55:3|70:19.relation: Man's creation and the weakness in his nature.

cmp-card:55:17|70:40.why: Lord of the easts and the wests, in dual and plural.

cmp-card:55:17|73:9.why: Lord of the east and the west, in dual and singular.

cmp-card:55:5|75:9.why: The sun and the moon run by reckoning, and on the Day they are joined together.
cmp-card:55:5|75:9.relation: Contrast: their exact order now and its undoing on the Day.

cmp-card:55:60|77:44.why: Good is repaid with good: the same idea in close words.

cmp-card:55:9|83:3.why: Do not shortchange the balance, and woe to those who shortchange when they weigh.
cmp-card:55:9|83:3.relation: Contrast: the command for just weight and those who break it.

cmp-card:55:37|84:1.why: When the sky splits apart: the same scene.

cmp-card:55:7|88:18.why: The sky and how it was raised.

cmp-card:55:50|88:12.why: A flowing spring in the Garden.

cmp-card:55:3|90:4.why: He created man, and We created man in hardship.

cmp-card:55:3|95:4.why: He created man, and We created man in the best form.
cmp-card:55:3|95:4.relation: Man's creation and his honoured form.

cmp-card:55:3|96:2,55:14|96:2.why: He created man, and from what: clay and a clinging clot.
cmp-card:55:3|96:2,55:14|96:2.relation: Man's origin told in different stages.

cmp-card:56:8|56:27.why: The companions of the right, twice in one surah with two words for right. A memorizer trap.

cmp-card:56:24|66:7.why: Repaid for what they used to do: the reward of the foremost and the punishment of the disbelievers.
cmp-card:56:24|66:7.relation: Contrast: the same justice gives the Garden and the Fire.

cmp-card:56:94|82:15.why: Burning in Hell, with the same root of burning in two forms.

cmp-card:56:90|84:7.why: As for the one of the right, and the one given his book in his right hand: the same division.

cmp-card:56:74|87:1,56:96|87:1.why: Glorify the name of your Lord: twice in al-Waqia with the Great, once in al-Ala with the Most High.

cmp-card:56:25|88:11.why: No idle talk is heard in the Garden.

cmp-card:56:95|102:7.why: Certainty described two ways: the truth of certainty and the eye of certainty.

cmp-card:57:21|57:29.why: That is the bounty of Allah, He gives it to whom He wills: the same closing twice in one surah.

cmp-card:57:1|59:1,57:1|59:24.why: Everything in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allah, the Mighty, the Wise: near-identical openings and a closing.

cmp-card:57:1|61:1.why: Near-identical openings, differing in one small word. Classic memorizer material.

cmp-card:57:2|67:1.why: His is the dominion and He has power over all things.

cmp-card:57:11|73:20,57:18|73:20.why: Lending Allah a goodly loan, a rare expression, with the reward multiplied or found with Allah.

cmp-card:57:24|92:8.why: Miserliness and self-sufficiency together: the miser who turns away while Allah is the Self-Sufficient.

cmp-card:58:9|58:12.why: O you who believe, when you hold private talk: two rulings in one surah.

cmp-card:58:17|64:15.why: Wealth and children: they will not avail against Allah, and they are a trial.
cmp-card:58:17|64:15.relation: Wealth and children as a test, not a refuge.

tree:095kk3k09zmibw.why: The inheritance law repeats the same condition in both ayat: every share is paid only after a bequest or debt is settled. A memorizer must track the varying verb form in each place.
tree:095kk3k09zmibw.relation: The same condition runs through all the shares of the inheritance law.

tree:0oou5g30oaqhyn.why: Same scene told twice: Pharaoh threatens the magicians who believed. The wording is near identical, with differences to note: an added warning in 26:49, and a different end to the threat in each.
tree:0oou5g30oaqhyn.relation: One event in two surahs: the believing magicians facing Pharaoh's threat.

tree:07qgkrr1sv87e3.why: Same declaration of Allah's dominion opening three ayat, each continuing differently; 2:107 and 9:116 both end with no protector or helper besides Allah, while 5:40 speaks of punishing and forgiving. Useful for a memorizer.

tree:093abcj0r9hgxx.why: The deniers' same question about being raised after becoming dust and bones, in four places; 37:53 alone ends with being judged instead of raised. Classic memorizer trap, and one theme: denial of resurrection.
tree:093abcj0r9hgxx.relation: The same disbelief in resurrection, answered differently in each surah.

tree:0gujjom0e2n2nu.why: A stock closing formula on Allah's power, shared by unrelated ayat on many subjects. Nothing to learn from seeing these together; it is a search, not a card.

tree:1ql64tj1p4g0vl.why: The same list of patriarchs in two nearby ayat of al-Baqara: in 2:136 the believers declare faith in what was revealed to them, in 2:140 Jews and Christians are refuted for claiming them as their own.
tree:1ql64tj1p4g0vl.changes: Add 3:84 and 4:163, which carry the same list; 3:84 is the classic twin of 2:136. They sit in another card only because the name is spelled differently in the script.
tree:1ql64tj1p4g0vl.relation: Contrast: the list as an object of faith versus the list as a disputed claim.

tree:1b2fybp1y0ncvd.why: The same list of patriarchs: 3:84 is the declaration of faith in all revelation, 4:163 lists those to whom Allah revealed as He revealed to the Prophet.
tree:1b2fybp1y0ncvd.changes: Add 2:136 and 2:140, which carry the same list; 2:136 is the classic twin of 3:84. They sit in another card only because the name is spelled differently in the script.
tree:1b2fybp1y0ncvd.relation: One chain of revelation, stated as faith in 3:84 and as Allah's act in 4:163.

tree:0oejs4v1tp2e57.why: Same statement that Allah varied the reminders for people and most refused all but disbelief. Two wordings of the first half to keep apart.
tree:0oejs4v1tp2e57.relation: The same complaint about people's refusal despite varied reminders.

tree:1gyr70d19kyrfp.why: Both ayat show the worthlessness of protectors taken besides Allah: in 29:41 as a spider's flimsy house, in 45:10 as nothing that will avail them before Hell.
tree:1gyr70d19kyrfp.relation: The weakness of false protectors, shown by a parable and by the Hereafter.

tree:0b3giaq1prpnwq.why: A rare full clause, fear Allah to whom you will be gathered, closing a command in only these two places (hunting in ihram, and secret counsel). Useful for a memorizer even though the subjects differ.

tree:1u6tjut1ekdgdv.why: The same exhortation, fear Allah if you are believers, in only these two places, both in al-Ma'ida: once to the believers, once from Jesus to the disciples asking for the table. Useful for a memorizer.

tree:1sbr54s1yiu9mo.why: Two neighbouring ayat end with the same promise of being rewarded by the best of what they did, the first for the patient, the second for every believer who does good. A memorizer needs to see them together.
tree:1sbr54s1yiu9mo.relation: The same reward promised to the patient and to every believing doer of good.

tree:0x4e00q15gyoh4.why: Same scene: Abraham questions his father and people about their worship. The question is worded fully in 21:52 and briefly in 26:70.
tree:0x4e00q15gyoh4.relation: One event told in two surahs.

tree:17jpnea0iw7goy.why: The same command to remember Allah much that you may succeed, once in the face of the enemy and once in the market after Friday prayer.
tree:17jpnea0iw7goy.relation: Remembrance asked for both in battle and in daily trade.

tree:0izljco02tepd2.why: Both call the believers to remember Allah's favour, then name a specific event: hearts joined after enmity in 3:103, enemies' hands held back in 5:11.
tree:0izljco02tepd2.relation: Allah's favour remembered through concrete events of protection and unity.

tree:1d5ybh81twbivm.why: The two sides of the same oath procedure between spouses: the husband swears he is truthful, the wife swears he is lying.
tree:1d5ybh81twbivm.relation: Mirror oaths in one law: truthful against lying.

tree:0h4czjg07akbr8.why: The same command to seek refuge in Allah with two different closing names: the Hearing, the Seeing in 40:56 and the Hearing, the Knowing in 41:36. A classic memorizer pair in neighbouring surahs.

tree:068mgkx12p78ln.why: The same scene of the wrongdoers hiding regret when they see the punishment, continued differently: judgment with justice in 10:54, chains on necks in 34:33.
tree:068mgkx12p78ln.relation: The same moment of regret on seeing the punishment.

tree:182re8v0bcjt1h.why: The same description of whoever submits his face to Allah while doing good: in 2:112 he has his reward, in 4:125 he follows the way of Abraham.
tree:182re8v0bcjt1h.relation: Two consequences of the same submission: reward, and the best of religion.

tree:1fdbl3d06ouh2h.why: Same command to obey Allah and the Messenger, then if they turn away, his duty is only clear delivery. Wording differs in the middle, which a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:1fdbl3d06ouh2h.relation: The same rule on the Messenger's duty in two surahs.

tree:1c06d9q1niftyc.why: Within one surah: Allah commands the Prophet to worship Him with sincere religion, then the Prophet declares he was commanded exactly that.
tree:1c06d9q1niftyc.relation: A command and the Prophet's own declaration of it.

tree:140nofm07sv7xg.why: The same threat of severe punishment prepared by Allah, opening an ayah in two neighbouring surahs, with different continuations. Useful for a memorizer.

tree:1bn93d503lg897.why: The same prayer for forgiveness and mercy ending differently: best of forgivers in 7:155 (Moses), best of the merciful in 23:109 (the believers).
tree:1bn93d503lg897.relation: One prayer in the mouth of Moses and of the believers.

tree:1d26o6l0egsjoh.why: The same command to pray, give alms and obey, then the object differs: the Messenger in 24:56, Allah and His Messenger in 58:13. A memorizer pair.

tree:1f0yl620xhepn2.why: Two consecutive ayat on the same people and their eating of the unlawful, ending with what they used to do and what they used to work, a classic memorizer difference.
tree:1f0yl620xhepn2.relation: Blame on the sinners, then on the scholars who did not forbid them.

tree:0cl2p6a1vk0fs4.why: Both protect wives from being pressured or put out of their homes, with the same single exception of open immorality. Same subject in two laws.
tree:0cl2p6a1vk0fs4.relation: The one exception that lifts a wife's protection, in marriage and in divorce.

tree:1h9pavb1je4zwd.why: The same exception on the Day: none speaks or intercedes except whom the Most Merciful permits, ending with being pleased with his word in 20:109 and speaking what is right in 78:38.
tree:1h9pavb1je4zwd.relation: Permission to speak on the Day of Judgment, described from two sides.

tree:0ayjze714u3fud.why: Both address all mankind and ground the oneness of Allah in His dominion over heavens and earth, then draw a different conclusion: believe in the Messenger, or how are you turned away. The shared part beyond the stock phrase is thin.
tree:0ayjze714u3fud.relation: Two calls to mankind arguing from creation to the oneness of Allah.

tree:0t8fdyr1p0grf1.why: What was revealed to the Prophet from his Lord is the truth: most people do not believe it (13:1), while those given knowledge see it (34:6).
tree:0t8fdyr1p0grf1.relation: Contrast: most people reject the revelation, the knowledgeable recognise it.

tree:10t511x0lxgep9.why: The creation of mankind from a single soul and its mate, told with two different verbs for making the mate. A classic memorizer pair, and one theme.
tree:10t511x0lxgep9.relation: The same origin of mankind, told as a call to piety and as a story of the first couple.

tree:1qc2l8u154x9b0.why: Only the stock formula of those who believe and do good with their reward; the contexts are unrelated and nothing is learned from the pair.

tree:1qxo81v1cpfuup.why: Both picture the Day of Judgment sorting people, with the believers placed in gardens named differently in each. The formula is common but the setting is shared.
tree:1qxo81v1cpfuup.relation: The believers' place in the judgment scene, named two ways.

tree:0tt11ka0oghls2.why: The shared word after the formula is a different word in each: from His bounty in 30:45, out of darkness in 65:11. Beyond that only the stock formula is shared.

tree:1nlm1a91h3cmel.why: Both show the gods taken besides Allah failing those who took them: a spider's flimsy house in 29:41, gods who abandoned their worshippers in 46:28.
tree:1nlm1a91h3cmel.relation: The helplessness of false gods, by parable and by history.

tree:0gu476k1fzzn1i.why: The same opening about those who took protectors besides Him, continued differently: their excuse that the idols bring them near in 39:3, Allah watching over them in 42:6. A memorizer pair.
tree:0gu476k1fzzn1i.relation: The idolaters' claim and Allah's watch over them.

tree:1pj1ndd0il2p7x.why: The same phrase about those worshipped besides Allah: the Prophet refuses to worship them (10:104), and Abraham shows they cannot provide (29:17).
tree:1pj1ndd0il2p7x.relation: Refusing false worship, and the reason: they own nothing.

tree:0h65de403m4axy.why: The same rare clause about those who split their religion into sects, with different conclusions: the Prophet has nothing to do with them, and each faction rejoices in its own.
tree:0h65de403m4axy.relation: The danger of sectarian division, stated twice.

tree:05904vz1rqdxo1.why: Both speak of those killed in Allah's cause and promise them a gain: they are alive with their Lord (3:169), their deeds are not lost (47:4).

tree:1fl9u4n1byb169.why: Same story: Noah saved and the people who denied Our signs drowned, with a different description of the people in each surah.
tree:1fl9u4n1byb169.relation: One event, Noah's people drowned, in two surahs.

tree:1oqqi7g0j5k6em.why: Close neighbours in al-A'raf with the same subject, those who deny Our signs and are arrogant, and two consequences: the Fire, and the gates of heaven closed to them.
tree:1oqqi7g0j5k6em.relation: Two fates of the arrogant deniers.

tree:15tkk440wl09v2.why: The same threat of painful punishment for the disbelievers among them, introduced by two different verbs. A memorizer pair.

tree:1wss4dm0vmt39m.why: Two neighbouring ayat on those who do not believe in Allah's signs: Allah does not guide them, and they are the ones who invent lies.
tree:1wss4dm0vmt39m.relation: The deniers described twice in a row: unguided, and the true liars.

tree:1rexad208e12qk.why: Both end with the aim of becoming God-fearing and mention those before you: worship of the Creator in 2:21, fasting in 2:183.
tree:1rexad208e12qk.relation: Piety as the aim of both worship and fasting.

tree:1r7wmu802esyb2.why: Those they call on besides Him answer nothing (13:14) and judge nothing (40:20), each set against Allah's true call or true judgment.
tree:1r7wmu802esyb2.relation: The false gods' helplessness against Allah's truth.

tree:1yn06290fg6tpv.why: A rare clause: opposing the Messenger after guidance has become clear, with the consequence in each. Same subject.
tree:1yn06290fg6tpv.relation: The fate of those who oppose the Messenger knowingly.

tree:1iezmus11979tg.why: The sun, moon and stars subjected by His command, as part of creation in 7:54 and as a sign for those who reason in 16:12.
tree:1iezmus11979tg.relation: The same cosmic order seen as Allah's creation and as a sign.

tree:1wyq6g01bpu00i.why: Only the stock closing that there are signs in that is shared; the word before it belongs to different phrases, and the subjects (Moses' mission, birds in the sky) are unrelated.

tree:0h3bjpp1ux09wt.why: Allah is the creator of all things, closing with two different attributes: the One, the Subduer in 13:16, and Guardian over all things in 39:62. A memorizer pair.
tree:0h3bjpp1ux09wt.relation: From creation of all things to two attributes of Allah.

tree:1xzr1910kze2br.why: Two agreements sealed by making Allah the guarantor of what is said: Jacob with his sons, and Moses with the old man of Madyan.
tree:1xzr1910kze2br.relation: Covenants witnessed by Allah in two prophets' lives.

tree:1u9sjv20gfwnyi.why: Allah begins creation then repeats it, closed differently: how are you deluded in 10:34, then to Him you return in 30:11.
tree:1u9sjv20gfwnyi.relation: Resurrection argued from the first creation.

tree:0m80mmy1rmsqao.why: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection: between the believers and the hypocrites in 4:141, over what you differed in at 22:69. Two continuations to keep apart.
tree:0m80mmy1rmsqao.relation: Disputes left to Allah's judgment on the Last Day.

tree:1x3yozo0v96jy8.why: The same list of the oppressed men, women and children in one surah: in 4:75 the believers must fight for them, in 4:98 they are excused from emigrating.
tree:1x3yozo0v96jy8.relation: The weak among the believers: a duty to defend them and an excuse granted to them.

tree:0h9kqaq1lpe8rk.why: The same rebuke said to the deniers in Hell: the Fire you used to deny, introduced differently in each place. Same scene and a memorizer pair.
tree:0h9kqaq1lpe8rk.relation: The deniers faced with the very Fire they denied.

tree:0mxu35c1olq4n8.why: The blessed land appears twice in al-Anbiya': Abraham and Lot saved to it, and the wind carrying Solomon's command to it. Same surah, different endings.
tree:0mxu35c1olq4n8.relation: One blessed land in two prophets' stories.

tree:0zik2ph0ev2egj.why: Revelation came to the Prophet and to those before him: in 39:65 with the warning against associating partners, in 42:3 as Allah's way of revealing. Neighbouring surahs.
tree:0zik2ph0ev2egj.relation: One revelation shared by all prophets.

tree:1jel2fy13nqdk4.why: Noah (10:72) and the Prophet (27:91) each declare they were commanded to be among those who submit, after different lead-ins.
tree:1jel2fy13nqdk4.relation: Two prophets with the same declaration of submission.

tree:0tliifk1xvzxz8.why: Same rare description of a community that guides by the truth and does justice by it: among the people of Moses, and among those We created.
tree:0tliifk1xvzxz8.relation: The righteous community, first among Moses' people and then in general.

tree:10m8th30ahtqw3.why: The same closing threat to the wrongdoers ends two ayat about false partners: Satan disowning those who associated him with Allah, and partners who legislated religion without Allah's leave.
tree:10m8th30ahtqw3.relation: Association of partners and its punishment.

tree:1nst4dy1tzpi08.why: A closing found only in these two places: Allah is kind and merciful to people, after the change of qibla in 2:143 and after the subjection of earth and sea in 22:65. Useful for a memorizer.

tree:07ga1531uemb5x.why: Allah does not love every one of a kind: the treacherous ingrate (22:38) and the arrogant boaster (31:18). A memorizer pair with two different types named.
tree:07ga1531uemb5x.relation: Two kinds of people Allah does not love.

tree:1re3oht1h7hmzd.why: Allah does not break His promise, said by the believers about the Day of gathering in 3:9 and by Allah about His promise coming upon the deniers in 13:31.
tree:1re3oht1h7hmzd.relation: Allah's promise, trusted by the believers and awaiting the deniers.

tree:0ttmw3o0mzjymq.why: The same sentence to the punished: that is for what your hands sent ahead, and Allah is never unjust to His servants. A memorizer pair, with a singular and plural for hands.
tree:0ttmw3o0mzjymq.changes: Add 3:182, which carries the same sentence word for word as 8:51.
tree:0ttmw3o0mzjymq.relation: Punishment as the fruit of one's own deeds.

tree:0udsezd1b784qr.why: Two places in at-Tawba close with Allah being the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful: about accepting repentance and charity, and about the three who stayed behind.
tree:0udsezd1b784qr.relation: Allah's acceptance of repentance in the same surah of repentance.

tree:0b2ab5e124qt0c.why: Deniers tell the believers or the warners that they are only in error, with different adjectives: clear in 36:47, great in 67:9.
tree:0b2ab5e124qt0c.relation: The deniers accusing the guided of error.

tree:0bc3rhs0xpgkuy.why: If they turn away, the Prophet's duty is only to deliver: closing with Allah seeing His servants in 3:20 and with clear delivery in 16:82.
tree:0bc3rhs0xpgkuy.relation: The Prophet's duty limited to delivering the message.

tree:0q1k9ym06e0d0s.why: Patience is called a matter of firm resolve both to the believers under trial (3:186) and in Luqman's advice to his son (31:17).
tree:0q1k9ym06e0d0s.relation: Patience under hardship as true resolve.

tree:0n1nlzn0ghaofl.why: The rare singular form, a sign for the believers, closes only these two ayat (the ruins of Lot's people, and creation of the heavens). Useful for a memorizer against the common plural.

tree:0vzhnc91h760gl.why: Two adjacent ayat set out the witness's test in Joseph's story: the shirt torn from the front or from the back, with the verdict reversed.
tree:0vzhnc91h760gl.relation: A test by evidence with two mirror outcomes.

tree:1jc0l4k0v35yze.why: Two adjacent offers to bring the Queen's throne to Solomon: the jinn before he rises, the one with knowledge of the Book before the glance returns.
tree:1jc0l4k0v35yze.relation: Contrast: the power of the jinn against the power of knowledge.

tree:0m5wknk0fu58k2.why: In one surah, what was revealed to the Prophet is the truth: most people do not believe (13:1), and the one who knows it is not like the blind (13:19).
tree:0m5wknk0fu58k2.relation: Knowing the revelation is truth, and the blindness of those who do not.

tree:1dl7zej13i2jbh.why: After destroying past nations Allah raised up another generation; the same phrase in 6:6 and 23:31 with a different linking word.
tree:1dl7zej13i2jbh.relation: The succession of nations after destruction.

tree:0yfz2kp1n851gz.why: The warning to see the end of the wrongdoers follows denial of the Quran in 10:39 and Pharaoh's drowning in 28:40.
tree:0yfz2kp1n851gz.relation: The end of wrongdoers as a lesson.

tree:1wzxfs312oa9p7.why: Both close a passage on Moses and Pharaoh with the same call to see the end of the corrupters. Same story.
tree:1wzxfs312oa9p7.relation: Pharaoh's end as the lesson on corruption.

tree:0gbq89i10cqjre.why: The same call to see the end of those warned, after Noah's people were drowned in 10:73 and after past warned nations in 37:73.
tree:0gbq89i10cqjre.relation: The end of the warned nations who denied.

tree:06hqkaq1k3ly0q.why: The same sentence said to the disbelievers in the Fire: you are only repaid for what you did, after telling them patience or excuses are useless.
tree:06hqkaq1k3ly0q.relation: No excuse helps on the Day: only deeds are repaid.

tree:0oh1oc50156yjl.why: The same closing on Allah being aware and seeing of His servants, twice in al-Isra': after His giving of provision, and after Him being witness between the Prophet and the deniers. A memorizer pair in one surah.

tree:112h1db05ts0ap.why: The core message given to every messenger, there is no god but Me, closing with fear Me in 16:2 and worship Me in 21:25.
tree:112h1db05ts0ap.relation: One message of all prophets, with two demands that follow from it.

tree:1huxyj90rtiqhl.why: The same words, I fear Allah the Lord of the worlds, in the mouth of Adam's righteous son refusing to kill, and in Satan's mouth disowning the man he misled.
tree:1huxyj90rtiqhl.relation: Contrast: a sincere fear of Allah, and the same words used by Satan as betrayal.

tree:12n8p950y8dfzv.why: The same description of those who bought error for guidance: the hypocrites, and those who hide the Book. 2:175 adds punishment for forgiveness. A memorizer pair in one surah.
tree:12n8p950y8dfzv.relation: The losing trade of choosing error over guidance.

tree:1azvfud1wpkxu9.why: The same promise that the doers of good enter Paradise and are not wronged, ending with not a speck in 4:124 and not at all in 19:60.
tree:1azvfud1wpkxu9.relation: Paradise for faith with deeds, and the repentant included.

tree:04p9p7h1h7n797.why: Both say a small patient band defeats a larger one by Allah's leave, and Allah is with the patient: Talut's army, and the believers at war.
tree:04p9p7h1h7n797.relation: The few who are patient overcome the many by Allah's leave.

tree:04r43bm1mrhxhe.why: Both list signs in creation, including spreading every kind of creature on the earth, then continue differently. Same theme.
tree:04r43bm1mrhxhe.relation: Living creatures as one of the signs of creation.

tree:06hy8ak0dxwspq.why: Whoever turns away or disbelieves after that are the defiant: after the covenant of the prophets in 3:82, after the promise of succession in 24:55. A memorizer pair.
tree:06hy8ak0dxwspq.relation: Turning away after a covenant or a promise as defiance.

tree:1uqhnjl1jt64yx.why: Both argue that the Creator is able to give life to the dead, from the creation of heavens and earth in 46:33 and from man's creation from a drop in 75:40.

tree:11v0m0n1kjjqb5.why: The same verdict on some People of the Book, cursed or sealed for their disbelief so they believe only a little, twice in an-Nisa'. A memorizer pair.
tree:11v0m0n1kjjqb5.relation: Disbelief leading to a sealed heart.

tree:1vrisi00b090jk.why: What Allah gave of His bounty appears in neighbouring ayat: martyrs rejoicing in it (3:170), the miserly withholding it (3:180).
tree:1vrisi00b090jk.relation: Contrast: rejoicing in Allah's bounty against hoarding it.

tree:05992i21btfmlc.why: Faced with clear signs, deniers say this is nothing but magic (Pharaoh's people) or nothing but a man who wants to turn you from your fathers' gods (the Prophet's people).
tree:05992i21btfmlc.relation: The same denial of clear signs, against Moses and against the Prophet.

tree:1hwy1xb0ypv0j3.why: The same sign of clouds gathered and rain coming from within them, falling on whom He wills. Same theme in two surahs.
tree:1hwy1xb0ypv0j3.relation: Rain from clouds as a sign of Allah's power.

tree:0ds48ve0p2tkto.why: The same command not to associate partners and to be good to parents, followed by different duties in 4:36 and 6:151. Classic memorizer pair and one theme.
tree:0ds48ve0p2tkto.relation: Tawhid and kindness to parents opening two lists of duties.

tree:19zxc251eaewmd.why: Salih and Shu'ayb in the same surah both call their people to seek forgiveness and repent, closing with different names of Allah.
tree:19zxc251eaewmd.relation: Two prophets with the same call to repentance.

tree:0c4zugr1vv4o21.why: Same story: Our messengers came to Abraham with good news, then the greeting in 11:69 and the announcement of Lot's town's destruction in 29:31.
tree:0c4zugr1vv4o21.relation: One visit of the angels to Abraham told in two surahs.

tree:0j0vopp00doob3.why: Allah made mates for you from yourselves, continued with children and grandchildren in 16:72 and with mates among cattle in 42:11.
tree:0j0vopp00doob3.relation: Pairs in creation as a sign and blessing.

tree:1rr6azp0dka8f1.why: Until they see what they are promised, then they will know who is weaker: a near-identical warning to the deniers in 19:75 and 72:24.
tree:1rr6azp0dka8f1.relation: The deniers learning the truth only when the promise comes.

tree:1utrc2k0ptbsa2.why: The same instruction not to sit with those who mock Allah's signs until they enter another talk, given to the believers in 4:140 and the Prophet in 6:68.
tree:1utrc2k0ptbsa2.relation: Leaving gatherings where the signs are mocked.

tree:0ow0vml0pstgqj.why: Shu'ayb tells his people it is better for them if they are believers, in both of his tellings (7:85, 11:86). Same story.

tree:1hq5oei15nzp1e.why: The same verdict, that is because they are a people who do not reason, closing two ayat on mockers of prayer and on divided enemies. Rare exact closing, useful for a memorizer.

tree:0fbfs2j1hszizb.why: After signs of creation, That is Allah your Lord, His is the dominion: continued with the helplessness of false gods in 35:13 and with no god but He in 39:6.
tree:0fbfs2j1hszizb.relation: From creation to the Lord who owns all dominion.

tree:0g1vxg91mzkx0z.why: The same rare clause: they are returned to Allah, their true Master, after death in 6:62 and on the Day of reckoning in 10:30.
tree:0g1vxg91mzkx0z.relation: The return to the true Master, and the false gods lost.

tree:0aferrl1dojdg5.why: The same command to spend from what We provided before something comes: a Day without trade or friendship (2:254), or death (63:10).
tree:0aferrl1dojdg5.relation: Spend before it is too late: the Day and death.

tree:06m23ze1pwoow6.why: Allah provided good things and preferred them: the children of Adam over much of creation, the children of Israel over the worlds.
tree:06m23ze1pwoow6.relation: Two honourings with the same wording: mankind and Israel.

tree:1nbl8xi1oczbi2.why: Messengers from among you reciting My signs: in 6:130 the jinn and men confess on the Day they came, in 7:35 the children of Adam are told they will come.
tree:1nbl8xi1oczbi2.relation: The same messengers promised in 7:35 and confessed to in 6:130.

tree:09ehn8v0mpvx8t.why: Messengers sent to their peoples came with clear proofs, then two endings: hearts sealed (10:74), the criminals punished and the believers helped (30:47).
tree:09ehn8v0mpvx8t.relation: The pattern of messengers and the fate of those who reject them.

tree:0w4o7v61ozlt4i.why: The same rare warning in two surahs, followed in both by the same next ayah: We will lead the deniers on step by step, and I give them respite, My plan is firm.
tree:0w4o7v61ozlt4i.relation: Allah's gradual respite for the deniers.

tree:1bu9r8h0lh8vh1.why: Divorce before consummation in two rulings: half the dowry if one was fixed (2:237), no waiting period and a gift (33:49).
tree:1bu9r8h0lh8vh1.relation: Two rulings on the same case.

tree:0lqbnfg0emp1h8.why: The punishment of disgrace in this world: lifted from the people of Jonah when they believed (10:98), tasted by 'Ad (41:16).
tree:0lqbnfg0emp1h8.relation: Contrast: the disgrace removed by faith, and the disgrace inflicted for denial.

tree:00xv49c1884cos.why: The same promise of forgiveness to those who do good, closing with a great reward in 11:11 and a noble provision in 34:4. A memorizer pair, though the formula is common.

tree:02igv9x1ukxzcj.why: Allah knows what is in the heavens and earth and what you hide and declare: in the hoopoe's words in 27:25, and as a statement in 64:4.
tree:02igv9x1ukxzcj.relation: Allah's knowledge of the hidden and the open.

tree:1r2a0tm0gfdb1o.why: Two ayat open the same way with a different verb: those who emigrated for Allah after being wronged, and those who argue about Allah after He was answered. The shared words carry different senses, so the link is thin.
tree:1r2a0tm0gfdb1o.relation: Contrast: reward for those who leave for Allah, wrath for those who dispute about Him.

tree:03i2fcv00vhcql.why: Striving in Allah's cause with wealth and lives earns a higher rank: over those who sit back (4:95), and greater in degree with Allah (9:20).
tree:03i2fcv00vhcql.relation: The rank of those who strive with wealth and life.

tree:16fzb9s1xpfbpu.why: Allah casts terror into the hearts of the disbelievers, after Uhud in 3:151 and at Badr in 8:12, said with We and with I.
tree:16fzb9s1xpfbpu.relation: Terror in the enemy's hearts as Allah's help in battle.

tree:0epzbsk0qg0u5q.why: Those who do not hope to meet Us make demands: a different Quran (10:15), angels or seeing their Lord (25:21).
tree:0epzbsk0qg0u5q.relation: The deniers' demands as a cover for not expecting the meeting.

tree:0dr2u9f1q6zkkj.why: Pharaoh's chiefs speak twice in al-A'raf: calling Moses a learned magician, then urging Pharaoh against Moses and his people.
tree:0dr2u9f1q6zkkj.relation: Pharaoh's chiefs before and after the magicians' contest.

tree:1ggrwl31363f0t.why: I was given it only because of knowledge: Qarun's claim in 28:78, and man's claim after a favour in 39:49, both answered.
tree:1ggrwl31363f0t.relation: Ingratitude: crediting one's own knowledge for Allah's gift.

tree:136c81b1th1tav.why: The same list of destroyed peoples before them, Noah, 'Ad and Thamud, then Abraham's people and others in both places. Same theme.
tree:136c81b1th1tav.relation: The past nations as a warning and consolation.

tree:0uj6f991nvynm3.why: If they believe they are guided, if they turn away: they are only in schism (2:137), your duty is only to deliver (3:20). A memorizer pair.
tree:0uj6f991nvynm3.relation: The People of the Book's choice: guidance or turning away.

tree:0295wjo0u8u4xk.why: The deniers demand signs and the answer is the same: signs are only with Allah, continued differently.
tree:0295wjo0u8u4xk.relation: The reply to demands for miracles.

tree:0w77r9u10uzone.why: Asked about the Hour, the answer is the same: its knowledge is only with Allah, then most people do not know (7:187), and perhaps it is near (33:63).
tree:0w77r9u10uzone.relation: The Hour's time known only to Allah.

tree:08gszxm0uqf274.why: The Prophet asks no wage for the message, then it is only a reminder (6:90), except love for kin (42:23). Classic memorizer pair.

tree:1byipdc1dc1d80.why: Are the blind and the seeing equal, then continued with will you not reflect (6:50) and are darkness and light equal (13:16).
tree:1byipdc1dc1d80.relation: The blind and the seeing as faith and disbelief.

tree:1h7tbl214jymow.why: On the Day the idolaters are asked where are those you used to worship (26:92), associate (40:73). A memorizer pair.
tree:1h7tbl214jymow.relation: The false gods missing when called for.

tree:0g0xaa31auop3h.why: Only the common closing on Allah's knowledge of all things; the subjects (the seal of prophets, the treaty at Hudaybiya) are unrelated, and the closing occurs in other places too.

tree:1emczip1jcihsl.why: Both recall Allah holding back the enemy from the believers, at the Trench (33:9) and near Mecca (48:24), and close with Allah seeing what they do.
tree:1emczip1jcihsl.relation: Allah's protection of the believers from their enemies.

tree:01joio013x9ygk.why: A rare closing found only twice: that is written in the Book, after the end of towns in 17:58 and after inheritance among kin in 33:6. Useful for a memorizer.

tree:1gfu03d19crbwv.why: Consolation to the Prophet: before them the people of Noah and 'Ad denied, continued with Thamud in 22:42 and Pharaoh in 38:12.
tree:1gfu03d19crbwv.relation: The Prophet consoled by past nations' denial.

tree:1m59ilh0i0dthn.why: Two close ayat in an-Nahl: so did those before them, after the deniers wait for the angels (16:33) and blame Allah's will for their shirk (16:35).
tree:1m59ilh0i0dthn.relation: The deniers repeating the excuses of earlier nations.

tree:18si3e60tx81fi.why: So did those before them deny: until they tasted Our might (6:148), so see the end of the wrongdoers (10:39). A memorizer pair.
tree:18si3e60tx81fi.relation: Today's deniers repeating the past nations' denial.

tree:1xzkfon1jy6obr.why: Thus We established Joseph in the land, said twice in his story: as a boy in the minister's house, and as ruler over Egypt's stores.
tree:1xzkfon1jy6obr.relation: Two stages of Joseph's establishment, from slave to ruler.

tree:0fqlr620t5u12c.why: Thus Allah seals the hearts of the disbelievers (7:101), of those who do not know (30:59). A memorizer pair.
tree:0fqlr620t5u12c.relation: The sealing of hearts as the end of persistent denial.

tree:14s86yf1rg54c1.why: Each faction rejoicing in what it has, after people split their religion into sects. Same theme in both places.
tree:14s86yf1rg54c1.relation: Sectarian division and each sect's self-satisfaction.

tree:1hp1xkp1k0jvpt.why: How many generations We destroyed before them: they walk in their dwellings (20:128), they will not return to them (36:31).
tree:1hp1xkp1k0jvpt.relation: The ruins of past nations as a lesson.

tree:0maxwmd0fmrbnr.why: I ask you no wage for it: the Prophet (6:90) and Hud (11:51), with different continuations.
tree:0maxwmd0fmrbnr.relation: Prophets asking no reward for their message.

tree:1brjnmn0d2g23b.why: Do not consume your wealth among you unjustly, continued with bribing judges (2:188) and the exception of trade by consent (4:29).
tree:1brjnmn0d2g23b.relation: The ban on unjust wealth and its lawful alternative.

tree:03adj5z1lzppj5.why: Do not sell My signs for a small price: to the Children of Israel (2:41), and to the rabbis judging by the Torah (5:44).

tree:1i8c54k0kkl626.why: Do not walk on earth arrogantly, with two reasons: you cannot tear the earth (17:37), Allah does not love the boaster (31:18).
tree:1i8c54k0kkl626.relation: Humility in walking, argued two ways.

tree:1fuyoqh17yyt8n.why: The false gods create nothing and are themselves created, the same argument in two surahs.

tree:0l0759b05fe21n.why: Allah burdens no soul beyond its capacity (2:286), beyond what He gave it (65:7). Classic memorizer pair.
tree:0l0759b05fe21n.relation: Duty measured by ability and by means.

tree:1ygqpje0hxa9oe.why: In Hell the criminal neither dies nor lives, in 20:74 and 87:13, each followed by the success of the purified believer.
tree:1ygqpje0hxa9oe.relation: The state of the damned, set against the saved.

tree:1ubiv5q0ouq99o.why: That you magnify Allah for guiding you, after completing the fast (2:185) and after the sacrifice (22:37).
tree:1ubiv5q0ouq99o.relation: Takbir closing two acts of worship.

tree:1dd65zp1iallpp.why: Revelation sent to warn the Mother of Towns and those around it, said of the Book in 6:92 and of the Arabic Quran in 42:7.
tree:1dd65zp1iallpp.relation: Mecca and its surroundings as the first audience.

tree:1p9dpjf1oxxlif.why: The Prophet cannot guide people himself, but Allah guides whom He wills, in 2:272 and 28:56.
tree:1p9dpjf1oxxlif.relation: Guidance is Allah's alone, not the Prophet's.

tree:06r6b9p17yie6b.why: On the Day they feel they stayed only an hour of a day, in 10:45 and 46:35. Same scene.
tree:06r6b9p17yie6b.relation: The shortness of worldly life seen from the Day.

tree:12jgws30k484zt.why: The word after the dominion phrase is a different word in each: and you have no protector in 2:107, and what is between them in 43:85. This is the owner's own example of a different structure.

tree:1ceiggf1cjkk51.why: Theirs is the curse and the evil home: for those who break Allah's covenant (13:25) and for the wrongdoers on the Day (40:52).
tree:1ceiggf1cjkk51.relation: The curse and evil abode for covenant breakers and wrongdoers.

tree:0ukok1a13u8hcs.why: A rare punishment phrase, a painful torment of foul kind, for those who oppose or deny Our signs. Same subject.
tree:0ukok1a13u8hcs.relation: The punishment for fighting the signs.

tree:0l9mm7d02kiz9x.why: They have no protector from Allah: said of the deniers in 13:34 and of destroyed past nations in 40:21. Rare clause, same theme.

tree:0q5djkp0i4bfub.why: He is the One who brings you out of darkness into light, through His blessings in 33:43 and His clear signs in 57:9, each closing with His mercy.
tree:0q5djkp0i4bfub.relation: Allah's mercy taking believers from darkness to light.

tree:13fkg7y03jshck.why: A rare clause: none besides Allah for it, about a soul with no protector in 6:70, and the Hour none can disclose in 53:58. Useful for a memorizer though the subjects differ.

tree:153atp41gnsv2g.why: Two ayat in the Badr passage repeat that Allah brought the armies together to settle a matter already decreed.
tree:153atp41gnsv2g.relation: Badr as Allah's decree, from the meeting to the perception of numbers.

tree:00daek61vzai2u.why: What Allah gave them of His bounty: hidden by the misers (4:37) and envied by others (4:54).
tree:00daek61vzai2u.relation: Two vices toward Allah's bounty: hiding it and envying it.

tree:0sxqvfe0uj4c6g.why: We sent no messenger except to be obeyed (4:64), except in his people's tongue (14:4). A memorizer pair on the purpose of messengers.

tree:06gvuo10brssb5.why: We sent you only as a bearer of good news and a warner, the same sentence about the Prophet's role in two surahs.
tree:06gvuo10brssb5.relation: The Prophet's role defined in the same words.

tree:1rhsjgf06pa8xt.why: Your Lord is not unaware of what you do: this closing ends both Hud and an-Naml, the last ayah of each surah. A memorizer pair.
