tree:1rhsjgf06pa8xt.relation: Two surahs closing on Allah's watch over deeds.

tree:13c9hu81k6gyi6.why: They have no defender against Allah, with two different nouns at the end: no protector in 10:27, no shield in 13:34. A memorizer pair.

tree:0ltf3ab0wk5e7j.why: They have none besides Him, ending with two related nouns for a guardian in 13:11 and 18:26. A memorizer pair.

tree:1jgvama0eqslhe.why: That of which I have no knowledge: Noah asking forgiveness for asking it (11:47), and Pharaoh's believer refusing to associate it with Allah (40:42).
tree:1jgvama0eqslhe.relation: Refusing to go beyond knowledge, in prayer and in creed.

tree:01rja460ga615c.why: There is no god but Allah, followed by two pairs of names: the Mighty, the Wise (3:62) and the One, the Subduer (38:65). A memorizer pair.

tree:1k9azhi0io1jac.why: None take heed but people of understanding, closing an ayah on wisdom (2:269) and one on the clear and ambiguous verses (3:7).
tree:1k9azhi0io1jac.relation: Understanding as the condition for benefiting from wisdom and revelation.

tree:0b0qjrp1w68zd7.why: Only the phrase about what they worship besides Allah is shared; Abraham leaving his people and the gathering of idols with their worshippers are different subjects with no point drawn between them.

tree:109pmhi15gtokk.why: Satan promises them nothing but delusion: the same sentence in 4:120 and 17:64, each in a passage on Satan's plan to mislead.

tree:11jor6016wu248.why: The deniers ask what Allah meant by this parable, about the gnat in 2:26 and the number of the guardians of Hell in 74:31; both then say He leads astray and guides by it.
tree:11jor6016wu248.relation: The same test: one example misleads some and guides others.

tree:1wcvpb60f4r770.why: The same promise of gardens and good dwellings in gardens of Eden, closing with the great success; 9:72 adds Allah's pleasure. Same reward for believers.
tree:1wcvpb60f4r770.relation: The highest reward described in the same words.

tree:1gg601f0p2a1zh.why: Confirming what came before it: Jesus confirming the Torah (5:46) and the Quran confirming the Book (5:48), in neighbouring ayat.
tree:1gg601f0p2a1zh.relation: Each revelation confirming the one before.

tree:0foj7u510budwz.why: Do not call another god with Allah: a warning that whoever does has no proof (23:117), and a command to the Prophet (28:88).
tree:0foj7u510budwz.relation: The prohibition of calling on other gods.

tree:0iaru980uzjyig.why: His is the dominion of heavens and earth, and to Allah is the return, ending with the destination in 24:42 and all matters in 57:5. A memorizer pair.

tree:0bloisq0njclus.why: Two adjacent ayat on eating what Allah's name was mentioned over: a command, then why would you not.
tree:0bloisq0njclus.relation: The command and its reason, side by side.

tree:13g8k0w1dkpase.why: From before them and behind them: Satan's attack from every side (7:17), and messengers coming to 'Ad and Thamud from every side (41:14).
tree:13g8k0w1dkpase.relation: Contrast: Satan's approach and the messengers' approach from all directions.

tree:1pzqjmg0akk1t6.why: Whoever repents, believes and does good: they enter Paradise (19:60), they may be successful (28:67).
tree:1pzqjmg0akk1t6.relation: Repentance opening the way to success.

tree:0a8gj510puss7j.why: Those worshipped besides Allah own nothing: no provision (29:17), not an atom's weight (34:22). Same argument against false gods.

tree:1iyh9w80uf0oym.why: No protectors besides Allah, in two places of Hud: for the deniers (11:20), and for whoever leans to the wrongdoers (11:113).

tree:0y232qx1vy5w8r.why: No protector besides Him, then nor does He share His rule (18:26) and nor intercessor (32:4). A memorizer pair.

tree:0l73tcv0f73ej1.why: Deniers deny that anything was revealed and accuse the messengers: you only lie (36:15), you are in great error (67:9).
tree:0l73tcv0f73ej1.relation: The deniers rejecting revelation and accusing its bearers.

tree:0e9f62l1e9osrl.why: Only the stock phrase from Allah, indeed Allah is shared; Mary's provision and victory at Badr are unrelated subjects.

tree:0o0230b0td7bud.why: From above them and from beneath their feet: provision that would have poured on the People of the Book had they kept the Torah (5:66), and punishment covering the deniers (29:55).
tree:0o0230b0td7bud.relation: Contrast: blessing from every side, or punishment from every side.

tree:1lub0f904nnr5v.why: The last shared word is a different word in each: all are obedient to Him in 30:26, every day He is at work in 55:29. Beyond that only the common phrase of those in the heavens and earth is shared.

tree:1v2hioh04fn6tn.why: Same story: Lot's people answer only by saying expel them, they keep themselves pure. Near identical in both surahs, with the object named differently.
tree:1v2hioh04fn6tn.relation: One reply of Lot's people told twice.

tree:0mhco4v0xi8tql.why: The chiefs answer Noah and Hud with the same words, we see you in error, then in foolishness. A memorizer pair in one surah.
tree:0mhco4v0xi8tql.relation: Successive prophets met with the same accusation.

tree:1p0u1o00r69j44.why: Whoever of you is ill or: on a journey, for fasting (2:184); with an ailment of the head, for pilgrimage (2:196). The same concession in two acts of worship.
tree:1p0u1o00r69j44.relation: Allah's concessions for the sick in fasting and in Hajj.

tree:0m7bfik09727by.why: Whoever disbelieves, Allah is free of need: of the worlds after the duty of Hajj (3:97), and praiseworthy after Luqman's gratitude (31:12).
tree:0m7bfik09727by.relation: Allah needs no one's worship or thanks.

tree:08j2wq00nyjwte.why: Only the phrase of those your right hands possess is shared; a marriage ruling and a parable against shirk have nothing to learn from each other.

tree:14f0c8a1aumv4o.why: People in danger at sea or land vow to be grateful if saved, and both passages go on to show them break the vow once rescued.
tree:14f0c8a1aumv4o.relation: The vow made in danger and broken in safety.

tree:0uj4pup18vdnyt.why: The Prophet answers the deniers that Allah knows, or they will know, who is in clear error. Same reply in two surahs.
tree:0uj4pup18vdnyt.relation: Leaving the verdict on who is misguided to Allah.

tree:0cpxctf0x1mikp.why: Whoever fears Allah, He makes for him a way out (65:2) and ease in his affair (65:4), two promises in the same divorce passage.
tree:0cpxctf0x1mikp.relation: Two rewards of piety amid the hardships of divorce.

tree:0y4rsf61pxh4ew.why: Who provides for you from the sky and earth: a question the idolaters answer with Allah (10:31), and a challenge is there a god with Allah (27:64).
tree:0y4rsf61pxh4ew.relation: Provision as proof of Allah's oneness.

tree:13058n41fltsb0.why: Allah guides to Himself whoever turns to Him, past tense in 13:27 and present in 42:13. A memorizer pair.
tree:13058n41fltsb0.relation: Guidance given to those who turn to Allah.

tree:08kjd1x068asej.why: Who would help me against Allah if: Noah if he drove away the believers (11:30), Salih if he disobeyed (11:63). Two prophets in one surah.
tree:08kjd1x068asej.relation: Prophets fearing Allah more than their people.

tree:0yf8ioy0bw2dr4.why: Whoever of you does this has strayed from the straight way: disbelief after the covenant (5:12), secret friendship with enemies (60:1). A memorizer pair.
tree:0yf8ioy0bw2dr4.relation: Two betrayals that lead astray: of the covenant and of loyalty.

tree:1ft5wx517jtnpn.why: Moses sent with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, in 7:103 and 43:46. Same story.
tree:1ft5wx517jtnpn.relation: Moses' mission told in two surahs.

tree:13r6rdf1leequx.why: Same event word for word: We saved Noah and his family from the great distress.

tree:1wm7lfd08xz437.why: Both speak of the Prophet as a warner against the objections of others, ending differently: Allah is able over all things (5:19), Guardian over all things (11:12). Thin beyond the stock endings.

tree:1tuvobg0xm4jku.why: Those who take Allah's signs in mockery have a humiliating punishment, said twice with different verb forms. A memorizer pair.
tree:1tuvobg0xm4jku.relation: Mocking the signs and its punishment.

tree:08x5dlb1vbr163.why: He made the night for you: for rest (10:67), as a covering (25:47), and the day for sight or rising.
tree:08x5dlb1vbr163.relation: Night and day as a sign and a mercy.

tree:16dflgt11r6uh3.why: In the Hereafter among the losers: whoever seeks a religion other than Islam (3:85), whoever rejects faith (5:5).
tree:16dflgt11r6uh3.relation: Loss in the Hereafter for rejecting the faith.

tree:1vs0lso0kdnq8i.why: The promise of Allah, Allah does not break His promise, said of Rome's victory (30:6) and of Paradise's rooms (39:20).
tree:1vs0lso0kdnq8i.relation: Allah's promise kept in this world and the next.

tree:17egefy0tncmf6.why: O believers, if you obey a group of the People of the Book (3:100) or the disbelievers (3:149), they will turn you back. Same warning in one surah.
tree:17egefy0tncmf6.relation: The danger of obeying the enemies of faith.

tree:0j9xx8805mayjy.why: O people, if you are in doubt: of my religion (10:104), of the resurrection (22:5). A memorizer pair, each followed by its answer.

tree:011pz211y0jjk3.why: Seeking bounty from Allah and His pleasure: the companions in prayer (48:29), and the poor emigrants (59:8).
tree:011pz211y0jjk3.relation: The companions described by what they seek.

tree:1qmngqe0fvw8r8.why: Those who transgress on earth without right: the rescued who rebel (10:23), and the oppressors held accountable (42:42).
tree:1qmngqe0fvw8r8.relation: Transgression on earth and its punishment.

tree:154f53k0qo92fc.why: He brings them out of darkness into light: Allah as protector of the believers (2:257), and through the Book (5:16).
tree:154f53k0qo92fc.relation: Allah leading from darkness to light.

tree:09nxeq301qu0zp.why: He knows what you hide and what you declare, in 16:19 and 64:4. A memorizer pair for the closing words.

tree:0ibmecl07xqys9.why: Only the common phrase that He knows what is in the heavens and earth is shared; a call to Allah as witness and a statement of His knowledge continue in unrelated ways.

tree:0bjpc761wxtnzm.why: Both promise that Allah will give something better and forgive: the captives at Badr if there is good in their hearts, and the believers a double share of mercy. The parallel is more than the closing formula, but thin.
tree:0bjpc761wxtnzm.relation: Allah's compensation and forgiveness offered for faith.

tree:0eu7i5p1yj8emf.why: Same description of Thamud's ringleaders, who spread corruption in the land and do not set right, in two tellings of Salih's story.
tree:0eu7i5p1yj8emf.relation: One people's corrupters in two surahs.

tree:0mouw2a10s9ic8.why: To Allah is your return, and He will inform you of what you differed in, said with two lead-ins in 5:48 and 6:164.
tree:0mouw2a10s9ic8.relation: Differences settled by Allah on the return.

tree:1nji4e51xw0yhh.why: Whatever you spend will be repaid in full and you will not be wronged: spending in charity (2:272) and in preparing for war (8:60).
tree:1nji4e51xw0yhh.relation: Spending in Allah's cause is never lost.

tree:16mulr50v6sow7.why: Moses calls his people three times with the same opening: to repent from the calf, to remember Allah's favour, and to stop hurting him.
tree:16mulr50v6sow7.relation: Moses' patience with his people through three calls.

tree:1ek719e04u9bdo.why: Remember Allah's favour upon you when: Moses reminding his people twice (5:20, 14:6), and the believers reminded of the Trench (33:9).
tree:1ek719e04u9bdo.relation: Allah's favours remembered through specific rescues.

tree:0xblzi80h8rj2k.why: Ask forgiveness of your Lord then repent to Him, three times in Hud: the Prophet, Hud and Shu'ayb, each with a different promise.
tree:0xblzi80h8rj2k.relation: The same call to repentance by three messengers.

tree:0u1bqik1ombv52.why: Know that Allah is severe in punishment, in three places; 5:98 alone pairs it with His forgiveness and mercy. A memorizer set.
tree:0u1bqik1ombv52.relation: Allah's severity, balanced once by His mercy.

tree:1l2kgae09f689a.why: Know that Allah is with the God-fearing closes three commands about fighting: retaliation in the sacred month, fighting the idolaters together, and fighting those near you.
tree:1l2kgae09f689a.relation: Allah's company promised to the pious in warfare.

tree:166cqc40hxm0wm.why: They turn to one another questioning: the people of Hell blaming each other (37:27), and the people of Paradise recalling the past (37:50, 52:25).
tree:166cqc40hxm0wm.relation: Contrast: the same mutual questioning in Hell and in Paradise.

tree:1jhzmwp0s6gamx.why: They swore by Allah their strongest oaths that if: a sign came, the Prophet commanded, a warner came, they would comply; and they did not.
tree:1jhzmwp0s6gamx.relation: Strong oaths of the insincere, broken each time.

tree:0c3fin91b6h10l.why: That of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew: the reward of emigrants (16:41) and the punishment of deniers (39:26, 68:33).
tree:0c3fin91b6h10l.relation: Contrast: the Hereafter's reward and punishment both greater than this world's.

tree:1421nto0ku0nx2.why: The dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is over all things: able in 3:29 and 3:189, witness in 85:9. The memorizer value is that ending; the rest is a common formula.

tree:08xxowo1fhk7t8.why: Only the common formula of those who believe and do good, those are, followed by unrelated rewards; generic reward wording with nothing to learn from the set.

tree:0slt9f81v70w1g.why: Three times in Ghafir: those who dispute about Allah's signs, twice without authority given to them and once asked how they are turned away.
tree:0slt9f81v70w1g.relation: The disputers' arrogance as the surah's theme.

tree:04bvo0u1jrlf3y.why: Those who call on others besides Allah: do not insult their gods (6:108), they follow only guesswork (10:66), their gods create nothing (16:20).
tree:04bvo0u1jrlf3y.relation: Three ways of dealing with false worship.

tree:1rdg7q91db5g4t.why: Those who invent lies about Allah will not succeed (10:69, 16:116), and what will they think on the Day (10:60).
tree:1rdg7q91db5g4t.relation: The fate of those who lie about Allah.

tree:1136y150isp1br.why: He sends the winds as good news before His mercy, three times with different continuations: rain reviving dead land, pure water, and a challenge to the idolaters.
tree:1136y150isp1br.relation: The winds as a sign of Allah's mercy and power.

tree:0nrlksw1u6y2oc.why: The punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive: past plotters (16:26), a threat to present ones (16:45), past deniers (39:25).
tree:0nrlksw1u6y2oc.relation: Sudden punishment for those who plot and deny.

tree:01yielt07gpidb.why: The same list of kin, orphans, the poor and the traveller as rightful recipients: of charity (2:177), of the war spoils (8:41) and of the fay' (59:7).
tree:01yielt07gpidb.relation: The same needy people named in three kinds of wealth.

tree:0kqwi5q1p7al4q.why: Taking the disbelievers as allies instead of the believers, forbidden in 3:28 and 4:144 and blamed in 4:139, each with a different warning.
tree:0kqwi5q1p7al4q.relation: Loyalty to the believers, three warnings.

tree:0mg2csn0u244b7.why: Only the stock closing that Allah is Mighty and Wise is shared; victory at Badr, the believers' alliance and the endless words of Allah are unrelated.

tree:1fgglc900r8rn1.why: Allah is witness over all things, closing ayat on His judgment between the religions (22:17), on the Day He informs people of their deeds (58:6), and on His dominion (85:9).
tree:1fgglc900r8rn1.relation: Allah as witness on the Day of judgment.

tree:1pbst8p0vt4csv.why: The real pair is 14:11 and 58:10: nothing happens except by Allah's leave, so upon Allah let the believers rely. 5:11 shares only the common closing after a different phrase.
tree:1pbst8p0vt4csv.changes: Remove 5:11: its link is only the common closing about reliance, after fear Allah, not after by Allah's leave.
tree:1pbst8p0vt4csv.relation: Reliance on Allah because all is by His leave.

tree:03gqpw01vm85s8.why: The hypocrites and those with sickness in their hearts speak against the believers at Badr and the Trench, and are threatened in 33:60.
tree:03gqpw01vm85s8.relation: The hypocrites' talk in times of war.

tree:0108uwe0u77rbi.why: My reward is only from Allah, said by Noah twice and by the Prophet, each continued differently. A classic memorizer set.
tree:0108uwe0u77rbi.relation: Messengers seeking no reward from people.

tree:1p5ovaj179zftn.why: Only the stock closing that Allah sees what you do is shared; prayer and charity, nursing, and the dowry are separate subjects, and the closing is found in many more places.

tree:0q6cedo1q6znr0.why: Only the stock closing that Allah is aware of what you do; justice, false oaths and preparing for tomorrow are unrelated, and the closing occurs elsewhere too.

tree:1dpgdv316j6bcl.why: Only the stock closing that Allah knows what is in the breasts; the hypocrites' rage, the covenant, and grief over disbelief are unrelated subjects.

tree:1bl2n5e0nbh03m.why: Allah does not guide: whom He leaves astray (16:37), the transgressing liar (40:28). A memorizer pair with different objects.

tree:1ffbguw1vfx6z0.why: Allah is the Free of need, the Praised: 57:24 and 60:6 share the full clause whoever turns away, Allah is free of need, against 31:26 on His owning all. A memorizer set.
tree:1ffbguw1vfx6z0.relation: Allah needs nothing from those who turn away.

tree:0393mmf15uo9ix.why: It is only a reminder to the worlds: the same description of the Quran in three surahs, the latter two closing their surahs.

tree:10th2xq1da9cca.why: We disbelieve in what you were sent with: the reply of the wealthy to every warner, of 'Ad and Thamud, and of those following their fathers.
tree:10th2xq1da9cca.relation: The same rejection by every people.

tree:0p2qc3915slm7n.why: We caused to grow in it every noble pair (26:7, 31:10), every delightful pair (50:7). A memorizer set.
tree:0p2qc3915slm7n.relation: Plants in pairs as a sign of creation.

tree:0yraxim0y9wntg.why: Wait, I am waiting with you: Hud to his people and the Prophet twice in Yunus. A memorizer set.
tree:0yraxim0y9wntg.relation: The prophets leaving the outcome to Allah.

tree:1bha3xi1b7y3z8.why: Travel in the land and see the end of the deniers, linked with then in 6:11 and with so in the others. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1bha3xi1b7y3z8.relation: Lessons from the ruins of the deniers.

tree:1or5xlp0kk4rod.why: Al-Khidr tells Moses three times that he cannot be patient with him, growing sharper each time. A memorizer set within one story.
tree:1or5xlp0kk4rod.relation: The progression of Moses' test of patience.

tree:0x06swk10f5wrq.why: Abraham is among the righteous in the Hereafter, after his blessings in this world, in three surahs.

tree:1x4lzqp0s4ug6v.why: Evil is what they used to do, closing descriptions of those who barred others from Allah's way: idolaters who broke treaties, and hypocrites using oaths as a shield.
tree:1x4lzqp0s4ug6v.relation: Barring others from Allah's path and its verdict.

tree:03v9bqw0vu7m9c.why: Do they not see that Allah who created: is able to create them again (17:99), is stronger than they (41:15), is able to revive the dead (46:33).
tree:03v9bqw0vu7m9c.relation: Allah's creative power as an argument against the deniers.

tree:1d9bg6b0epcpjn.why: Associating with Allah what He sent no authority for, in three places: its punishment, Abraham's argument, and the list of what is forbidden.

tree:1qavrci11xrvwu.why: Striving with wealth and lives in Allah's cause: the bond of emigrants and helpers (8:72), the true believers (49:15), and those who hated it (9:81).
tree:1qavrci11xrvwu.relation: Contrast: the true believers who strive and the hypocrites who stay behind.

tree:0hnsfv91384w1f.why: Allah gives to whom He wills of His servants: guidance (6:88), good (10:107), rain (30:48). The phrase is fairly common.
tree:0hnsfv91384w1f.relation: Allah's choice in giving guidance and blessing.

tree:06os85v1scwfw5.why: Except those who repent after that and reform, followed by Allah's forgiveness; 3:89 and 24:5 are identical, 16:119 differs. A classic memorizer set.
tree:06os85v1scwfw5.relation: Repentance opening the door after serious sins.

tree:161j54w137bu3i.why: You are recompensed only for what you did, said in three Day of Judgment scenes with different lead-ins.

tree:002b1a7186csfl.why: Moses' hand coming out white without harm, told three times with different commands and continuations. Same story.

tree:15eqzco17fybyu.why: He gave you hearing, sight and hearts, ending with that you may be grateful (16:78), little do you thank (32:9, 67:23).
tree:15eqzco17fybyu.relation: Allah's gifts of perception and man's ingratitude.

tree:0n61z1a0kub06y.why: Their deeds have come to nothing in this world and the next: apostates, those who kill the prophets and the just, and the hypocrites. Same verdict in three places.

tree:1u3dyhq0m014y8.why: At sea in danger they call on Allah sincerely, then return to shirk when saved. Same scene in three surahs.
tree:1u3dyhq0m014y8.relation: Sincerity in distress, forgotten in safety.

tree:0hord6803b00q8.why: That was because they disobeyed and transgressed, closing three passages on the Children of Israel. A memorizer set.
tree:0hord6803b00q8.relation: Disobedience as cause of humiliation and curse.

tree:1vhqqqz1eyzmxj.why: A punishment from the sky because of their sin: twice on the Children of Israel who changed the word (2:59, 7:162, ending in defiance or wrongdoing) and on Lot's town (29:34).
tree:1vhqqqz1eyzmxj.relation: Punishment from the sky for corrupting the command.

tree:1qwwh2g0vvqzdu.why: Three surahs open with the same glorification, 57:1 without the second what is in. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1qwwh2g0vvqzdu.relation: The surahs of glorification opening alike.

tree:0qp182a0hgvx7g.why: 2:173 and 2:182 share the full clause there is no sin on him, Allah is Forgiving, Merciful: the one forced to eat the forbidden, and the one who corrects an unjust will.
tree:0qp182a0hgvx7g.changes: Remove 5:39: its link is only the stock closing; the word before it belongs to a different phrase (Allah turns to him), not to there is no sin on him.
tree:0qp182a0hgvx7g.relation: Allah lifting blame from those acting under need or for justice.

tree:08qc1401js0xoc.why: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who is guided, in three places with small differences. A classic memorizer set.
tree:08qc1401js0xoc.relation: Guidance and error known only to Allah.

tree:0gwowzi0qggm8s.why: He placed firm mountains in the earth lest it shake with you, followed by roads, creatures or paths. Three tellings to keep apart.
tree:0gwowzi0qggm8s.relation: Mountains as a sign of mercy and stability.

tree:1mzidpt0oke521.why: In the life of this world and in the Hereafter: the friends of Allah have good news (10:64), the believers are made firm (14:27), the angels are their allies (41:31).
tree:1mzidpt0oke521.relation: Allah's support of the believers in both worlds.

tree:0osjuy60um8dqw.why: Punishment in this world, and the punishment of the Hereafter is worse: harder, greater, more disgraceful. One word changes in each, a classic memorizer set.
tree:0osjuy60um8dqw.relation: Worldly punishment as a foretaste of a worse one.

tree:1j1ewdi1e5okf8.why: Loss in this world and the next, with no helpers: 3:22 and 3:56 alike, 9:74 adds on earth no protector.
tree:1j1ewdi1e5okf8.relation: No helper for the disbelievers in either world.

tree:0ei0als0crkn3w.why: Among nations of jinn and men that passed before you or them, entering the Fire or condemned. A memorizer set.
tree:0ei0als0crkn3w.relation: Joining the condemned nations of the past.

tree:1qdl6vq00ocfdw.why: Moses repeats He says it is a cow, three times with three descriptions as the Israelites keep asking.
tree:1qdl6vq00ocfdw.relation: The Israelites' repeated questions making the command harder.

tree:0z3ukjw1n4477w.why: How many generations We destroyed before them: 6:6 and 38:3 with a singular generation, 32:26 with the plural. A memorizer set.

tree:18g2kx51e25nm7.why: There is no god but He, so how are you deluded, or turned away: three ayat after signs of creation.
tree:18g2kx51e25nm7.relation: From Allah's creation to the folly of turning away.

tree:114g8ac1y4wjws.why: Shu'ayb tells his people not to cheat people of their goods and not to spread corruption, in three tellings with small differences.

tree:13eo2af1xgk4eh.why: We burden no soul beyond its capacity, placed amid fair measure (6:152), the reward of believers (7:42), and the record of deeds (23:62).
tree:13eo2af1xgk4eh.relation: Duties within capacity, in law and in judgment.

tree:0zleb7k1b37gxc.why: But most people do not believe, after the truth from your Lord (11:17, 13:1) and the coming Hour (40:59). A memorizer set against the commoner do not know.
tree:0zleb7k1b37gxc.relation: Most people's disbelief in the truth.

tree:1iuoxao06xwp68.why: To Allah belongs the dominion of heavens and earth and what is between them or in them, three times in al-Ma'ida with different endings. A memorizer set.
tree:1iuoxao06xwp68.relation: Allah's dominion answering claims about Jesus and the chosen people.

tree:1nccxlg0qx0nrc.why: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and earth: so He has no son, all obey Him (2:116); religion is His alone (16:52).
tree:1nccxlg0qx0nrc.changes: Remove 59:24: there the words are the object of glorifies Him, a different structure, not a statement of ownership.
tree:1nccxlg0qx0nrc.relation: Allah's ownership of all as an argument for His sole worship.

tree:1mbbe9o1e443k8.why: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth: all are devoutly obedient (30:26), even those near Him never tire of worship (21:19).
tree:1mbbe9o1e443k8.changes: Remove 24:41: there the words are the subject of glorifies Him, a different structure, not a statement of ownership.
tree:1mbbe9o1e443k8.relation: All creation belongs to and serves Allah.

tree:1x00t5v1wkwcjh.why: Disgrace in this world and great punishment in the Hereafter: for those who block mosques, wage war on Allah, and the hypocrites and some Jews.
tree:1x00t5v1wkwcjh.relation: A double punishment for three kinds of enemies.

tree:1uuqtdv179wxh1.why: That He may reward those who believe and do good: the stated purpose of the resurrection or the Hour in three places.
tree:1uuqtdv179wxh1.relation: The Day exists so that justice is done to the believers.

tree:1sxzsdb1moc341.why: What was revealed to you from your Lord, in close ayat of al-Ma'ida: it increases many of them in rebellion (5:64), and the Messenger must deliver it (5:67).
tree:1sxzsdb1moc341.relation: The revelation that the Prophet must deliver despite rejection.

tree:1t2fkra08hwbkw.why: What was revealed to you from your Lord: the People of the Book told to uphold it (5:68), all told to follow it (7:3) and its best (39:55).

tree:0dom05m0wtaxqe.why: What you call on besides Allah: Abraham leaving them (19:48), and the Prophet's challenges about their power (39:38) and their creation (46:4).
tree:0dom05m0wtaxqe.relation: Exposing the helplessness of false gods.

tree:1nbqwgv16t2w8x.why: The Messenger's duty is only delivery, plain or clear, in three places. A memorizer set.
tree:1nbqwgv16t2w8x.relation: The limit of the Messenger's duty.

tree:1mq726v1q1atv5.why: What He sent down no authority for, in three places: the punishment of shirk, the forbidden things, and worship of what they do not know.

tree:1w9h55v037ynn5.why: He has no share in the Hereafter: whoever buys magic (2:102), whoever asks only for this world (2:200, 42:20). A memorizer set with two nouns for the share.
tree:1w9h55v037ynn5.relation: Choosing this world at the cost of the next.

tree:0hjcuak1cyk6si.why: They have no knowledge of it, only conjecture: about the crucifixion (4:157), the claim of a son (18:5), and naming angels as female (53:28).
tree:0hjcuak1cyk6si.relation: False beliefs resting on guesswork, not knowledge.

tree:1ot0hm10xfxco1.why: What god other than Allah could bring it back to you: hearing and sight (6:46), light (28:71), night (28:72). A memorizer set and one argument.
tree:1ot0hm10xfxco1.relation: Allah alone gives what He takes away.

tree:088lkuv0759qbh.why: After clear proofs had come to them, people differed (2:213, 2:253) or took the calf (4:153).
tree:088lkuv0759qbh.relation: Division and error after clear evidence.

tree:1yd6nb80kvewyi.why: Before him and behind him: guardian angels (13:11), warners before and after Hud (46:21), guards for the messenger (72:27).
tree:1yd6nb80kvewyi.relation: Allah's guarding and warning on every side.

tree:1stl69u16s9xiu.why: Whoever wills takes a way to his Lord: identical in 73:19 and 76:29, with a return instead of a way in 78:39.
tree:1stl69u16s9xiu.relation: Free choice to take the path to Allah.

tree:11no5b60ih4rm8.why: From dry clay of altered mud, three times in al-Hijr: man's creation, Allah telling the angels, and Iblis's refusal.
tree:11no5b60ih4rm8.relation: The material of Adam, at the root of Iblis's pride.

tree:0jh1o0k0czcan2.why: Allah gives to whom He wills, and Allah is All-Encompassing, Knowing: kingship to Talut (2:247), bounty in 3:73 and 5:54.
tree:0jh1o0k0czcan2.relation: Allah's free choice in giving rule and favour.

tree:04sp1pk0j1496g.why: Those who believed, emigrated and strove in Allah's cause, with three rewards: hope of mercy, true believers, greater rank.
tree:04sp1pk0j1496g.relation: The emigrants who strive and their rewards.

tree:1phw58k1jkgv36.why: He created the heavens and the earth: in truth (6:73), in six days with His throne on water (11:7), in six days then rose over the throne (57:4).
tree:1phw58k1jkgv36.relation: The creation of heavens and earth told with different details.

tree:1llp9ab1i07hev.why: Those who give zakat and are certain of the Hereafter (27:3, 31:4), against those who do not give zakat and disbelieve in it (41:7).
tree:1llp9ab1i07hev.relation: Contrast: the believers and the idolaters, by zakat and by the Hereafter.

tree:0wyd5bq1111l1e.why: Enjoining good and forbidding evil: a command to the community (3:104), praise of some of the People of the Book (3:114), and the mark of the believers (9:71).
tree:0wyd5bq1111l1e.relation: Enjoining good as the mark of the faithful.

tree:04wfjma1cml91s.why: He knows what they hide and what they reveal, ending the ayah in 2:77 and continued with two different closings in 11:5 and 16:23.

tree:19v5y1517w3whn.why: On the Day He asks where are My partners whom you claimed; 28:62 and 28:74 are identical, 16:27 differs. A classic memorizer set.
tree:19v5y1517w3whn.relation: The false partners missing on the Day.

tree:1fo1vrj0j465sz.why: Fear Allah and know that Allah: is with the pious, severe in punishment, knows all, sees all, four times in al-Baqara's laws. Which ending goes where is the memorizer's task.

tree:0wxw5y71udfln7.why: Praise be to Allah, but most of them do not know, after two parables and an admission (16:75, 31:25, 39:29); 29:63 ends do not reason.
tree:0wxw5y71udfln7.relation: The idolaters' admissions and parables answered with praise.

tree:17vpc461p4flhw.why: He to whom belongs the dominion of heavens and earth, followed four ways: no god but He, no son or partner, and what is between them, witness over all. A memorizer set.
tree:17vpc461p4flhw.relation: Allah's dominion and what follows from it.

tree:08ojcm20bcd3zu.why: Those given the Book before you: their harm to be endured (3:186), the same command of piety given to them (4:131), not to be taken as allies when they mock (5:57).
tree:08ojcm20bcd3zu.relation: The believers and the earlier People of the Book.

tree:0071urs1kq5kw0.why: The disbelievers say this is nothing but clear magic, tales of the ancients, or a lie he invented. Same accusation in four places.
tree:0071urs1kq5kw0.relation: The many labels the deniers put on the revelation.

tree:0pj8jxk0o7anhm.why: Allah sends down water from the sky, and four outcomes: dead land revived, earth turned green, fruits of many colours, springs and crops.
tree:0pj8jxk0o7anhm.relation: Rain as a sign of revival and variety.

tree:18evu7g0fh6c98.why: Only the stock closing that Allah does not guide the disbelieving people; charity spoilt by showing off, the Prophet's duty to deliver, the postponed months and apostasy are unrelated.

tree:0dbn0450bgokx9.why: Allah has favour on people, but most people are not grateful: in the story of those who fled death (2:243), Joseph's words (12:38), and night and day (40:61).
tree:0dbn0450bgokx9.changes: Remove 40:57: its people belongs to the creation of people and it ends with do not know, so it shares only the common half sentence.

tree:04ptqdq1bf8orc.why: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter: a painful punishment, swerving from the path, deeds made attractive, naming angels female. Four short descriptions of the same people.
tree:04ptqdq1bf8orc.relation: What denial of the Hereafter leads to.

tree:1ygy7ig1v3au4y.why: Only the stock closing that Allah is Knowing and Wise; inheritance, marriage, a command to the Prophet and Allah's will are separate subjects.

tree:1r3a1ot1r474ih.why: Only the stock closing that Allah is Forgiving and Merciful, after unrelated rulings and events; nothing to learn from the set.

tree:01dlrai1tfu6wu.why: Allah does not let the reward be lost: of the believers (3:171), of the doers of good after striving, patience and Joseph's trial.
tree:01dlrai1tfu6wu.relation: No good deed is lost with Allah.

tree:1chhdgr14ozd9n.why: Allah knows what is in the heavens and earth, said with the plural or the singular sky, after the Ka'ba's rites (5:97), the Book (22:70) and secret talk (58:7).
tree:1chhdgr14ozd9n.changes: Remove 2:235: there the words continue with what is in yourselves, a different object, in a ruling on proposals in the waiting period.

tree:1ix68mf1y9kkbv.why: To Allah belongs what is in the heavens and earth, said as a reply to disbelief in an-Nisa' and as a declaration in 10:55 and 24:64. A memorizer set.
tree:1ix68mf1y9kkbv.relation: Allah's ownership: He needs no one's faith.

tree:0kkb0xo0iu9dac.why: These are only tales of the ancients, the deniers' line in four places; 23:83 and 27:68 differ only in word order. A classic memorizer set.
tree:0kkb0xo0iu9dac.relation: The deniers dismissing revelation as old tales.

tree:0rqz1vg0p7n6z6.why: Bring us what you threaten if you are truthful: said to Hud, Noah and Hud again; to Salih with if you are a messenger.
tree:0rqz1vg0p7n6z6.relation: Each people daring its prophet to bring the punishment.

tree:0m55bqy01vissi.why: The way of Abraham, upright, and he was not of the idolaters, in four places with different lead-ins. Classic memorizer set.
tree:0m55bqy01vissi.relation: Abraham's pure monotheism as the model.

tree:1qlpu7u0i1joc2.why: We created the heavens and earth and what is between them: in truth, not in play, in six days without fatigue.
tree:1qlpu7u0i1joc2.relation: Creation has a purpose and costs Allah no effort.

tree:05lhndg17p4fek.why: Taste the punishment for your disbelief; 6:30 and 46:34 share the whole scene of are not this the truth, yes by our Lord. Classic memorizer set.
tree:05lhndg17p4fek.relation: The deniers' confession on the Day, too late.

tree:0mgd3l41n6f7pc.why: Allah is pleased with them and they with Him, four times with different surroundings: the truthful, the first emigrants, the party of Allah, and those who fear their Lord.
tree:0mgd3l41n6f7pc.relation: Mutual pleasure as the highest reward.

tree:0pze9f70ilb68v.why: On whom He wills of His servants: Allah's choice of whom to send revelation to, envied by the Jews (2:90), claimed by messengers (14:11), and the spirit sent down (16:2, 40:15).

tree:04xz9je1w8c1xm.why: Nothing on earth or in the sky is hidden from Allah (3:5, 10:61, 14:38), and you cannot escape Him on earth or in the sky (29:22).
tree:04xz9je1w8c1xm.relation: Allah's knowledge and power reach everywhere.

tree:0iv6ycb1b5t6oz.why: The disbelievers said to the believers: which side is better, follow our way, should we feed, if it were good. Four mocking sayings to the believers.
tree:0iv6ycb1b5t6oz.relation: The arguments of the disbelievers against the believers.

tree:10ck46l064ik3b.why: That is easy for Allah, closing four punishments: for murder, for the deniers in Hell, the hypocrites' deeds, and doubled punishment for the Prophet's wives.
tree:10ck46l064ik3b.relation: No punishment is hard for Allah to carry out.

tree:04m3wyo0lxjaws.why: Thus Allah makes His signs clear to you, closing with that you may reason, be guided, be grateful, or Allah is Knowing, Wise. A classic memorizer set.
tree:04m3wyo0lxjaws.relation: Laws explained so that people reason and are thankful.

tree:1b9tshm0q986gy.why: Thus Allah makes the signs clear to you, closing with reflect, reason, or Knowing, Wise. A classic memorizer set, twin of the set with His signs.
tree:1b9tshm0q986gy.relation: Laws explained so that people reflect.

tree:0caipjc0w4ztr2.why: Eat of the good things We provided: 2:57 and 7:160 identical with manna and quails, 2:172 with gratitude, 20:81 with a warning against excess.
tree:0caipjc0w4ztr2.relation: Provision with the duty of thanks.

tree:1ivrfiv0ehvxyp.why: No bearer of burdens bears another's burden, in four places with different continuations. A classic memorizer set.

tree:1xqsb1i1l7xw06.why: Allah is full of favour to people, but most are not grateful, with most people or most of them. A memorizer set.

tree:0th0z3t0xwrdnh.why: We sent Noah to his people, four tellings: 7:59 and 23:23 nearly identical, 11:25 and 29:14 different.

tree:18l6i6o0dixaam.why: What they earned or enjoyed did not avail them, said of destroyed peoples in four places. A memorizer set.
tree:18l6i6o0dixaam.relation: Wealth and power useless against punishment.

tree:0x97xl61ilm3os.why: What you have no knowledge of: Noah not to ask it (11:46), no one to follow it (17:36), parents' pressure to associate it (29:8, 31:15).

tree:168ey9l04k2uy1.why: The dominion of heavens and earth and what is between them, followed four ways, including the challenge in 38:10. A memorizer set.

tree:0r7s9kc1nl501c.why: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day: 2:62 and 5:69 are near twins, 2:177 defines righteousness, 9:18 the builders of mosques.
tree:0r7s9kc1nl501c.relation: Faith in Allah and the Last Day as the core of righteousness.

tree:1cp8xfc1f6ayhu.why: After it became clear to them: that idolaters are of Hell (9:113), and the guidance which apostates and deniers turned from (47:25, 47:32).
tree:1cp8xfc1f6ayhu.relation: Acting against what has become clear.

tree:1u7khbz0sbsxg7.why: He leaves astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills, in four places with different closings. A memorizer set.
tree:1u7khbz0sbsxg7.relation: Guidance and misguidance by Allah's will.

tree:0dts8z50idpkgb.why: When Our clear signs are recited to them, five reactions follow: mocking, hostile faces, calling it magic, demanding the fathers back. Same scene in five places.
tree:0dts8z50idpkgb.relation: The deniers' responses to the recited signs.

tree:1dxb3hf1fgvdr3.why: Except those who believe and do good: the exception closes five passages, and 84:25 and 95:6 differ only by one letter. The formula is common, but the exceptions are a known memorizer set.

tree:14h5cxz1fapu1j.why: Those you call on besides Allah: 6:56 and 40:66 are the Prophet's near-identical refusal; 7:194, 22:73 and 35:40 expose the false gods' helplessness.
tree:14h5cxz1fapu1j.relation: Refusing false gods and showing their weakness.

tree:0m78zw01gpuwoa.why: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Book, in five places: their envy, their expulsion, the hypocrites' promises to them, and their fate in al-Bayyina.
tree:0m78zw01gpuwoa.relation: The People of the Book who rejected the Prophet.

tree:1fbag1f0p0iwul.why: Satan is a clear enemy to you, closing warnings not to follow his steps, not to worship him, not to let him turn you away.
tree:1fbag1f0p0iwul.relation: Satan's open enmity as the reason for each warning.

tree:1dvbtbn0l9k8sp.why: Asking Allah's forgiveness closes four ayat: after the pilgrims' departure, the night prayer, and the Prophet asking for those seeking leave and for the women's pledge.
tree:1dvbtbn0l9k8sp.changes: Remove 8:69: it has fear Allah, not ask forgiveness, before the closing, so it shares only the stock closing.
tree:1dvbtbn0l9k8sp.relation: Seeking forgiveness after acts of worship and allegiance.

tree:00ujcv81x2vfmi.why: 9:80 and 63:6 are a strong pair: asking forgiveness for the hypocrites, or not, will not help, and Allah does not guide the defiant. The other three share only the stock closing.
tree:00ujcv81x2vfmi.changes: Keep only 9:80 and 63:6; remove 5:108, 9:24 and 61:5, which share only the closing formula.
tree:00ujcv81x2vfmi.relation: The hypocrites beyond the reach of forgiveness.

tree:1tsx36h16cn25l.why: No protector or helper besides Allah: 2:107 and 9:116 after His dominion, 29:22 and 42:31 after you cannot escape, 2:120 a warning to the Prophet. Memorizer pairs inside one set.
tree:1tsx36h16cn25l.relation: No one can protect from Allah.

tree:0u1irqj16fznhj.why: The bounty of Allah, He gives it to whom He wills, closing with All-Encompassing, Knowing or Owner of great bounty. A memorizer set.

tree:1exxy9809y2kzo.why: Allah extends provision to whom He wills and restricts it, five times with different continuations; 30:37 and 39:52 end alike.

tree:162p4yg0sezmbg.why: Allah knows and you do not know, closing rulings people may dislike (fighting, remarriage) and arguments without knowledge.
tree:162p4yg0sezmbg.relation: Allah's knowledge behind commands people cannot see the wisdom of.

tree:09d3c9h12tf4h9.why: As for those who believe and do good: each opens one half of a sorting on the Day, with the reward named differently; 3:57 and 4:173 share their wording.
tree:09d3c9h12tf4h9.relation: The believers' side in each scene of division.

tree:0mu6tma1pkd8le.why: This is nothing but clear magic, the deniers' charge against Jesus' miracles, the Book, the resurrection and the signs.

tree:10ayo501pdn2vq.why: That is better for you if you know, after commands to strive, worship and hurry to Friday prayer; 7:85 ends if you are believers.

tree:1jmu8sn1gnaxnr.why: Travel in the land and see: the end of deniers, criminals, earlier idolaters, or how creation began.

tree:1au6hdc0tkgysw.why: Saying about Allah what you do not know, in five places: false claims about Hell, Satan's command, claiming Allah ordered indecency, the list of forbidden things, and claiming a son.
tree:1au6hdc0tkgysw.relation: Speaking about Allah without knowledge as a grave sin.

tree:0qhco3f05k1dg3.why: Allah is over all things, closing with five different names: Keeper, Able, Powerful, Watcher. A classic memorizer set.

tree:0jup13g1tw7jiu.why: Do not spread corruption on earth, said by Moses, Salih and Shu'ayb (three times).

tree:1jzolrn1akm7w5.why: That you may seek His bounty and be grateful, closing signs of the sea, the winds, and night and day.
tree:1jzolrn1akm7w5.relation: Allah's signs as sources of livelihood and gratitude.

tree:13kxq2h0hb89ab.why: To Allah belongs what is in the heavens and earth, with five different follow-ups. A memorizer set.
tree:13kxq2h0hb89ab.changes: Remove 57:1: there the words are the subject of glorifies Allah, a different structure.
tree:13kxq2h0hb89ab.relation: Allah's ownership, stated with its consequences.

tree:1r00dmb1irwg7v.why: But for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them: 11:110 and 41:45 identical about Moses' Book, 10:19 and 42:14 about division.
tree:1r00dmb1irwg7v.relation: Allah's delay of judgment on people's differences.

tree:133gp4b0p9bso3.why: Only the stock closing that Allah is not unaware of what you do, shared by unrelated passages; it occurs in more places than these.

tree:0rsitei09cdddq.why: Allah who created the heavens and the earth, six places: three with six days and the throne, two on resurrection, one on provision.
tree:0rsitei09cdddq.relation: Creation as the basis of Allah's right to be worshipped.

tree:0nfu6a7112pmo1.why: Only the stock closing that Allah knows all things; the subjects are unrelated, and the closing occurs in many more places.

tree:1dd1whv0whpp7f.why: In that is a sign for people who: reflect, remember, hear, reason, know. Mostly in the signs of an-Nahl, each ending with a different faculty. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1dd1whv0whpp7f.relation: Each sign of creation addressed to a different faculty.

tree:11ne6jp1a8m97h.why: I fear for you the punishment of a day: great, big, painful, encompassing. Said by Noah, Hud, Shu'ayb and the Prophet. A classic memorizer set.
tree:11ne6jp1a8m97h.relation: The prophets' shared warning of a coming day.

tree:102sa841izz400.why: Lord of the heavens and earth and what is between them, six places with six different continuations. A memorizer set.

tree:1uhejsd0su2pl7.why: What they used to invent has left them, closing six scenes where the idolaters face the truth on the Day.
tree:1uhejsd0su2pl7.relation: False gods vanishing on the Day.

tree:1ly8mf10ve6i0d.why: Have they not travelled and seen the end of those before them, then each place names a different trait of those peoples. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1ly8mf10ve6i0d.relation: Lessons from the ruins of mightier nations.

tree:1ka2ugn09tfrp1.why: Were it not for Allah's favour on you and His mercy, six places, four in the slander passage of an-Nur, each with a different consequence.
tree:1ka2ugn09tfrp1.relation: Allah's favour as protection from ruin.

tree:0ps8vov18zkbcx.why: He knows what is before them and what is behind them: four statements of Allah's knowledge (2:255, 20:110, 21:28, 22:76), each closed differently.
tree:0ps8vov18zkbcx.changes: Remove 34:9 and 41:25: there the same words are not about Allah's knowledge but about the sky and earth around them, and what their companions made attractive.

tree:04lsd8l05mwwf9.why: He extends and restricts provision for whom He wills, six times with different closings. A memorizer set.

tree:1livj7e125uhnw.why: A generic reward formula, those who believe and do good have, with unrelated subjects; the variety of rewards is better found by search than shown as one card.

tree:1229vf10sj6avp.why: Only the stock closing that Allah does not guide a wrongdoing, disbelieving or defiant people; the subjects of the seven ayat are unrelated.

tree:0k6m6i20w44hzi.why: The generic reward formula of gardens with rivers, abiding forever, shared by unrelated passages.

tree:1npqx5w19x5xna.why: That is better for you if you know, closing commands to fast, forgive debt, strive, keep covenants, worship and attend Friday prayer.
tree:1npqx5w19x5xna.relation: Each command presented as the believer's real gain.

tree:1mne0lg1xhapms.why: I ask no reward for it: five prophets in ash-Shu'ara' repeat the same line word for word, and 25:57 and 38:86 continue differently.
tree:1mne0lg1xhapms.relation: Every prophet refusing reward for the message.

tree:0jr6nzn1rfiwmf.why: A common opening call, O believers fear Allah, followed by seven unrelated commands; nothing to learn from the set.

tree:0envmey1yk36g0.why: Allah, there is no god but He, followed eight ways; 2:255 and 3:2 share the Ever-Living, the Sustainer. A memorizer set.
tree:0envmey1yk36g0.relation: The declaration of oneness with Allah's attributes.

tree:1xb96gl09p2q6p.why: Worshipping besides Allah what can neither benefit nor harm, eight times with the order of harm and benefit swapping. A classic memorizer set.
tree:1xb96gl09p2q6p.relation: The futility of worshipping the powerless.

tree:1bajah5036u9qj.why: Only the stock closing that He is able over all things, after unrelated subjects; it occurs in many more places.

tree:10aiyfr18bxhh1.why: Only the stock closing that Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people, after ten unrelated subjects.

tree:1h94wwi17q0hi0.why: The generic formula of those who believe and do good with ten different rewards; unrelated passages, better as a search.

tree:0btm5n20bo768e.why: Only the stock closing that most people do not know, after eleven unrelated subjects; a search, not a card.

tree:0a6a9yr02auyzr.why: Only the stock closing on Allah's power over all things, after twelve unrelated subjects; a search, not a card.

tree:1rpu3bv0fz1mlx.why: The stock reward refrain, no fear on them nor will they grieve, closing twelve unrelated passages. The lead-in letters differ, but the set is too broad to teach anything as one card.

tree:1rik0cc08c028c.why: In that are signs for people who: hear, reflect, reason, believe. Each sign of creation is tied to a different faculty, and memorizers must know which ending goes where. The plural twin of the singular set.
tree:1rik0cc08c028c.relation: Signs of creation addressed to hearing, reflection, reason and faith.

tree:1v0mtx90yvga4x.why: Only the stock closing on Allah's power, nineteen places with unrelated subjects; a search, not a card.

tree:0lrgr5602f2bba.why: Two consecutive ayat of the same argument end with is there a god with Allah, then they are a people who deviate (27:60) and most of them do not know (27:61).
tree:0lrgr5602f2bba.relation: A chain of questions proving Allah's oneness.

tree:0vpdozg0682rja.why: Only the generic formula of whoever believes and does good, those ones, with unrelated subjects (repentance after neglecting prayer, wealth not bringing near); generic reward wording.

tree:0n52j3d0jjarmh.why: Those who believe in the life of this world: the good things are theirs now and theirs alone on the Day (7:32), and Allah helps them now and on the Day of witnesses (40:51).
tree:0n52j3d0jjarmh.relation: The believers' share in this world and the next.

tree:0rf0j980oxsdvc.why: Those who believe and rely on their Lord: Satan has no power over them (16:99), and what is with Allah is better for them (42:36).
tree:0rf0j980oxsdvc.relation: Faith with reliance as the believers' protection and reward.

tree:03pxib51qmovcz.why: The deniers ask will we really be in a new creation, after dust (13:5) or lost in the earth (32:10), each answered with their disbelief.
tree:03pxib51qmovcz.relation: Denial of resurrection as denial of meeting the Lord.

tree:1l0y7da05y46oa.why: Only His signs and the stock closing on knowledge and wisdom are shared; Satan's insertions in a prophet's wish and children asking permission are unrelated, and the verbs before differ.

tree:1g0yjfr0mssp71.why: Following the way of Abraham, upright: the best in religion (4:125), the Prophet's command (16:123).
tree:1g0yjfr0mssp71.relation: Abraham's way as the model for the Prophet and the believers.

tree:0cl7iyd1i55umf.why: Taken a covenant with the Most Merciful, twice in Maryam: the boaster has none (19:78), only those who have it may intercede (19:87).
tree:0cl7iyd1i55umf.relation: The covenant with Allah as the only ground for hope.

tree:1c79gj71xazzmn.why: Fear Allah and know that you: will be gathered to Him (2:203), will meet Him (2:223). A memorizer pair in al-Baqara.
tree:1c79gj71xazzmn.relation: Piety grounded in the coming meeting with Allah.

tree:1psc78f1wxne7b.why: Lot's plea to his people, fear Allah and do not disgrace me, in Hud and al-Hijr. Same story.
tree:1psc78f1wxne7b.relation: One moment in Lot's story told twice.

tree:1cf0yro0rhyjo2.why: So fear Allah, O people of understanding: that you may succeed (5:100), you who believe (65:10). A memorizer pair.
tree:1cf0yro0rhyjo2.relation: Piety addressed to people of understanding.

tree:04ogx1u0gi8djs.why: He will pay them their rewards in full and add from His bounty, in 4:173 and 35:30. A memorizer pair.

tree:1nlqrqx0mhsbk3.why: I seized them, and how was My punishment: after respite for mockers (13:32), after nations plotted against their messengers (40:5).

tree:0r4ck5w0mploqc.why: We took from them a solemn covenant: from the Children of Israel at the mount (4:154), from the prophets (33:7).
tree:0r4ck5w0mploqc.relation: Solemn covenants taken from Israel and from the prophets.

tree:1gepsiw0dceqkk.why: We took the covenant of the Children of Israel: its terms (2:83), and how they treated the messengers sent after it (5:70).
tree:1gepsiw0dceqkk.relation: The covenant of Israel and its breaking.

tree:1v5o1240q9i2pk.why: Call on Him, sincere in religion: as He began you, you will return (7:29); praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds (40:65).
tree:1v5o1240q9i2pk.relation: Sincere worship of the One who creates and lives.

tree:0bfucxt0gnarbf.why: Repel evil with what is better: in 23:96 with Allah knowing what they say, in 41:34 with the enemy becoming a close friend.

tree:002yu9x0djxb15.why: When Abraham said to his father: to Azar about idols (6:74), to his father and people declaring himself free (43:26).
tree:002yu9x0djxb15.relation: Abraham confronting his father over idols.

tree:14gnf3q0eotpby.why: A rare clause, when they return to their families: Joseph's brothers finding their goods (12:62) and the criminals returning jesting (83:31). Useful for a memorizer though the subjects differ.

tree:0bbxwyv0j1qnt9.why: When the second promise comes, twice in al-Isra' about the Children of Israel: their sanctuary entered again (17:7), and gathering them together (17:104).
tree:0bbxwyv0j1qnt9.relation: The promised end for the Children of Israel.

tree:037tb0w0fdn86a.why: When death approaches one of you: the bequest to parents and kin (2:180), and witnesses to the bequest (5:106).
tree:037tb0w0fdn86a.relation: Rules for the bequest at death.

tree:114znwc0uyfu7a.why: The same two ayat (19:75, 72:24) as card tree:1rr6azp0dka8f1, which is kept; this card only repeats it with a shorter title.

tree:1o8xbn51j5hwzf.why: The shared not is a different word in each: a prohibition, do not spread corruption, in 2:11, and the negation of there is no god but Allah in 37:35.

tree:1d52no60bb1jts.why: When you meet the disbelievers: do not turn your backs (8:15), strike the necks (47:4). Two battle rules.
tree:1d52no60bb1jts.relation: The conduct of believers in battle.

tree:084jlxk1y9u9fg.why: When We let man taste mercy from Us: despair when it is taken (11:9), rejoicing in it (42:48).
tree:084jlxk1y9u9fg.relation: Human fickleness in blessing and loss.

tree:1ppc7070dkmbet.why: Lords besides Allah: the call to the People of the Book not to take each other so (3:64), and the charge that they took their rabbis and monks so (9:31).
tree:1ppc7070dkmbet.relation: The invitation, and what it warned against.

tree:1vty5gg01zbkss.why: Moses' demand to Pharaoh, send the Children of Israel with us, in Ta-Ha and ash-Shu'ara'. Same story.

tree:1byyhkg0xtugco.why: We sent before you messengers among the sects of old (15:10) and to towns whose wealthy rejected them (43:23); both console the Prophet. The word after differs, so the link is thin.

tree:196eucv07a9dcd.why: Same scene: Iblis was arrogant and became one of the disbelievers.

tree:0vy98i115p3lhx.why: Same verdict on Pharaoh's people: they were arrogant and a criminal people, after the plagues and after Moses' mission.

tree:1r4g8i01206gfe.why: So be patient for your Lord's decision, then do not be like the man of the whale (68:48), do not obey the sinful (76:24).
tree:1r4g8i01206gfe.relation: Patience with Allah's decree, two warnings.

tree:0n8ahur1ox7sz3.why: Same story: build the ark under Our eyes and inspiration, then the warning not to plead for the wrongdoers.
tree:0n8ahur1ox7sz3.relation: Noah's command to build the ark.

tree:0m0ptwh1kyva2z.why: Obey Allah and His Messenger and do not: turn away (8:20), dispute (8:46). Both in al-Anfal.
tree:0m0ptwh1kyva2z.relation: Obedience and unity in the Badr surah.

tree:0j0l5pm0y14hmu.why: Jesus says worship Allah my Lord and your Lord, in the world (5:72) and on the Day when questioned (5:117).
tree:0j0l5pm0y14hmu.relation: Jesus' message, stated in life and confirmed on the Day.

tree:1ot5qp80mgdr6e.why: Only the stock closing that a humiliating punishment is prepared for the disbelievers is shared; the misers in 4:37 and those who separate Allah from His messengers in 4:151 are different subjects.

tree:1qok6eb15k7g8t.why: Only the stock closing of a painful punishment prepared for them, after unrelated subjects: late repentance and denial of the Hereafter.

tree:1wgynfm1ipz678.why: Only the closing formula that Allah is forgiving, in two unrelated rulings: proposals in the waiting period and repentant brigands.

tree:087jz0k1gh7lfc.why: Their eyes overflow with tears: Christians recognising the truth (5:83), and poor believers grieving they could not join the campaign (9:92).
tree:087jz0k1gh7lfc.relation: Two kinds of believers' tears: of recognition and of longing to serve.

tree:1pu181r1jlpyo1.why: Whoever invents a lie against Allah is a wrongdoer: after the truth about food laws (3:94), and while being called to Islam (61:7).
tree:1pu181r1jlpyo1.relation: Lying about Allah as the height of wrongdoing.

tree:0xz01u816n23ai.why: Establishing prayer and giving zakat: inspired to the prophets (21:73), kept by men whom trade does not distract (24:37).
tree:0xz01u816n23ai.relation: Prophets and devoted believers share the same practice.

tree:0uk07nj1vio9lv.why: A rare expression: lending Allah a goodly loan, said of charitable men and women (57:18) and commanded along with prayer and zakat (73:20).
tree:0uk07nj1vio9lv.relation: Charity as a loan to Allah.

tree:1gswz3a0y83pb0.why: Set your face to the religion, upright: and do not be of the idolaters (10:105), the nature Allah created people upon (30:30).

tree:1gng0t11b1vsx9.why: Except those who repent and reform, then: and make clear (2:160), and hold to Allah and purify their religion (4:146). A memorizer pair on the conditions of repentance.

tree:1w7qjty1knwrqq.why: A rare exception, except the wrongdoers among them: those who argue about the qibla (2:150), and People of the Book not to be debated gently (29:46). Useful for a memorizer.

tree:0aoxnx1145eb35.why: Unless it is trade: present trade need not be written (2:282), trade by mutual consent is lawful (4:29).
tree:0aoxnx1145eb35.relation: Trade as an exception in two financial rules.

tree:0i7vdxm0fqg6z2.why: Only as mercy from your Lord: the revelation kept (17:87) and given (28:86) to the Prophet.
tree:0i7vdxm0fqg6z2.relation: Revelation as pure mercy to the Prophet.

tree:071rf7h1muwzp7.why: Evil is what they bear: the deniers carrying their burdens on their backs (6:31), and the misleaders carrying others' burdens too (16:25).

tree:0kttqjf0p2hq5r.relation: The worst position for the deniers.

tree:1okthb11q6rekf.why: We made for you livelihoods on earth: little do you give thanks (7:10), and for those you do not provide for (15:20).

tree:0z1b1500ihsfhi.why: He subjected for you the night and day, the sun and moon, in two lists of blessings.

tree:0d3zhqt1oo9lor.why: Only nothing and stock closing names are shared across different structures; conjecture and old age are unrelated subjects.

tree:1dgg9ge1yy0q32.relation: Two rebukes to the People of the Book.

tree:0cki54e1xs3tpc.why: The shirt torn from behind: the condition (12:27) and its proof seen (12:28). Adjacent in Joseph's story.

tree:0jrtenl00mnq9v.why: Allying with a people with whom Allah is angry: the hypocrites did (58:14), the believers forbidden (60:13).
tree:0jrtenl00mnq9v.relation: Loyalty to those under Allah's wrath.

tree:0vdkuhb0pilhgv.why: Peoples stronger in power and traces on earth, twice in Ghafir with the same warning.

tree:1bbwmn60hd5lk0.relation: Those who do not use their senses.

tree:187kkjq0tvk2xo.why: Allah's command is always done, a rare closing: a threat to the People of the Book (4:47) and Zayd's marriage (33:37). A memorizer pair.

tree:04bbjgm156y3ny.why: The same two ayat (12:26, 12:27) as card tree:0vzhnc91h760gl, which is kept; this one only repeats it.

tree:0wret7r1vd0wgj.why: Those before them were stronger, in the same warning to travel and see, in two surahs.

tree:0wj5abc13tl08a.why: The same two ayat (7:36, 7:40) as card tree:1oqqi7g0j5k6em, which is kept; this one only repeats it.

tree:0z3jfdd0ph80dl.why: Thus We repay the criminal people, after the destroyed generations (10:13) and 'Ad (46:25). A memorizer pair.

tree:1jx1alu06l8i6s.relation: The parallel ends of 'Ad and Thamud.

tree:1tjun2s1aef7mm.relation: The orbits of the heavenly bodies.

tree:0ld3cpf0nipdej.relation: Ranks among believers, all promised good.

tree:1snu7ym15qcp0y.relation: Comfort to the messenger over his people's rejection.

tree:0g10fzm15i51l2.relation: Comfort in the face of others' wrong.

tree:1hxd23z00wwrk9.why: Do not follow the desires of: those who deny Our signs (6:150), those who do not know (45:18).

tree:0tws1lu1vn16pe.relation: The Prophet's independence from his enemies.

tree:0zkvykh0zmft6r.why: No soul is wronged at all: the scales of justice (21:47), the Day of recompense (36:54).

tree:0twmh5e0o378ay.why: The same two ayat (16:104, 16:105) as card tree:1wss4dm0vmt39m, which is kept; this one only repeats it.

tree:1eapx411ups2fl.why: An evil deed is repaid only with its like: and good tenfold (6:160), and good with Paradise (40:40).
tree:1eapx411ups2fl.relation: Allah's justice in evil and generosity in good.

tree:06bnuew0imjtue.why: Let not the disbelievers think: that respite is good for them (3:178), that they have escaped (8:59).

tree:1cm3v6k0vnuj1s.why: It is not lawful for you to: take back what you gave wives (2:229), inherit women by force (4:19).

tree:1ccazmm16yp0kk.why: The disbelievers will not cease: to be struck by calamity (13:31), to be in doubt until the Hour (22:55).
tree:1ccazmm16yp0kk.relation: The disbelievers' lasting state until the end.

tree:1to3hgn06keicr.why: Those near Allah are not too proud to worship Him. Same description of the angels.

tree:0mytxrv0z6dzx3.why: Unable to do anything: the slave against the free giver (16:75), the mute against the just man (16:76). Adjacent parables.
tree:0mytxrv0z6dzx3.relation: Two parables of false gods against Allah.

tree:0xj08qo0rxzvyg.why: That every soul be repaid for: its striving (20:15), what it earned (45:22). A memorizer pair.
tree:0xj08qo0rxzvyg.relation: The purpose of the Hour and of creation.

tree:0gmr4nx0g9inc9.why: That you may know the number of years and the reckoning: from the sun and moon (10:5), from night and day (17:12).

tree:1npo2y51cx4fot.why: We created man from: dry clay of altered mud (15:26), an extract of clay (23:12). A memorizer pair.

tree:0gtqirz0qsnn0d.why: Detail of all things, guidance and mercy: the Torah (6:154), the Quran (16:89).
tree:0gtqirz0qsnn0d.relation: Moses' Book and the Quran described alike.

tree:0eqicix17zuxlh.why: The signs made clear so that you may reason: thus Allah makes clear (24:61), We have made clear (57:17). A memorizer pair.

tree:0w5jw490wugi7n.why: You have no merit over us: said by the followers to the leaders in Hell (7:39) and by Noah's chiefs (11:27). A rare phrase, useful for a memorizer.

tree:0zd5zj71oluw35.why: What is on earth is for you: He created it (2:29), He subjected it (22:65).

tree:0g3n6710rkeket.why: But I see you are an ignorant people: Noah (11:29) and Hud (46:23). A memorizer pair.

tree:1nszo4o1q8sg9e.why: For the male the share of two females: children (4:11) and siblings (4:176). Same inheritance law.
tree:1nszo4o1q8sg9e.relation: The same rule applied to children and siblings.

tree:12fuh4p1jv4k6v.why: It is said to the wrongdoers, taste the punishment: of eternity (10:52), of the Fire you denied (34:42).
tree:12fuh4p1jv4k6v.relation: The wrongdoers' punishment on the Day.

tree:1gkg1qx197142d.why: To Allah belongs the inheritance of the heavens and earth, said against the misers (3:180) and to urge spending (57:10).
tree:1gkg1qx197142d.relation: Wealth returns to Allah, so spend it.

tree:16l5qsv19tlnll.why: When fighting was prescribed for them, they turned away (2:246, Israel under Talut) or some feared people (4:77).
tree:16l5qsv19tlnll.relation: Those who asked for fighting then shrank from it.

tree:11fvviy0thoiuu.why: We will not believe you until: we see Allah openly (2:55, to Moses), you make a spring gush (17:90, to the Prophet).
tree:11fvviy0thoiuu.relation: Demands for miracles as a condition for belief.

tree:1arsvuw0z4vjcw.why: His is the judgment and to Him you return, twice in al-Qasas after there is no god but He; 28:88 closes the surah.

tree:1lkjdhi0wycen4.why: The same two ayat (26:92, 40:73) as card tree:1h7tbl214jymow, which is kept; this one only repeats it.

tree:1s1qxo204cbgue.why: They will have in it whatever they wish: the pious in gardens of Eden (16:31), abiding as a promise (25:16).

tree:15lqpk6093k5la.why: The generic reward formula, forgiveness and a great reward, closing two unrelated passages.

tree:1pe86mm1x62jj8.why: The same two ayat (13:11, 18:26) as card tree:0ltf3ab0wk5e7j, which is kept; this one only repeats it.

tree:1yqdqcs120oi3i.why: If only we had another chance: to disown our leaders (2:167), to be believers (26:102).

tree:1jtyi6q1q16or8.why: If you could see the wrongdoers: in the throes of death (6:93), standing before their Lord (34:31).

tree:0bu8bjg0qmggow.why: Had He willed He would have guided you all, said in 6:149 and 16:9.

tree:1d12ytt1bkjzlv.why: To test which of you is best in deed: the purpose of creation of heavens and earth (11:7), of death and life (67:2).
tree:1d12ytt1bkjzlv.relation: Life as a test of deeds.

tree:0godbet1tw21yv.why: To test you in what He gave you: different laws for nations (5:48), ranks among people (6:165).

tree:1wgd8gg1f8kln0.why: Let him fear Allah his Lord, and do not: cheat (2:282), hide testimony (2:283). Adjacent ayat on debts.

tree:0kclx650myvtpl.why: That Allah may reward them for the best of what they did, said of those who strive (9:121) and the men of the mosques (24:38).
tree:0kclx650myvtpl.relation: The best reward for good deeds.

tree:0o9qfw91283ynh.why: What you have no knowledge of: arguing about Abraham (3:66), spreading the slander (24:15). Both blame speaking without knowledge.

tree:0nri63g014d6ju.why: To lead astray from Allah's path: the arrogant arguer (22:9), the buyer of idle talk (31:6).
tree:0nri63g014d6ju.relation: Those who mislead others and their punishment.

tree:0gjp4n60vibzjq.why: Those who disbelieve would say: this is only magic (11:7), you are only falsifiers (30:58).

tree:0jnbuwi0hsb57g.why: If you ask them who created, they say Allah, so how are they turned away. Same argument.

tree:1glb1nb0xrp06x.why: For a Day in which there is no doubt, twice in Aal Imran: the believers' prayer (3:9), the gathering where every soul is paid (3:25).

tree:07xpdgo161ytnq.why: We did not send you as a keeper over them, after those who turn away (4:80) and those who reject (42:48). A memorizer pair.

tree:0ib8ww211qcplg.why: Allah does not want injustice for the worlds (3:108), for the servants (40:31). A memorizer pair.

tree:17q1urw1ha3r5s.why: They were commanded only to worship: one God (9:31), Allah sincerely (98:5).
tree:17q1urw1ha3r5s.relation: The original command to the People of the Book.

tree:0kx523z0bkotm9.why: I am not a keeper over you: the Prophet (6:104), Shu'ayb (11:86). A memorizer pair.
tree:0kx523z0bkotm9.relation: Messengers not responsible for people's choices.

tree:1bqbq241gh41xu.why: And I am not of the idolaters: Abraham (6:79) and the Prophet (12:108).
tree:1bqbq241gh41xu.relation: Abraham and the Prophet disowning shirk.

tree:0jsmnjp1ufaehd.why: Only what Allah sent down upon is shared; the denial that Allah revealed anything and the desert Arabs' ignorance of the limits are unrelated.

tree:0vw3ue50kn3uoh.why: Whatever good you spend: is for yourselves (2:272), Allah knows it (2:273). Adjacent ayat.
tree:0vw3ue50kn3uoh.relation: Charity's benefit and Allah's knowledge of it.

tree:1azhjc81hbc122.why: Whatever you spend of anything: Allah knows it (3:92), it will be repaid (8:60).

tree:0hmbzay0wky7n6.why: What Allah created in is shared by unrelated subjects: what is in wombs and what is in the heavens and earth.

tree:01xdv0j02ze4fj.why: I asked you no reward; my reward is only from Allah: Noah (10:72) and the Prophet (34:47).

tree:1u4ucwr03ivdin.why: We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves (16:118) or were the wrongdoers (43:76). A memorizer pair.

tree:11c56vn1tzrptt.why: Only it is not for you to is shared; making trees grow and harming the Prophet are unrelated.

tree:0lefvv402x3lnm.why: It is not for us to: associate partners (12:38, Joseph), bring proof without Allah's leave (14:11, the messengers).

tree:0luzeyf0orb6qr.why: Only the stock clause that the wrongdoers have no helper is shared; idol worship without authority and the cry from the Fire are separate scenes, and the clause recurs in other places.

tree:01btqqg0jyxkde.why: What you did not know, twice in al-Baqara: the Messenger teaching it (2:151), Allah teaching the way to pray (2:239).
tree:01btqqg0jyxkde.relation: Knowledge as Allah's gift, calling for remembrance.

tree:07rc74b12g7qk1.why: They have no escape, a rare closing in neighbouring surahs (41:48, 42:35). A memorizer pair.
tree:07rc74b12g7qk1.relation: No escape for the idolaters and disputers.

tree:0g6vk5i1uc74y6.why: Only the phrase those your right hands possess is shared; a marriage ruling and a parable against shirk teach nothing together.

tree:1xm8mo51imxtht.why: We will not believe you: Pharaoh's people whatever sign comes (7:132), Hud's people (11:53). A memorizer pair.

tree:0qf8uuw049o8wc.why: What Allah and His Messenger promised us, said at the Trench by the hypocrites as delusion (33:12) and by the believers as truth (33:22).
tree:0qf8uuw049o8wc.relation: Contrast: the same words of doubt and of faith in one battle.

tree:0qtiykv1b2x231.why: They do not know when they will be raised: the idols (16:21), all in heaven and earth (27:65). A memorizer pair.

tree:1bmk30c1tqwbaw.why: Only it is not for us to is shared; Shu'ayb refusing to return to his people's religion and the believers refusing to repeat a slander are different subjects.

tree:05fi8w10uxgejt.why: It is not for me to: say what I have no right to (5:116, Jesus), change the Quran myself (10:15, the Prophet).
tree:05fi8w10uxgejt.relation: Messengers who do not alter Allah's word.

tree:0zt07ll0cbo2kv.why: Those who disbelieve and die as disbelievers: no ransom accepted (3:91), never forgiven (47:34).
tree:0zt07ll0cbo2kv.relation: Dying in disbelief closes every door.

tree:0oxb4ta0f48alk.why: Their refuge is Hell, an evil resting place, closing 3:197 and 13:18. A memorizer pair.
tree:0oxb4ta0f48alk.relation: The end of those deceived by this world.

tree:0ij22lv0gu15o5.why: The enjoyment of worldly life, then: to Us is your return (10:23), he is among those brought forward (28:61).

tree:02xf8bz0y3ordz.why: Reclining on couches in Paradise, in 18:31 and 76:13 with different continuations. A memorizer pair.
tree:02xf8bz0y3ordz.relation: The rest of the people of Paradise.

tree:0w3ehtc0bs9n8i.why: The weight of a mustard seed: brought to the scales (21:47), brought by Allah wherever it is (31:16).

tree:1x1j64l0tkkrh5.why: The likeness of the people who deny Our signs: the panting dog (7:176), the donkey with books (62:5).
tree:1x1j64l0tkkrh5.relation: Two parables of knowledge without benefit.

tree:0cjvbhw1mpxkk6.why: A calamity because of what their hands sent forth: then they come swearing (4:62), then they would say why no messenger (28:47).

tree:1yrxo5k0uujd14.why: Of what parents and relatives leave, twice in an-Nisa' inheritance law (4:7, 4:33).

tree:1237nuy08ncugu.why: The generic formula of whoever believes and does good with its reward; Dhul-Qarnayn's rule and wealth not bringing near are unrelated.

tree:0toi5k91n80nin.why: Have you seen the one who takes his desire as his god: a question to the Prophet (25:43), and his sealed heart (45:23). A memorizer pair.

tree:19xyw7h1vq6gs7.why: Who is better than Allah in colouring (2:138), in judgment (5:50). A memorizer pair.
tree:19xyw7h1vq6gs7.relation: Allah's religion and law as best.

tree:1gh131s1hsxf44.why: He sent down water from the sky in measure, then stored it (23:18) or revived dead land (43:11).

tree:1rd8qjw0b89gx6.why: We sent down water from the sky and grew by it: gardens (27:60), noble pairs (31:10).

tree:0f7c6lm0p37d1w.why: Only from Allah, indeed Allah is shared by unrelated subjects: inheritance shares and following desire.

tree:1xtwnr417nqh4g.why: Only from Allah, that is because they is shared; Israel's humiliation and the hypocrites' fear are different subjects.

tree:0rg7bw813zdbas.why: The shared words sit in different structures (you cannot avail him, their wealth will not avail them), and the subjects differ.

tree:19o0d851ed151r.why: You have no protector from Allah: the evildoers on the Day (10:27), Pharaoh's people warned (40:33).

tree:1vmunqb0w1ypkf.why: A charge from Allah, and Allah is Knowing: in the inheritance shares (4:12) and the recipients of zakat (9:60). Both fix a distribution of wealth by Allah's command.

tree:0kibisj0md83pp.why: From Allah and His Messenger to: the declaration of disassociation (9:1) and the proclamation on the day of the great pilgrimage (9:3).

tree:0xkfvrv0yvqpdh.why: Only from among people, indeed Allah is shared; protection of the Prophet and the choice of messengers are unrelated.

tree:0ilfh3j0b32lft.why: Of women, except what: has passed (4:22), your right hands possess (4:24). Close in an-Nisa'.

tree:15l1ugf1mcjgjd.why: Many or a party of the People of the Book wish they could turn you back (2:109) or mislead you (3:69). A memorizer pair.
tree:15l1ugf1mcjgjd.relation: The wish to turn believers away.

tree:03oxyih17wd51t.why: Of the People of the Book, from their fortresses (33:26) or homes (59:2): Qurayza and an-Nadir expelled.
tree:03oxyih17wd51t.relation: The fate of the Jewish tribes who broke treaties.

tree:1a4bhkb0pk3ait.why: After they were wronged: the emigrants for Allah (16:41), and the believing poets who defended themselves (26:227).

tree:0hlbzwu1yp62lu.why: The shared words are a bare phrase meaning 'from the Children of Israel' in two unrelated settings: the curse on those of them who disbelieved (5:78) and a witness from them confirming the Quran (46:10). Nothing to learn by setting them together.

tree:06ifycr1wczi7j.why: Rare clause, used twice in one surah, about not being answerable for others' account: the Prophet must not drive away the poor believers (6:52), and the God-fearing are not charged with the mockers' account but only with reminding them (6:69). Good for memorizers and for pondering on responsibility.
tree:06ifycr1wczi7j.relation: Both say no one carries another's reckoning; one ayah applies it to the Prophet and the poor believers, the other to the God-fearing and the mockers.

tree:07erurm137xdhq.why: Ibrahim's speech to his people in one surah: twice he says they took idols besides God, first as lies they fabricate (29:17), then as a bond of worldly friendship that will turn to mutual denial on the Day (29:25). Same story, a reciter can mix the two openings.
tree:07erurm137xdhq.relation: Same speech of Ibrahim, showing what the idols are: a lie with no provision, and a passing worldly bond.

tree:1vrl4sc0vg1lfc.why: The shared words only mean 'anything besides Him', used in two different structures: the polytheists' excuse that had God willed they would not have worshipped anything besides Him (16:35), and God knowing whatever they call on (29:42). Different subjects, no shared point.

tree:09xr33403at98k.why: The same rare description of revelation, clear proof from your Lord with guidance and mercy, closes two answers to the deniers: they said they would be better guided if given a book (6:157), and they asked for a sign (7:203). Both reply that the Quran is already that proof.
tree:09xr33403at98k.relation: Two demands of the deniers answered with the same words: the Quran itself is the proof, guidance and mercy they ask for.

tree:03u17sw0o2nupg.why: The two ayat share the words 'from God' followed by a different particle: a negation in 3:78 (they say it is from God, and it is not), and a relative pronoun in 3:198 (what is with God is better). Different structures and subjects.

tree:04oa4rq0jsw3tw.why: Two consecutive ayat of the expiation for the zihar oath repeat 'before they touch each other': freeing a slave, and if not possible, fasting two months. Seeing them together fixes the order of the expiation steps.
tree:04oa4rq0jsw3tw.relation: Steps of one ruling, each bound by the same condition of being done before the couple resume relations.

tree:1e4ax3o0easpl4.why: Same clause about whoever hopes to meet his Lord, ending differently: let him do righteous deeds and associate none (18:110), and God's appointed term is surely coming (29:5). An easy swap for a memorizer, and a good pair for pondering what that hope requires.
tree:1e4ax3o0easpl4.relation: Hope of meeting God answered two ways: act rightly now, and know the meeting is certain.

tree:0jwsvtf1xtn383.why: Both ayat state a covenant or promise and then warn whoever disbelieves after that: the covenant with the Children of Israel (5:12, he has strayed from the right way) and the promise of succession to the believers (24:55, they are the defiantly disobedient). Same warning after a divine pledge, different endings to keep apart.
tree:0jwsvtf1xtn383.relation: After each divine pledge comes the same warning against turning away from it.

tree:12abxmq12hsj58.why: A rare clause: whoever disbelieves bears his own disbelief. It continues differently: whoever does good prepares for himself (30:44), and disbelief only adds to the disbelievers' loss (35:39). A memorizer must keep the continuations apart.
tree:12abxmq12hsj58.relation: Each person carries the result of his own choice; one ayah sets the believer beside the disbeliever, the other shows disbelief only deepening its loss.

tree:01wrwxk1p95d3c.why: Same scene of the Day: a witness raised or drawn out from every nation, introduced by different verbs, then the disbelievers given no leave to excuse themselves (16:84) or told to bring their proof (28:75). Same theme, easy to mix.
tree:01wrwxk1p95d3c.relation: The witness from every nation leaves the deniers with no excuse and no proof.

tree:02w9t271w3fwb7.why: Same rare ending about the earth sprouting every delightful kind of plant after rain or after being spread out, both as a sign: of the resurrection in 22:5, and of insight and reminder in 50:7. Same theme, different lead-ins for a memorizer.

tree:1fb3m570wsq8k3.why: Nuh's rescue with those with him in the ark, told twice with different continuations: made successors while the deniers drowned (10:73), and the laden ark (26:119). Same story, a memorizer must keep the two endings apart.

tree:0hood7u0kd7w2k.why: The rare warning against overstepping God's limits closes two divorce rulings: those are the wrongdoers (2:229), and he has wronged himself (65:1). Same subject, two endings worth keeping apart and pondering.
tree:0hood7u0kd7w2k.relation: Overstepping God's limits in divorce wrongs others and also one's own self.

tree:16a4izw1hf3r36.why: Whoever relies on God, answered two ways: God is mighty and wise against the hypocrites' mockery that the believers were deluded by their religion (8:49), and God is enough for him (65:3). A reciter could swap the endings, and the pair shows what reliance on God earns.
tree:16a4izw1hf3r36.relation: Reliance on God: He is mighty over those who mock it, and sufficient for the one who practises it.
