tree:0lbvlob1w7uw67.relation: Why people differ: test, guidance, mercy.

tree:0jq5i2d16zejsr.why: The real pair here, 8:28 and 9:22 ('with God is a great reward'), already has its own card. 31:34 ('with Him is knowledge of the Hour') is a different phrase, so this card only repeats the pair with an outsider.

tree:1n6is4b1q6ahj5.why: 'God is Strong' with two closings: severe in punishment (8:52) and Mighty (57:25, 58:21). Both later ayat are about God supporting His messengers.
tree:1n6is4b1q6ahj5.relation: God's strength shown in punishing deniers and making His messengers prevail.

tree:03dfpkj0cbh4g1.why: 'And indeed God, He is ...' with three closings: Mighty and Wise (3:62), best of providers (22:58), Free of need and Praiseworthy (22:64). Two in one surah, close together.

tree:0tjqro20t5x9ik.why: 'You follow only ...': 'a bewitched man' in the deniers' mouth (17:47, 25:8, near-identical with the same next ayah), and 'conjecture' said to the polytheists (6:148).
tree:0tjqro20t5x9ik.relation: The deniers' charge turned back on them: they are the ones following mere guesses.

tree:1lh8pd80x69mi2.why: 'If you are patient and mindful' three times in Al Imran: their plot will not harm you (3:120), angels will reinforce you (3:125), that is of firm resolve (3:186).
tree:1lh8pd80x69mi2.relation: Patience and taqwa as the believers' defence against enemies.

tree:0oe3ut41x9lmm8.why: 'If you disbelieve, then ...': twice in an-Nisa with 'to God belongs what is in the heavens and earth' and different closing names (4:131, 4:170), and 'God is free of need of you' (39:7).
tree:0oe3ut41x9lmm8.relation: Disbelief harms only the disbeliever; God needs nothing.

tree:12inzzf0vlgyv1.why: 'Indeed your Lord is full of ...': forgiveness for people despite their wrong (13:6), bounty on people (27:73), forgiveness and painful punishment (41:43).
tree:12inzzf0vlgyv1.relation: God's forgiveness and bounty held together with His punishment.

tree:0lxxfkr1cxauf5.why: Only 'if you have' is shared: a victory from God in the hypocrites' talk (4:141) and a plot in the challenge on the Day (77:39). Unrelated.

tree:1rur5qx1q9cnkt.why: 'If you must do something' closes a proposal in three stories: Joseph's brother suggesting the well (12:10), Lot offering his daughters (15:71), Abraham's people calling to burn him (21:68).

tree:1p6zkxz1suyeoz.why: 'If you are in doubt ...': about the Quran (2:23), about the Prophet's religion (10:104), about the Resurrection (22:5), each followed by an answer.
tree:1p6zkxz1suyeoz.relation: Doubt answered by a challenge, a stand, and a proof from creation.

tree:0z2352l0l20t83.why: 51:59 and 52:47, at the ends of neighbouring surahs, warn the wrongdoers: their share like their companions' share, and a punishment before that. 39:47 is a different structure ('if the wrongdoers had').
tree:0z2352l0l20t83.changes: Removed 39:47: its 'if they had' is a hypothetical ransom, not the warning 'indeed, for the wrongdoers'.
tree:0z2352l0l20t83.relation: The wrongdoers' portion of punishment, in this world and the next.

tree:0t4qw7s1k6u07m.why: The inheritance ayat repeat 'if he / they / she has no child' with different pronouns (4:11, 4:12, 4:176). Essential for memorizers of the shares.

tree:0bokegc05f0e26.why: 'This is surely a sorcerer': Pharaoh's chiefs (7:109) and Pharaoh himself (26:34) say 'learned', near-identical with the same next ayah; the deniers of Muhammad say 'clear' (10:2).
tree:0bokegc05f0e26.relation: The same accusation against Moses and against Muhammad.

tree:0n2yt9b1jp5ziv.why: 'This is surely a ... thing' with three endings: wondrous (11:72, Sarah), astonishing (38:5) and intended (38:6), the last two neighbours. A memorizer's trap.

tree:19vms7s0lzu71a.why: 'I am only a warner': and bringer of good news (7:188), clear (26:115 Noah, 46:9 Muhammad). The lead-ins and the endings differ.
tree:19vms7s0lzu71a.relation: Every messenger only warns; he has no power of his own.

tree:0dezfip04gxqv7.why: 'And we will surely guard him': Joseph's brothers promise it twice (12:12, 12:63) and fail; God says it of the Reminder (15:9) and keeps it.
tree:0dezfip04gxqv7.relation: Contrast: people's promise to guard fails, God's guarding of the Quran does not.

tree:1h4ja9b1r67mhf.why: 'I am only a clear warner': 'and only' after 'the signs / the knowledge is with God' (29:50, 67:26), and 'that I am' in 38:70. A memorizer's trap.

tree:10iqp4y02hmww6.why: God sent down His tranquillity: at Hunayn (9:26), in the cave (9:40), at Hudaybiya (48:26). Same words in three moments of fear.
tree:10iqp4y02hmww6.relation: Calm sent down from God at moments of danger.

tree:0r497gs0y4u0j2.why: When told to believe in or follow what God sent down, they answer with their own: what was sent to us (2:91), what we found our fathers on (2:170, 31:21).
tree:0r497gs0y4u0j2.relation: Rejecting revelation in favour of tribe and forefathers.

tree:07ri62q0ox7opc.why: 'We sent down the Book to you': to explain what they differ in (16:64), is it not enough (29:51), for people in truth (39:41). Three openings to keep apart.
tree:07ri62q0ox7opc.relation: The purposes of the Book sent down.

tree:0kj0i6603lsvko.why: 'We produced after them another generation' (6:6, 23:31) and 'other generations' (23:42). Singular vs plural, two in the same surah.

tree:1bztgvr1rcwl85.why: 'Your duty is only to convey' with three tails: God sees His servants (3:20), on Us is the reckoning (13:40), 'the clear conveying' (16:82).
tree:1bztgvr1rcwl85.relation: The Messenger conveys; guidance and reckoning belong to God.

tree:1sjezpg0w96uik.why: 9:55 and 9:85 are near-identical about the hypocrites' wealth and children, with small differences ('so that' vs 'that', 'and' vs 'nor'); 33:33 shares 'God only wants' for the household of the Prophet.
tree:1sjezpg0w96uik.relation: Contrast: God wills punishment through the hypocrites' wealth, and purification for the Prophet's household.

tree:12134y41d2vxhg.why: Knowing it is the truth from their Lord: the believers about the parable (2:26), the People of the Book about the qibla (2:144), those given knowledge about the revelation (22:54, 'from your Lord').
tree:12134y41d2vxhg.relation: Who recognises the truth, and what they do with that knowledge.

tree:10hkxzs0vd4ibg.why: 'Indeed He, of all things, is ...' with three closings: encompassing (41:54), knowing (42:12), seeing (67:19). A memorizer's trap.

tree:0ielk09020od5h.why: 'I fear God, Lord of the worlds' from Adam's righteous son refusing to kill (5:28), and the same words from Satan disowning his followers (8:48, 59:16).
tree:0ielk09020od5h.relation: Contrast: the same words as true fear in one mouth and as a hollow excuse in Satan's.

tree:1qndnua1ul3c0o.why: 15:4 and 26:208: 'We never destroyed a town but that it had ...' a known term / warners. 28:58 ('how many towns We destroyed') is a different structure and point.
tree:1qndnua1ul3c0o.changes: Removed 28:58: it opens 'how many', a different structure about towns that were ungrateful.
tree:1qndnua1ul3c0o.relation: No town is destroyed without a set term and a warning first.

tree:1tuq4ja1jr75b4.why: Lot saved with his family except his wife: 'she was of those who stayed behind' (7:83, 29:32) vs 'We decreed her to be' (27:57). Same story, a key word changed.

tree:0noyiza0x3p90y.why: 'Follow / recite what is revealed to you of ...': your Lord (6:106), your Lord's Book (18:27), the Book (29:45). A memorizer's trap.

tree:1l76jlr0mndomp.why: 'Those, their deeds are void': apostates (2:217), polytheists maintaining the mosques (9:17), those who indulged like earlier nations (9:69). Tails differ.
tree:1l76jlr0mndomp.relation: What makes deeds worthless: apostasy, polytheism, and following the ways of the doomed.

tree:0jdq9ra0ynt0ee.why: 'Those are in error ...': far (14:3) vs clear (39:22, 46:32). A one-word memorizer's trap, and all three describe people who turn from God's call.
tree:0jdq9ra0ynt0ee.relation: Loving this world, hard hearts, refusing the caller: all lead astray.

tree:0o6lfmt1w80n8d.why: 'Those will enter the Garden': not wronged a speck (4:124), not wronged at all (19:60), provided without account (40:40). 4:124 and 40:40 share 'male or female, being a believer'.

tree:06m2jyr1j25zhr.why: The believers' certainty in the Hereafter: 'and in the Hereafter they are certain' (2:4) vs 'and they, in the Hereafter, are certain' (27:3, 31:4, identical). Openings of three surahs.

tree:0fyaxmp1vu4zml.why: 'In fairness, a duty on ...': the mindful (2:180 bequest, 2:241 divorced women) and the doers of good (2:236). One word to keep apart within al-Baqara.

tree:0uc4xd800c6rec.why: Moses sent with Our signs and clear authority, three times (11:96, 23:45 with Aaron, 40:23), each followed by whom he was sent to and their response.

tree:1aalce81kgk0hc.why: 'I am free of what you associate': the Prophet (6:19), Abraham (6:78), Hud (11:54). Three prophets, three forms of 'I'.
tree:1aalce81kgk0hc.relation: Every messenger declares himself free of his people's idols.

tree:0lezwhi1u3wsr8.why: 'Give them tidings of a painful punishment' after killing prophets (3:21), hoarding gold (9:34), and denial (84:24). Same ironic 'tidings'.

tree:1updx2g1mt8qga.why: Only 'some of you over others' is shared: preference among people (4:32, 16:71) and household members moving among each other (24:58), a different sense. Nothing more specific links them.

tree:1v4pvks0cu4lei.why: Adam's descent: 'Go down, some of you enemies to others' (2:36, 7:24) and 'Go down, both of you' (20:123), each with a different tail. Key memorizer card.

tree:0chxjb914lmwl7.why: 'Drew upon themselves God's anger': 2:61 and 3:112 describe the Children of Israel in close words, with the order of humiliation and poverty changed; 8:16 says it of one who flees battle.

tree:06iy83m10lbums.why: 'Is He not able to ...?': create the like of them (36:81), give life to the dead (46:33, 75:40). Arguments for the Resurrection.
tree:06iy83m10lbums.relation: The One who created the heavens can raise the dead.

tree:1g1bt1i1wf1gl6.why: 'Rather, they are a people ...': who ascribe equals (27:60), contentious (43:58), transgressing (51:53). One word changes; all describe the deniers.

tree:0sy67iz1hqnt4b.why: 'Of what you do, He is Knowing' is a stock closing found in many places; these three (pledges, the messengers' food, entering houses) share nothing more.

tree:1shvmpe16lvq6w.why: 'A drink of boiling water and a painful punishment for what they used to deny' (6:70, 10:4, identical), and 'the severe punishment' in 10:70. A memorizer's trap.

tree:157m8th07at1kd.why: Water giving life to a dead land, followed by three different tails: we give drink to cattle and people (25:49), thus you will be brought out (43:11), thus is the coming out (50:11).
tree:157m8th07at1kd.relation: Rain reviving the land as proof of the Resurrection.

tree:0vdesl50gdnwe7.why: Selling the Book for a small price: writing it with their hands (2:79), hiding it (2:174), casting it behind their backs (3:187). Three forms of one sin.
tree:0vdesl50gdnwe7.relation: Corrupting, hiding and abandoning revelation for small gain.

tree:0rfw8pj1qqjvaj.why: 27:39 and 27:40 are neighbouring offers to bring the Queen's throne 'before you ...': before you rise (the jinn) vs before your glance returns (the one with knowledge of the Book). 7:123 (Pharaoh: 'you believed in him before I permitted') is a different phrase whose real twin is 20:71.
tree:0rfw8pj1qqjvaj.changes: Removed 7:123: its 'in him before' is Pharaoh's charge, unrelated to the throne story.
tree:0rfw8pj1qqjvaj.relation: Power of the jinn against the power of knowledge from the Book.

tree:0ma8y8o1gmdo9e.why: 'A slander and a clear sin' closes three ayat on wronging the innocent: taking back a wife's dowry (4:20), blaming an innocent for one's sin (4:112), hurting believers undeservedly (33:58).
tree:0ma8y8o1gmdo9e.relation: Injustice to the innocent is counted as slander.

tree:1buja7m1aptrpe.why: 'We make no distinction between any of them': 2:136 and 3:84 are near-identical (to us / upon us, and 'what was given'), and 4:152 praises those who do not distinguish.
tree:1buja7m1aptrpe.relation: Faith in all the prophets alike.

tree:0zhiisj18jc1mh.why: 'Clear proof has come to you from your Lord': Salih (7:73) and Shu'ayb (7:85) in identical openings, then their different commands; 6:157 says it of the Quran.
tree:0zhiisj18jc1mh.relation: Each prophet came with clear proof before the call to obey.

tree:1eoi7lu0ienq42.why: Ships that sail the sea: with what benefits people (2:164), by His command (22:65), by God's favour (31:31). The word after 'sea' is the trap.
tree:1eoi7lu0ienq42.relation: Ships as a sign of God's favour and command.

tree:0wqpbqj1ry49h1.why: Saying about God: 'what you do not know' in 2:169 (Satan's command) and 7:33 (what God forbade), and 'nothing but the truth' in 4:171.
tree:0wqpbqj1ry49h1.relation: Speaking about God without knowledge is among the gravest sins.

tree:1ghzmqk0b4hmlw.why: 'Then to Him you will be returned' closes three ayat on life, death and return: you were dead and He gave you life (2:28), He begins and repeats creation (30:11), His is all intercession (39:44).
tree:1ghzmqk0b4hmlw.relation: Every argument ends at the return to God.

tree:0uzxbq50lqdwkl.why: Selling for a small price, 'those ...': those who hide the Book eat fire (2:174), those who sell God's covenant have no share (3:77), and those of the People of the Book who do not sell have their reward (3:199).
tree:0uzxbq50lqdwkl.relation: Contrast: those who sell the covenant and those who refuse to.

tree:0q6746713n52ip.why: 'They made partners for God': the jinn (6:100), partners who created like Him (13:16), name them (13:33). Two in the same surah.
tree:0q6746713n52ip.relation: Every argument against the partners they invent.

tree:0t4zou40d7ow16.why: 'Strove with their wealth and their lives': the emigrants and helpers (8:72), the Messenger and those with him (9:88), the true believers (49:15).
tree:0t4zou40d7ow16.relation: Striving with wealth and self as the sign of true faith.

tree:1ngexpv1v6yfcb.why: 'Hell, and wretched is the resting place' closes three ayat: gathered to Hell (3:12), short enjoyment then Hell (3:197), those who refused their Lord (13:18).

tree:0xgxjd31bttnxb.why: 'Hell, and evil is the destination': those who did not emigrate (4:97), who oppose the Messenger (4:115), the hypocrites and polytheists (48:6). Same closing, two in an-Nisa.

tree:0mx0g350ku9z55.why: 6:61 and 23:99: 'until, when death comes to one of you / them' — the angels take him, or he begs to be sent back. 11:40 ('until Our command came' in Noah's story) shares only the frame.
tree:0mx0g350ku9z55.changes: Removed 11:40: it continues with God's command and the flood, not death.
tree:0mx0g350ku9z55.relation: Death as the end of respite: taken by the angels, and too late to return.

tree:1hec4rx0pdu73r.why: 'Those against whom the word came true': 41:25 and 46:18 continue identically ('among nations of jinn and men before them'), and in 28:63 they disown their followers.
tree:1hec4rx0pdu73r.relation: The decree on those who misled and were misled.

tree:1ypboy01oojabk.why: 'We created man from ...': clay of altered mud (15:26), an extract of clay (23:12), a mixed drop (76:2). Stages of man's creation.
tree:1ypboy01oojabk.relation: Man's humble origin, from earth and from a drop.

tree:089grrd0y0n7zh.why: 'Better than what they amass': God's forgiveness for those killed in His way (3:157), His bounty and mercy (10:58), your Lord's mercy (43:32).
tree:089grrd0y0n7zh.relation: God's mercy against everything people gather in this world.

tree:1826ru11y3mxhx.why: 'That is more likely to ...': that witnesses testify truly (5:108), that the Prophet's wives are content (33:51), that believing women are recognised (33:59). Same wording, two in one surah.

tree:1cqktvi10spfuq.why: 'That is the upright religion': of the sacred months (9:36), of worship of God alone (12:40), of the natural disposition (30:30). 12:40 and 30:30 continue identically.
tree:1cqktvi10spfuq.relation: Calendar, monotheism and human nature all called the upright religion.

tree:1b6nmwe0xy1st0.why: 'Taste the punishment of burning': 3:181 and 8:50 are followed by the same next ayah ('that is for what your hands put forth'); 22:22 has it in Hell itself.

tree:1qrazda0o75a0i.why: Three prophets' prayers opening 'My Lord, forgive me': Moses adds his brother (7:151), Solomon asks a kingdom (38:35), Noah his parents and the believers (71:28).
tree:1qrazda0o75a0i.relation: Each prophet starts with forgiveness before asking.

tree:083ax4103m9y6x.why: 'Lord of the Great Throne' closing a declaration of God's oneness: the Prophet's reliance (9:129), the question to the deniers (23:86), the hoopoe's words (27:26).
tree:083ax4103m9y6x.relation: The Lord of the Throne is the only one worth relying on and worshipping.

tree:0ww5w8u1m1uye4.why: 'My Lord, grant me': Zakariya asks for good offspring (3:38), Abraham for wisdom (26:83) and for a righteous son (37:100).

tree:13vcymi1rccvue.why: 'Our Lord, do not make us': with the wrongdoing people (7:47), a trial for the wrongdoing people (10:85), a trial for the disbelievers (60:5). Close wording, three speakers.

tree:01sbb881888ai2.why: 'And provided you with good things' after three reminders of blessings, then different tails: that you may give thanks (8:26), do they believe in falsehood? (16:72), that is God your Lord (40:64).

tree:1e3uf3k0h4c4m6.why: 'And We provided them with good things': the Children of Israel (10:93, 45:16) and the children of Adam (17:70), with different tails.
tree:1e3uf3k0h4c4m6.relation: Favour given, and how it was received.

tree:1dmugvq04rpxg8.why: Comfort to the Prophet: 'messengers before you were denied', with three tails: they came with clear proofs (3:184), they were patient until help came (6:34), to God all matters return (35:4).
tree:1dmugvq04rpxg8.relation: The Prophet is not the first to be denied; the earlier messengers' patience is his model.

tree:06f8s350kriyw1.why: 'Their messengers came to them with clear proofs, and ...': they would not believe (7:101) vs God would not wrong them, they wronged themselves (9:70, 30:9, identical tails).

tree:1xybp5w0g48peq.why: 'I am the messenger of God to you': Muhammad to all mankind (7:158), Moses to his people (61:5), Jesus to the Children of Israel (61:6), the last two neighbours.
tree:1xybp5w0g48peq.relation: Three messengers with one claim, and how each was received.

tree:0powjgu1lh9amo.why: 'We adorned the nearest heaven': with the adornment of the stars (37:6) vs with lamps (41:12, 67:5), each with a different purpose after it.

tree:1sadbxu0sd2dgc.why: 'When their term comes, they cannot delay it an hour nor advance it': 7:34 and 16:61 without 'so', 10:49 with it. A one-letter memorizer's trap.

tree:182qkia0aspwk8.why: Only 'the way of God, then' is shared: spenders (2:262), emigrants who died (22:58), and disbelievers who blocked the way (47:34). Different subjects and structures.

tree:046czgk1ip1hdc.why: 'You will come to know who ...': 'so you will' in 6:135 and 11:39, 'you will' without 'so' in 11:93 after the same 'work according to your position'. A known trap.
tree:046czgk1ip1hdc.relation: The messengers' confident warning to their people.

tree:16lsoaa1cqubkg.why: 'Sufficient is God as witness between me and you' with three tails: and whoever has knowledge of the Book (13:43), He is aware of His servants (17:96), He is the Forgiving (46:8).

tree:1gi79xs03f3m2o.why: Scripture as 'a detailing of everything and guidance and mercy': the Torah (6:154), the Quran's stories (12:111), the Book sent to the Prophet (16:89, 'clarification').
tree:1gi79xs03f3m2o.relation: The same description for the Torah and the Quran.

tree:0rp1bna0r98p5a.why: The idols 'create nothing and are themselves created' (7:191, 16:20, 25:3), each with a different lead-in and next words.
tree:0rp1bna0r98p5a.relation: The basic argument against idols: a created thing cannot be a god.

tree:15fjhza13ikwxy.why: 'The darknesses of land and sea': who saves you from them (6:63), stars to guide you in them (6:97), who guides you in them (27:63).
tree:15fjhza13ikwxy.relation: God's guidance and rescue in the dark, as proof of His oneness.

tree:120h1i60v8ajye.why: 'Perhaps your Lord will ...': destroy your enemy (7:129, Moses), have mercy on you (17:8), remove your misdeeds (66:8).
tree:120h1i60v8ajye.relation: Hope held out by God in three situations.

tree:05jhsux0pyr6xh.why: Moses' staff: 'and behold, it was a clear serpent' (7:107, 26:32, identical with the same next ayat) vs 'it swallowed what they faked' (26:45).

tree:03dgsc81be1eys.why: Only 'on those who believe' is shared, in three unrelated sentences (a plot to unsettle believers, no blame for food, Satan has no power).

tree:0urh0ga0cwb998.why: 6:125 and 10:100 both end 'God places defilement on those who do not ...' (believe / reason). 9:91 (no blame on those who find nothing) is a different structure.
tree:0urh0ga0cwb998.changes: Removed 9:91: its 'on those who do not find' is about exemption from war, not defilement.
tree:0urh0ga0cwb998.relation: Defilement as the result of refusing faith and reason.

tree:1hgkrrc1o1zcng.why: Only 'on the Children of Israel' is shared, after three different verbs (prescribed, fulfilled, narrates). Different subjects, nothing to confuse.

tree:1116xj11bowxe9.why: 'Does not urge the feeding of the poor' (69:34, 107:3) vs 'you do not urge one another' (89:18). A short ayah with a pronoun trap.
tree:1116xj11bowxe9.relation: Neglect of the poor as a mark of the one who denies the Judgment.

tree:08nv3z517k9bp3.why: 'On Him I rely, and to Him I turn': Shu'ayb (11:88) and the Prophet (42:10) with 'I turn', and 13:30 with 'my return'. A one-word trap.

tree:1dlgnm40dlpabg.why: 2:134 and 2:141 say 'you will not be asked about what they used to do', while 15:92-93 swear 'We will surely ask them all about what they used to do'. Same words, opposite statement.
tree:1dlgnm40dlpabg.changes: Merged 15:92 into the 15:93 row: 15:93 alone is only the shared phrase, and the oath in 15:92 gives it its meaning.
tree:1dlgnm40dlpabg.relation: Contrast: no one is asked about others' deeds, but everyone is asked about his own.

tree:1743k0q0jxmi2a.why: Barring from the Sacred Mosque: do not let hatred for those who barred you lead to aggression (5:2), the polytheists deserve punishment for barring (8:34), the disbelievers barred you at Hudaybiya (48:25).
tree:1743k0q0jxmi2a.relation: The same wrong, and how believers must respond to it justly.

tree:12uqox11oaowf5.why: Distraction from the remembrance of God: wine and gambling (5:91), trade that does not distract the true men (24:37), wealth and children (63:9).
tree:12uqox11oaowf5.relation: What distracts from God's remembrance, and those who are not distracted.

tree:09m0ig101dfpq3.why: 'With God it is better': what is with God is better than a small price (16:95), and what you send ahead you find with God better (73:20, 'better' in the accusative). 28:49 is a different structure ('a book from God more guiding').
tree:09m0ig101dfpq3.changes: Removed 28:49: its 'from God' describes a book, and 'more guiding' is a different comparison.

tree:02hh2vr1vhvtzh.why: Only 'with God, and God' is shared, joining three unrelated sentences (ranks, reward, those not equal). No relation and no slip.

tree:1djy1h21nigge6.why: 'With their Lord are gardens': beneath which rivers flow (3:15), of bliss (68:34), of Eden (98:8). The mindful's reward in three descriptions.

tree:1exbgld0xvbdst.why: 'And the life of this world deluded them': those who took their religion as play (6:70, 7:51, with 'play and amusement' in reverse order) and the jinn and men confessing (6:130).
tree:1exbgld0xvbdst.relation: This world's delusion behind mocking the religion.

tree:18qadgb091k7fn.why: 'A people with whom God is angry': hypocrites who take them as allies (58:14), believers told not to (60:13), and God's anger on the hypocrites and polytheists (48:6).
tree:18qadgb091k7fn.relation: Allying with those under God's anger shares in their fate.

tree:0q7g11c0xrp230.why: 'Seeking bounty from God and pleasure': the companions of the Prophet (48:29) and the emigrants (59:8), and 'bounty from God and favour' in 49:8. A one-word trap.

tree:12wo6vo1ghqdie.why: 9:38 and 13:26: 'the life of this world, compared to the Hereafter, is only ...' little / passing enjoyment. 11:16 ('they have nothing in the Hereafter but the Fire') is a different structure.
tree:12wo6vo1ghqdie.changes: Removed 11:16: its 'in the Hereafter only' names their punishment, not the comparison of the two lives.
tree:12wo6vo1ghqdie.relation: This world measured against the Hereafter.

tree:14yjxio11ytx1u.why: 'In the Hereafter they are the greatest losers' (11:22, 27:5) vs 'the losers' (16:109). One word, three places.

tree:1hpzdhp18feq9r.why: Only 'in the earth, or' is shared, a fragment that joins two halves of three unrelated questions.

tree:0mx8nrx111f2yn.why: 'Good in this world' and the Hereafter: the believers' prayer (2:201), God's promise to the emigrants (16:41), and what was given to Abraham (16:122).
tree:0mx8nrx111f2yn.relation: The good of both worlds asked for, promised, and given.

tree:1beb1fr0wmp7hb.why: 'For them in this world is disgrace, and in the Hereafter a great punishment' (2:114, 5:41, identical tails) vs 22:9 in the singular with a different tail.

tree:1wiq6ve0qhuh3i.why: God's knowledge of what is in the sky and earth (singular 'sky'): He knows all speech (21:4), it is in a Book (22:70), nothing hidden but in a clear Book (27:75).

tree:1xgartn012atyp.why: Pharaoh's chiefs advise sending gatherers to the cities: 'send' with two different verbs in 7:111 and 26:36, followed by 'every learned sorcerer' in two forms; 26:53 has Pharaoh sending them after Moses.
tree:1xgartn012atyp.relation: The same summons twice: against Moses' signs and against his escape.

tree:1dgh1d61vp0bxo.why: 'We will remove whatever rancour is in their hearts': the people of the Garden in 7:43 and 15:47, with different continuations. 59:13 (fear in their hearts) shares only the frame.
tree:1dgh1d61vp0bxo.changes: Removed 59:13: its 'in their hearts' is about the hypocrites' fear, a different structure.
tree:1dgh1d61vp0bxo.relation: The Garden is free of grudges between believers.

tree:1rydi6y1lu3476.why: 'We sent no prophet / warner to a town but ...': hardship took its people (7:94), its affluent said we disbelieve (34:34), we follow our fathers (43:23).

tree:1hoqpcd1fw4l1r.why: 'In the hearts of those who ...': terror cast into the disbelievers' hearts (3:151, 8:12), compassion and mercy placed in the hearts of Jesus' followers (57:27).
tree:1hoqpcd1fw4l1r.relation: Contrast: God puts terror in one set of hearts and mercy in another.

tree:00wlle91hog2n5.why: 'In the fire of Hell': hoarded gold heated (9:35), the building on a crumbling edge (9:109), the disbelievers forever (98:6). Different images of the same end.

tree:11d433x04gnsvn.why: 'One of them said': Joseph's brother (12:10), one of the cave sleepers (18:19), a dweller of the Garden recalling his companion (37:51). Same opening, three stories.

tree:1ij5fi21lvaoxm.why: 'Moses said to them': throw what you will throw (10:80, 26:43, identical) vs woe to you, do not invent lies (20:61).

tree:0kw12w919vhopx.why: Abraham's argument with the star, moon and sun: 'this is my Lord' three times in a row, each followed by a different conclusion when it sets.
tree:0kw12w919vhopx.relation: Step by step from the setting bodies to the One who does not set.

tree:1qo0web03upzkv.why: 'They say we believe, and when they are alone ...' with their devils (2:14), with each other (2:76), they bite their fingers in rage (3:119). Hypocrites' two faces.

tree:1ehct2c1dg63di.why: 'You are only ...': a fabricator (16:101) and 'one of the bewitched' said to Salih (26:153) and Shu'ayb (26:185) with different next ayat.

tree:0i0fxwm1hxi27y.why: Abraham's guests say 'Peace': he answers 'peace' (11:69, 51:25) or 'we are afraid of you' (15:52). Same scene, three tellings.

tree:1qtxi3x18vk7lz.why: 'If you do not desist, you will surely be among ...': Noah's people threaten stoning (26:116), Lot's people expulsion (26:167); 7:149 is the calf-worshippers' repentance in the same 'if not, we will be' pattern.

tree:1fqq0od1ejnydn.why: 'This is clear magic' against Moses (27:13) and Jesus (61:6), and 'this is magic, and we disbelieve in it' against the Quran (43:30).

tree:0xkt89a1vkyfk6.why: 'How many generations We destroyed before them': 20:128 and 32:26 continue 'walking in their dwellings' with different endings (and 'from before' in 32:26); 36:31 says they do not return.

tree:1yev3gn1rvcfyh.why: 'He has failed who ...': invents lies (20:61), carries injustice (20:111), corrupts his soul (91:10).

tree:1fdeo6w1gzll9i.why: 'Lost are those who ...': deny the meeting with God (6:31, 10:45) and kill their children (6:140); 6:140 and 10:45 end with 'and they were not guided'.

tree:1r3lw02123ymd6.why: 'He has strayed far' (4:116, 4:136) vs 'strayed clearly' (33:36), after association, disbelief, and disobeying God and His Messenger.

tree:12mesea1ah5vta.why: 6:37 and 13:27 answer the same demand for a sign with 'say: God ...' and two different answers (He is able to send one / He leaves astray whom He wills). 7:28 (God does not command indecency) is a different subject.
tree:12mesea1ah5vta.changes: Removed 7:28: it answers a different claim, about indecency, not the demand for a sign.
tree:12mesea1ah5vta.relation: Two answers to the demand for miracles: God's power, and His guidance of those who turn to Him.

tree:12ykh4u00w8fd2.why: 17:51 and 27:72 answer the deniers' 'when?' with 'say: perhaps it is near / perhaps some of it is close behind you'. 18:24 ('perhaps my Lord will guide me') is a different subject.
tree:12ykh4u00w8fd2.changes: Removed 18:24: it is a personal hope for guidance, not an answer about the Hour.
tree:12ykh4u00w8fd2.relation: The Hour and the punishment may be closer than the mockers think.

tree:1dou3zv18hh0sd.why: 'Say: bring your proof': 'if you are truthful' in 2:111 and 27:64, and 'this is the Reminder' in 21:24. Against false claims and false gods.
tree:1dou3zv18hh0sd.relation: Every false claim is met with the demand for proof.

tree:04v4lfr17daaux.why: 'Say: are they equal ...?': the blind and the seeing (6:50, 13:16) and those who know and those who do not (39:9).
tree:04v4lfr17daaux.relation: Knowledge and sight vs ignorance and blindness.

tree:0d93rhu0ih8gsa.why: 'Little do you remember' closes three ayat with different lead-ins: following other protectors (7:3), the One who answers the distressed (27:62), not the word of a soothsayer (69:42).

tree:0ehbjp40be68v2.why: Joseph's shirt: torn from the front (12:26), from the back (12:27), seen torn from the back (12:28). Three neighbouring ayat that turn on one word.

tree:0vqn941067pem3.why: 'Protect us from the punishment of the Fire': 'and protect' in 2:201 and 3:16, 'so protect' in 3:191. Three believers' prayers.

tree:05csozn0ka8eq1.why: 'A people who do not believe' is a stock phrase; here it ends three unrelated statements (signs do not help them, Joseph left their creed, the Prophet's complaint). Little to confuse or ponder.

tree:0zt3mq91fvs2q7.why: 'And the command of God is ever done' (4:47, 33:37) vs 'a decree determined' (33:38), the last two neighbours.

tree:09l2fp80j3gm7w.why: 'Even if he is a near relative': no false witness (5:106), be just in speech (6:152), no one carries another's burden (35:18).
tree:09l2fp80j3gm7w.relation: Kinship does not bend justice, testimony or accountability.

tree:1v3qfs00i7g4v6.why: 'They had no ...': protectors besides God (11:20, 42:46) and no defender from God (40:21). Close wording about the helplessness of the deniers.

tree:1via7v40wvgmzy.why: The real pair, 41:52 and 46:10 ('if it is from God and you disbelieve in it', with 'then' vs 'and'), is the one the books compare and should stand as its own card; 4:82 ('from other than God') is a different phrase.

tree:0al9u3b17lealn.why: Lot's wife 'was of those who stayed behind', said of her (7:83, 29:32) and to Lot (29:33, 'your wife'). The pronoun is the trap.

tree:032bfbj1vgxbqb.why: 'They used to reject Our signs' after 'what' (7:51), 'and' (41:15), 'for what' (41:28). Two in Fussilat.

tree:1ukyehg1h6zwe4.why: 'No sign comes to them but they turn away from it' (6:4, 36:46, identical) vs 'We gave them Our signs and they turned away' (15:81).

tree:08mrlz60ys8yc0.why: 'And many of them are defiantly disobedient' closes three ayat of al-Hadid about the people of earlier scripture (57:16, 57:26, 57:27).
tree:08mrlz60ys8yc0.relation: Hearts hardened over time, a warning to the believers.

tree:0uwjfeb0iab5sz.why: 'Those who denied the signs of God' is a common phrase; the three ayat (a warning to the Prophet, the end of evildoers, the donkey parable) share nothing more.

tree:1kdz3yw0yybqrw.why: 'Thus says your Lord: it is easy for Me' to Zakariya (19:9) and Mary (19:21), and 'thus says your Lord: He is the Wise' to Abraham's wife (51:30).
tree:1kdz3yw0yybqrw.relation: Three miraculous births announced in the same words.

tree:1kyo1f71s2h479.why: 'Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers': 'and thus' in 7:41, 'thus' in 12:75 and 21:29.

tree:1jpmlye1jktgm0.why: 'Thus God leaves astray ...': the transgressor and doubter (40:34), the disbelievers (40:74), whom He wills (74:31).

tree:0yqmyxp0z2b67h.why: 'My / our Lord encompasses all things in knowledge': Abraham (6:80) and Shu'ayb (7:89), both after 'except what my Lord wills'; and Moses on God (20:98).
tree:0yqmyxp0z2b67h.relation: Prophets entrusting their future to God's all-encompassing knowledge.

tree:0q8o4001izd668.why: 'Which you used to deny': the Fire (34:42, 52:14) and the verses (23:105, 'so you used to deny them').

tree:1ltetrp04pkuch.why: 16:43 and 21:7 are near-identical ('before you' with and without 'from'): ask the people of the Reminder if you do not know. 30:56 ('but you did not know') is a different sentence.
tree:1ltetrp04pkuch.changes: Removed 30:56: its 'you did not know' is a rebuke on the Day, not the command to ask.

tree:00nmaky0qypm7c.why: 'Then there is no sin on him': the one forced by need (2:173), the one who mends a bequest (2:182), the pilgrim who hastens or delays (2:203).

tree:13en6hm10jgl6a.why: 'Do not follow their desires' in judging by what God sent down (5:48, 5:49) and in calling to the religion (42:15).
tree:13en6hm10jgl6a.relation: Revelation, not the desires of others, is the basis of judgment.

tree:1ptxkgx0w4dc8v.why: 'Do not grieve over them': followed by 'lower your wing to the believers' (15:88) and 'do not be distressed by their plotting' (16:127, 27:70, near-identical: 'tak' vs 'takun').
tree:1ptxkgx0w4dc8v.relation: Comfort to the Prophet over the deniers.

tree:1s7dyac1pxe1bo.why: 'You will not be asked about what ...': they did (2:134, 2:141, identical) and 'what we committed' (34:25). Each answers for his own deeds.
tree:1s7dyac1pxe1bo.relation: Personal responsibility, between generations and between believers and deniers.

tree:0wpp29611oym3w.why: 'Do not obey the disbelievers': 'so do not' then strive against them (25:52), 'and do not' with 'and the hypocrites' twice in al-Ahzab (33:1, 33:48).

tree:1fwlvgs0viw1mw.why: 11:17 and 11:109 in the same surah: 'so do not be in doubt about it / about what these worship'. 16:127 ('do not be in distress') is a different phrase whose twin is 27:70, already in another card.
tree:1fwlvgs0viw1mw.changes: Removed 16:127: distress over plotting, not doubt; it belongs with 27:70.

tree:12awfjq0ws5yec.why: 'Do not be among ...': the doubters (3:60), the heedless (7:205), the despairing (15:55). One word at the end changes.

tree:076pswf0f53q6r.why: 30:43 and 42:47: 'before a Day comes that cannot be turned back from God', then different tails. 13:11 ('then there is no turning it back') is God's will against a people, a different sentence.
tree:076pswf0f53q6r.changes: Removed 13:11: it is about God's will to harm a people, not the coming Day.
tree:076pswf0f53q6r.relation: Act before the Day that none can push back.

tree:1sn35ff0g7f0xp.why: 'We do not let the reward of ... be lost': the reformers (7:170), the doers of good (12:56), whoever does good work (18:30).

tree:1g35kat183l0cx.why: 'Nor will they be allowed to make amends' closes three scenes of the Day (16:84, 30:57, 45:35), each with a different lead-in.
tree:1g35kat183l0cx.relation: On the Day no excuse is accepted.

tree:1olrbgk1wpbztq.why: 'And God does not love the wrongdoers' (3:57, 3:140) vs 'indeed He does not love the wrongdoers' (42:40).

tree:0zzm0sb0ril5kp.why: 'Do not transgress; God does not love the transgressors' in fighting (2:190) and in forbidding good things (5:87), and 'indeed He does not love' after supplication (7:55).

tree:09cyjm71lnwyqz.why: 'God does not guide whom ...': whom He leaves astray (16:37), who is a liar and disbeliever (39:3), who is a transgressor and liar (40:28).

tree:1324xdh0msfdap.why: 'If you do not desist': Abraham's father threatens stoning (19:46), Noah's people stoning (26:116), Lot's people expulsion (26:167).
tree:1324xdh0msfdap.relation: Every prophet threatened by those closest to him.

tree:039zthv0e57ht3.why: 'Evil indeed is what they used to ...' closing three ayat of al-Ma'ida with three verbs: do, work, do (5:62, 5:63, 5:79). A classic trap.

tree:1klijys03tpw0y.why: 'That you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you': 28:46 and 32:3 identical except the last word; 36:6 'whose fathers were not warned'.

tree:0wl4svz0x9yd2p.why: 'God's curse is on ...': the disbelievers (2:89) and the wrongdoers (7:44, 11:18), the last two followed by near-identical ayat.

tree:1awu8n016dmm9o.why: 'Followed by a curse in this world and on the Day of Resurrection': 'Ad (11:60), Pharaoh (11:99, without 'world'), Pharaoh's people (28:42).

tree:18ewtsa0xaq58m.why: The deniers' wonder: 'shall we really be in a new creation?' (13:5, 32:10, 34:7), each followed by a different answer.

tree:0wya6db1nj94fb.why: 6:42 and 16:63: 'We sent messengers to nations before you' then hardship took them / Satan made their deeds fair. 27:45 ('We sent to Thamud their brother Salih') is the common story opening, not this pair.
tree:0wya6db1nj94fb.changes: Removed 27:45: it is the standard opening of one prophet's story, not the general statement about nations.
tree:0wya6db1nj94fb.relation: Earlier nations: tested with hardship, deceived by Satan.

tree:1da3p501i51a3a.why: 'You have done a grievous / terrible / unheard-of thing': Moses to al-Khidr twice (18:71, 18:74) and Mary's people (19:27). Three adjectives to keep apart.

tree:1femkzk0tf07vu.why: 'You know well that ...': Lot's people (11:79), Moses to Pharaoh (17:102), Abraham's people about the idols (21:65).

tree:0xpccge1vc64za.why: Night and day for you: subjected (14:33, 16:12) and made (28:73). Signs of mercy with different tails.

tree:05ojp2k0vn3w4m.why: Jesus came to make lawful 'some of what was forbidden' (3:50) and to explain 'some of what you differ about' (43:63), both ending 'so fear God and obey me'. 27:72 ('some of what you hasten') is a different subject.
tree:05ojp2k0vn3w4m.changes: Removed 27:72: it is about the punishment the deniers hasten.
tree:05ojp2k0vn3w4m.relation: Jesus' mission: easing and clarifying the Law.

tree:19nwito0cwunf6.why: 2:36 and 7:24: 'and for you on earth a dwelling and provision for a time', identical in Adam's story. 16:13 ('what He spread for you on earth') is a different phrase.
tree:19nwito0cwunf6.changes: Removed 16:13: it lists blessings of varied colours, not Adam's descent.

tree:17hclig0wv75z8.why: 'For you in them are benefits': the sacrificial animals till their term (22:33), cattle with milk and food (23:21), cattle to ride (40:80).

tree:0qcvpxx1sw6scr.why: 'He will forgive you of your sins and defer you to a set term' (14:10 the messengers, 71:4 Noah) vs 'and protect you from a painful punishment' (46:31 the jinn).

tree:1e6z7cy0595npq.why: 'I am to you from Him a warner': and a bringer of good news (11:2) vs clear (51:50 and 51:51, two neighbouring ayat with the same ending).

tree:15yu8l80vbpeui.why: 'I am to you a clear warner': Noah in 11:25 and 71:2 ('indeed I'), and the Prophet in 22:49 ('I am only'). Each followed by the call to worship God.

tree:1m91brs1ysy8ho.why: 'For those who do not believe' is a common phrase; the three ayat (devils as allies, work as you will, the evil description) share nothing more.

tree:16ceidb0m2ymxz.why: 'A humiliating punishment for the disbelievers' three times in an-Nisa: 'and We prepared' (4:37, 4:151) vs 'God has prepared' (4:102).

tree:1yr1two1gbhtp2.why: On the Day, life seems to have lasted only an hour of the day (10:45, 46:35, with and without 'the') or an evening or its morning (79:46).
tree:1yr1two1gbhtp2.relation: How short this life will seem when the Day comes.

tree:1vacg1j0t9mvst.why: 'When they saw the punishment': they hid their regret (10:54, 34:33, same clause, different tails), and the wrongdoers ask for a way back (42:44).
tree:1vacg1j0t9mvst.relation: Regret that comes only when the punishment is seen.

tree:1n2fy9s0kbxjk4.why: 'If You save us / give us ..., we will surely be among the grateful': at sea (6:63, 10:22) and the couple praying for a child (7:189); each time they break the promise in the next ayah.
tree:1n2fy9s0kbxjk4.relation: Promises made in distress and broken in ease.

tree:1xr75op0ys22rz.why: 'To Him belong the best names': call Him by any (17:110), no god but He (20:8), the Creator, Maker, Fashioner (59:24).

tree:1ml0e2y0jvjb70.why: 'His is the praise in ...': the first and the last (28:70), the heavens and earth (30:18), the Hereafter (34:1).

tree:13cizu50rncd4n.why: The real pair, 30:43 and 42:47 ('a Day that cannot be turned back from God'), is already a card. 5:41 ('you have no power for him against God') is a different phrase, so this card adds only an outsider.

tree:014wf5v0pnepyp.why: Only 'for him, before' is shared, in three unrelated settings (a brother who stole, John's unique name, submit before the punishment).

tree:094pfo8034wshc.why: 'It will have what it earned': a nation that passed (2:134, 2:141, identical) and every soul (2:286, 'and against it what it incurred').
tree:094pfo8034wshc.relation: Each answers for what it earned.

tree:1vvr0111y3az7f.why: Only 'for them; indeed God' is shared, joining three unrelated sentences (treaties, lowering the gaze, the hypocrites).

tree:0amhimb0x06l6h.why: 'They will have whatever they wish with their Lord' (39:34, 42:22) and 'whatever they wish therein' (50:35). The reward of the Garden, with different tails.

tree:07i0y2j1ickb0z.why: 'They have besides Him no ...': protector or intercessor (6:51), defender (13:11), protector (18:26). The noun is the trap.

tree:0c3rdhe040e60c.why: 'Had your Lord willed': they would not have done it (6:112), all on earth would believe (10:99), He would make people one nation (11:118).
tree:0c3rdhe040e60c.relation: God's will behind people's choices and differences.

tree:0ag40d906c7fpj.why: 'Even though the disbelievers dislike it': God perfects His light (9:32, 61:8, near-identical) and worship Him sincerely (40:14).

tree:082p0mp0df271d.why: Only 'if God willed' is shared, in three unrelated settings (guiding all people, feeding the poor, defeating the enemy). The phrase is too general to hold them together.

tree:0ugdhos0og8xee.why: 'Grant me from Yourself': Zakariya asks for good offspring (3:38) and an heir (19:5), and the Prophet for a supporting authority (17:80).
tree:0ugdhos0og8xee.relation: Asking for what only God can give.

tree:1p1wtzj1wh4mx5.why: 'What God has given them of His bounty': hiding it out of stinginess (4:37), envying others for it (4:54), being content with it (9:59).
tree:1p1wtzj1wh4mx5.relation: Three attitudes to God's gifts: hoarding, envy, contentment.

tree:1f18tl61rnts60.why: 'I do not want to ...': Shu'ayb does not want to oppose his own teaching (11:88), the old man of Madyan does not want to burden Moses (28:27), and God wants no provision from people (51:57).
tree:1f18tl61rnts60.relation: Sincerity without self-interest, from prophet, host and Lord.

tree:1dhzyj51d52mld.why: 'I am not a guardian over you' (6:104, 11:86) vs 'not a keeper over you' (10:108). The prophet's role is to convey, not to force.

tree:1u4o88n18f9127.why: Only 'what you are upon' is shared, and the words carry different senses (your present state, what you are doing, you cannot tempt anyone). Different structures, nothing to confuse.

tree:10iiglf0vijysf.why: 'Whatever you spend of ...': good (2:215), expenditure (2:270), anything (34:39), each with a different promise after it.
tree:10iiglf0vijysf.relation: Nothing spent is lost: God knows it and replaces it.

tree:0003rev1u6h7qt.why: 'What was given to Moses': in the believers' creed (2:136, 3:84) and in the deniers' demand for the like of it, though they disbelieved in it before (28:48).
tree:0003rev1u6h7qt.relation: Contrast: believers affirm all revelation; deniers ask for Moses' signs and reject them.

tree:0ycamxa1vm5ham.why: 'He knows what you reveal and what you conceal': 'what you used to conceal' in 2:33, 'what you conceal' in 5:99 and 24:29. A one-word trap.

tree:1t5rkix025jy0n.why: Only 'what you worship' is shared, in three senses: Jacob's question about after him (2:133), the idols are mere names (12:40), the idols as fuel of Hell (21:98). Different structures and subjects.

tree:1qcj3lj1p1wbe9.why: 'After the clear proofs had come to them': they differed out of envy (2:213), they fought each other (2:253), they took the calf (4:153).
tree:1qcj3lj1p1wbe9.relation: Division and disbelief came not from ignorance but after clear proof.

tree:0w7ey8l1ajic57.why: 5:84 (Christians moved to tears) and 20:72 (Pharaoh's magicians) are both new believers holding to what has come to them of truth and clear proofs. 5:19 ('no bringer of news came to us') is a different subject.
tree:0w7ey8l1ajic57.changes: Removed 5:19: it is the excuse the People of the Book might give, not a believer's stand.
tree:0w7ey8l1ajic57.relation: Converts who choose the truth that reached them over every worldly cost.

tree:0zpcgjf0qbhc4f.why: Only 'God has not made' is shared, in three unrelated rulings (no way against neutral people, no invented taboo animals, no two hearts).

tree:103fhl204wtgf4.why: 'We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves' (11:101), 'they used to wrong themselves' (16:118), 'they were the wrongdoers' (43:76). Close wording, three endings.

tree:1skt80g0fwmz9k.why: 6:151 and 7:33 both forbid indecencies 'what is apparent of them and what is hidden'. 24:31 ('except what is apparent' of adornment) is a different subject.
tree:1skt80g0fwmz9k.changes: Removed 24:31: its 'what appears of it' is about women's adornment, not indecency.

tree:02xgzoc0wfv5yw.why: 'What has already passed' is pardoned: past marriages to a father's wife and to two sisters (4:22, 4:23), and the disbelievers' past if they desist (8:38).
tree:02xgzoc0wfv5yw.relation: God does not hold people to account for what was before the law came.

tree:0e2i1ts0ijao6i.why: 11:117 and 28:59: your Lord would never destroy towns unjustly / until He sent a messenger. 19:64 ('your Lord is never forgetful') is a different subject.
tree:0e2i1ts0ijao6i.changes: Removed 19:64: it is about God not forgetting, not about destroying towns.
tree:0e2i1ts0ijao6i.relation: God destroys no town unjustly or without warning.

tree:0ig9igq197oosm.why: Only 'it was not for you' is shared, in three unrelated settings (the people of the Fire, growing trees, the Prophet's wives).

tree:0nl5vmb0rej3ob.why: 'It was not for us': Joseph refuses to associate (12:38), messengers cannot bring authority except by God's leave (14:11), and the misleaders disown any authority over their followers (37:30).
tree:0nl5vmb0rej3ob.relation: No one, prophet or misleader, holds power of his own.

tree:1s4iret1t2mie5.why: 'And they were not guided' closes three ayat about loss: selling guidance for error (2:16), killing children (6:140), denying the meeting with God (10:45).

tree:0qawqw00k93jeo.why: Only 'it has no ...' is shared, about a rootless tree (14:26), a blast without pause (38:15) and a sky without rifts (50:6). Unrelated images.

tree:1imij2n0rmf063.why: 'What I have no ...': right to say (5:116, Jesus) vs knowledge of (11:47 Noah, 40:42 the believer of Pharaoh's people).
tree:1imij2n0rmf063.relation: Prophets and believers refusing to speak without right or knowledge.

tree:0f7tjkd1uosvth.why: 'There is no creature on earth but ...': they are nations like you (6:38), God provides for it (11:6), He holds its forelock (11:56).
tree:0f7tjkd1uosvth.relation: Every creature known, provided for and held by God.

tree:1i57t4v117ei27.why: 'And we will not be punished': 'Ad's boast (26:138), the rich deniers' boast (34:35), and the people of the Garden in wonder (37:59).
tree:1i57t4v117ei27.relation: Contrast: the deniers' false security and the believers' true security.

tree:0wtt6d31apopxv.why: The 'what' differs: a negation in 7:71 and 67:9 ('God sent down nothing'), a relative in 47:26 ('what God sent down'). Two different structures, and 7:71 / 67:9 alone are not close.

tree:0alayg21cxzh8a.why: 'What is recited to you': about women and orphans (4:127), and cattle made lawful 'except what is recited to you' (5:1, 22:30).

tree:1f0fg271ve1prx.why: 'Follow what is revealed to you' (10:109, 33:2), and 'perhaps you would leave some of what is revealed to you' (11:12).
tree:1f0fg271ve1prx.relation: Holding to the revelation despite pressure.

tree:17dkzdd1gbo4up.why: 'And died while disbelievers': the curse (2:161), no ransom accepted (3:91), no forgiveness (47:34). Close openings, different consequences.

tree:02izjlf18egn6n.why: 'And enjoyment for a time': Adam's descent (2:36, 7:24, identical) and the delay of punishment (21:111).

tree:0cf6dkw0g4u28m.why: 'The like of what was given to ...': the messengers (6:124), Moses (28:48), Qarun (28:79).
tree:0cf6dkw0g4u28m.relation: Envy of what others were given, of prophethood and of wealth.

tree:0ysilrb0is6w2b.why: 'With the wrongdoing people': do not sit with them (6:68), do not place us with them (7:47), do not place me with them (7:150).

tree:16tc47h1y5jnmh.why: Noah saved with those with him in the ark: 'and those with him' (7:64) vs 'and whoever was with him' (10:73, 26:119), with different tails.

tree:05k1q7v1nk98o3.why: 'That is among the signs of God' after clothing (7:26) and the sun turning from the cave (18:17). 33:34 ('what is recited of God's verses') is a different phrase.
tree:05k1q7v1nk98o3.changes: Removed 33:34: there the words mean the recited verses, not a sign in creation.

tree:0bmjkct0zthd4n.why: Lot's rebuke 'no one in the worlds preceded you in it' in 7:80 and 29:28, which differ in the opening ('do you commit' vs 'indeed you commit'). 35:41 ('no one after Him') is a different sentence.
tree:0bmjkct0zthd4n.changes: Removed 35:41: its 'anyone' is about holding the heavens, unrelated to Lot.

tree:0n26sjs1sldjn4.why: 'Who is more astray than one who ...': follows his desire (28:50), is in far dissension (41:52), calls on what will not answer (46:5).
tree:0n26sjs1sldjn4.relation: Three faces of the worst error: desire, opposition, false worship.

tree:0p3tyn802t2jdy.why: Houses cut from the mountains: Thamud 'used to carve' (15:82) and 'you carve' (26:149), and the bee told to take homes in the mountains (16:68).
tree:0p3tyn802t2jdy.relation: Contrast: the bee builds as inspired and gives healing; Thamud built proudly and perished.

tree:1at9t8414ztgkq.why: 'I will fill Hell with jinn and men all together' (11:119, 32:13, identical), and the last ayah of the Quran naming the whisperers 'of the jinn and men' (114:6).

tree:0hwume80uyn0nu.why: Two charges in an-Nisa opening 'of those who are Jews': distorting words (4:46) and the wrong for which good things were forbidden (4:160).
tree:0hwume80uyn0nu.relation: The wrongs of some of the Jews and their consequence.

tree:0xoxszh0ud9mll.why: 2:164 and 45:5 list the same signs in close words: what God sends from the sky, of water / of provision, reviving the earth, the winds. 24:43 (hail from mountains of cloud) is a different passage.
tree:0xoxszh0ud9mll.changes: Removed 24:43: it describes hail and lightning, not the list of signs.
tree:0xoxszh0ud9mll.relation: Rain called 'provision' in one and 'water' in the other.

tree:18tfzmi06kkxz6.why: 34:2 and 57:4 share a whole clause: He knows what enters the earth and what comes out, what descends from the sky and what ascends, then different tails. 36:28 (no army sent from the sky) is unrelated.
tree:18tfzmi06kkxz6.changes: Removed 36:28: it is about no army sent against a people, a different sentence.

tree:04ew8kx029o1w9.why: 2:120 and 13:37: 'if you followed their desires after the knowledge that came to you, you would have no protector from God, nor helper / defender'. 19:43 (Abraham: knowledge came to me that did not come to you) is a different structure.
tree:04ew8kx029o1w9.changes: Removed 19:43: its 'what did not come to you' is a different sentence, not the warning.

tree:0o5d4rb0zqsusf.why: 'Saved from the great distress': Noah and his family (21:76, 37:76) and Moses and Aaron with their people (37:115).

tree:0d1truv12fojhx.why: 'Who would help me against God if ...': Noah if he drove the poor away (11:30), Salih if he disobeyed (11:63), and 'who can protect you from God if He wills' (33:17).
tree:0d1truv12fojhx.relation: No one can protect from God.

tree:1ef5fnt1gfmlp1.why: 'God has been gracious to us': Joseph reunited (12:90), those who envied Qarun (28:82), the people of the Garden (52:27).
tree:1ef5fnt1gfmlp1.relation: Recognising God's favour: after trial, after a near escape, and in Paradise.

tree:1it528908zgcpb.why: Only 'from the command of God' is shared, in three different senses (no refuge from it, wonder at it, guarding by it).

tree:1vblmw11uat6in.why: 'That is of the news of the unseen, which We reveal to you': Mary (3:44), Noah ('those' in 11:49), Joseph (12:102).

tree:0vp8zwd106tbp7.why: Only 'after' is shared, in three unrelated sentences (Satan's discord, victory at Mecca, intercession by God's leave).

tree:0hkt2ys09d7n24.why: 'From before them and behind them': Satan's attack from every side (7:17), the barrier around the deniers (36:9), messengers coming from all sides (41:14).
tree:0hkt2ys09d7n24.relation: Surrounded on every side: by Satan, by blindness, and by the call of the messengers.

tree:13q7r0a1r2et8a.why: 'The interpretation of events' three times in Yusuf: promised (12:6), begun in Egypt (12:21), and acknowledged by Joseph at the end (12:101).

tree:1p6wdy31t0ey0b.why: 'Whoever's scales are heavy': 7:8 and 23:102 identical, 101:6 with 'as for'. Followed by the light scales in the next ayah.

tree:1lq5rsb1qi35nf.why: 'Whoever brings an evil deed': only its like (6:160), thrown face-first (27:90), recompensed only for what they did (28:84).

tree:1oztqvl03xx8jn.why: 'Whoever's scales are light': 7:9 and 23:103 share the start and end differently, 101:8 'as for'. The pair of the previous card.

tree:0yvmyqw0vg5mf0.why: 'Those they call upon besides Him cannot ...': help (7:197), answer (13:14), judge (40:20).

tree:0f7qfzf1ai1p85.why: 'Nor smaller than that nor greater, but in a clear Book' (10:61, 34:3, with earth and heaven in reverse order) and 'nor less than that nor more' (58:7).

tree:0yer55a12fkeas.why: 'From your Lord; so whoever ...': sees (6:104), is guided (10:108), wills (18:29). The choice given after the message.

tree:08gmczw1q5leee.why: The demand 'why is a sign not sent down to him from his Lord? Say ...' with three answers (6:37, 13:27, 29:50).

tree:1oz5fcq0ngy9ky.why: 15:21 and 17:44: 'there is nothing but ...' its treasuries are with Us / it glorifies His praise. 12:68 ('it did not avail them anything except a need') is a different structure.
tree:1oz5fcq0ngy9ky.changes: Removed 12:68: its 'anything except' is about Jacob's advice, not all things.
tree:1oz5fcq0ngy9ky.relation: Everything is held by God and glorifies Him.

tree:16uc2oj1bfnry5.why: 36:15 and 67:9: the deniers say 'God sent down nothing; you are only ...' (lying / in great error). 12:67 (Jacob: I cannot avail you anything) is a different structure.
tree:16uc2oj1bfnry5.changes: Removed 12:67: its 'anything' is Jacob's humility, not the deniers' claim.

tree:1i1w9u41x04ey2.why: Nothing escapes God 'in the earth or in the heaven' (14:38) and nothing can frustrate Him 'in the heavens or in the earth' (35:44): the order is reversed. 8:60 ('whatever you spend of anything in God's way') is a different sentence.
tree:1i1w9u41x04ey2.changes: Removed 8:60: its 'anything' is about spending, not God's knowledge or power.

tree:075cwh81h0i60g.why: 'When the truth came to them from Us, they said ...': this is clear magic (10:76), why was he not given like Moses (28:48), kill the sons of the believers (40:25).
tree:075cwh81h0i60g.relation: Three reactions of deniers to the truth: slander, excuse, persecution.

tree:0fhyfiz0ipghkf.why: 'Of His bounty; indeed He ...' with three closings: is ever merciful to you (17:66), does not love the disbelievers (30:45), is Forgiving, Appreciative (35:30).

tree:1kxzy4z11b3uyt.why: 23:83 and 27:68: 'we and our fathers were promised this before' with the words in a different order. 2:91 ('why did you kill God's prophets before') is unrelated.
tree:1kxzy4z11b3uyt.changes: Removed 2:91: its 'before, if' is a different sentence.

tree:1ywbx3c0rgabqa.why: 'Have they not travelled ... those before them were stronger than them': 30:9, 40:21 ('they were, they'), 40:82 ('more numerous and stronger'). A well-known trap.
tree:1ywbx3c0rgabqa.relation: Past nations were stronger, and it did not save them.

tree:0o553is1q8rtmc.why: 'We never destroyed a town but ...' (15:4, 26:208) and 'there is no town but We will destroy it' (17:58). Same theme of God's decree on towns.

tree:19kzm8c1pcos2q.why: 'Town that We destroyed': how many (7:4), none of them believed (21:6), how many, while it was wrong-doing (22:45).

tree:0aqok0n0jcaftj.why: 'Whoever of you is ill' in the fasting ruling (2:184) and the pilgrimage ruling (2:196), each with a different concession. 2:232 ('whoever of you believes') is a different structure.
tree:0aqok0n0jcaftj.changes: Removed 2:232: it is an admonition to believers, not a concession for illness.
tree:0aqok0n0jcaftj.relation: The same concession for the sick in two acts of worship.

tree:19a0fgt0ymlvl1.why: 'And whoever disbelieves, then indeed God / my Lord is Free of need': of the worlds (3:97), Generous (27:40), Praiseworthy (31:12).

tree:1nymreg1u41lim.why: Only 'from every place' is shared: waves at sea, death in Hell, a town's provision. Unrelated images, nothing to confuse.

tree:00foapl1xz0bwb.why: 'Who provides for you from the sky (10:31, 27:64) / the heavens (34:24) and the earth?' with three different follow-ups.

tree:0u1tvsz1s0hcrf.why: Only 'whom He wills, and' is shared: guidance and spending (2:272), the dead not hearing (35:22). Unrelated.

tree:116zfth1ayhefb.why: 6:10 and 21:41 are identical: messengers were mocked, and what they mocked encompassed the mockers. 28:6 ('what they feared from them') is a different sentence.
tree:116zfth1ayhefb.changes: Removed 28:6: it is about Pharaoh seeing what he feared, a different structure.

tree:0mynd5e1i1u9hm.why: 'Among them is one who says': the prayer for both worlds (2:201), 'excuse me' (9:49), 'which of you did this increase in faith?' (9:124).
tree:0mynd5e1i1u9hm.relation: What people say reveals what they want.

tree:06wufev1g235pn.why: The covenant of the Children of Israel: its terms (2:83), the twelve chiefs (5:12), the messengers they denied or killed (5:70).

tree:04wkhuk02x2jmi.why: 'Excellent is the reward of the workers': 'and excellent' (3:136), 'excellent' (29:58), 'so excellent' (39:74). The particle is the trap.

tree:1neinxt1nb78tp.why: 2:48 and 2:123: 'fear a Day when no soul will avail another', with intercession and ransom in reverse order. 36:54 ('no soul will be wronged') is a different sentence.
tree:1neinxt1nb78tp.changes: Removed 36:54: its verb is 'wronged', not 'avail', and the rest differs.

tree:1dvyfkl0rbsf5f.why: 'Benefit or harm': the Prophet has none for himself (7:188), the idols have none even for themselves (13:16), and on the Day no one has any for another (34:42).
tree:1dvyfkl0rbsf5f.relation: No one owns benefit or harm but God.

tree:1rimhj5161p1qb.why: 'We relate to you of the news of ...': the towns (7:101), the messengers (11:120), what has passed (20:99).

tree:14qypgb10mqkol.why: Wishes to be among the believers: 'and be' (6:27, 28:47) vs 'so be' (26:102). Each wish comes too late or is false.

tree:1mzx9nm00w3vsm.why: 'Grant me from ...': Zakariya twice 'from Yourself' (3:38, 19:5), Abraham 'of the righteous' (37:100).

tree:1shz78411wb81c.why: 'This is clear magic' said of Moses' signs (27:13), the Quran (46:7), Jesus' proofs (61:6). Same slander, three messengers.

tree:07812m70cjl6z7.why: Moses' sister in two tellings: 'shall I show you one who will nurse him' (20:40) vs 'a household who will nurse him' (28:12). 61:10 ('shall I show you a trade') is a different subject.
tree:07812m70cjl6z7.changes: Removed 61:10: it is the call to faith and striving, not the story of Moses.

tree:07b3kyj13lxdcz.why: 'Those who guard their prayer' (6:92, 70:34) vs 'those constant in their prayer' (70:23). Two in al-Ma'arij.

tree:1bmygms0ro284e.why: 'So they do not hear' (7:100, 41:4) vs 'while they do not hear' (8:21).

tree:1oxis2a0ddy8nw.why: 'It is the truth from ...': the deniers' defiant prayer 'if this is the truth from You' (8:32), 'rather it is the truth from your Lord' (32:3), and the believers who believe in it as the truth from their Lord (47:2).
tree:1oxis2a0ddy8nw.relation: Contrast: the same truth challenged by deniers and accepted by believers.

tree:0f06rhn01dhk0d.why: 'And He is the Wise, the Aware' closes three ayat with different lead-ins: the Subduer (6:18), Knower of the unseen (6:73), praise in the Hereafter (34:1).

tree:0s82ths1ghl7oe.why: 22:62 and 31:30 are near-identical ('that is because God is the Truth', with 'it is' falsehood only in 22:62); 34:23 ends 'and He is the Most High, the Great'.

tree:00u4hw5003yy17.why: 'Indeed He is the Knowing, the Wise': Jacob's hope (12:83) and Joseph's thanks (12:100), father and son in one surah; 66:2 with 'and He is'.
tree:00u4hw5003yy17.relation: Jacob trusts God's wisdom in loss, Joseph praises it in reunion.

tree:0nwkghh0epzuxb.why: 'He is only one God': I am free of what you associate (6:19), so that people of understanding remember (14:52), so fear Me (16:51).

tree:0g5j8051eerbsd.why: 'Until God judges, and He is the best of judges': Shu'ayb (7:87), the Prophet (10:109), Joseph's eldest brother (12:80).

tree:1kbjzl60zkf9bc.why: 'Lord of the Throne': the Great (9:129, 27:26) vs the Noble (23:116). One word.

tree:08khule16hyoxm.why: 3:85 and 5:5 end 'and in the Hereafter he is among the losers' (seeking another religion, rejecting faith). 17:72 ('blind in the Hereafter') is a different sentence.
tree:08khule16hyoxm.changes: Removed 17:72: its 'he will be blind in the Hereafter' is a different structure.

tree:1lbenex1nge2ob.why: 'While he is a believer, those ...': will enter the Garden (4:124, 40:40, with 'male or female') and their effort is appreciated (17:19).
tree:1lbenex1nge2ob.relation: Faith is the condition for deeds to count.

tree:16oytsy0fz0fjc.why: 'He gives life and causes death' after 'no god but He' with three tails: believe in His Messenger (7:158), to Him you return (10:56), your Lord and your fathers' Lord (44:8).

tree:0zopmhp0mnesex.why: 'Jews or Christians' three times in al-Baqara: only they enter the Garden (2:111), be them to be guided (2:135), Abraham and his sons were (2:140).
tree:0zopmhp0mnesex.relation: Exclusive claims answered with Abraham's pure faith.

tree:13600310z200qn.why: 'What we found our fathers upon': 'even if their fathers ...' (5:104, 31:21) and Pharaoh's people to Moses (10:78).
tree:13600310z200qn.relation: Blind following of forefathers against every messenger.

tree:1ixfkdv0wsh66v.why: 'Only one blast, and then they ...': extinguished (36:29), all brought before Us (36:53), looking on (37:19).

tree:0bbmeu000dywke.why: 'The promise of God is true' with three tails: who is truer in speech (4:122), He begins creation (10:4), He is the Mighty (31:9).

tree:1cclkk80zzdz3e.why: 'No protector and no intercessor besides Him': 6:51 and 6:70 in one surah ('Him' vs 'God'), and 32:4 'you have'.

tree:0p7pbs20n180l2.why: The angels glorify their Lord's praise around the Throne (39:75), bearing it and asking forgiveness for believers (40:7), and for those on earth (42:5).
tree:0p7pbs20n180l2.relation: The angels' worship includes praying for us.

tree:0ppf7e518q5o69.why: 'They hasten to good deeds': the righteous People of the Book (3:114), Zakariya's family (21:90), the believers who fear their Lord (23:61).

tree:1qgpg4u16c7dec.why: 'God leaves astray whom He wills' (14:4, 74:31) vs 'whoever is a transgressor and doubter' (40:34).

tree:1l2jmon1swhnfj.why: 3:142 and 9:16: 'did you think you would ... while God has not yet made evident those of you who strive', with different tails. 24:63 ('God knows those who slip away') is a different sentence.
tree:1l2jmon1swhnfj.changes: Removed 24:63: it is about leaving the Prophet's gathering, a different structure.
tree:1l2jmon1swhnfj.relation: Paradise and acceptance come only after proof by striving.

tree:0rt2gv51wla7kx.why: 'Do they not know that God ...': knows their secret (9:78), accepts repentance (9:104), extends provision (39:52, 'have they not').

tree:04fq1tr0oiyyfr.why: 'O Jesus son of Mary' three times in the last part of al-Ma'ida: God reminds him of His favours (5:110), the disciples ask for the table (5:112), God asks about worship of him (5:116).

tree:1nxvxyz0a78uf1.why: 'He will forgive you your sins': for following the Prophet (3:31), for upright speech (33:71), for faith and striving (61:12), each with a different tail.

tree:1izjpnw0tg41yw.why: 'How will I have a boy?': Zakariya in 3:40 and 19:8 (old age and barren wife in reverse order), Mary in 19:20.

tree:1cjlbtm1nmvy6w.why: 'He will inform them of what they did': 24:64, 58:6 and 58:7, each with a different closing. Two neighbouring ayat in al-Mujadila.

tree:0ab0jjk19rh14k.why: 4:42 and 15:2 are the disbelievers' wishes on the Day: that the earth were levelled over them, that they had been Muslims. 2:105 ('they do not like that good be sent down to you') is a different structure.
tree:0ab0jjk19rh14k.changes: Removed 2:105: its 'do not like' is a negated verb about envy in this world.
tree:0ab0jjk19rh14k.relation: Wishes of the deniers that come too late.

tree:1kr7wdt1ovaw3r.why: 'The day the two armies met': those who fled at Uhud (3:155), what struck you at Uhud was by God's leave (3:166), and the Day of Criterion at Badr (8:41).
tree:1kr7wdt1ovaw3r.relation: Victory and setback both by God's will.

tree:0o2adjz1kuv15f.why: 39:15 and 42:45 share 'the losers are those who lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection', then different tails. 11:60 ('and on the Day of Resurrection; truly 'Ad ...') is a different sentence.
tree:0o2adjz1kuv15f.changes: Removed 11:60: its words belong to the curse on 'Ad, not the definition of the losers.

tree:1n4iko701gahlr.why: 'Leave them to plunge and play until they meet their Day which they are promised' (43:83, 70:42, identical) and 'woe from their Day which they are promised' (51:60).

tree:0c73h040l6pi9a.why: 'Woe to us, we were wrongdoers' (21:14, 21:46) vs 'we were transgressors' (68:31).

tree:1s1tz4x1cn8afp.why: Two different words hide in one spelling: the command 'believe in God and His Messenger' (4:136, 57:7) and the description 'those who believed in God and His Messenger' (24:62, 49:15, both opening 'the believers are only').
tree:1s1tz4x1cn8afp.changes: Split: the command (4:136, 57:7) is a different word from the past-tense description (24:62, 49:15); each pair is a clear memorizer's card.

tree:167ifpl0t13q0z.why: 'Those who believed and were mindful' closing four ayat: the friends of God (10:63), Joseph's reward (12:57), saved with 'We saved' (27:53) vs 'and We rescued' (41:18).

tree:0ba3ctx1c3c3ql.why: 'And revived the earth with it after its death' in four lists of signs; 29:63 has 'from after' and comes as a question to the deniers.

tree:04bylgm1abre8k.why: 'When he called out to his Lord': Zakariya (19:3, 21:89) and Job (21:83, 38:41, 'harm' vs 'Satan has touched me').
tree:04bylgm1abre8k.relation: Prophets' private calls to God in need.

tree:0eur0ay1si944c.why: 'When their term comes': they cannot delay or advance it (7:34, 10:49, 16:61), and 35:45 (twin of 16:61) ends 'then God sees His servants'.

tree:1dkgexu079la5y.why: 'When the promise of ... comes': the first and last of the two (17:5, 17:7), the last (17:104), and Dhul-Qarnayn's 'my Lord' (18:98).

tree:1dxwjf1155gpvr.why: Mentioning God's name over food: on game (5:4), and three neighbouring ayat of al-An'am (6:118, 6:119 allowed, 6:121 forbidden when not mentioned).

tree:1mfl3y60rz5e8s.why: 'Stronger than them in power': three 'have they not travelled' ayat (30:9, 35:44, 40:21) and 'Ad's boast answered (41:15).
tree:1mfl3y60rz5e8s.relation: Strength did not save the nations before.

tree:0sbbdwd0vp0n39.why: 'Obey God and His Messenger' three times in al-Anfal (8:1, 8:20, 8:46) and in 58:13, each with a different tail.

tree:1hjctgw0gbvwre.why: 'God has prepared for them': gardens (9:89), forgiveness and great reward (33:35), and a severe punishment (58:15, 65:10).
tree:1hjctgw0gbvwre.relation: Contrast: what God prepares for the obedient and for the hypocrites.

tree:0ihxe0a15lwi1c.why: 'Work according to your position': 'I am working, so you will know' (6:135, 39:39), 'you will know' (11:93), 'we are working' (11:121).

tree:06ktmpl0psweqt.why: 'Only the clear conveying': on the messengers (16:35), on the Messenger (24:54, 29:18), on us (36:17).

tree:122u5iu1bl2ek2.why: 'They deceive / mislead / destroy only themselves, and they do not perceive' (2:9, 3:69, 6:26) and 'they do not harm you' (4:113).
tree:122u5iu1bl2ek2.relation: Evil plots harm only their makers.

tree:0ilddw610q9aak.why: 'A human like you': the messengers' own answer (14:11) and the deniers' charge (21:3, 23:24, 23:33), with different tails.

tree:0h7843z1gzagsh.why: 'A human like us': the deniers' charge against the messengers (14:10, 26:154, 26:186, 36:15), each with a different tail.

tree:1i60jdj0i8h547.why: 'Only one blast': three times in Ya-Sin (36:29, 36:49, 36:53) and once in Sad (38:15), with different tails.

tree:0ierlx21pidsce.why: 'My reward is only from God': Noah (10:72, 11:29) and the Prophet (34:47). 11:6 ('its provision is on God') is a different structure.
tree:0ierlx21pidsce.changes: Removed 11:6: it is about God providing for every creature, not a prophet's reward.

tree:1d1tizz1tny2oz.why: 'The home of the Hereafter is better for those who are mindful; do you not reason?' (6:32, 7:169, 12:109 with small differences), and 12:57 'the reward of the Hereafter'.

tree:1cf2rl81awhdfw.why: 'We detail the signs for a people who know' with four verb forms: We have detailed (6:97), thus We detail (7:32), and We detail (9:11), He details (10:5).

tree:05pn55m1i1qepu.why: 'The land which We blessed': inherited by the Children of Israel (7:137), Abraham and Lot (21:71), Solomon's wind (21:81), Sheba's route (34:18).

tree:0pc0vgp069hxdn.why: 'The truth from their Lord': known by believers and People of the Book (2:26, 2:144), and followed by believers (47:2, 47:3).

tree:139h7n30morifh.why: 'The life of this world is only ...': the enjoyment of delusion (3:185), play and amusement (6:32), amusement and play in reverse order (29:64).

tree:0xbjicd1pytaq9.why: 'What We revealed to you': to recite it (13:30), they nearly tempted you from it (17:73), it is the truth (35:31), the same religion given to Noah, Abraham, Moses and Jesus (42:13).
tree:0xbjicd1pytaq9.relation: The revelation as one message across all prophets.

tree:07fbe6m161han8.why: 'Those who took besides God / besides Him': protectors like the spider's house (29:41), 'only to bring us near' (39:3), God watches them (42:6), gods that abandoned them (46:28).
tree:07fbe6m161han8.relation: The weakness of every protector other than God.

tree:1s2nzp510ieyfl.why: 5:73 and 9:90 warn that 'a painful punishment will touch / strike those of them who disbelieved'. 5:110 ('those of them who disbelieved said: this is magic') is a different sentence.
tree:1s2nzp510ieyfl.changes: Removed 5:110: it is about the reaction to Jesus' miracles, not the threatened punishment.

tree:18yqqxp0zsfpfr.why: 'Those who dispute about the signs of God' three times in Ghafir (40:35, 40:56, 40:69) and 'about Our signs' in 42:35.

tree:1t3o9170q1r18h.why: 'Those who fear their Lord unseen': (21:49, 35:18, 67:12) and those whose skins shiver at the Book (39:23).
tree:1t3o9170q1r18h.relation: Fear of the unseen Lord as the mark of the believer.

tree:0zdfxm91pir7ah.why: 'Those who say: our Lord ...': forgive us (3:16), take us out of this town (4:75), avert Hell (25:65), grant us comfort in spouses (25:74).
tree:0zdfxm91pir7ah.relation: The believers' prayers for themselves, the oppressed and their families.

tree:0ulq2af0ntkv99.why: 'Those who establish prayer': with zakat while bowing (5:55), and spending (8:3); 27:3 and 31:4 identical with certainty in the Hereafter.

tree:0f0kbwm0lyvn06.why: 'The heavens and the earth; and God is ...' with four closings: aware (3:180), able (3:189), sees (49:18), witness (85:9). A memorizer's trap.

tree:14uh0sw067vvu6.why: 'God sees what they do' (2:96, 3:163, 5:71) vs 'what you do' (49:18).

tree:0xynzy31mldcfj.why: 'Among people is one who disputes about God without knowledge': 22:3 'and follows every devil', 22:8 and 31:20 identical 'without guidance or an enlightening Book'. 31:6 (misleading without knowledge) is a different structure.
tree:0xynzy31mldcfj.changes: Removed 31:6: its 'without knowledge' follows 'to mislead', not 'disputes about God'.

tree:002or0l1850s97.why: 'God encompasses what they do' (3:120, 8:47; 4:108 'ever encompassing') vs 'sees what they do' (8:39).

tree:1igy0ki0if83uy.why: God sealed (2:7) and set a seal (9:93, 16:108, 47:16) upon their hearts, each continuing differently.
tree:1igy0ki0if83uy.relation: Hearts sealed as the end of stubborn refusal.

tree:142pk3g10ova0s.why: 'And God knows the wrongdoers': 2:95 and 62:7 nearly identical (never / will not wish for death), plus 2:246 and 9:47.

tree:1a6vc0t1bq2rcj.why: 'Exalted is God above what they associate' (7:190 'so exalted', 27:63) vs 'glory be to God above what they associate' (52:43, 59:23).

tree:003clkk1g2yggy.why: 'God is Forgiving, Forbearing' after four lead-ins: 'and God' (2:225, 5:101), 'know that God' (2:235), 'indeed God' (3:155).

tree:0iqiwyh0kmf72n.why: 'God does not fail His promise': 'indeed God does not fail the appointment' (3:9, 13:31), 'God does not fail His promise' (30:6), 'God does not fail the appointment' (39:20).

tree:1q5h6vp0cc7e55.why: 'And fear God that you may succeed' (2:189, 3:130, 3:200) vs 'remember the favours of God that you may succeed' (7:69).

tree:1p2yt911g9m2hd.why: 'God is with the patient': 'indeed God' (2:153, 8:46) vs 'and God' (2:249, 8:66), each in a call to patience or a battle.

tree:1df2ud000ktz3e.why: Only 'God, before' is shared, in four unrelated sentences (killing prophets, betrayal, broken pledge, God's earlier word).

tree:1r76dzz0nuzk6t.why: 'That is because God is the Truth': 22:6, 22:62 and 31:30 (with 'it is' only in 22:62), and 'they will know that God is the clear Truth' (24:25).

tree:0vr6wa815gbtsy.why: 'And those are the ...' is a stock closing; these four (winners, liars, successful, people of understanding) have unrelated subjects and nothing more in common.

tree:0g46cqs1bwe0wc.why: 18:43 and 28:81: no party to help him besides God, 'nor could he defend himself' vs 'nor was he of those who could'. The garden owner and Qarun, both ruined by wealth. 2:143 and 6:136 share only 'God, and it was not'.
tree:0g46cqs1bwe0wc.changes: Removed 2:143 and 6:136: their 'and it was not' starts unrelated sentences.
tree:0g46cqs1bwe0wc.relation: Two rich men whose wealth could not save them.

tree:1yct2jz0e5tl3z.why: 'God does what He wills' with two verbs for willing (2:253, 22:14 vs 3:40, 22:18), the last two close together in al-Hajj.

tree:19teaw01yghuto.why: 'The Messiah son of Mary': 5:17 and 5:72 identical claims answered differently, 5:75 he was only a messenger, 9:31 they took him as lord.
tree:19teaw01yghuto.relation: Every claim of divinity for Jesus answered in the Quran.

tree:0cmp4ux0wl2ea9.why: Two different phrasings: 'there is no god except God' with 'and there is no' (3:62, 38:65), and the exact testimony 'no god but God', which occurs only in 37:35 and 47:19.
tree:0cmp4ux0wl2ea9.changes: Split into the two phrasings: 3:62 and 38:65 share 'and there is no god but God'; 37:35 and 47:19 are the only two places of the testimony itself.
tree:0cmp4ux0wl2ea9.relation: The testimony of faith: the deniers turn from it in arrogance (37:35); the Prophet is told to know it (47:19).

tree:1dx8jf41taoyze.why: 'What god other than God would bring you ...?': your hearing and sight back (6:46), light (28:71), night (28:72). 52:43 ('or have they a god other than God') is a different sentence.
tree:1dx8jf41taoyze.changes: Removed 52:43: it is a plain question about another god, not 'who would bring you'.
tree:1dx8jf41taoyze.relation: Every blessing taken for granted could be withheld; none but God could restore it.

tree:1i8hfgi0vndo36.why: 'I have been commanded to be ...': the first to submit (6:14), of the Muslims (10:72), of the believers (10:104).

tree:1hclcgg03av1t6.why: 'Their wealth and children will not avail them against God' (3:10, 3:116, 58:17) and 'let not their wealth and children impress you' (9:55).
tree:1hclcgg03av1t6.relation: Wealth and children: no protection from God, and a means of punishment.

tree:00wds250yctrqh.why: 'And I was commanded to be of the Muslims' (10:72, 27:91) vs 'of the believers' (10:104). 2:67 (Moses: I seek refuge from being of the ignorant) is a different sentence.
tree:00wds250yctrqh.changes: Removed 2:67: its 'that I be of' follows seeking refuge, not a command.

tree:179w26b1985ejv.why: 'God is Free of need': Praiseworthy (2:267, 31:12), of the worlds (3:97), of you (39:7).

tree:18dixba0y58sto.why: Only 'indeed God has' is shared, before three unrelated verbs (sent Talut, destroyed earlier generations, judged between servants).

tree:0hhdw7c06b9hg2.why: 'If evil befalls them': they blame the Prophet (4:78), they see Moses as a bad omen (7:131), they despair (30:36), man is ungrateful (42:48).
tree:0hhdw7c06b9hg2.relation: How people react to hardship: blaming others, despair, ingratitude.

tree:1r0ekyj0vbvbup.why: 'If they turn away, then only ...': they are in dissension (2:137), your duty is to convey (3:20, 16:82), on him is what he was charged with (24:54).

tree:076xhp713jx563.why: 'You stayed only ...': a little (17:52, 23:114), ten (20:103), a day (20:104).
tree:076xhp713jx563.relation: How short life will seem on the Day.

tree:10ekrs21dwmd8a.why: 'If He wills, He can remove you and bring ...': others (4:133), successors (6:133), a new creation (14:19, 35:16, identical with the same next ayah).
