tree:1rhi6le1472zre.why: 'To our Lord we will return': Pharaoh's magicians twice (7:125, 26:50), the riders (43:14 'surely return'), and 'to our Lord we turn in hope' (68:32).

tree:08u7pwz00sy3ov.why: 'We were wrongdoers': the destroyed towns (7:5), 'woe to us' (21:14, 21:46), 'glory to our Lord' from the garden owners (68:29).

tree:0i7x6h20qc3zo4.why: Two different senses of 'what God sent down from': rain from the sky (2:164, 45:5, a pair already in its own card) and the Book (2:174, 42:15). Mixed together they make no single point.

tree:1tly0lc1ytq4yu.why: 'We sent down to you the Book': in truth to judge (4:105), confirming (5:48), and thus (29:47), in truth so worship God (39:2).

tree:1skfxf417bwcdi.why: 'He was of Our servants': the sincere (12:24, Joseph) and the believers, three times in as-Saffat (37:81, 37:111, 37:132).

tree:1wyp2bo0m0p5vo.why: 'I fear that ...': Abraham for his father (19:45), Moses that they will deny him (26:12, 28:34), and Pharaoh that Moses will change their religion (40:26).
tree:1wyp2bo0m0p5vo.relation: Contrast: the prophets fear for others; Pharaoh fears for his power.

tree:1kuq32o05utqne.why: 'So wait, I am with you among those who wait' (7:71, 10:20, 10:102) vs 'wait, I am with you among the waiting' with another verb (52:31).

tree:0qqxxxg01nlms6.why: 'How can I have a boy / child?': Zakariya (3:40, 19:8) and Mary (3:47 'child', 19:20 'boy').

tree:0izq9ge08gny9i.why: 'Or on a journey' in fasting (2:184, 2:185) and in purification (4:43, 5:6), each pair with near-identical wording.
tree:0izq9ge08gny9i.relation: The same concession for travellers in fasting and prayer.

tree:08048110029s1n.why: 23:6 and 70:30 are identical ('except from their wives or those their right hands possess'), with the same following ayat. 4:3 and 24:31 use the phrase in different rulings.
tree:08048110029s1n.changes: Removed 4:3 and 24:31: there the phrase is part of other rulings (number of wives, who may see adornment).

tree:1gtd4z51hsxccn.why: 'Those are the companions of Hellfire': after 'disbelieved and denied Our signs' (5:10, 5:86, 57:19) and after 'strove against Our signs' (22:51).

tree:12gzd0d0sqfdff.why: Taking the disbelievers as allies instead of the believers: forbidden (3:28, 4:144) and condemned (4:139). 7:30 (devils as allies instead of God) is a different phrase.
tree:12gzd0d0sqfdff.changes: Removed 7:30: it ends 'besides God' and is about devils, not disbelievers.

tree:0sdybuy0hutioe.why: 'Where is what you used to ...?': call upon (7:37), worship (26:92), associate (40:73). 57:4 ('He is with you wherever you are') uses the words in a different sense.
tree:0sdybuy0hutioe.changes: Removed 57:4: its 'wherever you are' is a different structure.
tree:0sdybuy0hutioe.relation: On the Day the false gods are asked for and are gone.

tree:1ly60j01pmvjx6.why: 'We believe in God and what was sent down': to us (2:136, 5:59), upon us (3:84), and the believing People of the Book (3:199).

tree:1gbtlt30txgql3.why: Only 'some of them to others' is shared, with four different verbs (alone with, inspire, look at, throw back words). Unrelated settings.

tree:0n4pegc17xhb1e.why: 'God is ever Knowing of all things' is a stock closing found in many places; these four (inheritance shares, the Seal of the Prophets, hidden thoughts, Hudaybiya) share nothing more.

tree:1io07ob1675p1h.why: 'Rather they are in doubt' (27:66, 38:8, 44:9) vs 'in confusion' (50:15). The deniers' state described four times.

tree:1xw6kmy1mvskrg.why: 'We disbelieve in what you were sent with': said to many messengers (14:9 with doubt, 34:34, 41:14, 43:24 with 'disbelievers').
tree:1xw6kmy1mvskrg.relation: The same answer from every nation that denied.

tree:0e3iudu1fwmzj4.why: 'Whoever repents, believes and does good': enter the Garden (19:60), forgiven (20:82), evil turned to good (25:70 'a righteous deed'), among the successful (28:67).
tree:0e3iudu1fwmzj4.relation: Repentance with faith and deeds opens every door.

tree:0wpfzx11rdeat7.why: 'Rivers flowing beneath them': in the Garden (7:43, 10:9, 18:31), and beneath the earlier nations who were destroyed despite them (6:6).
tree:0wpfzx11rdeat7.relation: Contrast: rivers as worldly comfort that did not save, and as reward that lasts.

tree:1x345nr0gxh4ff.why: 'That you worship none but God': 11:26 (Noah) and 46:21 (Hud) end 'I fear for you the punishment of a painful / great day'; 11:2 and 41:14 give the same call.

tree:11sw5oa10az7f8.why: 'Do not spread corruption on earth': after its reform (7:56, 7:85), the hypocrites' answer (2:11), and 'would you spread corruption if you turned away' (47:22).

tree:0b20kai0ch42re.why: 'Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you ...': differ (6:164) vs do (39:7), both after 'no bearer bears another's burden'; and 'then to your Lord you will be returned' (32:11, 45:15).

tree:0v0dwnh0g3f441.why: 'Seek forgiveness of your Lord, then repent to Him' four times in Hud: the Prophet, Hud, Salih, Shu'ayb, each with a different promise.
tree:0v0dwnh0g3f441.relation: Every prophet's call: forgiveness and repentance bring blessing.

tree:1kjbtnj1gtuyon.why: 'Then He causes you to die, then gives you life' (2:28, 22:66, 30:40) vs 'He gives you life, then causes you to die, then gathers you' (45:26).

tree:1eb8bjn0rrxd6x.why: 'After the knowledge that has come to you': warnings against following their desires (2:120, 2:145, 13:37) and the challenge of mutual cursing (3:61).
tree:1eb8bjn0rrxd6x.relation: Once knowledge has come, no compromise with desires.

tree:1h93rtm1ns3p8m.why: 'He made for you the night': to rest and the day to see (10:67, 40:61, near-identical), as a garment (25:47), night and day (28:73).

tree:1v6ewk511ac3hl.why: Dhul-Qarnayn's three journeys: 'until he reached the setting of the sun / the rising of the sun / between the two barriers' (18:86, 18:90, 18:93). 46:15 ('until he reached his maturity') is a different subject.
tree:1v6ewk511ac3hl.changes: Removed 46:15: it is about a person reaching maturity, not the journeys.

tree:0oy1pmd1fteb0b.why: 'Abiding therein, and that is ...': the great success (4:13), the reward of the doers of good (5:85), of who purifies himself (20:76), and of the wrongdoers in the Fire (59:17).
tree:0oy1pmd1fteb0b.relation: Contrast: the same eternal abiding in the Garden and in the Fire.

tree:0kptien11hd1gb.why: 'Creator of all things' in four declarations, with the order of 'no god but He' and the tails changing (6:102, 13:16, 39:62, 40:62).

tree:0o7omo003vwgj2.why: 'That is because they said': trade is like usury (2:275), the Fire will touch us only briefly (3:24), no blame toward the gentiles (3:75), we will obey you in part (47:26).

tree:0bzgld31qhgr49.why: 'Evil is what they judge' closing four ayat, with 'truly' only in 16:59; two begin 'or do they think' (29:4, 45:21).

tree:1km0l160139xgy.why: 'Glory be to God above what they describe' (23:91, 37:159) vs 'above what they associate' (52:43, 59:23).

tree:0cpd5st0hm5bx5.why: 8:72 and 8:74 share 'those who believed, emigrated and strove in God's way, and those who gave shelter and help', then differ. 4:76 and 9:34 share only 'God's way, and those'.
tree:0cpd5st0hm5bx5.changes: Removed 4:76 and 9:34: their 'and those' begins unrelated clauses.
tree:0cpd5st0hm5bx5.relation: The emigrants and the helpers: true believers and allies of one another.

tree:1wjc27l0m17k1z.why: Only 'anything; indeed God' is shared, joining the end of one clause to an unrelated closing name in four different ayat.

tree:1j169ps0448m10.why: 'No power to harm or benefit': the idols for you (5:76), the Prophet for himself (10:49), the calf (20:89), the gods for themselves (25:3).
tree:1j169ps0448m10.relation: Nothing worshipped besides God owns harm or benefit.

tree:0dg0h4h1ffy9id.why: 'Perhaps it is near': 17:51 and 27:72 ('say: perhaps ...') about the Hour and the punishment, and 7:185 'perhaps their term has drawn near'. 28:67 ('perhaps he will be among the successful') is a different subject.
tree:0dg0h4h1ffy9id.changes: Removed 28:67: its 'perhaps he will be' is a hope for the repentant, not the nearness of the end.
tree:0dg0h4h1ffy9id.relation: The end may be closer than people think.

tree:0p08pqr1aahysf.why: The three prayers 'give us victory over the disbelieving people' (2:250, 2:286, 3:147) are already a card of their own; 5:68 ('do not grieve over the disbelieving people') is a different subject.

tree:1n6cqdk1hsr636.why: 'Those who believe and do good, those ...': companions of the Garden (2:82), forgiveness and great reward (11:11), forgiveness and noble provision (34:4), best of creatures (98:7).

tree:1nfhfjx06r5uah.why: Disputing about the signs of God, four times in Ghafir: none but disbelievers (40:4), without authority (40:35, 40:56), how are they turned away (40:69).
tree:1nfhfjx06r5uah.relation: Ghafir's recurring theme: arguing against God's signs from pride.

tree:19nmsyt0p8qudf.why: 27:87 and 39:68 describe the Trumpet: all in the heavens and earth terrified / swoon 'except whom God wills'. 11:6 and 11:116 share only 'on earth except'.
tree:19nmsyt0p8qudf.changes: Removed 11:6 and 11:116: their 'except' begins unrelated clauses.

tree:0739w220t1ry1c.why: Only 'on earth, of' is shared, joining four unrelated clauses (no protector, successors, creatures prostrating, trees as pens).

tree:1622pz81yaea92.why: 'On land and sea': God knows all in it (6:59), He makes you travel (10:22), He carries the children of Adam (17:70), and corruption appears in it because of people (30:41).
tree:1622pz81yaea92.relation: God's care over land and sea, and man's corruption of it.

tree:06yt0is15fyisq.why: 'In the Gardens of Bliss' with different lead-ins: those who believe and do good (10:9, 22:56), and alone as a short ayah (37:43, 56:12).

tree:0ix9wab1veitaz.why: 'In gardens and springs': 'the mindful are in' (15:45, 51:15) and alone (26:147 Thamud's worldly gardens, 44:52 the Garden).
tree:0ix9wab1veitaz.relation: Contrast: Thamud's gardens in this world (26:147) and the gardens of the mindful.

tree:00m2h4m1y78ju4.why: 8:75 and 33:6 share 'blood relatives are closer to one another in the decree of God', then different tails. 9:36 and 30:56 use 'in the Book of God' in other senses.
tree:00m2h4m1y78ju4.changes: Removed 9:36 and 30:56: their 'in God's Book' is about the months and the stay in the grave.

tree:00bzyef0qhvz49.why: Two phrases in one card: 'those who do not know said' (2:113, 2:118) and 'those who do not hope to meet Us said' (10:15, 25:21). Each pair is a memorizer's trap, and 2:118 and 25:21 both demand that God speak or angels come.
tree:00bzyef0qhvz49.changes: Split by the two phrases: 'those who do not know' (2:113, 2:118) and 'those who do not hope to meet Us' (10:15, 25:21).

tree:010vj7x0qxxvkx.why: 'Did I not tell you': to the angels (2:33) and Jacob (12:96) with 'to you (plural)'; al-Khidr to Moses twice, without and with 'to you' (18:72, 18:75). A famous trap.

tree:027fllw0ltiqlq.why: 'They said: do not fear': the angels to Abraham (11:70, 51:28), to Lot (29:33), the litigants to David (38:22).

tree:1wmil5z19zla77.why: 'Say: I am only ...': a human like you (18:110, 41:6, same opening, different tails), a warner (38:65), one of the warners (27:92).

tree:09l30nu0iddu0u.why: 'Little do you give thanks' after hearing, sight and hearts (23:78, 32:9, 67:23) and after livelihoods (7:10).
tree:09l30nu0iddu0u.relation: God's gifts to man and his little gratitude.

tree:09i4l951jrbymj.why: 'When it is said to them: come': to what God sent down and to the Messenger (4:61, 5:104, identical start), to fight (3:167), for the Messenger to ask forgiveness for you (63:5).
tree:09i4l951jrbymj.relation: Hypocrites and deniers turning away from the call.

tree:0r1lse305pwzsp.why: 'God is ever, of what they / you do, ...': encompassing (4:108), seeing (33:9, 48:24), aware (48:11).

tree:0k3v1aa0qq2d6e.why: 3:164 and 62:2 are near-identical (a messenger among them who recites, purifies and teaches, though they were before in clear error). 2:89 and 30:49 share only 'they were before'.
tree:0k3v1aa0qq2d6e.changes: Removed 2:89 and 30:49: their 'they were before' starts different sentences.
tree:0k3v1aa0qq2d6e.relation: The Prophet's mission described twice: to the believers and to the unlettered.

tree:095ejw60z1ogu6.why: 'Indeed many of the people are ...': defiantly disobedient (5:49), heedless of Our signs (10:92), disbelievers in the meeting (30:8). 14:36 ('they led many people astray') is a different structure.
tree:095ejw60z1ogu6.changes: Removed 14:36: there 'many of the people' is an object of misleading, not the subject described.

tree:1inr8mf1q8nd39.why: 'Those who disbelieved in the signs of God': severe punishment (3:4), seized for sins (8:52), despair of My mercy (29:23), the losers (39:63).

tree:1t7n5gq00tq5s2.why: 'Which you used to deny': the Fire (32:20), the Day of Decision (37:21), 'go to what you denied' (77:29), 'this is what you denied' (83:17).

tree:0gmhqn60qp6uds.why: 'So how was My reproach' closing four ayat about earlier deniers (22:44, 34:45, 35:26, 67:18).

tree:116aqxt1e21jzh.why: 'I ask you no reward / wealth for it': the Prophet (6:90, 42:23), Noah (11:29, 'wealth'), Hud (11:51). Each with a different tail.

tree:191hd9q15lqa70.why: 'No blame on the two of them' in family rulings: ransom (2:229), remarriage (2:230), weaning (2:233), reconciliation (4:128).

tree:0eytwh81duyvx2.why: 'The Hour, no doubt about it': the cave sleepers as proof (18:21), it is coming (22:7, 40:59), and the deniers' answer (45:32).

tree:0oeeuj40wvg3q2.why: 'God does not love every ...': sinful disbeliever (2:276), treacherous ingrate (22:38), arrogant boaster (31:18, 57:23).

tree:10y46wh1qqkc5t.why: 'Those who do not hope to meet Us': content with this life (10:7), left to wander (10:11), demand another Quran (10:15), demand angels (25:21). Three in Yunus.

tree:0e0wqd513g8dnx.why: 'God does not let the reward of ... be lost': the believers (3:171) vs the doers of good (9:120, 11:115, 12:90).

tree:0r2v7jw06tdpem.why: Two pairs share 'does not avail against': conjecture does not avail against the truth (10:36, 53:28, near-identical), and Hell's shade and food do not avail against flame or hunger (77:31, 88:7).
tree:0r2v7jw06tdpem.changes: Split into the two pairs: conjecture and truth (10:36, 53:28); the punishments that avail nothing (77:31, 88:7).
tree:0r2v7jw06tdpem.relation: Conjecture is as empty against truth as Hell's shade is against fire.

tree:1m6j0bh07wth83.why: 'They are in doubt about it': 11:110 and 41:45 identical about Moses' Book, 42:14 about the heirs of the Book, and 4:157 about killing Jesus.

tree:0mq7yf90e1ju0d.why: 'The meeting of this Day of yours': warned of it (6:130, 39:71, then 'they said') and forgot it (32:14, 45:34).
tree:0mq7yf90e1ju0d.relation: Warned of the Day, they forgot it, and now they are forgotten.

tree:0wlv6170w38mbd.why: 'Thus God makes clear to you the signs, that you may ...': reflect (2:219, 2:266) vs reason (24:61, 57:17 'We have made clear').

tree:0hldxu80yyynma.why: 'He created / subjected for you what is in ...': the earth (2:29, 22:65), the heavens and earth (31:20, 45:13).

tree:1c04ux21k8kvag.why: 'And He has no partner in dominion' (17:111, 25:2, both after 'has not taken a son') and 'and none is equal to Him' (112:4). 4:11 ('if he has no child') is an inheritance ruling.
tree:1c04ux21k8kvag.changes: Removed 4:11: its 'he has no' is about a deceased person's heirs.
tree:1c04ux21k8kvag.relation: God's oneness: no son, no partner, no equal.

tree:06ppa8r1ymune7.why: 'You will never find for him ...': a helper (4:52), a way (4:88, 4:143), a guiding protector (18:17).

tree:0rymilt08ah1qf.why: 'Whoever is guided is guided for himself, whoever strays ...': four tails (10:108, 17:15, 27:92, 39:41).

tree:1ibe2tf0l25cat.why: 'Satan made their deeds fair-seeming to them': and said none can overcome you (8:48), he is their ally (16:63), and barred them from the way (27:24, 29:38).

tree:07unbp711gvsg1.why: 'A painful punishment for them': We have prepared (4:18, 17:10), tidings to the hypocrites (4:138), He has prepared (76:31).

tree:1jizojt0ecnoip.why: 'We sent you only as ...': a bringer of good news and a warner (17:105, 25:56), a mercy to the worlds (21:107), to all people (34:28).
tree:1jizojt0ecnoip.relation: The Prophet's mission in four descriptions.

tree:1q6bknd0r7vh9l.why: 'The life of this world is only ...': enjoyment of delusion (3:185, 57:20), play and amusement (6:32), a passing enjoyment compared to the Hereafter (13:26).

tree:0gagrlk0izsvoi.why: 'And I am not of ...': the guided (6:56), the polytheists (6:79 Abraham, 12:108 the Prophet), those who pretend (38:86).

tree:166u3ii0dj81jo.why: 'You are not over them a guardian' (6:107, 39:41, 42:6) vs 'a tyrant' (50:45).

tree:0m56cqa13zpnkg.why: 'What was sent down to you from your Lord': believed by some of the People of the Book (3:199), to be upheld (5:68), to be followed (7:3, 39:55 'the best of').

tree:0lcu9q708mnx4b.why: 'What was sent down to you and what was sent down before you': the believers (2:4, 4:162), the hypocrites' claim (4:60), and 5:59.

tree:1sop8bv0xes5a5.why: 'After it had become clear to them': the truth (2:109), that they are people of Hell (9:113), the guidance (47:25, 47:32).
tree:1sop8bv0xes5a5.relation: Turning away after clear knowledge is the gravest kind.

tree:0f28nt500i928l.why: 'Whatever you spend of good / anything': it is for yourselves (2:272), God knows it (2:273, 3:92), it will be repaid to you (8:60).

tree:05wwl6h1gzuh75.why: 'They would not believe': even with angels and the dead speaking (6:111), what they denied before (7:101, 10:74 near-identical), and the destroyed generations (10:13).

tree:1qbr7ap0q1myv3.why: 'What they used to earn did not avail them' (15:84, 39:50, 40:82), and 'what they earned covered their hearts' (83:14).

tree:15z0neh1w0dio7.why: The real pair, 23:6 and 70:30, is already another card (as proposed for tree:08048110029s1n); 16:71 uses 'what their right hands possess' about sharing provision, a different subject.

tree:02uy1bu1i76cui.why: 'I only follow what is revealed to me': four replies to the deniers' demands (6:50, 7:203, 10:15, 46:9).

tree:0bkqc26159e5d8.why: 'Their refuge is Hell, and wretched is ...': the resting place (3:197, 13:18) vs the destination (9:73, 66:9, identical ayat).

tree:138bgjs13f86to.why: 'We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us': Hud (7:72, 11:58), Salih (11:66), Shu'ayb (11:94).

tree:0ipbode07nh12q.why: 'The religion of Abraham, upright': 'and he was not of the polytheists' (3:95, 6:161, 16:123) vs 'and God took Abraham as a friend' (4:125).

tree:1w4lp8e1pqek96.why: The rescue from Pharaoh's people is told three times with one changed verb (we saved, we delivered, He delivered you) and one changed verb for the killing of sons. A classic memorizer set. 40:28 uses the same words for the believing man of Pharaoh's family, a different structure.
tree:1w4lp8e1pqek96.changes: Removed 40:28: there the words name the believer from Pharaoh's family, not the rescue.
tree:1w4lp8e1pqek96.relation: The same favour to the Children of Israel, recalled by God (2:49, 7:141) and by Moses (14:6).

tree:0xq5tsl0jn0wvr.why: Two of these ayat show the same scene: the deniers mocking and laughing at the believers in this life (2:212, 83:29), each followed by the reversal on the Last Day. 4:51 (guided more than) and 90:17 (being among the believers) are different structures.
tree:0xq5tsl0jn0wvr.changes: Kept only 2:212 and 83:29, the two ayat about mocking the believers; removed 4:51 and 90:17, where the words have another sense.
tree:0xq5tsl0jn0wvr.relation: Contrast: the deniers laugh at the believers now, and the believers are above them, laughing at them, on the Day of Judgment (2:212 with 83:29-34).

tree:0xqzcqm1qzmaho.why: The shared words are a plain preposition phrase in four unrelated settings: Jesus purified from the deniers, a battle at Uhud, the ratio of fighters, and ransom refused on the Last Day. Nothing to compare or ponder.

tree:0mk9err0caajg1.why: Prayers for rescue from the wrongdoing people, in the mouths of Noah, Moses (twice) and Pharaoh's wife. The memorizer sees the same closing with different forms of the verb; the reader sees the believers' recurring plea.
tree:0mk9err0caajg1.relation: The same plea for deliverance from oppressors, said by prophets and by Pharaoh's believing wife.

tree:1p3ybci10mgyms.why: Each ayah names something as coming from God and then closes with different divine names: a bequest (Knowing, Forbearing), a deterrent punishment (Mighty, Wise), an obligation in zakat (Knowing, Wise), and His pleasure (Seeing). Easy to mix the closings when memorizing.
tree:1p3ybci10mgyms.relation: Each ruling ends with names that fit it: forbearance after inheritance shares, might after the punishment for theft.

tree:1gh68uk0bpxt9s.why: The real pair, the disavowal and the proclamation from God and His Messenger (9:1, 9:3), is its own card. Here it is mixed with 2:279 (war from God) and 9:24 (dearer than God and His Messenger, a comparative), so the group adds nothing new.

tree:1rv70au0lesx6e.why: The name of the Children of Israel joins four unrelated scenes: asking for a king, the curse by David and Jesus, a witness to the Quran, and the disciples. Only the name is shared, not a story or a wording to memorize.

tree:1lqw4z31w0tlgj.why: Before and behind as an image of full protection: angels guarding a person (13:11), falsehood unable to reach the Book (41:42), guards around the Messenger (72:27). 46:21 uses it in time, warners before and after Hud, which a memorizer must still keep apart.
tree:1lqw4z31w0tlgj.relation: God's guarding from every side: of each person, of His Book and of His messengers.

tree:12hpw1t0ylw7bp.why: Three warnings against taking the deniers as allies instead of the believers, each with a different follow-up question. A strong memorizer set. In 33:50 the same words mean exclusively for you, apart from the believers, a different sense.
tree:12hpw1t0ylw7bp.changes: Removed 33:50: there the words mean a permission special to the Prophet, not allies.

tree:1n1w7bh01j9bqv.why: Taking other gods besides Him, answered four ways: why no clear proof (18:15), bring your evidence (21:24), they create nothing (25:3), their intercession is worthless (36:23). Same opening, different replies.
tree:1n1w7bh01j9bqv.relation: Four arguments against the same act of taking gods besides God.

tree:1srpfq71c4cdfp.why: The truth from your Lord, so do not be among the doubters, in three places with small differences (with and without the emphatic ending), and 28:86 where the same lead-in ends with a supporter of the deniers. Classic memorizer traps.
tree:1srpfq71c4cdfp.relation: The Prophet is told twice not to doubt and once not to back the deniers, each after a reminder that the revelation is from his Lord.

tree:0ks93060v7ocl2.why: The refrain in As-Saffat closing the stories of Noah, Abraham, Moses with Aaron, and Ilyas. The memorizer must know which story each closes and where it is in the dual.
tree:0ks93060v7ocl2.relation: Each prophet's story ends with the same praise: he was one of Our believing servants.

tree:112vph21vt3no8.why: Who saves from the painful punishment: answering God's caller (46:31), the trade of faith and striving (61:10), and none can save the deniers (67:28). 22:25 has the same words after to make taste, the opposite sense.
tree:112vph21vt3no8.changes: Removed 22:25: there the punishment is tasted, not escaped.
tree:112vph21vt3no8.relation: The way out of the painful punishment, offered by the jinn, by God, and denied to the deniers.

tree:0zhwxt009tn4p4.why: The deniers have no knowledge of it, they only guess or follow assumption: about the angels (43:20, 53:28) and about death (45:24). Close wording with different endings. 46:4 has the words in a challenge to bring a trace of knowledge, a different structure.
tree:0zhwxt009tn4p4.changes: Removed 46:4: there the words are a challenge, not the verdict on the deniers.
tree:0zhwxt009tn4p4.relation: Belief built on conjecture, not knowledge, in three of the deniers' claims.

tree:1xv1vms197e1zu.why: Seeking the bounty of God as earning a living: after the Friday prayer (62:10) and travellers for trade excused from long night prayer (73:20). 12:38 and 57:29 use the words for God's favour itself, not seeking it.
tree:1xv1vms197e1zu.changes: Kept only 62:10 and 73:20; removed 12:38 and 57:29 where the words have another sense.
tree:1xv1vms197e1zu.relation: Worship and earning a living set side by side in both ayat.

tree:1wd0acw02rwf8q.why: Those who are in error or blindness: blind here and blinder hereafter (17:72), given respite to grow (19:75), beyond the Prophet's power to guide (43:40). 19:29, the child in the cradle, is a different scene.
tree:1wd0acw02rwf8q.changes: Removed 19:29: there the words describe the infant Jesus.
tree:1wd0acw02rwf8q.relation: Three looks at the one who stays in error: his end, his respite, and the limit of the messenger.

tree:1othqzn1fn1i6v.why: Judgment scenes in which God brings out from every nation a witness (4:41, 16:84, 28:75) or a troop of deniers (27:83). Same frame with changed verbs and objects.
tree:1othqzn1fn1i6v.relation: Every nation is called to account with its witness on the Last Day.

tree:09uz3970292pc5.why: Plants of every kind brought out of the earth, as a sign of resurrection, with different adjectives (beautiful in 22:5 and 50:7, noble in 26:7). A neat memorizer set.
tree:09uz3970292pc5.relation: The living earth as evidence of revival.

tree:12x0g85057k2qp.why: We have set forth every kind of example in this Quran, four times with changed verb, changed word order and four different endings. A model memorizer card.
tree:12x0g85057k2qp.relation: Every example has been given, yet most people refuse, argue, or reject.

tree:00bsc6r0liglwn.why: From a far place as an image of the deniers' distance: Hell sees them from afar (25:12), faith is out of reach (34:52), they throw guesses from afar (34:53), they are called from afar (41:44). Shared ending with clear meaning.
tree:00bsc6r0liglwn.relation: Distance from the truth in this life becomes distance from salvation in the next.

tree:0l0izvw1loqpxo.why: Created from one soul, with four continuations (He created its mate, a dwelling and a deposit, He made its mate, then He made its mate). A strong memorizer set on one theme.
tree:0l0izvw1loqpxo.relation: The single origin of humanity and of the pair, as a reason for piety and gratitude.

tree:19yzd90144b760.why: Whoever believes in God: his sins removed and gardens (64:9, 65:11, almost identical), his heart guided (64:11). In 9:99 the same words describe some of the Bedouins, a different structure.
tree:19yzd90144b760.changes: Removed 9:99: there the words describe a group, not a conditional promise.
tree:19yzd90144b760.relation: What faith in God brings: forgiveness, gardens, and a guided heart in hardship.

tree:0bce9en1wuai3j.why: God guides, helps and provides for whom He wills, each closing with a fitting pair of names. Short, similar endings a memorizer can mix up.
tree:0bce9en1wuai3j.relation: Each act of God is sealed with the names that fit it: knowledge after guidance, might after victory, strength after provision.

tree:0uzpyl41xx031e.why: Whoever associates partners with God, with four consequences: a great sin (4:48), far astray (4:116), paradise forbidden (5:72), falling from the sky (22:31). 4:48 and 4:116 differ in one ending, a classic trap.
tree:0uzpyl41xx031e.relation: The gravity of shirk shown four ways.

tree:1hj58g91yjl28b.why: Whom God guides is truly guided, then four different endings for whom He leaves astray. Classic mutashabih with spelling and ending differences.
tree:1hj58g91yjl28b.relation: Guidance and misguidance are in God's hand, said four ways.

tree:1eprgp11kwnd2v.why: We know best what they say, listen to, or describe: God reassuring the Prophet about the deniers' words, four times with changed verbs. 20:104 and 50:45 share the same verb, which a memorizer must place.
tree:1eprgp11kwnd2v.relation: God's knowledge of the deniers' words as comfort for the Prophet.

tree:0tazawf0msj71b.why: The declaration and to Him we submit closes Jacob's sons' answer, two creeds of faith in all the prophets (2:136, 3:84, nearly identical) and the call to the People of the Book. The 2:136 and 3:84 pair differs in small words, a classic trap.
tree:0tazawf0msj71b.relation: One religion of submission, confessed by Jacob's sons and by the believers toward the People of the Book.

tree:15uvwx109msk0l.why: No soul is burdened beyond its capacity, said in the third person (2:286) and in the first person three times, each followed by something else: a prayer, fair measure, the people of paradise, the speaking record.
tree:15uvwx109msk0l.relation: God's mercy in the limits of obligation, set beside different duties.

tree:0jr29pm10rk2fs.why: Thus We detail the signs for a people who know, reflect, or reason, each after a different lesson. The memorizer must match the ending to its ayah (7:32 and 9:11 share one ending).
tree:0jr29pm10rk2fs.relation: Each kind of sign is matched to the faculty it calls on: knowledge, reflection, reason.

tree:18mf2e70yuun45.why: This worldly life described as passing: only play (29:64), only enjoyment (40:39), all Pharaoh can rule over (20:72), and what the deniers spend in it (3:117). Same phrase, contrasted with the lasting hereafter.
tree:18mf2e70yuun45.relation: The smallness of this life against the next, said by God, by the believing man, and by Pharaoh's magicians.

tree:1gooldy0qi9zac.why: And He knows best the rightly guided, closing four ayat; 6:117, 16:125 and 68:7 also share the first half with small differences. A strong memorizer set.
tree:1gooldy0qi9zac.relation: Guidance is God's to know and give, said to the Prophet in different situations.

tree:1vy4tsm0z3u07k.why: Your Lord knows best who strays and who is guided, with the variant who is guided in 53:30 and who is God-fearing in 53:32. Fine differences a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:1vy4tsm0z3u07k.relation: Only God knows who is truly guided or pious, so do not claim purity for yourselves.

tree:01773qt0631mt3.why: He is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful, closing the repentance of Adam, of the calf worshippers, of the givers of charity and of the three who stayed behind. Two openings to keep apart.
tree:01773qt0631mt3.relation: God's acceptance of repentance across the stories of Adam, Israel, and the companions.

tree:06szqsf1lm9dhh.why: He sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to make it prevail, three times with two different endings. 25:48 shares only the opening, for the winds, a different subject.
tree:06szqsf1lm9dhh.changes: Removed 25:48: it shares only the opening and is about the winds.
tree:06szqsf1lm9dhh.relation: The promise that the true religion will prevail, sealed once with God as witness and twice despite the polytheists.

tree:18a7w5e1ncn62m.why: He is the All-Hearing, All-Seeing, after three different openings (indeed He, indeed God, and He). The memorizer must know which form closes which ayah.
tree:18a7w5e1ncn62m.relation: Hearing and seeing set after the Night Journey, true judgment, refuge from the arrogant, and His incomparability.

tree:0bs4xvh0odkut3.why: Those who pray and give zakat, followed by bowing (5:55) or certainty in the hereafter (27:3, 31:4), and the opposite in 41:7: those who do not give zakat and deny the hereafter.
tree:0bs4xvh0odkut3.relation: Contrast: the believers who give and are certain of the hereafter, and the polytheists who withhold and deny it.

tree:1vwj8121ej90b4.why: O people, there has come to you: the Messenger, a proof, an exhortation, the truth. Four calls to all mankind naming what has come from their Lord.
tree:1vwj8121ej90b4.relation: What God has sent to all people, named four ways.

tree:1gcwyv402yuv5s.why: God provides for whom He wills without measure, closing three different scenes (the mockers, Mary's food, the men of the mosques), and with another ending in 42:19.
tree:1gcwyv402yuv5s.relation: Provision without account, for the God-fearing over the mockers, for Mary, and for those who remember God.

tree:1nb9dmu05avgty.why: Two of these share a sharp idea: God only wants to strike those who turn away for some of their sins (5:49), and to punish the hypocrites through their wealth in this life (9:85). 4:28 and 8:7 share only the stock phrase God wants.
tree:1nb9dmu05avgty.changes: Kept 5:49 and 9:85; removed 4:28 and 8:7 where only the stock phrase is shared.
tree:1nb9dmu05avgty.relation: Punishment that comes in this world, through what people turn to.

tree:0pt4wn71i7319x.why: And He increases them from His bounty: full reward plus more, four times with different closings. Often contrasted with the deniers' punishment in the same ayah.
tree:0pt4wn71i7319x.relation: The believers' reward goes beyond their deeds, from God's bounty.

tree:0kz524q1ef93x4.why: The blind and the seeing are not equal, asked as a question (6:50, 13:16) and stated (35:19, 40:58), each followed by a different pair. A strong memorizer and pondering set.
tree:0kz524q1ef93x4.relation: Faith as sight and denial as blindness, set side by side four times.

tree:150etdo1a0q1eq.why: Promises that end and He forgives you, then a different closing name each time: great bounty, forgiving merciful, appreciative forbearing. 8:29 and 57:28 also share the shape of the promise.
tree:150etdo1a0q1eq.relation: Forgiveness promised for piety, sincere captives, faith and generous loans.

tree:1mg4uq20ncb2mm.why: Corruption in the land: two nearly identical ayat (2:27, 13:25) with different fates, and two that pair corruption with not setting right (26:152, 27:48). Memorizer pairs inside one theme.
tree:1mg4uq20ncb2mm.relation: Breaking God's covenant and cutting what should be joined is named corruption, as was the deeds of Thamud's leaders.

tree:05ik0un0g38g5l.why: And the deniers say, three times in Ar-Ra'd (13:7 and 13:27 share their whole request), plus their charge of old tales in 6:25. Different answers to the same objection.
tree:05ik0un0g38g5l.relation: The deniers ask for a sign, and the answer differs each time: you are a warner, God guides whom He wills.

tree:0psyntb0qysot7.why: Or do they say he invented it, with four answers: bring one surah, bring ten surahs, my crime is on me (Noah), you cannot protect me from God. A classic set.
tree:0psyntb0qysot7.relation: The charge of invention answered by the challenge and by the messenger's own accountability.

tree:0j8zjea19zh26o.why: On the Day of Resurrection, then indeed God, with three closings (bounty, witness, knowing). 68:39 shares only the day and indeed, about the deniers' supposed oaths, a different structure.
tree:0j8zjea19zh26o.changes: Removed 68:39: its indeed starts a different clause, not about God.
tree:0j8zjea19zh26o.relation: What God will do on that Day, sealed by what He is.

tree:0zk69xu1bm07oc.why: He will surely gather you to the Day of Resurrection, no doubt in it, three times with different openings and closings. 28:41 shares only the words for the day.
tree:0zk69xu1bm07oc.changes: Removed 28:41: it shares only the words for the day and a negation.
tree:0zk69xu1bm07oc.relation: The certainty of the gathering, said after His oneness, His mercy, and His giving of life and death.

tree:00qiiyv1g4i9vt.why: Fear God, whom..., with three different relative clauses, two of them occurring twice (in whom you believe: 5:88, 60:11; to whom you will be gathered: 5:96, 58:9). A good memorizer set.
tree:00qiiyv1g4i9vt.relation: Each command is anchored in a reason to fear God: kinship, faith, the gathering.

tree:1apht451u3m00f.why: Fear God so that you may succeed, be grateful, or receive mercy, after different commands. The memorizer must match the ending to each.
tree:1apht451u3m00f.relation: Piety tied to its fruit: success, gratitude and mercy.

tree:00smh3o1ggeo9m.why: The alternation of night and day as a sign, in five settings with different companions and audiences (people who reason, people of understanding, the pious). Classic memorizer set.
tree:00smh3o1ggeo9m.relation: One sign named to different audiences who are meant to reflect on it.

tree:1lw4sms0225rp4.why: Be patient over what they say, told to the Prophet four times, each followed by a different remedy: glorify your Lord (20:130, 50:39), remember David (38:17), leave them gracefully (73:10). 31:17 is patience over what befalls you, in Luqman's advice, a different object.
tree:1lw4sms0225rp4.changes: Removed 31:17: there patience is over misfortune, not over what they say.
tree:1lw4sms0225rp4.relation: Patience with the deniers' words, paired each time with worship or a model to follow.

tree:1hx0mq80ln7wha.why: Those are the companions of paradise, they abide in it eternally, after four different descriptions of the believers; 59:20 ends instead with they are the winners. A strong memorizer set.
tree:1hx0mq80ln7wha.relation: Who the people of paradise are: faith and good deeds, excellence, humility before their Lord.

tree:1x3wxew165czgy.why: Worship none but God, in the message of the messengers (11:2, 41:14, 46:21), and worship none but Him as a decree (12:40, 17:23). The noun and pronoun forms are a real memorizer trap.
tree:1x3wxew165czgy.relation: The one message of every messenger, given as a call and as a decree.

tree:1n5uzf415hclk2.why: The deniers' prayer is only in vain (13:14, 40:50, the same words), their plot is only in vain (40:25), and the deniers tell the believers you are only in clear or great error (36:47, 67:9).
tree:1n5uzf415hclk2.relation: Contrast: the deniers' calls and plots are lost, while they accuse the believers of being lost.

tree:1g4vkdz0pi17u9.why: To God belongs what is in the heavens and the earth, and God is ever... with four different closing names. 48:4 and 48:7 repeat the armies of the heavens with a changed ending, a classic trap.
tree:1g4vkdz0pi17u9.relation: God's ownership of all, sealed by His knowledge, wisdom, sufficiency and might.

tree:1k57jea0dboxhs.why: He who created you from one soul, from clay, from weakness, from dust. One opening with different origins, each leading to a different lesson.
tree:1k57jea0dboxhs.relation: Human origins recalled to teach piety, the appointed term, and the stages of life.

tree:0pixdje0fwpkni.why: This is what you used to deny, said to the deniers in the hereafter, with changed endings: deny, hasten, call for. A tight memorizer set.
tree:0pixdje0fwpkni.relation: What the deniers rejected or mocked in this life is shown to them on the Day.

tree:0y996tn0hyg9v9.why: Those who believe in God and His messengers or His Messenger: 24:62 and 49:15 define the true believers with the same opening, 4:152 and 57:19 promise their reward. Singular and plural Messenger is a trap.
tree:0y996tn0hyg9v9.relation: What true faith includes: not dividing the messengers, steadfastness, striving, and staying with the Prophet.

tree:0okt7pf0woizi5.why: Indeed those who believe and those who..., in the three ayat on the Jews, Christians and Sabians (2:62, 5:69, 22:17, with changed order and case) and the emigrants in 2:218. 2:212 has the words in another structure.
tree:0okt7pf0woizi5.changes: Removed 2:212: there the words are not the opening of this formula.
tree:0okt7pf0woizi5.relation: Who is saved and who is judged among the religions on the Last Day.

tree:00oqu571bt6dmx.why: Those who passed away before you or before them: their trials (2:214), their days (10:102), their example (24:34), God's way with them (33:38, 33:62). The pronoun changes are the trap.
tree:00oqu571bt6dmx.relation: God's way with past nations as a lesson for the present one.

tree:0azbbqy0b62zl8.why: Rather, those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension (38:2), in denial (85:19), in doubt about it (22:55). The states of the deniers in the same frame. 3:196 and 48:26 have other structures.
tree:0azbbqy0b62zl8.changes: Kept 22:55, 38:2 and 85:19; removed 3:196 (moving about in the land) and 48:26 (in their hearts) where the words have another sense.
tree:0azbbqy0b62zl8.relation: The inner states that keep the deniers from faith: pride, denial, doubt.

tree:0up8okv03s4z9d.why: Those before you as a reference point: created like you (2:21), fasting prescribed as for them (2:183), their ways shown to you (4:26), enjoying their share (9:69), their news (14:9). 2:21 and 2:183 end the same way, a memorizer pair.
tree:0up8okv03s4z9d.relation: The present community measured against the nations before it, in worship, law and warning.

tree:08furqr1gcqmod.why: Those who spend their wealth: in God's cause, without reminders of favours, seeking God's pleasure, night and day, and to be seen by people. Five continuations to keep apart, ending with the contrast of showing off.
tree:08furqr1gcqmod.relation: Contrast: spending for God and spending to be seen.

tree:123m2o60obyhn4.why: The heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise, closing four ayat with different openings; 6:14 shares the start and then turns to He feeds and is not fed. A memorizer set.
tree:123m2o60obyhn4.relation: Glorification of God by all in the heavens and earth, sealed by His might and wisdom.

tree:08y79hd1kgs6kv.why: He subjected the sun and the moon, each running for or to an appointed term, or swimming in an orbit. Classic preposition differences in five places.
tree:08y79hd1kgs6kv.relation: The ordered course of the sun and moon as a sign of the Creator.

tree:0ztilos0g56rb8.why: The people who denied Our signs: as a parable (7:176, 7:177), in Noah's rescue (21:77), Moses' mission (25:36), and the parable of the donkey with God's signs (62:5). Close wording with different roles.
tree:0ztilos0g56rb8.relation: The deniers of signs as an evil example and as a people destroyed.

tree:01nj2t51rcumud.why: God is my Lord and your Lord, said by Jesus (3:51, 19:36 nearly identical, 5:72, 5:117) and by Hud (11:56). Jesus' own words refute the claim of his divinity.
tree:01nj2t51rcumud.relation: Jesus' repeated statement that God is his Lord too, set against those who deified him.

tree:1xgc9sp0ncptqb.why: Remember God's favour upon you when..., five times with five different events. The memorizer must link each favour to its ayah.
tree:1xgc9sp0ncptqb.relation: The habit of remembering specific favours: brotherhood, protection, prophets, rescue, victory.

tree:18jju7c0yp278i.why: God knows what they do is a stock closing here after five unrelated scenes (conjecture, Joseph's sale, the deniers' death, glorification by birds, the one pleased with his evil). The verb changes alone do not make a useful card.

tree:1xzk4860g02akq.why: The Ma'ida trio on not judging by what God revealed (deniers, wrongdoers, defiant), plus 2:229 with the same wrongdoers ending for transgressing God's limits and 30:39 with a positive ending. A famous memorizer set.
tree:1xzk4860g02akq.relation: Ruling by God's revelation and keeping His limits, with the names given to those who do not.

tree:0vac6lz1xvv7xn.why: And sufficient is God as..., with three closings: Knower, Guardian, Accountant. 4:81, 33:3 and 33:48 share the whole phrase on relying on God.
tree:0vac6lz1xvv7xn.relation: Trust in God, and God as enough for the one who relies on Him.

tree:0pqkyua17s0leo.why: God loves the doers of good, closing five ayat on spending, forgiving, steadfastness, pardon and piety. Indeed God or and God is the trap.
tree:0pqkyua17s0leo.relation: The many deeds that God names excellence.

tree:0uzyuhw1gnsl4k.why: God guides whom He wills, with three openings (and God, but God, and that God) and one changed verb in 22:16. A real memorizer set.
tree:0uzyuhw1gnsl4k.relation: Guidance belongs to God, not to the Prophet.

tree:1abxhwq1x08s2c.why: He merges the night into the day and the day into the night, five times, each followed by something different. A classic set.
tree:1abxhwq1x08s2c.relation: The turning of night and day as proof of God's power and knowledge.

tree:1vsldpx0awam9z.why: Until the day they are raised: Iblis asks for respite until then (7:14, 15:36, 38:79 with small differences), the dead wait behind a barrier until then (23:100), Jonah would have stayed in the fish until then (37:144).
tree:1vsldpx0awam9z.relation: One horizon, the Day of Resurrection: respite for Iblis, waiting for the dead, and the prison Jonah was saved from.

tree:11kt17i1nvtmz4.why: The same five ayat on merging night into day already form card tree:1abxhwq1x08s2c. One copy is enough.

tree:02yoltc179lmes.why: Worship God, the core of the messengers' call, each time followed by something different: my Lord and your Lord (Jesus), avoid false gods, you have no god but Him, they split into two parties (Salih), fear Him and obey me (Noah).
tree:02yoltc179lmes.relation: One call carried by every messenger, and the different responses it met.

tree:1u3p9b00tkc18k.why: Indeed many of the people are..., with three endings (defiant, heedless of Our signs, deniers of the meeting with their Lord), and the same opening for the rabbis and monks and for partners in business. A real memorizer set.
tree:1u3p9b00tkc18k.relation: Most people stray, in law, in heeding signs, and in belief in the meeting with God.

tree:1tm8gas1133c2m.why: Indeed this is truly..., five times with five different predicates: the true story, the clear favour, the great triumph, the clear trial, the certain truth. Short and easy to mix.
tree:1tm8gas1133c2m.relation: Different realities each sealed with emphatic certainty.

tree:0rr162j0ytaxql.why: The deniers' claim that there is only this life or only our first death, and no raising (6:29, 23:37, 44:35). 7:155 (Moses: it is only Your trial) and 53:23 (only names you have named) are different subjects.
tree:0rr162j0ytaxql.changes: Kept 6:29, 23:37 and 44:35; removed 7:155 and 53:23 where the words carry other subjects.
tree:0rr162j0ytaxql.relation: Denial of resurrection, voiced by Quraysh, by a past nation, and by the deniers in Ad-Dukhan.

tree:0r29btv0ngt9tt.why: You are the Mighty, the Wise, closing prayers of Abraham, Jesus, the angels and Abraham's followers; and in 44:49 the denier is mocked: taste, you are the mighty, the noble.
tree:0r29btv0ngt9tt.relation: Contrast: the believers call God mighty and wise in prayer; the arrogant denier is told in scorn that he was the mighty one.

tree:1pqtptx09faq5p.why: They were a people blind (Noah's people) or defiant (Pharaoh's people, three times, and Noah's people in 51:46). The memorizer must know which nation gets which word.
tree:1pqtptx09faq5p.relation: The verdict on destroyed nations, named in one sentence.

tree:1qmff9o0e6x3pu.why: Those given the Scripture before you: their harm to the believers, the same command to them and you, their mockery, and the warning not to be like them in hardness of heart (with before, without you, in 57:16).
tree:1qmff9o0e6x3pu.relation: The People of the Book as a mirror: same command, and a warning not to repeat their hardness.

tree:1r9elcv1a3eacb.why: Four of its five ayat (2:82, 7:42, 10:26, 11:23) are already card tree:1hx0mq80ln7wha on the same closing. Only 46:14 is new, which does not need its own card.

tree:0rrzmm20vde0u6.why: Two of these say the same thing in the same words: whoever turns away or disbelieves after that, those are the defiant (3:82 after the covenant of the prophets, 24:55 after the promise of succession). The others share only the stock closing.
tree:0rrzmm20vde0u6.changes: Kept 3:82 and 24:55; removed 5:47, 24:4 and 59:19, which share only the closing.
tree:0rrzmm20vde0u6.relation: Turning away after a binding covenant or a great promise is named defiance.

tree:0tfmlr20cj35qs.why: Some of them are allies of others, said of the Jews and Christians, the emigrants and helpers, the deniers, the believing men and women, and the wrongdoers. The same phrase for both camps.
tree:0tfmlr20cj35qs.relation: Contrast: alliance among believers built on faith and good deeds, and alliance among deniers and wrongdoers.

tree:0gdveen1udgcf7.why: Rather, you are a people..., in the stories of Lot (excessive, transgressing, ignorant), Salih (being tested) and the town's messengers (excessive). The ending changes with each story.
tree:0gdveen1udgcf7.relation: Each people's sin named in one word by its prophet.

tree:1ffv1xy14fg6yu.why: In what was revealed to you and what was revealed before you: the believers (2:4, 4:162), the false claim of the hypocrites (4:60). 4:166 and 13:36 use the same words for God's testimony and the rejoicing of the People of the Book.
tree:1ffv1xy14fg6yu.relation: Contrast: true faith in all revelation, a false claim of it, and God's own testimony to it.

tree:1r2cxf400n4yjm.why: Two of these share a real trap in one surah: if you do good and fear God, or if you distort and turn away, indeed God is ever Aware of what you do (4:128, 4:135), both about being fair. The others share only the stock closing.
tree:1r2cxf400n4yjm.changes: Kept 4:128 and 4:135; removed 4:94, 33:2 and 48:11, which share only the closing.
tree:1r2cxf400n4yjm.relation: Fairness between spouses and in testimony, both under God's awareness.

tree:1w4d6gy1ubiq3s.why: Punishment because they were defiant: a plague from the sky on the Israelites (2:59) and on Lot's town (29:34) in the same words, the Sabbath-breakers tested and seized (7:163, 7:165), and the deniers touched by punishment (6:49).
tree:1w4d6gy1ubiq3s.relation: Defiance as the stated cause of punishment in several stories.

tree:0swkvkx1ee7y7v.why: Taste the punishment for what you used to deny, said on the Day to the black-faced (3:106), to those stood before their Lord (6:30, 46:34 nearly identical), to Quraysh at the House (8:35), and burn in it today (36:64).
tree:0swkvkx1ee7y7v.relation: The deniers' own denial named as the cause of their punishment.

tree:1c3xnaf0nvob91.why: That is God's guidance, He guides with it whom He wills (6:88, 39:23), and He strikes with rain or good whom He wills (10:107, 24:43, 30:48). Two sub-pairs with the same frame.
tree:1c3xnaf0nvob91.relation: Guidance and rain both fall on whom God wills, a parallel worth pondering.

tree:0o8867f06vdzct.why: Their refuge is Hell, and evil is the destination: 9:73 and 66:9 are identical, 3:162 and 8:16 share returning with God's wrath, 67:6 a shorter form. Classic set.
tree:0o8867f06vdzct.relation: The end of hypocrites, deserters and deniers, in one closing.

tree:1q5rkoe1gmyole.why: Satan made their deeds seem good to them, with what follows changing: hardened hearts, the betrayal at Badr, past nations, Sheba, Ad and Thamud. 27:24 and 29:38 share a longer tail.
tree:1q5rkoe1gmyole.relation: Satan's adornment of deeds as the common root of many nations' ruin.

tree:0kt30yp1ay958v.why: Four of its five ayat (13:2, 31:29, 35:13, 39:5) already make card tree:08y79hd1kgs6kv on the sun and moon. 29:61 alone does not justify a second card.

tree:10ydlux1askjwn.why: Except God's chosen servants, the refrain in As-Saffat, and once in the deniers' mouth: we would have been God's chosen servants (37:169).
tree:10ydlux1askjwn.relation: Contrast: God's sincere servants are excepted from punishment; the deniers claim they would have been among them.

tree:1gcs4c30qk5zv1.why: And upon their Lord they rely, closing descriptions of the believers after different traits (faith increased, patience, faith). 16:42 and 29:59 are identical.
tree:1gcs4c30qk5zv1.relation: Reliance on God paired with patience and faith.

tree:0kksuvi1s4d694.why: What is with God is better: than magic (2:103), than this world (28:60, 42:36 with different endings), than trade and amusement (62:11).
tree:0kksuvi1s4d694.relation: Every worldly gain set against what is with God.

tree:0kus4620tcuqy0.why: Say: the signs are only with God, and what will make you perceive (6:109); say: its knowledge is only with God, and what will make you know (33:63). A tight pair. The others share only the words with God.
tree:0kus4620tcuqy0.changes: Kept 6:109 and 33:63; removed 3:78, 3:198 and 30:39 where the words are in other structures.
tree:0kus4620tcuqy0.relation: The signs and the Hour are in God's knowledge, not the Prophet's.

tree:08gxjph0zf6vad.why: Disgrace in this world and a great punishment in the hereafter, for those who block the mosques, wage war on God, and race to disbelief (2:114, 5:33, 5:41), and with the fire for the exiled tribe (59:3). 57:20 shares the words in a different structure.
tree:08gxjph0zf6vad.changes: Removed 57:20: there the words describe the hereafter in a list, not a sentence on a group.
tree:08gxjph0zf6vad.relation: Two punishments, here and hereafter, for the same kinds of hostility to God.

tree:0j6jp6x0lsv07l.why: Two different phrases are mixed here. One: he has no share in the hereafter (2:102, 2:200 with share as one noun, 42:20 with another). Two: and in the hereafter he is among the losers (3:85, 5:5). Each is a good memorizer group on its own.
tree:0j6jp6x0lsv07l.changes: Split into two cards: no share in the hereafter (2:102, 2:200, 42:20) and among the losers in the hereafter (3:85, 5:5).
tree:0j6jp6x0lsv07l.relation: Choosing this world or rejecting faith leaves a person with nothing in the hereafter.

tree:06qp4yw0ashn1m.why: Wandering blindly in their transgression, after four different verbs (He extends them, We leave them, He leaves them, they would persist). A classic memorizer set.
tree:06qp4yw0ashn1m.relation: The deniers left in their transgression as a result of their own refusal.

tree:1l9ojfp1ie2a47.why: Except in a clear record, closing descriptions of God's complete knowledge: the falling leaf, the atom's weight (10:61, 34:3 nearly identical), every creature's dwelling, every hidden thing.
tree:1l9ojfp1ie2a47.relation: Nothing in creation escapes God's knowledge and record.

tree:1hzz8uq067ny3c.why: Four of its five ayat (17:89, 18:54, 30:58, 39:27) already make card tree:12x0g85057k2qp on every kind of example. Only 17:41 is new; it could be added to that card instead.

tree:1asmb2k199qe9a.why: In this world: good for those who do good (7:156, 16:30, 39:10) and a curse that follows Ad and Pharaoh's people (11:60, 28:42, also into the Day of Resurrection).
tree:1asmb2k199qe9a.relation: Contrast: the doers of good receive good in this world, the deniers are pursued by a curse in this world and the next.

tree:0ze045n0rdq417.why: How many generations We destroyed before them, five times with five lessons: they were stronger, richer, now silent, cried out too late, searched for escape.
tree:0ze045n0rdq417.relation: The fate of past generations as a warning to Quraysh.

tree:0fh0w990455qkb.why: The people of Noah, Ad and Thamud, listed as nations that denied, with the list changing (38:12 puts Pharaoh in place of Thamud). A memorizer trap.
tree:0fh0w990455qkb.relation: The chain of destroyed nations recalled to the Prophet and to Quraysh.

tree:0sbn0jp00m85d9.why: Indeed God is ever Forgiving, Merciful is a stock closing here after unrelated subjects: marriage law, asking forgiveness, fairness among wives, the Quran's revelation, the hypocrites. The particle differences alone do not make a useful card.

tree:0k6548e1db82hg.why: Thus We detail the signs, followed by a people who know, reflect, reason, or by a purpose clause (that the way of the criminals be clear, that they may return). The two short purpose forms (6:55, 7:174) are the trap.
tree:0k6548e1db82hg.relation: Why the signs are detailed: to expose the criminals, to bring people back, and for those who think.

tree:0zq98f300jqph5.why: And sufficient is God as Guardian, after two lead-ins: rely on God (4:81, 33:3, 33:48) and to Him belongs all in the heavens and earth (4:132, 4:171). A memorizer set on which lead-in comes where.
tree:0zq98f300jqph5.relation: God is enough as guardian because all things are His.

tree:0t4pehb070vixn.why: Every thing, and He..., after creating, owning or giving speech to every thing: He knows all, He is the One, He protects, He is Guardian, He created you. Similar frames with different endings.
tree:0t4pehb070vixn.relation: God's sovereignty over everything, sealed with a different attribute each time.

tree:0s3pqbi0fpu06y.why: Every soul for what it earned or strives: God watches over it, it will be repaid, it is held in pledge. Changed verbs and frames in five places.
tree:0s3pqbi0fpu06y.relation: Each soul answers for its own deeds.

tree:0owfycn10bf297.why: How many We destroyed: generations before them, generations after Noah, a town ungrateful for its living. The noun after the verb changes in each place.
tree:0owfycn10bf297.relation: Destroyed nations whose homes still stand as a lesson.

tree:0omr7bt0ptd3cr.why: Concerning what you used to differ in, after God judges or informs on the Day: five places with judge, inform, make clear. A clear memorizer set.
tree:0omr7bt0ptd3cr.relation: Human disagreement will be settled by God on the Day of Resurrection.

tree:07wvm1i180f052.why: Nor will they be reprieved: 2:162 and 3:88 are identical, 16:85 is close, and 21:40 and 32:29 use it for the sudden Hour and the day of victory.
tree:07wvm1i180f052.relation: No delay once the punishment or the Hour arrives.

tree:1un3deg0n0s5ii.why: The punishment will not be lightened for them, ending with nor helped (2:86) or nor reprieved (2:162, 3:88, 16:85), and in 35:36 nor will it be lightened from its punishment. The endings are the trap.
tree:1un3deg0n0s5ii.relation: The unchanging punishment of the deniers.

tree:1w0zsl3012qmzj.why: In clear error: before the Messenger came (3:164, 62:2 nearly identical), Joseph's brothers about their father, the idolaters' confession in Hell, the man of the town. A good memorizer set.
tree:1w0zsl3012qmzj.relation: Clear error before guidance, confessed by the lost in the hereafter.

tree:161sjrs00hfb08.why: It would have been better for them, after five conditions (if the People of the Book believed, said we hear and obey, did what they were told, were true to God, waited patiently), with different continuations.
tree:161sjrs00hfb08.relation: The good that people miss when they do not obey.

tree:0dnbwq31b7xkd3.why: A humiliating punishment for those who mock God's signs (31:6, 45:9 with the same phrase), deny, swear false oaths, or are given respite. The humiliation matches arrogance and mockery.
tree:0dnbwq31b7xkd3.relation: A punishment of humiliation for those who held God's signs in contempt.

tree:0gj2prf11rkrzj.why: For them is forgiveness and a reward great or large: which ayah has which word is a known trap, after five descriptions of the believers.
tree:0gj2prf11rkrzj.relation: Who earns forgiveness and great reward: good deeds, patience, reverence, fear of God unseen.

tree:1c4ci960kge5jk.why: The useful slips (no protector from God, in two words) are in the smaller card. Here they are mixed with God's great bounty for believers (33:47) and what appears to the wrongdoers (39:47), which share only the words from God.

tree:1fjz0r007wg4x2.why: What they used to earn or enjoy did not avail them: 15:84, 39:50 and 40:82 end the same, 26:207 and 46:26 change the subject. A good memorizer set.
tree:1fjz0r007wg4x2.relation: Wealth, strength and senses are no help against God's punishment.

tree:1wkrgkk1k6ty9a.why: You cannot escape, ending the ayah (6:134, 10:53, 11:33) or followed by in the earth (29:22, 42:31 nearly identical). Clear memorizer set.
tree:1wkrgkk1k6ty9a.relation: No escape from God's promise, in earth or heaven.

tree:12w6pue0pvw43q.why: Except what God wills, in the Prophet's limits: no power to benefit or harm himself (7:188, 10:49, word order swapped) and he will not forget (87:7). 6:128 is an exception about Hell, and 18:39 is an exclamation, not an exception.
tree:12w6pue0pvw43q.changes: Kept 7:188, 10:49 and 87:7; removed 6:128 (another subject) and 18:39 (a different structure).
tree:12w6pue0pvw43q.relation: Even the Prophet has no power or memory except by God's will.

tree:16hx3xm0ni6vpw.why: What is with God is better or lasting: for the righteous, against what you have, which runs out, against worldly enjoyment, against trade. 16:96 adds the clear contrast of lasting and running out.
tree:16hx3xm0ni6vpw.relation: Contrast: what people hold runs out, what is with God remains.

tree:1vca0xi1js8lce.why: The same mocking objection of the deniers: that the reminder was sent down to this man. 15:6 says it as a taunt of madness, 38:8 as a jealous question, which a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:1vca0xi1js8lce.relation: The same objection from Quraysh in two surahs, once as mockery and once as envy.

tree:0ef85u308qv6sf.why: A rare clause, whoever disbelieves bears his own disbelief, then two different continuations: 30:44 turns to those who do good, 35:39 says disbelief only adds to the deniers' loss. A clear memorizer pair.
tree:0ef85u308qv6sf.relation: Each person carries his own disbelief; one surah sets the doers of good beside it, the other the growing loss of the deniers.

tree:0gv6sax0y1wml9.why: The shared words are a different structure: in 9:128 the Prophet is grieved by what burdens you, in 24:54 he bears only what he was charged with. Different subjects, nothing to learn together.

tree:1ocsqn00e42w6e.why: Only a pronoun and a negation meet by accident: patience with prayer in 20:132, the natural disposition in 30:30. No shared phrase or theme.

tree:14bof9z1h4dx1d.why: Two unrelated uses: the disciples wish to be witnesses to the table in 5:113, and no creature would be left on earth in 16:61. Nothing in common.

tree:0g9xitx07etq17.why: A rare expression, the life grew long for them, used both times of past generations whom time made heedless. 21:44 has one verb form, 28:45 the stronger form, an easy slip.
tree:0g9xitx07etq17.relation: Long life and long time made earlier generations forget; both ayat explain heedlessness by the passing of time.

tree:0fp6tbf05dyv3t.why: In 4:91 authority is given to the believers over hostile people; in 30:35 it is a denied proof sent down to idolaters. Different subjects and meanings.

tree:0d69lfc1hypz7o.why: Both ayat are about Jesus as a witness over his people: 4:159 on the Day of Resurrection, 5:117 in his own words while he lived among them. The row for 4:159 reads on into 4:160, which has nothing to do with the match.
tree:0d69lfc1hypz7o.relation: Jesus as witness over the People of the Book, foretold in one surah and spoken by him in the other.

tree:1th2bfo0jxfpli.why: Two kinds of deniers, the apostate and those who dispute about God after He was answered, receive the same sentence of anger and punishment, ending in different adjectives. Good for memorizers and for pondering.
tree:1th2bfo0jxfpli.relation: Apostasy and false dispute about God earn the same wrath.

tree:16mfehy1bxce24.why: Both end on the question of who is a guardian over people: no one will plead for traitors before God (4:109), and the Prophet was not sent as their guardian (17:54). A memorizer ending pair; both rows read on into the next ayah only because of the run-on.

tree:0cpxc8l1ccw5y5.why: Only a pronoun and a conjunction meet: regrets of the followers in the Fire (2:167) and God guarding the idolaters (42:6). Different subjects.

tree:051gq051p6qz2t.why: Two separate rulings in one surah, waiting period after divorce and the outer garment, joined only by a preposition. Nothing to learn together.

tree:1ya3k0t1j3r22f.why: A stock phrase about what they say: a threat to the Trinitarians in 5:73 and a glorification formula in 17:43. Different frames, no slip and no shared theme.

tree:0jldeh40tfff7w.why: Two peoples accuse their messenger of turning them from their gods: Quraysh in 25:42 and the people of Hud in 46:22. The same complaint recurs across generations.
tree:0jldeh40tfff7w.relation: Different peoples answer their prophets with the same complaint about their gods.

tree:17su1jj0vpgiln.why: A rare paired expression, from the right and from the left, used of the recording angels in 50:17 and of the deniers crowding around the Prophet in 70:37. Easy to confuse in recitation.
tree:17su1jj0vpgiln.relation: The same words describe the angels sitting to record and the deniers sitting in groups around the Prophet.

tree:0x4vgco1dz1rco.why: A rare phrase about desire: the Prophet does not speak from desire (53:3), and the one who fears his Lord holds his soul back from desire (79:40). Worth pondering together. Both rows read on into the next ayah, which completes each thought.
tree:0x4vgco1dz1rco.relation: Freedom from desire: the Prophet is free of it, and the believer earns paradise by restraining it.

tree:02di7xe1uevs18.why: A preposition and a noun meet by chance: a warning about being lured from part of the revelation (5:49) and the Prophet passing over part of a secret (66:3). Unrelated.

tree:1fgljac15oxik8.why: A rare phrase, by mutual consent, governs two dealings: weaning by both parents (2:233) and trade between believers (4:29). The pronoun differs, an easy slip.
tree:1fgljac15oxik8.relation: Mutual consent as the condition of lawful dealings, in family matters and in trade.

tree:0rsbqfh083xz39.why: Both describe the one who turned away from God's remembrance and wants only this world, and the Prophet is told how to treat him. Same theme, wording close enough to confuse.
tree:0rsbqfh083xz39.relation: Heedlessness of God's remembrance goes with wanting the life of this world.

tree:0c9gzqr1m0kzl3.why: Both are about turning from God's remembrance and the blindness that follows: eyes veiled from it in this life (18:101), raised blind on the Day of Resurrection (20:124). A real theme for pondering.
tree:0c9gzqr1m0kzl3.relation: Blindness to God's remembrance in this world becomes blindness on the Day of Resurrection.

tree:1b5etzb0ur2xr7.why: Different structures: God turns the hail away from whom He wills (24:43), and the Prophet turns away from whoever turned away (53:29). Nothing shared in meaning.

tree:0tamjur1gss223.why: Both challenge idolaters to produce evidence for their claims about God, once knowledge (6:148), once authority (10:68). Same argument, the noun differs.
tree:0tamjur1gss223.relation: The deniers are asked for proof and have none, whether they speak of God's will or of a son.

tree:0toylqb0owmi89.why: Intercession with God only by His permission, in the Throne verse and in 34:23, both ending with two of His names. Same doctrine, slightly different wording.
tree:0toylqb0owmi89.relation: No one intercedes with God except by His leave.

tree:0i6fi311ureyff.why: Hiding a testimony one holds from God (2:140) and no favour owed to anyone (92:19) share only a preposition. Unrelated.

tree:0dc1frz0mhozdj.why: False gods cannot remove harm from you (17:56) and God is free of need of you (39:7): the shared words are a different structure, subjects differ.

tree:1vy4z9r0p1slif.why: The same clause, his wealth will not avail him, said of the miser in 92:11 and of Abu Lahab in 111:2, once as a future question and once as a past fact.
tree:1vy4z9r0p1slif.relation: Wealth cannot save the one who denies, whether a type of person or a named enemy.

tree:11z5kvw0n9e804.why: Only a turning away and a saying meet: believers turning from idle talk (28:55) and deniers turning from the Prophet (44:14). A stock frame, different subjects.

tree:1fcpy201vsb862.why: Yaqub's precaution could not avail his sons (12:68) and the punishment of Hell is not lightened (35:36). The shared words are only a pronoun and a preposition.

tree:1rrxw8e0vz5c2c.why: Pleading for someone on the Day of Resurrection (4:109) and turning away from deniers (54:6): the shared words are a different structure each time.

tree:05cm8ra07cfsqm.why: What was hidden from Adam and his wife (7:20) and two prophets unable to avail their wives (66:10): a pronoun and a preposition, nothing more.

tree:0tq8rfg0jhhyf0.why: A rare phrase, We made a covenant with, opens God's charge to Ibrahim and to Adam. Ibrahim and Ismail were charged to purify the House; Adam forgot and had no resolve.
tree:0tq8rfg0jhhyf0.relation: Two covenants: one kept by Ibrahim and Ismail, one forgotten by Adam.

tree:1l9e3x41rwmi26.why: Same surah, same battle: the hypocrites had pledged to God not to turn their backs (33:15), while true believers kept what they pledged (33:23).
tree:1l9e3x41rwmi26.relation: Contrast: those who broke their pledge to God and those who were true to it.

tree:1q7fhzf0443atp.why: Both close a promise of increased reward to believers with the same pair of names, Forgiving and Appreciative, in two neighbouring surahs: one with a pronoun, one with God's name. A memorizer pair. Both rows read on into the next ayah, which adds nothing to the match.
tree:1q7fhzf0443atp.relation: God gives more than the deed deserves, which is why He is called Forgiving and Appreciative.

tree:0s108f815f9rg8.why: Two unrelated rulings, those excused by disability from fighting (4:95) and male attendants without desire (24:31), sharing a two-word particle phrase. Different subjects, little slip risk.

tree:1b8x9t50hgm089.why: The hoopoe stayed not long (27:22) and Paradise is brought near, not far (50:31). The same adverb, unrelated scenes.

tree:1xuaxd80t3ry5i.why: A barren valley at the House (14:37) and a Quran without crookedness (39:28) share only a negating construction. Different subjects, nothing to ponder together.

tree:0sbbufp1yad683.why: Al-Fath twice promises a near victory: as reward for the pledge under the tree (48:18) and as what came before the fulfilled dream (48:27). Same ending in one surah, easy to confuse. The run-on rows add the next ayah, which the match does not need.
tree:0sbbufp1yad683.relation: The pledge and the dream both lead to the same near victory.

tree:0olgmwu1qj2rg2.why: Deniers rejoice in what they have, the blessings opened to them (6:44) or their own knowledge (40:83), and then the punishment seizes them. Same pattern of false security.
tree:0olgmwu1qj2rg2.relation: Rejoicing in what one has, instead of in the message, comes just before the seizing.

tree:0w0y6uo0zsnpfs.why: People rejoice in a good wind or a mercy, then fall into panic or despair when it changes (10:22, 30:36). Same picture of human fickleness.
tree:0w0y6uo0zsnpfs.relation: Joy in a passing mercy turns to fear or despair the moment it is taken.

tree:13362fs0z20n8a.why: Both reassure the Prophet about a household matter in which God has given him room: his marriage that God ordained (33:38) and the release from his oath (66:2).
tree:13362fs0z20n8a.relation: What God has allowed for the Prophet is no fault, and he should not deny himself it.

tree:1kr3zw01p6hkoe.why: Pharaoh sends heralds to the cities (26:53) and calls out to his people about his kingdom (43:51): different moments and verbs, only his name and a preposition shared.

tree:1xowucf08kyv3j.why: The destruction of what Pharaoh and his people built (7:137) and the signs sent to them (27:12): only the name of the people is shared, not a phrase or a point.

tree:05capuk1c3hojo.why: Pharaoh's command was not right-guided (11:97) and Pharaoh's question about the Lord of the worlds (26:23): the conjunction is a different structure each time.

tree:1a42d9o08lc1v4.why: A party of the People of the Book who threw away the Book (2:101) and a party of God's servants who prayed (23:109): the same generic noun, opposite subjects without a shared point.

tree:0a0oi8m1mpydxa.why: A rare phrase, a party you kill, used of the Israelites who killed prophets (2:87) and of the believers' victory over the People of the Book at the Trench (33:26). Easy to confuse. The row for 2:87 reads on into 2:88, which the match does not need.
tree:0a0oi8m1mpydxa.relation: Those who once killed a party of the prophets later saw a party of their own killed.

tree:10mufh41j92yk0.why: In one surah: its ayat are set out clearly as an Arabic Quran (41:3), and had it been foreign they would have asked why its ayat were not set out (41:44). The second answers the first.
tree:10mufh41j92yk0.relation: The Arabic Quran with clear ayat, and the excuse the deniers would have made without it.

tree:114kr6b0kdi7v1.why: God's favour over others: over all the worlds for the prophets in 6:86, and over many believers for Dawud and Sulayman in 27:15, who thank God for it. A memorizer pair.
tree:114kr6b0kdi7v1.relation: Favour is given to prophets; Dawud and Sulayman answer it with praise.

tree:08nank912nxtwt.why: Arguing about Ibrahim (3:65) and the good example in Ibrahim (60:4) share only his name after a preposition. Different subjects and frames.

tree:15tswn11mtz8wh.why: Among the people of the Garden (46:16) and among the people of the Blaze (67:10): a generic phrase with different subjects, not a real contrast between the two ayat.

tree:01p31yk1r2gv74.why: Iron collars on the deniers' necks, in this life as a picture of their blindness (36:8) and in the Fire as they are dragged (40:71). Same image, different word order.
tree:01p31yk1r2gv74.relation: The collars that keep the deniers from seeing the truth are the collars of their punishment.

tree:0u83mt80dgc6om.why: In one surah, the deniers object that the messenger eats food and walks in the markets (25:7), and God answers that every messenger before him did the same (25:20).
tree:0u83mt80dgc6om.relation: Objection and answer in the same words.

tree:0o75cwa1ntrezk.why: People of the Book who think they owe nothing to the unlettered (3:75) and the messenger raised among the unlettered (62:2) share a rare word but no point or subject.

tree:0lcow1c1nz7nxm.why: Neighbouring hajj rulings, fasting during hajj and no dispute during hajj, sharing only the word for hajj. Not a mutashabih and not a relation.

tree:16lbdol0t108ub.why: Freeing slaves appears in two lists of where wealth goes: righteousness (2:177) and the recipients of charity (9:60). Two long lists a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:16lbdol0t108ub.relation: The ransoming of slaves is part of both voluntary righteousness and obligatory charity.

tree:191cufb14zwvhj.why: Al-Qamar ends two ayat in the scriptures: the deniers have no exemption written there (54:43), and all they did is written there (54:52). The runs read on, and 54:53 completes the second.
tree:191cufb14zwvhj.relation: No exemption is written for the deniers, but every deed of theirs is.

tree:0vrzkac1k3jfm0.why: The hypocrites find fault in the matter of charity: with the Prophet's share-out (9:58) and with poor believers who give their little (9:79). Same surah, same theme.
tree:0vrzkac1k3jfm0.relation: Faultfinding about charity marks the hypocrites, whoever is the target.

tree:1jgj40f00x565f.why: Mentioning God alone in the Quran (17:46) and the cursed tree in the Quran (17:60) share only the word. Different subjects.

tree:0as57pk0pfe6ja.why: Walking among people with light (6:122) and the call to hajj among people (22:27): only a preposition and a noun.

tree:1hqzddg031cbew.why: Musa asks for a partner in his task (20:32) and the queen asks for counsel in her affair (27:32): different stories, only a common noun with a pronoun.

tree:01aximg1ahcp0a.why: People surging into one another (18:99) and obeying in part of the matter (47:26): unrelated.

tree:1y4cugs09icyae.why: What you store in your houses (3:49) and had you stayed in your houses (3:154): different stories, the shared words carry no point.

tree:029hvbs1m8q8gc.why: Two consecutive commands to the Prophet's wives about their houses: stay in them, and remember what is recited in them. A memorizer pair that also shows the house as a place of revelation.
tree:029hvbs1m8q8gc.relation: The wives' homes are where they stay and where revelation is recited.

tree:12vvrmb04khvep.why: Two promises to the believers in the same shape, as for those who..., then in God's mercy (3:107, 4:175). Near in wording and meaning.
tree:12vvrmb04khvep.relation: The believers' end is God's mercy, in both surahs.

tree:18vetkj0abf249.why: God speaks of those harmed in His way (3:195) and of going out to strive in His way (60:1), but the ayat are about reward and about secret friendship with enemies. Only a phrase in passing is shared.

tree:0lpbqsd1iega59.why: Whatever affair you are engaged in (10:61) and every day He is about some matter (55:29): the same noun in two different senses and subjects.

tree:10chfhi11agzym.why: Those who turn away are in dissension (2:137) and who is more astray than one in far dissension (41:52): a stock description of deniers, different addressees and arguments.

tree:0vtvkya1bg1t3a.why: The scrolls of Musa (53:36) and the honoured scrolls of the Quran (80:13) share only one noun. Different subjects.

tree:0qki3xo0xz9l70.why: The people of Paradise in shades, reclining on couches (36:56) or with springs (77:41). Same picture, different completion: a memorizer pair.
tree:0qki3xo0xz9l70.relation: Shade and rest as the reward of the God-fearing.

tree:16ow82y1rgi7mw.why: In neighbouring surahs, the wrongdoers are in lasting punishment (42:45) and the criminals in the punishment of Hell forever (43:74). Close wording, easy to swap.
tree:16ow82y1rgi7mw.relation: Wrongdoing and crime end in the same abiding punishment.

tree:1h1ye77011kppr.why: Deniers are drowned in heedlessness: their hearts in a flood of it (23:63), themselves heedless in it (51:11). A rare word used the same way.
tree:1h1ye77011kppr.relation: Heedlessness pictured as a flood that covers the heart.

tree:10wcpnk1odpfqi.why: What is in the hypocrite's heart (2:204) and one with disease in his heart (33:32): different people and points, only a common phrase.

tree:1913sx50ix389b.why: Yusuf kept the accusation to himself (12:77) and Musa felt fear within himself (20:67). Different verbs and moments, only the phrase within himself is shared.

tree:0rhqzk216a1obw.why: A mark on the believers' faces: the trace of prostration in this life (48:29) and the radiance of bliss in the next (83:24). A worthwhile pairing for pondering.
tree:0rhqzk216a1obw.relation: The mark of prostration in this world becomes the radiance of bliss in Paradise.

tree:1ldwpou15u3tsk.why: Signs in Yusuf and his brothers (12:7) and how you failed with Yusuf (12:80): his name after a preposition, two different points.

tree:0vdcul61d4p1oa.why: Two descriptions of hypocrites in battle: had they gone out among you they would have added only trouble (9:47), had they been among you they would have fought little (33:20). Same structure and theme.
tree:0vdcul61d4p1oa.relation: The hypocrites' presence in the army would have helped nothing.

tree:1hjyplv0oq0bg1.why: Never stand in that mosque (9:108) and abiding in it forever (18:3): the same adverb, unrelated subjects.

tree:04czkal0k6bu4n.why: The same parable in two surahs: no master would share his provision with his slaves as an equal, so how do they give God partners. Wording differs in pronoun and frame.
tree:04czkal0k6bu4n.relation: Parable against shirk: you would not make your slaves your equals, yet you make God's creatures His.

tree:1xqolzn1gdnt5v.why: Partners in a dead animal (6:139) and a man owned by quarrelling partners (39:29): the same word, different subjects and points.

tree:14n23s211s6fyw.why: The Book with guidance in it: the Quran is guidance for the God-fearing (2:2) and the Injil had guidance and light (5:46), which also ends with the God-fearing.
tree:14n23s211s6fyw.relation: Each revealed book carries guidance for the God-fearing.

tree:15nyiob0tz3y23.why: Disagreement over the Book (2:213) and God witnessing what you do (10:61): only a pronoun and a conjunction meet.
