tree:10ghe7f10qgflh.changes: Removed 21:34: same verb, a different statement.
tree:10ghe7f10qgflh.relation: Things God set as a test, to sort out who follows and who doubts.

tree:18y9srt027m1n5.why: Your Lord is not unaware of what you do, and not unjust to His servants; four surah endings a memorizer must keep apart (what they do, what you do, unjust).
tree:18y9srt027m1n5.relation: God watches every deed and wrongs no one.

tree:01n481v0mxake1.why: 39:48 and 39:51 in one surah, with 45:10, show the evil of what they earned coming back on them. 3:155 is about Satan making some believers slip, then God forgiving them.
tree:01n481v0mxake1.relation: What the wrongdoers earned comes back to strike them.

tree:01g4u701piz6b2.why: 2:120 and 13:37 give the same warning to the Prophet about following their desires after knowledge came, differing in the last word. 12:11 and 15:32 are questions, a different structure.
tree:01g4u701piz6b2.changes: Removed 12:11 and 15:32: the words there are a question, a different structure.
tree:01g4u701piz6b2.relation: Following others' desires after knowledge leaves one without protector.

tree:1u9neph09krqcp.why: A short phrase at the end of unrelated ayat, and a question in 99:3; nothing shared in meaning.

tree:16svd0o1c58nfq.why: The same words are a relative clause in some and a negation in others, across unrelated subjects.

tree:0gqeeop0hkjk5f.why: 5:1 and 22:30 make the same ruling: cattle are lawful except what is recited to you. 4:127 and 33:34 use the words for other recitations.
tree:0gqeeop0hkjk5f.relation: The same exception in the food rulings, in the Table and in the Hajj.

tree:0o5n9wp0owy5tz.why: The clean set of endings about God doing what He wills is its own card; 5:6 is a negation with another meaning.

tree:0kp6hjr1wvqxrf.why: Pairs that are not equal: the two seas, the blind and the seeing, the living and the dead; 35:19 and 40:58 open alike and differ after.
tree:0kp6hjr1wvqxrf.relation: Parables of inequality between belief and disbelief.

tree:19o4dth0tk3kut.why: 18:16 and 19:49 tell of leaving one's people and what they worship, and God's gift in return: the cave and its mercy, and Ibrahim's sons. 11:109 and 25:17 are about idolaters and their idols in another sense.
tree:19o4dth0tk3kut.changes: Removed 11:109 and 25:17: same words, different subjects.
tree:19o4dth0tk3kut.relation: Leaving the idolaters and their gods for God's sake, rewarded with mercy and offspring.

tree:0jhdc4314mt93h.why: Seeing what they were promised: 19:75 and 72:24 open the same way and end differently; 23:93 and 46:35 are the Prophet's side of the same threat.
tree:0jhdc4314mt93h.relation: When the promised punishment comes, they will know who was weaker.

tree:02dj4h91ckvudb.why: The same verdict with four different endings that a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:02dj4h91ckvudb.relation: The Fire as the home of the wrongdoers, for different sins.

tree:1lp4tok0k2m6ww.why: The Prophet's mission: bearer of good news and warner, with or without witness; two close pairs (17:105/25:56 and 33:45/48:8).
tree:1lp4tok0k2m6ww.relation: What the Prophet was sent as.

tree:074xn570qk3b6f.why: Messengers sent as bearers of good news and warners, each time with a different purpose stated; 6:48 and 18:56 open identically.
tree:074xn570qk3b6f.relation: Why messengers were sent: to judge, to leave no excuse, and how people received them.

tree:0ssyeia018jyo2.why: Man's response when harm touches him: despair, long prayers, panic; 17:83 and 41:51 open identically and part at the end.
tree:0ssyeia018jyo2.relation: The fickle nature of man in ease and hardship.

tree:0y5369p0z0v1ap.why: Prayers and commands about whose company one keeps: with the righteous, never with the wrongdoers; 7:47 and 7:150 are prayers in the same surah.
tree:0y5369p0z0v1ap.relation: Contrast: hoping to be with the righteous, asking not to be with the wrongdoers.

tree:1d2y0jr1xb6b5b.why: 5:104 and 31:21 are the same answer to the call to revelation: we follow what we found our fathers on, each rebutted differently. 7:102 and 51:36 are God saying what He found, a different subject.
tree:1d2y0jr1xb6b5b.changes: Removed 7:102 and 51:36: same verb, different subjects.
tree:1d2y0jr1xb6b5b.relation: Blind following of the fathers, answered: even if they knew nothing, even if Satan was calling them.

tree:0jhb3tf0g0k6rp.why: 2:264 and 14:18 are two parables of deeds lost: the rock washed bare and ashes in the wind, both saying they have no power over anything they earned, with the order of the words swapped. 2:202 and 42:22 use the phrase for other things.
tree:0jhb3tf0g0k6rp.changes: Removed 2:202 and 42:22: same phrase, different meaning.
tree:0jhb3tf0g0k6rp.relation: Two images of wasted deeds: charity spoiled by show, and the deeds of disbelievers.

tree:16d4iq51ii16kb.why: 17:1 and 20:23 give the same purpose to the Night Journey and to Moses' call: to show him some of Our signs. 18:9 and 45:9 use the phrase for other things.
tree:16d4iq51ii16kb.relation: The Prophet and Moses each shown God's signs at the start of a great mission.

tree:148hk0u1ia0l1e.why: Following God's guidance and what it brings: peace, safety from going astray, forgiveness. Close wording a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:148hk0u1ia0l1e.relation: Whoever follows the guidance is safe and guided.

tree:18uxdk80zlyns6.why: Only the word for spouses is shared; the subjects are unrelated (offspring, Lot's people, lost dowries, family as a trial).

tree:1ew7a9h1j545ov.why: Who is further astray: the one who follows his desire, the one who opposes the truth, the one who calls on what cannot answer; 25:42 has the deniers ask it of the believers.
tree:1ew7a9h1j545ov.relation: The Quran's answer to who is truly astray.

tree:07li8va05ockpo.why: Two pairs: Satan getting Adam and his wife out of the Garden (7:27, 20:117), and the believers lodged in the Garden (29:58, 39:74, both ending the same way).
tree:07li8va05ockpo.changes: Split into the expulsion pair and the reward pair.
tree:07li8va05ockpo.relation: The Garden lost by Satan's deceit, and the Garden regained by faith and deeds.

tree:1izavay0191e08.why: Moses, Noah, Yusuf and the Prophet are each kept from acting like the ignorant; worth reflecting on together.
tree:1izavay0191e08.relation: Prophets guarded from ignorance: mockery, wrong requests, temptation, impatience.

tree:195yo1l1o7idd5.why: Only a name of God after a preposition is shared; the subjects are unrelated.

tree:0fl7lgt17ntcwt.why: A common ending about witnesses, in unrelated settings (the prophets' covenant, the disciples, Ibrahim, Moses' story).

tree:0y2f1nf1epud85.why: Lot's wife left behind, told in three surahs with the verb changing; a classic memorizer set.
tree:0y2f1nf1epud85.changes: Gave 29:32 and 29:33 one row each (the old rows repeated 29:33).
tree:0y2f1nf1epud85.relation: Lot's family saved except his wife.

tree:1plt9n512ykvyb.why: Only the word for water is shared; the subjects are unrelated.

tree:0ug9f8804q8ufq.why: 12:36 and 12:78 have the same line said to Yusuf, by the prisoners and by his brothers. 7:56 and 39:58 use the word for other things.
tree:0ug9f8804q8ufq.changes: Removed 7:56 and 39:58: same word, different subjects.
tree:0ug9f8804q8ufq.relation: Yusuf recognized as a doer of good, in prison and in power.

tree:114czq01wckq2k.why: A common ending about messengers in mixed contexts; the real Moses pair is its own card.

tree:1ui8tgk1b119o4.why: The truth is from your Lord, so do not doubt: four times, with a small change in the verb form that a memorizer must catch.
tree:1ui8tgk1b119o4.relation: Certainty in the revelation, repeated to the Prophet.

tree:0mbzena0wx2vsq.why: The same words mean God's decree, His command and His affair in unrelated contexts.

tree:1dgnvjd1wtx7wx.why: 15:5 and 23:43 are the same sentence about each nation's fixed term. 16:92 and 35:24 use the word nation in other sentences.
tree:1dgnvjd1wtx7wx.relation: Every nation has its term, neither advanced nor delayed.

tree:0i6w60k1jde2m8.why: Mixed senses of the same phrase; the 4:35 and 12:26 pair is its own card.

tree:0aiwumk12431dc.why: No protectors besides God, said four times with different continuations; 11:20 and 11:113 in one surah.
tree:0aiwumk12431dc.relation: No protector besides God, whatever they hoped for.

tree:1ejvz7v0butp5j.why: Only a time phrase is shared; the subjects are unrelated (Jacob, Moses, Solomon, Jesus).

tree:0bcl0p204ix3um.why: A common phrase of kinship or likeness in unrelated contexts.

tree:1s1tkov1rgyphd.why: 38:8 and 54:25 are the same objection in the same form: was the message sent to him from among us; 6:53 has the same envy. 41:5 is a screen between us and you, another sense.
tree:1s1tkov1rgyphd.changes: Removed 41:5: the words there mean a screen between, a different sense.
tree:1s1tkov1rgyphd.relation: The envious objection: why him, and not us.

tree:1f1bwyv15ke98h.why: 3:26, 3:27 and 7:155 praise God as giving and withholding as He wills: kingship, provision, guidance. 33:51 is the Prophet's choice among his wives, another subject.
tree:1f1bwyv15ke98h.changes: Removed 33:51: the Prophet's choice, not God's will.
tree:1f1bwyv15ke98h.relation: God's sovereign will in kingship, provision and guidance.

tree:0n74dv01496qzy.why: Only a short relative clause about turning away is shared, in unrelated contexts.

tree:0nvzeau0lrl2ba.why: Pharaoh's threat to the magicians in three surahs, with small differences a memorizer must catch, and 5:33 the same penalty as God's law for those who wage war on Him.
tree:0nvzeau0lrl2ba.relation: Contrast: the same penalty threatened by a tyrant against believers, and set by God against those who spread corruption.

tree:04xe24v1tkg5bb.why: 13:11, 41:42 and 72:27 describe protection on every side: guardian angels around man, the Quran beyond the reach of falsehood, watchers around the revelation to a messenger. 46:21 uses the words for warners who came before and after, a sense of time.
tree:04xe24v1tkg5bb.changes: Removed 46:21: the words there are about time, not protection.
tree:04xe24v1tkg5bb.relation: God's guard around man and around His revelation, before and behind.

tree:05m5k3e09yir7a.why: Only a short spatial phrase is shared; the subjects are unrelated.

tree:19vsyad1pfvt33.why: Driving people out of their homes: forbidden in the covenant, a test few would pass, and in 60:8 and 60:9 the line between those to treat justly and those not to befriend.
tree:19vsyad1pfvt33.relation: Expulsion from homes as a sin, a test, and the measure for how to treat non-believers.

tree:0cnu20r1gv5bzp.why: 28:73 and 30:46 are signs of God's mercy (night and day, the winds) that end with the same two clauses, a memorizer trap. 18:16 and 57:28 use the phrase for other gifts.
tree:0cnu20r1gv5bzp.changes: Removed 18:16 and 57:28: same phrase, different subjects.
tree:0cnu20r1gv5bzp.relation: Signs of mercy given so you may seek His bounty and give thanks.

tree:1q6wadw1rrtpkw.why: Man's creation from clay, three times in al-Hijr with the same words and once in ar-Rahman with a different image.
tree:1q6wadw1rrtpkw.relation: The clay of man's creation, and Iblis' pride in it.

tree:03qlay808lah7q.why: 5:90 and 28:15 both call something the work of Satan: intoxicants and gambling, and Moses' blow that killed a man. 10:61 and 25:23 use the word deed in other senses.
tree:03qlay808lah7q.relation: What is named Satan's work: the forbidden, and even a prophet's rash act.

tree:0ha3txs1f1ybs2.why: Only a phrase meaning from Him is shared; the subjects are unrelated.

tree:1roc0ft1ely415.why: Moses' hand coming out white without harm, three times with different openings and endings; a classic memorizer set. 52:35 is about being created from nothing, another subject.
tree:1roc0ft1ely415.relation: The sign of the white hand.

tree:1j7og5r10e7iv9.why: Silver in Paradise for the righteous (three times in al-Insan) set against 43:33, silver roofs God would give disbelievers if not for the trial.
tree:1j7og5r10e7iv9.relation: Contrast: silver as a worthless worldly gift, and silver as an honour in Paradise.

tree:0kuavp219cu0q4.why: No escape: said by the followers in Hell, of the idolaters, of those who dispute God's signs, and of past nations.
tree:0kuavp219cu0q4.relation: There is no escape from God's reckoning.

tree:01ebj6i1huntzo.why: A common phrase about prophets in scattered contexts; the real 7:94 and 43:7 slip is its own card.

tree:12nlzx207prxqa.why: Gardens of palms and vines: a parable of loss, a demand of the deniers, and twice a favour from God; close wording a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:12nlzx207prxqa.relation: Gardens as gift, as parable, and as a demand of disbelief.

tree:12uhuf11v5oaj9.why: Promises to whoever fears God: three in at-Talaq, each different, and Yusuf's lesson from his life.
tree:12uhuf11v5oaj9.relation: What God gives the one who fears Him: a way out, ease, forgiveness, reward.

tree:1yc5ctr00qsunb.why: 57:24 and 60:6 end identically, and 48:17 has the same turning away with a threat. 5:56 is about taking God as ally, a different verb sense.
tree:1yc5ctr00qsunb.changes: Removed 5:56: the verb there means taking as ally.
tree:1yc5ctr00qsunb.relation: Whoever turns away harms only himself: God is free of need.

tree:0cbvpgz1jtt8ct.why: 22:3, 22:8 and 31:20 describe those who argue about God without knowledge, two of them identical in the phrase. 4:109 is about arguing on someone's behalf, another subject.
tree:0cbvpgz1jtt8ct.relation: Arguing about God without knowledge, guidance or scripture.

tree:11ws5r91wuzvsz.why: Only a conditional about willing is shared, in four unrelated contexts.

tree:02wfglz1lwenuh.why: Only a short phrase is shared; the subjects are unrelated.

tree:0gf38qn0jyd6zb.why: Many of the People of the Book are defiantly disobedient: said in 5:81 and three times in al-Hadid, with different lead-ins.
tree:0gf38qn0jyd6zb.changes: Gave 57:26 and 57:27 one row each (the old rows repeated 57:27).
tree:0gf38qn0jyd6zb.relation: The pattern of the earlier communities: some guided, many disobedient.

tree:0uvw1xn132zzlh.why: Only two short particles are shared; nothing in meaning.

tree:1oikvnn0i3jh7v.why: The weighing of deeds, told twice with the same opening and different endings; a classic memorizer pair.
tree:1oikvnn0i3jh7v.relation: Heavy scales and light scales, and what each brings.

tree:1nkr1e802y8sny.why: 2:136 and 3:84 are the same creed with small differences a memorizer must catch; 33:7 and 42:13 name the same great prophets in the covenant and the shared religion.
tree:1nkr1e802y8sny.relation: One faith across the prophets, believed in without distinction.

tree:07eb12a01qu66m.why: What serves as an admonition for the God-fearing: a punishment, the Quran, the Gospel, the clear signs. Same closing a memorizer must place.
tree:07eb12a01qu66m.relation: Lessons for the God-fearing in history and in scripture.

tree:0xnjbd606comvk.why: Prophets calling on their Lord: Zakariyya twice and Ayyub twice, with different wording.
tree:0xnjbd606comvk.relation: The prayers of Zakariyya and Ayyub in distress.

tree:0yad75m0x93en8.why: Noah saved with his family from the great distress, and Lot with his family except an old woman; the same verb with different endings in each.
tree:0yad75m0x93en8.relation: God's rescue of His prophets and their families.

tree:16oj1b710qjo7z.why: God varies the signs, with four different endings a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:16oj1b710qjo7z.relation: The signs varied, and people's different responses.

tree:13e5l5b0xgr33f.why: The word half is shared across unrelated rulings (dowry, a husband's inheritance, a slave woman's penalty, a sister's share); the real slip is kept in a smaller card.

tree:0lshmvq000dnua.why: 3:23, 4:44 and 4:51 open identically about those given a portion of the Book and go three different ways, a memorizer trap. 40:47 asks for a portion of the Fire, another subject.
tree:0lshmvq000dnua.relation: Those given part of the Book: turning from its judgement, buying error, siding with idolaters.

tree:1hwriar1lwpfhb.why: 2:48 and 2:123 are the classic pair with swapped clauses; 21:47 and 36:54 add that no soul will be wronged in the least on that Day.
tree:1hwriar1lwpfhb.relation: On the Day each soul stands alone, and none is wronged.

tree:0grt48h0jicg49.why: No power to benefit or harm: the Prophet himself, the false gods, and people on the Day; the order of the two words flips, a memorizer trap.
tree:0grt48h0jicg49.relation: Only God controls benefit and harm.

tree:1al44hy1w99wle.why: People going back to what they were forbidden: usury, the Sabbath, secret talk, and the deniers who would return if sent back.
tree:1al44hy1w99wle.relation: Returning to the forbidden after being warned, and its punishment.

tree:1m15vou1xwycyc.why: Only the verb of God guiding is shared, in four unrelated contexts.

tree:0qd1u170mz7ktf.why: Four peoples calling the clear truth magic, in close wording: Pharaoh's people, Quraysh twice, and the Children of Israel to Jesus.
tree:0qd1u170mz7ktf.relation: Every messenger's clear signs called magic.

tree:1va2a2r0h29g7n.why: Only a demonstrative and a preposition are shared; nothing in meaning.

tree:0bhhdzi0isgg30.why: Are they equal: the blind and the seeing (6:50 and 13:16), the helpless and the just man, those who know and those who do not.
tree:0bhhdzi0isgg30.relation: Questions of inequality between guidance and blindness, knowledge and ignorance.

tree:0ykdcv91o6escn.why: Who the winners are: those who strive, those who were patient, those who obey, the people of Paradise. Same closing with different lead-ins.

tree:0qr6te40guwsdi.why: The verdict on the deniers' motive, with different last words; 51:53 and 52:32 both end with transgressors.
tree:0qr6te40guwsdi.relation: Behind their arguments: they are a people who equate, argue, transgress.

tree:05nlnyw09sgaxq.why: Dying in disbelief, four times with different consequences a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:05nlnyw09sgaxq.relation: Death in disbelief closes the door: curse, no ransom, no repentance, no forgiveness.

tree:0fhgydn0z2x7jb.why: Turning away in aversion: from the Book's judgement, from hearing, after God's bounty, from the reminder.
tree:0fhgydn0z2x7jb.relation: Aversion as a habit of those who reject guidance.

tree:04l0pay1cm64w6.why: 21:12 and 43:47 are the same turn: when Our signs or punishment came, at once they ran or laughed. 15:48 and 27:66 use the words for other things.
tree:04l0pay1cm64w6.relation: Contrast: fleeing from the punishment, laughing at the signs.

tree:0x6dvms10lh93u.why: 12:83 and 12:100 close with the same praise of God, first by Ya'qub in his grief and then by Yusuf at the reunion. 30:54 and 66:2 are stock closings with other subjects.
tree:0x6dvms10lh93u.changes: Removed 30:54 and 66:2: stock closings, unrelated subjects.
tree:0x6dvms10lh93u.relation: Father and son, in loss and in reunion, both trust God's knowledge and wisdom.

tree:0f2yb9k0nlenza.why: A stock closing about God's knowledge after unrelated subjects; only 36:79 differs and that alone is no card.

tree:12yb6kw0tqlrki.why: God gives life and death, said with the oneness formula and different continuations a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:12yb6kw0tqlrki.relation: The One who gives life and death is the only one to worship.

tree:1s7a6ta0ni4hrc.why: The idolaters' one argument, we found our fathers so, in four places; 43:22 and 43:23 differ only in the last word.
tree:1s7a6ta0ni4hrc.relation: Blind imitation of ancestors as the answer to every prophet.

tree:19ordl61nxgd9c.why: Seeking God's face: everywhere one turns, in spending, and in 30:38 and 30:39 giving to kin and zakat set against usury.
tree:19ordl61nxgd9c.relation: Deeds done for God's face grow; usury does not.

tree:0wao9db1qcop1l.why: The address to people of understanding, each time tied to fearing God and a different command.
tree:0wao9db1qcop1l.relation: Understanding shown in mindfulness of God: in retaliation, the Hajj, choosing the good.

tree:0oy0j2i0lw2p5o.why: The denial that God has taken a son; 17:111 and 25:2 share a whole clause, a memorizer pair.
tree:0oy0j2i0lw2p5o.relation: God has no son: it does not befit Him, and He has no partner in His dominion.

tree:1lv1t8n01trc63.why: The classic set: the Prophet sent to recite, purify and teach; Ibrahim's prayer puts teaching before purifying, the answers put purifying first. 28:59 is a messenger sent before a town is destroyed, another subject.

tree:0u6pv5206dcidw.why: God turning in mercy: to those who repent soon, to whom He wills (twice in at-Tawba), and to the believers.

tree:1vx6qxk0r5pxpa.why: Left to God: He may forgive or punish them; four places with different order and endings.
tree:1vx6qxk0r5pxpa.relation: The fate of the wrongdoers is God's to decide, not the Prophet's.

tree:1cmazna0ewwz84.why: Arguing about God without knowledge (22:3, 22:8, 31:20) and arguing about His signs (40:4); close wording a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:1cmazna0ewwz84.relation: Disputing God and His signs without knowledge.

tree:0arvs1g11tecgc.why: 65:2 and 65:4 are two promises to whoever fears God, in the same divorce rulings: a way out, and ease. 18:1 and 72:25 use the verb for other things.
tree:0arvs1g11tecgc.changes: Removed 18:1 and 72:25: same verb, different subjects.
tree:0arvs1g11tecgc.relation: Fear of God brings a way out and ease, even in the hardship of divorce.

tree:191zd150j5lnoz.why: People who think they are guided or doing well while they are lost; 7:30 and 43:37 end identically.
tree:191zd150j5lnoz.relation: The deception of thinking oneself guided while astray.

tree:1whbqdl04h5921.why: The hypocrites swearing by God, four times, each oath covering a different lie.

tree:0lrrwtr10iqvat.why: God gives life to the dead, with different frames (He is the Truth, He is the Protector, He is able); close wording a memorizer must hold.
tree:0lrrwtr10iqvat.relation: The power to revive the dead as proof of the resurrection.

tree:1hyx4a10ro8t4z.why: God never breaks His covenant or promise, four times with a different noun (covenant, promise, appointment).
tree:1hyx4a10ro8t4z.relation: Certainty of God's promise against the false hopes and impatience of the deniers.

tree:1iq2oj70i7bx3n.why: God directs the whole affair, after creation and the throne; the continuations differ and a memorizer must keep them apart.
tree:1iq2oj70i7bx3n.relation: The Creator who directs every matter is the only one to worship.

tree:1xwntg5048uas5.why: Those who will enter the Garden, said three times with different endings, set against 7:40 where the arrogant deniers will not enter it.
tree:1xwntg5048uas5.relation: Contrast: who enters the Garden and who never will.

tree:10qjr9z00mhscz.why: Who provides for you from the sky and the earth: four questions to the idolaters, one with heavens in the plural.
tree:10qjr9z00mhscz.relation: The provider is the one to be worshipped.

tree:165fcde0lcl1as.why: 17:68, 17:69 and 67:17 warn that God could send a storm of stones or a gale on those who feel safe. 6:61 is about guardian angels sent over people, a different sense.
tree:165fcde0lcl1as.changes: Removed 6:61: the verb there sends guardians, not punishment.
tree:165fcde0lcl1as.relation: Do not feel safe from God's sudden punishment.

tree:0zjufgr1mw67sp.why: 4:48 and 4:116 are the classic pair differing only at the end. 2:269 and 39:23 share only the words around a clause break.
tree:0zjufgr1mw67sp.changes: Removed 2:269 and 39:23: only words across a clause break are shared.
tree:0zjufgr1mw67sp.relation: Association with God is the unforgiven sin: a great lie, a far straying.

tree:10j5eb00zk9xye.why: God strikes parables: foam and what lasts, the good tree, the niche of light, the two parties.

tree:0ihqy5a1kmfkfc.why: Hud, Salih, Shu'ayb and the messengers in general answered with the same refusal to leave what their fathers worshipped.
tree:0ihqy5a1kmfkfc.relation: Different prophets, the same reply: we will not leave our fathers' gods.

tree:0bcg9y919sninn.why: Fighting in God's way: against Satan's allies, as the believers' sale of themselves, in ranks, and as one of the excuses for lighter night prayer.
tree:0bcg9y919sninn.relation: What fighting in God's way means and how God values it.

tree:0o4sh1b0sonxvt.why: Four regrets of the lost, each saying would that I had or had not: associating, not following the Messenger, the record, the deeds.
tree:0o4sh1b0sonxvt.relation: Late regrets that teach what to do now.

tree:09i9iww1norm2o.why: Callers to God addressing their people: Ibrahim disowning idols, the believer of Pharaoh's family fearing for them twice, Noah warning.
tree:09i9iww1norm2o.relation: The callers' concern for their people.

tree:1ocbvfe0lzqjda.why: Only a short verb phrase is shared; four unrelated contexts.

tree:0zzb86k1pjuwqc.why: 4:171 and 6:101 deny that God has a son; 2:247 has the same question form about Talut having kingship. 8:67 is about a prophet taking captives, another subject.
tree:0zzb86k1pjuwqc.relation: How could He have a son, and how could Talut be king: one rejected claim and one rejected objection.

tree:0po24ke1qeiueu.why: What guides to the truth: God and not the idols, the revelation as the people of knowledge see it, and the jinn twice describing the Quran.
tree:0po24ke1qeiueu.relation: The Quran guides to the truth, to the straight path, to right conduct.

tree:1k4v8mg1lpnhhy.why: God guides by His word whom He wills; 6:88 and 39:23 share the same clause, and 2:26 shows the same word misleading others.
tree:1k4v8mg1lpnhhy.relation: The same revelation guides some and misleads others.

tree:0vdxc2i0net81e.why: 10:109, 11:12 and 33:2 are commands to the Prophet about what is revealed to him: follow it, do not leave any of it. 42:3 is a general statement about revelation.
tree:0vdxc2i0net81e.changes: Removed 42:3: a different structure and statement.
tree:0vdxc2i0net81e.relation: Holding to the revelation despite the deniers.

tree:0hkhihq12e8t28.why: Scenes of the gathering: jinn and men, the short stay, the worshipped and their worshippers questioned.
tree:0hkhihq12e8t28.relation: On the Day of gathering, the false ties are exposed.

tree:171kv9l1cx32st.why: The Day when the reckoning, the witnesses, the Spirit and the angels, and all people stand.
tree:171kv9l1cx32st.relation: The standing of the Day from four sides.

tree:050h44i00214we.why: God's call on the Day: where are My partners (28:62, 28:74, 41:47) and how did you answer the messengers (28:65).
tree:050h44i00214we.relation: The questions of the Day: about the partners and about the messengers.

tree:0161xgy0vgp0t4.why: What will not happen on that Day: intercession, excuses, questioning, a punishment like His.

tree:1pcp5p21cti1mq.why: Leave them until they meet their promised Day: 43:83 and 70:42 identical, 52:45 differs at the end.
tree:1pcp5p21cti1mq.relation: The deniers left to their play until the Day.

tree:177p2de0ynbpfq.why: How people respond to what God gave them of His bounty: the martyrs rejoice in it, misers hoard it, others hide it or envy those who have it, and the hypocrites are told to be content with it.
tree:177p2de0ynbpfq.relation: Five attitudes to God's bounty: joy, miserliness, concealment, envy, contentment.

tree:07q4kck1pcb4p4.why: The deniers' question about rising after becoming dust or bones, five times with differences a memorizer must catch (dust or bones, raised or brought out).
tree:07q4kck1pcb4p4.relation: The same denial of resurrection across the surahs, and the answers it gets.

tree:0fpq48m01glj2o.why: Declarations of faith in the revelation: the firmly grounded in knowledge, the People of the Book, the believers, the jinn; set against 34:52, the deniers who say it when it is too late.
tree:0fpq48m01glj2o.relation: Contrast: faith declared in time, and the same words said too late on the Day.

tree:0slz79a01y92hs.why: Calls to believe in what God sent down: to the People of the Book, who are told it confirms what they have (2:41, 4:47), their refusal (2:91), the hypocrites' false claim (4:60), and the believers who did believe (47:2).
tree:0slz79a01y92hs.relation: Belief in the revelation demanded, refused, claimed and fulfilled.

tree:0wp88rv1ugoprp.why: The question will we really be raised, five times, with pairs that match exactly (17:49 and 17:98; 37:16 and 56:47) and others that differ.
tree:0wp88rv1ugoprp.relation: The denial of resurrection and the answers: be stone or iron, yes and humbled, the first and the last.

tree:0n1e3ji1w8can0.why: What people follow: the command to follow what God sent (7:3), the reply that they follow their fathers (2:170, 31:21, a close pair), and those who followed the devils' magic or what angers God.
tree:0n1e3ji1w8can0.relation: Following revelation against following fathers, devils and what angers God.

tree:1jbr2mi1as61d8.why: The claim that God took a son, answered four times in different ways. 4:125, God taking Ibrahim as a close friend, uses the verb in another sense.
tree:1jbr2mi1as61d8.changes: Removed 4:125: the verb there is about taking Ibrahim as friend, not the claim of a son.
tree:1jbr2mi1as61d8.relation: The claim of a son refuted: He owns all, He is free of need, it is a lie, there is no other god.

tree:0uqlcsu0hs428g.why: God is more worthy: to be feared (9:13, 33:37, even said to the Prophet), to be pleased (9:62), to be followed (10:35). 9:108 is about a mosque more worthy to stand in.
tree:0uqlcsu0hs428g.changes: Removed 9:108: about a mosque, not about God.
tree:0uqlcsu0hs428g.relation: Fear, pleasing and following are owed to God before people.

tree:1gpwl060kqe4gk.why: What God made lawful: intimacy on fasting nights, marriage beyond the forbidden degrees, good things to eat (5:4, 5:5), the catch of the sea.
tree:1gpwl060kqe4gk.relation: The Quran's statements of the lawful.

tree:0fm1vki06vhc0e.why: The covenants God took: 2:63 and 2:93 identical openings with different endings, 2:83 and 2:84 its terms, and 33:7 the covenant of the prophets.
tree:0fm1vki06vhc0e.relation: The covenants with the Children of Israel and with the prophets.

tree:1cxnqpc13d05ag.why: Only a time phrase is shared, in five unrelated contexts.

tree:0vb8lmn0suqdu1.why: Two separate pairs: when Our punishment came (6:43, 7:5), and what kept people from believing when guidance came (17:94, 18:55). 17:101 is Moses before Pharaoh, another subject.
tree:0vb8lmn0suqdu1.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 17:101.
tree:0vb8lmn0suqdu1.relation: Too late at the punishment; and the excuses that blocked faith when guidance came.

tree:10vhl0o112hxt2.why: Only a speech opener is shared, by five unrelated speakers.

tree:0aias0818jwnig.why: 8:49 and 33:12 are the same opening about the hypocrites and the sick of heart, at Badr and at the Trench, with different words after. The others share only the speech opener.
tree:0aias0818jwnig.changes: Removed 9:40, 17:47 and 20:104: only the speech opener is shared.
tree:0aias0818jwnig.relation: The hypocrites' mockery at two battles.

tree:02qo7kn1mlmbi1.why: The three journeys of Dhu al-Qarnayn, each opening the same way. 24:59 and 46:15 use the phrase for reaching an age.
tree:02qo7kn1mlmbi1.changes: Removed 24:59 and 46:15: the phrase there is about reaching maturity.
tree:02qo7kn1mlmbi1.relation: Dhu al-Qarnayn's journeys west, east and to the two barriers.

tree:17728i70tj9iv1.why: Only a time clause is shared; what comes (the Hour, a sign, the angels, good fortune) and the subjects are unrelated.

tree:13eg5rg1ajvziy.why: When God decrees a thing He says to it Be: four times, with and or so before it. 33:36 is about a matter decided by God and His Messenger for the believers, a different sentence.
tree:13eg5rg1ajvziy.changes: Removed 33:36: a ruling, not the creative command.
tree:13eg5rg1ajvziy.relation: God's creative command, in creation, in the birth of Jesus, and against the claim of a son.

tree:0y5sl9108zo1p5.why: A speaker binding himself: then I would be a wrongdoer or a sinner, in following desires, in testimony, and in belittling the poor. 26:42 is Pharaoh's promise to the magicians, a different sentence.
tree:0y5sl9108zo1p5.changes: Removed 26:42: a promise of favour, not a self-check.
tree:0y5sl9108zo1p5.relation: Self-checks of justice in speech and testimony.

tree:0vcdakd02g1jen.why: Only a verb of wanting is shared, in five unrelated contexts.

tree:1y3f02o04dcqsu.why: Moses sent with Our signs, five times: 11:96 and 40:23 identical, the others differing in what follows.
tree:1y3f02o04dcqsu.relation: The mission of Moses with signs and clear authority.

tree:1gcz0qk032a88e.why: God has prepared for the disbelievers a punishment, five times with a different object; 4:37 and 4:151 identical.
tree:1gcz0qk032a88e.relation: What is prepared for the disbelievers: humiliation, pain, blaze, chains.

tree:18ozvsv1mr75r7.why: The command to turn from opponents, each time with a different follow-up: admonish, rely on God, judge or not, until they change the topic, and wait.
tree:18ozvsv1mr75r7.relation: How to turn away from those who reject, without abandoning the mission.

tree:0swimoj1nrfqkt.why: Only the opener know that is shared, followed by five unrelated statements.

tree:1vulywx0413awv.why: Prophets asking forgiveness, each adding a different request: Moses for his brother, Ibrahim and Noah for parents and believers, Moses for himself, Solomon for a kingdom.
tree:1vulywx0413awv.relation: How the prophets asked forgiveness, and for whom.

tree:1euf57c1154k7g.why: Will you not be mindful: the same call by Hud, Noah and a messenger in identical words, and twice after the idolaters admit God is the Lord.
tree:1euf57c1154k7g.relation: The prophets' call to worship God alone, and the argument from what the idolaters themselves admit.

tree:1fbjgp60psxelu.why: The command to establish prayer, five times, each with its own addition: its times (11:114, 17:78), its purpose (remembrance, restraining from evil), and Luqman's advice.
tree:1fbjgp60psxelu.relation: Prayer: when, why, and what it does.

tree:1xj8l5z1qwa8hb.why: 10:72, 10:104 and 27:91 are the same statement, I was commanded to be among the Muslims or the believers, a memorizer trap. 2:67 (refuge from ignorance) and 39:58 (a wish on the Day) are different sentences.
tree:1xj8l5z1qwa8hb.relation: The prophets' declaration of their own submission.

tree:18wnfrf05pz9f5.why: They follow only conjecture: five times, with three close endings (they only guess) and two in an-Najm that add desire and the worthlessness of conjecture.
tree:18wnfrf05pz9f5.relation: Idolatry rests on conjecture, not knowledge.

tree:1yszy741vqru40.why: 2:9, 3:69, 4:113 and 6:26 say the plotters deceive, mislead or destroy only themselves, with the same ending in three. 24:6 is about a husband with no witness but himself, a different sentence.
tree:1yszy741vqru40.changes: Removed 24:6: same words, different structure and subject.
tree:1yszy741vqru40.relation: Evil plotting harms only the plotter.

tree:02twhnr1vcwqub.why: No soul is burdened beyond its capacity, five times in different settings: nursing, the closing prayer of al-Baqara, fair dealing, Paradise, the record.
tree:02twhnr1vcwqub.relation: God's mercy in what He asks of each soul.

tree:1u6qeze0pxuefs.why: Only two words across a clause break are shared; the real 35:40 and 46:4 pair is kept elsewhere.

tree:010krow1su1p18.why: Only two words across a clause break are shared; the subjects are unrelated.

tree:1qqc1ou1s3lgiw.why: Creation of the heavens and earth in six days, four times with different continuations, and 41:9 the earth in two days.
tree:1qqc1ou1s3lgiw.relation: The six days of creation, and what each passage draws from it.

tree:17fsmig1m0fk2e.why: A common phrase about the earth and whoever is on it, with different subjects (glorification, inheritance, corruption, ownership); no shared point.

tree:1t3wkwk01yp4py.why: The particle after man is a different word in each (relative, exclamation, question), so the ayat do not match in structure.

tree:1n577sy0lbd04o.why: Only a stock closing about God making the signs clear is shared; the subjects are unrelated rulings and parables.

tree:1j9crza0f5cgs2.why: Two separate things: God reminding the Children of Israel of His favour (2:40, 2:47, 2:122), and the prayer to be thankful for the favour on me and my parents, by Solomon and by the grown man (27:19, 46:15).
tree:1j9crza0f5cgs2.changes: Split into the Children of Israel set and the prayer pair.
tree:1j9crza0f5cgs2.relation: Favour recalled as a reminder to a people, and favour thanked for in a personal prayer.

tree:1ra6oun1ri30gz.why: Two closings: the best or the worst of what they used to do (29:7, 39:35, 41:27), and the Day they were promised (46:16, 70:44).
tree:1ra6oun1ri30gz.changes: Split by the two different closings.
tree:1ra6oun1ri30gz.relation: Contrast: the believers rewarded by their best deeds, the disbelievers by their worst; the promise of truth and the Day of humiliation.

tree:1sd2kib15cy847.why: The One who sent down the Book and the Criterion, believed in, relied on, and mocked by the deniers in 15:6. 43:11 is about sending down rain, another subject.
tree:1sd2kib15cy847.changes: Removed 43:11: the verb is about rain.
tree:1sd2kib15cy847.relation: The revelation from the One who sent it down, and how people met it.

tree:0wim7kp13xdabv.why: The arrogant chiefs against the believers among Salih's and Shu'ayb's peoples, and the arrogant arguing with the weak in Hell.
tree:0wim7kp13xdabv.relation: The arrogant in this life and in the Fire.

tree:0tbafcz13e0fdn.why: Only a relative clause with a negation is shared, followed by unrelated verbs.

tree:0eqewch0zb2gth.why: 3:16, 4:75, 25:65 and 25:74 describe people by their prayers to their Lord, each prayer different. 63:7 is the hypocrites saying do not spend, the opposite.
tree:0eqewch0zb2gth.changes: Removed 63:7: the hypocrites' saying, not a prayer.
tree:0eqewch0zb2gth.relation: The believers known by what they ask their Lord.

tree:1glhchk01juku0.why: 34:2 and 57:4 are the real pair and are kept elsewhere; the others share only two common words.

tree:1d7axeu1xpgrds.why: Hearing, sight and hearts as God's gift, with endings that differ (so you may give thanks, little do you give thanks); 23:78 and 67:23 continue alike.
tree:1d7axeu1xpgrds.relation: The gift of senses, and how little thanks it gets.

tree:07s4i011pznbgv.why: God is free of need and praised, five times with different lead-ins; 57:24 and 60:6 identical.
tree:07s4i011pznbgv.relation: God needs nothing from His creatures.

tree:16w2s0c12qmens.why: Sun and moon each running to a set term, four times, and each in an orbit in 21:33.
tree:16w2s0c12qmens.relation: The ordered course of the sun and moon as a sign.

tree:1nhbaf9016wfzh.why: God made for you: spouses, homes, shade and shelter (three in an-Nahl), and the earth spread out. 29:10 is a man treating people's harm like God's punishment, another sense.
tree:1nhbaf9016wfzh.changes: Removed 29:10: the verb there means treating one thing as another.
tree:1nhbaf9016wfzh.relation: The everyday favours of God listed one by one.

tree:073ndmo1oyv8xw.why: 58:6 and 58:18 open identically about the Day God raises them all, and part. The others use all together in other senses.
tree:073ndmo1oyv8xw.relation: On the Day all are raised: told what they did, and still swearing false oaths.

tree:075css51oru5hb.why: Acknowledging God's favour: Yusuf twice and his brothers in the same surah, the onlookers of Qarun, and the people of Paradise.
tree:075css51oru5hb.relation: Grace recognized: by the prophet, by those who wronged him, by those spared, and in Paradise.

tree:045r2v21hby92u.why: Only the name of God before a conditional is shared; five unrelated rulings.

tree:1f7x8b905isauv.why: 7:178, 17:97 and 18:17 are the classic set on whom God guides and whom He leaves astray, with small spelling and ending differences. 22:30 and 65:3 share only the conditional form.
tree:1f7x8b905isauv.changes: Removed 22:30 and 65:3: same form, different subjects.
tree:1f7x8b905isauv.relation: Guidance and misguidance are in God's hand.

tree:1v9n7bt1eb7qlz.why: 3:52 and 61:14 are the same exchange between Jesus and the disciples, who are my helpers for God. The other three share only two words across a break.
tree:1v9n7bt1eb7qlz.relation: The disciples' answer as a model for the believers.

tree:0mfc9k21sn0vvg.why: 5:56 and 58:22 both describe the party of God, ending with two different words (the victors, the successful). The other three share only two words.
tree:0mfc9k21sn0vvg.relation: The party of God: victorious and successful.

tree:0yee9zm12avzua.why: Obey God and the Messenger, four times with different consequences, and 8:27 the warning not to betray them.
tree:0yee9zm12avzua.relation: Obedience to God and the Messenger, its fruits, and its opposite.

tree:0921s0k1usfj7w.why: 3:117 and 16:33 say God did not wrong them but they wronged themselves, with a small change a memorizer must catch. The other three share only a construction around but.
tree:0921s0k1usfj7w.relation: People's ruin is their own doing, not God's injustice.

tree:18kzn0m0oys072.why: Two things: God wants no injustice (3:108 to the worlds, 40:31 to the servants), and what God wants against what people want (4:27 repentance against desires, 8:67 the Hereafter against the world). 11:34 is Noah on God's will to let them err.
tree:18kzn0m0oys072.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 11:34.
tree:18kzn0m0oys072.relation: God's will is mercy and the Hereafter, while others want deviation and the world.

tree:13elpf30p3vb6b.why: Did I not tell you: God to the angels, Ya'qub to his sons, al-Khidr to Moses twice, the best of the garden owners. Each time the one who knew is proven right.
tree:13elpf30p3vb6b.relation: The one who warned or knew is vindicated.

tree:0vdehhx03ew4lr.why: Did not messengers, news or a warner come to you: asked of jinn and men, by the keepers of Hell (39:71 and 67:8), and of people about past nations.
tree:0vdehhx03ew4lr.relation: No one is punished without a warning first.

tree:0g6gxw811ot2vy.why: Two pairs: do they not see how many generations We destroyed before them (6:6, 36:31), and do they not see the birds and the night (16:79, 27:86, same ending). 7:148 is about the calf, another subject.
tree:0g6gxw811ot2vy.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 7:148.
tree:0g6gxw811ot2vy.relation: Lessons from history and from nature, both introduced by do they not see.

tree:0esfyxv1ygkkax.why: The claims about the Messiah son of Mary refuted: he is God (5:17, 5:72 identical openings), son of God, a lord; 5:75 states he was only a messenger.
tree:0esfyxv1ygkkax.relation: What the Messiah is and is not.

tree:14rage509qh3kb.why: The chiefs of the prophets' peoples speaking against them: Noah's, Pharaoh's twice, and another messenger's. 2:246 is the chiefs of the Children of Israel asking for a king, another story.
tree:14rage509qh3kb.changes: Removed 2:246: a different story and stance.
tree:14rage509qh3kb.relation: The chiefs' opposition to the prophets.

tree:151o5uv1mwmk6j.why: Two pairs: fear the Fire prepared for the disbelievers (2:24, 3:131), and the Fire you used to deny (34:42, 52:14). 56:71 is the fire people kindle, another subject.
tree:151o5uv1mwmk6j.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 56:71.
tree:151o5uv1mwmk6j.relation: The Fire warned of, and the Fire they denied.

tree:11j2cbb06pkpwx.why: The Fire as a refuge with no helpers, four times with different words a memorizer must keep apart (29:25 and 45:34 identical). 5:37 is about trying to leave the Fire, a different sentence.
tree:11j2cbb06pkpwx.relation: In the Fire there is no helper.

tree:1t8tzjs168e8ek.why: O mankind, there has come to you: the Messenger, a proof, an admonition, the truth. 3:173 is about people gathering against the believers, another sentence.
tree:1t8tzjs168e8ek.relation: What has come to mankind from their Lord.

tree:04fch900zj65jg.why: The One, the Subduer, five times with different lead-ins: Yusuf in prison, the Day, the Prophet's declaration, the denial of a son.
tree:04fch900zj65jg.relation: God's oneness and supremacy in this world and on the Day.

tree:0q9o6xz033ktg7.why: Two pairs: God turning to the heaven to form it (2:29, 41:11), and the call to look at the sky (50:6, 88:18). 22:15 is a rope to the ceiling, another sense.
tree:0q9o6xz033ktg7.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 22:15.
tree:0q9o6xz033ktg7.relation: The forming of the heaven, and the call to look at it.

tree:0znxw4z18hooyb.why: Those who invite to the Fire: idolaters in marriage, Pharaoh's leaders, and Pharaoh's people calling the believer. 14:30 and 41:19 are about going to the Fire, a different structure.
tree:0znxw4z18hooyb.relation: Contrast: some invite to the Fire, while God and His believers invite to Paradise and salvation.

tree:18ovcph0hsvfi7.why: Disbelievers gathered or driven to Hell, five times with different endings.
tree:18ovcph0hsvfi7.relation: The driving of the disbelievers to Hell.

tree:10apmdu1plas5i.why: Whoever wills takes a way to his Lord: 73:19 and 76:29 identical, 25:57 and 78:39 close. 18:87 is the wrongdoer returned to his Lord for punishment, another sentence.
tree:10apmdu1plas5i.relation: The way to God is open to whoever wills.

tree:0dstooe1dmww9o.why: Two pairs: the proud man sure he would be well off if returned to his Lord (18:36, 41:50), and Lot and Ibrahim leaving their people for their Lord (29:26, 37:99). 34:50 is another sentence.
tree:0dstooe1dmww9o.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 34:50.
tree:0dstooe1dmww9o.relation: Contrast: false confidence of the proud about the return, and true migration to the Lord.

tree:15n46fj0681uph.why: Two pairs: enjoyment for a little, then forced into a harsh punishment (2:126, 31:24), and Satan leading to the punishment of the blaze (22:4, 31:21). 9:101 is about the hypocrites, another sentence.
tree:15n46fj0681uph.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 9:101.
tree:15n46fj0681uph.relation: Short enjoyment then punishment; Satan's call leading to the blaze.

tree:0c6cdqg1kbu5oo.why: The angels telling Ibrahim they are sent to Lot's people, three times. 4:90 and 48:16 are about other peoples.
tree:0c6cdqg1kbu5oo.relation: The angels' mission to Lot's people.

tree:1872xmk0fdh5q0.why: God sending down the Book to the Prophet, each time with a purpose: to judge, as a guardian over earlier books, as a mercy, to be believed in, to worship sincerely.
tree:1872xmk0fdh5q0.relation: What the Book was sent for.

tree:0x1gmm01vqeetc.why: The Prophet commanded to worship God and forbidden to worship what they call on: 6:56 and 40:66 identical openings, the others the positive command.
tree:0x1gmm01vqeetc.relation: What the Prophet was commanded and forbidden to worship.

tree:1vfbhrz1w7zy3v.why: The Hour is coming, five times with changes in particles and endings a memorizer must hold.

tree:1h1xc7m1vuly9q.why: Satan as a clear enemy: to Adam and his wife, to man (Ya'qub's warning, the Prophet's), disobedient to the Merciful, and an enemy to take as an enemy.
tree:1h1xc7m1vuly9q.relation: The many warnings that Satan is man's sworn enemy.

tree:1r9re960y6q51s.why: A stock opening about the wrongdoers, followed by different predicates in unrelated contexts; nothing to learn from the grouping.

tree:0kiho091qtfbt3.why: If you turn away: 5:92 and 64:12 are identical, and the others give other consequences (you cannot escape God, I ask no wage, you would spread corruption).
tree:0kiho091qtfbt3.relation: What turning away means: the Messenger has only to deliver, and the loss is yours.

tree:1g9li490ug2wxz.why: Statements about Hell: 9:49 and 29:54 end identically (it surrounds the disbelievers), and the others name it as the appointed place, the recompense and the ambush.
tree:1g9li490ug2wxz.relation: Hell waiting for those who deny.

tree:0der3h813t8bxm.why: Two pairs: your Lord is God who created in six days (7:54, 10:3), and your Lord is kind and merciful (16:7, 16:47). 20:90 is Harun's word to the calf worshippers, another subject.
tree:0der3h813t8bxm.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 20:90.
tree:0der3h813t8bxm.relation: The Creator who directs everything is also the Kind and Merciful.

tree:0s6pwkv10e7bdf.why: 36:29 and 36:53 are the same single blast in Ya-Sin, first destroying a town and then raising all. The others share only a conditional.
tree:0s6pwkv10e7bdf.relation: One blast destroys, one blast raises.

tree:18mo0uu0v282pu.why: A negation pattern followed by unrelated statements; the wording diverges at once.

tree:1paiqjb1y6j7z3.why: Two pairs: there is a lesson for you in cattle (16:66, 23:21), and the rebuke in al-Qalam, do you have what you choose, what you judge (68:38, 68:39). 2:61 is another subject.
tree:1paiqjb1y6j7z3.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 2:61.
tree:1paiqjb1y6j7z3.relation: The lesson of cattle, and the deniers' baseless claims.

tree:1taty201d2b04e.why: Two pairs in the same form: there is nothing whose stores are not with Us or that does not glorify Him (15:21, 17:44), and no town not destroyed and no nation without a warner (17:58, 35:24). 4:159 is about the People of the Book, another subject.
tree:1taty201d2b04e.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 4:159.
tree:1taty201d2b04e.relation: All things owned by God and praising Him; every nation warned and every town judged.

tree:0wdk1cj1vw0nfr.why: Scattered conditionals with different subjects; the Anfal pair is its own card.

tree:0hhrwsb1uy2l77.why: 2:90 and 2:105 both describe resentment that God should send His favour on whom He wills, among the People of the Book and the idolaters. The others ask for a table or a sign, another subject.
tree:0hhrwsb1uy2l77.relation: Envy of God's choice of whom to favour.

tree:0hmhdae1ya25aw.why: Then we would be: sinners, wrongdoers, losers, astray; said by witnesses, Yusuf's brothers, Yusuf, and Thamud. Endings a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:0hmhdae1ya25aw.relation: People naming what they would become if they did a thing.

tree:1gm8tgv1ilkjcx.why: To our Lord we return (the magicians twice, the traveller's prayer) and to our Lord we turn in hope (9:59, 68:32); close endings a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:1gm8tgv1ilkjcx.relation: Return to God faced with certainty, and hope in Him.

tree:1l8zskj1t6p1k3.why: Yusuf's brothers promising to guard and care for him and his brother (12:11, 12:12, 12:63), then God promising to guard the Reminder (15:9) and record good deeds (21:94).
tree:1l8zskj1t6p1k3.relation: Contrast: the brothers' broken promise to guard, and God's promise to guard the Quran.

tree:1scroiq0qvze1w.why: Indeed We: sent down the Reminder and the Quran, inherit the earth, give life and death. Two clear pairs inside.
tree:1scroiq0qvze1w.relation: God's acts of majesty: revelation, life and death, inheritance.

tree:0bk8xiu19im1bm.why: What God caused to grow on the earth, with close endings a memorizer must keep apart (weighed, noble, delightful); 15:19 and 50:7 open identically.
tree:0bk8xiu19im1bm.relation: The earth spread out and every kind of plant made to grow.

tree:12h98s80p25p8c.why: Accusations against prophets: you are bewitched (26:153 and 26:185, Salih and Shu'ayb), you are joking (Ibrahim), you are ungrateful (Pharaoh to Moses). 79:43 is about the Hour, another sentence.
tree:12h98s80p25p8c.relation: What the prophets were called by their peoples.

tree:04zm47f1qt892x.why: You cannot escape God: five times, 29:22 and 42:31 close in wording.
tree:04zm47f1qt892x.relation: No escape from God's promise and power.

tree:0tnqule0ejm28g.why: Sinning while you know: setting up rivals, mixing truth with falsehood (2:42 and 3:71 a pair), devouring wealth, betraying trusts.
tree:0tnqule0ejm28g.relation: Wrong done knowingly is the gravest.

tree:10cite70qlu10j.why: Prophets' verdicts on their peoples: Lot's three times with different words, Salih's, and the town's messengers; 7:81 and 36:19 end the same way.
tree:10cite70qlu10j.relation: How prophets named their peoples' sin.

tree:0ovtso01ujhojw.why: Two pairs: do not die except as Muslims (2:132, 3:102), and so will you submit (11:14, 21:108). 3:80 is another sentence.
tree:0ovtso01ujhojw.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 3:80.
tree:0ovtso01ujhojw.relation: The command to die in submission, and the call to submit.

tree:0ps4wsf0b6i3qj.why: Idols as mere names given by the idolaters and their fathers (7:71, 12:40, 53:23, nearly identical), and Ibrahim telling his people they and their fathers were astray.
tree:0ps4wsf0b6i3qj.relation: Ancestral idolatry exposed as names without authority.

tree:0dgc2os1ten7xw.why: 2:91 and 3:84 are a sharp contrast: we believe only in what was sent to us, against we believe in what was sent to us and to all the prophets. 6:157 and 25:21 are the deniers' demands for a book or angels. 5:114 is Jesus' prayer.
tree:0dgc2os1ten7xw.changes: Split into the contrast pair and the demands pair, and removed 5:114.
tree:0dgc2os1ten7xw.relation: Contrast: exclusive belief against belief in all the prophets; and the deniers' demands.

tree:06ds7z70h0e0mx.why: Those God favoured: the prophets and the righteous (4:69, 19:58), the two God-fearing men (5:23), and, right after 4:69, the hypocrite who calls it God's favour that he missed martyrdom. 33:37 is about Zayd, another subject.
tree:06ds7z70h0e0mx.relation: Contrast: true favour is being with the prophets and martyrs; the hypocrite thinks it is escaping them.

tree:1yui02315v4sld.why: 2:9, 3:69, 4:113 and 6:26 say the plotters deceive or ruin only themselves. 18:51 is about their own creation, another sentence.
tree:1yui02315v4sld.relation: Evil plotting harms only the plotter.

tree:1mv965t1dsio77.why: 24:6 and 24:8 are the oaths of the curse procedure, the husband swearing he is truthful and the wife that he is a liar; 12:51 has the wife of al-Aziz confess that Yusuf is truthful. 10:83 and 21:59 are other judgements of a person.
tree:1mv965t1dsio77.relation: Testimony to truthfulness: an oath against an oath, and a confession that clears Yusuf.

tree:1fitkh7004uiwx.why: How are they turned away: after the truth about the Messiah, after admitting God created all (29:61, 43:87), and in the curse on the hypocrites and those who claim a son (9:30, 63:4).
tree:1fitkh7004uiwx.relation: Wonder at people who turn from the truth they half admit.

tree:0ocopgd0i4fxp1.why: 7:96, 7:97 and 7:98 are a run about the people of the towns: had they believed, and do they feel safe from punishment by night or by day. 12:109 and 59:7 use the phrase in other senses.
tree:0ocopgd0i4fxp1.changes: Removed 12:109 and 59:7: other senses of the phrase.
tree:0ocopgd0i4fxp1.relation: The towns that could have been blessed, and their false sense of safety.

tree:13gjcf11l6d9iz.why: Messengers came with clear proofs: they would not believe (7:101, 10:74), God did not wrong them (9:70, 30:9), you kept doubting Yusuf (40:34). Two exact pairs a memorizer must hold.
tree:13gjcf11l6d9iz.relation: Clear proofs rejected, and the rejecters wronging themselves.

tree:1fjmtiq0yd2kv0.why: Seek refuge in God: from Satan's prompting (7:200, 41:36, a classic pair with different endings) and from the arrogant disputers (40:56). 24:6 and 24:8 are oaths by God, a different structure, and kept in another card.
tree:1fjmtiq0yd2kv0.changes: Removed 24:6 and 24:8: oaths, not seeking refuge.
tree:1fjmtiq0yd2kv0.relation: Refuge in God from Satan and from the arrogant.

tree:0z6b5xb15q0yqn.why: Whoever does this with God has then: grasped the firm handhold, been guided, invented a sin, strayed far, been barred from Paradise. 4:48 and 4:116 are the classic pair.
tree:0z6b5xb15q0yqn.relation: Holding fast to God against associating others with Him, and the outcome of each.

tree:1bgkoay0hx74ga.why: What appears to them on the Day: what they hid, what they never reckoned, the evil of their deeds (39:48 and 45:33 nearly identical). 12:35 is the decision to imprison Yusuf, another sense.
tree:1bgkoay0hx74ga.changes: Removed 12:35: the verb means a decision occurred to them.
tree:1bgkoay0hx74ga.relation: On the Day the hidden comes out.

tree:0boybfs05ls6uw.why: Clear authority: demanded by the deniers, brought by Moses, demanded of the deniers, and even demanded of the hoopoe. The phrase means a clear proof each time.
tree:0boybfs05ls6uw.relation: Who has a clear proof, and who only demands one.

tree:15w1jmd12hxxa7.why: Only a short stock closing, give good news to the believers, is shared; the subjects are unrelated.

tree:03yzato1ugh99q.why: God's covenant: fulfil it, do not sell it for a small price (3:77 and 16:95), the believers who fulfil it.
tree:03yzato1ugh99q.relation: Keeping God's covenant against selling it cheap.

tree:18r4m9q0ucuwze.why: Killing the prophets unjustly, four times in the charges against the Children of Israel, worded differently. 22:40 is about believers driven out unjustly, another subject.
tree:18r4m9q0ucuwze.relation: The killing of prophets as a mark of rebellion.

tree:0qnt5yc10c4wts.why: Only a short particle phrase before a negation is shared; the subjects are unrelated.

tree:1mc5u680q2muqu.why: Rewarded for their patience: the oppressed given the land, the believers on the Day, the servants of the Merciful, the People of the Book twice over, the righteous with Paradise.
tree:1mc5u680q2muqu.relation: Patience as the cause of reward.

tree:0manr8i1me6nj4.why: God knows best what is in the selves, the hearts and the breasts: four ayat on the same point. 53:36 is about the scrolls of Moses, another subject.
tree:0manr8i1me6nj4.relation: God alone knows what the heart hides.

tree:11o10ao0jhnq8i.why: If God took people to task for what they earned: 18:58 and 35:45 say He would hasten the punishment or leave no creature, and 42:34 that He pardons much. 4:88 and 6:70 use the phrase for other things.
tree:11o10ao0jhnq8i.relation: God's patience: He could punish at once, but He delays and pardons.

tree:06yxvpa0yxcyoo.why: Two pairs: whenever a messenger came with what they did not desire, some were denied and some killed (2:87, 5:70); do you inform God of what He does not know (10:18, 13:33). 2:171 is another sentence.
tree:06yxvpa0yxcyoo.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 2:171.
tree:06yxvpa0yxcyoo.relation: Rejecting messengers out of desire; claiming to know what God does not.

tree:0nlteb10gcbvsv.why: Only a pronoun and the name of God are shared; five unrelated contexts.

tree:1r0h4uj1vpr399.why: 2:27, 13:21 and 13:25 are about joining what God commanded to be joined: those who cut it and those who keep it. 5:117 and 6:70 share only words across a break.
tree:1r0h4uj1vpr399.changes: Removed 5:117 and 6:70: only words across a break are shared.
tree:1r0h4uj1vpr399.relation: Contrast: those who keep ties God commanded and those who cut them.

tree:0d0la6e1r4q936.why: The deniers' reply, we reject what you were sent with, in several nations, with small differences.
tree:0d0la6e1r4q936.relation: One answer from every nation to its messengers.

tree:15kbcvn1ytqwnn.why: 2:121 and 11:17 both say they believe in it, and whoever disbelieves in it, with different endings. The other three share only two words.
tree:15kbcvn1ytqwnn.relation: Belief in the Book, and the fate of whoever rejects it.

tree:0kl66vh0ejwjcz.why: Except those who repented after that: five places with small changes (after, before, after it) a memorizer must catch.
tree:0kl66vh0ejwjcz.relation: The door of repentance kept open.

tree:1rg725r1lozmaz.why: 4:59 and 24:2 tie a ruling to the same condition, if you believe in God and the Last Day. The others use belief in God in other sentences.
tree:1rg725r1lozmaz.relation: Faith in God and the Last Day as the condition for obeying a ruling.

tree:0d5bxwu0o6ny58.why: When we are dust and bones: the deniers' question five times, with endings a memorizer must hold (brought out, raised, judged).
tree:0d5bxwu0o6ny58.relation: The denial of resurrection and judgement.

tree:0bb07lo1mgsl70.why: Five surah openings with the revelation of the Book, three identical and two that differ (32:2 and 40:2).
tree:0bb07lo1mgsl70.relation: The Book from God the Mighty, the Wise.

tree:1epxevq0djn6jw.why: The Prophet told to turn away from the deniers: for a while (37:174, 37:178), you are not to blame, until the Day of the caller. 27:28 is Solomon's order to the hoopoe, another story.
tree:1epxevq0djn6jw.relation: Turning from the deniers and leaving them to what is coming.

tree:0jgqoe00mxw1v8.why: Then to Him you return: after life and death, after the dead are raised, after sleep, after creation is repeated, after intercession belongs to Him. The endings differ slightly (you return, they return, your return).
tree:0jgqoe00mxw1v8.relation: Every account of life, death and creation ends in the return to God.

tree:0o4bwm401kngyy.why: A messenger came to them, and was rejected: by the People of the Book, the Children of Israel, a town, Quraysh, and Pharaoh's people. 44:13 and 44:17 differ in one word.
tree:0o4bwm401kngyy.relation: The messenger came; the people turned away.

tree:018s8e11mphq1x.why: What the idolaters ascribed to God: partners from the jinn, a share of crops and cattle, partners who create, partners without names, rivals. Two close pairs inside (13:16 and 13:33).
tree:018s8e11mphq1x.relation: The forms of associating others with God.

tree:0mwuwqe1oef9bg.why: No blame on you if: seeking trade in Hajj, shortening prayer, entering empty houses, older women laying aside outer garments, eating together.
tree:0mwuwqe1oef9bg.relation: Dispensations that show the ease in the law.

tree:0tossab11f7mu7.why: Those who strove in God's way, five times with small differences (in His way, in God, with wealth and selves) and different rewards.
tree:0tossab11f7mu7.relation: Striving for God and its rewards.

tree:0eobmo20oamu8o.why: 2:173 and 16:115 are the classic pair on forbidden foods with small differences; 6:119 refers to the same list and the same exception of necessity. 3:50 and 5:96 are about other prohibitions.
tree:0eobmo20oamu8o.relation: The forbidden foods and the exception for necessity.

tree:1srerx20jal3a4.why: Only a closing pair of divine names is shared, after unrelated subjects.

tree:1os80uk0o9qr48.why: The religion of Ibrahim, upright and not an idolater, four times in the same words and once in his own voice (6:79).
tree:1os80uk0o9qr48.relation: Ibrahim's pure monotheism as the model to follow.

tree:15tjbhw1dok6gg.why: God the best of providers: in Jesus' prayer, for those who die in His way, in the Prophet's asking no wage, in spending, and against trade and amusement. The lead-ins differ.
tree:15tjbhw1dok6gg.relation: Provision from God is better than anything people chase.

tree:1v6qq490qbmzkp.why: The Hereafter is better for the God-fearing: 6:32, 7:169 and 12:109 end almost the same way, and 12:57 is close. 30:38 is about giving to kin, another subject.
tree:1v6qq490qbmzkp.relation: The Hereafter is better for those who fear God.

tree:0i6js1e0aju2co.why: Better and more lasting: God for the magicians, God's provision, what is with God (28:60, 42:36 a pair), the Hereafter.
tree:0i6js1e0aju2co.relation: What lasts against the passing goods of this world.

tree:1rk3w4i0xws6jg.why: 4:59 and 17:35 end with the same phrase, that is better and best in outcome, after obedience and fair measure. The others use that is better in other sentences.
tree:1rk3w4i0xws6jg.relation: Obedience and fair dealing as the best in the end.

tree:0xpzcpi1ej7bfg.why: 17:58 and 33:6 end with the same clause, that is written in the Book. The others share only two words.
tree:0xpzcpi1ej7bfg.relation: What is decreed in the Book: the end of towns, and the order of kinship.

tree:13j2ov70erovbh.why: Names of the Last Day: gathering and witness, the threat, eternity, coming out, mutual loss; three in Qaf a memorizer must order.
tree:13j2ov70erovbh.relation: The Day named by what happens in it.

tree:1p2pu4916yzmrf.why: When they saw the punishment: followers and leaders disown each other, they hide regret (10:54 and 34:33), partners do not answer, they ask for a way back.
tree:1p2pu4916yzmrf.relation: The moment the punishment is seen, and what it reveals.

tree:09cpdyg05rn596.why: The particle after your Lord is a different word in each (no god but He, it will not benefit, they do not, no one changes).

tree:0arn3in11a8w0n.why: Prayers that begin our Lord, do not: do not take us to task, do not let our hearts swerve, do not place us with the wrongdoers, do not make us a trial (10:85 and 60:5).
tree:0arn3in11a8w0n.relation: What the believers ask God to spare them.

tree:13dcbji1bj05yy.why: 12:98 and 19:47 are a father and a son of the prophets promising to ask forgiveness: Ya'qub for his sons and Ibrahim for his father, each ending with a different name of God. The others share only my Lord, He is.
tree:13dcbji1bj05yy.relation: Promises to seek forgiveness for family, granted and not granted.

tree:0wkldyx0m4hh17.why: God is pleased with them and they with Him: four times with the same clause and different endings, and 48:18 the pledge under the tree.
tree:0wkldyx0m4hh17.relation: Mutual pleasure between God and His servants.

tree:0eldibw0fmwo42.why: The evil of what they did came back on them: 16:34, 39:48 and 45:33 almost identical, 39:51 and 40:45 close.
tree:0eldibw0fmwo42.relation: Evil deeds and plots recoil on their doers.

tree:0pwed781sk17n4.why: Two sets: except as your Lord wills, for the people of the Fire and of the Garden (11:107, 11:108); had your Lord willed, all would believe or be one nation (6:112, 10:99, 11:118).
tree:0pwed781sk17n4.relation: God's will over eternity, and His will that people differ.

tree:17hgoxt0sjteal.why: Only a word and a particle across a break are shared; the real pairs are their own cards.

tree:0omb3ti1wlhrq0.why: A single blast: three times in Ya-Sin and twice for past nations, with different results.
tree:0omb3ti1wlhrq0.relation: One cry ends a nation or raises all.

tree:1bgjddg16srksc.why: No power to harm or benefit: idols, the calf, the Prophet himself; the order of the words and the last word differ.
tree:1bgjddg16srksc.relation: Only God controls harm and benefit.

tree:0hpo6wb1mkuinf.why: 3:69 and 3:72 are two schemes of a party of the People of the Book in the same passage. The others use a party in other senses.
tree:0hpo6wb1mkuinf.relation: The plots of a party of the People of the Book against the believers.

tree:1og6ey01llodzq.why: The verb of thinking means different things here (certainty of doom, despair, false confidence) about unrelated people; no shared point.

tree:09on7rw0iwj7jo.why: The list of past nations, Noah, Ad and Thamud, five times with different lead-ins and continuations a memorizer must keep apart.
tree:09on7rw0iwj7jo.relation: The fate of past nations as a warning to the deniers.

tree:0vmfn520m1925u.why: Taste the punishment of burning, five times with different lead-ins; three of them read on into the same next clause, that is for what your hands sent forth.
tree:0vmfn520m1925u.relation: The burning punishment and its cause: what one's own hands sent ahead.

tree:0t4r0ne0td3tyq.why: 6:40, 6:47 and 12:107 warn of God's punishment or the Hour coming suddenly. 14:21 and 22:2 use the phrase in other sentences.
tree:0t4r0ne0td3tyq.relation: Do not feel safe from God's sudden punishment.

tree:15vyz0j1katbvn.why: A lasting punishment: 11:39 and 39:40 identical in Noah's words and the Prophet's, and three other places with other lead-ins.

tree:1kustv808y9guy.why: Only a stock closing pair of divine names is shared, after unrelated subjects.

tree:1p8vugq15e2t94.why: The people of Paradise reclining on couches, five places with different details; 83:23 and 83:35 identical.
tree:1p8vugq15e2t94.relation: Rest in Paradise, and the believers watching.

tree:1bjyp3512df2br.why: Illness or travel as an excuse: for fasting (2:184, 2:185) and for ablution (4:43, 5:6), plus the pledge when travelling.
tree:1bjyp3512df2br.relation: The ease God gives the sick and the traveller.

tree:0abe81q07juq8a.why: 28:78 and 39:49 are the same proud claim, I was given it by my own knowledge, by Qarun and by man in general. The others are about God's knowledge.
tree:0abe81q07juq8a.relation: The claim that wealth comes from one's own knowledge.

tree:030rtnp1foqrtp.why: Only a preposition and the word people are shared; five unrelated contexts.

tree:0i0bve508rd36x.why: In Him I trust, said by the Prophet, Shu'ayb and Ya'qub, each followed by a different clause a memorizer must hold.

tree:0ws8fdv146ieaf.why: Satan or their own scheming made deeds look good and turned them from the way: Sheba's people, Ad and Thamud (27:24 and 29:38 a pair), Pharaoh, the idolaters.
tree:0ws8fdv146ieaf.relation: Deeds made attractive, and the way blocked.

tree:1luvc861jq9xp4.why: 2:86, 2:162 and 3:88: the punishment is not lightened for them, with two different endings. 11:8 and 43:50 are about punishment delayed or lifted, other sentences.
tree:1luvc861jq9xp4.relation: No relief for those who chose this world.

tree:0suisp51e15ahp.why: God removes their misdeeds, five times with different conditions and rewards.
tree:0suisp51e15ahp.relation: Faith and good deeds wipe out sins.

tree:1q1ao6k0efot88.why: Two pairs: they changed the word for one not said to them (2:59, 7:162), and we would do other than what we did (7:53, 35:37). 4:81 is the hypocrites' night plotting, another sentence.
tree:1q1ao6k0efot88.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 4:81.
tree:1q1ao6k0efot88.relation: Changing God's word in life, and wishing to change deeds when it is too late.

tree:08zdrb81tly5jg.why: The as-Saffat refrains are the real family and are kept in another card; 26:84 only ends the same way.

tree:08xilhc0vubshc.why: Two things: do not be deceived by the disbelievers' movement in the lands (3:196, 40:4), and the mighty nations that roamed and tyrannized in the lands (50:36, 89:8, 89:11).
tree:08xilhc0vubshc.changes: Split into the warning pair and the past-nations set.
tree:08xilhc0vubshc.relation: The disbelievers' power in the land is brief; greater nations were destroyed.

tree:09s5tii17e87h8.why: Two pairs: do not plead with Me for the wrongdoers, said to Noah (11:37, 23:27), and God's way with those who passed before (33:38, 33:62). 24:19 is another sentence.
tree:09s5tii17e87h8.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 24:19.
tree:09s5tii17e87h8.relation: Noah told not to plead for the drowned; God's way does not change.

tree:0y427a10x9wqnz.why: God admits whom He wills into His mercy: 42:8 and 76:31 a pair that diverge, with three other places.
tree:0y427a10x9wqnz.relation: Admission into God's mercy, set against the wrongdoers.

tree:1cxaci21lqyg6y.why: 7:43 and 15:47 are the real pair and are kept elsewhere; the others only mention what is in the chests.

tree:1k31wod1mzqy5v.why: 6:97 and 27:63 are about guidance in the darkness of land and sea. The others use darkness in other images.
tree:1k31wod1mzqy5v.relation: God guides through the darkness of land and sea.

tree:14j76u30eyxrmz.why: Doubt: be not in doubt about it, said to the Prophet three times, and the deniers in doubt about it or the meeting with their Lord.

tree:1le1ykf16iq2cb.why: 32:5 and 70:4 are the day whose length is a thousand years and fifty thousand years, a famous pair. The others are other days.
tree:1le1ykf16iq2cb.relation: Days with God are not like our days.

tree:14buil70jik5b3.why: Firm mountains placed on the earth, five times with different companions (rivers, plants, blessing, water); 15:19 and 50:7 open alike.
tree:14buil70jik5b3.relation: The mountains as a sign of God's care for the earth.

tree:0gc9re90phwls3.why: The real pair (2:162, 3:88) is already in the card on the punishment not lightened; the others share only two words.

tree:0rleefo0kuvxei.why: 40:30 and 40:38 are the believer of Pharaoh's family addressing his people with the same opening and different appeals. The others are different men in other stories.
tree:0rleefo0kuvxei.relation: The believer's two appeals to Pharaoh's people.

tree:1aesk9o186kck2.why: The four did I not tell you ayat are already a card on their own; 26:18 is Pharaoh's different question and adds nothing.

tree:0rk7i8c0iznggu.why: Only a speech opener is shared; the Talut pair is its own card and the rest are unrelated.

tree:1rp5h1b1qzyh8l.why: Claims made with I: Iblis claiming to be better (7:12, 38:76 identical), the king claiming to give life, Pharaoh claiming lordship, set against Yusuf's I am Yusuf, followed by praise of God's favour.
tree:1rp5h1b1qzyh8l.relation: Contrast: the arrogant I of Iblis, the king and Pharaoh, and the grateful I of Yusuf.

tree:1m89uvc0l4zvlw.why: 2:68, 2:69 and 2:71 are Moses' three answers about the cow, each opening He says it is a cow. 12:28 and 27:44 are other speakers and subjects.
tree:1m89uvc0l4zvlw.relation: The questions of the Children of Israel about the cow, and how each answer narrowed it.

tree:0uljv341t9mdiw.why: 10:89 and 20:36 are both God telling Moses his prayer was answered. The other three share only a speech opener.
tree:0uljv341t9mdiw.relation: Moses' prayers granted: against Pharaoh, and for his own mission.

tree:1isiy1i0li9tb4.why: Zakariyya and Maryam each told it will be so, in Al Imran (3:40, 3:47) and again in Maryam (19:9, 19:21): two pairs of matching answers to the same wonder. 20:126 is about forgetting God's signs, another subject.
tree:1isiy1i0li9tb4.relation: The same divine answer to the old man without a child and the virgin without a husband.

tree:1f5j6ew14tveus.why: Only a speech opener with a question is shared; five unrelated questions.

tree:02xv2n404hx87g.why: They said God (or the Merciful) has taken a son: five times with the name and the reply changing.
tree:02xv2n404hx87g.relation: The claim of a son, answered each time from a different side.

tree:0b8wxhy1veeg5m.why: False claims introduced by only: we are only reformers, trade is only like usury, you are only a forger, you are only bewitched (26:153 and 26:185 identical).
tree:0b8wxhy1veeg5m.relation: Self-justifying claims of the corrupt and the deniers.

tree:0mb13j8152ew08.why: We hear and disobey, against we hear and obey, and those who say we hear but do not hear. 21:60 is about hearing of a youth named Ibrahim, another sense.
tree:0mb13j8152ew08.relation: Contrast: hearing with obedience and hearing with defiance.

tree:1os9vd70vx8mgh.why: Only a speech opener with if is shared; the if-God-willed pair is its own card.

tree:0hd4a1a0a7xbkg.why: Yusuf's brothers addressing their father five times, from the first plot to the final confession; useful to follow the story.
tree:0hd4a1a0a7xbkg.relation: The brothers' words to Ya'qub, from deceit to repentance.

tree:17pjpbo0zuj25q.why: 2:210, 14:22 and 19:39 are about the matter decided on the Day. 11:44 (the flood) and 12:41 (the dream) use the words for other events.
tree:17pjpbo0zuj25q.relation: When the matter is decided on the Day: Satan disowns, the heedless regret.

tree:04tkqye0j92b9q.why: 3:12 and 8:38 both tell the disbelievers their two possible ends: defeat and Hell, or forgiveness if they stop. The others address other groups.
tree:04tkqye0j92b9q.relation: Warning and open door to the disbelievers.

tree:09vbso70c27x2j.why: 3:151 and 8:12 are God's promise to cast terror into the hearts of the disbelievers, at Uhud and at Badr. The others are about other hearts.
tree:09vbso70c27x2j.relation: Terror cast into the enemy's hearts in two battles.

tree:0qbygrb0abtdgn.why: Hearts sealed so they do not hear, understand or know, and hearts in doubt; the endings a memorizer must hold.
tree:0qbygrb0abtdgn.relation: The sealing of hearts as the result of turning away.

tree:00uqbhl0uaq3nr.why: They were a defiantly disobedient people: Pharaoh's people (27:12, 28:32, 43:54), Noah's people, and the hypocrites.
tree:00uqbhl0uaq3nr.relation: The verdict on the nations that rejected their prophets.

tree:0ollzg61jtb0am.why: Two sets: your Lord would not destroy towns unjustly or before sending a messenger (11:117, 28:59), and your Lord is never forgetful, all-seeing, all-able (19:64, 25:20, 25:54).
tree:0ollzg61jtb0am.relation: God's justice in destroying towns, and His attributes as closings.

tree:1jpebd11ru4877.why: Only a verb of having is shared, followed by unrelated nouns.

tree:0p8r5820loqunm.why: Only a verb of having is shared; the real slip is its own card.

tree:1etqhut1r1bkf5.why: Whoever wants: the reward of this world, its life, the immediate, honour, the harvest of the Hereafter; each answered differently.
tree:1etqhut1r1bkf5.relation: What people want, and what God gives them for it.

tree:17kkxgg174q1w2.why: Women described by what they were among: Lot's wife among those left behind (three times), the Queen of Sheba among a disbelieving people, Maryam among the devout.
tree:17kkxgg174q1w2.changes: Gave 29:32 and 29:33 one row each (the old rows repeated 29:33).
tree:17kkxgg174q1w2.relation: Contrast: a prophet's wife lost, a queen guided out of her people, and Maryam among the devout.

tree:0m0vifv08f6iv9.why: They turned from the signs or were heedless of them: 6:4 and 36:46 identical, 7:136 and 7:146 end alike.
tree:0m0vifv08f6iv9.relation: Turning from the signs as the root of ruin.

tree:1yo8mkx04s805j.why: Two pairs: they disbelieved and killed the prophets (2:61, 3:112, almost identical), and the boiling drink and painful punishment for their disbelief (6:70, 10:4). 10:70 shares only the stock closing.
tree:1yo8mkx04s805j.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 10:70.
tree:1yo8mkx04s805j.relation: The cause of humiliation and of the punishment: disbelief.

tree:1ylxw7j01dv0tr.why: What God has written: what He allowed you, the land He assigned, what befalls us, His victory, and the exile of the Nadir. One verb of decree across several outcomes.
tree:1ylxw7j01dv0tr.relation: God's decree, for the believers and against their enemies.

tree:14qs0a10g2gqez.why: Prescribed for you: retaliation, the bequest, fasting, fighting, all in al-Baqara, and 2:246 the earlier nation's test when fighting was prescribed.
tree:14qs0a10g2gqez.relation: The duties prescribed in al-Baqara, and how an earlier people failed one.

tree:096ru490jk22kf.why: Only the word many is shared; five unrelated contexts.

tree:04r5hhk0donbde.why: Many of them: the People of the Book doing evil (5:66), blind and deaf (5:71), and three times in al-Hadid defiantly disobedient.
tree:04r5hhk0donbde.changes: Gave 57:26 and 57:27 one row each (the old rows repeated 57:27).
tree:04r5hhk0donbde.relation: Most of the earlier communities strayed, though some stayed on course.

tree:1r5m6cr03of2cn.why: Two sets: those without knowledge said the like of their words (2:113, 2:118), and so your Lord has said, the answer to Zakariyya, to Maryam and to Ibrahim's wife (19:9, 19:21, 51:30).
tree:1r5m6cr03of2cn.relation: The same reply to three wondering at a child; and the deniers repeating one another.

tree:1esski00vmrq28.why: Two sets: lists of prophets each closed with all were among the righteous, the patient, the best (6:85, 21:85, 38:48); and all is from God or our Lord (3:7, 4:78).
tree:1esski00vmrq28.relation: Prophets praised by their virtues; and everything coming from God.

tree:1pkwskt13ntay1.why: Your Lord's word was fulfilled in truth and good, and became due on the disobedient and the disbelievers; close wording a memorizer must hold.
tree:1pkwskt13ntay1.relation: Contrast: the word fulfilled as a promise, and as a sentence.
