tree:0aw50nn1ltudhz.why: You were a people: disobedient, transgressing, wasteful, criminal, ruined. Five verdicts in the same frame.
tree:0aw50nn1ltudhz.relation: How the Quran names the guilt of those it addresses.

tree:1p0557s1qyvioy.why: Do not consume: wealth unjustly (2:188, 4:29 a pair), usury, orphans' wealth, meat not slaughtered in God's name.

tree:1fj3igb1brorcb.why: 17:75, 17:77 and 17:86 are in one passage of al-Isra: you would find no helper, no change in Our way, no advocate. 7:17 and 58:22 use the verb in other sentences.
tree:1fj3igb1brorcb.relation: Warnings to the Prophet and the fixed way of God.

tree:0xz2qdn0gw89y7.why: Do not think: that the martyrs are dead, that the boasters escape, that God is unaware, that He breaks His promise, that the disbelievers escape.
tree:0xz2qdn0gw89y7.relation: Correcting what people assume about God and the unseen.

tree:1oit5un05q30df.why: Do not go near: prayer while drunk, indecencies, the orphan's wealth (6:152 and 17:34 a pair), adultery.
tree:1oit5un05q30df.relation: The commands to keep away from what leads to sin.

tree:0gzqwaw07fj996.why: Do not say: a word of mockery, that martyrs are dead, that a greeter is not a believer, more than the truth about God, lies about lawful and unlawful.

tree:14w60v20a0m694.why: No doubt: 11:22 and 16:109 are the classic pair (the greatest losers, the losers), and the other three state other certainties.
tree:14w60v20a0m694.relation: Certain outcomes stated with the same emphatic opening.

tree:1g8fmnx1uguxmz.why: They do not see: the hypocrites in darkness, the heedless with eyes, the idols, the blind who look at the Prophet, those barred.

tree:01mynfv0km4f3b.why: Let them not grieve you: those rushing into disbelief (3:176, 5:41), their words, their disbelief.
tree:01mynfv0km4f3b.relation: Comfort for the Prophet against the deniers.

tree:1tp5huo0aqd5t2.why: 21:95 and 36:31 say the destroyed towns and generations do not return. The others use the words for other things (the deaf hypocrites, Pharaoh's assumption, the transformed).
tree:1tp5huo0aqd5t2.relation: The destroyed do not come back.

tree:0i1c97500x98bp.why: They are not too proud: the angels and those near God (7:206, 21:19, 16:49), the believers who fall prostrate, and Christians who weep at the revelation.
tree:0i1c97500x98bp.relation: Humility before God as a mark of those near Him.

tree:18wp5oh1lrouxp.why: The real pair (10:18, 13:33) is kept in another card; the rest use the verb in unrelated senses.

tree:01t7s9b1850rd9.why: What has no power: idols over harm, benefit or provision, the calf, people on the Day, the false intercessors.
tree:01t7s9b1850rd9.relation: Nothing besides God controls harm, benefit, provision or intercession.

tree:0ksbhzi0u49vy2.why: On that Day nothing benefits: late faith, wealth and sons, excuses (30:57 and 40:52 close), faith on the day of victory.
tree:0ksbhzi0u49vy2.relation: What will be of no use on the Day.

tree:0vut45i1ypyjvg.why: Two pairs: their fathers neither understood nor were guided (2:170, 5:104), and the Queen of Sheba's people not guided, then she tested (27:24, 27:41). 4:98 is about the helpless who find no way out.
tree:0vut45i1ypyjvg.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 4:98.
tree:0vut45i1ypyjvg.relation: Blind imitation unguided; and the queen who found guidance where her people had not.

tree:1wu8pwl0n9q7nr.why: Only a stock closing about people of understanding is shared, after unrelated subjects.

tree:0k8llgj1jpwkez.why: Evil is what they did: four in al-Ma'ida, two pairs back to back with different last verbs a memorizer must catch. 2:102 is a different form about what they sold themselves for.
tree:0k8llgj1jpwkez.relation: The condemnation of those who did and allowed sin.

tree:0hk3yjv1nyqobj.why: 17:2 and 32:23 say the Book given to Moses was made a guidance for the Children of Israel. The others mention them in other sentences.
tree:0hk3yjv1nyqobj.relation: The Torah as guidance for the Children of Israel.

tree:0w3qhdj1al1svp.why: God is kind and merciful to people, said after the qibla, the burdens carried by cattle, the threat delayed, the subjected earth and the revelation; three forms a memorizer must keep apart (to people, your Lord, to you).
tree:0w3qhdj1al1svp.relation: God's kindness shown in law, nature and revelation.

tree:1pa2wop0r76ek7.why: The punishment of the Hereafter is harder, more lasting, greater, more shameful: five places with different comparatives.
tree:1pa2wop0r76ek7.relation: Worldly punishment is small next to the punishment of the Hereafter.

tree:06hhgnk13j54lu.why: God's curse: on the disbelievers, on those who die as disbelievers (2:161, 3:87 a pair), on the wrongdoers (7:44, 11:18 a pair that read on into the same description).

tree:0eid2i10y8t39j.why: There was in it a sign, a lesson, a good example: Yusuf's story at its start and end, the Prophet and Ibrahim as models (33:21, 60:6), Saba as a sign.
tree:0eid2i10y8t39j.relation: Where the Quran points for lessons and models.

tree:0k6v2sx0pmwrif.why: Were it not for a prior word from your Lord, it would have been judged between them: five places, 11:110 and 41:45 identical.
tree:0k6v2sx0pmwrif.relation: God's delay of judgement on those who differ.

tree:1mtucsl0ojb771.why: What you have no knowledge of: Noah's request, the command not to follow it, and parents pushing to associate (29:8 and 31:15 a pair). 17:86 is another sentence.
tree:1mtucsl0ojb771.relation: Do not ask, follow or obey in what you have no knowledge of.

tree:0ufb9dg1vo57w4.why: 2:229, 4:19 and 33:53 forbid what is not for you regarding wives: taking back the dower, inheriting women, hurting the Prophet or marrying his wives. 4:176 and 27:60 share only words.
tree:0ufb9dg1vo57w4.changes: Removed 4:176 and 27:60: only words are shared.

tree:1m1f9tw1qk3dfs.why: It is better for you, and if you: 8:19 and 9:3 are a pair, and 4:170 the same choice for mankind. 3:160 and 24:28 share only words.
tree:1m1f9tw1qk3dfs.changes: Removed 3:160 and 24:28: only words are shared.
tree:1m1f9tw1qk3dfs.relation: The choice put to the opponents: stop and it is better, turn away and you cannot escape.

tree:1wq5f55115xvyx.why: Only a relative clause with a negation is shared, followed by unrelated verbs and subjects.

tree:0rd3aho1767lre.why: And for the disbelievers is a punishment: humiliating or painful, twice in al-Baqara and back to back in al-Mujadila; endings a memorizer must hold.
tree:0rd3aho1767lre.changes: Gave 58:4 and 58:5 one row each (the old rows repeated 58:5).

tree:0pyen4k0phiwy0.why: If you do not find: water (4:43, 5:6 a pair), a scribe, anyone at home, something to give; each followed by an easier way.
tree:0pyen4k0phiwy0.relation: The ease the law gives when one cannot find what is required.

tree:02vkr8j09d3anx.why: 2:151 and 2:239 end the same way, God taught you what you did not know. The others use the words in other sentences.
tree:02vkr8j09d3anx.relation: Remembrance as thanks for what God taught.

tree:0r6br9i0b8uljk.why: 6:77 and 6:78 are Ibrahim watching the moon and the sun rise, with the same words; 6:76, the ayah before, is the star, the first step of the same argument. 11:70, 12:28 and 33:22 share only when he saw.
tree:0r6br9i0b8uljk.changes: Kept 6:77 and 6:78 and added 6:76, the star, which starts the same sequence.
tree:0r6br9i0b8uljk.relation: Ibrahim's reasoning from the setting of star, moon and sun to the One who does not set.

tree:056ga4y1ym193w.why: When they saw the punishment: they hid regret (10:54, 34:33), they believed too late (40:84, 40:85), they asked for a way back.
tree:056ga4y1ym193w.relation: Faith and regret that come when the punishment is seen are of no use.

tree:0szubqq16weaye.why: You are among the messengers, and Elias, Lot and Jonah among the messengers: the same phrase for the Prophet and for three prophets in as-Saffat.
tree:0szubqq16weaye.relation: The Prophet named in the line of the messengers.

tree:1f33kpr0fjqlef.why: It is not for us to: return to idolatry, associate, bring a proof without leave, speak a slander, take protectors besides God. Each said by believers or the worshipped.
tree:1f33kpr0fjqlef.relation: What is not fitting for the believers and the righteous.

tree:02anlwq07l23n6.why: To Him belongs the dominion: 35:13 and 39:6 identical in the frame that is God your Lord, and 6:73 and 64:1 the same. 2:247 is about Talut's kingship, another subject.
tree:02anlwq07l23n6.changes: Removed 2:247: kingship of a man, another subject.

tree:00tgo9h1daw06l.why: Only a pronoun and a preposition are shared; five unrelated contexts.

tree:1vdoxjw1wv3gho.why: Their reward: unfailing (41:8, 84:25, 95:6 with a small change), great, generous.
tree:1vdoxjw1wv3gho.relation: The reward of faith and good deeds and of spending.

tree:0961wa50yogs5t.why: Satan made their deeds seem good to them: five places with different consequences; 27:24 and 29:38 a close pair.

tree:1cxu5x11v71909.why: 7:183 and 68:45 are identical: I give them respite; My plan is firm. The others share only two words.
tree:1cxu5x11v71909.relation: God's respite to the deniers is part of His plan.

tree:0gdscle169xyxa.why: They have no knowledge of it: about the Messiah's killing, the claim of a son, their idols, the angels as females. 9:120 is about deeds recorded, another sense.
tree:0gdscle169xyxa.relation: Claims about God made without knowledge.

tree:05tiryh0z7sj19.why: Theirs is an evil reckoning, an evil home (13:25 and 40:52 a pair), an evil punishment. 9:37 is about evil deeds made to seem good, another phrase.
tree:05tiryh0z7sj19.relation: The evil end of those who break covenants and reject.

tree:1bjivm40rl8ojk.why: If you ask them who created, they will say God: five places with different answers to their admission.
tree:1bjivm40rl8ojk.relation: The idolaters' own admission used against them.

tree:1od7wlm0epyrtg.why: 16:64 and 20:2 state why the Book was sent down to the Prophet: to make clear, and not to make him miserable. The others share only the verb.
tree:1od7wlm0epyrtg.relation: The purpose of the revelation to the Prophet.

tree:0rfnnvc08eomzi.why: Two sets: the creed of belief in what Moses, Jesus and the prophets were given (2:136, 3:84), and wanting what others were given: the deniers asking for what the messengers and Moses got, and the worldly wishing for what Qarun got (6:124, 28:48, 28:79).
tree:0rfnnvc08eomzi.changes: Split into the creed pair and the set about wanting what others were given.
tree:0rfnnvc08eomzi.relation: Faith in what the prophets were given, against envying what others were given.

tree:1rw3l5z14s0djn.why: 6:106, 18:27 and 29:45 command the Prophet to follow or recite what was revealed to him. 6:145 and 53:10 use the words otherwise.
tree:1rw3l5z14s0djn.relation: Holding to the revelation: follow it, recite it, and pray.

tree:13pzalb0jsdu5x.why: Two things: shares of what the deceased left (4:11, 4:12, 4:176), and God would not leave a single creature if He took people to task (16:61, 35:45, a close pair).
tree:13pzalb0jsdu5x.changes: Split into the inheritance set and the pair on God's delay.
tree:13pzalb0jsdu5x.relation: The inheritance shares; and God's patience in delaying punishment.

tree:11oxpun1odfsel.why: What God forbade, in unrelated contexts (Israel's self-ban, food, the ten commands, the People of the Book, the calendar); nothing ties them.

tree:04n1l8m17ctsq0.why: We did not create the heavens and earth in play or in vain but with truth: five places with small changes (heaven or heavens, playing or vain).

tree:1o5tgsy04zwzr2.why: 2:63 and 7:171 are the same command under the raised mountain, take what We gave you with strength and remember what is in it. The others share only two words.
tree:1o5tgsy04zwzr2.relation: The covenant under the mountain, told twice.

tree:1f0yfz81tfq4fs.why: The except-what-has-passed set is its own card; the others share only two words.

tree:1ufs7ct0uscx0l.why: What a soul or one's hands sent ahead, five times: evil sent ahead, forgotten, to be examined for tomorrow, seen on the Day, known on the Day.
tree:1ufs7ct0uscx0l.relation: Every deed sent ahead will be met.

tree:00gp14n025g88f.why: They have whatever they wish, in Paradise or with their Lord, with different endings; a memorizer set.
tree:00gp14n025g88f.relation: The fulfilment of every wish in Paradise.

tree:07kry780wzsxio.why: They died while disbelievers or defiant: five places, with consequences that differ.
tree:07kry780wzsxio.relation: Dying in disbelief seals the outcome.

tree:17glh171srpdz1.why: 3:133 and 57:21 are the classic pair: hasten or race to forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden as wide as heaven and earth. The others share only two words.
tree:17glh171srpdz1.relation: The race to forgiveness and Paradise.

tree:132jhkc1cjmnlo.why: Forgiveness and a reward great or large, five times after different deeds (faith, patience, lowered voices, fear unseen).
tree:132jhkc1cjmnlo.relation: The deeds that earn forgiveness and great reward.

tree:0px15tc00at31s.why: 4:7, 4:11, 4:33 and 4:176 are all inheritance rules on what parents and relatives leave. 2:248 is the relics left by Moses' family, another subject.
tree:0px15tc00at31s.relation: The share of men and women in what is left.

tree:0h01fpw0brhs4u.why: The three ayat on the rescue from Pharaoh's people are already a card; 19:6 and 40:28 only mention a family.

tree:0qa4f8b1k3wj1b.why: Who is better than: God's colouring, the religion of Ibrahim, God's judgement, one who calls to God. 18:30 is about whoever does good deeds, another sentence.
tree:0qa4f8b1k3wj1b.relation: What is best: in religion, judgement and speech.

tree:1m07gcf1bbe1hl.why: The word matter means different things here; the real same-surah pairs are their own cards.

tree:08ogfce0ezdp7s.why: Two pairs: rain that brings out fruits as provision (2:22, 14:32), and Ibrahim's two prayers for his people to be given fruits (2:126, 14:37). 7:130 is a loss of fruits as punishment.
tree:08ogfce0ezdp7s.changes: Split into the two pairs and removed 7:130.
tree:08ogfce0ezdp7s.relation: Fruits as God's provision and as Ibrahim's prayer for Mecca.

tree:1jtma7y0fzhpw4.why: Houses from the mountains: Thamud carving them (15:82, 26:149), and the bee told to take its homes in them (16:68). 16:81 and 35:27 are about shelter and coloured rock.
tree:1jtma7y0fzhpw4.relation: Contrast: Thamud's proud houses in the rock, and the bee's homes made by inspiration.

tree:09mok911fxb3cd.why: Vows to be among the grateful when in danger (6:63, 7:189, 10:22), each broken after rescue, and the command to be among the grateful (7:144, 39:66).
tree:09mok911fxb3cd.relation: Contrast: gratitude promised in danger and forgotten, and gratitude commanded.

tree:0h08ybm0aysrny.why: 7:80, 26:165 and 29:28 are Lot's rebuke to his people, a classic memorizer set. 5:20 and 5:115 use the word for other things.
tree:0h08ybm0aysrny.relation: Lot's people and a sin no one in the worlds had done before.

tree:18hekzr0wwp4ad.why: A common ending about liars, in unrelated scenes; nothing to learn from the grouping.

tree:0ewvavj1dt7l03.why: Iblis' refusal (2:34, 38:74) and the denier on the Day (39:59) share the same words: he was arrogant and became a disbeliever. 26:19 and 71:26 use the word in other sentences.
tree:0ewvavj1dt7l03.relation: Arrogance leads to disbelief, for Iblis and for man.

tree:1dbxpc816i3elm.why: 3:124, 3:125 and 8:9 are the angels sent as help, three, five and one thousand. 17:40 and 22:75 share only the word angels.
tree:1dbxpc816i3elm.relation: The help of angels at Badr and Uhud.

tree:0tecah40jvx1cq.why: 16:72, 30:21 and 42:11 say God made spouses for you from yourselves, each with a different purpose. 9:128 and 30:28 use the phrase otherwise.
tree:0tecah40jvx1cq.relation: Spouses from among yourselves as a sign and a favour.

tree:0bnf62l09hkbwx.why: The phrase from themselves is used in different senses in five unrelated contexts.

tree:05g0dj5059bf5j.why: The same principle in four places: whoever is guided is guided for himself, whoever strays strays against himself. Each ends differently (no guardian, no bearer of another's load, only a warner), a close memorizer set. 20:135 says who is guided in another structure.
tree:05g0dj5059bf5j.changes: Removed 20:135: its wording about who is guided is a different structure, not the same principle.
tree:05g0dj5059bf5j.relation: Each person carries his own guidance or straying; the messenger only conveys.

tree:0kb3fnj0u1d5in.why: Only a common connective about descent from someone is shared; the ayat speak of unrelated people and events, nothing to learn together.

tree:1pu6xow03ubjnk.why: Rivers flowing beneath them: in 6:6 beneath destroyed nations' gardens, in 7:43, 10:9 and 18:31 beneath the people of Paradise. Worldly and lasting gardens worded alike. 39:16 speaks of layers of fire beneath them, a different phrase.
tree:1pu6xow03ubjnk.changes: Removed 39:16: it describes canopies of fire, not rivers.
tree:1pu6xow03ubjnk.relation: Contrast: rivers that did not save past nations, and rivers that flow for the believers forever.

tree:13t8qlw1o6z4m6.why: Whoever brings a good deed gets better than it, whoever brings an evil deed is repaid in kind: told in 6:160, 27:89-90 and 28:84 with small differences a memorizer must keep apart. 28:85 is about the Prophet's return, not this law.
tree:13t8qlw1o6z4m6.changes: Removed 28:85: it shares only a word, not the recompense statement.
tree:13t8qlw1o6z4m6.relation: The law of recompense: good is multiplied, evil only matched.

tree:0q04mn11pzav4p.why: The only real pair here (6:70 and 10:4) is already kept in tree:1yo8mkx04s805j; the other rows share a stock phrase on different subjects.

tree:05qdfzc1dikypk.why: From before them and from behind them: Iblis's vow to come at people from every side (7:17), the barrier set before and behind the deniers (36:9), and messengers coming to Aad and Thamud from before and behind (41:14). Close wording a memorizer can confuse.
tree:05qdfzc1dikypk.changes: Kept only the three ayat that share the full phrase; the others use it loosely.
tree:05qdfzc1dikypk.relation: Encirclement from every side: by Satan's whispers, by a barrier of blindness, and by messengers who left no excuse.

tree:0oap6oz19iyajr.why: If you ask them who created the heavens and the earth, they will say God: the same question in four places with different endings. 67:14 asks whether the Creator does not know, another structure.
tree:0oap6oz19iyajr.changes: Removed 67:14: it is a different question, not the 'if you ask them' pattern.
tree:0oap6oz19iyajr.relation: The deniers admit God created everything, yet worship others.

tree:1fjolaj07mivt1.why: Male or female: the promise that no believer's deed is lost whether man or woman, and 49:13 which says all were created from a male and a female. Useful for memorizers and a clear theme of equal standing.
tree:1fjolaj07mivt1.relation: Men and women stand equal in origin and in the reward for deeds.

tree:0cm7vfr0bqbnnh.why: Bracelets of gold are the adornment of Paradise in several ayat, and in 43:53 Pharaoh mocks Musa because no bracelets of gold were thrown on him. The same rare words set worldly vanity against the reward of the believers.
tree:0cm7vfr0bqbnnh.relation: Contrast: gold Pharaoh demanded as proof, and gold given to the believers in Paradise.

tree:0dy619i0f68f2i.why: The shared words are a common connective used in unrelated contexts; no story, theme or confusion to learn from.

tree:1crluti140ysgw.why: Two separate links. 9:91 and 42:41 say there is no way of blame against the doers of good or against those who retaliate after wrong. 40:11 and 42:44 are the wrongdoers asking whether there is any way out. 42:46 shares only the word.
tree:1crluti140ysgw.changes: Split into two pairs and removed 42:46, which only shares the word for way.
tree:1crluti140ysgw.relation: No blame on the excused, and no way out for the wrongdoers.

tree:0yocs9r17nmqdl.why: Only a short common phrase is shared; the ayat speak of different subjects with nothing to compare or confuse.

tree:022kibv02k5f8x.why: The repeated seeking of refuge from evil in Al-Falaq, with the same opening in An-Nas. A memorizer must keep the four evils of 113 in order and not run into 114:4.
tree:022kibv02k5f8x.relation: The two refuge surahs: evils from outside (113) and the whisperer within (114).

tree:0kt377j10yuj37.why: The four ayat with the guidance-for-himself principle are already kept in tree:05g0dj5059bf5j. 5:105 uses the straying word in another structure (those who stray cannot harm you), so this card adds nothing.

tree:0qec7k40gn6jdm.why: 4:81 and 47:16 both describe hypocrites who say one thing in the Prophet's presence and something else once they leave him. The same scene in two surahs. The other rows use the words for something else (from you, from your side).
tree:0qec7k40gn6jdm.changes: Kept only the hypocrites pair 4:81 and 47:16; removed 4:78, 8:32 and 28:27 where the words mean different things.
tree:0qec7k40gn6jdm.relation: The hypocrites' two faces: obedient in the gathering, scheming or mocking once they go out.

tree:0bziwds0dxhuws.why: The shared words are generic (of a book) and the five ayat are on unrelated subjects; nothing to confuse or ponder together.

tree:1ru03m30lf3cff.why: Only a relative pronoun with a negation is shared; the subjects are unrelated and nothing would be confused.

tree:11773t60pk59wy.why: Saved with those with him: Nuh in the laden ship (10:73, 26:119) and Musa (26:65), against Pharaoh drowned with all who were with him (17:103). Close wording to keep apart, and a clear contrast. 7:131 is about blaming Musa for bad omens.
tree:11773t60pk59wy.changes: Removed 7:131: it is the omen accusation, not the rescue or drowning.
tree:11773t60pk59wy.relation: Contrast: the prophet and his companions saved, the tyrant and his host drowned, in the same words.

tree:07r8p1j1mdrrjt.why: Two different matches. 28:46 and 32:3 are almost identical (to warn a people to whom no warner came before you), differing in their last word. 34:34 and 43:23 are almost identical too: no warner sent to a town without its affluent ones refusing. 34:44 only shares the word warner.
tree:07r8p1j1mdrrjt.changes: Split into the two near-identical pairs; removed 34:44 with its run-on.
tree:07r8p1j1mdrrjt.relation: The affluent of every town reject the warner, and the Prophet came to a people with no warner before.

tree:10zfmxk0yohity.why: Heedless of this: the deniers on the Day admit they were in heedlessness of this (21:97, 50:22), and their hearts are in a flood of it now (23:63). 18:24 and 43:52 use the words as a plain comparison.
tree:10zfmxk0yohity.changes: Removed 18:24 and 43:52, where the words only mean nearer than or better than this.
tree:10zfmxk0yohity.relation: The heedlessness of this life, confessed too late on the Day.

tree:1reufx313rbwyr.why: From behind is shared, but the subjects differ: Ishaq and Yaqub, a screen with the Prophet's wives, God speaking from behind a veil, calls from behind the rooms, fighting from behind walls. A rare phrase alone with different subjects.

tree:0r34rfb1fonimd.why: And of them you eat closes several lists of God's gifts in livestock and fruit (16:5, 23:19, 23:21, 40:79), and in 43:73 the fruit of Paradise. Memorizers must place each closing; the last row sets worldly provision beside Paradise.
tree:0r34rfb1fonimd.relation: Gifts of this world and of Paradise named in the same words.

tree:06ce0231co2ahv.why: We know best what they say: God comforting the Prophet against the deniers' words (17:47, 20:104, 23:96, 50:45). 20:104 and 50:45 are identical in the phrase. 29:32 is the angels saying they know who is in the town, another structure.
tree:06ce0231co2ahv.changes: Removed 29:32: its phrase is about who is in Lot's town, not what the deniers say.
tree:06ce0231co2ahv.relation: Comfort to the Prophet: God knows what they say, so he need not answer every word.

tree:0lqx9rl0cemn03.why: No soul is burdened beyond its capacity: said in four places with we or God as subject, and in 65:7 as beyond what He gave it. A clear memorizer set and a principle worth pondering.
tree:0lqx9rl0cemn03.relation: God asks of each soul only what it can bear.

tree:0hu8k0c0t8lke0.why: We relate to you: God telling the Prophet the stories of towns, messengers, Yusuf and the cave youths. Similar openings to keep apart, and the purpose of the stories is stated (to make firm your heart).
tree:0hu8k0c0t8lke0.relation: Why the Quran tells stories: to strengthen the Prophet and remind.

tree:1l5c11x0vgvb23.why: Those who believed, emigrated and strove: five places that differ in what follows (in the way of God, with wealth and lives, with you) and in the reward named. A classic memorizer set, and it shows the rank of the emigrants.
tree:1l5c11x0vgvb23.relation: Faith, emigration and striving together earn mercy, true faith and the highest rank.

tree:0kbrt0q0qxtgr8.why: Prophets asking their Lord to grant them: Zakariyya a good offspring, Ibrahim wisdom and a righteous son, Sulayman a kingdom. Similar openings a memorizer must separate, and the prayers show what each prophet sought.
tree:0kbrt0q0qxtgr8.relation: What the prophets asked for: offspring, wisdom, righteous children, a kingdom.

tree:0y5lg4b0ub7nn5.why: God's guidance is the only guidance (2:120, 3:73, 6:71) and that is God's guidance by which He guides whom He wills (6:88, 39:23). Two near-identical pairs plus a variant, a strong memorizer set.
tree:0y5lg4b0ub7nn5.relation: True guidance comes only from God, against the claims of the People of the Book and the idolaters.

tree:10y4ild1rstvdb.why: Two different towns. 2:58 and 7:161 are the famous near-identical command to Bani Israil (enter / dwell in this town). 29:31 and 29:34 are Lut's town doomed for its wrongdoing, and 4:75 the oppressed asking to leave this town whose people are wrongdoers.
tree:10y4ild1rstvdb.changes: Split into the Bani Israil pair and the town-of-wrongdoers set.
tree:10y4ild1rstvdb.relation: Towns of wrongdoers: one to be destroyed, one the weak pray to escape.

tree:1xcx4y31b5faf1.why: Only divine names at the end of ayat are shared (the Wise, the All-Aware or All-Knowing). The ayat themselves are on different subjects; a stock closing is not enough for a card.

tree:0ohb9jn14cv6fh.why: 22:62 and 31:30 are nearly the whole same ayah (God is the Truth, what they call on besides Him is falsehood), differing in one word, and both read on into an ayah opening with 'have you not seen'. The other rows share only the divine names.
tree:0ohb9jn14cv6fh.changes: Kept the near-identical pair 22:62 and 31:30 with their run-ons; removed rows that share only the closing names.
tree:0ohb9jn14cv6fh.relation: God is the Truth and the idols are falsehood, said twice in nearly the same words.

tree:1u4bic90yp02u1.why: 57:24 and 60:6 end with the same clause: whoever turns away, God is the Rich, the Praised. A memorizer pair. The others share only the closing names.
tree:1u4bic90yp02u1.changes: Kept the pair with the identical clause, rows as they read on; removed rows that share only the divine names.
tree:1u4bic90yp02u1.relation: Whoever turns away harms only himself; God needs no one.

tree:1y4izzg16g8heu.why: No god but He, Lord of the Throne: the Mighty Throne in 9:129 and 27:26, the Noble Throne in 23:116. A memorizer must keep the adjective right. 6:164 and 53:49 use Lord of in other meanings.
tree:1y4izzg16g8heu.changes: Removed 6:164 and 53:49, which share only the words Lord of.
tree:1y4izzg16g8heu.relation: Tawhid sealed with God's lordship of the Throne.

tree:0slfcup19tlj5j.why: It is from God: Maryam says it truly of her provision (3:37), the distorters say it falsely of their writing (3:78), and after Uhud the believers are told it is from yourselves (3:165). 12:26-27 use the words in another structure (he is of the liars).
tree:0slfcup19tlj5j.changes: Removed 12:26 and 12:27: there the words mean he is among the liars or the truthful.
tree:0slfcup19tlj5j.relation: What truly comes from God, what is falsely claimed to, and what comes from ourselves.

tree:05g897119jo1t5.why: Woe to those who: the distorters of scripture, and the deniers from the Day, the Fire and their promised day. 19:37 and 43:65 open identically (the factions differed among themselves) and end differently, a key memorizer pair.
tree:05g897119jo1t5.relation: The threats of woe and what each is tied to.

tree:0ifb6jr0u3bic3.why: The calls to the children of Adam in Al-A'raf right after Adam's story, and the reminder of the covenant in 36:60. Together they show the lessons drawn from Adam and Iblis.
tree:0ifb6jr0u3bic3.relation: After Adam's fall, his children are warned against Satan and told to keep covered and follow the messengers.

tree:0p86umn1qlkviz.why: Those who dispute about God and His signs: three times in Ghafir with different endings, plus 13:13 and 42:35. A memorizer set and a clear theme of arrogance behind the dispute.
tree:0p86umn1qlkviz.relation: Disputing God's signs without authority comes from pride and leaves no escape.

tree:0psz2s70fwn3b1.why: God making something is a common phrase; the objects and subjects (a way for women, good in a disliked thing, no way for disbelievers, filth, light) are unrelated.

tree:0eb6na80kmewok.why: 24:43 and 30:48 describe the clouds and then the same scene: you see the rain coming out from within them. A strong memorizer pair. The other rows only share the verb of coming out.
tree:0eb6na80kmewok.changes: Kept only 24:43 and 30:48; removed the rows where the words are about other things.
tree:0eb6na80kmewok.relation: God drives the clouds and brings the rain from them, told twice.

tree:1px4hgl1sh28ef.why: Those who fear their Lord, three times with 'unseen' (21:49, 35:18, 67:12) and twice without. Easy to confuse, and the set shows what fear of the unseen brings: the warning benefits them, and they get forgiveness.
tree:1px4hgl1sh28ef.relation: Fearing God unseen is the mark of those who benefit from the reminder.

tree:17vrgwj0m8r6qf.why: Have they not seen: the shadows prostrating, the birds held in the sky (16:79 and 67:19, nearly the same), the plants of the earth, the sky and earth around them. A memorizer set calling to look at creation.
tree:17vrgwj0m8r6qf.relation: Invitations to look at creation: none holds the birds up but God.

tree:0nvcz1c02i8f00.why: Have they not seen that We: reduce the land, made night and day, made a safe sanctuary, drive water to dry land, created livestock. Same opening with different signs, a good memorizer and pondering set.
tree:0nvcz1c02i8f00.relation: Signs of God's care that people see and still ignore.

tree:1jn2sa205xdfc8.why: The shared words are only 'whom He wills, and He is' followed by different divine names, on unrelated subjects. A stock closing pattern.

tree:13gqo430gtxpcj.why: Thus God leads astray: whom He wills (14:4, 74:31, near-identical wording), the wrongdoers, the excessive doubter, the disbelievers. The set shows whom God leaves to stray, a point worth pondering.
tree:13gqo430gtxpcj.relation: God leads astray those who chose wrongdoing, excess and doubt.

tree:09crx2u072cypu.why: Two different things. 9:80, 47:34 and 63:6: God will not forgive them, said of the hypocrites and disbelievers. 12:92 and 24:22: forgiving those who wronged you (Yusuf to his brothers, the call to pardon in 24:22), with the hope that God forgives you.
tree:09crx2u072cypu.changes: Split into the never-forgiven set and the forgive-to-be-forgiven pair.
tree:09crx2u072cypu.relation: Those God will never forgive, and the forgiveness He gives those who forgive.

tree:1ass6qp0hpdzc1.why: God does what He wills: two places with 'wills' as intends and two as wishes. A known memorizer distinction. 12:32 is about Yusuf not doing what he is ordered.
tree:1ass6qp0hpdzc1.changes: Removed 12:32: there the words mean doing what he is told, not God's will.
tree:1ass6qp0hpdzc1.relation: God's will is never hindered: in the fighting of nations, a son in old age, reward and punishment.

tree:1rvlikq0s32muq.why: He has no partner in the kingdom: 17:111 and 25:2 nearly the same, with 112:4 that none is equal to Him. 4:11 and 4:85 use the words for inheritance and a share of intercession.
tree:1rvlikq0s32muq.changes: Removed 4:11 and 4:85, which use the words in unrelated rulings.
tree:1rvlikq0s32muq.relation: God has no son, no partner and no equal.

tree:03oh6vg1jkgflo.why: Then He will inform them of what they did: with 'used to do' in three forms. Easy to confuse, and each ties God's knowledge to the final account.
tree:03oh6vg1jkgflo.relation: Every deed, forgotten by people, is counted and shown on the Day.

tree:06sr55r1gzxg35.why: The Day of Sorting in five places: the day you denied, the appointed time for all, what will make you know, gathered with the first ones. Short close wordings that a memorizer mixes.
tree:06sr55r1gzxg35.relation: The Day of Judgment named as the day of separation and its appointed time.

tree:1dq9s510aq3np7.why: Whoever believes in God and the Last Day: 2:62 and 5:69 nearly identical (with word-order and ending differences), and the same phrase defining piety, the builders of mosques and the strivers. A core memorizer set.
tree:1dq9s510aq3np7.relation: Faith in God and the Last Day as the measure of righteousness, beyond lineage or service at the Sanctuary.

tree:07p59r90mgw1wp.why: Why has no sign been sent down to him from his Lord: the deniers' demand four times, each answered differently (God can send it, the unseen is God's, you are only a warner, God guides whom He wills). A strong memorizer set. 6:4 and 36:46 are a separate identical pair, kept in tree:0crx6qd1iskkdl.
tree:07p59r90mgw1wp.changes: Kept the four demand ayat; removed 6:4 and 36:46, which belong to the turning-away card.
tree:07p59r90mgw1wp.relation: The same demand for a sign, and four answers that teach why it is not given.

tree:0dmxh2j0st9fid.why: Make for me: Zakariyya asking for a sign (3:41 and 19:10, nearly identical, three days against three nights), and prophets asking for authority, a helper and an honoured name. Pharaoh uses the same words to order a tower to reach Musa's God.
tree:0dmxh2j0st9fid.relation: Contrast: prophets ask God to make things for them; Pharaoh asks Haman.

tree:1ftoon00u0367w.why: Lut's words to his people in 7:80 and 29:28 are nearly identical (an indecency none in the worlds did before you) and both read on into 'you approach men'. Other rows share only 'any one of'.
tree:1ftoon00u0367w.changes: Kept only the Lut pair with their run-ons; removed 2:285, 9:6, 33:40, 35:41.
tree:1ftoon00u0367w.relation: Lut's rebuke told twice, with a question in one and a statement in the other.

tree:10zww0512xsxmf.why: When she said: the wife of Imran vowing her child, the angels speaking to Maryam twice (3:42, 3:45, a memorizer pair), and Pharaoh's wife asking for a house in Paradise. Righteous women and what was said to or by them. 7:164 and 33:13 are groups of people, another subject.
tree:10zww0512xsxmf.changes: Removed 7:164 and 33:13, where a group speaks, not these women.
tree:10zww0512xsxmf.relation: Righteous women: their prayers and the angels' good news.

tree:1de297g1a3z81o.why: And when We said to the angels, prostrate to Adam, they prostrated except Iblis: four places, each ending differently (refused and was arrogant, asked about clay, was of the jinn, refused). A classic memorizer set. 2:58 and 17:60 share only the opening.
tree:1de297g1a3z81o.changes: Removed 2:58 and 17:60, which share only 'and when We said'.
tree:1de297g1a3z81o.relation: Iblis's refusal told four times, each adding a trait.

tree:1batbim13wylm4.why: We sent Nuh to his people: five openings of his story with different continuations (7:59 and 23:23 nearly identical). 57:26 sends Nuh and Ibrahim together, another statement.
tree:1batbim13wylm4.changes: Removed 57:26: it is about Nuh and Ibrahim's offspring, not his call to his people.
tree:1batbim13wylm4.relation: Nuh's mission told from several sides: his call, his warning, his long stay.

tree:1ygbgbb13vmzg5.why: Ibrahim, Ismail, Ishaq: lists of prophets in faith declarations (2:136 and 3:84 nearly identical with small differences), Yaqub's sons' answer, and Ibrahim's thanks for his two sons. A core memorizer set.
tree:1ygbgbb13vmzg5.relation: One line of prophets, all Muslims, against claims they were Jews or Christians.

tree:06s65uv0pgu033.why: Stronger than them in power (four places) or in might (two places): past nations stronger than the Quraysh were destroyed. Classic memorizer set with a clear lesson.
tree:06s65uv0pgu033.relation: Strength did not save the nations before.

tree:0t5jsqa02ohn6g.why: Those who disbelieved and denied Our signs, those are the companions of Hellfire: identical in 5:10, 5:86 and 57:19, with a variant in 22:51. Each is set beside a promise to the believers. 2:119 and 9:113 use the words in other sentences.
tree:0t5jsqa02ohn6g.changes: Removed 2:119 and 9:113, where the words are not this closing.
tree:0t5jsqa02ohn6g.relation: The deniers' end stated after the believers' reward, in fixed words.

tree:1ckahkb1mm8aod.why: Obey God and obey the Messenger: six places with different continuations (those in authority, beware, if you turn away, do not void your deeds). A core memorizer set on the duty of obedience.
tree:1ckahkb1mm8aod.relation: Obedience to the Messenger joined to obedience to God, and the Messenger's only duty is to convey.

tree:1mtpnuo0fzcm56.why: He has prepared for them: gardens and a noble reward for the believers, humiliating punishment, blazing fire and Hell for the deniers. The same verb sets the two ends side by side.
tree:1mtpnuo0fzcm56.relation: Contrast: what God has prepared for the foremost believers and for those who harm Him and His Messenger.

tree:0n8c7z40b6zgfe.why: A plain comparison (greater than) in unrelated contexts: fighting in the sacred month, wine, the demand to see God, creation, signs. Nothing shared in meaning.

tree:1d18dlj06jqsiv.why: The Messenger's only duty is to convey: six places, four with 'clear', with different lead-ins. A memorizer set and a principle worth pondering.
tree:1d18dlj06jqsiv.relation: Guidance is God's; the messengers only deliver the message.

tree:0z1wdmc0i0k12i.why: Surely they are the corrupters, the fools, the liars: the hypocrites described in 2:12, 2:13 and 58:18 in the same form. The other rows use the opening for other statements.
tree:0z1wdmc0i0k12i.changes: Kept the three hypocrite ayat; removed 11:5, 37:151, 41:54.
tree:0z1wdmc0i0k12i.relation: The hypocrites called what they call the believers, and judged as liars on the Day.

tree:0bjaods0tg1l1o.why: The refrain of Ash-Shu'ara: each prophet's brother calls 'will you not fear God', I am a trustworthy messenger, I ask no reward. Shu'ayb lacks 'their brother', and Ilyas in 37:124 shares the call. A key memorizer set showing all prophets with one message.
tree:0bjaods0tg1l1o.relation: Every prophet came with the same call and the same refusal of payment.

tree:0crx6qd1iskkdl.why: No sign, messenger or reminder comes to them but they turn away or mock: six places differing in a word or two (sign, messenger, reminder, prophet; turning away or mocking). A strong memorizer set.
tree:0crx6qd1iskkdl.relation: The constant answer of deniers to every sign and messenger.

tree:0eav5lq0xmamhk.why: I am only a warner: clear, a bringer of good news, to you. Six places where the Prophet or Nuh describe their role, with small differences a memorizer must keep.
tree:0eav5lq0xmamhk.relation: The messenger is a warner, not a madman or one who knows the unseen.

tree:0oi2wnm1cg5lik.why: Two near-identical pairs. 3:29 and 49:16: God knows what is in the heavens and the earth, ending in power and knowledge. 3:189 and 85:9: His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, ending powerful and witness. The others share only the closing.
tree:0oi2wnm1cg5lik.changes: Split into the two pairs; removed 3:180 and 49:18.
tree:0oi2wnm1cg5lik.relation: God's knowledge and ownership of all, each tied to a warning.

tree:0g3whfi1vzorz4.why: He is the Accepter of repentance, the Merciful, closing the repentance of Adam, of Bani Israil after the calf, Ibrahim's prayer, those who repent and make amends, and the three who stayed behind. The lead-ins differ, a memorizer set, and the stories share the theme.
tree:0g3whfi1vzorz4.relation: Repentance accepted across the stories, from Adam to the three left behind.

tree:09qah1d1p9b1cf.why: The Home of the Hereafter: for whom it is (not exclusively for a people, for the God-fearing, for those who seek no arrogance), seeking it over this life, and the real life it holds. The ayat show what earns it.
tree:09qah1d1p9b1cf.relation: The Hereafter is the true life and belongs to the humble and God-fearing.

tree:0ghkucw0d80qt8.why: Good in this world: asked for in prayer (2:201, 7:156) and promised to those who do good and emigrate (16:30, 16:41, 39:10), with different second halves about the Hereafter. A memorizer set.
tree:0ghkucw0d80qt8.relation: Good in this world, and something better in the Hereafter.

tree:1h695171rf5pi7.why: Two separate sets. 9:33, 48:28 and 61:9: He sent His Messenger with guidance to make it prevail, with one ending different in 48:28. 25:48 and 35:9: He sent the winds bringing rain. 26:27 is Pharaoh mocking the messenger.
tree:1h695171rf5pi7.changes: Split into the messenger set and the winds pair; removed 26:27.
tree:1h695171rf5pi7.relation: God sends the Messenger to revive faith and the winds to revive the earth.

tree:0p47owe05qedyy.why: This is what you used to: be promised (said to the believers), deny, hasten, call for (said to the deniers). The same frame gives the joy of one group and the rebuke of the other.
tree:0p47owe05qedyy.relation: Contrast: the promised day welcomed by believers and the denied punishment faced by deniers.

tree:0lune3t1tyemdb.why: Those who were patient: 16:42 and 29:59 identical (and rely on their Lord), and others naming the reward of patience. A memorizer set on one theme.
tree:0lune3t1tyemdb.relation: What patience earns: forgiveness, the final home, the best reward.

tree:1jhde0n0e5wud9.why: Most rows only share 'those who believe'. But 9:44 and 24:62 make a real pair about asking the Prophet's leave: true believers do not ask leave to avoid striving, and they ask leave before leaving a common matter.
tree:1jhde0n0e5wud9.changes: Kept only the leave-asking pair 9:44 and 24:62.
tree:1jhde0n0e5wud9.relation: Contrast: the believers never ask leave to stay out of jihad, yet ask leave even to step away from a gathering.

tree:1jyhoa000zwqhi.why: Those who spend their wealth: in God's way, seeking His pleasure, night and day, in ease and hardship, set against those who spend to be seen (4:38). Similar openings for a memorizer, and the set shows what makes spending accepted.
tree:1jyhoa000zwqhi.relation: Contrast: spending for God's sake multiplied, spending for show joined to Satan.

tree:1ve50is0uwv9sm.why: The Most Merciful, the Merciful is the basmala and a pair of divine names; nothing to tell apart or ponder across these places, and 1:1 with 1:3 is already a book card.

tree:0xh1f0e0r3t7em.why: The strong set (do not follow Satan's steps, he is a clear enemy) is already kept in cmp:1rm4ewm1v4bask and tree:1fbag1f0p0iwul; 28:15 is Musa's own words in his story. This card repeats them.

tree:15junsi04ctsk8.why: Until they see the painful punishment: Musa's prayer against Pharaoh (10:88), and the deniers who will not believe whatever sign comes (10:97, 26:201). Same ending in three places to keep apart. The others only name the punishment.
tree:15junsi04ctsk8.changes: Kept the three 'until they see' ayat with their run-ons; removed 15:50, 37:38, 51:37.
tree:15junsi04ctsk8.relation: Some will not believe until the punishment is before their eyes, when faith no longer helps.

tree:0wwfj4b0g93xm3.why: That is the decree of the Almighty, the All-Knowing: said after the sun, moon and night in 6:96 and 36:38, and the seven heavens in 41:12. A clear memorizer set on God's measuring of the cosmos. The other three share only the names.
tree:0wwfj4b0g93xm3.changes: Kept the three 'decree' ayat with their run-ons; removed 27:78, 40:2, 43:9.
tree:0wwfj4b0g93xm3.relation: The order of the heavens, the sun and the moon is set by the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

tree:0aec80n0ocpunj.why: Two sets. The Book, no doubt in it: 2:2, 10:37, 32:2. People of the Book, do not exceed bounds in your religion: 4:171 and 5:77, a known memorizer pair. 18:49 is the record of deeds.
tree:0aec80n0ocpunj.changes: Split into the two sets; removed 18:49.
tree:0aec80n0ocpunj.relation: The Book beyond doubt, and the warning to those given earlier books not to go to extremes.

tree:1k7ihyw1yjehwq.why: Only God's name followed by 'those' is shared; the ayat are about different people and themes.

tree:0anx5k00zlwuzu.why: Among people is one who disputes about God without knowledge (22:3, 22:8, 31:20, with 22:8 and 31:20 identical), and those who dispute God's signs without authority (40:35, 40:56). A memorizer set on one theme. 31:6 is about buying idle talk.
tree:0anx5k00zlwuzu.changes: Removed 31:6, which uses 'without knowledge' about another act.
tree:0anx5k00zlwuzu.relation: Disputing God without knowledge, guidance or a book, out of pride.

tree:0awmz110s1qomh.why: God is self-sufficient: forbearing, praiseworthy, free of need of the worlds or of you. Each ends a call to give, perform Hajj or be grateful. A memorizer set with a clear lesson.
tree:0awmz110s1qomh.relation: God needs nothing from His servants; their charity, thanks and worship benefit them.

tree:0v3b2zu0kblsr4.why: 2:187 and 2:229: these are God's limits, so do not approach them / do not transgress them. A known memorizer pair. The other rows share only God's name with 'so no'.
tree:0v3b2zu0kblsr4.changes: Kept the limits pair 2:187 and 2:229; removed the rest.
tree:0v3b2zu0kblsr4.relation: Fasting limits are not to be approached, divorce limits not to be crossed.

tree:02q7suw1bg9ak4.why: 'God has' and 'they have strayed' in unrelated contexts (Talut, killing children, Qarun, the arrogant in Hell). Nothing shared in meaning.

tree:09ty1j400nx8eu.why: The east and the west belong to God: the qibla verses (2:115, 2:142, 2:177) and the Lord of the east and west (26:28, 70:40, 73:9). A memorizer set and a lesson that direction is God's.
tree:09ty1j400nx8eu.relation: God owns every direction; righteousness is not in facing east or west.

tree:1d0det50y28jd7.why: God is full of bounty to people, but most do not give thanks: five places that differ in 'most people' and 'most of them'. A classic memorizer set. 40:57 ends 'do not know' and is about creation.
tree:1d0det50y28jd7.relation: God's bounty is everywhere and thanks are few.

tree:1bftk0z1r4odyf.why: 'One to another' describes unrelated scenes (hypocrites in private, spouses, devils whispering, the weak and the arrogant). Nothing to learn together.

tree:0ixfbce1d9tsv0.why: Then to your Lord is your return: 6:164 and 39:7 nearly identical (no bearer bears another's burden), 32:11 and 45:15 shorter. A memorizer set on personal accountability. 7:164 and 39:54 use 'to your Lord' otherwise.
tree:0ixfbce1d9tsv0.changes: Removed 7:164 and 39:54, where the words mean an excuse to your Lord and turning to your Lord.
tree:0ixfbce1d9tsv0.relation: Each soul answers for itself, and all return to their Lord.

tree:06yz80p0b6qbtp.why: Two sets. What was revealed to you and what was revealed before you: 2:4, 4:60, 4:162. That is of the news of the unseen We reveal to you, you were not with them: 3:44 (Maryam) and 12:102 (Yusuf's brothers), a famous pair.
tree:06yz80p0b6qbtp.relation: Faith in all revelation; and the Prophet told of events he never saw as proof of revelation.

tree:0731njx0ie0ga1.why: It is the same to them whether you warn them or not (2:6, 36:10), whether you preach or not (26:136), whether you seek forgiveness for them or not (63:6). The memorizer must hold the 'and' in 36:10. 23:69 and 53:36 only share the particle.
tree:0731njx0ie0ga1.relation: Hearts so closed that warning and prayer make no difference.

tree:0h9346i18as0um.why: Their wealth and children will not avail them against God (3:10, 3:116, 58:17), and do not admire their wealth and children (9:55). A memorizer set. 4:2 and 4:6 are about orphans' wealth.
tree:0h9346i18as0um.relation: Wealth and children cannot protect the deniers; they become a punishment.

tree:03m2aih0o3ewh9.why: I was commanded to be of the Muslims / the believers / the first to submit: 6:14, 10:72, 10:104, 27:91. A memorizer set on the messenger's own submission. 2:67 and 5:31 use 'that I be' in other sentences.
tree:03m2aih0o3ewh9.relation: The messenger is the first to obey what he calls to.

tree:0jczwud01wlgj7.why: Two pairs inside. Are they waiting for the angels to come to them: 6:158 and 16:33. The Hour coming on them suddenly: 12:107, 43:66 and 47:18. 18:55 is a looser variant.
tree:0jczwud01wlgj7.changes: Split into the angels pair and the sudden-Hour set; removed 18:55.
tree:0jczwud01wlgj7.relation: The deniers wait for what will come too late: the angels or the sudden Hour.

tree:0oaxnm50r4fiwv.why: 'That it be' is a grammatical frame across unrelated subjects; the trade pair (2:282, 4:29) has its own card.

tree:16geeit0r13jkl.why: 'If you fear' opens unrelated rulings (divorce, prayer in fear, orphans, marital discord, travel, poverty). Nothing to compare.

tree:1jsdtsl1vhz0xj.why: To God belongs what is in the heavens and earth: after 'if you disbelieve' (4:131, 4:170) and opened with 'surely' (10:55, 10:66, 24:64). Pairs a memorizer confuses. 8:41 is the fifth of the spoils.
tree:1jsdtsl1vhz0xj.relation: Disbelief does not harm God, who owns everything.

tree:1dhoj831tyi2k5.why: The refrain of As-Saffat: thus We reward the doers of good, after each prophet, against 'thus We deal with the criminals' (37:34). The run-ons show which prophet is called a believing servant. A key memorizer set.
tree:1dhoj831tyi2k5.relation: Contrast: the same 'thus We' for the reward of prophets and the punishment of criminals.

tree:1pagndw001lc7c.why: What was sent down to you from your Lord: follow it (7:3, 39:55, nearly the same), establish it (5:68), and believe in what was sent to you and to them (3:199, 29:46). 6:114 is about the Book sent detailed, another sentence.
tree:1pagndw001lc7c.relation: One revelation to all, to be followed and established.

cmp-card:1:1|27:30.why: The basmala opening the Quran, and quoted as the opening of Solomon's letter.
cmp-card:1:1|27:30.relation: The basmala as the opening of revelation and of a prophet's letter.

cmp-card:1:2|45:36.why: Al-Jathiya closes with the praise that opens al-Fatiha, spelling out the Lord of the worlds as Lord of the heavens and the earth. A small but real echo for pondering; a memorizer may also slip from one to the other.
cmp-card:1:2|45:36.relation: The brief praise of al-Fatiha is unfolded at the end of al-Jathiya.

cmp-card:2:14|2:76.why: When they meet the believers they say 'we believe', and when alone: with their devils (the hypocrites) or with one another (some of the Jews). Classic memorizer pair on the same double face.
cmp-card:2:14|2:76.relation: The same two-faced speech, among hypocrites and among some of the People of the Book.

cmp-card:2:16|2:175.why: The same description of those who bought error for guidance: the hypocrites, and those who hide the Book. 2:175 adds punishment for forgiveness. A memorizer pair in one surah.
cmp-card:2:16|2:175.relation: The losing trade of choosing error over guidance.

cmp-card:2:45|2:153.why: Same command to seek help through patience and prayer, first to the Children of Israel, then to the believers, with different endings. A memorizer pair and a link worth pondering.
cmp-card:2:45|2:153.relation: The command once given to Israel is given again to the believers.

cmp-card:2:47|2:122.why: The two ayat are word for word the same. The real difference is in the next ayah, where intercession and compensation swap places. A memorizer needs the pair together with the ayah after it.
cmp-card:2:47|2:122.relation: The same reminder bookends the story of the Children of Israel in al-Baqara.

cmp-card:2:48|2:123.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:2:51|2:92.why: The same rebuke for taking the calf after Musa left, once in the story itself and once as an argument against the Jews of Madina. They open differently and continue differently.
cmp-card:2:51|2:92.relation: The calf recalled twice: first as history, then as evidence against later claims of faith.

cmp-card:2:63|2:93.why: The covenant and the mount raised over them, word for word, then two different continuations: remember what is in it, or hear (and they said: we hear and disobey). Memorizer pair and a telling contrast.
cmp-card:2:63|2:93.relation: The same covenant, recalled first as a call to remember and then as the scene of their open disobedience.

cmp-card:2:89|2:101.why: The same opening, once about a book and once about a messenger, both confirming what they had. Both times a group rejects it. A close pair for a memorizer.
cmp-card:2:89|2:101.relation: Book and messenger both came confirming the earlier scripture, and both were rejected by those who expected them.

cmp-card:2:134|2:141.why: The same refrain, word for word, closing two passages on Abraham and his sons. Memorizers need to know it occurs twice; the repeat drives home that each nation answers for its own deeds.

cmp-card:2:234|2:240.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:2:25|29:58.why: Only the generic reward formula is shared. 29:58 speaks of lofty chambers and the reward of those who work, a different picture from 2:25.

cmp-card:2:119|35:24.why: The same sentence about the Prophet's mission, sent with the truth as a bringer of good news and a warner, continuing two ways. A memorizer must know which continuation goes where.
cmp-card:2:119|35:24.relation: The Prophet's mission: he is not answerable for the people of hellfire, and every nation before had a warner.

cmp-card:2:6|36:10.why: Same sentence on the disbelievers whom warning does not move, in two surahs; 2:6 opens with a particle, 36:10 with a conjunction. A clear memorizer pair.

cmp-card:2:34|38:74.why: Same scene: Iblis was arrogant and became one of the disbelievers.

cmp-card:2:218|49:15.why: Those who believe and strive in Allah's cause: they hope for His mercy (2:218), they are the truthful (49:15).

cmp-card:2:284|59:6.why: Shared only a stock closing about God's will and His power over all things. One ayah is about the reckoning of what is in the soul, the other about spoils taken without battle; nothing to ponder together.

cmp-card:2:232|65:2.why: The same reminder closes divorce rulings in two surahs, with and without 'among you' and with 'that' in two forms. Memorizer pair on the same subject.

cmp-card:3:10|3:116.why: The same sentence that wealth and children will not help the deniers against God, in two places of one surah, ending differently: fuel of the Fire in one, companions of the Fire abiding forever in the other. A classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:3:22|3:56.why: The same closing that the deniers have no helpers in this world or the next, after their deeds are made void (3:22) and after they are punished severely (3:56). A memorizer pair in one surah with one lesson: nothing saves them in either life.
cmp-card:3:22|3:56.relation: Same theme: the loss of the deniers in both worlds, once in their deeds and once in their punishment.

cmp-card:3:29|3:189.why: Only the stock closing about God's power over all things is shared. One is about God knowing what is in hearts, the other about His dominion over the heavens and the earth; the rows run on into unrelated ayat.

cmp-card:3:98|3:99.why: Two adjacent rebukes, say O People of the Book, why do you: disbelieve (3:98), bar from Allah's way (3:99).
cmp-card:3:98|3:99.relation: Two rebukes to the People of the Book.

cmp-card:3:94|61:7.why: Whoever invents a lie against Allah is a wrongdoer: after the truth about food laws (3:94), and while being called to Islam (61:7).
cmp-card:3:94|61:7.relation: Lying about Allah as the height of wrongdoing.

cmp-card:3:189|85:9.why: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and He is over all things, closing once with all-powerful and once with witness. The ending changes with the context: power in 3:189, witness over the persecutors of the believers in 85:9.
cmp-card:3:189|85:9.relation: Similarity: the same sovereignty, shown as power and as watchful witness.

cmp-card:4:5|4:8.why: Provide for them and speak to them kindly: to the weak-minded and to relatives at the division of inheritance. Same command in neighbouring ayat; worth pondering that giving is paired with kind words.
cmp-card:4:5|4:8.relation: Material help always joined to kind speech.

cmp-card:4:48|4:116.why: The same ayah on shirk twice in one surah, ending with 'invented a great sin' and 'strayed far'. The books link each ending to its context (the People of the Book, the polytheists).
cmp-card:4:48|4:116.relation: Shirk as a lie against God, and shirk as going far astray.

cmp-card:4:57|4:122.why: The same long promise to those who believe and do good, word for word, twice in one surah, then two different tails (pure spouses and deep shade, a true promise of God). In the large gardens card this tight pair is lost among nineteen rows.
cmp-card:4:57|4:122.relation: Same promise repeated, once describing the reward and once affirming God's truthfulness.

cmp-card:4:131|4:170.why: If you disbelieve, to God belongs what is in the heavens and the earth: said in one surah to the people of the Book and to all mankind, with two different endings (Free of need and Praiseworthy, Knowing and Wise) and a missing repetition in 4:170. A sharp memorizer pair.
cmp-card:4:131|4:170.relation: Same theme: disbelief does not harm God, who owns everything.

cmp-card:4:137|4:168.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:4:13|5:85.why: A repeat: both ayat are already in the large gardens card and its branches, where their different tails are shown. The pair adds nothing.

cmp-card:4:43|5:6.why: The dry ablution ruling word for word, with 'from it' added only in 5:6. A classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:4:61|5:104.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same call (4:61, 5:104, 63:5), which shows how the hypocrites and the imitators of their fathers each refuse it.

cmp-card:4:135|5:8.why: Stand firm for justice as witnesses for God, and for God as witnesses in justice: the order is reversed. A famous memorizer pair; the books explain the reversal from the context (kin versus enemies).
cmp-card:4:135|5:8.relation: Justice even against oneself and kin, and justice even towards enemies.

cmp-card:4:22|17:32.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:4:124|19:60.why: The same promise that the doers of good enter Paradise and are not wronged, ending with not a speck in 4:124 and not at all in 19:60.
cmp-card:4:124|19:60.relation: Paradise for faith with deeds, and the repentant included.

cmp-card:4:9|33:70.why: The same command, fear God and speak a right word: to guardians of orphans (4:9) and to all believers (33:70). Each row reads on into the next ayah, which shows its fruit.
cmp-card:4:9|33:70.relation: Right speech as a fruit of fearing God, in a family duty and in general.

cmp-card:4:149|33:54.why: If you show or hide something, God is: pardoning and able (4:149), knowing all (33:54). Memorizer pair with endings fitted to their context.

cmp-card:4:133|35:16.why: If He wills He can remove you and bring others, or a new creation. A short memorizer pair that reminds that people are replaceable.
cmp-card:4:133|35:16.relation: Same theme: mankind's existence hangs on God's will.

cmp-card:4:105|39:2.why: We sent down to you the Book with the truth, then its purpose: to judge between people by what God showed you, or to worship God sincerely. A memorizer pair that names two aims of revelation.
cmp-card:4:105|39:2.relation: Same theme: the Book is for just judgment and for sincere worship.

cmp-card:4:124|40:40.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same promise (4:124, 16:97, 40:40), which shows this pair's difference beside the third.

cmp-card:4:115|47:32.why: A rare clause: opposing the Messenger after guidance has become clear, with the consequence in each. Same subject.
cmp-card:4:115|47:32.relation: The fate of those who oppose the Messenger knowingly.

cmp-card:4:13|48:17.why: Both ayat are in the four-row card of the same conditional promise (4:13, 48:17, 64:9, 65:11), which shows this pair's difference beside the other two. The pair adds nothing.

cmp-card:4:170|48:4.why: Only the heavens-and-earth wording and the stock closing Knowing and Wise are shared. One calls mankind to believe, the other speaks of tranquillity and God's hosts; different subjects.

cmp-card:4:37|57:24.why: Those who are stingy and order people to be stingy, in the same words twice, with different tails: they hide God's bounty and a humiliating punishment awaits, or whoever turns away, God is Free of need and Praiseworthy. A memorizer pair on one fault.
cmp-card:4:37|57:24.relation: Same theme: stinginess that spreads to others, and God's independence from it.

cmp-card:4:95|57:10.why: Not equal are the strivers and others, yet to each Allah promised good. Same principle in two surahs.
cmp-card:4:95|57:10.relation: Ranks among believers, all promised good.

cmp-card:5:15|5:19.why: The same call to the People of the Book, our messenger has come making things clear, continuing once with what they hid of the Book and once with the gap between messengers. Memorizer pair four ayat apart.
cmp-card:5:15|5:19.relation: The messenger comes both to expose what they concealed and to end their excuse that no warner came.

cmp-card:5:55|5:56.why: Two consecutive ayat on loyalty to Allah, His Messenger and the believers: who your allies are, and that their party prevails.

cmp-card:5:62|5:63.why: Two consecutive ayat on the same people and their eating of the unlawful, ending with what they used to do and what they used to work, a classic memorizer difference.
cmp-card:5:62|5:63.relation: Blame on the sinners, then on the scholars who did not forbid them.

cmp-card:5:112|5:114.why: The disciples ask for a table from the sky, and Jesus prays for it, two ayat apart.
cmp-card:5:112|5:114.relation: The request and the prayer for the table.

cmp-card:5:88|8:69.why: Eat what is lawful and good and fear Allah: of what Allah provided (5:88), of war spoils (8:69).

cmp-card:5:76|16:73.why: Worshipping besides God what has no power: over harm or benefit for you, or over provision from the heavens and the earth. A memorizer pair and a clear argument against idols.
cmp-card:5:76|16:73.relation: Same argument: what is worshipped besides God owns nothing.

cmp-card:5:88|16:114.why: Eat of what God has provided you, lawful and good, then: fear God in whom you believe, or be grateful for God's favour. A memorizer pair whose tails differ.
cmp-card:5:88|16:114.relation: Same command: lawful provision joined to piety and to gratitude.

cmp-card:5:85|20:76.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the large gardens card, which shows the branch of that is the reward of the doers of good and of whoever purifies himself.

cmp-card:5:76|21:66.why: Do you worship besides God what does not benefit or harm you? Asked by the Prophet of the Christians (5:76) and by Abraham of his people (21:66). The same argument in two mouths, with harm and benefit in reverse order.
cmp-card:5:76|21:66.relation: Same argument used by two prophets against two kinds of false worship.

cmp-card:5:43|24:47.why: Then they turn away after that, and those are not believers: said of the Jews who seek the Prophet's judgment while they hold the Torah, and of the hypocrites who claim obedience then refuse to be judged. Both about turning from God's judgment.
cmp-card:5:43|24:47.relation: Same theme: claiming faith while refusing God's judgment.

cmp-card:5:99|24:29.why: God knows what you show and what you hide: the closing of two rulings, the Messenger's duty is only to deliver and entering uninhabited houses. A rare exact closing that a memorizer must place; the subjects differ.

cmp-card:5:97|58:7.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the four-row card of God knowing what is in the heavens and the earth.

cmp-card:5:8|59:18.why: Only the stock closing, fear God, God is aware of what you do, is shared. One ayah commands justice even toward enemies, the other to look at what one has sent ahead for tomorrow; different subjects.

cmp-card:5:118|60:5.why: Two pleas that close with the Mighty, the Wise rather than the Forgiving, the Merciful: Jesus on his people and Abraham's followers. Worth pondering why might and wisdom close a plea for forgiveness.
cmp-card:5:118|60:5.relation: Forgiveness asked of the One who is mighty enough to forgive and wise in whom He forgives.

cmp-card:6:27|6:30.why: If you could see when they are made to stand before the Fire (6:27) and before their Lord (6:30). Two scenes three ayat apart; memorizer pair and worth pondering together.
cmp-card:6:27|6:30.relation: Standing before the Fire they wish to return; standing before their Lord they confess.

cmp-card:6:40|6:47.why: Have you considered, if God's punishment came to you: two questions in one surah, one about whom they would call, one about who would be destroyed. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:40|6:47.relation: Same theme: what remains when the punishment comes.

cmp-card:6:143|6:144.why: Has He forbidden the two males or the two females, or what the wombs of the two females contain: the same question in consecutive ayat about the eight kinds of livestock, with different closings. A memorizer pair in one argument.
cmp-card:6:143|6:144.relation: Same argument: the pagan food taboos have no basis.

cmp-card:6:42|7:94.why: Seized them with hardship and affliction so they might humble themselves, with two forms of the verb. Classic memorizer pair on the same sunna.
cmp-card:6:42|7:94.relation: Hardship sent to nations to bring them to humility.

cmp-card:6:48|7:35.why: Whoever believes, or fears God, and reforms: no fear on them nor will they grieve. Both follow the sending of messengers and both are followed by the fate of those who deny Our signs. A memorizer pair with the same structure.
cmp-card:6:48|7:35.relation: Same theme: the messengers' message splits people into the reformers and the deniers.

cmp-card:6:151|7:33.why: What your Lord has forbidden: indecencies open and hidden, and associating partners. Two lists of prohibitions that overlap and differ, worth reading together.
cmp-card:6:151|7:33.relation: Same theme: the core prohibitions, listed twice.

cmp-card:6:17|10:107.why: If God touches you with harm none removes it but He; then two continuations for good (He is able over all things; none can repel His favour). Classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:6:37|10:20.why: A partial card of the demand for a sign from his Lord; both ayat belong in the fuller card proposed under the 6:37 and 13:27 pair.

cmp-card:6:62|10:30.why: The same rare clause: they are returned to Allah, their true Master, after death in 6:62 and on the Day of reckoning in 10:30.
cmp-card:6:62|10:30.relation: The return to the true Master, and the false gods lost.

cmp-card:6:116|10:66.why: They follow nothing but conjecture and they only guess: said of the majority on earth and of those who call on partners. A clear memorizer pair with one verdict.
cmp-card:6:116|10:66.relation: Same theme: false belief rests on guessing.

cmp-card:6:50|11:31.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:6:90|12:104.why: No reward asked; it is only a reminder to the worlds, with two forms of the word reminder. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:6:147|12:110.why: His might is not turned back from the criminal people: a warning after mercy (6:147) and the end of the messengers' trial (12:110).
cmp-card:6:147|12:110.relation: God's mercy is wide, but His punishment of criminals is certain.

cmp-card:6:126|16:13.why: Only a stock ending, for a people who remember, after two different subjects. Both rows read on without adding a link.

cmp-card:6:145|16:115.why: The forbidden foods with the exemption for whoever is forced, not desiring nor exceeding: then your Lord is forgiving, or God is forgiving. Different framing (I find nothing forbidden but, He has only forbidden) and a different name at the end.
cmp-card:6:145|16:115.relation: Same ruling: what is forbidden to eat and the mercy for necessity.

cmp-card:6:148|16:35.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:6:149|16:9.why: Had He willed He would have guided you all, said in 6:149 and 16:9.

cmp-card:6:152|17:34.why: Do not approach the orphan's wealth except in the best way until he reaches maturity, then fulfil: the measure and the covenant, or the covenant alone. The same commandment in two lists, a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:152|17:34.relation: Same commandment: guarding the orphan's wealth, joined to keeping one's word.

cmp-card:6:10|21:41.why: The two identical ayat are already in the three-row card of the same opening (with 13:32), which also shows the third variant. The pair adds nothing beyond it.

cmp-card:6:29|23:37.why: There is nothing but our worldly life, and we will not be raised: the deniers' creed in two places, one with the addition we die and we live. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:29|23:37.relation: Same claim: denial of resurrection, in Mecca and among earlier peoples.

cmp-card:6:11|30:42.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the fuller card of the travel-in-the-land command (6:11, 27:69, 29:20, 30:42).

cmp-card:6:159|30:32.why: The same rare clause about those who split their religion into sects, with different conclusions: the Prophet has nothing to do with them, and each faction rejoices in its own.
cmp-card:6:159|30:32.relation: The danger of sectarian division, stated twice.

cmp-card:6:4|36:46.why: The same ayah word for word in two surahs: no sign of their Lord comes to them but they turn away from it. A memorizer must know where it occurs and what follows each.
cmp-card:6:4|36:46.relation: Same theme: habitual turning away from God's signs.

cmp-card:6:15|39:13.why: A repeat: the two identical ayat are in the three-row card of the same sentence (with 10:15).

cmp-card:6:130|39:71.why: Did messengers not come to you from among you, warning of this Day: asked of jinn and men (6:130) and by Hell's keepers (39:71).
cmp-card:6:130|39:71.relation: The same question that leaves the condemned without excuse.

cmp-card:6:135|39:39.why: My people, work according to your position, I am working; you will come to know: once with the addition about whose end will be good, once shorter. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:135|39:39.relation: Same theme: the Prophet leaves the outcome to be seen.

cmp-card:6:164|39:7.why: No bearer of burdens bears another's burden, then to your Lord is your return and He will inform you of what you...: differed about, or did. A long shared run with a different tail.
cmp-card:6:164|39:7.relation: Same theme: individual responsibility and the final reckoning.

cmp-card:6:56|40:66.why: Say, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides God: then, I will not follow your desires, or since the clear proofs came to me. A memorizer pair with one stance.
cmp-card:6:56|40:66.relation: Same stance: refusing false worship, by revelation and clear proof.

cmp-card:6:102|40:62.why: That is God your Lord: 'no god but He' and 'creator of all things' in opposite order, with different endings. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:6:30|46:34.why: Is this not the truth? Yes, by our Lord. Then taste the punishment for your disbelief: the same dialogue in two scenes, standing before their Lord and shown the Fire. A sharp memorizer pair.
cmp-card:6:30|46:34.relation: Same scene: the deniers forced to admit the truth when it is too late.

cmp-card:6:132|46:19.why: For each are degrees according to what they did: then your Lord is not unaware, or so He may pay them fully without wrong. A short memorizer pair on one principle.
cmp-card:6:132|46:19.relation: Same theme: ranks follow deeds, with full and just pay.

cmp-card:6:5|50:5.why: They denied the truth when it came to them, said in 6:5 and 50:5 with different consequences.
cmp-card:6:5|50:5.relation: Denial of the truth when it arrives.

cmp-card:6:117|68:7.why: Identical except 'who strays' in the present without the preposition (6:117) and 'who strayed' with it (68:7). A sharp memorizer pair.

cmp-card:7:69|7:74.why: Remember when He made you successors after...: the people of Noah (to Ad) and Ad (to Thamud), then remember God's favours. Two prophets remind of the same favour and the chain of peoples.
cmp-card:7:69|7:74.relation: Same theme: each people inherits the land from one destroyed before it.

cmp-card:7:79|7:93.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:7:97|7:98.why: Do the people of the towns feel safe that Our punishment will come to them: at night while they sleep, in the morning while they play. Consecutive ayat that differ by the conjunction and the time.
cmp-card:7:97|7:98.relation: Same warning: punishment can come at any hour, in sleep or in play.

cmp-card:7:159|7:181.why: Same rare description of a community that guides by the truth and does justice by it: among the people of Moses, and among those We created.
cmp-card:7:159|7:181.relation: The righteous community, first among Moses' people and then in general.

cmp-card:7:39|8:35.why: Only the stock threat 'taste the punishment for what you used to' is shared, with two different endings and unrelated subjects (leaders and followers quarrelling in Hell; Quraysh's prayer at the House). Little to learn beyond the last word.

cmp-card:7:54|10:3.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the five-row card of the same phrase, where their different continuations are shown.

cmp-card:7:64|10:73.why: Noah's people denied him and We saved him and those with him in the ark: two verb forms, 'who' or 'those', 'made them successors' added, and different endings. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:7:133|10:75.why: Same verdict on Pharaoh's people: they were arrogant and a criminal people, after the plagues and after Moses' mission.

cmp-card:7:71|12:40.why: Names that you and your fathers have named, for which God sent down no authority: said by Hud, by Joseph in prison, and in an-Najm (53:23), now split into two pairs. One card shows all three.
cmp-card:7:71|12:40.relation: Same argument: idols are only names, with no proof from God.

cmp-card:7:34|16:61.why: When their term comes they cannot delay it an hour nor advance it: for every nation, and for all people despite their wrong. A memorizer pair, with a spelling difference in the verb.
cmp-card:7:34|16:61.relation: Same theme: the fixed term of nations and people.

cmp-card:7:115|20:65.why: Will you throw or shall we: 'be the throwers' (7:115) or 'be the first to throw' (20:65). Classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:7:206|21:19.why: Those near Allah are not too proud to worship Him. Same description of the angels.

cmp-card:7:147|30:16.why: Those who denied Our ayat and the meeting of the hereafter: their deeds void (7:147), and they are brought to punishment (30:16).
cmp-card:7:147|30:16.relation: Denying the hereafter voids deeds and leads to punishment.

cmp-card:7:200|41:36.why: If an evil suggestion from Satan provokes you, seek refuge in God: He is hearing, knowing, or He is the hearing, the knowing. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:7:134|43:49.why: Call on your Lord for us by the covenant He made with you: Pharaoh's people ask Moses twice, once by name with a promise to believe, once calling him sorcerer. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:7:134|43:49.relation: Same story: Pharaoh's people beg Moses for relief, then break their word.

cmp-card:7:71|53:23.why: A partial card of the names-you-named clause; both ayat belong in the three-row card proposed under the 7:71 and 12:40 pair.

cmp-card:7:176|62:5.why: The likeness of the people who deny Our signs: the panting dog (7:176), the donkey with books (62:5).
cmp-card:7:176|62:5.relation: Two parables of knowledge without benefit.

cmp-card:8:4|8:74.why: Those are the believers in truth; for them...: ranks with their Lord, forgiveness and noble provision, or forgiveness and noble provision. A memorizer pair in one surah.
cmp-card:8:4|8:74.relation: Same verdict: true believers, defined by worship and by emigration and striving.

cmp-card:8:22|8:55.why: The worst of creatures in God's sight: the deaf and dumb who do not reason, those who disbelieve and will not believe. A memorizer pair in one surah.
cmp-card:8:22|8:55.relation: Same verdict on those who refuse to hear and believe.

cmp-card:8:52|8:54.why: Like the way of Pharaoh's people, twice in two ayat: disbelieved and seized, then denied and destroyed by drowning. Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp-card:8:52|8:54.relation: The first states their disbelief and seizure; the second their denial and the manner of destruction.

cmp-card:8:65|8:66.why: Two adjacent rulings: twenty patient overcome two hundred, then lightened to a hundred overcoming two hundred. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:8:65|8:66.relation: The ratio of the patient few, then eased.

cmp-card:8:74|9:20.why: Those who believed, emigrated and strove in the way of God: then the true believers, or greater in rank, the winners. A memorizer pair across two adjacent surahs.
cmp-card:8:74|9:20.relation: Same subject: the reward of the Emigrants who strove.

cmp-card:8:51|22:10.why: The same sentence to the punished: that is for what your hands sent ahead, and Allah is never unjust to His servants. A memorizer pair, with a singular and plural for hands.
cmp-card:8:51|22:10.relation: Punishment as the fruit of one's own deeds.

cmp-card:8:49|33:12.why: When the hypocrites and those with sickness in their hearts said: at Badr, their religion deluded them; at the trench, God's promise was a delusion. Two battles, one slander.
cmp-card:8:49|33:12.relation: Same theme: the hypocrites call faith a delusion in times of danger.

cmp-card:8:75|33:6.why: Blood relatives are closer to one another in the Book of God: the same ruling on inheritance in two surahs, with different surroundings.
cmp-card:8:75|33:6.relation: Same ruling: kinship takes precedence over the brotherhood bond in inheritance.

cmp-card:8:50|47:27.why: Same scene: the angels take the disbelievers' souls striking their faces and backs.

cmp-card:8:70|57:28.why: Both promise that Allah will give something better and forgive: the captives at Badr if there is good in their hearts, and the believers a double share of mercy. The parallel is more than the closing formula, but thin.
cmp-card:8:70|57:28.relation: Allah's compensation and forgiveness offered for faith.

cmp-card:8:13|59:4.why: That is because they opposed God and His messenger: the doubled letters and the messenger mentioned again only in 8:13. A classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:8:45|62:10.why: The same command to remember Allah much that you may succeed, once in the face of the enemy and once in the market after Friday prayer.
cmp-card:8:45|62:10.relation: Remembrance asked for both in battle and in daily trade.
