cmp-card:9:55|9:85.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:9:87|9:93.why: Content to be with those who stay behind, their hearts sealed: they do not understand (9:87) or do not know (9:93), with God named only in the second. Classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:9:94|9:105.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:9:39|11:57.why: Replacing you with another people, and you cannot harm Him at all: the warning to the believers at Tabuk and Hud's warning to 'Ad, with replace or make successors and the pronoun forms changing. Memorizer pair and a shared sunna.
cmp-card:9:39|11:57.relation: Those who turn away are replaceable; God is not harmed.

cmp-card:9:38|13:26.why: The life of this world compared with the Hereafter is only...: a little enjoyment, or an enjoyment. A memorizer pair that differs in the ending and in the lead-in.
cmp-card:9:38|13:26.relation: Same theme: the worldly life weighed against the Hereafter.

cmp-card:9:89|20:76.why: A repeat: only the gardens formula is shared, and both ayat are in the large gardens card.

cmp-card:9:129|27:26.why: The confession that there is no god but Him, Lord of the mighty Throne, closes the Prophet's word of trust (9:129) and the hoopoe's report against sun-worship (27:26). Rare exact clause, good memorizer pair. The 9:129 row reads on across the surah boundary into 10:1, which should be checked.
cmp-card:9:129|27:26.relation: The Lord of the mighty Throne: enough for the Prophet when people turn away, and the only one worthy of worship, not the queen's sun.

cmp-card:9:70|30:9.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same closing (with 29:40).

cmp-card:9:72|61:12.why: The same promise of gardens and good dwellings in gardens of Eden, closing with the great success; 9:72 adds Allah's pleasure. Same reward for believers.
cmp-card:9:72|61:12.relation: The highest reward described in the same words.

cmp-card:9:87|63:3.why: Their hearts were sealed, so they do not understand: said of those content to stay behind and of the hypocrites who believed then disbelieved. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:9:87|63:3.relation: Same theme: hypocrisy seals the heart.

cmp-card:9:73|66:9.why: O Prophet, strive against the deniers and the hypocrites and be firm with them: the same ayah word for word in two surahs, each followed by a different passage. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:9:73|66:9.relation: Same command in two contexts: the hypocrites' oath and the wives of Noah and Lot.

cmp-card:9:63|72:23.why: Whoever opposes or disobeys Allah and His Messenger has the fire of Hell, abiding. Same warning in two surahs.
cmp-card:9:63|72:23.relation: The punishment of defying Allah and His Messenger.

cmp-card:10:47|10:54.why: It will be judged between them with justice and they will not be wronged: closing two ayat of one surah, after the messenger comes to a nation and after the wrongdoers wish to ransom themselves. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:10:47|10:54.relation: Same theme: judgment with justice, in this world and the next.

cmp-card:10:38|11:13.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:10:49|16:61.why: When their term comes they cannot delay it an hour nor bring it forward: with and without the conjunction, after different lead-ins. Together with 7:34 it is a three-place memorizer family.
cmp-card:10:49|16:61.relation: Same theme: the fixed term that no one can move.

cmp-card:10:108|17:15.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the card of whoever is guided is guided for himself.

cmp-card:10:106|21:66.why: Calling on, or worshipping, besides God what neither benefits nor harms you: a command to the Prophet and Abraham's question to his people. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:10:106|21:66.relation: Same argument against idols, in a command and in a question.

cmp-card:10:55|24:64.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the same opening (with 10:66) and in the card with 4:170.

cmp-card:10:80|26:41.why: When the sorcerers came: Moses tells them to throw, or they ask Pharaoh for a reward. Two tellings of the same moment.
cmp-card:10:80|26:41.relation: Same story: the arrival of the sorcerers, seen from Moses and from Pharaoh.

cmp-card:10:60|27:73.why: He is full of favour to people, but most of them do not give thanks: once after those who lie about God, once about your Lord. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:10:60|27:73.relation: Same theme: God's generosity and people's ingratitude.

cmp-card:10:67|27:86.why: The night to rest in and the day for seeing, signs for a people who hear, or who believe. A memorizer pair that differs in its opening and its last word.
cmp-card:10:67|27:86.relation: Same sign: night and day as proof for those who listen and believe.

cmp-card:10:108|27:92.why: Whoever is guided is guided for himself: whoever strays, strays against himself (10:108) or say I am only a warner (27:92). Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:10:39|28:40.why: The warning to see the end of the wrongdoers follows denial of the Quran in 10:39 and Pharaoh's drowning in 28:40.
cmp-card:10:39|28:40.relation: The end of wrongdoers as a lesson.

cmp-card:10:55|28:13.why: God's promise is true, but most of them do not know: as a general statement and in the return of Moses to his mother, where the promise was seen fulfilled. A memorizer pair with a lesson.
cmp-card:10:55|28:13.relation: Similarity: the promise to Moses' mother is a small proof of God's promise in general.

cmp-card:10:31|30:19.why: He brings the living out of the dead and the dead out of the living: once as a question to the deniers, once as a statement leading to resurrection. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:10:31|30:19.relation: Same sign: life from death, as proof of God and of resurrection.

cmp-card:10:67|30:23.why: Night for rest and day for seeking, ending 'signs for people who hear' in both. Memorizer pair on the same sign.
cmp-card:10:67|30:23.relation: Sleep and waking as a sign meant for those who listen.

cmp-card:10:1|31:2.why: These are the signs of the wise Book, opening Yunus and Luqman. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:10:1|31:2.relation: The Book described as wise in two openings.

cmp-card:10:109|33:2.why: Follow what is revealed to you: then be patient until God judges, or from your Lord, God is aware of what you do. A memorizer pair, the closing command of Yunus and an opening command of al-Ahzab.
cmp-card:10:109|33:2.relation: Same command: hold to revelation and leave the outcome to God.

cmp-card:10:52|34:42.why: It is said to the wrongdoers, taste the punishment: of eternity (10:52), of the Fire you denied (34:42).
cmp-card:10:52|34:42.relation: The wrongdoers' punishment on the Day.

cmp-card:10:61|34:3.why: Not an atom's weight escapes Him in the earth or the heaven, nor anything smaller or bigger, but it is in a clear Book: the order of earth and heaven is reversed in 34:3. A known memorizer pair.
cmp-card:10:61|34:3.relation: Same theme: God's complete knowledge, recorded.

cmp-card:10:72|34:47.why: I asked you no reward; my reward is only from Allah: Noah (10:72) and the Prophet (34:47).

cmp-card:10:65|36:76.why: Let not their words grieve you: 'and' or 'so', then two reasons (all might is God's; We know what they hide and show). Memorizer pair and the same consolation.
cmp-card:10:65|36:76.relation: The Prophet consoled first by God's might, then by God's knowledge.

cmp-card:10:73|37:73.why: The same call to see the end of those warned, after Noah's people were drowned in 10:73 and after past warned nations in 37:73.
cmp-card:10:73|37:73.relation: The end of the warned nations who denied.

cmp-card:10:108|39:41.why: Guided for himself and astray against himself, then I am not your guardian (10:108) or you are not their guardian (39:41), with 'is guided' dropped in 39:41. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:10:46|40:77.why: Whether We show you some of what We promise them or take you to Us, to Us is their return: two endings (God is witness, they will be returned). A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:10:46|40:77.relation: Same theme: the outcome is God's, whether the Prophet sees it or not.

cmp-card:10:36|53:28.why: Conjecture avails nothing against the truth: after most of them follow only conjecture, and after they have no knowledge of the angels. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:10:36|53:28.relation: Same theme: guessing cannot replace knowledge of the truth.

cmp-card:10:85|60:5.why: Our Lord, do not make us a trial: Moses' people (10:85) and Abraham with his followers (60:5).
cmp-card:10:85|60:5.relation: Believers praying not to be a trial for the oppressors.

cmp-card:11:28|11:63.why: Noah and Salih: and He gave me mercy from Himself, with 'from Him' before or after mercy. Tight memorizer pair.

cmp-card:11:39|11:93.why: You will know who gets a disgracing punishment: Noah and Shuaib in one surah, with and without the particle, then different tails (a lasting punishment, and who is a liar). A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:11:39|11:93.relation: Same threat from two prophets in one surah.

cmp-card:11:107|11:108.why: Abiding there as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except as your Lord wills: said of the wretched in the Fire and of the happy in the Garden, consecutive ayat with different endings.
cmp-card:11:107|11:108.relation: Contrast: the same words describe the eternity of the Fire and of the Garden; the Garden's gift is never cut off.

cmp-card:11:82|15:74.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:11:22|16:109.why: No doubt in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers (11:22) or the losers (16:109). A classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:11:123|16:77.why: To God belongs the unseen of the heavens and the earth: then all matters return to Him, or the Hour is like the blink of an eye. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:11:123|16:77.relation: Same theme: God's knowledge of the unseen, of all affairs and of the Hour.

cmp-card:11:85|26:183.why: Do not deprive people of their things and do not spread corruption in the land: Shuaib's words in two surahs, one longer. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:11:85|26:183.relation: Same message of Shuaib about honest trade.

cmp-card:11:117|28:59.why: Your Lord would not destroy the towns: unjustly while their people set things right, or until He sends a messenger to their mother town. Memorizer pair and a principle worth pondering.
cmp-card:11:117|28:59.relation: No town is destroyed without a messenger and without its own wrongdoing.

cmp-card:11:69|29:31.why: Same story: Our messengers came to Abraham with good news, then the greeting in 11:69 and the announcement of Lot's town's destruction in 29:31.
cmp-card:11:69|29:31.relation: One visit of the angels to Abraham told in two surahs.

cmp-card:11:77|29:33.why: When Our messengers came to Lot he was distressed for them: 'when' or 'when that', and two continuations (a hard day; do not fear). Classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:11:119|32:13.why: I will fill Hell with jinn and men all together: the word of your Lord fulfilled, and the word from Me came true. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:11:119|32:13.relation: Same decree, after God's choice to leave people free.

cmp-card:11:39|39:40.why: Who will get a disgracing punishment and on whom a lasting punishment will fall: Noah's words to his people and the Prophet's to his. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:11:39|39:40.relation: Same threat from Noah and from the Prophet.

cmp-card:11:93|39:39.why: My people, work according to your position, I am working: Shuaib with the conjunction and the Prophet with say, then different tails. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:11:93|39:39.relation: Same challenge from Shuaib and from the Prophet.

cmp-card:11:96|40:23.why: A repeat: the two identical ayat are in the four-row card of the sending of Moses with Our signs.

cmp-card:11:110|41:45.why: A repeat: the two identical ayat are in the three-row card of the word that preceded from your Lord (with 10:19).

cmp-card:11:110|42:14.why: But for a word that preceded from your Lord it would have been judged between them, and they are in disquieting doubt about it: 42:14 adds to a set term and changes who is in doubt. Not in the three-row card, and a sharp memorizer pair.
cmp-card:11:110|42:14.relation: Same theme: division over the Book, and God's decree delaying judgment.

cmp-card:11:70|51:28.why: He felt fear of them; they said, do not fear: then we are sent to Lot's people, or they gave him news of a knowing son. A memorizer pair.

cmp-card:11:83|51:34.why: Marked by your Lord: the stones on Lot's people, for the wrongdoers or for the transgressors. A short memorizer pair.
cmp-card:11:83|51:34.relation: Same punishment, with two names for those it struck.

cmp-card:12:18|12:83.why: Jacob says the same words over the loss of Joseph and later of Benjamin, then ends differently: God is the one whose help is sought, and perhaps God will bring them all back. Memorizer pair and a moving development.
cmp-card:12:18|12:83.relation: The same patience, first enduring, then hopeful.

cmp-card:12:27|12:28.why: The shirt torn from behind: the condition (12:27) and its proof seen (12:28). Adjacent in Joseph's story.

cmp-card:12:43|12:46.why: Seven fat cows eaten by seven lean, seven green ears and others dry: the king's dream, then the cupbearer repeating it to Joseph. A memorizer pair in one passage.
cmp-card:12:43|12:46.relation: Same story: the king's dream told and retold.

cmp-card:12:22|28:14.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:12:40|30:30.why: That is the right religion, but most people do not know: Joseph's words in prison and the command to turn to the natural religion. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:12:40|30:30.relation: Same theme: pure monotheism is the upright religion.

cmp-card:12:2|43:3.why: We sent it down (12:2) or made it (43:3) an Arabic Quran so you may reason. A tight memorizer pair.

cmp-card:12:40|53:23.why: Both ayat are in the three-row card proposed under the 7:71 and 12:40 pair, which also holds Hud's use of the same clause.

cmp-card:13:1|13:19.why: In one surah, what was revealed to the Prophet is the truth: most people do not believe (13:1), and the one who knows it is not like the blind (13:19).
cmp-card:13:1|13:19.relation: Knowing the revelation is truth, and the blindness of those who do not.

cmp-card:13:7|13:27.why: The disbelievers ask why no sign was sent down, twice in al-Ra'd, answered differently (you are only a warner; God leads astray whom He wills). Memorizer pair.
cmp-card:13:7|13:27.relation: The same demand answered once by the Prophet's role, once by God's will in guidance.

cmp-card:13:15|16:49.why: To God prostrates whoever or whatever is in the heavens and the earth: 'who' with willing and unwilling, 'what' with creatures and angels. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:13:43|17:96.why: Say, God suffices as witness between me and you: answering you are not a messenger, then he who has knowledge of the Book; or He is aware and seeing of His servants. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:13:43|17:96.relation: Same answer: God as witness for His messenger.

cmp-card:13:41|21:44.why: We come to the land, reducing it from its edges: with have they not seen and the judgment of God, or do they not see and are they the victors. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:13:41|21:44.relation: Same sign: the shrinking of the deniers' land.

cmp-card:13:32|22:44.why: I gave respite to the disbelievers then seized them: how was My punishment, or how was My reproach. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:13:22|35:29.why: Established prayer and spent of what We provided them, secretly and openly: in the description of the people of understanding and of those who recite God's Book. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:13:22|35:29.relation: Same description of the righteous: prayer and spending.

cmp-card:13:18|39:47.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the ransom of all that is on earth (with 5:36).

cmp-card:13:23|40:8.why: Gardens of Eden with the righteous among their fathers, spouses and offspring: as a description, and in the angels' prayer for the believers. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:13:23|40:8.relation: Same promise: families reunited in the Garden, promised and prayed for.

cmp-card:13:38|40:78.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:14:3|16:107.why: They prefer the life of this world over the Hereafter, said of those who bar from Allah's way and those who disbelieve after faith.
cmp-card:14:3|16:107.relation: Preferring this world as the root of disbelief.

cmp-card:14:33|16:12.why: He subjected for you the night and day, the sun and moon, in two lists of blessings.

cmp-card:14:34|16:18.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:14:32|27:60.why: He created the heavens and earth and sent down water from the sky: with 'for you' added and different results. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:14:1|34:6.why: To the path of the Mighty, the Praised: the purpose of the Book (14:1) and what the knowledgeable see in it (34:6).
cmp-card:14:1|34:6.relation: The Book guiding to Allah's path.

cmp-card:14:19|35:16.why: If He wills He will remove you and bring a new creation, and that is not hard for God: two ayat repeated together in two surahs, after the creation of the heavens and earth in truth and after man's need of God.
cmp-card:14:19|35:16.relation: Same theme: mankind replaceable at God's will.

cmp-card:14:31|35:29.why: Prayer and spending from what We provided, secretly and openly: a command to God's servants before a day with no trade, and the praise of those who recite the Book. A memorizer pair (13:22 has the same clause).
cmp-card:14:31|35:29.relation: Same deeds: prayer and spending, commanded and praised.

cmp-card:14:23|85:11.why: Only the common gardens phrase is shared, already shown in the gardens cards. The pair adds no new branch.

cmp-card:15:42|17:65.why: Over My servants you have no authority: except those who follow you, or your Lord suffices as guardian. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:15:42|17:65.relation: Same promise: Satan has no power over God's true servants.

cmp-card:15:5|23:43.why: No nation can advance its term, nor delay it: the same ayah word for word in two surahs. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:15:5|23:43.relation: Same theme: the appointed term of nations.

cmp-card:15:12|26:200.why: Thus We insert it in the hearts of the criminals: present tense in 15:12, past in 26:200. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:15:80|26:176.why: Two peoples denied the messengers, with the same shape: the people of al-Hijr (15:80) and of the Thicket (26:176).
cmp-card:15:80|26:176.relation: The denial of messengers by Thamud and Madyan, told alike.

cmp-card:15:88|26:215.why: Lower your wing to the believers (15:88) or to those of the believers who follow you (26:215). Memorizer pair and the same gentle command.

cmp-card:15:1|27:1.why: Verses of the Book and a clear Quran (15:1) against verses of the Quran and a clear Book (27:1). A neat inversion for memorizers.

cmp-card:15:11|36:30.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the seven-row card of no messenger or sign comes to them but they mock or turn away.

cmp-card:15:85|46:3.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the two three-row cards of the same sentence.

cmp-card:15:45|51:15.why: The God-fearing will be among gardens and springs: the same ayah word for word, then different next ayat. A memorizer pair.

cmp-card:15:62|51:25.why: The same angels, called unfamiliar people by Lut (15:62) and by Ibrahim (51:25). The rows read on to show each host's reaction.
cmp-card:15:62|51:25.relation: One visit of angels, met with unease by two prophets.

cmp-card:16:28|16:32.why: Those whom the angels take in death: wronging themselves, or good. Two ayat of one passage with opposite ends.
cmp-card:16:28|16:32.relation: Contrast: the death of the wrongdoers and the death of the good, in the same words.

cmp-card:16:96|16:97.why: Two neighbouring ayat end with the same promise of being rewarded by the best of what they did, the first for the patient, the second for every believer who does good. A memorizer needs to see them together.
cmp-card:16:96|16:97.relation: The same reward promised to the patient and to every believing doer of good.

cmp-card:16:110|16:119.why: Then your Lord, to those who emigrated after persecution, and to those who did wrong in ignorance then repented: after that He is forgiving and merciful. Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp-card:16:110|16:119.relation: Forgiveness opened to two groups: the persecuted who strove and the sinners who repented.

cmp-card:16:43|21:7.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of We sent before you only men (with 12:109).

cmp-card:16:119|24:5.why: Those who repent after that and reform, God is Forgiving and Merciful: after evil done in ignorance, and after slander of chaste women. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:16:119|24:5.relation: Same theme: repentance with reform opens forgiveness.

cmp-card:16:127|27:70.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:16:42|29:59.why: Those who were patient and rely on their Lord: the same short ayah word for word in two surahs, then different next ayat. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:16:42|29:59.relation: Same description of the emigrants and the believers.

cmp-card:16:55|29:66.why: So that they deny what We gave them, then enjoy, you will come to know: a command in the second person in 16:55, a third-person form in 29:66. A fine memorizer distinction.
cmp-card:16:55|29:66.relation: Same theme: the ungrateful are left to enjoy for a while.

cmp-card:16:65|29:63.why: Sent down water from the sky and revived the earth after its death: a statement in an-Nahl and a question to the deniers in al-Ankabut, who answer God. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:16:65|29:63.relation: Same sign used as a statement and as an argument against the idolaters.

cmp-card:16:72|29:67.why: Do they believe in falsehood and deny God's favour: with the pronoun 'they' only in 16:72. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:16:55|30:34.why: So that they deny what We gave them; enjoy then, you will come to know: the same ayah word for word in two surahs, each after people who call on God in distress and then associate. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:16:55|30:34.relation: Same theme: ingratitude after rescue, met with a threat.

cmp-card:16:60|30:27.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:16:14|35:12.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:16:61|35:45.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:16:4|36:77.why: From a sperm-drop, and then he is an open adversary: once as a statement, once inside the question does man not see. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:16:4|36:77.relation: Same irony: made from a drop, he argues against his Maker.

cmp-card:16:30|39:10.why: For those who do good in this world there is good: in the God-fearing's answer about revelation, and in the call to the believers to fear God. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:16:30|39:10.relation: Same promise: good for the doers of good, here and in the Hereafter.

cmp-card:16:2|40:15.why: He sends the Spirit of His command on whom He wills of His servants: to warn that there is no god but Him, or to warn of the Day of Meeting. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:16:2|40:15.relation: Same theme: revelation chosen by God, for warning.

cmp-card:16:97|40:40.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of whoever does good, male or female, while a believer (with 4:124).

cmp-card:16:125|68:7.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the card of your Lord knows best who strays from His path.

cmp-card:17:22|17:39.why: Do not set up another god with God: at the start and the end of the same list of commandments, with different results (blamed and forsaken, cast into Hell blamed and rejected). A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:17:22|17:39.relation: Same command framing the commandments of al-Isra.

cmp-card:17:30|17:96.why: The same closing on Allah being aware and seeing of His servants, twice in al-Isra': after His giving of provision, and after Him being witness between the Prophet and the deniers. A memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp-card:17:49|17:98.why: When we are bones and dust, shall we be raised as a new creation: the same words twice in al-Isra, the second giving it as the cause of their punishment. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:17:9|18:2.why: Gives glad tidings to the believers who do good that theirs is a great reward (17:9) or a good reward (18:2). Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:17:89|18:54.why: We have varied for people in this Quran every example: the word order of for people and in this Quran is reversed between the two. A classic memorizer pair.
cmp-card:17:89|18:54.relation: Same theme: the many examples and man's refusal or argument.

cmp-card:17:94|18:55.why: Nothing prevented people from believing when guidance came except: that they said 'has God sent a human messenger', or that the way of the ancients should come upon them. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:17:108|18:98.why: The promise of my Lord, said by the people of knowledge who prostrate (17:108) and by Dhul-Qarnayn of the barrier's end (18:98). Neighbouring surahs, close wording.
cmp-card:17:108|18:98.relation: Believers and a just king alike are certain that God's promise comes.

cmp-card:17:89|25:50.why: Same statement that Allah varied the reminders for people and most refused all but disbelief. Two wordings of the first half to keep apart.
cmp-card:17:89|25:50.relation: The same complaint about people's refusal despite varied reminders.

cmp-card:17:105|25:56.why: We sent you only as a bearer of good news and a warner, the same sentence about the Prophet's role in two surahs.
cmp-card:17:105|25:56.relation: The Prophet's role defined in the same words.

cmp-card:17:111|25:2.why: He has not taken a son and has no partner in dominion: in the praise that closes al-Isra and in the description that opens al-Furqan, with different surroundings. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:17:111|25:2.relation: Same declaration of God's oneness and sovereignty.

cmp-card:17:96|29:52.why: Say, God suffices between me and you as witness: the word witness comes before between me and you in one and after it in the other. A memorizer pair (13:43 has a third form).
cmp-card:17:96|29:52.relation: Same answer to the deniers: God is witness.

cmp-card:17:26|30:38.why: Give the relative his right, and the needy and the traveller: then do not squander, or that is better for those who seek God's face. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:17:26|30:38.relation: Same command: rights of kin and the needy.

cmp-card:17:2|32:23.why: We gave Moses the Book and made it guidance for the Children of Israel. Same statement.
cmp-card:17:2|32:23.relation: Moses' Book as guidance to Israel.

cmp-card:17:56|34:22.why: Call those you claim besides Him or besides God: they own no power to remove harm, or not an atom's weight. Memorizer pair on the same challenge.

cmp-card:17:81|34:49.why: The truth has come: and falsehood has vanished, or falsehood neither begins nor repeats. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:17:81|34:49.relation: Same declaration: falsehood has no power before the truth.

cmp-card:17:44|35:41.why: The only two places closing He is Forbearing, Forgiving, both about the heavens and earth: they glorify Him (17:44), He holds them from collapsing (35:41). Allah's forbearance shown against the cosmos.
cmp-card:17:44|35:41.relation: The heavens obey while people associate, and Allah is patient.

cmp-card:17:99|36:81.why: He who created the heavens and earth is able to create their like. Same argument for resurrection.

cmp-card:17:99|46:33.why: Do they not see that God who created the heavens and the earth is able: to create their like, or to give life to the dead. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:17:99|46:33.relation: Same argument: the Creator of the heavens can raise the dead.

cmp-card:17:68|67:17.why: The same warning: do you feel safe that He will not send a storm of stones on you? 'Do you then feel safe' (17:68) vs 'or do you feel safe' (67:17), and what follows differs.

cmp-card:18:61|18:63.why: The fish took its way into the sea: tunnelling (18:61) and wondrously (18:63). Same story; memorizer pair.

cmp-card:18:72|18:75.why: Did I not say you could not be patient with me: 'to you' added the second time. Memorizer pair and a pointed escalation.
cmp-card:18:72|18:75.relation: The reproach sharpens with the added 'to you'.

cmp-card:18:89|18:92.why: Then he followed a way: the same short ayah twice, each followed by a different destination. A memorizer pair in one story.
cmp-card:18:89|18:92.relation: Same story: the transitions in Dhul-Qarnayn's journeys.

cmp-card:18:31|22:23.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the bracelets of gold (with 35:33).

cmp-card:18:6|26:3.why: Perhaps you will destroy yourself with grief: over their traces if they do not believe, or that they will not be believers. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:18:6|26:3.relation: Same consolation to the Prophet over his people's rejection.

cmp-card:18:43|28:81.why: He had no party to help him besides God, nor could he help himself: the owner of the two gardens and Qarun. Two rich men undone in the same words.
cmp-card:18:43|28:81.relation: Similarity: wealth proud of itself, left with no helper.

cmp-card:18:26|32:4.why: No protector besides Him, then nor does He share His rule (18:26) and nor intercessor (32:4). A memorizer pair.

cmp-card:18:110|41:6.why: Say, I am only a man like you, revealed to me that your god is one God: then whoever hopes to meet his Lord, or go straight to Him. A long identical run with different tails.
cmp-card:18:110|41:6.relation: Same declaration of the Prophet's humanity and of oneness.

cmp-card:19:78|19:87.why: Taken a covenant with the Most Merciful, twice in Maryam: the boaster has none (19:78), only those who have it may intercede (19:87).
cmp-card:19:78|19:87.relation: The covenant with Allah as the only ground for hope.

cmp-card:19:49|21:72.why: We gave him Ishaq and Yaqub and made each: prophets (19:49), righteous (21:72). A classic memorizer pair on Ibrahim.
cmp-card:19:49|21:72.relation: The reward of Ibrahim's leaving his people: a line of prophets.

cmp-card:19:88|21:26.why: They say the Merciful has taken a son: then you have brought a monstrous thing, or glory be to Him, they are honoured servants. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:19:88|21:26.relation: Same claim, answered with horror and with correction.

cmp-card:19:50|26:84.why: An honoured mention: Ibrahim asks for it (26:84) and God grants it to him and his sons (19:50).
cmp-card:19:50|26:84.relation: Prayer and its answer in the same words.

cmp-card:19:81|36:74.why: They took gods besides God: to be a source of strength for them, or hoping to be helped. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:19:81|36:74.relation: Same theme: false gods taken for power and help, which fail.

cmp-card:19:63|43:72.why: That is the Garden which...: We give as inheritance to the God-fearing, or you have been given as inheritance for what you did. With and without the conjunction, a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:19:63|43:72.relation: Same theme: the Garden inherited by piety and deeds.

cmp-card:20:100|20:124.why: Same surah: whoever turns away from it carries a burden (20:100), whoever turns from My remembrance has a hard life and is raised blind (20:124).
cmp-card:20:100|20:124.relation: Turning from the reminder brings a burden and blindness on the Day.

cmp-card:20:112|21:94.why: Whoever does good deeds while a believer: 'and' or 'so', then he fears no wrong, or his effort will not be denied. Memorizer pair.
cmp-card:20:112|21:94.relation: Two assurances that a believer's good deeds are never lost.

cmp-card:20:114|23:116.why: Exalted is God, the King, the Truth: then do not hasten with the Quran, or there is no god but He, Lord of the noble Throne. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:20:114|23:116.relation: Same praise of God, the true King.

cmp-card:20:10|27:7.why: A partial card of Moses seeing the fire; both ayat belong in the three-row card proposed under the 20:10 and 28:29 pair.

cmp-card:20:10|28:29.why: Moses sees a fire and tells his family to stay, I have perceived a fire, perhaps I will bring you...: in three tellings (20:10, 27:7, 28:29), now spread over two pairs. One card shows the three.
cmp-card:20:10|28:29.relation: Same scene: Moses and the fire, told three ways.

cmp-card:20:134|28:47.why: Our Lord, why did You not send us a messenger so that we would follow Your signs: the excuse the deniers would have given, in two surahs with different tails.
cmp-card:20:134|28:47.relation: Same theme: messengers sent to cut off every excuse.

cmp-card:20:128|32:26.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:20:130|50:39.why: Be patient over what they say and glorify your Lord before sunrise and before its setting (20:130) or the setting (50:39). Memorizer pair on the same command.

cmp-card:20:76|98:8.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the large gardens card, which shows the gardens of Eden branch.

cmp-card:21:36|25:41.why: When they see you they take you only in mockery: is this the one who mentions your gods, or whom God sent as messenger. Memorizer pair on the same scene.
cmp-card:21:36|25:41.relation: Mockery of the Prophet for attacking their gods and for claiming to be sent.

cmp-card:21:53|26:74.why: We found our fathers worshipping them (21:53) or rather we found our fathers doing so (26:74). Same story; memorizer pair.

cmp-card:21:35|29:57.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:21:33|36:40.why: Each swims in an orbit, the sun and moon and night and day. Same image.
cmp-card:21:33|36:40.relation: The orbits of the heavenly bodies.

cmp-card:21:70|37:98.why: They intended a plot against him and We made them the greatest losers (21:70) or the lowest (37:98). Same story; classic memorizer pair.

cmp-card:21:16|38:27.why: We did not create the heaven and the earth and what is between them: in play, or in vain. A memorizer pair whose last word differs.

cmp-card:21:22|43:82.why: Exalted is the Lord of the Throne above what they describe, after the argument against other gods (21:22) and a son (43:82).

cmp-card:21:16|44:38.why: We did not create ... in play: heaven singular in 21:16 and heavens plural in 44:38, each followed by a different ayah. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:21:16|44:38.relation: Same theme: creation is not a game.

cmp-card:21:91|66:12.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:22:28|22:34.why: To mention God's name over the livestock He provided them: in the rites of pilgrimage and in the rite given to every nation. A memorizer pair in one passage.
cmp-card:22:28|22:34.relation: Same theme: sacrifice as remembrance of God, common to all nations.

cmp-card:22:8|31:20.why: Among people is one who disputes about God without knowledge, guidance or an illuminating book: word for word in two surahs. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:22:63|31:16.why: Only the closing names, Subtle and Aware, are shared; rain turning the earth green and Luqman's mustard seed are different subjects.

cmp-card:22:64|31:26.why: His or God's is what is in the heavens and the earth; He is the Rich, the Praised: with and without the extra 'what is in' and the emphasis. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:22:22|32:20.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:22:23|35:33.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of the bracelets of gold (with 18:31).

cmp-card:22:42|38:12.why: Consolation to the Prophet: before them the people of Noah and 'Ad denied, continued with Thamud in 22:42 and Pharaoh in 38:12.
cmp-card:22:42|38:12.relation: The Prophet consoled by past nations' denial.

cmp-card:22:6|42:9.why: He gives life to the dead and He is able over all things: once with that and once with He, after God is the Truth and after God is the Protector. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:22:6|42:9.relation: Same theme: the giver of life is the only real protector.

cmp-card:23:26|23:39.why: A repeat: the two identical ayat are in the three-row card of my Lord, help me (with 29:30).

cmp-card:23:31|23:42.why: Then We produced after them another generation, or other generations: singular and plural in one surah. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:23:31|23:42.relation: Same theme: generations succeed one another.

cmp-card:23:66|23:105.why: My verses were recited to you, and you turned on your heels, or were they not recited and you denied them. Memorizer pair in one surah.

cmp-card:23:117|28:88.why: Do not call another god with Allah: a warning that whoever does has no proof (23:117), and a command to the Prophet (28:88).
cmp-card:23:117|28:88.relation: The prohibition of calling on other gods.

cmp-card:23:53|30:32.why: Each faction rejoicing in what it has, after people split their religion into sects. Same theme in both places.
cmp-card:23:53|30:32.relation: Sectarian division and each sect's self-satisfaction.

cmp-card:23:19|36:34.why: Gardens of palms and vines produced from water. Same sign.
cmp-card:23:19|36:34.relation: Gardens as a sign of provision.

cmp-card:23:88|36:83.why: In whose hand is the dominion of everything, asked in 23:88 and glorified in 36:83.

cmp-card:23:18|43:11.why: He sent down water from the sky in measure, then stored it (23:18) or revived dead land (43:11).

cmp-card:23:19|43:73.why: Many fruits for you, of which you eat: earthly gardens (with 'and') and Paradise (without). Memorizer pair and a contrast worth pondering.
cmp-card:23:19|43:73.relation: The fruits of this world prefigure the fruits of Paradise.

cmp-card:23:70|43:78.why: The truth came to them, but most of them hate the truth (23:70, 43:78). The rows read on into the next ayah.
cmp-card:23:70|43:78.relation: Denial comes from hating the truth, not from lack of proof.

cmp-card:23:37|45:24.why: There is only our worldly life, we die and we live: then we will not be raised, or nothing destroys us but time. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:23:37|45:24.relation: Same creed of the deniers of resurrection.

cmp-card:24:34|24:46.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:24:43|30:48.why: The same sign of clouds gathered and rain coming from within them, falling on whom He wills. Same theme in two surahs.
cmp-card:24:43|30:48.relation: Rain from clouds as a sign of Allah's power.

cmp-card:24:45|35:1.why: He creates, or adds to creation, what He wills; God is able over all things: after creatures walking on two or four legs, and after angels with two, three or four wings.
cmp-card:24:45|35:1.relation: Similarity: the variety of creatures on earth and of angels, both by God's will.

cmp-card:24:12|46:11.why: This is a lie: what believers should have said about the slander (24:12), and what deniers say of the Quran (46:11).
cmp-card:24:12|46:11.relation: Contrast: the same words rightly refuse slander and wrongly refuse revelation.

cmp-card:24:54|64:12.why: Same command to obey Allah and the Messenger, then if they turn away, his duty is only clear delivery. Wording differs in the middle, which a memorizer must keep apart.
cmp-card:24:54|64:12.relation: The same rule on the Messenger's duty in two surahs.

cmp-card:25:7|25:20.why: In one surah, the deniers object that the messenger eats food and walks in the markets (25:7), and God answers that every messenger before him did the same (25:20).
cmp-card:25:7|25:20.relation: Objection and answer in the same words.

cmp-card:25:59|32:4.why: He created the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, then rose over the Throne: 'God' added in 32:4 and two different continuations. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:25:57|38:86.why: Say, I ask you no reward for it: except whoever wills to take a way to his Lord, or I am not of the pretenders. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:25:57|38:86.relation: Same stance: the Prophet asks nothing.

cmp-card:25:2|85:9.why: Only the phrase whose is the dominion of the heavens and the earth is shared. One is about having no son or partner, the other about God witnessing the persecutors; the pair adds little.

cmp-card:26:116|26:167.why: Same threat from two peoples, differing in the prophet named and the punishment (stoning for Noah, expulsion for Lot). A precise mix-up for memorizers.
cmp-card:26:116|26:167.relation: Different peoples answer their prophets with the same threat.

cmp-card:26:152|27:48.why: Same description of Thamud's ringleaders, who spread corruption in the land and do not set right, in two tellings of Salih's story.
cmp-card:26:152|27:48.relation: One people's corrupters in two surahs.

cmp-card:26:173|27:58.why: The punishment of Lot's people in identical words in two surahs, followed by different ayat. A memorizer must know which continuation belongs where.

cmp-card:26:213|28:88.why: The same prohibition of calling another god beside God, with a different connective and a different ending (being among the punished, or there is no god but He). Good for memorizers and for pondering tawhid.
cmp-card:26:213|28:88.relation: The command to worship God alone, once with a warning, once with the reason: all perishes but His face.

cmp-card:26:90|50:31.why: Same scene of Paradise brought near to the righteous, ending differently (Hell shown to the strayers in 26:91, not far in 50:31). A real mix-up point for memorizers.

cmp-card:27:24|29:38.why: Same clause about Satan beautifying deeds and turning people from the path, said of Sheba and of Aad and Thamud, with opposite endings (they are not guided, though they had insight).
cmp-card:27:24|29:38.relation: Satan's work on different peoples; even those who could see were led astray.

cmp-card:27:3|31:4.why: A repeat: both ayat sit inside cmp:01im3jr0g3y2ab, which already shows this description of the believers in full.

cmp-card:27:60|31:10.why: We sent down water from the sky and grew by it: gardens (27:60), noble pairs (31:10).

cmp-card:27:87|39:68.why: The Trumpet is blown and whoever is in the heavens and earth is terrified (27:87) or swoons (39:68), except whom God wills. Classic memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp-card:27:87|39:68.relation: The first blast in two descriptions: terror and fainting.

cmp-card:27:53|41:18.why: We saved those who believed and were God-fearing: two forms of 'saved'. Same story of Thamud; memorizer pair.

cmp-card:27:25|64:4.why: Allah knows what is in the heavens and earth and what you hide and declare: in the hoopoe's words in 27:25, and as a statement in 64:4.
cmp-card:27:25|64:4.relation: Allah's knowledge of the hidden and the open.

cmp-card:28:37|28:85.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:28:71|28:72.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:28:20|36:20.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:28:60|42:36.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:28:85|67:29.why: The Prophet answers the deniers that Allah knows, or they will know, who is in clear error. Same reply in two surahs.
cmp-card:28:85|67:29.relation: Leaving the verdict on who is misguided to Allah.

cmp-card:29:8|31:15.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:29:22|42:31.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:30:16|34:38.why: Those who deny or oppose Our signs will be brought into the punishment. Same verdict.

cmp-card:30:6|39:20.why: The promise of Allah, Allah does not break His promise, said of Rome's victory (30:6) and of Paradise's rooms (39:20).
cmp-card:30:6|39:20.relation: Allah's promise kept in this world and the next.

cmp-card:30:37|39:52.why: Have they not seen (30:37) or known (39:52) that God extends provision: otherwise identical. A sharp memorizer pair.

cmp-card:30:43|42:47.why: Before a Day comes that none can turn back from God: preceded by 'set your face to the religion' or 'respond to your Lord', and followed by different scenes. A rare clause shared; memorizer pair worth pondering.
cmp-card:30:43|42:47.relation: Two calls to act now, before the irreversible Day.

cmp-card:30:5|44:42.why: Both close a mention of God's help or mercy with the same pair of names, after 'and He is' (30:5) and 'indeed He is' (44:42). The phrase is common, but here the lead-in fits the closing in both.
cmp-card:30:5|44:42.relation: God's help for whom He wills and His mercy on whom He has mercy, both from the Mighty, the Merciful.

cmp-card:30:46|45:12.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:30:26|55:29.why: The last shared word is a different word in each: all are obedient to Him in 30:26, every day He is at work in 55:29. Beyond that only the common phrase of those in the heavens and earth is shared.

cmp-card:31:29|39:5.why: Night and day alternate and sun and moon run: merging (31:29) or wrapping (39:5), to a term or for a term. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:31:7|45:8.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:32:20|34:42.why: Taste the punishment of the Fire which you denied: the relative pronoun agrees with punishment in 32:20 and with Fire in 34:42. A famous memorizer pair the books explain.

cmp-card:32:6|64:18.why: Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Mighty, then the Merciful (32:6) or the Wise (64:18). A memorizer pair.

cmp-card:32:5|70:4.why: Ascending to Him in a day whose measure is a thousand years (32:5) or fifty thousand (70:4). Memorizer pair worth pondering.

cmp-card:32:19|95:6.why: Only the stock formula of those who believe and do good with their reward; the contexts are unrelated and nothing is learned from the pair.

cmp-card:33:38|33:62.why: God's way with those who passed before: ending 'God's command is a decree determined' or 'you will find no change in God's way'. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:33:63|42:17.why: What will make you know, perhaps the Hour is near: with 'will be near' in 33:63 and 'near' in 42:17. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:33:43|57:9.why: He is the One who brings you out of darkness into light, through His blessings in 33:43 and His clear signs in 57:9, each closing with His mercy.
cmp-card:33:43|57:9.relation: Allah's mercy taking believers from darkness to light.

cmp-card:34:36|34:39.why: Say my Lord extends provision to whom He wills: with 'of His servants' and 'for him' only in 34:39, and different endings. Memorizer pair three ayat apart.

cmp-card:34:34|43:23.why: We sent no warner to a town but its affluent said: we disbelieve in your message, or we found our fathers on a way. Memorizer pair on the same pattern.
cmp-card:34:34|43:23.relation: The wealthy always lead the rejection, out of disbelief or blind imitation.

cmp-card:34:5|45:11.why: A rare punishment phrase, a painful torment of foul kind, for those who oppose or deny Our signs. Same subject.
cmp-card:34:5|45:11.relation: The punishment for fighting the signs.

cmp-card:36:29|36:53.why: It was only one shout, and then they were extinguished (36:29) or all brought before Us (36:53). Memorizer pair and a telling contrast.
cmp-card:36:29|36:53.relation: One shout ends a town; one shout raises all mankind.

cmp-card:36:36|43:12.why: He who created all the pairs, glorified in 36:36 and named in 43:12 with ships and cattle.
cmp-card:36:36|43:12.relation: Pairs in creation as a sign.

cmp-card:37:16|37:53.why: When we have died and become dust and bones, shall we be raised (37:16) or be judged (37:53). Memorizer pair in one surah.
cmp-card:37:16|37:53.relation: The deniers doubt resurrection; the doomed companion doubted judgement.

cmp-card:37:174|37:178.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:37:48|38:52.why: With them are maidens of restrained glance, wide-eyed (37:48) or of equal age (38:52). Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:37:34|77:18.why: Thus We deal with the criminals: with 'indeed We' in 37:34, without in 77:18. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:38:4|50:2.why: They wondered that a warner came from among them: 'and' or 'rather', and the disbelievers said: a lying sorcerer, or a strange thing. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:39:24|39:47.why: The worst punishment on the Day of Resurrection, twice in az-Zumar: shielding the face from it (39:24), and wishing to ransom oneself from it (39:47).
cmp-card:39:24|39:47.relation: The terror of the Day's punishment.

cmp-card:39:48|45:33.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:40:21|40:82.why: Peoples stronger in power and traces on earth, twice in Ghafir with the same warning.

cmp-card:40:30|40:32.why: The believer of Pharaoh's people twice says he fears for them a day: like the day of the confederates (40:30), and the Day of mutual calling (40:32). Same speech; the two objects of fear are easy to confuse.
cmp-card:40:30|40:32.relation: The believer warns of both a worldly ruin like past nations and the Day of Judgement.

cmp-card:41:49|41:51.why: When evil touches man he is despairing (41:49) or full of long prayers (41:51). Memorizer pair and a sharp portrait.
cmp-card:41:49|41:51.relation: Two reactions of the same man to hardship: despair and loud supplication.

cmp-card:43:22|43:23.why: We found our fathers on a way and we are guided by their footsteps (43:22) or following them (43:23). A famous memorizer pair.
cmp-card:43:22|43:23.relation: The present deniers claim guidance; their predecessors merely followed.

cmp-card:47:36|57:20.why: The life of this world is only play and amusement, with two continuations: believe and be rewarded (47:36), a parable of fleeting rain (57:20).
cmp-card:47:36|57:20.relation: The world's vanity and the believer's way out.

cmp-card:47:13|86:10.why: No helper: a stronger town destroyed with none to help it (47:13), and man on the Day with no strength or helper (86:10). The row for 86:10 reads on into an oath that does not belong to the match.
cmp-card:47:13|86:10.relation: Strength fails and no one helps, for towns and for each soul.

cmp-card:48:4|48:7.why: To God belong the armies of the heavens and earth, and God is knowing and wise (48:4) or mighty and wise (48:7). Memorizer pair three ayat apart.
cmp-card:48:4|48:7.relation: The armies bring tranquillity to believers (knowing) and punishment to enemies (mighty).

cmp-card:50:17|70:37.why: A rare paired expression, from the right and from the left, used of the recording angels in 50:17 and of the deniers crowding around the Prophet in 70:37. Easy to confuse in recitation.
cmp-card:50:17|70:37.relation: The same words describe the angels sitting to record and the deniers sitting in groups around the Prophet.

cmp-card:51:50|51:51.why: I am a clear warner to you from Him, closing two consecutive ayat (flee to God; do not set up another god). Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:51:15|52:17.why: The same pair read on into the next ayah: taking what their Lord gave them (because they did good) or enjoying what He gave and protected from Hell. Memorizer pair.

cmp-card:52:43|59:23.why: Glory to Allah above what they associate, after the question of another god (52:43) and the list of names (59:23).

cmp-card:52:16|66:7.why: The same sentence said to the disbelievers in the Fire: you are only repaid for what you did, after telling them patience or excuses are useless.
cmp-card:52:16|66:7.relation: No excuse helps on the Day: only deeds are repaid.

cmp-card:53:36|80:13.why: The scrolls of Musa (53:36) and the honoured scrolls of the Quran (80:13) share only one noun. Different subjects.

cmp-card:54:18|54:21.why: The refrain comes twice in 'Ad's story, before and after the punishment. The books ask why; a small memorizer point already inside the larger refrain card.

cmp-card:57:2|57:5.why: His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth: He gives life and death (57:2), to God all matters return (57:5). Memorizer pair in one passage.

cmp-card:57:12|66:8.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:58:14|60:13.why: Allying with a people with whom Allah is angry: the hypocrites did (58:14), the believers forbidden (60:13).
cmp-card:58:14|60:13.relation: Loyalty to those under Allah's wrath.

cmp-card:58:15|65:10.why: The same threat of severe punishment prepared by Allah, opening an ayah in two neighbouring surahs, with different continuations. Useful for a memorizer.

cmp-card:64:9|65:11.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:68:48|76:24.why: So be patient for your Lord's decision, then do not be like the man of the whale (68:48), do not obey the sinful (76:24).
cmp-card:68:48|76:24.relation: Patience with Allah's decree, two warnings.

cmp-card:69:19|69:25.why: As for him given his record in his right hand, and in his left: the joyful 'read my record' against 'would that I had not been given it'. A direct contrast in the same words.
cmp-card:69:19|69:25.relation: Contrast: the same moment of receiving the record, in delight and in despair.

cmp-card:73:14|79:6.why: The day the earth quakes (73:14), the day the quake quakes (79:6).
cmp-card:73:14|79:6.relation: The shaking of the Day of Judgement.

cmp-card:76:5|76:17.why: Two cups in al-Insan, one mixed with camphor (76:5), one with ginger (76:17). A classic memorizer pair.
cmp-card:76:5|76:17.relation: Two drinks of the righteous, cooling and warming.

cmp-card:82:17|82:18.why: What will make you know what the Day of Judgement is; then what will make you know. Repetition with 'then'; memorizer and emphasis.

cmp-card:83:9|83:20.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:84:2|84:5.why: And it listens to its Lord, as it must: said of the sky (84:2) and of the earth (84:5). Same refrain; memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp-card:84:2|84:5.relation: Heaven and earth both obey their Lord on the Day.

cmp-card:84:22|85:19.why: Rather those who disbelieve deny (84:22) or are in denial (85:19). Memorizer pair in neighbouring surahs.

cmp-card:89:15|89:16.why: When his Lord tests him with honour he says 'my Lord honoured me'; with restricted provision, 'my Lord humiliated me'. A direct contrast in the same words.
cmp-card:89:15|89:16.relation: Contrast: man misreads both ease and hardship as the measure of his worth.

cmp-card:89:6|105:1.why: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with 'Ad, and with the people of the elephant. Memorizer pair and worth pondering.
cmp-card:89:6|105:1.relation: God's dealing with a mighty nation and with an invading army.

cmp-card:92:11|111:2.why: The same clause, his wealth will not avail him, said of the miser in 92:11 and of Abu Lahab in 111:2, once as a future question and once as a past fact.
cmp-card:92:11|111:2.relation: Wealth cannot save the one who denies, whether a type of person or a named enemy.

cmp-card:99:7|99:8.why: Whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it, and of evil will see it. A direct contrast in the same words.
cmp-card:99:7|99:8.relation: Contrast: nothing, good or evil, is too small to be seen.

cmp-card:7:103|10:75.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the three-row card of then after them We sent (with 10:74).

cmp-card:7:59|23:23.why: A repeat: both ayat are in the card of the prophets' call to worship God alone and in the card of the sending of Noah, which show this pair's differences.

cmp-card:7:82|27:56.why: Same story: Lot's people answer only by saying expel them, they keep themselves pure. Near identical in both surahs, with the object named differently.
cmp-card:7:82|27:56.relation: One reply of Lot's people told twice.

cmp-card:7:83|27:57.why: The same places as a book card. By the rule, only the book's card stays.

cmp-card:7:80|29:28.why: Lot to his people: you commit an indecency no one in the worlds did before you, with and without the emphasis, followed by different charges. A memorizer pair.
cmp-card:7:80|29:28.relation: Same story: Lot's rebuke of his people.

cmp-card:11:27|23:24.why: The chiefs who disbelieved among his people said: we see you only as a man like us, or this is only a man like you. Noah's people in two surahs, a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:11:27|23:24.relation: Same objection: a human cannot be a messenger.

cmp-card:15:52|51:25.why: When they entered upon him and said peace, he said: we are afraid of you, or peace, strangers. Two tellings of Abraham's guests, a memorizer pair.

cmp-card:21:83|38:41.why: Job when he called his Lord, harm has touched me: or Satan has touched me with weariness. Two tellings, a memorizer pair.
cmp-card:21:83|38:41.relation: Same story: Job's prayer in affliction.

cmp-card:21:84|38:43.why: His family and as many with them, as mercy from Us (two forms) and a reminder for worshippers or for those of understanding. Same story; memorizer pair.
